agents.bio:
Zugeili Stallworth – Real Estate Professional
As a dedicated and passionate Realtor®, I take pride in guiding individuals and families through one of the most meaningful decisions of their lives, buying or selling a home. With years of experience in residential real estate, I offer clients a combination of professionalism, deep market knowledge, and personalized service tailored to each unique situation.

I specialize in working with a diverse range of clients, from first-time buyers and seasoned investors to families relocating or upgrading. My goal is to make real estate accessible, and I consistently seek out creative financing options, local programs, and down payment assistance opportunities to help clients succeed.

In addition to working with buyers, I excel in selling homes. I use strategic pricing, professional marketing, and strong negotiation skills to ensure my sellers receive the best return on their investment. Whether staging a property, coordinating professional photography, or executing targeted digital marketing campaigns, I am committed to showcasing each home in its best light and achieving outstanding results.

Fluent in both English and Spanish, I proudly serve a diverse community and ensure that every client feels supported and understood. I believe that real estate is not just about transactions, it's about relationships, trust, and building a better future. That’s why I am especially passionate about helping immigrant families and underserved communities gain access to homeownership, financial stability, and generational wealth.

Clients value my calm, professional demeanor, clear communication, and tireless dedication to their goals. I strive to make each step of the process as smooth and stress-free as possible, whether it’s coordinating showings, navigating contracts, or solving unexpected challenges. I am with my clients every step of the way, from our first conversation to closing day and beyond.

Staying current with market trends, loan programs, and local housing policies allows me to provide informed, relevant guidance. I also believe in empowering my clients through education, ensuring they understand each part of the process and feel confident in their decisions.

If you are looking for a Realtor® who combines experience, results, and heart, I would be honored to assist you on your journey. Whether buying, selling, or investing, let’s work together to turn your real estate goals into reality.

Beyond his professional endeavors, he is deeply committed to giving back to the community. He has proudly served as the Vice President of the University of Houston Bauer College of Business Alumni Association and actively volunteers as Treasurer of his church. Houston is not just a market to Justin; it's a vibrant community that he is devoted to contributing to and enhancing.

remarks: Welcome to this exquisite residence nestled in the vibrant heart of Highland Park. This charming 1940s home seamlessly blends timeless character with modern design sensibilities. Featuring three spacious bedrooms plus a bonus room and two full bathrooms, this property boasts a bright and airy open concept layout highlighted by beautiful wood floors, recessed lighting, and new double-pane windows throughout. The updated kitchen offers plenty of counter space, making it ideal for cooking and entertaining, and showcases gorgeous granite countertops and stainless steel appliances. The bathrooms have been beautifully updated with granite counters and elegant stone tiles in the showers. The master bedroom includes a slider that opens to the backyard, perfect for enjoying the serene outdoor space. Additionally, a versatile bonus room can serve as a game room or office, while the detached garage offers endless possibilities, including potential for an ADU or workspace. The property features beautiful landscaping and a variety of fruit trees, including pomegranates, lemons, and more, enhancing the tranquil atmosphere. Situated on a quiet cul-de-sac for added privacy, this home features a lovely front patio with city views. Enjoy the convenience of being just minutes away from dining and shopping scene along Fig and York. With a new AC system, a newer roof, and move-in readiness, this home is the perfect private haven, offering the best of both worlds—historic charm and modern comforts. Don’t miss the opportunity to make this beautiful property your own!

remarks: This southeast-facing residence is the largest remaining three-bedroom available at Encore Brentwood, offering 2,226 square feet of expansive, light-filled living. It is also one of just ten remaining floorplans available in Brentwood's only newly constructed, premium-amenity luxury building. With beautiful natural light throughout the day and sweeping views across the Westside, the home feels open, elevated, and refined. An oversized entertaining area anchors the residence, seamlessly blending kitchen, dining, and living spaces into one impressive open-concept design ideal for hosting or everyday living. Walls of windows enhance the sense of scale while framing the outlook and drawing in sunlight from its prime orientation. The thoughtfully designed layout features three exceptional bedroom suites, each offering privacy and comfort. The spacious primary suite is complemented by two additional well-proportioned suites, creating flexibility for guests, family, or a dedicated office space. Interiors are finished with sleek hardwood flooring, custom German closets, and a chef-caliber kitchen equipped with Sub-Zero and Wolf appliances. Encore Brentwood offers a curated suite of resort-style amenities, including a state-of-the-art fitness center, yoga and meditation studio, pool and spa with cabanas, outdoor fire pit, screening room, conference space, rose garden, and an outdoor kitchen complete with pizza oven and BBQ. Residents enjoy secure gated parking, 24-hour security, and immediate access to San Vicente Boulevard's premier dining, shopping, and neighborhood charm. A rare opportunity to own the largest remaining three-bedroom in this exclusive 39-residence community. *These photos reflect a similar unit.*

When considering accomplished real estate professionals, Rebecca Strauss stands out not just as a choice, but as an invaluable partner ready to help you achieve your ambitious real estate goals.

David Berg is a Founding Partner of Smith & Berg Property Group at Compass, the #1 Medium-Sized Real Estate Team in Los Angeles and the #7 in the nation according to The Wall Street Journal's 2026 REALTrends Report based on verified sales volume rankings. Alongside co-founder F. Ron Smith, he has helped build one of the most respected and recognizable brands in luxury real estate, generating more than $7.5 billion in residential sales while representing some of the most significant transactions across Los Angeles.

Known throughout the industry simply as "Berg," he is widely regarded as one of Southern California's leading real estate advisors. With more than two decades in the business, he has developed a reputation for bringing clarity, strategy, and certainty to situations where others struggle to find solutions. His experience spans record-setting estates, new construction, land acquisitions, trusts, probate sales, receiverships, bankruptcy proceedings, and bank-owned properties, making him a trusted resource for clients navigating both opportunity and complexity.

Berg personally advises high-net-worth clientele including business leaders, entrepreneurs, developers, professional athletes, entertainers, and family offices throughout Los Angeles, with a particular focus on Brentwood, Pacific Palisades, Santa Monica, Bel Air, Beverly Hills, and the surrounding Westside neighborhoods. His approach combines institutional-level analysis with hands-on execution, helping clients maximize value through strategic positioning and exposure.

His expertise in land and development is particularly sought after. Berg regularly advises clients from acquisition through entitlement, design, construction, branding, and ultimate disposition. He is known for identifying opportunities before they become obvious to the broader market and for helping developers and homeowners make informed decisions at every stage of the process. Following the Palisades Fire, he emerged as a trusted expert on redevelopment and recovery, representing more land transactions in Pacific Palisades than any other agent and helping shape the next chapter of one of Los Angeles' most iconic communities.

A lifelong Angeleno, Berg offers clients a rare combination of local knowledge, long-standing relationships, and access to discreet offerings before they become available on the open market. His work and listings have been featured in acclaimed publications including The Wall Street Journal, Los Angeles Times, The Hollywood Reporter, Variety, Los Angeles Business Journal, Los Angeles Magazine, Robb Report, Mansion Global, and The Real Deal. He also co-publishes Tacos & Tequila, the team's award-winning blog covering luxury real estate, architecture, design, and Los Angeles culture.

Berg is an active supporter of Steadfast LA, the Children's Burn Foundation, the Jewish Federation, and the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation. He lives in Brentwood with his wife and their three sons. Outside of work, he enjoys playing hockey and has a longstanding appreciation for architecture, art, and the neighborhoods that make Los Angeles one of the world's most dynamic places to call home.

agents.bio: Lisa obtained her real estate license in 2011 after 13 years in the title industry. She started out managing a large volume of HUD foreclosures in the beginning of her career and then recruited her husband, Alex, to help streamline the process. After a couple of years selling foreclosures, Lisa switched gears and focused on new construction. She sold out a new home community in Garden Oaks in less than 2 years and was awarded a Million Dollar Circle Award by the Greater Houston Builders Association Sales and Marketing Council. In 2017, Lisa opened a boutique real estate brokerage, Tejas Realty Group. The brokerage started out with 2 agents and now has a team of 25. Lisa is a licensed real estate broker, wife, and mother. She volunteers with the Houston Livestock show and Rodeo, the Houston Association of Realtors Global Advisory Group, and the Texas Realtors Professional Development Committee. Lisa was also the Women's Council of Realtors Houston 2023 President and the 2024 Texas District Vice President.  She is currently the 2025 National Women's Council of Realtors Global Mastermind Co-Chair and the National Association of Hispanic Real Estate Professionals Secretary.

Alex decided to pursue a career in real estate in 2012 where he joined forces with his wife, Lisa to create a powerhouse team.  Alex came into the real estate industry after experiencing a successful career as a paralegal; helping homeowners with all aspects of real estate law from drafting deeds to loan modifications.  He immediately earned recognition from various asset management companies as a top tier market analyst.  With a firm understanding of big business and Houston’s ever changing market dynamics, Alex brings a refined and strategic approach when consulting with his clients. When Alex is not selling real estate, he is enjoying family time with his daughter Alessandra and his boxer Titan.  Alex is an avid tennis player and loves playing golf.  He has received the Houston Association of Realtors Top Producing Realtor reward multiple times and has earned several designations such as Certified Negotiation Expert, Certified Neighborhood Specialist and Seller Representative Specialist to name a few.

Adrian Wright works at the Malibu Compass office, serving Malibu, Topanga, Calabasas, and the greater Los Angeles area. Adrian’s family moved to Topanga in 1976, and she earned her real estate license in 1986. She began her real estate career working for Jon Douglas Company in Topanga and the West Valley. She has worked in real estate or real estate finance, in the area, for most of the past 31 years, as a realtor, escrow officer, and loan officer. She currently volunteers for The Topanga Women's Circle, which sets up short term housing for homeless families and veteran families. She has also volunteered her time on Topanga Elementary Charter School Committees, PTO Board, Booster Club Board, as a fundraiser for Palisades Charter High’s inaugural surf team, of which her son was a founding member.

An avid bodysurfer, hiker, and former “Surf Mom” who spent long summer hours “wave shopping” with her sons, Adrian is passionate about the ocean and the environment, and has participated in Beach and Creek clean-ups over the years. Adrian passed on her passion for our local beaches and mountains to her two sons, Jordan and Biko. Adrian has teamed up with her son, Jordan Wright, who also works at Compass Malibu. She managed the office of the Resource Conservation District of the Santa Monica Mountains during a 2-year hiatus from real estate, in the 90s, where she gained a deep understanding of the environmental concerns of our communities. agents.bio:
He is very knowledgeable about the nuances in many neighborhoods throughout Houston, which strengthens his ability to help people relocating to Houston from other cities. David's primary concern is satisfying his clients, because satisfied clients generate repeat business and referrals. 

A native Houstonian, David graduated from Memorial High School in 1980 and received a BA in finance from the University of Texas at Austin in 1984. He traveled internationally after college, then moved to California, where he cultivated a diverse management background, including two years in residential mortgage brokerage, nine years in international trade management, and six years in enterprise software sales management. 

David returned to Houston in 2001, obtained his real estate license, and joined his father, David H Young, in residential real estate sales. In January 2005, they started the David Young Team, bringing together top-producing agents and experienced assistants to provide the highest quality service to buyers and sellers of residential real estate. They were recognized for 12 years by the Houston Business Journal as one of the Top 5 Teams in Houston, with sales volume over $100,000,000 per year.

David joined Compass in October 2020, where he has operated as Young Realty Group - a small team of agents and a licensed assistant with them since 2014. ?On a personal level, David's wife Brenda and he are very active in animal rescue. She established Save A Purrfect Cat Rescue many years ago and they, along with an army of volunteers, find homes for 250-300 cats yearly. To keep fit he has practiced Tae Kwon Do since the 1990s and has been a member of the Houstonian Club since 2007. He also relieves stress by banging on his drum set.

A native Houstonian, Lance graduated from Memorial High School in 1980, went on to the University of Texas at Austin where he received his degrees in business administration and marketing, and attended graduate school at McCombs Graduate School of Business in Austin.

Since the 1980s, Lance has successfully acquired an influential background in building sales, office leasing, marketing and divesting. He also possesses wide-ranging understanding of business management through his experiences owning and managing both private and public companies.

The "Lance philosophy" as a real estate agent is that he must earn his clients business by putting their complete satisfaction first and foremost. He believes that satisfied clients generate repeat business and referrals.

Throughout his career, Lance has had the honor of representing many deserving clients in the Houston area. He first entered the world of residential real estate and then became a top producer, focused on the West University, River Oaks, Bellaire and Close-In Memorial neighborhoods. Now Lance continues his work as a luxury-home agent for both buyers and sellers throughout the Houston area.

As a Texas Real Estate Commission licensed real estate broker, a member of the Texas Association of Realtors, and a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Lance values the trust of his clients and the respect of his fellow brokers and agents.  In his free time, Lance enjoys spending time with his wife, Valerie and their dog Maxwell.  He is also a competitive triathlete, so he is always running, biking or swimming. Lance is a fan of live music venues and watching Houston sports.

Lily, a refugee from Vietnam, has always sought a sense of security and stability. Her life has been marked by constant transitions, from leaving Saigon to pursuing a career as a News Anchor in various cities, before returning home to Houston. Having personally experienced the challenges of finding the right home in different locations, Lily empathizes with the emotional significance of this decision. Now firmly rooted in Houston, she is grateful for the opportunity to assist others in discovering a place within the city where they can truly feel at home.

agents.bio:
Fourth-generation Houstonian Ed Wolff grew up watching his mother, Beth Wolff, build a world-class residential real estate business. After college at Louisiana State University (LSU), Ed joined the family firm and learned the ropes, working his way up to president of the company. Today, Ed and Beth preside over Beth Wolff Realtors®, one of Texas’ most successful residential brokerages and respected mother-son enterprises. Whether it’s new construction, townhouses, or luxury homes, Ed enjoys assisting buyers and sellers throughout Houston - and beyond. He holds the Certified Relocation Professional (CRP) and Certified International Property Specialist (CIPS) designations and is often called upon to share his expertise through talks at real estate seminars and meetings in many different countries.
As a director and spokesperson for FIABCI-USA, the American Chapter of the International Real Estate Federation, he promoted his hometown and the USA in cities around the globe and was instrumental in bringing the World Congress of FIABCI to Houston in 2004. An active promoter and supporter of the professional real estate community, Ed has served on the Houston Association of Realtors® (HAR) and Texas Association of Realtors® (TAR) boards of directors, and is a past chair of TREPAC (Texas Association of Realtors® in Political Action Committee), and contributes his expertise to HAR Governmental Affairs. Ed has received several awards and recognitions including the HAR 2008 John E. Wolf Citizenship Cup Award and HAR 2010 REALTOR of the Year.
Houston Business Journal recognized him with its “40 Under 40” award, presented to Houston’s top 40 business people under the age of 40 who excel in their industries and show dynamic leadership in their community. Beth and Ed share fascinating family history. Their family was established in Texas during Mexican colonial times when an ancestor received a land grant from the Mexican government and has been an influential presence in the business and civic affairs of Houston since the 1880s.

agents.bio:
As a 5th generation Houstonian, I have a deep appreciation for this city and its people. This is an exciting time to live in the Greater Houston Area, and I'm proud to be a part of it all! I've been licensed for 10 plus years and have successfully closed over 500 transactions since 2010. Although I live and work in Bellaire, I proudly serve the entire Houston market and will continue to provide exceptional service for each of my clients and my community as a whole. As your Real Estate Specialist, I promise to be your trusted resource for answers about the process of buying or selling. I will provide expertise about neighborhood features and schools and will target your home search based on your individual needs and wants. My custom innovative marketing strategies along with my strong negotiation skills are the keys to your successful transaction.

As an agent who's an expert in this local area, I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise about buying and selling real estate here. It's not the same everywhere, so you need someone you can trust for up-to-date information. I am eager to serve you. Here are some of the things I can do for you. Do you need someone who knows this area inside and out? I can work with you to find the right home at the right price for you, including all the neighborhood amenities that matter - not to mention the essential criteria you have for your ideal home. When it's time to move, you need someone who will advertise your home, show it to prospective buyers, negotiate the purchase contract, arrange to finance, oversee the inspections, handle all necessary paperwork and supervise the closing. I can take care of everything you need, from start to close. Oftentimes buyers don't visualize living in your home the way you do. I can make your home attractive to its ideal audience which can help you get top dollar. Things like staging the home, making repairs or minor improvements, or even simply painting the walls can be the difference between a home resting on the market and one that's sold fast.

remarks: Alluring 1935 Spanish Revival in the Heart of West Adams-2 Bedroom, 1 Bath. Step into the timeless elegance of 1935 with this exquisitely preserved Spanish Revival unit, located in the coveted West Adams District of Los Angeles. This 2-bedroom, 1-bath gem exudes character and historical charm, perfectly blending period style and modern comfort. From the moment you arrive, the architectural details transport you to a bygone era of craftsmanship, with every curve and corner thoughtfully designed to evoke a sense of history and sophistication. The unit s facade, with its crisp white stucco exterior, terracotta tile roof, and soft blue accents, is a classic example of the Spanish Revival architecture that swept Los Angeles in the early 20th century. The unique arched windows adorned with decorative shutters invite sunlight to dance through the interiors, creating a warm and welcoming ambiance. These striking arched and semi-circular windows provide architectural interest and a perfect frame for the lush, tree-lined street views. Inside, the living room opens up with an airy, spacious feel, accentuated by high, textured ceilings and period-correct plaster walls that exude character. A sculpted decorative fireplace becomes the room s focal point, reminding you of the home s 1930s roots while adding a touch of romance to the space. New floors span the unit; their warmth sets the perfect backdrop for easy living, creating a seamless flow between rooms. A Thoughtful Blend of Vintage and Contemporary while maintaining its historic integrity, this unit has been updated for today's lifestyle. The remodeled kitchen combines modern amenities with vintage-inspired cabinetry and fixtures that complement the unit's original style. Large, classic windows line the walls, flooding each room with natural light and bringing out the rich tones of the interior design. The bathroom retains vintage charm with tasteful tilework that nods to the period style, harmonizing beautifully with the home s overall aesthetic. This unit's private front yard, framed by elegant, curved walls and lush landscaping, offers a charming outdoor space that feels secluded and inviting. Enjoy an evening on the front porch, overlooking the beautifully landscaped yard and appreciating the classic California sunsets. With easy access to West Adams' trendy cafes, local shops, and cultural landmarks, this home offers a lifestyle that blends the best of historic LA charm with modern urban convenience.

Home Buying and Selling as EASY as Pye—that’s more than a motto for Colleen Pye; it’s her mission. With over 21 years of experience in residential real estate, Colleen brings skill, heart, and a personal touch to every transaction. Whether helping first-time buyers, seasoned sellers, or real estate investors, she delivers trusted guidance with a commitment to making the process smooth and successful.

Based in Tomball and proudly serving the surrounding Greater Houston area, Colleen holds multiple professional designations, including SRES® (Seniors Real Estate Specialist), CDPE, CRS, EPRO, and QSC. Her background and certifications enable her to assist a wide range of clients—from retirees transitioning to the next chapter, to investors growing their portfolios.

Colleen has called Tomball home for over a decade, living in a lovingly built custom home with her husband in the heart of downtown. She’s a familiar and trusted face in the community, serving as an Ambassador for the Tomball Chamber of Commerce, a Planning & Zoning Commissioner for the City of Tomball, and an active member of the Heart of Tomball Alliance.

Outside of real estate, Colleen enjoys sourdough baking, home cooking, gardening, and giving back through volunteer work. Her blend of professionalism, local insight, and genuine care make her a go-to partner for anyone looking to buy, sell, or invest in the Tomball area.

agents.bio:
As a 5th generation Houstonian, I have a deep appreciation for this city and its people. This is an exciting time to live in the Greater Houston Area, and I'm proud to be a part of it all! I've been licensed for 10 plus years and have successfully closed over 500 transactions since 2010. Although I live and work in Bellaire, I proudly serve the entire Houston market and will continue to provide exceptional service for each of my clients and my community as a whole. As your Real Estate Specialist, I promise to be your trusted resource for answers about the process of buying or selling. I will provide expertise about neighborhood features and schools and will target your home search based on your individual needs and wants. My custom innovative marketing strategies along with my strong negotiation skills are the keys to your successful transaction.

As an agent who's an expert in this local area, I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise about buying and selling real estate here. It's not the same everywhere, so you need someone you can trust for up-to-date information. I am eager to serve you. Here are some of the things I can do for you. Do you need someone who knows this area inside and out? I can work with you to find the right home at the right price for you, including all the neighborhood amenities that matter - not to mention the essential criteria you have for your ideal home. When it's time to move, you need someone who will advertise your home, show it to prospective buyers, negotiate the purchase contract, arrange to finance, oversee the inspections, handle all necessary paperwork and supervise the closing. I can take care of everything you need, from start to close. Oftentimes buyers don't visualize living in your home the way you do. I can make your home attractive to its ideal audience which can help you get top dollar. Things like staging the home, making repairs or minor improvements, or even simply painting the walls can be the difference between a home resting on the market and one that's sold fast.

remarks: Welcome to 11107 Savannah Oaks Lane, an elegant 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath residence in a secure gated community, offering modern luxury and exceptional design. Soaring 12-foot ceilings create an airy, light-filled ambiance, while the first-floor living space is perfectly tailored for both comfort and entertaining.The open-concept kitchen features sleek Poliform Italian cabinetry, stone countertops, and premium Bertazzoni appliances, including a 5-burner gas range and microwave. The spacious living room is anchored by a 10-foot sliding glass pane door that seamlessly connects the indoors to the outdoors.Upstairs the expansive primary suite is a true retreat, boasting a spa-like bathroom with a soaking tub, separate shower, and an impressive walk-in closet. Each bedroom offers its own en-suite bathroom for ultimate convenience and privacy.This home delivers an elevated lifestyle in one of Houston’s most desirable communities—close to shopping, dining, and top-rated schools.

A Top Producer for the last 10 years, with over 350 transactions under her belt, accumulating a career volume of almost $265+ million, Rachel Conkling is your go-to Houston realtor. A long-time Houstonian with a passion for real estate and an energy level that is unmatched. Buying or selling a home can be complicated and stressful, and Rachel’s goal is to make the process as smooth and enjoyable as possible from start to finish.

It is evident that her approach and knowledge throughout each transaction, have contributed to her remarkable success from day one: At her previous broker, she was inducted into their Hall of Fame in 2019, recognized as the top producing new agent, 2014, received the award for Most Transactions with Buyers, 2016, and was one of the Top 25 Producing Agents 3rd Quarter 2016 and 2nd Quarter 2018. Recently, Rachel was a Houston Business Journal Residential Award Winner, 2022, ranked #25 in the city based on sales volume. Rachel thrives on guiding her clients during the home sale or purchase process, always an exciting, yet emotional milestone in people's lives. 

Rachel specializes in all areas "inside the Loop" and "just outside the Loop" including The Heights, Oak Forest/Garden Oaks, Montrose, Rice Military, West University, River Oaks, Tanglewood, Briargrove, Spring Branch, Memorial, Memorial West, and Bellaire. Rachel graduated from Second Baptist High School in Houston. She comes from "a long line of Longhorns," graduating from the University of Texas, Austin, where she was a member of Pi Beta Phi. Later she earned an M.B.A. from Houston Baptist University. She is a member of St. Martins Episcopal Church, serves on the board for The Children's Fund, Inc., and is a member of the Salvation Army Women's Auxiliary. Rachel and her husband are the proud parents of two little girls and enjoy living in Memorial.

Betty Shindler’s real estate roots run deep. A native Texan from Crockett, Betty worked side-by-side for 31 years with her late husband, Jim Shindler, in their Houston real estate company. The Shindlers handled residential and commercial properties, property management, and property development. Betty KNOWS Houston and loves every aspect of real estate from assisting buyers to find their dream home to guiding sellers through the process of marketing and selling their home. “My clients become life-long friends,” Betty says, “and that’s one of the nicest parts of this business.”

Betty is experienced, enthusiastic and energetic. She ranks organization and communication as two of her greatest strengths, allowing her to focus on her clients’ goals and to keep them fully informed.

Every day is a gift, according to Betty. She believes in giving back to the Houston community and had been an active supporter of the March of Dimes Foundation, Crohn’s & Colitis Foundation of America, The Museum of Fine Arts, The Moores School of Music at the University of Houston, and other philanthropic organizations. Betty is a member of St. John the Divine Episcopal Church.

When not working, Betty, a high-rise condominium resident, spends as much time as possible with her children and grandchildren. She enjoys leisure hours at the beach or in the mountains, exercises, reads, and listens to music.

remarks: Step inside this beautifully reimagined Spanish-style residence where timeless architecture meets fresh, contemporary design. Nestled in the heart of Vermont Knolls, a neighborhood known for its tree-lined streets, central location, and easy access to dining, parks, and transit, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers the perfect balance of historic charm and modern convenience. The light-filled living room welcomes you with smart Hue recessed lighting and bay windows framed by new shutters, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. Flowing seamlessly into the dining area and kitchen, the space showcases white shaker cabinetry, Calacatta quartz countertops, a crisp herringbone tile backsplash, and stainless steel appliances - an ideal setting for both everyday living and entertaining. Both bathrooms reflect a refined Spanish-modern aesthetic, featuring designer lighting, stylish tilework, and thoughtfully appointed vanities. Wide-plank luxury laminate flooring runs throughout, enhancing the home's cohesive, open design. Outdoors, the gated front patio offers a charming and versatile space for morning coffee, evening gatherings, or quiet relaxation. The backyard, designed with drought-tolerant xeriscape landscaping, presents a blank canvas ready to be reimagined into your own outdoor retreat. Completing the property is a finished garage with recessed lighting, laminate flooring, and mini-split heating and cooling. Offering ADU potential, this versatile space is ready to become a guest suite, private office, studio, or gym, and offers nearly 300 more square feet of living area. Perfectly blending character, style, and opportunity, this home embodies the best of Los Angeles living in a design all its own.

After moving to Westwood to attend U.C.L.A., Ron has lived in Santa Monica, the Valley, and West Hollywood, before finally settling with his family in the South Bay. They now live in Manhattan Beach’s Tree Section where his daughters attend American Martyrs School.

Ron believes in real estate done right. And he believes that the most important way to do that is to listen to really hear what the client wants and needs, and to put all other concerns aside in pursuit of that. Ron knows how important your decision to buy or sell a property is. After 30 years working as an actor working in both TV and Film, Ron has brought that passion to real estate. He loves helping people find the perfect place to call home or helping someone get the best price for their property so that they can achieve their dreams. He believes that this job is all about service. At the end of the day, he wants to look back and know that he always did right by his clients.

Trey Poteet is a Houston-based real estate agent who specializes in helping individuals and families relocate to the Houston area. As a native Houstonian, Trey provides relocating buyers with local insight, clear guidance, and a streamlined approach to navigating one of the largest and most diverse real estate markets in the country.

Houston’s size and variety can be challenging for those moving from out of state or transferring within Texas. Trey helps relocation buyers understand neighborhood differences, commute patterns, school districts, housing styles, and pricing trends across Houston and its surrounding communities. His goal is to help clients quickly narrow their options and make confident, well-informed decisions.

Trey works with corporate relocations, remote professionals, and families moving to Houston for career opportunities, lifestyle changes, or long-term investment. He takes a consultative approach, focusing on education, realistic expectations, and strong negotiation to protect his clients’ interests throughout the buying process.

In addition to relocation buyers, Trey assists sellers and local buyers across the Houston metro area. Sellers benefit from strategic pricing, professional marketing, and data-driven exposure designed to maximize value and reduce time on market.

Known for his responsiveness and clear communication, Trey partners with a trusted network of lenders, inspectors, and service providers to help ensure smooth, efficient transactions—especially important for clients coordinating moves from outside the area.

Whether you are relocating to Houston, purchasing a primary residence, or investing in real estate, Trey Poteet offers professional representation and local expertise you can rely on.

remarks: Opportunity is Knocking! Outstanding Highland Park property featuring 2 homes on 1 lot, Zoned LARD2. This is the one you have been waiting for! Family owned for almost 50 years! The front house draws you in with the charming raised covered front porch providing ideal views of the neighborhood. Step back in time to this meticulously maintained home complimented by old and new charm. The stunning hardwood floors and bold baseboards throughout are impressive, crown molding and curved ceiling with ceiling fan in the living room are inviting features. The dining room boasts a functional built in buffet with lights and glass fronts, quite the statement and period piece. The decorative glass doors leading to the kitchen open and close giving a different feel to each room. The kitchen has been updated and your solid surface counters with seamless sink are in impeccable condition and the amount of cabinet space is perfect. The remodeled hall bath was designed with a large jetted tub with detachable wand, the primary is generous in size and allows for a large walk in closet, both bedrooms have ceiling fans and mirrored wardrobe closets. Other improvements include a tankless water heater, copper plumbing, most windows have been updated, electrical panel and roof (approx 11 years old) The Back House - Super cute 1+1 with kitchen and living room! Wow, what incredible space. Upgrades and features of this home include roof (approx 11 years old), bamboo floors in living room, plush berber carpeting in the bedroom, kitchen with cook top, fridge and sink. 2 split unit air conditioners, copper plumbing, updated windows, ceiling fans and paneled doors. Bathroom with tiled floors and a walk in shower. This completely fenced and gated yard is designed to accommodate multiple cars, has incredible fig and Meyer lemon trees, storage areas, outside laundry cabinet, the second home has its own electric and gas meter, water is shared. A must see to appreciate the love and care that this home has received!

I dedicate myself to helping clients take one of the biggest steps in life. remarks: Where 1920's Charm Meets Modern Living! Picture yourself arriving home to this stunning Tudor, where a charming blue fence and sliding driveway gate welcome you into your own private sanctuary. As you step onto the front deck with your morning coffee, you'll find yourself naturally connecting with neighbors as they stroll by with their dogs. Enter through the front door and be swept away by soaring vaulted ceilings that frame an original fireplace mantel - a beautiful reminder of the home's rich history. The expansive dining room continues the dramatic ceiling treatment, creating the perfect backdrop for intimate dinners or grand holiday celebrations. Your daily routine flows effortlessly from the beautifully remodeled kitchen, where a breakfast bar becomes your casual dining spot, into the adjacent home office. Here, original restored glass doors and built-in shelving create an inspiring workspace, while the arched window and vaulted ceiling make even the longest work days feel special. At day's end, retreat to the master suite where luxury awaits. The renovated bathroom features dual showers within original arched entries, blending authentic Spanish character with modern convenience. Step directly from your bedroom onto the private back patio, where avocado and peach trees create your personal oasis - perfect for morning meditation or evening entertaining. Throughout this lovingly restored home, you'll appreciate the thoughtful updates: a brand new roof overhead, efficient HVAC keeping you comfortable year-round, wraparound new fencing and gleaming new floors underfoot. The gated driveway provides secure parking, while the detached garage offers additional storage or workshop space. This isn't just a house - it's a lifestyle where historic charm and modern comfort create the perfect backdrop for your next chapter.

agents.bio: I have been passionately selling Real Estate for 28 years in Los Angeles and my sales consistently rank in the top 1% of all the agents in the county. I recognize and value the trust my clients place in me and I strive every day to exceed their expectations. My clients view me as a partnership in their decision-making process, as I guide them through the problems, and intricate details of every deal and situation. My market knowledge, my negotiating strategies, and my thinking out of the box, has clients coming back for many years. I work with some very strong personalities, and first-time home buyers and they deserve the amount of attention to the details that goes into every single transaction and is the reason of my years of success. Drew Smyth was born in Issaquah, Washington, where he grew up racing motocross, playing rugby and drag racing his 64 Chevelle, which he still has! His first job out of school was selling cars, and he did it successfully for 3 years. Needing a change, Drew decided to move to California in 2010. He got his first taste of the hot real estate market when he worked doing short sales with investors and real estate agents. In 2018 he decided to take the leap into being a real estate agent himself. The first year was a lot of learning, but by his second year as an agent, Drew was already in the top 50% of his KW office. By his third year Drew was in the top 20% of his office and was asked to join the ALC board of directors for the KW Los Feliz office. After closing over 5 million in sales in 2020 alone, Drew has become one of the top agents to call when looking to buy or sell in the LA area. In a market that is hot, and people are offering over asking, Drew has become creative in finding ways to get discounts or instant equity on 90% of his sales for clients. The need to win for his clients is always his biggest drive for Drew. His chill demeanor, cheerful outlook, and unique laugh will keep you calm as you navigate one of the biggest purchases of your life. Do yourself a favor and call Drew when you are ready to buy, sell or lease real estate.

remarks: Welcome to 2353 Lucerne Ave, where timeless elegance meets modern luxury in this stunning Spanish Revival home that will capture your heart from the moment you arrive behind the charming white picket fence and discover your personal sanctuary a gorgeous retreat adorned with swaying palm trees, vibrant birds of paradise, and mature landscaping that creates an instant sense of tranquility. Enter through the welcoming foyer where beautiful marble tile floors gleam beneath soaring ceilings and an elegant chandelier sets the tone for the sophistication that flows throughout, as European oak floors guide you through graceful arched entryways into the completely renovated kitchen where your culinary dreams come alive with brand-new stainless steel appliances, a professional gas cooktop, and stunning tile work extending to the ceiling, all crowned by a custom-made range hood that serves as both functional art and conversation starter. The sun-drenched dining room showcases the home's original character with beautiful arched windows flooding the space with natural light while French doors open to the private side yard, creating seamless flow between kitchen, dining, and living areas that makes hosting a joy. Down the thoughtfully lit hallway, you'll discover a versatile first bedroom perfect as a guest suite or home office, plus a bathroom that's a work of art itself with unique tile floors and perfectly placed sconces creating spa-like ambiance, while convenient laundry placement keeps daily life effortless. The true showstopper awaits in the primary suite your personal oasis featuring peek-a-boo views, a palm tree framed perfectly outside your window, a generous walk-in closet, and the crown jewel master bathroom where luxury knows no bounds as you imagine starting each day with breathtaking views of the Santa Monica Mountains and Culver City from your soaking tub or refreshing in the double shower with double vanity convenience. Step outside to the back deck that beckons for morning coffee or evening gatherings surrounded by fruit trees that add both beauty and bounty to your daily life, while the detached garage offers endless possibilities as an art studio, motorcycle haven, or extra storage, complemented by easily accessible under-house storage and a newly redone front parking spot that seamlessly blends 1920s character with today's lifestyle needs. This isn't just a house it's your gateway to the California dream, where every detail has been carefully curated to create a living experience that's both luxurious and livable, so don't just imagine your perfect home come see it at 2353 Lucerne Ave and make this Spanish Revival masterpiece your own.

agents.bio:
As an award-winning real estate agent for the past twenty years, Jennifer has built a successful business based on her diverse knowledge, professionalism, and a keen sensitivity to her client's needs. Her education and background are in art and business; prior to becoming a Realtor, Jennifer earned her B.F.A. in fine art and worked as a studio artist, then took positions with two major art auction houses in Los Angeles. At Christie's she served as Assistant Vice President, Operations Manager, and at Butterfield & Butterfield, as Director of LA Estates.

While at Christie's and B&B she established relationships with collectors, buyers, business managers and financial professionals, in addition to managing and supervising exhibitions and auctions. She honed her negotiating skills, set up unique events, and developed marketing strategies. While managing complex logistics of house sales at Christie's, her interest in architecture and real estate grew.

Becoming a real estate agent was a natural progression for Jennifer, as it merged her client-centered business skills with her knowledge of art, architecture, and design. By nature, an enthusiastic, outgoing, and initiative-taking person, Jennifer enjoys helping her clients find and create opportunities they might miss out on otherwise. She can see potential in a property and can often assist or advise on aesthetic changes that make a significant difference.

Jennifer loves what she does—working as a "firsthand" agent, helping clients through the entire process of buying or selling, educating them along the way so they feel comfortable with every decision they make. Whether staging an attractive interior, negotiating a deal, or helping a client envision how they might modify a property, Jennifer's great attention to detail allows her clients to relax and feel excited, not stressed, about buying or selling a home.

remarks: Brand-new 3-bedroom, 2-bath home in Houston’s Clinton Park Tri-Community, designed for comfort, efficiency, and accessibility. With a HERS rating of 58, this ENERGY STAR® certified home outperforms most new builds, lowering utility costs while providing year-round comfort. Net-zero ready, it can generate as much energy as it consumes when paired with solar. Features include efficient appliances, advanced insulation, and a high-performance cooling system. Accessibility is built in with wide doorways, step-free entry, and ADA-friendly design, making the home functional and welcoming for all. Nestled on a quiet street surrounded by other new homes, it offers both privacy and a sense of community while remaining just minutes from downtown Houston and area amenities. Scheduled for completion September 2025, this home is an ideal choice for buyers seeking modern living that is sustainable, affordable, and inclusive.

agents.bio:
With nearly two decades of experience, Michael Maguire has built a distinguished reputation as one of the foremost experts in the greater Los Angeles market. Michael consistently ranks among the top 1.5% of real estate agents nationwide, bringing unmatched expertise, a refined eye for design, and a deep understanding of the intricacies of the luxury market. With a track record of success, Michael has built lasting relationships with clients, guiding them through the complexities of real estate transactions with ease and confidence. Whether it’s negotiating high-profile sales, advising on real estate wealth strategy, or curating the perfect property presentation, Michael delivers an unparalleled experience in every aspect of the process.

Known for his client-first approach, Michael is committed to delivering an exceptional client experience, focusing on what truly matters: trust, honesty, communication and the achievement of each client's unique goals. Michael combines world-class service with a deep passion for art, architecture and design. His attention to detail and distinct eye for style offer an advantage to his broad clientele within the sports and entertainment industry.

Michael graduated from Northeastern University with a Bachelor of Arts in English. Today he lives in Los Feliz with his longtime partner in a quintessential 1920's historic home that they continue to meticulously restore. Michael also has been noted as one of Los Angeles Business Journal's Real Estate All Stars and featured in The Wall Street Journal, Los Angeles Times, Real Trends and Real Trends: The Thousand. He was one of the first 25 Compass agents in Los Angeles and is a member of the Compass Sports and Entertainment Division.

A Southern California native, Victoria Massengale has become a vital real estate resource for Los Angeles residents for more than twelve years. Navigating the expansive geographical terrains from the Hollywood Hills to LA's beaches, Victoria has catapulted her career with her honest, genuine approach to providing quick, timely advice to clients that ultimately saves buyers and sellers thousands of dollars.

Victoria's humorous, solutions-based approach to navigating the real estate market partnered with her extensive knowledge of the category makes her a highly sought-after agent who has represented the sales of home such clients as Vince Vaughn and Anthony Broccoli Estates. Most recently, she represented Mr. Alan Rothenberg - former President of the Los Angeles Clippers and founding partner of the prestigious Manatt, Phelps, Rothenberg & Phillips Law firm, in addition to numerous celebrities in the purchase of multi-million-dollar homes.

Today, Victoria brings her candid real estate expertise to the public through a series of videos, designed for home buyers and sellers alike. She offers friendly, down-to-earth solutions to common obstacles both current and future homeowners face when buying and selling property.

Victoria has been featured in AOL Real Estate, The Huffington Post, The Los Angeles Times, Curbed LA and on the television shows, Million Dollar Listing, Selling LA, and Scoring the Deal.

Adam’s start in real estate is a natural progression from his experience in the world of entertainment aligned with his passion and commitment to the community. Before his real estate career, Adam was a managing partner representing talent for over 15 years. Being able to draw on a large network of celebrity clientele he created relationships with nightclubs and casinos managing their celebrity events. He would hone a concept then leverage personal relationships to find cost-effective ways to enhance branding and create “relevance in the marketplace.”

This collaborative work ethic comes naturally to Adam, allowing him to exercise his unwavering dedication to community service and urban planning. agents.bio:
Carol Rowley launched her real estate career in Georgia with DeForest Realty before relocating to Houston, where she gained invaluable experience working alongside top real estate and tax attorneys. She later joined Bolin Development Corp., focusing on commercial real estate.

Today, Carol is a 20+ year Top Producer and has been recognized by the Houston Business Journal as one of Houston’s Top 25 Individual Realtors. Her remarkable success is built on attention to detail, hard work, and an exceptional referral network. Known for being highly goal-oriented, Carol delivers first-class service from start to finish, ensuring every client feels confident and cared for throughout the process.

In 2017, Carol’s daughter, Paige Jones, joined her, creating one of Houston’s most dynamic mother-daughter real estate teams—a duo clients rave about for their energy, expertise, and dedication.

Deep Roots in Houston
Having lived in West University, Southgate, Bellaire, Braes Heights, and Old Braeswood, Carol offers clients unparalleled insight into the Houston market. Her years of volunteering at local schools—West U Elementary, River Oaks Baptist, Lanier Middle, and Lamar High—deepened her connection to the community she loves.

Now, with her three children grown and thriving—graduates of UT, NYU, St. Edward’s, Tulane, and Duke—Carol dedicates even more time to delivering exceptional results for her clients.

Clients consistently praise Carol’s professionalism and personal touch:

“I’ve always been skeptical about the value of a real estate agent—until I worked with Carol. She made the process a pleasure and truly earned my trust. I’ve already referred her to three friends!”

Another client shared:

“You went above and beyond to negotiate and guide us through a challenging process. You earned every penny of your commission—and our gratitude.”

A Passion for Service—In Real Estate and Beyond
Carol’s commitment extends beyond real estate. For more than 25 years, she has been a driving force in the fight against juvenile diabetes through her work with the Juvenile Diabetes Research Foundation (JDRF). Her leadership earned her the prestigious Living and Giving Award at the JDRF Promise Ball. She also served as Chair of the JDRF Children’s Congress in Washington, D.C., where she worked with 200 families from all 50 states to advocate for increased research funding.

Whether helping families find their dream home or supporting a cause close to her heart, Carol brings passion, perseverance, and integrity to everything she does.

My team and I are constantly striving to implement innovative and creative solutions. Each team member has specific skills they excel at and focus on - like the adage ‘the sum is greater than its’ parts’ - our system enables the team to be stronger, efficient, and more effective as a whole. Making an extra effort and going above and beyond, gives my clients a distinct advantage. I understands the importance of regular communication with clients and investing extra time behind the scenes, to make each transaction easy and hassle-free. I make sure we do everything possible to insure our clients’ success by providing superior service.

remarks: New Price! Transitional luxury living on a North Kentwood cul-de-sac, Westchester's most desirable neighborhood. The open floor plan extends to a spacious backyard with multiple decks for seamless indoor-outdoor living. High 9'-10' ceilings add light & volume, while the vaulted living room showcases custom cabinetry, floating shelves, and a sleek modern fireplace. The primary suite offers vaulted ceilings, a large-walk-in closet, and an in-suite spa bathroom with double sinks, lighted touch mirrors, a natural stone shower, and an oversized soaking tub. Additional highlights include, attic space above the garage, surround sound & ethernet wiring, LED designer lighting, EV ready, alarm system, and much more. Near LMU, the golf course, the beach, Playa Vista and SoFi Stadium.

agents.bio:
Colin Wellman is truly an all-around entrepreneur plus business owner, having been actively involved with the startup and management of three local companies. His sense of loyalty, commitment to detail, and integrity have always been the pillars upon which Colin builds entrepreneurial endeavors and professional relationships.

As a Realtor, Colin brings with him 20 years of real estate experience. He’s a licensed broker (www.campbellwellman.com), a state-certified appraiser (www.tcappraisal.net), and a licensed contractor (www.wellmanandco.com). His well-rounded expertise in this field has already allowed him to sell over a billion dollars in real estate during his distinguished career.

A native of Pacific Palisades, Colin was a talented athlete growing up. He was City MVP for varsity volleyball at Palisades High School, after which he went on to graduate from Pepperdine in 1997 as the captain of the NCAA Pepperdine Men’s Volleyball Team. After finishing college, he spent several years on the AVP professional beach volleyball tour as well as the international tour in Europe. The leadership and teamwork skills he developed while involved in sports became the foundation of his entrepreneurial mentality and mindset.

Colin is capable of working with investors, sellers, and buyers alike. He is an expert negotiator, and he has a thorough knowledge of the different real estate submarkets in and around Los Angeles.

Colin is married with three kids and, when he’s not busy helping his clients with their real estate needs, an avid golfer enjoys spending time on the links.

Todd Stein, a native of Brentwood, knows the Westside better than anyone else, and his intimate knowledge of the area allows him to know which area is right for each client he takes on. Whether a client is looking for something in the middle of downtown so they can go out regularly, needs a quieter home to raise a growing family, or wants to invest in multiple properties to perfect their real estate portfolio, Todd can pair anyone with the right home (or homes) for their needs.

Home prices in California are always on a steep increase, and Todd knows how to get buyers their dream property at a great price while helping sellers get what their home is worth. With a background in appraising, Todd brings a deep knowledge of the real estate industry market that very few agents possess.

As a founding member of Campbell Wellman, instead of focusing on selling and buying, Todd wanted to look at the market drivers and quickly analyze, dissect and communicate vital market information to clients quickly and easily. With the conception of Campbell Wellman, Todd was able to execute his vision in a boutique setting, that is tailored to his clients needs. 

Todd has worked with people from every corner of the globe, and his honest and direct attitude makes home buying or selling easier than ever. His responsiveness and knowledge have quickly made him one of the area’s most in-demand agents. He will work closely with buyers and sellers to hold their hand through the process, ensuring that each party’s needs are met so everyone can reach their real estate goals. 

Whether you’re looking to invest in multiple properties or put down roots for the first time, Todd can help you find the right property for your needs in no time. When not selling real estate, Todd likes to spend time at the beach and explore local businesses in the Brentwood area.

Founder + CEO of a privately-owned real estate development, investment & operations firm headquartered in Los Angeles, right in the heart of Silicon Beach. Developing luxury residences & providing first-in-class real estate services.

remarks:
BACK ON THE MARKET - First time on the market in almost 40yrs! Welcome to 8831 Glider Ave - A total of 5 rooms!! 4-bedroom home and an extra bonus room with 2,541 sq ft of pure possibility! One bedroom includes a convenient half bath, plus there’s a versatile loft with a balcony overlooking the neighborhood. Some areas showcase beautiful original hardwood floors from the home’s 1942 origins and classic wood stairs added in 1986, adding timeless warmth and character throughout. Enjoy peace and comfort inside thanks to an official soundproof retrofit through the LAX Aircraft Noise Mitigation Program, which includes professionally installed sound-rated windows and doors. For those who find magic in flight, the balcony and front porch offer the ideal spot to unwind while watching planes glide home...a daily reminder you’re living at the gateway to the world!
Set on a generous lot just minutes from Playa Vista, LAX, Culver City, Silicon Beach, and major freeways (405 & 110), this home offers the space, access, and potential today’s buyers are searching for. Whether you plan to update, expand, or build new, this is your chance to create something truly unique...just how you envision it! Priced at just $588 per square foot, this home offers exceptional value compared to the average in the area at $945/sqft. Please see Supplemental Section for additional information. Step inside from anywhere with the full 3D immersive tour and floor plan!

agents.bio:
Jennifer Delaney delights in assisting her clients in buying, selling, and renting real estate inside the 610 Loop and other areas of Houston. As a native Houstonian, she's watched many parts of the city that were once neglected transform into communities that people are proud to call home. Jennifer has practiced real estate for over 6 years, however, it's not her first time dealing in the business. Jennifer Delaney has extensive knowledge of the Houston residential and investment real estate scene with over 20 years of construction and real estate investment experience. Prior to getting her real estate license, she spent 10 years specializing in middle school education after obtaining her B.S. degree in interdisciplinary studies from the University of Houston. Her teaching and prior real estate experience enables her to be an amazing resource for her clients. 

In addition to consulting with her clients, Jennifer is an active real estate investor. Her most recent projects include developing, building and designing a tiny home community in Galveston, TX, as well as renovating and marketing other multi-family projects across the Houston Metro area. Jennifer is an active member of the Houston and Galveston Association of Realtors, as well as the National Association of Realtors. When she's not submitting offers, listing properties, or helping people find their new home, you can catch her volunteering as a child advocate for CPS and the youth program at St. Theresa Catholic Church. 

Jennifer can be found off the clock enjoying the culturally diverse food scene, running through Memorial Park, and spending time with her family. Jennifer loves to travel and calls Costa Rica her happy place. Jennifer is your go-to source for residential, commercial, and rental real estate across Houston and Galveston.

Charlie Bingham is a distinguished REALTOR® specializing in the Greater Houston market. Renowned for his exceptional negotiation skills and meticulous attention to detail, Charlie ensures that every client receives unparalleled service tailored to their unique needs. His client-centric approach is rooted in a deep understanding of the real estate process, supported by his extensive background in hospitality management.

Charlie’s expertise encompasses investment properties and renovation projects, making him a valuable advisor for clients at any price point. His commitment to open communication keeps clients well-informed and confident throughout their real estate journey. Fluent in French, Charlie adeptly assists French-speaking clients and other expatriates, simplifying their transition to Houston.

An active community member, Charlie serves as the President of the Crestwood Civic Club, volunteers at the Houston Food Bank, contributes to a Rodeo Committee, and is a member of the Memorial Park Advisory Board.

Outside of real estate, Charlie enjoys cultural events, padel, and pickleball. He is happily married, with two daughters and a Pomeranian dog.

Charlie Bingham’s dedication to excellence and his profound understanding of the Houston real estate market make him an outstanding choice for clients seeking an authentic and trustworthy REALTOR®.

Welcome to the wonderful world of Real Estate! Each and every transaction is completely different, each transaction has it's very own ups and downs, however I make those much easier. I am Team Lead and Co Owner of Got Keys Realty Team in Houston, Tx. After 10 years in the business I still continue to learn and grow to make myself and our team have all the tools, and be able to offer solutions to our clients. As a realtor I'm not here to push papers for you or log online and just list your home. I'm here to teach you. Teach you what to do and how to do it. I am an Multi-Million Dollar Producer, an expert in Harris and Mongomery county for Probate and Divorce, I specialize in innovative homes sales, Owner Financing, and am an Assistant to a local mortgage broker. Buying a home or getting approved for a Morgage does not look like it once did. Society is so used to believing that in order to purchase a home you have to have an 800 credit score with 20% down. That is not the case on some loans we are approving at 560 credit scores and 3.5% down or in some cases 0% down. Most people just want to know what their monthly payments will be with everything. I do the monthly breakdown of your mortgage, with your PMI, your insurance, your monthly taxes, before we even go see the home! So you can tell me what payment your are comfortable with. Something else that is often missed when buying a home, how much the tax rate will actually change your monthly payment, I will take the time and help you to understand these things. I'm very easy going and extremely honest. I will also help keep you on track. Alot of times when you start seeing homes you loose focus of the things you truly wanted in a home. I remind my clients and help keep them on tract. So there will be very few surprises along the way. This is my first lesson call me for your next!

Michael got his initial taste of real estate in law school when he started a rental home company with one of his professors. The company provided housing to recovering addicts in collaboration with the organization Oxford House, Inc.

agents.bio: Gonzalo is a world traveler, born in Chile and raised as far West as Los Angeles, and as far East as Miami, with friends and family members everywhere in between. Now residing in Houston for over 20 years, Gonzalo has developed a true sense of compassion for his hometown, and aspires to share his knowledge and experience in real estate with his clients from all over the world. His entrepreneurial, sales, and negotiating background with a love for working with people, led Gonzalo to begin his real estate career. Since he earned his real estate license in 2005 however, selling for him has been all about helping people and providing exceptional service. “Earning my clients’ trust and helping families begin a new chapter is an amazing feeling,” he says. “I’m so fortunate to be able to see smiling faces at the conclusion of a sale and know that I had a part in getting my clients where they want to be.” Gonzalo is fluent in Spanish, which is a huge asset in Houston’s diversified market. His goal in every transaction is to provide his clients with clear and open communication so they are informed and educated throughout the entire process. As a buyer you can be assured that Gonzalo will be as patient as you need me to be, or act as quickly as required. Gonzalo is also passionate about his family, Christ and CrossFit. Gonzalo follows the same advice in CrossFit as in his life and his career…never quit!

John Anthony is a licensed realtor through Keller Williams. His journey in real estate began in 2017 and has never looked back. In a short period, he was awarded top selling agent twice, top seller's agent 8 times, and has helped over 100 sellers, in challenging situations, successfully sell their homes on and off-market. His specialties are, but are not limited to, market analysis, estate sales, senior homeowners, investor-minded, leading his team, and negotiations.

In his spare time, John Anthony enjoys doing activities to keep his body strong and his mind sharp, and spending time in prayer. He understands it is crucial to keep his cup full so he can serve his clients best. He also enjoys volunteering for the PTO at his daughters' school. This gives him an additional sense of purpose as he builds a community around him while raising funds for the school.

John Anthony is passionate about solving problems, building relationships through real estate and referrals, and believes in Zig Ziglar's famous quote, "You can have everything in life you want if you will just help enough other people get what they want."

remarks:
Tucked behind gates on one of lower Nichols Canyon’s most coveted streets—surrounded by $3M–$10M estates—this mid-century icon delivers rare value, privacy, and effortless luxury just minutes from the Sunset Strip. Quiet, wide streets and generous guest parking make this feel worlds away from the chaos, yet close to everything that matters. Clean lines. Vaulted ceilings. Exposed beams. Walls of glass. The architecture is timeless, the energy unmistakably cool. Natural light pours into the open living spaces, while floor-to-ceiling sliders erase the line between indoors and out—designed for hosting, unwinding, and living well. Multiple outdoor lounges set the scene. A private front patio for morning espresso or midday work sessions. An elevated view deck for sunset cocktails, late dinners, and city lights flickering below. Canyon views from every room turn everyday moments into something cinematic. The kitchen is sleek, confident, and designed to impress—premium stainless appliances, modern counters, clean lines, and a skylight that keeps the space bright and editorial. It’s equal parts functional and social. The primary suite feels like a boutique hotel escape. Wake up to canyon views. Wind down in a spa-level bath with soaking tub, glass shower, and skylight overhead. Private, serene, and undeniably indulgent. Two additional bedrooms—each with uninterrupted canyon views—offer flexibility for guests, creative space, or a refined work-from-home setup. One features a fireplace, adding warmth and character. An attached two-car garage, updated systems, and immediate access to West Hollywood dining, nightlife, and hiking trails complete the package. This isn’t just a home—it’s a statement.
Architectural. Private. Elevated.
A true Nichols Canyon lifestyle.

agents.bio: James is a native Galvestonian and a lifelong resident of the Houston/Galveston area, and his real estate practice includes those two cities and points in between. A former banker, Selig received his BBA in finance with a concentration in real estate. Actively selling real estate since 2003, Selig believes in being a life-long learner, evidenced by his many professional designations and certifications, to serve his clients better. Honors include being featured in a “Residential Specialist” magazine issue and being named a Five Star Realtor every year since 2011. Selig serves on the Agent Leadership Council of Keller Williams Memorial, where he chairs the Financial Planning Committee and teaches. The agents awarded Selig the Eagle Award, the highest honor given in a Keller Williams office, for the positive impact they felt that he had on the office and the agents.

remarks: Located on one of North Kentwood's premier streets, this light-filled single-level home with three bedrooms and two bathrooms blends timeless charm with modern updates. A formal living room with a classic brick fireplace flows into an adjacent dining room, while the chef's kitchen with breakfast nook and stainless steel appliances opens to a spacious family room with French doors leading to a private backyard that backs to Loyola Marymount University and is lined with tall trees for added privacy. The serene primary suite sits at the rear of the home and features French doors with direct access to the backyard, a walk-in closet, and a spa-like bath with dual sinks, skylight, and oversized shower. Two secondary bedrooms at the front of the home are served by the original hallway bath. Additional highlights include beautifully refinished original hardwood floors, freshly painted interior and exterior, central heating and A/C, gated driveway, and bright, airy rooms throughout. A detached two-car garage offers a versatile flex space with half bath, ideal for a home office, studio, or gym.

agents.bio: Amber McLain has been an award winning agent and top producer for over twenty years. Her early career as one of the most sought after and knowledgable escrow officers for luxury home transactions in Beverly Hills gave her a major advantage when she moved into sales. A polished professional, with commanding knowledge of the buying and selling process and a diligent commitment to her clients, she regularly completes a prodigious volume of sales and is in demand by buyers and sellers alike for her expert representation. As an owner of multiple properties herself, she is as comfortable dealing with seasoned investors as first time home buyers, and takes pride that the vast majority of her business comes from referrals and repeat clients. "Having been on all sides of the transaction," Amber says, "gives me a unique perspective when helping my clients, and my experience allows me to anticipate and react to every situation which will ultimately give my clients a wonderful experience.

agents.bio:
Following this transaction, a friend asked him to help with a home purchase. This friend then referred five others and the roots of New Leaf were planted. However, it is David’s childhood connection to Houston’s many neighborhoods, as well as his passionate determination to thoughtfully populate these communities, that have consistently motivated him and his team at New Leaf Real Estate.

David began his career in the energy sector in 1993 with Texas Ohio Gas, remaining with the company for 14 years. He transitioned from the energy sector to real estate when his brother, Eric, and he launched Houston Brothers Mortgage in 2002. David’s background in energy trading and mortgage informs his in-depth, market-based analysis approach to New Leaf Real Estate’s model.

At New Leaf, his market expertise allows him to identify a client’s specific needs, and combine that with his strategic negotiation and deal-making capability, consistently delivering the best deal possible for his clients. From the initial contact to inspections to final contract, David is committed to providing his clients with unparalleled service. Because of his relationship-driven vision of the industry, he has fostered productive realtor relationships and formed lifelong friendships with many of his clients in Houston.

Since the launch of New Leaf, David has managed approximately $425 million dollars of real estate sales and has personally handled over 625 transactions. In 2017, he closed approximately $60 million, which garnered praise and recognition as one of the Houston Business Journal’s Top Agents by Sales Volume for the sixth consecutive year.

David lives in Montrose with his wife, Heather, and their two young children, Hart and Holden. Committed to giving back to the community, he and Heather support Poe Elementary, Presbyterian School, Roberts Elementary, Neartown Little League, West University Little League, Push Sharks, Urban Harvest, Dress for Success and Eastside Farmers Market.
15+ years of representing buyers and sellers of land and light industrial.

remarks: Step into this modern one-story custom home, built in 2018, offering an open-concept design that blends style and functionality. The spacious living area flows seamlessly into the chef’s kitchen, complete with a dine-in island featuring double sinks, stainless steel appliances, a gas cooktop, modern light fixtures, and abundant storage. remarks: Tucked away on a sweet cul-de-sac in Lakeside Estates, this spacious home with plenty of built-in storage is ready for its next chapter. Bright and airy with raised ceilings and oversized windows, this home is filled with natural light. You'll love the highly adaptable layout-4 bedrooms (two are primary bedroom-sized!), a cozy family room with fireplace, a breakfast room, and two flex spaces that could serve as an office, sitting room, playroom, homeschool room or formal dining room. The updated kitchen has plenty of counter & cabinet space as well as a pantry closet to keep everything organized. Outside, timeless details and practical perks shine: rounded brick archways, a welcoming covered front porch, an extra-long driveway for ample parking, two-car detached garage with storage shelves, gated breezeway, partially covered patio, and a generous backyard shaded by mature trees-perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. Don't miss this opportunity to make this home your own!

remarks: Welcome home to Hilltop Colony, a tranquil gated community in El Sereno. This 3 BED 3 BATH condo offers breathtaking hillside views. Enjoy peaceful natural surroundings and easy access to transportation and urban amenities! Enter through gates at the staffed guard kiosk. Then park conveniently in either of two assigned tandem spaces in the garage, with EV charging and access to the elevator to the 2nd floor. This condo offers two private entrances, one upstairs and one downstairs! The first floor entry is a privately enclosed patio providing natural light and open air access to the front door. Upon entering, find a bright kitchen with a greenhouse window for growing herbs or allowing wonderful natural light. The kitchen also has a pass through to the dining and living area. An open floor plan allows you to enjoy the breezes and views from living room to balcony, while relaxing by the cozy fireplace. New carpet throughout, and in-unit laundry are also featured. The three bedrooms, all separated, have access to different bathrooms, allowing for privacy and spaciousness. One first floor bedroom opens to the front patio, another large bedroom has an en-suite bath and walk-in closet. The second-floor suite offers its own entry, and a full bath. Finally, you'll have use of a BBQ area, children's playground, and community swimming pool with spa, as well as common area gathering spaces. Convenient to Downtown LA, Pasadena, Alhambra, Highland Park, USC Health science campus.

Just moments from Atwater Village's favorite cafs, boutiques, the L.A. River bike path, and Los Feliz Boulevard, this home is a modern reinvention of classic California living.
