agents.bio:
Shannon brings a wealth of financial expertise and a deep love for Los Angeles’ Eastside communities to her career in real estate. A longtime resident of Atwater Village, Shannon pairs her professional background in corporate finance with her hands-on experience in residential renovation to offer clients both strategic insight and personal guidance.

A graduate of Westfield State University in Massachusetts, where she earned her B.S. in Business, Shannon went on to spend over 14 years building an impressive career in Corporate America. She held leadership roles as an Accounting Manager at Mellon Financial and Colony Capital—a private real estate investment firm—before moving into senior positions with Pacific Financial Research and ultimately serving as Assistant Vice President at U.S. Bancorp Fund Services.

Her passion for real estate grew organically while managing multiple home renovation projects in Atwater Village, where she combined her financial acumen with a keen eye for design and value. This hands-on experience inspired her to transition into real estate full-time, pursuing her dream of becoming a REALTOR®.

Today, Shannon leverages her rare blend of financial expertise, project management skills, and neighborhood knowledge to guide clients through every stage of the buying and selling process. Her clients value her professionalism, attention to detail, and dedication to helping them make confident, informed decisions in one of life’s most important investments.

remarks: Nestled in the coveted Franklin Elementary School District, offering elevated hillside living above Los Feliz Village and minutes from Griffith Park and the Observatory. Spanning 2,387 sq ft over three levels, the home delivers timeless mid-century design blended with modern luxury: exposed wooden beam ceilings, rich hardwood floors, and expansive glass that showcases sweeping panoramic views from nearly every room. On the main level, the open-plan living and dining areas flow effortlessly out to wide-view decks. At the same time, the chef's kitchen features top-tier appliances, a Sub-Zero refrigerator, a Viking Stove, double ovens and microwaves, a wine cooler, and Brazilian granite countertops, ideal for entertaining. Two serene bedrooms and two full baths provide comfortable everyday living. Below, a fully independent one-bedroom suite with living room, full bath, separate entrance, and laundry offers guests, extended family, or income rental potential. Additionally, a flexible bonus room at the lowest level invites use as a home office, art studio, gym, or media room. Outdoor living shines with terraced lawns, mature fruit trees, a koi pond, multiple view decks, and newly renovated exterior stairways connecting every level, making this one of the rare hillside retreats where architecture, views, and lifestyle converge. Ideal for buyers seeking Los Feliz's vibrant neighborhood life, top schools, and ready-to-go design-forward home, don't miss this rare opportunity to own a hillside classic with panoramic views, income-capable space, and mid-century pedigree.

Mary Wassef is a proud Canadian who has made Houston her beloved home, emerging as a leading expert in luxury real estate within The Heights and its historic markets. With over two decades of experience, Mary blends her deep knowledge of historic architecture with modern construction techniques, offering a unique perspective to her diverse clientele. Her multicultural background and extensive network allow her to connect with clients from all walks of life, providing an empathetic and tailored real estate experience. Mary's unwavering commitment to her clients' dreams and goals truly sets her apart. She makes the real estate journey enjoyable and even fun, understanding the profound life changes it often represents. Her dedication extends to walking alongside her clients through every transaction, ensuring that each step is handled with precision and care. In 2011, Mary founded Circa Real Estate, which flourished under her leadership with a team of nearly 30 agents renowned for their personalized and unique services. Her approach is characterized by generosity, selflessness, and an unmatched work ethic, inspiring her team to consistently go above and beyond. Her 19th Street storefront stands as a testament to her commitment to community development, frequently hosting local art, community events, and support for neighborhood businesses. Recently, Mary has transitioned her team, the Circa Houston Group, to Realty of America, allowing her to expand her reach while maintaining the personalized service her clients have come to expect. For Mary, Houston's Heights is more than just a location; it's a cherished community. Whether you're buying, selling, or investing, Mary Wassef is your trusted partner in navigating this vibrant and historic Houston neighborhood.

agents.bio:
Ruth’s focus has always been on customers first. She is committed to helping clients have fun finding their dream homes from start to finish. 

Ruth grew up in the booming Richmond/Rosenberg area. She has experienced what it has been like to go from country living to the hustle and bustle of the current growth in the suburbs.

Ruth’s past leadership positions in sales, marketing, and customer service paved the way for her real estate career. Her personal style is to communicate well and show respect, kindness, and compassion while clients go through one of the most exciting times in their lives. 

Century 21 is top for brand name recognition, which is why Ruth chose to work with the company. So, if you are looking for an agent who is committed to excellence and integrity, and has a strong work ethic with a desire to make sure the transaction is the right fit, look no more.

Ali Pourmemar is a highly accomplished real estate professional, mortgage loan officer, and long-time real estate investor with more than 30 years of sales and negotiation experience. Known for his strategic mindset and exceptional deal-making ability, Ali has built a reputation as a master negotiator who consistently delivers outstanding results for his clients.

Throughout his career, Ali has developed an elite track record in sales, beginning with door-to-door residential sales and advancing to high-level B2B and enterprise sales. His performance consistently ranked among the top 1% of producers, earning him multiple President’s Club awards—an honor reserved for the highest-performing professionals in enterprise and business-to-business sales.

Today, Ali brings this elite-level negotiation expertise into every real estate transaction.

Ali serves as a Delegated Supervisor at Next Trend Realty, where he helps oversee and support a growing network of 170+ real estate agents, maintaining high standards of professionalism, compliance, and service across the brokerage.

In addition to his role in real estate brokerage, Ali is also a Mortgage Loan Officer, giving his clients a powerful advantage by understanding both the real estate and financing sides of a transaction. As a long-time real estate investor, he also provides valuable insight into investment strategies, market trends, and wealth-building opportunities through real estate.

Ali specializes in:

• Luxury homes
• Land and lot acquisitions
• Commercial real estate
• Investment properties
• Residential sales and purchases
• High-level negotiation and deal structuring

Whether representing homeowners, investors, or commercial clients, Ali is known for his strong advocacy, strategic negotiation, and commitment to delivering exceptional results in every transaction.

remarks:
Hidden from the street and nestled among beautifully terraced grounds, this exceptional 3-bedroom, 2-bath residence is more than a home—it's a private retreat where nature, comfort, and entertaining come together.
Designed for those who appreciate character over cookie-cutter living, the thoughtfully landscaped multi-level property offers a series of outdoor sanctuaries, including peaceful decks, covered patios, and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen—creating the perfect setting for morning coffee, weekend gatherings, or relaxing beneath the evening sky.
Inside, you'll find a beautifully renovated kitchen, spacious living areas filled with natural light, and the convenience of an enclosed laundry room. Every space has been thoughtfully designed to create a warm, inviting atmosphere that feels worlds away from the city, yet remains close to everything.
Located within walking distance of Cal State LA and public transportation, and just minutes from Keck Medicine of USC, Alhambra, Downtown Los Angeles, Highland Park, South Pasadena, and major freeways, this home offers an ideal balance of privacy and accessibility.

With excellent parking, timeless character, and solid construction, this is a rare opportunity to own one of El Sereno's most distinctive hillside homes. If you've been searching for a property with soul, exceptional outdoor living, and a true sense of retreat, your search ends here.
Motivated seller—schedule your showing today!

remarks: Introducing 1818 Decatur: a storybook Victorian where history & modern living intertwine. Loved, restored, & filled w/ light, this 3-bed, 3-bath home showcases original wood floors, exposed brick chimneys, soaring ceilings, & two claw-foot tubs. The chef’s kitchen is a dream w/ marble counters, dual sinks, & endless cabinetry, while the library invites quiet moments among built-ins & books. Upstairs, discover three spacious bedrooms & two beautifully updated baths. Minutes from Downtown, the home offers effortless access to Houston’s most vibrant destinations. Outdoors, lush gardens w/ native perennials, butterfly plants, & fruit trees, along w/ two private driveways—rare for the neighborhood—providing easy parking for entertaining & guests. Recent updates include roof & porch work (2021), fencing & landscaping (2020), & a new walk-in shower (2023). Filled w/ natural light & timeless calm, welcome to your oasis in a charming neighborhood, & own a beautiful piece of Houston’s History.

Last year, The Sansone Group earned the Diamond Club Award from RE/MAX International for the fifth time in six years. The Diamond Club Award is RE/MAX's highest level of production, less than 1% of agents out of more than 84,000 in the U.S. achieve Diamond Club status.

The Sansone Group is a team of 7 dedicated licensed Realtors® who specialize in Residential Real Estate, New Construction Homes, Luxury Homes, Commercial Property for Sale, Commercial Property for Lease, Farm & Ranch and Investment Property & Land.

In 2018, The Sansone Group had 156 transactions for more than $44 million in sales volume and is in the Top 25 RE/MAX teams in the state of Texas. In 2017, The Sansone Group was named #15 in Luxury Sales, #15 in Transaction Count and #20 in Sales Volume among Real Estate Teams in the Houston Metro Area by the Houston Business Journal.

Transactions in 2017 were 175, 2016 transactions numbered 154, transactions totaled 147 in 2015 and 129 in 2014, for a total transaction count of 761 sold properties alone since 2014! The Sansone Group has achieved career awards with RE/MAX as a member of the RE/MAX Hall of Fame and they have been awarded the RE/MAX Lifetime Achievement Award.

The Sansone Group is a member of RE/MAX Fine Properties in Sugar Land, Texas, the #1 RE/MAX Office in Texas for the last three years.

Lizz was named a Five Star Real Estate Agent in the Houston Region for the 8th year in a row (2010-2018). Lizz has been featured in the June edition of Texas Monthly Magazine each year! A Five Star agent is one who scored highest in overall satisfaction.

Chris has his Broker's license and is a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Texas Association of Realtors and the National Association of Realtors. Chris has spoken at several real estate conferences on the subject of building successful real estate teams on the state level for RE/MAX of Texas and the national level at RE/MAX International events.

The Sansone Group covers Sugar Land to all over the Houston Metro Area including Katy, Missouri City, Richmond, Rosenberg, Pearland, Spring and The Woodlands.

From growing up in Texas, moving to Idaho, and then coming back to the Lone Star State, Haley knows what it’s like to relocate your home, your career, and your life to a new place. It’s an experience she brings forward in every interaction with her clients, especially those moving to Texas for the first time.

Haley has been a tenacious champion for her clients, especially first-time buyers and those new to Texas. She has closed millions of dollars worth of properties from Single Family Homes, Investment Properties, Farm & Ranch, and even Undeveloped Land.

The key to her success is her passion for helping others, her positive energy, and building trust with her clients. The majority of her sales are referral-based, and she prides herself on keeping a constant line of communication open. When you work with Haley, she understands your time is extremely valuable and she always harnesses her attention-to-detail and negotiation skills for your benefit.  

Haley is a full-time realtor and a full-time mom. In her spare time, she loves spending quality time with her husband and son, exploring the Texas Hill Country, and eating BBQ, of course :) Through her Realty work, she’s contributed to Austin Habitat for Humanity, the SAFE Alliance, Central Texas Table of Grace, and Community First Village.

Ultimately, Haley’s strength is being a guiding hand and a firm authority on one of life’s most important and sensitive decisions. She can’t wait to work with you!

Andrea Curran is an accomplished real estate professional with a track record of success in the highly competitive metro Houston area. Since beginning her real estate career in 2016 as an individual agent, Andrea has consistently demonstrated her commitment to excellence and has climbed the rankings in production and volume, ultimately becoming one of the top-ranked real estate professionals in the region.

In 2019, Andrea established The Andrea Curran Team. Under her leadership, the team has become recognized as a leading force in the industry, with a focus on providing exceptional service and building strong relationships with clients, colleagues, and the community. The team's outstanding performance has earned numerous accolades, including recognition by the Wall Street Journal Realtrends rankings and the Houston Business Journal.

Andrea's personal and professional experience with equestrian properties led her to be named to the Compass Ranch and Land Division, further demonstrating her expertise in the industry. In 2024, Andrea joined the ranks of the most elite in land sales, earning her Accredited Land Consultant designation.

Outside of work, Andrea is dedicated to giving back to her community through volunteer work with local charities. She is a past president of the Cypress Gems Chapter of the National Charity League, Inc. and remains an active member. Additionally, Andrea serves as a guardian ad litem for children in foster care through Child Advocates, Inc. and is an active member of the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo Quarter Horse Committee.

agents.bio:
As the Tricia Turner Group, we work with a team of qualified specialists to help with the sale of your home, from beginning to end.  We have put together a full marketing team, our own staging company, as well as a Preferred Partner Program, which involves a list of vendors that we know, like, and trust.

No truly successful company on the planet has one person doing everything, including the real estate company you hire. We would love to be your expert home selling advisors.

With over 25 years in the real estate industry, and having SOLD thousands of homes, TTG has put together some amazing plans and programs that are unique to our organization, and have the best results in achieving our goals.  We keep our eyes laser focused on the market and what’s ahead, while maintaining a unique culture within our organization.

Our belief in providing the best customer experience keeps us steadfast as innovators, as we continue to differentiate ourselves from our competition.  No other real estate company has employed such strategies and opportunities to help the consumer experience as TTG.

What separates us…

~ The Coming Soon Listing Program - we have a private FB group that we moderate which allows us to market our listings, before they are active, to the top producers in our industry~ 
~ Our own “Make it Pretty” Program allows you, the homeowner, to have repairs done on your home prior to listing, with no upfront cost to you
~ Professional STAGING INCLUDED with our own staging company Honeybee Homestaging & More
~ Our own 60 Step Listing Program - for optimal marketing on all listings which includes a partnership with Homes.com to maximize our exposure
~ Protect and Serve Program - we give discounts and rebates to all military, police officers, firefighters, first responders, and teachers
~ Easy Exit Listing Plan - you can fire us for any reason if you are not 100% satisfied 
~ Flexible Commission Plan - Pay as little as zero% commission
~ Immediate Buyout Program with our own CASH OFFER DIVISION
~ Love It or Leave It Program - if you’re not happy in your home during the first 12 months of owning it, we’ll sell it for you for FREE (waive the listing broker fee of 3%)
~ Immediate Response System - All buyer inquiries will be handled in 5 minutes or less and most often within the first 60 seconds
~ Reverse Offer Strategy - this lets us go to buyers that may be on the fence about your home and make an offer to them, with terms, conditions, and prices that are acceptable to all parties
~ Preferred Partner Program - a list of vendors that we work exclusively with - you can locate them at:   www.residentialservicedirectory.com
~ Move for Free - use of our company moving truck at no charge...forever

With the real estate industry always changing, it is imperative that we stay ahead of the curve and always have the best techniques to help you, the consumer, with one of the largest investments in your life

Mentored by his Mother, Barbara McCarver, a leading Real Estate Broker in Houston for 50 years, Barbara served as the first female President of the Houston Association of Realtors. Dan comments, “Real estate is a challenging and rewarding business. Having grown up around home sales, it seems second nature to me.”

Dan McCarver has achieved the #1 position in resale real estate transaction sales volume many times in the Clear Lake area. His success is no surprise. The honors and recognition he has received are indicative of his commitment, professionalism, and level of understanding in this specialized discriminating market.

I specialize in achieving top dollar sales with minimal market time, but what sets me apart is how I manage the process for my clients. From pricing to marketing to negotiation, I handle the details with care, making sure my clients not only get the best outcome but also enjoy a seamless experience.

agents.bio:
There is an elegance to the way in which Aaron Sonnier works. He manages every detail, no matter how small. He is committed to excellence in service and luxury in every way. He curates his every choice with refinement and grace.

That would explain why he is an esteemed member of Martha Turner's Circle of Excellence.

Nothing compares when it comes to the unsurpassed attention he pays to every client and every property, right down to the clothes he wears and the image he projects. It is no wonder why he was voted Best Dressed Realtor (2019) by Realtor Magazine.

Originally from Lake Charles, Louisiana, Aaron holds a Bachelor of Fine Arts Degree with a concentration in Photography and Painting from USL in Lafayette, Louisiana.

It is his impeccable work ethic and his degree in fine arts combined with his unparalleled experience in branding, management, and leadership that makes him such a force.

He has thirty years of retail industry experience and owns a concierge and construction management company. His success in the real estate world comes from knowing how to lead, how to negotiate, and how to make things happen brilliantly and without exception.

For Aaron, doing the right thing, means attending to any client need that may arise from driving contracts to and from title companies, meeting mobile notaries on site, reading the meter on a prospective sale, and staging a home.

Aaron is acutely aware that the key to the best transactions is impeccable communication, and there is nothing at which Aaron is more skilled. He answers every call and responds to every text. The time of day is no matter – what matters is always delivering the most refined service each and every time.

Paramount to all of Aaron’s work is building lasting relationships and helping clients to make the most informed decisions. Whether it is a home or a piece of property, whether a client is buying or selling, Aaron instills in clients the kind of confidence that can only come from working with a discerning professional of the highest caliber.

No decision has ever been easier for Aaron than choosing to be a part of the Martha Turner Sotheby’s International Realty team. Having superior tools and the latest in technology at his fingertips, allows Aaron - a 2020 Top Producer at his previous firm - to always be one step ahead of the competition.

In the high stakes world of real estate, you do not just want to get a property on the market, you want to get it the attention it deserves. Aaron Sonnier gets every property and client the attention they deserve.

remarks: Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in the heart of Memorial, 11607 Barazi Oaks Ct. offers luxury living with exceptional design and convenience. The first floor features a serene primary suite complete with an exercise or bonus room attached while upstairs you'll find four additional bedrooms—each with its own en-suite bath and walk-in closet. The open-concept home includes a 2018-remodeled kitchen and laundry room, butler’s pantry, elevator, a custom wine bar and office both remodeled in 2021, plus a dedicated media/movie room. Outside, entertain by the sparkling pool and relax under the covered patios surrounded by lush landscaping. A spacious 3-car garage completes this superb home. A rare Memorial gem on a peaceful cul-de-sac with only two homes on the street. Zoned to Memorial Drive Elementary, Spring Branch Middle School and Memorial High School. agents.bio:
Houston has been Joan's home for over 21 years and she is proud to be called a Houstonian. Raising a family of four in Houston, Joan learned early that the right home can be the heart and hub of a family. Personal service, discretion and candor are keys to her success, whether you are selling your home, relocating to Houston or looking for a new place to land. Her drive and interest in real estate grows out of a desire to find the perfect property that is a reflection of the style and individuality of her clients.

She began in real estate renovating houses and building homes in and around Houston. She knew then that she was committed to the business and soon she had her real estate and then brokerage license. Joan’s entrepreneurial spirit continued and she started a boutique brokerage company. Her fresh set of eyes on Houston neighborhoods gives her the ability to recognize the possibilities in all corners of our city. Her success is driven by her philosophy of focusing on the quality of relationships over quantity. Her reputation of honest, active, informed and accountable representation has been the core of her relationship with clients. She continues to follow these core values and is honored to have loyal, repeat clients and referrals.

You will find her involved in the improvement of our parks and the expansion of recreational paths in the City. She has spent hours winding through the trails and parks of Houston and the surrounding areas which affords her a unique perspective on neighborhoods and maximizes her knowledge and expertise of the Bayou City. Chappell Hill serves as a second home base for the Bremner family, along with their 2 dogs, 4 horses, 1 cat and 12 cows.

remarks: Modern Luxury Meets Effortless California Living Fully reimagined and expanded in 2025, this stunning one-story modern residence in the most desirable Kentwood neighborhood of Westchester offers the perfect blend of style, comfort, and functionality. Behind its understated exterior, the home opens into a light-filled sanctuary with designer finishes and a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The main house features 4 bedrooms + office and 3.5 baths, thoughtfully designed for contemporary living. The primary suite serves as a private retreat with a soaking tub, double shower, and walk-in closet. A formal living room with fireplace and built-in bar creates an inviting space for entertaining, while the great room is anchored by a large island and chef’s kitchen with custom oak cabinets and premium Thermador appliances—flowing effortlessly into dining and living areas. Multi-slide glass doors open to a spacious backyard with outdoor kitchen, dining and lounge areas, ideal for gatherings under the California sun. The permitted one-bedroom ADU offers exceptional versatility, complete with its own full kitchen and bath—perfect for guests, extended family, or rental income. Sophisticated yet approachable, this Westchester gem embodies the best of SoCal living—modern design, natural light, and effortless indoor-outdoor harmony.

agents.bio:
Jennifer Petsu is a top-producing Luxury Specialist at Pacific Union International in Los Angeles. She has a background in mortgage banking and entrepreneurship, running her own socially conscious clothing company that was featured on ABC News, Redbook and USA Today.

Jennifer honed her keen eye for architecture and design while studying at The Art Institute of Chicago. Billion-dollar developers Brookfield Residential took note and selected Jennifer to be the exclusive agent representing the groundbreaking Marlowe Everly, and The Collection luxury properties in Playa Vista. That was public recognition of her extensive market knowledge of the white-hot L.A. neighborhood Silicon Beach, which has become one of the world's top tech locales, hosting media and tech titans such as Google and Facebook.

Jennifer spends her free time with family and as a volunteer art teacher through Art in Action which she fully funded as a gift to Broadway Elementary in Venice, CA. In the competitive world of high-end L.A real estate, Jennifer Petsu offers buyers and sellers a dynamic advantage.

Westside LA Real Estate Expert.

A Santa Monica native, Jessica Abbott has a deep and comprehensive understanding of the Los Angeles market. Living in many vibrant pockets and neighborhoods throughout the city, she has valuable firsthand insight into the communities and nuances that make each area unique and how that translates to what clients are looking for.
 
With a successful career in fashion, e-commerce, and luxury, Jessica brings a unique perspective to real estate. She has a keen eye for design, curation, merchandising, and branding and has leveraged these skills to excel in interior design and home remodeling.
 
Born and raised in Santa Monica, Jessica “Jess” Abbott, Westside Native, brings a distinctly local perspective to Los Angeles luxury real estate. Partnered with Christie’s International Real Estate SoCal, she combines homegrown Westside intelligence with the global reach of the world’s most respected luxury real estate brand.

For Jess, local knowledge is not a slogan—it is memory, pattern recognition, and context applied block by block to every property conversation. Her approach prioritizes the block before the bedroom count, the light before the finishes, and the long-term value beyond today’s market.

Before entering real estate, Jess built a successful career across luxury, fashion, and e-com, developing a sophisticated understanding of branding, visual storytelling, and consumer psychology. She later expanded that foundation through interior design, modern remodeling, and new construction consulting, giving her a highly refined editorial eye for property, positioning, and value.

Whether helping a buyer recognize the potential of an off-market Mar Vista property or preparing a timeless Venice compound for market, Jess sees opportunity in details others may overlook.

As a lifelong Westsider, she brings an intimate understanding of the communities that shape Los Angeles—from Santa Monica, Brentwood, Mar Vista, Venice, and Beverly Hills to the city’s broader luxury enclaves. Her clients rely on her not simply for market data, but for perspective: what makes a property special, what may be overlooked, and what will continue to matter long after the transaction closes.

For sellers, that perspective translates into thoughtful positioning, compelling storytelling, and a deep understanding of how discerning buyers experience a property. For buyers, it means looking beyond finishes and square footage to understand context, livability, potential, and long-term value.

Jess pairs this creative intuition with disciplined strategy and formidable negotiation, approaching every client’s interests with quiet confidence and an uncompromising commitment to protecting their assets.

From legacy estates to architectural enclaves, Jess brings refined taste, strategic thinking, unmistakable L.A. style, and distinctly Westside intelligence to every transaction.

She doesn’t simply sell Westside homes—she interprets them

agents.bio: For 18 years Patrick Martin has been a top industry producer in Los Angeles handling a diverse portfolio of properties. Accessible & available, Patrick is directly involved in the entire process of client transactions, from finding a home through the escrow process & long after the close. Jeffrey Winans is a licensed Houston REALTOR® with a Broker's License and over 15 years of experience serving the dynamic Inner Loop communities, including Montrose, The Heights, Rice/Memorial, River Oaks, Third Ward, and Willow Meadows, as well as surrounding neighborhoods. He is a member of NAR, TAR and HAR real estate associations.

Affiliated with Nan & Company Properties / Forbes Global Properties, he is recognized as a Top Producer from 2020 through 2024, demonstrating consistent success in Houston's competitive residential market. As a listing agent in Houston Inner Loop, his deep knowledge of neighborhoods, combined with a data-driven and client-focused approach, ensures buyers and sellers receive expert guidance and transparent communication throughout every transaction.

Trusted by clients and peers alike, Jeffrey has received over 100  HAR.com ratings with an average of 4.99/5.00 stars, highlighting his dedication to exceptional service and measurable results.

Kyla Linn spent several years bringing the best of fashion to Houstonians as one of the lead buyers for Houston's own legacy luxury retailer, Tootsies. After a decade in the retail industry, she developed a keen eye and sharp negotiation skills. These skills, along with an aptitude for customer service, marketing, competitive analysis, pricing, and data analytics, allow Kyla to bring value to her clients when selling or buying their next home. With over $200 million in residential real estate sales in the Greater Houston and surrounding areas, Kyla offers unmatched expertise to buyers, sellers, and investors. Rapidly rising to one of the top agents in Houston, Kyla has been featured in HAR's Rising Stars of Real Estate Top 20 Under 40 and Houston Business Journal's Top 10 Groups in Houston two years in a row.

Kyla's success has always been attributed to her customer centric approach, and she has long held the principle that a customer's experience is far more important than the transaction itself. Organized, detail oriented, and quick to respond, Kyla has had success streamlining processes for many organizations throughout her career, so her clients can be sure that they will have a seamless and stress free experience.

When asked why she decided to make the move to real estate, Kyla explained "My entire career, I have had success understanding and meeting the needs of consumers all across the United States. Retail was a perfect match for me, as it coupled my creative nature with my strong business acumen. As I got older, I became passionate about personal finance and helping others understand how to build a better future for themselves. I am eager to be in a position where I can utilize my skills and take my passion for understanding the needs of others to give my clients a competitive edge when it comes to undertaking what will likely be one of the biggest investments of their lifetime, their home."

Kyla is a native Houstonian and a graduate of Houston Christian High School. She received a degree in Business Marketing from Texas A&M University, where she graduated Summa Cum Laude. She has been voted by her peers in several positions of leadership throughout her career, as her reputation for being smart, levelheaded, and empathetic makes her an excellent advocate for others. She enjoys a love of food and travel, having visited over 30 countries in her lifetime, and is always eager to give restaurant and travel recommendations. She currently lives with her husband, daughter, and two goldendoodles in the Heights.

With over a decade in the real estate industry, Jonathan Williamson has been a dynamic force in buying, selling, and managing properties. Since becoming a licensed agent in 2013, he has completed over 300 transactions, showcasing an unparalleled commitment to his clients and excellence in service.

Living in the charming heavily wooded subdivision of Grogan's Mill with his amazing wife and two beloved rescue dogs, Jonathan embraces a life of service, passion, and excellence. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, a seasoned investor, a home builder or somewhere in between, Jonathan is dedicated to making your real estate journey memorable and successful.

agents.bio: Henrry is a dedicated residential real estate agent specializing in the vibrant markets of Houston and Galveston. Before real estate, he spent 14 years in a career in sales and business development in the Oil & Gas industry which took him all over the world and now allows him to bring a diverse perspective and connect with a broad spectrum of clients. Yet his real estate journey started a decade earlier, after making the purchase of his first home, initially assisting and guiding friends and family with their home-buying processes based on his personal experiences. He quickly realized his natural aptitude for real estate and for the past 6 years, he has transformed his passion for real estate into a successful career, leading clients in the sale or purchase of their homes and investment, from first time home buyers to luxury homes and multi million dollar investments. Henrry has a true heart for people and is devoted to the welfare of his clients.

remarks: Welcome to 8734 Airlane Avenue, a beautifully preserved and thoughtfully updated 2-bedroom, 1-bath home on a generous 6,001-square-foot lot. This move-in ready residence blends classic Los Angeles charm with modern comfort, creating a light-filled retreat in the heart of Westchester. Step inside to discover beautifully refinished original hardwood floors, a cozy fireplace, and abundant natural light streaming through double, dual-paned windows. The updated kitchen and bathroom strike the perfect balance between contemporary upgrades and timeless details that honor the home's original character.Enjoy the convenience of an indoor laundry area and the serenity of a large, private backyard, ideal for outdoor dining, gardening, or quiet relaxation under the Los Angeles sun. An expansive front porch welcomes you home, while an approximately 260-square-foot enclosed patio with windows all around off the back of the house extends your living space.Nestled on a tree-lined street near Nielson Park, this home offers easy access to The Westchester Triangle, where you can enjoy favorites like Tomat, Ayara Thai, and Triangle Wines among other local shops and restaurants.Warm, bright, and full of character this Airlane Avenue residence is a rare opportunity to own a piece of classic Westchester charm with every modern comfort.

A Los Angeles native, Ashley Sackerman was born into a real estate family. Her parents both built their professional lives around the sale, management and corporate aspects of residential real estate and are esteemed members of the Westside real estate community.

Ashley graduated from the Marshal School of Business at USC knowing exactly what she wanted to do next: sell real estate. Since then, she has had the pleasure and privilege of working closely with some of the best and most respected agents in the business and has established her own reputation as an astute, engaging, honest and energetic professional.

Her ability to listen intently to her client's wants, needs and desires enables her to deliver highly personalized real estate experience for each of her clients. Ashley has successfully represented both buyers and sellers in standard, foreclosure and short sale transactions from the San Fernando Valley to the South Bay, West Hollywood to the ocean.

agents.bio:
Kate Myhan brings a highly distinctive background to commercial real estate, combining international business experience, advanced academic training, strategic marketing expertise, and hands-on dealmaking across multiple asset types. Based in Houston, Texas, Kate works with commercial property owners, investors, developers, landlords, tenants, and business buyers locally, nationally, and internationally. In addition to representing clients in Texas, she also works with national buyers pursuing opportunities in other states, helping them identify, evaluate, and secure the right assets based on their investment goals.

With a Master’s in Economics and more than two decades of experience in marketing, management, client relations, and real estate investing, Kate offers a sophisticated, results-driven approach to every assignment. Her professional background includes serving as a strategic marketing professor in Santiago, Chile, where she taught MBA students and developed high-level expertise in positioning, negotiation, market strategy, and consumer behavior. That international academic and business experience gives her a rare advantage in commercial real estate, especially when advising clients on marketability, asset positioning, and investment potential.

Kate has built her reputation on strong relationships, creative problem-solving, relentless work ethic, and an ability to connect the right people to the right opportunities. She is known for identifying value where others may not, whether in on-market listings, off-market deals, redevelopment sites, land opportunities, industrial assets, retail properties, mixed-use projects, multifamily investments, or business-related real estate transactions. Her combination of analytical thinking and marketing expertise allows her to not only find opportunities, but also present and promote properties in a way that drives attention and results.

Her experience is especially valuable to clients seeking guidance on acquisitions, dispositions, site selection, development potential, investment strategy, and high-visibility property marketing. Kate understands that commercial real estate success requires more than simply listing a property or submitting an offer—it requires insight, negotiation skill, persistence, financial awareness, and the ability to create momentum around a deal. She approaches each client relationship with professionalism, urgency, and a commitment to maximizing value.

Kate is a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Texas REALTORS®, National Association of Realtors, and the CCIM Institute. She holds respected industry credentials including CCIM (Certified Commercial Investment Member), CIPS (Certified International Property Specialist), TACS (Texas Accredited Commercial Specialist), and CRS (Certified Residential Specialist). Fluent in English, Spanish, French, and Polish, she is able to work effectively with a diverse range of clients, including international investors and cross-border buyers.

Clients appreciate Kate for her extensive market knowledge, global perspective, broad-based network, and unwavering devotion to their success. Her business is built largely through referrals and repeat relationships, reflecting the trust she earns through outstanding service, strategic guidance, and strong results. Whether representing a Houston-based owner, an out-of-state investor, or a national buyer expanding into new markets, Kate brings the experience, intelligence, and dealmaking energy needed to move complex transactions forward.

remarks: Discover the charm, character, and promise of this spacious Spanish-style residence tucked into the tree-lined hills of El Sereno. Surrounded by lush greenery and hillside views, this 4-bedroom, 2-bathroom home welcomes you with its arched picture window, warm stucco exterior, and classic architectural details waiting to shine. Inside, the layout flows from a cozy living area into a galley-style kitchen, offering an ideal footprint for those eager to personalize and elevate each space. A den at the rear provides a peaceful retreat, perfect for an office, reading room, or studio. Indoor laundry offers added convenience. The detached garage features a bonus suite that is complete with a 3⁄4 bath and kitchenette. Ideal for guests, creative space, or weekend escapes. Set in the heart of El Sereno 90032, you’re just moments away from the local flavor of Hecho en Mexico,Tirzahs Mexi-Terranean, Holy Grounds Coffee, Secret Pizza, "Yelp 100's Best" Mariscos El Chito and the scenic hiking trails of Ascot Hills Park. With mature landscaping and a welcoming yard, this home brims with natural beauty and neighborhood pride. Whether you’re looking to restore its original soul or design your dream residence from the ground up, this home offers a rare blend of character, space, and opportunity in one of LA’s most up-and-coming enclaves. Bring your vision and unlock the full potential of this hillside haven.

remarks: Nestled in the heart of North Kentwood, 7825 Cowan Avenue is a timeless estate that captures the essence of refined California living. Set on an oversized 7,774 sq. ft. lot, this stately 3,787-square-foot residence welcomes you through a grand double-height foyer, where a sweeping staircase and soaring cathedral ceilings create a breathtaking first impression. A gracious living room sets the tone with elegant proportions and abundant natural light, offering an inviting space to gather or unwind. Designed for comfort, connection, and effortless entertaining, the home features an ideal floor plan with three spacious bedrooms upstairs and two downstairs perfect for multi-generational living or guest accommodations. At the heart of the home, a gourmet kitchen showcases top-of-the-line Sub-Zero, Bosch, Wolf, and Viking appliances, a center island, and a sunny breakfast nook. The kitchen flows seamlessly into an adjoining formal dining room overlooking the pool, while the dining room opens to the family room, where a gas fireplace creates a warm focal point. Sliding glass doors lead to the expansive backyard, offering a seamless indoor-outdoor experience ideal for both intimate evenings and large-scale gatherings. Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite serves as a serene retreat, complete with a generous sitting area, private balcony with pool views, a sprawling walk-in closet, and a spa-inspired bath featuring dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a separate shower. Two additional upstairs bedrooms provide versatility for family, office, or creative use, while the two downstairs bedrooms offer privacy and flexibility for guests. A dedicated laundry room and two-car attached garage with direct entry enhance convenience and functionality. The resort-style backyard is an entertainer's dream, featuring a sparkling in-ground pool and spa with a traditional diving board and a safety cover that also reduces evaporation and heat loss. Lush landscaping frames the space, which includes an expansive patio for al fresco dining and a large, flat grassy lawn an exceptionally rare combination in this premier enclave. This unique slice of North Kentwood offers a friendly neighborhood atmosphere with local schools, LMU, and an array of everyday conveniences just moments away including the local grocery store, auto shop, and other essential services all within walking distance.

remarks: Sited in the heart of Laurel Canyon, this contemporary residence delivers panoramic views from nearly every angle. Designed to maximize its natural surroundings, wide custom windows and a 1,000-square-foot rooftop deck frame unobstructed 360-degree vistas of the mountains, canyon, city skyline, and glittering lights beyond. Set on a quiet street and spread across three combined lots totaling 13,564 square feet, the property offers rare scale, generous outdoor space, and the potential to add value, all within one of the Canyon's most coveted enclaves. Inside, the main living area is defined by soaring ceilings and one of the home's four wood-burning fireplaces. Walls of glass open to a large balcony, while a built-in bar supports seamless indoor/outdoor living and entertainment. The kitchen connects naturally to the living area and features an oversized island, ample storage, and stainless steel appliances, completing a thoughtful layout. There are three bedrooms, all en-suite and four bathrooms, each with high ceilings and custom windows. On the lower level, a generously-sized flex space, with its own entrance and full bath offers the ideal setup for a guest suite, office, or creative studio. Additional amenities include a two-car garage, ample street parking, extra storage, newer A/C system, and water filtration system. All of this, within the highly sought-after Wonderland Elementary School district and just moments to all that Sunset and Ventura Boulevards living have to offer.

agents.bio:
Over 18 years and hundreds of millions of dollars in Houston closings taught me one thing that never changes: the deal is won before anyone signs — in the prep, the pricing, and the negotiation. That's where I go to work for you.

I'm Le Nguyen, Broker and Owner of Go-M Realty, and I took the road less traveled to get here. I hold an accounting degree from UH-Downtown, so I read a contract the way few agents do — every number, every clause, every dollar that should stay in your pocket. Before real estate, I worked as a contractor for the U.S. Army in Kirkuk, Iraq, during the war as a purchaser, handling logistics, supplies and contracts. I also spent 16 years coaching competitive women's gymnastics — a sport where everything comes down to preparation, nerve, and executing when it counts. Those chapters shaped how I run a deal today. The numbers stay tight, and I don't flinch when the stakes climb.

When it's time to sell, I don't sit on a listing and hope. I market it hard — sharp pricing, strong presentation, and a strategy built to put your property in front of the right buyers fast. I'm a Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist and a Certified Negotiation Expert, but the part of my business I'm proudest of is the referrals. Most of my clients come from people I've worked with before — folks who trusted me enough to send me their family and friends. I don't take that lightly, and I've built my whole career on earning it.

When I'm not at the closing table, you'll find me in the gym, hunting down a new restaurant across town, planning my next trip, or getting talked back to by Lola, my parrot. When you're ready to make a move in Houston, I'd be proud to be your partner.

agents.bio: Lisa obtained her real estate license in 2011 after 13 years in the title industry. She started out managing a large volume of HUD foreclosures in the beginning of her career and then recruited her husband, Alex, to help streamline the process. After a couple of years selling foreclosures, Lisa switched gears and focused on new construction. She sold out a new home community in Garden Oaks in less than 2 years and was awarded a Million Dollar Circle Award by the Greater Houston Builders Association Sales and Marketing Council. In 2017, Lisa opened a boutique real estate brokerage, Tejas Realty Group. The brokerage started out with 2 agents and now has a team of 25. Lisa is a licensed real estate broker, wife, and mother. She volunteers with the Houston Livestock show and Rodeo, the Houston Association of Realtors Global Advisory Group, and the Texas Realtors Professional Development Committee. Lisa was also the Women's Council of Realtors Houston 2023 President and the 2024 Texas District Vice President.  She is currently the 2025 National Women's Council of Realtors Global Mastermind Co-Chair and the National Association of Hispanic Real Estate Professionals Secretary.

Alex decided to pursue a career in real estate in 2012 where he joined forces with his wife, Lisa to create a powerhouse team.  Alex came into the real estate industry after experiencing a successful career as a paralegal; helping homeowners with all aspects of real estate law from drafting deeds to loan modifications.  He immediately earned recognition from various asset management companies as a top tier market analyst. If you’re looking for a Houston Realtor who listens, communicates, and guides you through the process without the pressure, I’m here to help. I’ve been in real estate since 2013, helping buyers, sellers, and relocating families make confident decisions in a fast-moving market.

I work with clients all over Houston—from first-time buyers and growing families to sellers who want strong marketing and honest guidance. My approach is straightforward: clear communication, smart strategy, and a calm, steady experience from start to finish.

What You Can Expect
• Local knowledge – I was born and raised in Houston, and I know the city well.

• A strategic plan – Every listing gets thoughtful pricing, pro marketing, and the attention it needs to stand out.
• A smooth process – Real estate can feel overwhelming, and my job is to take the weight off your shoulders.

What Sets Me Apart
• 12+ years of real estate and negotiation experience
• A reputation for honesty, patience, and steady guidance
• A background in education that carries over into how I teach, inform, and advocate for my clients

I serve all of Houston and the surrounding suburbs. If you’re thinking about buying, selling, or relocating to Houston, I’d love to talk through your goals and help you map out your next steps. I’m here when you’re ready.

agents.bio:
For me, real estate has always been about people first.

I'm a Houston native, Broker Associate, and founder of Finch Properties Group. For nearly two decades, I've had the privilege of helping more than 800 of families buy, sell, and invest in homes across Houston. Along the way, I've learned that every move represents something much bigger than a transaction—it's the start of a new chapter.

Finding the right place to call home is personal to me because it's where my own story is unfolding. My husband and I are raising our family in Wilchester, one of Houston's beloved Memorial neighborhoods, with firsthand knowledge of what makes this community such a special place to live. From neighborhood traditions and local schools to market trends that vary street by street, I bring both professional expertise and the perspective of someone who proudly calls this area home.

While my team serves clients throughout the Houston area, my deepest local expertise is in Memorial and the surrounding communities. Whether you're relocating to Houston, moving within the neighborhood, or preparing to sell a home you've loved for years, my goal is to help you make confident decisions with thoughtful guidance every step of the way.

Clients often tell me they appreciate my honest communication, strategic advice, and calm approach during what can sometimes be an emotional process. I believe great real estate is equal parts market knowledge, negotiation, marketing, and genuinely caring about the people on the other side of the transaction.

Today, Finch Properties Group continues to be recognized among Houston's top-performing real estate teams. I'm a Certified Negotiation Expert (CNE), an active real estate investor and landlord, and a graduate of The University of Texas at Austin with a degree in Communication and extensive coursework in advertising. Our team has been recognized among Houston's top real estate professionals, including honors from the Houston Business Journal Top 25, RealTrends Top 100, and REALTOR® Magazine 30 under 30.

More than anything, I hope my clients remember how they felt working with us—heard, cared for, and confident that someone was advocating for their best interests.

Whether you're buying your very first home, moving up for your growing family, downsizing, or investing for the future, I'd be honored to help you navigate what's next.

Your trusted partner for all your real estate needs in the greater Houston area. Whether you're local, out of state or abroad, feel free to reach out to me any time. 
With a technical background, an MBA, hands on approach and common sense, I'm a reliable partner who will work with you to get things done from start to finish.

remarks: Pristine, elevated, and exquisitely designed, this custom-built 5-bedroom, 5.5-bath estate in Upper North Kentwood defines modern California luxury. Every element of this residence has been thoughtfully curated, blending timeless craftsmanship with contemporary sophistication for those who appreciate beauty in every detail. From the moment you enter, soaring 10-foot ceilings, 8-foot solid wood doors, bespoke moulding, and designer lighting create a grand yet inviting ambiance. Sunlight fills the open-concept living spaces, accentuating fine finishes and a natural flow ideal for both relaxed living and elegant entertaining. At the heart of the home, the chef's kitchen impresses with Carrara marble countertops, an oversized island with prep sink and breakfast bar, and professional-grade Viking, BlueStar and Thermador appliances, including an 6-burner range. A walk-in pantry, beverage refrigerator, and under-counter microwave enhance convenience, while the adjacent breakfast nook - framed by picture windows - invites serene morning moments overlooking the lush backyard. The formal dining room, highlighted by a coffered ceiling and chic dry bar with Carrara marble, sets a sophisticated stage for memorable gatherings. agents.bio:
Trey Poteet is a Houston-based real estate agent who specializes in helping individuals and families relocate to the Houston area. As a native Houstonian, Trey provides relocating buyers with local insight, clear guidance, and a streamlined approach to navigating one of the largest and most diverse real estate markets in the country.

Houston’s size and variety can be challenging for those moving from out of state or transferring within Texas. Trey helps relocation buyers understand neighborhood differences, commute patterns, school districts, housing styles, and pricing trends across Houston and its surrounding communities. His goal is to help clients quickly narrow their options and make confident, well-informed decisions.

Trey works with corporate relocations, remote professionals, and families moving to Houston for career opportunities, lifestyle changes, or long-term investment. He takes a consultative approach, focusing on education, realistic expectations, and strong negotiation to protect his clients’ interests throughout the buying process.

In addition to relocation buyers, Trey assists sellers and local buyers across the Houston metro area. Sellers benefit from strategic pricing, professional marketing, and data-driven exposure designed to maximize value and reduce time on market.

Known for his responsiveness and clear communication, Trey partners with a trusted network of lenders, inspectors, and service providers to help ensure smooth, efficient transactions—especially important for clients coordinating moves from outside the area.

Whether you are relocating to Houston, purchasing a primary residence, or investing in real estate, Trey Poteet offers professional representation and local expertise you can rely on.

agents.bio: Lisa obtained her real estate license in 2011 after 13 years in the title industry. She started out managing a large volume of HUD foreclosures in the beginning of her career and then recruited her husband, Alex, to help streamline the process. After a couple of years selling foreclosures, Lisa switched gears and focused on new construction. She sold out a new home community in Garden Oaks in less than 2 years and was awarded a Million Dollar Circle Award by the Greater Houston Builders Association Sales and Marketing Council. In 2017, Lisa opened a boutique real estate brokerage, Tejas Realty Group. The brokerage started out with 2 agents and now has a team of 25. Lisa is a licensed real estate broker, wife, and mother. She volunteers with the Houston Livestock show and Rodeo, the Houston Association of Realtors Global Advisory Group, and the Texas Realtors Professional Development Committee. Lisa was also the Women's Council of Realtors Houston 2023 President and the 2024 Texas District Vice President.  She is currently the 2025 National Women's Council of Realtors Global Mastermind Co-Chair and the National Association of Hispanic Real Estate Professionals Secretary.

Alex decided to pursue a career in real estate in 2012 where he joined forces with his wife, Lisa to create a powerhouse team.  Alex came into the real estate industry after experiencing a successful career as a paralegal; helping homeowners with all aspects of real estate law from drafting deeds to loan modifications.  He immediately earned recognition from various asset management companies as a top tier market analyst.  With a firm understanding of big business and Houston’s ever changing market dynamics, Alex brings a refined and strategic approach when consulting with his clients. When Alex is not selling real estate, he is enjoying family time with his daughter Alessandra and his boxer Titan.  Alex is an avid tennis player and loves playing golf.  He has received the Houston Association of Realtors Top Producing Realtor reward multiple times and has earned several designations such as Certified Negotiation Expert, Certified Neighborhood Specialist and Seller Representative Specialist to name a few.

I'm Michael Gee, a Houston Real Estate Advisor with Real Broker, West Point graduate, and Army veteran who has helped more than 250 families buy, sell, lease, and invest in real estate throughout the Greater Houston area.

I specialize in helping Houston first time homebuyers, military and veteran families, relocations, investment properties, new construction, VA home loans, and assumable VA loans. I also work with investors looking to build long term wealth through rental properties, duplexes, and strategic real estate investments.

My military background taught me the importance of integrity, communication, attention to detail, and putting others first. Those same values guide every client relationship. Whether you're purchasing your first home, relocating to Houston, selling your current property, or expanding an investment portfolio, my goal is to provide honest advice, strong negotiation, and a strategy tailored to your goals.

I'm proud to be a RealTrends Verified Agent and a 4 time Real Elite Agent, consistently recognized as one of the top producing agents at Real Broker. While awards are meaningful, what matters most is earning my clients' trust and helping them make confident real estate decisions.

Outside of serving clients, I enjoy educating consumers through social media by sharing insights on the Houston housing market, investment properties, VA home loans, assumable VA loans, and Houston neighborhoods. As both a veteran and REALTOR®, I understand the unique challenges military families face during PCS moves, transitions from active duty, and using VA benefits to build long term wealth through homeownership.

If you're looking for a trusted real estate professional in the Greater Houston area who values education, communication, and long term relationships, I'd love the opportunity to help you achieve your real estate goals.

Bay Oaks, is a premier golf community located in southeast Houston’s Clear Lake/NASA area. Dan McCarver knows the Clear Lake Real Estate Market very well.

Exemplary service is his standard. Dan possesses cool confidence, a professional demeanor, and a gracious personality, which is a winning combination and approach to his craft.

Mentored by his Mother, Barbara McCarver, a leading Real Estate Broker in Houston for 50 years, Barbara served as the first female President of the Houston Association of Realtors. Dan comments, “Real estate is a challenging and rewarding business. Having grown up around home sales, it seems second nature to me.”

Dan McCarver has achieved the #1 position in resale real estate transaction sales volume many times in the Clear Lake area. His success is no surprise. The honors and recognition he has received are indicative of his commitment, professionalism, and level of understanding in this specialized discriminating market.

remarks: Tucked just above Beachwood Village and right below the Hollywood Sign, this 1920s Hollywoodland home is full of character and charm. When you walk in, the space feels warm and inviting. Natural light pours across the hardwood floors and into a cozy sunken living room. Through the French doors, you'll find a terrace covered in grapevines, perfect for dinners outside or catching up with friends on soft LA evenings. Out back, loquat and lemon trees wait to be picked for your next meal. The kitchen, with its vintage green tile and stainless appliances, flows right into the formal dining area. A light-filled family room with a built-in bar makes a great spot for movie nights or casual get-togethers. Upstairs, the primary suite opens to a private deck, the perfect place to unwind and take in the hillside view. In total, there are three bedrooms, four baths, plus a flexible attached room that works well as an office or nursery. And just below, there's a charming (furnished or unfurnished) one-bedroom studio with its own separate entrance, ideal for guests or a creative workspace. Out back, a beautiful Moroccan door opens to a hidden stairway that winds up into the hills.People love this neighborhood for its creative, close-knit vibe with local cafes, hidden stairways, and hiking trails just steps from your door. Neighborhood Favorites: Beachwood Cafe - a cozy local landmark perfect for Sunday brunch.Beachwood Market - an old-school neighborhood grocer.Hiking trails leading directly to Griffith Park and the Hollywood Sign. Nearby Franklin Village with theater, restaurants, and nightlife. Prime Location: Easy access to the 101 freeway, studios, and the Valley. Quick drive to West Hollywood, Los Feliz, and Silver Lake. Ideal for those wanting the balance of privacy, architecture, and central LA living. The neighborhood features its own market, cafe, private mailbox rental, florist and stables.

If you ask where I work in Houston, you’ll probably hear me say: “If you divide Houston in half, I work the left-hand side.” I primarily serve Northwest Houston, and I’m very familiar throughout West Houston as well, including Spring, Tomball, Spring Branch, Cypress, Katy, and Richmond/Rosenberg.

Even though I’m tech-savvy (and yes—your home will be marketed online the right way), I still believe the best service happens voice-to-voice and face-to-face whenever possible. I’m hands-on with every client: meeting with sellers to stage and prepare a home, taking listings, coordinating photography, marketing, showing properties, hosting open houses, attending inspections—you name it. I’m the face and heart of The Bruner Team.

Behind the scenes, I’m supported by a trusted transaction coordinator who helps prepare listing documents and offers, tracks deadlines, and keeps everything moving smoothly—so you get both personal attention and professional precision.

If you’re looking for a knowledgeable agent who feels more like a steady partner than a sales pitch, I’d love to help you make your next move.

Although I live and work in Bellaire, I proudly serve the entire Houston market and will continue to provide exceptional service for each of my clients and my community as a whole. As your Real Estate Specialist, I promise to be your trusted resource for answers about the process of buying or selling. I will provide expertise about neighborhood features and schools and will target your home search based on your individual needs and wants. My custom innovative marketing strategies along with my strong negotiation skills are the keys to your successful transaction.

As an agent who's an expert in this local area, I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise about buying and selling real estate here. It's not the same everywhere, so you need someone you can trust for up-to-date information. I am eager to serve you. Here are some of the things I can do for you. Do you need someone who knows this area inside and out? I can work with you to find the right home at the right price for you, including all the neighborhood amenities that matter - not to mention the essential criteria you have for your ideal home. When it's time to move, you need someone who will advertise your home, show it to prospective buyers, negotiate the purchase contract, arrange to finance, oversee the inspections, handle all necessary paperwork and supervise the closing. I can take care of everything you need, from start to close. Oftentimes buyers don't visualize living in your home the way you do. I can make your home attractive to its ideal audience which can help you get top dollar. Things like staging the home, making repairs or minor improvements, or even simply painting the walls can be the difference between a home resting on the market and one that's sold fast.

With a rock-solid foundation built on years of experience in the commercial design and construction industry, Cathy brings a unique blend of expertise to the real estate arena. Known for her professionalism and unwavering commitment to excellence, Cathy approaches every transaction with an owner’s mindset, ensuring her clients’ interests always come first. Her strategic market insights and keen understanding of dynamics empower her to navigate Houston’s vibrant real estate landscape with finesse and precision.

A proud Houstonian and alumna of the Bauer College of Business at The University of Houston, Cathy is deeply ingrained in the pulse of the city she calls home. Her dedication to the community extends beyond the realm of real estate, as evidenced by her involvement with nonprofits like Abandoned Little Angels and Boat People SOS. Whether she’s serving on the board or volunteering for fundraisers, Cathy’s commitment to making a difference shines through.

remarks: This spacious freestanding home in Rice Military offers 4 bedrooms, 4.5 baths, and over 2,700 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space. The second floor showcases a large open concept living, dining, and kitchen area with access to a private balcony. Making it perfect for entertaining. The chef’s kitchen features Thermador appliances, Blanc Du Blanc quartzite countertops, a wine fridge, and soft-close cabinetry. A generously sized first-floor bedroom includes an en suite bath, walk-in closet, and opens to a private back patio. The third-floor primary suite boasts a luxurious bath with dual sinks, soaking tub, semi-frameless shower, and a spacious walk-in closet. Upstairs, a fourth-floor game room with exposed beam ceilings leads to a stunning rooftop terrace with pergola. Ideally located near Heights Blvd, Spotts Park, Buffalo Bayou trails, and the Washington Avenue dining and entertainment district, this home offers walkability and convenience in the heart of the city.

A third-generation Houstonian and University of Houston alum, Vincent Biondillo combines deep local knowledge with almost 20 years of real estate experience to help clients buy and sell homes with confidence. As co-founder of Norhill Realty—ranked #12 on the Cougar 100 in 2019—Vincent specializes in Houston’s Inner Loop neighborhoods and is passionate about connecting people to the city’s diverse culture and lifestyle.

With a background in marketing and mortgage lending, Vincent brings a well-rounded, client-first approach to every transaction. He’s a Certified Negotiation Expert (CNE) known for responsive service, honest advice, and smooth, stress-free closings.

Outside of real estate, Vincent stays active in the community through the SPJST Lodge and UH Bauer Alumni Association. He enjoys time with his wife and son, cheering on UH athletics, and competing in local BBQ cookoffs.

If you’re thinking about making a move—or just want to know if that Zestimate is lying to you—let’s talk. Happy to help, no pressure.

Erica Post Rogers is one of the top producing agents of Century 21 Western Realty; a company that has successfully serviced Houston and the surrounding areas since 1976. 

Erica’s philosophy of excellence and her cutting-edge work ethic make her the best choice when buying or selling property. As numerous testimonials state; her market knowledge helps clients feel secure knowing they have not missed out on anything!  She is always looking at the big picture while dialing down to dissect every detail that gets her client the absolute best deal possible.  

One of Erica’s strengths is her sincere ability to treat every client with the same level of care and respect. Her goal is to truly hear the client's desires and needs and then to move heaven and earth to do everything within her power to make it happen. Erica takes her client's goals very seriously and puts all of her efforts into achieving a successful transaction.  
 
Erica has a caring yet direct approach that helps her clients feel confident in her qualified recommendations.  She does not allow appeasement to limit her ability to get the job done to her client’s extreme satisfaction.

While servicing the entire Houston and surrounding area, Erica specializes in the area she grew up in, The Memorial Spring Branch area.

remarks: Modern farmhouse-style new construction by TDG just minutes from the Med Center, Hermann Park, U of H, and Downtown. Bold curb appeal with Hardie board-and-batten siding, whitewashed brick, ribbon driveway, and gated front yard. Inside, enjoy an open-concept layout with soaring 22-ft cathedral ceilings in the primary suite, exposed beam detail, and abundant natural light from oversized windows. The kitchen features sleek quartz countertops, a fluted waterfall island, and seamless flow into the dining and living areas. The spa-like primary bath boasts dual sinks and an oversized walk-in shower wrapped in designer tile. Two secondary bedrooms are located downstairs with a full bath and laundry. Luxury vinyl plank flooring throughout. Boutique finishes, thoughtful layout, and timeless style—welcome home!

The property features numerous recent upgrades, including a 2019 roof and a large covered back patio added in 2025, perfect for outdoor living and entertaining. Inside, you’ll find a stylishly refreshed kitchen with painted cabinetry, quartz countertops, under-cabinet lighting, and a large island that opens to the spacious family room. The first floor offers durable wood-look tile, while the second floor has been updated with vinyl plank flooring. All bedrooms are upstairs, including the expansive primary suite with a soaking tub, separate shower, and double sinks. Additional highlights include formal dining, breakfast room, gas range, crown molding, and a fully fenced backyard. Located in a convenient community with neighborhood amenities and easy access to major roads, this home is move-in ready and perfectly designed for comfort and functionality.

remarks: This lovely one-bedroom condo is located in Memorial, a corner unit on the second floor. It’s one of the most affordable condos in the area. The spacious one bedroom features a double walk-in closet and a ceiling fan. The living and dining are very bright & light. The kitchen is equipped with black appliances, including a stove, dishwasher, refrigerator and microwave. The bathroom has a shower tub and a washer machine. All tile floors except carpet in the bedroom. Electricity, water, & insurance are included in the HOA. The complex is well-maintained and features two swimming pools and two laundry facilities, security cameras, security guard at night. Conveniently located near City Centre and the Memorial Mall. You can also drive to Beltway 8 in a short commute. The condo is zoned to the acclaimed Memorial/Spring Branch Schools!

As the producer of a long-running and successful call-in radio program focusing on real estate, Shad is intimately familiar with the myriad details of the home buying and selling process, giving clients unparalleled access to his breadth of knowledge. He carefully listens to clients' unique goals and needs to formulate an effective plan to meet them. To make sure nothing falls through the cracks, he has assembled a staff of highly qualified professionals to take care of the many details involved in client's real estate transactions. Because of his years of experience helping first-time homebuyers find their dream home, Shad is especially turned to the unique needs and anxieties buyers face.

agents.bio:
The Bruner Team is currently a one-woman show—me, Elisa (Bruner) McNinch—and I’m honored to carry on the real estate legacy my parents began more than 40 years ago. Real estate has always been personal in our family, and that’s exactly how I still do business today: with genuine care, calm guidance, and a big dose of Southern hospitality.

I’m proud to have been recognized with the Five Star Professional Award for real estate customer service 13 years in a row (2012–2025)—an honor earned by fewer than 1% of Houston-area Realtors. I’m also a consistent multi-million dollar producer, but what matters most to me is that my clients feel heard, protected, and confident from start to finish.

If you ask where I work in Houston, you’ll probably hear me say: “If you divide Houston in half, I work the left-hand side.” I primarily serve Northwest Houston, and I’m very familiar throughout West Houston as well, including Spring, Tomball, Spring Branch, Cypress, Katy, and Richmond/Rosenberg.

Even though I’m tech-savvy (and yes—your home will be marketed online the right way), I still believe the best service happens voice-to-voice and face-to-face whenever possible. I’m hands-on with every client: meeting with sellers to stage and prepare a home, taking listings, coordinating photography, marketing, showing properties, hosting open houses, attending inspections—you name it. I’m the face and heart of The Bruner Team.

Behind the scenes, I’m supported by a trusted transaction coordinator who helps prepare listing documents and offers, tracks deadlines, and keeps everything moving smoothly—so you get both personal attention and professional precision.

If you’re looking for a knowledgeable agent who feels more like a steady partner than a sales pitch, I’d love to help you make your next move.

agents.bio:
Alberto Escobedo is not just a real estate agent—he’s a dedicated advocate for the Houston Latin community. His deep connections within the area give him a unique perspective, allowing him to serve as a bridge between his clients and their dream homes.
As a staple in the community, Alberto understands the challenges many families face in navigating the complex world of real estate, and he’s committed to making the process smoother, more accessible, and enjoyable for everyone.
Alberto’s passion for helping others goes beyond transactions; he genuinely cares about empowering the families he works with to make confident decisions.
His clients know they can count on him to stand by their side through every twist and turn, from understanding paperwork to negotiating deals that prioritize their best interests.
With his warm, approachable style and strong sense of community, Alberto is not just a realtor—he’s a trusted partner who helps transform dreams into reality while uplifting the neighborhoods that make Houston’s Latin community so special.
Aqeel Virk brings 7 years of real estate experience after joining Keller Williams Southwest in 2019.

agents.bio:
It could be said that either, you have a passion for real estate or you simply don’t. Without a shadow of doubt, Richard has that passion. He achieved is first real estate license at the age of 18 years old in Johannesburg South Africa. Ever since getting his license, all he has known is residential real estate. Evidence of this, are the best listing and best selling awards he has received in his early years. His passion and energy has served him well. By the age of 21 years old, he was managing an estate agency consisting of 25 experienced estate agents. But that was not enough, with a bold vision and an idea, he decided to go into partnership and start his own residential brokerage in 2009. During this time, Richard earned the esteemed designation of Master Practitioner in Real Estate. He successfully grew the business into a leading estate agency in Alberton & Johannesburg South area in South Africa.

By 2017 a new challenge was calling. He founded Stratton Real Estate in Johannesburg. The business quickly grew into a successful boutique brokerage, which delivered a more personal “white-glove” experience. In 2019, Richard immigrated to Houston Texas, and instantly fell in love with the city and its people. They say, “you might not have been born in Texas, but you got here as quick as you could.” For Richard, this is true. He is always very excited to show new comers to Houston why this is the best place for them and their family.

Richard’s ability to succeed and become a leading estate agent can be attributed to some key traits which makes him stand out from the crowd, namely his high energy, caring, friendly and compassionate nature. When you couple this with his relentless drive, attention to detail, along with a winning, “can do” attitude, you have a uniquely dynamic and qualified property professional, who will guide you to realize, your real estate goals.

When Richard is not shaking up the Houston residential property market, he is spending his time with is beautiful wife Roxanne. Richard’s guilty pleasure is Tex-Mex, Texas BBQ and desserts. So if you like good food, just ask Richard where the best restaurants are. Richard is a big sport fans. Growing up just outside of Newcastle, England, he is a huge Newcastle United fan, and he is also a big Rugby fan and not to mention an enthusiastic Texans fan. Richard always welcomes a little friendly banter from opposing sports fans.
