remarks: Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac, this stunning 5-bed, 3.5-bath home blends elegance, comfort, and function. A grand two-story entry welcomes you with soaring ceilings, abundant light, and timeless detail. Just off the entry, a dedicated office provides the perfect space for work or study. agents.bio:
William and Thuy Shipman moved to the Houston area in 1982 and have watched the area grow and emerge as one of the most thriving regions in the country! In fact, the Shipmans live in the same Cypress neighborhood that they grew up in! Their appreciation for Cypress and the Houston area stems from its diverse housing options that accommodate a wide range of families, an abundance of recreation opportunities, the people, and unmatched entertainment options. 

Over the last 30 years, they have enjoyed witnessing the continual developments that have made Cypress what it is today! As a real estate team, their goal is to introduce their buyers to an area where they feel this same connection with, and facilitate the selling process for sellers so that they can begin the next chapter of their lives in the home that best suits their needs. 

Prior to real estate, Thuy earned her Bachelor’s degree in Finance and worked as an accountant in the oil and gas field for years, as well as a loan originator and cash accountant for a mortgage company, and later, a cash accountant for a property management company. Her experience gives her a unique insight into the closing process that is unmatched by many. William’s wide scope of experience further enhances each transaction, as well. From helping home builders in his Cypress neighborhood and working in Data, to his experience in automobile sales and owning his own home theatre and automation company, William’s extensive expertise has proven beneficial to the team’s buyers and sellers. Their knowledge, skills, passion for real estate, and experience leasing out their own investment properties led William and Thuy to pursue a career in real estate! 

Determined, driven, self-starters, knowledgeable, personable, and helpful are just a few examples that define the Shipman team. After all, Thuy’s father brought her to America so that she could have a better life, and as a result, she capitalizes on every opportunity that presents itself not only to provide a better life for her family, but also for her clients. They place a great emphasis on communication, whether helping the client price their home, briefing them on the current market or trends, disclosing every detail about a property or neighborhood, or listening to their client’s needs and wants, William and Thuy’s commitment to communication never falters. 

In addition, their diligent work ethic and impressive negotiating skills produce optimal results that are in their client’s best interest. Plus, as residents of the community since 1982, they possess in-depth knowledge about the region and its accommodations.

Aside from their personality characteristics that attribute to their success, Thuy and William’s affiliation with Connect Realty further enhances each transaction. With the most innovative technology and tools in the industry, they have access to unparalleled resources that maximize their effectiveness and efficiency. Plus, Connect Realty’s premier training and support have equipped them with the essential knowledge, skills, and tools to overcome any obstacle that may arise throughout the transaction and deliver the most favorable results. 

When not diligently helping their clients, Thuy enjoys running, skating, attending her children’s events and activities, and spending time with her family. In addition, she owns a jewelry business and sells her jewelry online and at tradeshows. A sports enthusiast, William can be found golfing, shooting, fishing, or playing pool, when he is not spending time with his children.

With over 6 years in Real Estate and 15+ years in Sales and Business Development, Beth Buford is a seasoned expert. As a Houston local, she understands the crucial elements of choosing a home, neighborhood, and school system. With a remarkable track record in Greater Houston, Beth is on the path to becoming a top-producing agent, known for her relationship-building skills and deep Real Estate market insights.

As a waterfront property owner since 1996, Beth has firsthand knowledge of Lake Livingston's Real Estate landscape. She's passionate about helping Houstonians find their perfect place by the water, whether it's for weekend retreats, remote work, or future retirement.

Trust Beth to guide you through the significant financial decisions of buying or selling a home. As a caring, professional Realtor, she listens to your needs and provides top-notch service.

Beyond Real Estate, Beth enjoys hosting events, boating, and global travels with her husband, Carlos. She's a proud member of the Junior League of Houston (JLH) and volunteers at Bo’s Place, a bereavement center.

Binky Watkins is more than just a name in Houston’s luxury residential real estate scene. Originally from Minnesota, she’s embraced the essence of the Greater Houston Area since her teenage years. Binky’s diverse journey, from insurance agent to senior sales director, with a 12-year Middle East stint, uniquely informs her relocation expertise. She has called various places across the greater Houston area her home, all the way to College Station. remarks: Set on a serene, tree-lined street in the coveted Westport Heights neighborhood, this beautifully remodeled Westchester residence blends timeless charm with modern sophistication. Reimagined in 2020, the thoughtfully curated 1,001-square-foot floor plan lives impressively large, showcasing sun-filled interiors that capture warm southern and western light throughout the day. At the heart of the home, a bright gourmet kitchen elevates daily living with white shaker cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, a gas range, quartz countertops, and a classic subway tile backsplash. Its seamless connection to the backyard enhances both functionality and flow, making it an inviting hub for cooking, gathering, and entertaining. Rich hardwood floors continue into the adjoining living and dining areas, where an open, airy ambiance creates effortless continuity. The private quarters offer equal comfort and style. The full primary suite features dual sinks in an elegantly finished bathroom and direct access to the deck and expansive grassy yard, an ideal retreat for quiet mornings or evening relaxation. Two additional bedrooms and a second remodeled bath provide versatility for guests, family, or a dedicated office. Outdoors, the generous backyard becomes a natural extension of the interior, offering abundant room for entertaining, play, and future possibilities. The finished 360-square-foot garage adds remarkable flexibility--perfect as a studio, home gym, or workspace, and an excellent starting point for a future ADU. A charming storage shed further expands the property's potential as a creative retreat, office, or playroom. Turnkey, stylish, and positioned in one of Westchester's most desirable pockets, this Westport Heights gem delivers modern comfort, thoughtful design, and the welcoming neighborhood atmosphere that makes coming home a true pleasure.

agents.bio: As a top-ranked Real Estate Broker Associate in Houston for the past four years, I’ve had the honor of helping hundreds of clients navigate one of the most important decisions of their lives. With over 500 five-star reviews, my track record reflects my commitment to excellence, integrity, and results. Real estate isn’t just a career for me, it’s a passion. Whether buying your first home, selling, or investing, I take pride in guiding you every step with honest advice, personalized service, and a deep understanding of the market. Beyond real estate, I proudly serve the community as a firefighter, and giving back is at the core of everything I do. My team and I believe in building lasting relationships, not just closing deals, because to us, it’s not about houses, it’s about helping people achieve their dreams.

Esther Licona | Dual-State REALTOR®, Insurance Professional & Property Expert

Choosing the right agent means having someone who understands a home from the ground up—literally. As a licensed REALTOR® in both Texas and California, I bring a unique, multi-layered perspective to your real estate journey.

My approach to real estate is built on three core pillars designed to protect and empower my clients:

Unmatched Property Insight: Before transitioning into real estate, I spent 17 years in the swimming pool construction industry. This hands-on background gives me a sharp eye for structural details, backyard potential, and construction quality that standard agents might overlook.

Comprehensive Protection: In addition to real estate, I am a licensed insurance agent in Texas. This allows me to guide my clients seamlessly through the closing process while keeping a strategic eye on how to protect their biggest financial investments from day one.

Bilingual Communication: Serving both English and Spanish-speaking communities, I pride myself on clear, transparent, and comfortable communication. Everyone deserves to understand every detail of their transaction without a language barrier.

My Passion: First-Time Homebuyers
While I handle all facets of real estate, my true passion lies in helping first-time homebuyers achieve the dream of homeownership. There is nothing more rewarding than guiding a family through the complexities of their first purchase, breaking down the steps, and watching them hold the keys to their own home.

Whether you are looking to buy your very first home, sell a property, or invest in Texas or California, I am dedicated to providing a smooth, expert-led experience from start to finish.

Esther Licona | REALTOR® en Dos Estados, Profesional de Seguros y Experta en Propiedades

Elegir al agente adecuado significa contar con alguien que entienda una casa desde sus cimientos, literalmente. Como REALTOR® licenciada tanto en Texas como en California, aporto una perspectiva única y multifacética a tu experiencia inmobiliaria.

Mi enfoque en el sector inmobiliario se basa en tres pilares fundamentales diseñados para proteger y empoderar a mi clientes:

Conocimiento Inigualable de la Propiedad: Antes de dedicarme a los bienes raíces, pasé 17 años en la industria de la construcción de piscinas. Esta experiencia práctica me otorga una visión aguzada para los detalles estructurales, el potencial del patio trasero y la calidad de construcción que otros agentes convencionales podrían pasar por alto.

Protección Integral: Además de ser agente inmobiliario, soy agente de seguros con licencia en Texas. agents.bio: Who would have thought thirty-five years ago that a young man from Singer, Louisiana (a Cajun!) would end up in Aggieland and call it home! In 1986, Jonathan Poe began a new chapter in his life as he entered the Corps of Cadets at Texas A&M University. From day one, it was an experience that forever impacted his life. He received his B.S. Degree in Journalism and Public Relations in 1990 from Texas A&M University. Jonathan has dedicated his life to serving others. He was employed as a UPS Driver following his graduation from Texas A&M, with a tenure of ten years at United Parcel Service in the Bryan / College Station and outlying areas. He was honored to receive the Silver Medallion Recognition Award for exemplary customer service, a prestigious award only bestowed on 8 of 3000 employees in the South West District. Jonathan was fortunate enough to retire from UPS in July of 1999, and this enabled him to volunteer full-time, with no salary, for one year at his local church. That was a remarkable and amazing year; the Lord Blessed him and his family tremendously. After 20 years of employment and service to the church, wearing many hats (Care Pastor, Director of Operations, Construction Supervisor, Missions Pastor), Jonathan and his wife Jennifer, daughter Jillian, and rescue puppies Jambo and Jasper moved into their next God-given assignment of Real Estate. Jonathan Poe brings a myriad of talent and wisdom to the real estate community. He has an unquenchable passion and enthusiasm for helping friends and clients get the best possible deals in buying and selling real estate! Real Estate has allowed Jonathan to do what he loves; helping people buy their own home, purchase investment properties, and to reach their full God Given Potential. Jonathan embodies the highest integrity, character, and work ethic. His commitment to his clients is unwavering and unmatched! His relationship with his clients does not end at closing. He is constantly searching for homes or properties that will best suit his client’s/friend’s needs. He invites you to experience Real Estate like never before!!

Hi friends!  Whether you are looking to sell or buy a home or investment property, let me walk you through the process.  With over 35 years in the real estate industry, a background in banking/lending and escrow, my knowledge and connections can help alleviate the stress and create a smooth transaction.  

Give me a call, let's chat about your next real estate need - you will be glad you did!
                                             Making Real Estate Your Reality
                                                                                                 ~Nikki

agents.bio:
Jacqueline “Jaci” O’Neill is a seasoned, client-focused real estate professional with over two decades of experience. Since 2001, she has built a reputation for faith, knowledge, and exceeding expectations—not just meeting them.

Jaci is known as a strong, strategic negotiator—not just in price, but in the full structure of a deal. She understands that winning in real estate goes beyond the offer amount. From pricing strategy and contract terms to financing structure and risk positioning, she carefully crafts each transaction to protect her clients while making their offer or listing as competitive and compelling as possible.

At her core, Jaci’s focus is not on maximizing her own income, but on protecting those who come her way. She approaches every transaction with a responsibility to guide, safeguard, and advocate for her clients—ensuring they make sound, informed decisions that serve them well beyond the closing table.

What truly sets Jaci apart is her dual expertise as both a licensed realtor and loan officer. This unique combination allows her to see the full picture—how financing, terms, and market conditions work together. She helps clients navigate interest rates, lending guidelines, and affordability while simultaneously strengthening their negotiating position. This added layer of insight often uncovers opportunities and avoids pitfalls that others may miss.

Roughly half of her business comes from repeat and referral clients. The rest? Buyers and sellers who find her through platforms like Zillow, Homes.com, Trulia, Realtor.com, and YouTube—drawn by her authenticity, strong reviews, and commitment to excellence in both real estate and faith.
Her motto, “Serving YOU with Passion, Professionalism, & Prayer,” reflects her dedication to making the home buying or selling experience smooth, informed, and rewarding.
Jaci regularly hears from clients who’ve had negative experiences with agents who overpromise and underdeliver. Whether it’s overpriced listings that stagnate or buyers left unprepared, she is often the one they turn to next—and trust to get it right.
As a military spouse, she understands the stress of moving and specializes in relocation, veterans, and first-time buyers. Many of her clients are moving to or from Corpus Christi and Houston. She often provides in-depth tours of neighborhoods and homes that align with her clients’ goals and budget. For sellers, she helps coordinate every step from cleaning, repairs, staging, and more—even after they’ve left the area.
Her strong network of reliable tradespeople is another advantage. From pre-listing improvements to post-closing support, she ensures her clients are fully taken care of.
Jaci avoids flashy sales tactics and misleading data. Instead, she empowers clients with accurate information and personalized service. Her hands-on approach includes staging, updates/remodeling, and strategic marketing for sellers, and availability, research, and coordination for buyers.
She reminds clients: “No one controls the market—but we can understand it.” Pricing and strategy should reflect the actual market, not personal wishes or hype.
Whether through Jaci-O Group (Corpus Christi) or ORO Gold Standard (Houston), you’ll get transparency, reliability, and results. No games, no gimmicks—just professionalism and passion.
Beyond real estate, Jaci is passionate about writing and inspiring others. She especially loves to encourage others through her writing, with a heart to uplift, guide, and inspire as many people as possible—particularly the next generation.

agents.bio:
Oscar C. Hernandez, founder of The Advisory Real Estate + Development and Team Leader of The Oscar Fine Properties Team, has been a Houston real estate leader since 2002. His local expertise, financial background and client-first approach make him a trusted Advisor to clients. Oscar has closed more than $300 million in transactions and earned numerous industry accolades and designations, but he prefers to measure success through the satisfaction of his clients. Guided by a desire to serve others, he provides exceptional, personalized representation that surpasses the agent role - making him an integral member of each client’s professional services team. 
 
A Houston native, Oscar graduated from prestigious Rice University with a Bachelor’s Degree in Economics before heading to Wall Street, where he had an eight-year career as an oil & gas equity research analyst. He entered the real estate industry after he had moved back to Houston, when a former colleague sought his advice on the purchase of four multi-family properties. Oscar was the point person during the life of these investments; assisting with occupancy, improvements and, eventually, divestment. 
 
In many ways, Oscar's background as a financial analyst defines his approach to real estate. He views every purchase and sale through an investment lens. He specializes in using short and long-term trend analyses to determine a property’s current and potential resale value alongside in-depth market knowledge to guide his clients through the intricacies of real estate transactions. Oscar is also known for his creative marketing strategies and events - from open houses, to soiree's to client appreciation parties - and he has been creating and utilizing personalized, professional HD videos to sell lifestyle since 2008. 
 
Oscar specializes in Houston’s luxury market but believes in providing a luxury experience at every price point. He tailors his communication style to his clients’ preferences and provides information that is as thorough or concise as they wish. Many people in Oscar’s returning client-roster are busy professionals who are experts in their respective fields, and he’s also an expert that top Houston area agents call upon for their personal property needs or when a listing isn't selling in a timely fashion. He embraces the opportunity to collaborate with other agents on any need that may arise. 
 
Personally, Oscar's charitable donations and volunteer efforts include involvement with The Beacon, a local nonprofit that provides counseling, housing, and other civil services to bring Houston’s unhoused back into the community, and Scenic Houston, an organization that beautifies, connects, and improves Houston neighborhoods, drawing out his passion to help shape the future of Houston. Other organizations near and dear to his heart are Rice University, Kids' Meals, Inc., Ryan's Well Foundation, Living Water International, Autism Speaks, Houston Pets Alive, Pup Squad Animal Rescue and MD Anderson. 
 
When not with clients or giving back to the community, you’ll find Oscar keeping up with the latest events and openings around town, and enjoying the many activities that the greater Houston area offers - manifesting his mantra of 'Come Live Where You Play!'  Oscar is a resident of Houston's First Ward (est. 1840) and enjoys tennis, biking, leisurely walks, wine & food tastings and has a deep appreciation for the arts.

agents.bio:
Evan Compean is the founder of The Compean Group, a boutique Houston real estate team known for data-driven pricing, high-end marketing and skilled negotiation. A licensed agent since 2012 and a real estate investor since 2002, Evan has sold more than $250 million in real estate and brings a builder's and investor's eye to every home, from foundation and roof to resale value.

Areas: Houston Heights, Woodland Heights, Garden Oaks/Oak Forest, Montrose, Midtown, West University, Bellaire, Spring Branch, Pearland, Katy, Cypress and The Woodlands.

Specialties: Luxury and new construction, investment and multifamily properties, land, first-time buyers, and relocation.

Evan is also a licensed loan officer and a partner at Smart Title, so clients get guidance on financing and closing from someone who knows every step. Se habla español. With 400+ five-star reviews across Zillow, Google, Yelp and Realtor.com, The Compean Group focuses on clear communication and a smooth process from first call to closing.

remarks: Perched high in coveted Upper Ladera Heights, this newly refreshed mid-century retreat offers rare privacy and a move-in-ready lifestyle that feels effortlessly luxurious. Tucked at the end of a tranquil, low-traffic street, the home sits on an expansive 9,000+ sq ft lot, an elevated sanctuary where peaceful seclusion meets elevated Southern California living. Sunlight fills the single-level interior, where rich hardwood floors, a striking stone fireplace, and custom built-ins create an atmosphere of timeless elegance. Large sliding glass doors from both the living and dining rooms, along with a paned glass door from the office/guest room, invite seamless indoor-outdoor flow and frame the glittering cityscape beyond. The remodeled kitchen features sleek cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a double oven, opening gracefully to the formal dining room and spacious family room, perfect for effortless everyday living or refined entertaining. Step outside to a private backyard designed for enjoyment. Lush landscaping surrounds a generous patio with a built-in BBQ, abundant space for hosting, and the opportunity to craft your dream pool. The remodeled built-in jacuzzi hot tub with sheer-descent waterfall sits just beyond the primary suite, creating a serene escape right at home. The primary suite itself is a luxurious haven, complete with a walk-in closet, marble-tiled bathroom with dual vanities, and direct access to the backyard oasis. Additional enhancements include dual 50-gallon water heaters, an extra refrigerator in the garage and two sprinkler timer systems, as well as central A/C plus individual mini-splits for tailored comfort. A curved driveway leads to the attached two-car garage with direct entry, enhancing both convenience and privacy. Perfectly positioned in one of West L.A.'s most desirable hillside enclaves, this residence captures the essence of elevated California livingwhere quiet prestige, dramatic vistas, and impeccable updates come together in a rare and exceptional offering.

agents.bio:
In 2024 and 2025, Stephanie Younger was the #1 agent in the City of Los Angeles and the Westchester Neighborhood, selling more Single-Family homes than any other real estate agent or team. With unmatched expertise in Westside and South Bay neighborhoods, Stephanie and her team have built their brand on a reputation for service that exceeds all expectations.

Why Buyers and Sellers Choose Stephanie Younger:

- Ranked #11 Sales Team in LA County by the LA Business Journal (2024)
- Over $3 billion in lifetime sales.
- Consistently ranked a top producer in West LA real estate
- Featured in The LA Times, The Argonaut, Dwell, SpectrumNews, The RealDeal and more
- Neighborhood Expert: West LA & the Silicon Beach Corridor

As a Los Angeles native and long-time Westchester resident, Stephanie offers hyper-local knowledge that few agents can match. She specializes in: Westchester, Playa del Rey, Playa Vista, Marina del Rey, Culver City, Venice, and El Segundo

What Makes Stephanie Different?

- Stephanie's unique background in sales, event planning, hospitality, and the arts makes her an expert in both marketing and negotiation.
- She believes: “Real estate, like life, is all about getting the details right.”

Her Process Includes:

- Helping clients define and align their vision, goals, and budget
- Managing complex transactions with clear communication
- Navigating escrow, lending, and inspections with zero surprises
- Leading a high-performing team to deliver seamless service

Local, Loyal, and Living Here...

Stephanie lives in Westchester with her husband—a playwright and LMU professor—and their two children. She’s proud to serve the neighborhoods she calls home, and her passion for community is reflected in her generous support of local charitable organizations including the YMCA, Westchester Arts and Music Block Party, and more.

A Southern California native, Ron Melendez has lived all over the Los Angeles area. Growing up in the San Gabriel Valley, he would head over to the beaches of Orange County to surf. After moving to Westwood to attend U.C.L.A., Ron has lived in Santa Monica, the Valley, and West Hollywood, before finally settling with his family in the South Bay. They now live in Manhattan Beach’s Tree Section where his daughters attend American Martyrs School.

Ron believes in real estate done right. And he believes that the most important way to do that is to listen to really hear what the client wants and needs, and to put all other concerns aside in pursuit of that. Ron knows how important your decision to buy or sell a property is. After 30 years working as an actor working in both TV and Film, Ron has brought that passion to real estate. He loves helping people find the perfect place to call home or helping someone get the best price for their property so that they can achieve their dreams. He believes that this job is all about service. At the end of the day, he wants to look back and know that he always did right by his clients.

agents.bio:
Jeff Vrana is a CPA and started his career in 1984 with KPMG with a focus on Mortgage Banking and Real Estate. In 1988 he became the Accounting Manager of a large National Mortgage Company and helped manage the REO portfolio of over 2000 properties. He ended his mortgage career in 2009 as the CFO of a National Mortgage Company which produced mortgage loans in 42 states and had over 600 employees. As the CFO, he managed every aspect of the company and was directly responsible for negotiating over $1 Billion of financing with National Banks.

In 2009, Jeff left the mortgage industry and helped start two successful Property Tax Consulting firms, specializing in residential and commercial property valuation and negotiation. Jeff still retains a minority interest in one of the firms whose clients include ToysRUs, Darden Restaurants, Walgreens, and Landry’s. Jeff started his real estate sales career as a Realtor with Gary Greene Real Estate. In June 2012, Gary Greene partnered with Better Homes and Garden Real Estate, which brought the 50-year-old Houston real estate company marketing power of a brand that has been part of the American home since 1924.

Jeff was born and grew up in El Campo, TX. He graduated from Texas A&M University in 1984. He married his wife Kelly Vrana (Laswell) in 1987 and they have been happily married for 25 years. He has 3 children, Ashley, Lindsey, and Justin. The Vrana family are members of St. Ignatius Catholic Church and have lived in the Champions Park subdivision for 24 years.

agents.bio:
In January 2024, Angelina celebrated her 20th year in real estate!  Her journey began unexpectedly in 2004 when she inherited several rental properties after her mother's passing, becoming what she humorously calls an "unintentional landlord." Dissatisfied with the service provided by leasing agents, Angelina decided to take matters into her own hands and started taking real estate classes. By January 2006, she was a licensed Realtor with plans to only manage her rental properties but her warm demeanor and charisma propelled her to leave her full-time sales job and focus on real estate full time.  “I can’t believe it's been 20 years”, she admits, “and I have seen it all but it is still something new every day!”

Angelina reminds us it's still a “seller's market” in our area even with elevated mortgage rates.  She explains “With higher costs to rent, many renters have decided to buy instead of rent and build equity and in doing so they protect themselves from being priced out of the market in the future.  Other buyers have decided it is better to buy now with a higher interest rate but with today’s sales price instead of overpaying for a home later due to increased buyer competition in the summer months or when rates drop.” Angelina adds,  “There are even lenders that are offering no-cost refinances later when you use them as your lender now”. 

Angelina recommends that sellers consider listing their homes sooner rather than later if it makes sense. She explains that each situation is different but sellers may have fewer competing listings right now if they list before the summer.  Angelina declares “Early spring buyers are motivated buyers!” Sellers and buyers both need a Realtor with decades of wisdom and insight to formulate the best game plan. 

Along with her Broker’s license, attained in 2016, Angelina offers her clients ingenuity, diligence, and the wisdom that comes with almost 400 successful transactions. She skillfully navigates the most complex transactions such as relocation, divorce, and probate.  Drawing from her bachelor’s degree in psychology and background in sales, she caters to her client's unique needs.  Remaining abreast of evolving trends and technology, Angelina is a member of HAR.com’s  MLS Advisory Committee which underscores her dedication to enhancing industry standards for the benefit of agents and consumers alike. 

Beyond real estate, Angelina loves volunteering, supporting her children's activities, and planning fun activities for her friends and clients. Recognized for her numerous community contributions, she received the SBISD 2023 Good Neighbor Award.

agents.bio:
As a dedicated Realtor based in Cypress, Texas, I specialize in helping families turn their dream of homeownership into a reality. I don’t just help clients find any home—I guide them through one of the most important decisions of their lives with care, expertise, and attention to every detail.

From the very first conversation to the final signature at closing, I walk alongside my clients through each step of the journey. I take pride in making the process smooth and stress-free by handling everything from navigating complex paperwork to skillfully negotiating offers. My goal is to ensure that each family I work with feels confident, informed, and fully satisfied with their purchase.

Whether you're buying your first home, upgrading to meet your family’s growing needs, or relocating to the beautiful Houston area and surroundings, I’m here to advocate for you and make the experience rewarding from start to finish.

Let’s find the home that fits your life—and your future.

With a strong background in Oil & Gas sales, I bring over 25 years of experience in sales, negotiation, and customer service to the real estate industry. Over the past 6 years, I have worked with buyers, sellers, and investors, helping clients navigate the market with confidence and clarity.
As a husband and father of three, I understand that moving is more than just a transaction, it’s a major family decision. That’s why I focus on making the process as smooth and stress-free as possible, while ensuring my clients feel informed and supported from the initial search all the way through closing. My goal is simple: to understand your needs, provide honest guidance, negotiate strongly on your behalf, and deliver a positive real estate experience every step of the way.
I’m grateful for the trust my clients place in me and invite you to read the reviews shared by families and individuals I’ve had the privilege to help. Let’s make your next move a successful one.

She earns their respect by working tirelessly on their behalf, paying attention to detail, striving for perfection, and making each transaction as smooth as possible. Hello and thank you for your interest in my career!
I've had the opportunity to provide real estate expertise to Houstonians since 1982. As a British expat I am aware of the many decisions that must be made when relocating from another country to Houston or even moving within our dynamic city.  
I graduated with honours from the University of London, followed by a post-graduate program at the London College of Law. After completing the real estate broker requirements, I opened  Regal Realty International in January 1985.

Continuing education is vital to offering sound advice and in recent years I have complimented my academic qualifications with the completion of the "Graduate of the Real Estate Institute"(GRI) and "Certified International Property Specialist" (CIPS) accreditations.
It is my goal as your full service real estate broker for the Houston, Memorial, Energy Corridor, Katy, and Sugarland areas, to give you superior service at all times. My extensive real estate experience will benefit you whether you are serious about buying or selling a home at this time, or are a returning client checking out the many homeowner resources I offer.
Buying a home? I look forward to helping you select the home of your dreams by taking time to listen to your needs and desires. I will guide you through the financing, inspection and title processes of your real estate purchase.
Selling a home? My real estate expertise and many effective marketing programs will give you the exposure and edge you need to sell your home quickly for top dollar.
Returning client? I appreciate the opportunity to continue to serve you and hope you take advantage of the valuable resources I provide. Come back to visit often!I consider this community an excellent place to reside and would love to share with you my enthusiasm for the many neighborhoods that encompass it. I pride myself on providing unparalleled service and look forward to developing a long-term relationship with you. Please feel free to contact me if you would like to discuss how I can best assist you with your real estate needs.
Sincerely,
Ericka J. Thomas de No

remarks: Thoughtfully reimagined midcentury home sits in one of the area’s most desirable neighborhoods, just moments from Town & Country Village and Beltway 8. The living spaces have been professionally opened and redesigned to create a soft, modern flow. Custom cabinetry and elevated finishes found throughout. Nearly every room looks onto the private central courtyard and shimmering pool, filling the home with natural light and a sense of calm. The primary suite offers a quiet retreat with his-and-hers designer closets and a remodeled bath featuring a soaking tub, separate shower, and double sinks. All doors have been replaced, with premium metal and privacy-glass designs enhancing the exterior entries. Additional baths pair new cabinetry and quartz countertops with preserved midcentury tile for character. A standing-seam aluminum roof adds style and longevity. The detached fourth bedroom with its own bath opens to the pool and serves beautifully as a guest suite, game room, or pool house.

agents.bio:
With nearly three decades in real estate, Marta Mohan is a top-producing Realtor® with Hometown America Incorporated in Sugar Land, Texas. Licensed since 1996, she has helped countless buyers and sellers navigate the market with expertise, delivering exceptional service and outstanding results.
Marta holds multiple prestigious designations, including ABR (Accredited Buyer Representative), QSC (Quality Service Certified), CNE (Certified Negotiation Expert), and CLHMS (Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist). Her commitment to continued education and dedication to her clients—whether first-time homebuyers or seasoned investors—has earned her recognition as a Top Producer and Top Sales Associate. She has proudly secured first place in most listings and total units closed, a testament to her knowledge, experience, and passion for real estate.
A South Florida native, Marta moved to Houston in 1975, working at Gulf Oil in Fort Bend before transitioning to real estate. In 1985, her family embarked on an unforgettable journey to Indonesia, living in Borneo and Jakarta for seven years due to her husband's work in the oil industry. Immersing herself in a different culture was a transformative experience, one she treasures to this day.
Through her expertise, integrity, and enthusiasm, Marta continues to build lasting relationships with her clients, helping them achieve their real estate goals with confidence.

Located in one of Houston’s most vibrant and walkable neighborhoods, this updated townhome in Rice Military sits on an oversized lot with a large backyard, 2-car garage, and extra parking. Features include two new A/C units, a new roof, a new water heater, hardwood floors, an island kitchen with stainless steel appliances, and two balconies, one of which is plumbed for a grill. The flexible first-floor layout offers a spacious primary bedroom with vaulted ceilings and an ensuite secondary bedroom. Washer, dryer, fridge, and window treatments included, minutes to Memorial Park, Downtown, and top dining spots. No HOA!

Don’t miss this one, schedule your private tour today!

agents.bio:
Trey Poteet is a Houston-based real estate agent who specializes in helping individuals and families relocate to the Houston area. As a native Houstonian, Trey provides relocating buyers with local insight, clear guidance, and a streamlined approach to navigating one of the largest and most diverse real estate markets in the country.

Houston’s size and variety can be challenging for those moving from out of state or transferring within Texas. Trey helps relocation buyers understand neighborhood differences, commute patterns, school districts, housing styles, and pricing trends across Houston and its surrounding communities. His goal is to help clients quickly narrow their options and make confident, well-informed decisions.

Trey works with corporate relocations, remote professionals, and families moving to Houston for career opportunities, lifestyle changes, or long-term investment. He takes a consultative approach, focusing on education, realistic expectations, and strong negotiation to protect his clients’ interests throughout the buying process.

In addition to relocation buyers, Trey assists sellers and local buyers across the Houston metro area. Sellers benefit from strategic pricing, professional marketing, and data-driven exposure designed to maximize value and reduce time on market.

Known for his responsiveness and clear communication, Trey partners with a trusted network of lenders, inspectors, and service providers to help ensure smooth, efficient transactions—especially important for clients coordinating moves from outside the area.

Whether you are relocating to Houston, purchasing a primary residence, or investing in real estate, Trey Poteet offers professional representation and local expertise you can rely on.

remarks: Introducing a rare opportunity! The stunning Santi Elite Summit Model, one of the largest and most distinguished floor plans in the prestigious Westcliffe community. Perfectly positioned on a sweeping 13,000+ sqft corner lot at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, this architectural showpiece offers captivating panoramic views of the mountains, twinkling city lights, and rolling hillsides. Designed for resort-style living, the private backyard is a true sanctuary. A state-of-the-art saltwater smart pool with beach entry, tranquil water features, and a dramatic water wall sets the tone for outdoor elegance. The detached spa lounge area features a freestanding TV wall, an expansive fireplace flanked by custom fire pilasters, and multiple fire features an entertainer’s dream with a view. Over 100 mature trees surround the property, creating a sense of privacy and natural serenity rarely found. Recently, the entire exterior was fitted with discreet bird netting an effective and humane solution to prevent birds from entering unwanted areas, adding another layer of thoughtful care and value to the home. Inside, the home is a masterpiece of modern design, showcasing refined finishes, thoughtful upgrades, and curated details throughout. The open-concept layout is complemented by a sleek built-in wet bar and an impressive three-story floating staircase that leads to a versatile upper-level bonus room with its own full bath and expansive view terrace. Window coverings throughout include a combination of custom shutters and electric shades, blending style with convenience. Wellness and sustainability are seamlessly integrated with a private home gym, whole-home water softener and purification system, smart irrigation, and fully paid solar panels. Tech-forward conveniences include EV charging stations, two inside the garage and one exterior and premium sliding glass doors that create a seamless indoor-outdoor living experience. Enhanced with builder upgrades and custom options, this residence stands as a symbol of sophistication and distinction. Located within the highly desirable Porter Ranch community, enjoy close proximity to top-rated public and private schools, including the renowned Porter Ranch Community School and Sierra Canyon.

agents.bio:
With more than two decades of experience in real estate and mortgage lending, Jesse Guzman brings a unique, full-service perspective to every transaction. Serving buyers, sellers, investors, and property owners throughout Southern California, Jesse combines extensive real estate experience with in-depth knowledge of financing, negotiation, market analysis, and investment strategy.

What sets Jesse apart is his ability to look beyond simply buying or selling a property. As both a real estate broker and experienced mortgage professional, he understands the complete transaction,from determining the right pricing and negotiating strategy to evaluating financing options and structuring a deal that makes sense for his clients.

Jesse's experience spans residential homes, luxury properties, investment properties, multi-unit buildings, commercial real estate, and a wide range of financing solutions. Whether representing a first-time buyer, marketing a family home, negotiating a complex transaction, or helping an investor evaluate an opportunity, his approach is centered on preparation, communication, and protecting his client's best interests.

Over the years, Jesse has built his business largely through relationships, referrals, and repeat clients. He believes great representation means being accessible, explaining the process clearly, anticipating problems before they become obstacles, and providing clients with the information they need to make confident decisions.

Today, Jesse works alongside his family through The Guzman Group, providing clients with a team-oriented approach backed by decades of industry experience and a strong network of real estate, lending, escrow, title, and industry professionals.

For Jesse, real estate isn't just about completing a transaction, it's about becoming a trusted resource clients can rely on before, during, and long after closing.

Whether you're considering buying, selling, refinancing, or investing, Jesse welcomes the opportunity to help you evaluate your options and develop the right strategy for your goals.

agents.bio:
Katherine Boddeker grew up in New York and loves the bustle of the big city, so her move to the more southern climate of Houston was a smooth transition. She studied dance at the High School of Performing and Visual Arts, and later attended University of Houston for business.

After college, Katherine entered the real estate world in 1989 and has never wanted to do anything else. If you're searching for an expert in the Houston housing market, look no further. She can help you buy, sell, lease, invest, or even build. Having spent nearly thirty years in the business, she is well versed in all areas of the city and all aspects of the market.

First and foremost, Katherine is a mom. She has spent years as an active advocate in her children's schools, both public and private. She understands how important finding the right school for families can be.

Katherine knows that home is where the heart is, and many times, that home includes pets. A lover of animals, she has spent much of her spare time with dog rescues. She has opened up her home for training, fostering, and interviewing potential owners to find the perfect home for these animals she has come to love. She volunteers at pet adoptions and fundraising activities.

If you're looking for an experienced Real Estate Broker who knows the ropes and understands your needs, call Katherine today at 555.483.6838. Her website is: www.katherinetxrealtor.com

remarks: Charming and beautifully remodeled 2-bedroom, 1-bath Spanish-style home offering the perfect blend of classic character and modern comfort. This light-filled residence features hardwood flooring throughout, double-pane retrofit windows, central heating and air conditioning, and a new solar system, providing energy efficiency and long-term savings. The thoughtfully designed floor plan includes a formal dining room, a cozy breakfast nook, and a separate laundry room, offering both functionality and charm. The remodeled bathroom adds a fresh, contemporary touch while preserving the home's timeless appeal. The detached rumpus room is generously sized and presents an exceptional opportunity large enough to potentially accommodate a 2-bedroom ADU (buyer to verify), ideal for extended family, rental income, or a private office or studio. Situated in an Inglewood-adjacent neighborhood, this home is minutes from SoFi Stadium, The Forum, the 405 and 110 freeways, and a short drive to the beaches. Enjoy close proximity to shopping centers, parks, schools, and dining everything you want in a vibrant, well-connected community. A rare opportunity to own a character-rich home with modern upgrades, expansion potential, and an exceptional location.

Get to Know Me

As a proud Houston native raised in and currently residing in Montgomery County, I bring lifelong local knowledge and professional expertise to every client. As a Resident Realtor in The Woodlands Hills master-planned community, I proudly serve buyers, sellers, investors, landlords, tenants, and families throughout the Greater Houston area.

Outside of real estate, my favorite role is being a mom to my three children. As part of a military family, I value service, integrity, resilience, and the importance of home. Those values guide how I serve every client—with honesty, dedication, and a commitment to always putting your best interests first.

Known for my loyalty, strong communication, and attention to detail, I come from a strong family background in real estate and customer service. Combined with my own experience as an investor and landlord, I bring a well-rounded perspective to every transaction. My better half is a mortgage loan officer, giving me valuable insight into the financing side of the business and helping me guide clients confidently from contract to closing.

I hold the ABR, NHC, and MRP designations and have experience with residential homes, lots and acreage, new construction, assumable mortgages, pre-foreclosures, short sales, investment properties, and rental transactions. I assist sellers in maximizing exposure and protecting their equity, negotiate strong terms for buyers, represent landlords by marketing properties and screening tenants, and help tenants navigate every step of the leasing process.

As a Wychico Realty and my direct partnership with Homes.com, I provide exceptional local and nationwide exposure. My marketing includes professional photography, targeted digital advertising, enhanced online visibility, and most for-sale listings include a Matterport 3D virtual tour, allowing buyers to experience 24/7 virtual showings from anywhere.

Whether you're buying, selling, investing, relocating, or leasing, my goal is to make your real estate experience seamless, strategic, and stress-free while delivering exceptional service and proven results from start to finish.

remarks: Experience modern living at 7120 Gary St Unit A, a thoughtfully designed new construction home offering style, comfort, and functionality. This light-filled open-concept layout features elegant wood and tile flooring throughout—no carpet—for a sleek, contemporary feel. The chef-inspired kitchen showcases quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry, and a modern backsplash, seamlessly connecting to the living and dining areas—ideal for entertaining and everyday living. Spacious bedrooms offer generous closet space and abundant natural light, while spa-like bathrooms feature walk-in showers, designer finishes, and chic tile work. Enjoy a private fenced patio/yard, perfect for relaxing or hosting guests, plus convenient off-street parking. Ideally located near shopping, dining, and major commuter routes, this home delivers modern comfort, quality construction, and exceptional value.

Maggie Young Garza is a native Texan and top-producing Realtor® with Compass, proudly leading the HTX Real Estate Group — a dynamic team of six accomplished agents recognized for exceptional client service, market expertise, and results. Known for her energy, integrity, and deep community connections, Maggie has built her career on relationships, strategy, and an unwavering commitment to delivering outstanding outcomes.

Raised in a family of entrepreneurs, Maggie brings a disciplined work ethic, discretion, and a true client-first philosophy to every transaction. Since launching her real estate career in 2012, she has grown her business through market knowledge, thoughtful guidance, and a reputation for integrity. Her approach is both strategic and personal — ensuring each client feels confident, informed, and fully supported from contract to close.

Maggie is known for her attentive service, honest counsel, and ability to make the buying and selling process seamless and rewarding. She understands that real estate is not only a significant financial investment but also a meaningful life milestone. With approachable confidence and steady perspective, she helps clients navigate important decisions with clarity and ease — always valuing their time, trust, and long-term goals.

Her dedication extends well beyond real estate. Maggie has been deeply involved in the communities she serves. In West University Place, she has chaired Fathers & Flashlights and served on the West University Park Lovers Ball committee. She has also been actively engaged at St. Vincent de Paul Catholic School, chairing the PTO Auction & Gala and contributing to the Legacy Wall Project.

Born and raised in Corpus Christi, Maggie has proudly called Houston home since 2001, living in Montrose, The Heights, and now West University Place. Above all, she is devoted to her family. Maggie and her husband, Dax, are proud parents of three children — Dax II, Porter, and Marshal. When she’s not serving her clients, she enjoys traveling and spending meaningful time with family and friends.

In 2008, a native Venezuelan, Maria Carolina Pulido decided to permanently trade in her career as an Early Childhood Education teacher to be a business owner and decided to open a franchise restaurant. Her passion for customer service and experience on a daily basis in the restaurant industry and for over eight years with customers from all kinds of cultures and nationalities, brought to her attention that she could be a very valuable resource for people and families looking to invest their life and future in real estate. Committed to stellar customer service, her goal was to push herself to help buyers find the perfect home according to their lifestyle. Incorporating enthusiasm, integrity, and dedication to her clients, she used her strong people and problem-solving skills to succeed as a buyer's or top seller's advocate. She brought a strong background in marketing, business, technology, and investment to the table. As one of the most dedicated customer service representatives in the industry.

agents.bio: As a seasoned real estate broker in the greater Houston area since 2003, Thomas L. Saunders offers unparalleled expertise and deep local connections. "Today's real estate transactions are anything but average, and people demand a level of service that matches their complexity," says Saunders, a lifelong Houstonian. He emphasizes the importance of a REALTOR® who is well-prepared to handle issues like seller liability and evolving laws. Early in his career, Saunders gained significant experience with acquisitions and liquidations at HomeVestors of America, and he has worked on REO liquidations with Trillionaire Assets and asset management with Jet Lending, LLC. Beyond his professional commitments, Saunders is dedicated to giving back, supporting Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals® and volunteering at local schools and the Fellowship of the Woodlands East Campus. His extensive background in commercial architecture, BPO evaluations, real estate investment, and REO sales ensures that clients receive top-notch service and expert advice in every transaction.

agents.bio:
Robin Gaur is the Founder of Müv Real Estate Group at Compass, bringing over 20 years of real estate investment and transaction experience, a vast professional network, and a results-driven approach to every client relationship. A Los Angeles native, Robin has a deep appreciation for the Southern California lifestyle and an intimate understanding of the region's diverse neighborhoods and ever-evolving real estate market. Robin is also a RealTrends Verified real estate professional, recognized among the industry's top-performing agents.

A leader in luxury real estate, Robin represents buyers, sellers, investors, and developers throughout Greater Los Angeles, specializing in luxury homes, new construction, investment properties, and development opportunities. Having personally bought, sold, and invested in numerous residential and investment properties, he offers clients valuable firsthand experience and a unique perspective that extends well beyond the traditional real estate transaction.

Robin's success is built on exceptionally high standards, integrity, responsiveness, and an unwavering commitment to achieving outstanding results. He embraces cutting-edge technology, innovative marketing strategies, and data-driven market analysis to maximize exposure for sellers and identify opportunities for buyers. Known for his relentless work ethic and around-the-clock availability, Robin has earned the trust and respect of clients and industry professionals alike.

Before transitioning into real estate full-time, Robin spent more than two decades in the aerospace industry, where he held senior management positions overseeing complex engineering and business operations. His analytical mindset, leadership experience, and strategic approach continue to provide clients with a distinct advantage in today's competitive marketplace.

Robin earned a Master of Business Administration from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill, along with a Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering and a Master of Engineering Management from California State University, Northridge. Fluent in English, Hindi, and Punjabi, he proudly serves a diverse clientele throughout Southern California.

Outside of real estate, Robin enjoys spending time with his wife, Avneet, and their two sons, Shawn and Armaan. Whether buying, selling, leasing, or investing, Robin is committed to providing strategic guidance, exceptional service, and an elevated real estate experience that helps his clients achieve their goals with confidence.

agents.bio: Lisa obtained her real estate license in 2011 after 13 years in the title industry. She started out managing a large volume of HUD foreclosures in the beginning of her career and then recruited her husband, Alex, to help streamline the process. After a couple of years selling foreclosures, Lisa switched gears and focused on new construction. She sold out a new home community in Garden Oaks in less than 2 years and was awarded a Million Dollar Circle Award by the Greater Houston Builders Association Sales and Marketing Council. In 2017, Lisa opened a boutique real estate brokerage, Tejas Realty Group. The brokerage started out with 2 agents and now has a team of 25. Lisa is a licensed real estate broker, wife, and mother. She volunteers with the Houston Livestock show and Rodeo, the Houston Association of Realtors Global Advisory Group, and the Texas Realtors Professional Development Committee. Lisa was also the Women's Council of Realtors Houston 2023 President and the 2024 Texas District Vice President.  She is currently the 2025 National Women's Council of Realtors Global Mastermind Co-Chair and the National Association of Hispanic Real Estate Professionals Secretary.

Alex decided to pursue a career in real estate in 2012 where he joined forces with his wife, Lisa to create a powerhouse team.  Alex came into the real estate industry after experiencing a successful career as a paralegal; helping homeowners with all aspects of real estate law from drafting deeds to loan modifications.  He immediately earned recognition from various asset management companies as a top tier market analyst.  With a firm understanding of big business and Houston’s ever changing market dynamics, Alex brings a refined and strategic approach when consulting with his clients. When Alex is not selling real estate, he is enjoying family time with his daughter Alessandra and his boxer Titan.  Alex is an avid tennis player and loves playing golf.  He has received the Houston Association of Realtors Top Producing Realtor reward multiple times and has earned several designations such as Certified Negotiation Expert, Certified Neighborhood Specialist and Seller Representative Specialist to name a few.

agents.bio:
I began my career in Residential Real Estate because everyone deserves a place to call home—and I wanted to be the one to help make that happen. Trained and mentored by some of the industry’s best, I bring a strong commitment to professionalism, client care, and continuous improvement. Guided by the principles of Total Quality Management, I’m always learning—through certifications, webinars, and mastermind sessions—to stay ahead of the curve.

Selling or buying a home can feel overwhelming—emotionally, financially, and logistically. Why? Because it’s not just a transaction; it’s a major life transition and I get it. I’ve lived through it myself multiple times.

Then there is the looming ominous worry - “What if something goes wrong?”

I am proud to say, after 10 years in the business, I have guided hundreds of clients through their transitions and transactions - SUCCESSFULLY! My purpose is clear to me: Cut through the real estate brain fog and remove the fear factors. Keep it stress-free and simple and make them smile!

My father would tell me, “You think too much.” He meant it as a criticism—but I consider it my greatest strength. I’m constantly analyzing, learning, and anticipating—so I can make smart recommendations, resolve problems, protect my clients’ blind sides and seize opportunities before others do. I can provide the clear and honest confidence-building advice needed to make the best decisions for you and your family. I provide realistic timelines and present real numbers so there are no surprises at the closing table. I lead with transparency, trust, and implement programs designed to help my clients sleep better at night.

As you may know, real estate is a relationship business—built on trust and word-of-mouth. That’s why I’m dedicated to delivering five-star service every time. My success depends entirely on your success and your confidence in referring me to your family, friends, and neighbors.  Over the years, clients and colleagues have praised my work and dedication. I’m deeply grateful for the endorsements and referrals from those who see me as a trusted adviser, subject-matter expert, and top-rated agent. You can see my reviews on HAR and Zillow.

It’s been an incredible journey, and I’m grateful every day that I chose this path. If you’re looking for a Realtor who understands what you’re going through—who’s experienced, proactive, and fully invested in your next life chapter—look no further.

Let’s talk about your next move.
Call or text: 555-952-4547

Kiesha’s expertise has extended beyond the local realm, as she was designated a Five Star Market Leader in 2020 and featured in Forbes Magazine. She has had the privilege of sharing her insights on various platforms, including podcasts and magazines like Voyage Magazine Houston.

Kiesha’s educational background, holding a bachelor’s degree in social work and a Master's degree in Counseling, equips her with invaluable communication and customer service skills. remarks: Classic 1916 Windsor Village HPOZ Gem with Income Potential. The family who has spent the past 58 years making great memories is ready for the next owner to make their own memories. Located in the culturally rich Windsor Village community, this captivating 4-bedroom, 3.25-bath classic residence offers approximately 3,945 square feet of living space on a generous 7,504 sq ft lot. With its Historic Preservation Overlay Zone (HPOZ) designation, 838 S Lorraine Boulevard presents a rare chance to own a piece of LA's architectural heritage, ready for you to restore it to its full glory and make it your dream home. Character Meets Opportunity: Stunning original hardwood floors in the living room, dining room, and two bedrooms have been beautifully refinished, along with the graceful wood handrails and staircase, showcasing the exceptional craftsmanship of 1916. The home's timeless architecture and quality construction reflect an era when homes were built to last, cherished by the same family since 1967. Versatile Living Spaces: Finished third-floor attic with refreshed flooring and fresh paint offers flexible space for home office, studio, or additional living area. Bonus studio unit above the 2-car garage provides excellent income potential or perfect in-law/guest quarters. Spacious rooms with classic proportions throughout. Solid Bones, Ready for Your Vision: Newer roof (2019) provides peace of mind. Original character details and architectural elements throughout. Perfect opportunity for buyers who appreciate historic homes and want to restore this classic to its full potential. Prime Location: Windsor Village's Hancock Park adjacent location offers close proximity to Los Angeles' top destinations, vibrant Koreatown dining and shopping, the museums and culture of Miracle Mile, trendy restaurants and shops of Mid-City. Easy access to downtown and all major corridors. Trust Sale, no court confirmation required. Property being sold in its current condition. This beautiful classic home needs some TLC but offers tremendous potential for the right buyer. A rare chance to own a piece of LA's heritage, ideal for owner-occupants who love vintage architecture or investors seeking a value-add opportunity in one of LA's most sought-after neighborhoods.

agents.bio:
A third-generation Houstonian and University of Houston alum, Vincent Biondillo combines deep local knowledge with almost 20 years of real estate experience to help clients buy and sell homes with confidence. As co-founder of Norhill Realty—ranked #12 on the Cougar 100 in 2019—Vincent specializes in Houston’s Inner Loop neighborhoods and is passionate about connecting people to the city’s diverse culture and lifestyle.

With a background in marketing and mortgage lending, Vincent brings a well-rounded, client-first approach to every transaction. He’s a Certified Negotiation Expert (CNE) known for responsive service, honest advice, and smooth, stress-free closings.

Outside of real estate, Vincent stays active in the community through the SPJST Lodge and UH Bauer Alumni Association. He enjoys time with his wife and son, cheering on UH athletics, and competing in local BBQ cookoffs.

If you’re thinking about making a move—or just want to know if that Zestimate is lying to you—let’s talk. Happy to help, no pressure.

Like many successful agents and brokers, Jeremy came into the world of real estate from the field of academia where he served as Professor of Music at Lone Star College - Montgomery, The University of Texas at Tyler, and Stephen F. Austin State University. An obvious advocate of education and higher learning, Jeremy pursued his undergraduate studies at Texas Tech University, graduate studies and The Eastman School of Music, and post-graduate studies at The University of Southern California all in Music Performance and Literature. Due to his academic excellence, he was inducted into Phi Sigma Theta, a national honors society.

Jeremy’s eye for detail and his ability to listen and understand the needs of his clients creates an experience that is both productive and enjoyable. He makes communicating with his clients a priority and keeps them informed throughout the buying and selling process.

As a resident of EaDo, Jeremy’s focus is on the thriving neighborhoods of the inner loop: Downtown, East Downtown, Midtown, Rice Military, Montrose, The Heights, River Oaks, Upper Kirby, West University, Memorial Park, as well as Tanglewood and the Memorial Villages. His willingness to endlessly help and his infinite availability to his clients is the reason he is sought after as one of Houston’s most ambitious Realtors®.

Jeremy takes great pride in sharing his love for Houston and all it has to offer with his clients.

By the same token, when listing Adrienne generates significantly more marketing traffic to her listings enabling her sellers to get maximum exposure resulting a higher offers by potential buyers. Natural stones, wide plank engineered oak wood floors, floor to ceiling window views, walk in closets, solid wood site built cabinetry, raised ceilings, covered back patios & more. Nearby local eateries, breweries, athletic clubs & Haden Park make this a beloved neighborhood that is quickly becoming one of most sought after sections in the city. No history of flooding in this area & not in a flood zone.

agents.bio: Moises Arteaga is a proud native Houstonian and your trusted real estate advisor, combining local insight, deep community roots, and a genuine passion for helping others. Raised in the Aldine district on Houston's northeast side, Moises grew up immersed in the city's diverse culture and was part of a nationally ranked Cross Country team, an experience that shaped his competitive spirit and commitment to excellence. Having lived and worked in some of Houston's most iconic neighborhoods, including the Heights, Memorial, and Downtown. Moises brings an intimate understanding of the city's unique character and growth. Over the past two decades, he has witnessed Houston evolve into a world-class city, rich in opportunity and innovation. From its booming job market and affordability to its signature blend of cosmopolitan energy and Southern charm, Houston continues to attract residents and investors from around the globe and Moises is proud to help them call it home. Before entering real estate, Moises spent years in Houston's high-end hospitality industry, where he cultivated a passion for service and a talent for anticipating client needs. These skills translate seamlessly into real estate, where clear communication, thoughtful guidance, and a personalized approach define his service philosophy. Whether you're buying, selling, or leasing, Moises is committed to understanding your unique needs and delivering results with professionalism, care, and integrity. His knowledge of the market, love for Houston, and unwavering dedication to client success make him the ideal partner in your real estate journey. If you're ready to explore the vibrant possibilities Houston has to offer, connect with Moises Arteaga today. He looks forward to helping you find the perfect property and community to match your lifestyle and goals.

remarks: Discover this stunning Spanish Revival residence nestled in the heart of historic Windsor Village, a sought-after Los Angeles neighborhood known for its timeless architecture and convenient urban access. Built in 1924 and thoughtfully updated, this 3,204-square-foot main home offers 5 spacious bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, blending classic charm with modern comforts. Step inside to a grand living room featuring coffered ceilings, hardwood floors, and abundant natural light—ideal for entertaining or everyday living. The formal dining room flows seamlessly into a remodeled kitchen equipped with high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, and generous counter space. Upstairs, three generously sized bedrooms include a primary suite with en-suite bath, while two additional bedrooms downstairs offer flexibility for various living needs. The 7,296-square-foot lot features a manicured front yard with mature landscaping, a private driveway with gated entry, and a serene backyard perfect for outdoor enjoyment. Adding exceptional versatility, a separate 1,000-square-foot Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) provides 2 bedrooms, 2 en-suite bathrooms and a half bathroom, complete with modern finishes, a contemporary kitchen featuring navy blue cabinetry and appliances, spacious living areas, and private access—great for multigenerational living, guests, or additional use. Recent updates include fresh paint, energy-efficient windows, and a new roof for move-in readiness. Conveniently located near world-class museums, diverse restaurants, the Metro Purple Line, and vibrant shopping districts, this property offers a rare combination of historic elegance, modern functionality, and income potential in one of LA's premier areas.

agents.bio:
In January 2024, Angelina celebrated her 20th year in real estate!  Her journey began unexpectedly in 2004 when she inherited several rental properties after her mother's passing, becoming what she humorously calls an "unintentional landlord." Dissatisfied with the service provided by leasing agents, Angelina decided to take matters into her own hands and started taking real estate classes. By January 2006, she was a licensed Realtor with plans to only manage her rental properties but her warm demeanor and charisma propelled her to leave her full-time sales job and focus on real estate full time.  “I can’t believe it's been 20 years”, she admits, “and I have seen it all but it is still something new every day!”

Angelina reminds us it's still a “seller's market” in our area even with elevated mortgage rates.  She explains “With higher costs to rent, many renters have decided to buy instead of rent and build equity and in doing so they protect themselves from being priced out of the market in the future.  Other buyers have decided it is better to buy now with a higher interest rate but with today’s sales price instead of overpaying for a home later due to increased buyer competition in the summer months or when rates drop.” Angelina adds,  “There are even lenders that are offering no-cost refinances later when you use them as your lender now”. 

Angelina recommends that sellers consider listing their homes sooner rather than later if it makes sense. She explains that each situation is different but sellers may have fewer competing listings right now if they list before the summer.  Angelina declares “Early spring buyers are motivated buyers!” Sellers and buyers both need a Realtor with decades of wisdom and insight to formulate the best game plan. 

Along with her Broker’s license, attained in 2016, Angelina offers her clients ingenuity, diligence, and the wisdom that comes with almost 400 successful transactions. She skillfully navigates the most complex transactions such as relocation, divorce, and probate.  Drawing from her bachelor’s degree in psychology and background in sales, she caters to her client's unique needs.  Remaining abreast of evolving trends and technology, Angelina is a member of HAR.com’s  MLS Advisory Committee which underscores her dedication to enhancing industry standards for the benefit of agents and consumers alike. 

Beyond real estate, Angelina loves volunteering, supporting her children's activities, and planning fun activities for her friends and clients. Recognized for her numerous community contributions, she received the SBISD 2023 Good Neighbor Award.

remarks: Experience a beautifully upgraded two-story residence located at the legendary intersection of Hollywood & Vine. Designed with both form and function in mind, the layout offers a true separation between the main living spaces and the private bedroom level ideal for entertaining, working from home, or simply enjoying a more defined living experience. The main level features an open-concept living, dining, and kitchen layout anchored by a recently updated kitchen with a striking waterfall peninsula island, built-in wine cooler, and Viking appliances. Custom built-in shelving, architect-designed details, and thoughtful suspended accents preserve the industrial character of the space while adding warmth and livability. A convenient powder room and tucked-away washer/dryer combo complete this level. Upstairs, a spacious loft-style bedroom retreat offers privacy and flexibility, paired with a full bathroom and additional space for a home office, lounge, or creative studio all while maintaining the open, architectural feel that defines this unique home. Located in the prestigious Lofts at Hollywood & Vine a historic 1929 Mills Act building residents enjoy meaningful property tax savings along with full-service amenities including 24-hour security, valet parking, doorman service, and an expansive rooftop deck with BBQ and panoramic city views. The seller is also open to offering the home partially furnished for added convenience. Step outside and you're moments from some of Hollywood's best dining, entertainment, fitness, and nightlife, including the W Hotel, Pantages Theatre, Equinox, Barry's Bootcamp, and Trader Joe's, with the Metro Red Line just across the street providing easy access to Downtown LA and beyond. A rare opportunity to own a distinctive residence in one of Los Angeles' most iconic locations.

remarks: This rare multifunctional mixed-use property in the heart of the vibrant NoHo Arts District in North Hollywood offers an exceptional opportunity for live-work living, investment, or multigenerational setup. Spanning three separate parcel numbers with distinct addresses--11170, 11174, and 11178--the property combines residential comfort with commercial flexibility in one of Los Angeles' most creative and walkable neighborhoods.The NoHo Arts District is a thriving cultural hub, renowned for its concentration of over 20 professional theaters, art galleries, dance studios, music venues, diverse dining options, and eclectic shops--all within a compact, highly walkable area. Just steps from metro lines, historic landmarks like the Lankershim Train Depot, and endless entertainment, this location provides unbeatable access to the San Fernando Valley's artistic scene and urban amenities.The main house features three spacious bedrooms, a full bathroom, a large family room, an updated kitchen, and a cozy fireplace in the primary bedroom. It includes a dedicated laundry room and its own private entry. A portion of the main house offers optional commercial use, complete with a private bathroom and separate access, ideal for a home office, studio, or small business.Adjacent is a versatile ADU (Accessory Dwelling Unit) that can serve residential or commercial purposes. It boasts a front office area with a charming fireplace--perfect as a sitting room or reception space--opening to a large, open studio-style living area, its own laundry room, and a full bathroom. The ADU also has direct access to the backyard.The commercial portion includes a small storage area and private backyard entry, enhancing functionality for business or personal use. The entire property is fully fenced with privacy gates and offers generous on-site parking for up to seven cars, plus convenient street parking nearby.

As a 5th generation Houstonian, I have a deep appreciation for this city and its people. This is an exciting time to live in the Greater Houston Area, and I'm proud to be a part of it all! I've been licensed for 10 plus years and have successfully closed over 500 transactions since 2010. Although I live and work in Bellaire, I proudly serve the entire Houston market and will continue to provide exceptional service for each of my clients and my community as a whole. As your Real Estate Specialist, I promise to be your trusted resource for answers about the process of buying or selling. I will provide expertise about neighborhood features and schools and will target your home search based on your individual needs and wants. My custom innovative marketing strategies along with my strong negotiation skills are the keys to your successful transaction.

As an agent who's an expert in this local area, I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise about buying and selling real estate here. It's not the same everywhere, so you need someone you can trust for up-to-date information. I am eager to serve you. Here are some of the things I can do for you. Do you need someone who knows this area inside and out? I can work with you to find the right home at the right price for you, including all the neighborhood amenities that matter - not to mention the essential criteria you have for your ideal home. When it's time to move, you need someone who will advertise your home, show it to prospective buyers, negotiate the purchase contract, arrange to finance, oversee the inspections, handle all necessary paperwork and supervise the closing. I can take care of everything you need, from start to close. Oftentimes buyers don't visualize living in your home the way you do. I can make your home attractive to its ideal audience which can help you get top dollar. Things like staging the home, making repairs or minor improvements, or even simply painting the walls can be the difference between a home resting on the market and one that's sold fast.

Houston real estate professional Melissa Touqan ushers clients to success with a passion for helping people and a dynamic skill set that makes every transaction a seamless, enjoyable experience.
