remarks: Newly priced at $699,000, this is one of the best value opportunities for a move in ready home in Los Angeles. This beautifully updated home is ideal for first time buyers seeking comfort, style, and an attainable path to homeownership. The property features fresh interior and exterior paint, remodeled bathrooms with modern tile and vanities, and durable waterproof vinyl flooring throughout. The open and inviting layout creates a low maintenance living environment so you can move in and enjoy immediately. Recent upgrades include two new mini split systems for efficient heating and cooling, updated electrical outlets and lighting, and select new windows that enhance natural light and energy efficiency. These improvements provide both everyday comfort and long term peace of mind. Located in a centrally positioned and evolving neighborhood, the home offers convenient access to local shops, cafes, restaurants, and major commuter routes. The area continues to attract buyers looking for value and long term growth within Los Angeles. The property is zoned LARD2, offering flexibility for future expansion. Buyers may explore the potential to add an ADU, expand the existing footprint, or create multi unit opportunities, subject to city guidelines and approvals. This creates an opportunity to enjoy the home today while planning for future upside. The home is FHA eligible and may qualify for the Buyer Pathway to Homeownership grant offering up to $10,000 for qualified buyers, along with additional down payment assistance programs. Seller is open to creative offers to build in an interest rate buy down to help make ownership more affordable. All offers will be reviewed Monday at 5:00 PM.

stevenjsperry - Adams hill, Glendale, CA - 6/22/2021 Bought and sold a Single Family home in 2021 in Adams hill, Glendale, CA. Rachel is probably the best real estate agent that has ever existed. Roofers, contractors, inspectors, pest control, escrow... she's so experienced and well-connected that she can help connect you with trustworthy person who does quality work at every step of the way, no matter what you need. I closed on my house over 2 months ago and she still calls me sometimes just to see how my remodel is going and see if there's anything she can do to help. I highly doubt most realtors would do that. remarks:
Welcome to ''Private Little Sepulveda,'' a true Westchester hidden gem--set on a surprisingly calm and quiet, tree lined residential off-shoot of Sepulveda Boulevard. While the street itself is tucked away and serene, the community is gated, offering an added layer of security in the heart of West LA.
Inside, soaring ceilings, sun-filled interiors, and new flooring create a bright, modern backdrop. The chef-inspired kitchen with stainless steel appliances and a generous prep island flows effortlessly into the open living and dining space, anchored by a cozy fireplace and ideal for both everyday living and entertaining.
Upstairs, each bedroom features its own private full bath. The primary suite offers a spa-like retreat with dual vanities, a frameless glass shower, and a massive walk-in closet. A flexible loft with a full bath adds versatility--perfect for a guest suite, home office, gym, or creative studio.
The private rooftop deck is the crown jewel - your open-air escape for sunset cocktails, morning coffee, or evenings under the California sky.
Beyond the living spaces, this home truly shines with its oversized double-secure 2 car garage with storage, designed for modern living. Outfitted with a 220V electric vehicle outlet and exceptional storage capacity, it includes a separate enclosed 14' x 9' basement-level multi-use room that stays naturally cool and dark--ideal for wine storage, a photographer's darkroom, tech equipment, a recording or editing space, a private studio or just 125 square feet of valuable additional storage. A rare and highly coveted feature for creatives, collectors, and tech-forward buyers alike.
The lifestyle is unmistakably West LA. Enjoy easy access to nearby coffee shops, dining favorites, dog parks, Culver City, The Runway at Playa Vista (Silicon Beach), LMU, beaches, and LAX. For a change of pace, take a relaxing, dog-friendly walk along Bluff Trail Park, offering peaceful views of the Ballona Wetlands Ecological Reserve--a rare natural escape just moments from home.
HOA includes water, trash, sewer, security gates, insurance, roof maintenance, and more. This is Westchester living at its best: private, flexible, and effortlessly cool--a modern retreat with space to create, collect, and connect.

agents.bio:
As a 5th generation Houstonian, I have a deep appreciation for this city and its people. This is an exciting time to live in the Greater Houston Area, and I'm proud to be a part of it all! I've been licensed for 10 plus years and have successfully closed over 500 transactions since 2010. Although I live and work in Bellaire, I proudly serve the entire Houston market and will continue to provide exceptional service for each of my clients and my community as a whole. As your Real Estate Specialist, I promise to be your trusted resource for answers about the process of buying or selling. I will provide expertise about neighborhood features and schools and will target your home search based on your individual needs and wants. My custom innovative marketing strategies along with my strong negotiation skills are the keys to your successful transaction.

As an agent who's an expert in this local area, I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise about buying and selling real estate here. It's not the same everywhere, so you need someone you can trust for up-to-date information. I am eager to serve you. Here are some of the things I can do for you. Do you need someone who knows this area inside and out? agents.bio:
Evan Compean is the founder of The Compean Group, a boutique Houston real estate team known for data-driven pricing, high-end marketing and skilled negotiation. A licensed agent since 2012 and a real estate investor since 2002, Evan has sold more than $250 million in real estate and brings a builder's and investor's eye to every home, from foundation and roof to resale value.

Areas: Houston Heights, Woodland Heights, Garden Oaks/Oak Forest, Montrose, Midtown, West University, Bellaire, Spring Branch, Pearland, Katy, Cypress and The Woodlands.

Specialties: Luxury and new construction, investment and multifamily properties, land, first-time buyers, and relocation.

Evan is also a licensed loan officer and a partner at Smart Title, so clients get guidance on financing and closing from someone who knows every step. Se habla español. With 400+ five-star reviews across Zillow, Google, Yelp and Realtor.com, The Compean Group focuses on clear communication and a smooth process from first call to closing.

remarks: Elegant 2-story home located in a 24hr manned gated section of Stone Gate. The roof was replaced March 2017 and there were no issues with flooding or water damage during previous storms. The large kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite countertops is great for hosting family events. 2-car garage with an oversized storage area.Amazing view of the golf course from the oversized covered patio is a bonus! The refrigerator is included. New wood tile flooring was added to the 1st level and the tile around the fireplace was replaced with an elegant stack stone. The wrought iron fencing was recently repaired and painted so it looks brand new!

agents.bio:
The Bruner Team is currently a one-woman show—me, Elisa (Bruner) McNinch—and I’m honored to carry on the real estate legacy my parents began more than 40 years ago. Real estate has always been personal in our family, and that’s exactly how I still do business today: with genuine care, calm guidance, and a big dose of Southern hospitality.

I’m proud to have been recognized with the Five Star Professional Award for real estate customer service 13 years in a row (2012–2025)—an honor earned by fewer than 1% of Houston-area Realtors. I’m also a consistent multi-million dollar producer, but what matters most to me is that my clients feel heard, protected, and confident from start to finish.

If you ask where I work in Houston, you’ll probably hear me say: “If you divide Houston in half, I work the left-hand side.” I primarily serve Northwest Houston, and I’m very familiar throughout West Houston as well, including Spring, Tomball, Spring Branch, Cypress, Katy, and Richmond/Rosenberg.

Even though I’m tech-savvy (and yes—your home will be marketed online the right way), I still believe the best service happens voice-to-voice and face-to-face whenever possible. I’m hands-on with every client: meeting with sellers to stage and prepare a home, taking listings, coordinating photography, marketing, showing properties, hosting open houses, attending inspections—you name it. I’m the face and heart of The Bruner Team.

Behind the scenes, I’m supported by a trusted transaction coordinator who helps prepare listing documents and offers, tracks deadlines, and keeps everything moving smoothly—so you get both personal attention and professional precision.

If you’re looking for a knowledgeable agent who feels more like a steady partner than a sales pitch, I’d love to help you make your next move.

Shawn believes real estate is more than a transaction—it is a complex process where details matter, and his goal is to ensure every client moves forward with confidence. This perspective is especially valuable for investors, flippers, and buyers seeking long-term portfolio growth, as he brings a data-driven approach to evaluating opportunities in the Houston market. Shawn works with a wide range of clients, including first-time homebuyers, experienced investors, and individuals located out of state or overseas. He understands the unique goals of each client and tailors his strategy to ensure strong results, whether purchasing a first home or expanding an international real estate portfolio. For anyone navigating Houston real estate, he offers the knowledge, transparency, and precision needed to make confident decisions.

agents.bio: Monica Humphrey is proud to call herself a resident, local expert, and local Realtor. She is the owner and lead agent for the Texas Charm Real Estate Group. Her team includes multiple agents, a marketing director, a transaction coordinator, and admin. She, her husband, and their three children reside in Kingwood; which also happens to be where Monica grew up. Monica is active in her community: sits on the board for the Humble ISD Education Foundation, on multiple PTAs, and is a VP for the Humble BBQ & Rodeo. Monica realizes that buying and selling a home and/or investment property is an important financial decision. Her goal is to help guide her clients as questions arise and big choices must be made while protecting their finances. Monica's background in buying and negotiating contracts for Boeing on the F-22 fighter jets has served her well in helping to write up seamless contracts, contract knowledge, and negotiate deals for her clients both on the buy and the sell side. Monica and her team look forward to the opportunity to serve and help new clients with the next purchase/sale of their home or investment property.

Top-Producing Real Estate Agent Relocation Specialist

Carlen Rosson is a multi-million-dollar producer ICON agent and a dedicated member of the Living in Houston Youtube Channel, led by Joe Rodriguez and Kyler Ferris.
A native Houstonian, Carlen brings a deep-rooted passion for real estate and an expert understanding of the Houston market and surrounding areas. With a background in HR and technical recruiting and a degree in Business Management, she combines sharp business acumen with a warm, people-first approach.
Carlen specializes in relocation services and has helped numerous clients from across the countryand around the worldmake Houston their home. Her reputation for service, integrity, and going above and beyond for her clients has earned her industry recognition and client trust.

Most recently, Carlen was ranked #492 among all agents in the Greater Houston area, which includes Montgomery, Waller, Harris, and Fort Bend counties an incredible accomplishment among thousands of professionals.

In her free time, Carlen enjoys serving her community, traveling, and spending quality time with her husband and children. Known for her dedication, authenticity, and results, Carlen is more than an agentshe's a trusted advisor and advocate for her clients every step of the way.

remarks: LEASE, Move in Ready for the New Year! Verona Estates, it is a brand-new gate-guarded community located in Chatsworth, it's nestled in the foothills of Porter Ranch an established neighborhood, adjacent to the Vineyards in Porter Ranch. This newly finished home that is situated in a cul-de-sac, near Sierra Canyon School a private school (Pre-k to 12) that fosters and primes their students to be Trail Blazers for Higher Learning! The Visavi Model has 5 bedrooms, with 4.5 bathrooms, with 5,307 sq. ft, with a 3- car garage. The Visavi provides a spacious foyer opening immediately upon entering, it leads you to a soaring two-story great room and expansive outdoor covered living space, the kitchen features include an oversized center island with breakfast bar and High-end Appliances. There is multipurpose room on the first floor that can double as an office with an outside private entry. It could also be an entertainment room or a primary bedroom suite with a walk-in closet and an ensuite for guests (or in-laws for the extended stays). The Master suite bedroom provides an impressive walk-in closet and primary bath with dual vanities, large soaking tub, luxury shower with seat and private water closet. Highlights of the home include stunning luxury quartzite kitchen island and Wolf appliances, the Second story Loft and an additional bonus room which opens to the great room below. Landscaping started and can be completed 30 days. Pavers and artificial turf. Expected completion date JAN 2026.

agents.bio:
Meet Todd Trites – Your Trusted Southern California Real Estate Professional

I’ve devoted my life to service through leadership — in both my profession and my community. My goal is simple: to educate my clients so they can make the best possible decisions to achieve their real estate goals. Your goals, your needs, and your wants are the keys to our success in finding the Property of your dreams.

With extensive experience in the Northridge, Granada Hills, Chatsworth, Woodland Hills, and West Hills markets, I’m here to help whether you’re buying or selling a home.

My Story

I began my career in real estate in 2010, during the aftermath of the 2008 mortgage crisis. At the time, I used my corporate, financial, and healthcare management background to help people fix and refinance their mortgages — often pro bono — because I wanted to serve those who needed it most.

One day, I was asked to help sell a home. What started as a single transaction quickly turned into a calling. Former clients, colleagues, and friends began reaching out, and I discovered a passion for helping people through every stage of their real estate journey.

Experience You Can Trust

Since then, I’ve handled nearly every type of real estate transaction, including:

Probate & Trust Sales

Short Sales & REO

Auctions

Luxury Properties

Land, Lot Splits & New Construction

Investor Projects (Rehab, Fix & Flip)

Mobile Homes to Multi-Million Dollar Estates

Commercial, Industrial, Multi-Unit Properties, Farms, and Businesses

No matter the size or complexity, I approach every deal with confidence, competency, honesty, ethics, and professionalism.

What I Bring to the Table

Sellers: I’ll work tirelessly to market and sell your home at the best price, using proven strategies tailored to your property and market.

Buyers: Whether you’re upsizing, downsizing, or purchasing your very first home, I’ll help you find the right property for your lifestyle and goals.

Let’s Connect

I’d be honored to earn your trust and help you — or a friend — with any real estate transaction. You can always reach me by phone, email, or in person at my office.

remarks: Welcome home to this amazing single-story residence! Thoughtful updates and custom details make this home stand out, including a striking hand-carved front door imported from Indonesia. Large argon-filled double-pane windows and recently added blown-in attic insulation enhanced energy efficiency. Major system updates include HVAC system and water heater in 2022, as well as roof replacement in 2024. The recently remodeled bathrooms feature modern finishes and tasteful design. A remote-controlled access gate adds privacy and convenience. A massive workshop attached to the two-car garage can accommodate a car lift, making it ideal for automotive enthusiasts and hobbyists. The home offers a functional floor plan with inviting living spaces and a spacious backyard perfect for entertaining or gardening. Conveniently located with easy access to major roadways, shopping, dining, and everyday amenities. Experience all this home has to offer! Call today to schedule your private showing!

As the Tricia Turner Group, we work with a team of qualified specialists to help with the sale of your home, from beginning to end.  We have put together a full marketing team, our own staging company, as well as a Preferred Partner Program, which involves a list of vendors that we know, like, and trust.

No truly successful company on the planet has one person doing everything, including the real estate company you hire. We would love to be your expert home selling advisors.

With over 25 years in the real estate industry, and having SOLD thousands of homes, TTG has put together some amazing plans and programs that are unique to our organization, and have the best results in achieving our goals.  We keep our eyes laser focused on the market and what’s ahead, while maintaining a unique culture within our organization.

Our belief in providing the best customer experience keeps us steadfast as innovators, as we continue to differentiate ourselves from our competition.  No other real estate company has employed such strategies and opportunities to help the consumer experience as TTG.

What separates us…

~ The Coming Soon Listing Program - we have a private FB group that we moderate which allows us to market our listings, before they are active, to the top producers in our industry~ 
~ Our own “Make it Pretty” Program allows you, the homeowner, to have repairs done on your home prior to listing, with no upfront cost to you
~ Professional STAGING INCLUDED with our own staging company Honeybee Homestaging & More
~ Our own 60 Step Listing Program - for optimal marketing on all listings which includes a partnership with Homes.com to maximize our exposure
~ Protect and Serve Program - we give discounts and rebates to all military, police officers, firefighters, first responders, and teachers
~ Easy Exit Listing Plan - you can fire us for any reason if you are not 100% satisfied 
~ Flexible Commission Plan - Pay as little as zero% commission
~ Immediate Buyout Program with our own CASH OFFER DIVISION
~ Love It or Leave It Program - if you’re not happy in your home during the first 12 months of owning it, we’ll sell it for you for FREE (waive the listing broker fee of 3%)
~ Immediate Response System - All buyer inquiries will be handled in 5 minutes or less and most often within the first 60 seconds
~ Reverse Offer Strategy - this lets us go to buyers that may be on the fence about your home and make an offer to them, with terms, conditions, and prices that are acceptable to all parties
~ Preferred Partner Program - a list of vendors that we work exclusively with - you can locate them at:   www.residentialservicedirectory.com
~ Move for Free - use of our company moving truck at no charge...forever

With the real estate industry always changing, it is imperative that we stay ahead of the curve and always have the best techniques to help you, the consumer, with one of the largest investments in your life

Bea Flores, ABR, SRS, is a renowned figure in the Houston real estate market, with over 18 years of industry expertise. Her passion for real estate and dedication to exceptional service inspired her to establish her own brokerage, Luxe Living Group, over three years ago. Under her leadership, Bea has guided her team to remarkable success, earning recognition as one of Houston's top agents.

In December 2024, Bea and her team joined Compass Real Estate, a decision driven by the extensive marketing opportunities and advanced technology Compass offers. This move allows Luxe Living Group to enhance the already top-notch real estate experience they provide, giving clients access to cutting-edge tools and strategies that elevate every transaction.

Bea specializes in working with traditional buyers and sellers in Houston while carving out a niche in representing out-of-state institutional buyers across Texas cities like Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio. Her commitment to client education and transparent communication has earned her a loyal client base, with an impressive 85-90% of her business coming from repeat clients and referrals.

Beyond her success as an agent, Bea is also a dedicated educator. For over nine years, she has been teaching real estate licensing courses, mentoring both agents and clients, and empowering them to navigate their real estate journeys with confidence.

She also served as President of the Women's Council of Realtors - Bay Area, Houston Chapter in 2013, further demonstrating her commitment to leadership and the advancement of the real estate profession.

With a foundation built on integrity, expertise, and an unwavering commitment to client satisfaction, Bea Flores and her team at Luxe Living Group, now proudly partnered with Compass, are dedicated to providing personalized, seamless real estate experiences that exceed expectations.

agents.bio:
As a proud Houstonian and seasoned real estate professional, Dena brings a deep understanding of the local market and a passion for her city to every transaction. Whether you’re buying, selling, or investing, Dena offers a comprehensive, concierge-level service that ensures each client’s needs are met with precision and care. “I do more than simply help clients buy or sell homes,” Dena says. “I’m committed to promoting Houston, a city I know and love.”

With certifications as a Certified International Property Specialist (CIPS) and a Master Certified Negotiator (MCN), Dena’s expertise extends far beyond the basics of real estate. She’s equipped to handle complex, high-value transactions, whether locally, nationally, or internationally. Dena’s sharp negotiation skills and ability to connect buyers with the perfect home or community set her apart from others in the industry.

In addition to her real estate expertise, Dena is an active leader in the industry and community. In 2022, she served as the Membership Chair for the Women’s Council of Realtors® (WCR) Houston, and in 2023, she became President-Elect, set to assume the role of President in 2024. In 2025, Dena will serve as the Strategic Partnership Chair for WCR Texas. She’s also on the Houston Association of Realtors® (HAR) Global Advisory Committee (2023-2025), and actively involved in the TREPAC Committee (2024-2025) and the HAR Political Affairs Advisory Group (2025).

Dena is a dedicated volunteer and serves on several key committees for the Houston Livestock and Rodeo, including the Steer Auction Committee, International Committee, Wine Events Committee, and Houston General Go Texan Committee. She is also the past President of the Shady Acres Civic Association, working to enhance the quality of life in the neighborhood, and holds leadership roles with Business Network International (BNI) as both the Realtor® Chair and a member of the Women’s Council of Realtors®.

When she’s not guiding clients through successful real estate transactions or volunteering, Dena enjoys spending time with her husband and their young daughter, who attends Travis Elementary. The family enjoys biking through Houston’s parks, trying new restaurants, and staying active with Pilates.

Dena’s combination of market expertise, leadership, and community involvement, along with her advanced certifications, makes her a standout choice for anyone looking to navigate the Houston real estate market with confidence.

agents.bio:
Following this transaction, a friend asked him to help with a home purchase. This friend then referred five others and the roots of New Leaf were planted. However, it is David’s childhood connection to Houston’s many neighborhoods, as well as his passionate determination to thoughtfully populate these communities, that have consistently motivated him and his team at New Leaf Real Estate.

David began his career in the energy sector in 1993 with Texas Ohio Gas, remaining with the company for 14 years. He transitioned from the energy sector to real estate when his brother, Eric, and he launched Houston Brothers Mortgage in 2002. David’s background in energy trading and mortgage informs his in-depth, market-based analysis approach to New Leaf Real Estate’s model.

At New Leaf, his market expertise allows him to identify a client’s specific needs, and combine that with his strategic negotiation and deal-making capability, consistently delivering the best deal possible for his clients. From the initial contact to inspections to final contract, David is committed to providing his clients with unparalleled service. Because of his relationship-driven vision of the industry, he has fostered productive realtor relationships and formed lifelong friendships with many of his clients in Houston.

Since the launch of New Leaf, David has managed approximately $425 million dollars of real estate sales and has personally handled over 625 transactions. In 2017, he closed approximately $60 million, which garnered praise and recognition as one of the Houston Business Journal’s Top Agents by Sales Volume for the sixth consecutive year.

David lives in Montrose with his wife, Heather, and their two young children, Hart and Holden. Committed to giving back to the community, he and Heather support Poe Elementary, Presbyterian School, Roberts Elementary, Neartown Little League, West University Little League, Push Sharks, Urban Harvest, Dress for Success and Eastside Farmers Market.

remarks: Welcome to a newly built, stylish and meticulously crafted modern residence offering an exceptional blend of luxury, scale, and smart living in the heart of Highland Park. This move-in-ready 4-bedroom, 4.5-bath home delivers over 2,080 sq. ft. of light-filled living space, thoughtfully designed across a tri-level layout with no shared walls and excellent separation of space. The open-concept main level is anchored by a striking chef's kitchen featuring quartz countertops with matching backsplashes, European-finish custom cabinetry, a large cast-iron sink, and premium stainless steel appliances, seamlessly flowing into spacious living and dining areas enhanced by high ceilings, floor-to-ceiling windows, and wide-plank engineered white oak flooring. Designer lighting and refined finishes elevate every room. Each of the four bedrooms includes its own en-suite bathroom, making the home ideal for privacy, guests, home offices, or co-living arrangements. The primary suite offers a walk-in closet, spa-like bath with wood-look dimensional tile, oversized shower, and gold Delta plumbing fixtures, plus pre-wiring for speakers and flat-screen TVs. Smart entry and smart climate control add modern convenience throughout. Outdoor living truly sets this home apart, with multiple private balconies and an expansive rooftop deck designed for entertaining or relaxation. Enjoy sunset views, city lights, and hillside vistas, along with a custom built-in fire pit and prep for an outdoor kitchen. An attached private two-car garage, brand-new window blinds, and newly paved frontage further enhance comfort and curb appeal. Ideally situated near York and Figueroa's vibrant dining and shopping scene minutes from Joy, Hippo, Ggiata Delicatessen, and more this home also offers easy access to the Metro Gold Line, Downtown LA, Pasadena, Glendale, Burbank, Hollywood, and the 101, 134, and 2 freeways.

As your Real Estate Specialist, I promise to be your trusted resource for answers about the process of buying or selling. I will provide expertise about neighborhood features and schools and will target your home search based on your individual needs and wants. My custom innovative marketing strategies along with my strong negotiation skills are the keys to your successful transaction.

As an agent who's an expert in this local area, I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise about buying and selling real estate here. It's not the same everywhere, so you need someone you can trust for up-to-date information. I am eager to serve you. Here are some of the things I can do for you. Do you need someone who knows this area inside and out? I can work with you to find the right home at the right price for you, including all the neighborhood amenities that matter - not to mention the essential criteria you have for your ideal home. When it's time to move, you need someone who will advertise your home, show it to prospective buyers, negotiate the purchase contract, arrange to finance, oversee the inspections, handle all necessary paperwork and supervise the closing. I can take care of everything you need, from start to close. Oftentimes buyers don't visualize living in your home the way you do. I can make your home attractive to its ideal audience which can help you get top dollar. Things like staging the home, making repairs or minor improvements, or even simply painting the walls can be the difference between a home resting on the market and one that's sold fast.

agents.bio:
Bea Flores, ABR, SRS, is a renowned figure in the Houston real estate market, with over 18 years of industry expertise. Her passion for real estate and dedication to exceptional service inspired her to establish her own brokerage, Luxe Living Group, over three years ago. Under her leadership, Bea has guided her team to remarkable success, earning recognition as one of Houston's top agents.

In December 2024, Bea and her team joined Compass Real Estate, a decision driven by the extensive marketing opportunities and advanced technology Compass offers. This move allows Luxe Living Group to enhance the already top-notch real estate experience they provide, giving clients access to cutting-edge tools and strategies that elevate every transaction.

Bea specializes in working with traditional buyers and sellers in Houston while carving out a niche in representing out-of-state institutional buyers across Texas cities like Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio. Her commitment to client education and transparent communication has earned her a loyal client base, with an impressive 85-90% of her business coming from repeat clients and referrals.

At Luxe Living Group, Bea ensures every client receives a luxurious and seamless experience, prioritizing meticulous attention to detail and comprehensive support to ensure success in every transaction.

Beyond her success as an agent, Bea is also a dedicated educator. For over nine years, she has been teaching real estate licensing courses, mentoring both agents and clients, and empowering them to navigate their real estate journeys with confidence.

Bea's outstanding achievements have earned her numerous accolades, including recognition among the Top 25 agents in Houston, a recent ranking among the Top 5 agents by production in the Houston Business Journal, and being featured in national publications such as Top Agent Magazine. She also served as President of the Women's Council of Realtors - Bay Area, Houston Chapter in 2013, further demonstrating her commitment to leadership and the advancement of the real estate profession.

With a foundation built on integrity, expertise, and an unwavering commitment to client satisfaction, Bea Flores and her team at Luxe Living Group, now proudly partnered with Compass, are dedicated to providing personalized, seamless real estate experiences that exceed expectations.

remarks: Premiere location on the west side of Rice Military and close to the trails, golf & grounds of Memorial Park sits 312 Knox, a striking 2/3 bed-2.5 bath two-story freestanding home on a sizeable 4,200 sf lot (per HCAD). Welcoming entrance leads to the spectacular private yard space highlighted by an expansive deck. Large covered porch welcomes guests. First floor living area w/ great natural light and hardwood floors. Gourmet kitchen offers s/s appliances, quartz counter, pantry and counter seating. Relaxing living room with fireplace + open dining area that’s perfect for entertaining. Upstairs primary suite with sitting area and vaulted ceiling w/ walk-in closet and spa-like bath featuring double sinks, quartz counter, garden tub and walk-in shower. Nice-size secondary bedroom includes double closets and en suite bath. Office/guest bedroom, open loft area and picturesque upper patio complete the top floor. Two-car attached garage. Enjoy the proximity to Galleria, River Oaks & Heights.

remarks:
A fresh opportunity in the Hollywood Hills. Built in 1926 and thoughtfully updated for today, 3408 Troy Drive blends classic Los Angeles character with a flexible floor plan and meaningful improvements.

The home features 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms arranged across two levels. Upstairs are 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom along with the main living spaces, while downstairs offers a separate bedroom and bathroom -- an ideal setup for guests, extended-family living, a private office or studio, or the potential for a more independent living arrangement.

Original character remains an important part of the home's appeal, highlighted a dramatic barrel-vaulted ceiling and a beautiful Batchelder fireplace that brings warmth, craftsmanship and a distinctive sense of history to the living room.

Modern improvements include a remodeled kitchen and dual-pane windows completed in 2016, along with a new roof installed in 2025 -- valuable updates that complement the home's vintage charm.

Natural light floods the interior, while the hillside setting provides the privacy and relaxed atmosphere buyers seek in the Hollywood Hills. A two-car garage adds convenient parking and storage.

Hollywood Hills has a combination that’s hard to duplicate in Los Angeles: privacy, views, character, and proximity to the heart of the city. Ideally located near Hollywood, Studio City, West Hollywood, Beverly Hills, major studios, dining, entertainment and scenic hiking, 3408 Troy Drive offers character, flexibility and location in one compelling Hollywood Hills residence.

Born and raised in Cypress and now proud to call Katy home, I have a deep understanding of the Houston and West Houston markets, including Katy, Fulshear, Cypress, Richmond, Rosenberg, Sugar Land, and the surrounding communities. Whether you're purchasing your first home, relocating to Texas, selling a luxury property, or investing in real estate, my commitment is to make the process smooth, strategic, and successful.

In just six years in real estate, I've built a reputation for delivering results through expert negotiation, innovative marketing, and exceptional client service. I received a 4x ICON REALTOR Award during my time with eXp Realty, a recognition reserved for top-performing agents, and I've helped countless buyers and sellers successfully navigate every type of market. My business has been built almost entirely through referrals and repeat clients—a reflection of the trust I've earned by putting relationships before transactions.

Today, I'm proud to be brokered by SERHANT. Texas, a brokerage redefining luxury real estate through the power of media, technology, and personal branding. By combining SERHANT.'s cutting-edge marketing platform with my background in digital marketing and content creation, every listing receives maximum exposure across today's most influential online platforms. My Bachelor of Fine Arts from the University of Houston allows me to approach every property with a creative eye for branding, photography, video, and storytelling that helps homes stand out in a competitive market.

My approach is simple: provide honest advice, communicate consistently, negotiate relentlessly, and treat every client's investment as if it were my own. I believe successful real estate isn't about pressure—it's about education, preparation, and building lifelong relationships based on trust and personalizing every buyer and sellers experience directly to benefit them.

Whether you're searching for your dream home, selling for top dollar, relocating to Texas, or exploring new construction opportunities, I'd be honored to help you achieve your real estate goals.

remarks: Spectacular Hilltop View Home Built in 2015. Perched near the top of the hill, this stunning residence captures sweeping views of the surrounding hills and the iconic Los Angeles skyline. Built in 2015, this home offers modern design, abundant natural light, and an exceptional indoor outdoor lifestyle. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms across 2,267 sq. ft. of living space, the open-concept floor plan is both spacious and functional. The custom-designed kitchen showcases sleek cabinetry, quartz countertops, energy-efficient appliances, a walk-in pantry, and a convenient utility sink, all flowing seamlessly into the main living and dining areas, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Step outside to enjoy incredible indoor outdoor flow with walk out patios and an impressive 721 sq. ft. entertainer’s terrace, perfect for hosting gatherings while soaking in the views. Multiple balconies provide additional vantage points, and the beautifully landscaped backyard offers peaceful outdoor enjoyment along with convenient storage sheds and a water collection reservoir for added sustainability and smart water use. The primary suite is a private retreat featuring a walk-in closet and a spa-like bathroom complete with a jet tub, gorgeous shower, and elegant finishes. Several rooms offer high ceilings, enhancing the sense of space and light throughout the home. A standout bonus is the approximately 400 sq. ft. 2-car garage conversion, currently used as a music studio, complete with wood flooring and a mini-split climate control system ideal for a creative space, home office, gym, or guest overflow. Located in a desirable hilltop setting with beautiful mountain views and an easy commute to South Pasadena, Alhambra, and Downtown LA, this home offers the perfect blend of privacy, modern comfort, and city convenience.

agents.bio:
With nearly three decades in real estate, Marta Mohan is a top-producing Realtor® with Hometown America Incorporated in Sugar Land, Texas. Licensed since 1996, she has helped countless buyers and sellers navigate the market with expertise, delivering exceptional service and outstanding results.
Marta holds multiple prestigious designations, including ABR (Accredited Buyer Representative), QSC (Quality Service Certified), CNE (Certified Negotiation Expert), and CLHMS (Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist). Her commitment to continued education and dedication to her clients—whether first-time homebuyers or seasoned investors—has earned her recognition as a Top Producer and Top Sales Associate. She has proudly secured first place in most listings and total units closed, a testament to her knowledge, experience, and passion for real estate.
A South Florida native, Marta moved to Houston in 1975, working at Gulf Oil in Fort Bend before transitioning to real estate. In 1985, her family embarked on an unforgettable journey to Indonesia, living in Borneo and Jakarta for seven years due to her husband's work in the oil industry. Immersing herself in a different culture was a transformative experience, one she treasures to this day.
Through her expertise, integrity, and enthusiasm, Marta continues to build lasting relationships with her clients, helping them achieve their real estate goals with confidence.

remarks: Spectacular Hilltop View Home Built in 2015. Perched near the top of the hill, this stunning residence captures sweeping views of the surrounding hills and the iconic Los Angeles skyline. Built in 2015, this home offers modern design, abundant natural light, and an exceptional indoor outdoor lifestyle. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms across 2,267 sq. ft. of living space, the open-concept floor plan is both spacious and functional. The custom-designed kitchen showcases sleek cabinetry, quartz countertops, energy-efficient appliances, a walk-in pantry, and a convenient utility sink, all flowing seamlessly into the main living and dining areas, ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. Step outside to enjoy incredible indoor outdoor flow with walk out patios and an impressive 721 sq. ft. entertainers terrace, perfect for hosting gatherings while soaking in the views. Multiple balconies provide additional vantage points, and the beautifully landscaped backyard offers peaceful outdoor enjoyment along with convenient storage sheds and a water collection reservoir for added sustainability and smart water use. The primary suite is a private retreat featuring a walk-in closet and a spa-like bathroom complete with a jet tub, gorgeous shower, and elegant finishes. Several rooms offer high ceilings, enhancing the sense of space and light throughout the home. A standout bonus is the approximately 400 sq. ft. 2-car garage conversion, currently used as a music studio, complete with wood flooring and a mini-split climate control system ideal for a creative space, home office,

remarks: Welcome to a newly built modern residence that delivers refined design, exceptional light, and effortless indoor living in one of Highland Park's most coveted pockets. This turnkey 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath home offers approximately 1,900 square feet of thoughtfully curated living space with no shared walls. The open-concept main level is flooded with natural light and anchored by a sophisticated chef's kitchen featuring waterfall quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, matte-black fixtures, and premium built-in appliances, seamlessly connecting to the living and dining areas. Wide white-oak flooring, designer tile, and clean modern lines create a warm yet contemporary aesthetic that feels both luxurious and livable. Each bedroom has its own private retreat, complete with a spa-inspired en-suite bath, ideal for guests, home offices, or flexible living arrangements. Brand-new window blinds throughout add a polished finishing touch, balancing style with privacy. Outdoor living takes center stage with three private balconies and an expansive ~670 sq. ft. rooftop deck offering sweeping views of surrounding hills and city lights. Whether hosting sunset gatherings, enjoying morning yoga, or unwinding by the built-in fire pit with prep for an outdoor kitchen, this rooftop is designed to impress. Additional highlights include a private two-car attached garage, in-home laundry hookups, energy-efficient systems, and meticulously selected modern finishes throughout. Ideally positioned moments from York and Figueroa's acclaimed dining, cafes, boutiques, and nightlife while offering seamless access to Pasadena, Downtown Los Angeles, and the Hollywood this residence represents a rare opportunity to own architecturally significant new construction in one of Los Angeles' most dynamic and design-forward neighborhoods.

There is an elegance to the way in which Aaron Sonnier works. He manages every detail, no matter how small. He is committed to excellence in service and luxury in every way. He curates his every choice with refinement and grace.

That would explain why he is an esteemed member of Martha Turner's Circle of Excellence.

Originally from Lake Charles, Louisiana, Aaron holds a Bachelor of Fine Arts Degree with a concentration in Photography and Painting from USL in Lafayette, Louisiana.

It is his impeccable work ethic and his degree in fine arts combined with his unparalleled experience in branding, management, and leadership that makes him such a force.

He has thirty years of retail industry experience and owns a concierge and construction management company. His success in the real estate world comes from knowing how to lead, how to negotiate, and how to make things happen brilliantly and without exception.

For Aaron, doing the right thing, means attending to any client need that may arise from driving contracts to and from title companies, meeting mobile notaries on site, reading the meter on a prospective sale, and staging a home.

Aaron is acutely aware that the key to the best transactions is impeccable communication, and there is nothing at which Aaron is more skilled. He answers every call and responds to every text. The time of day is no matter – what matters is always delivering the most refined service each and every time.

Paramount to all of Aaron’s work is building lasting relationships and helping clients to make the most informed decisions. Whether it is a home or a piece of property, whether a client is buying or selling, Aaron instills in clients the kind of confidence that can only come from working with a discerning professional of the highest caliber.

No decision has ever been easier for Aaron than choosing to be a part of the Martha Turner Sotheby’s International Realty team. Having superior tools and the latest in technology at his fingertips, allows Aaron - a 2020 Top Producer at his previous firm - to always be one step ahead of the competition.

In the high stakes world of real estate, you do not just want to get a property on the market, you want to get it the attention it deserves. Aaron Sonnier gets every property and client the attention they deserve.

remarks: 820 N Formosa offers a rare fusion of contemporary design, meticulous craftsmanship, and an unbeatable West Hollywood setting, all within a newer-construction small-lot single-family home that feels like a private urban retreat. Nestled within the coveted Formosa Four community, this street-facing residence delivers a true neighborhood ambiance. Watch the city's rhythm from your enclosed front garden or private patio, all while enjoying the privacy and security of a modern home. The first level welcomes you with polished concrete floors and a direct-access two-car garage with ample storage, creating a sleek and practical entry that balances form and function. Upstairs, sun-drenched spaces unfold in an open-concept layout, seamlessly connecting living, dining, and kitchen areas for both everyday comfort and effortless entertaining. Expansive west and north facing windows frame both sunset views and a glimpse of the Hollywood Sign, while automatic shades provide instant privacy. Pocket sliding doors extend the living space outdoors, enhancing the home's sense of flow and openness. The kitchen serves as a modern showpiece, featuring Bosch stainless steel appliances, marble countertops with a dramatic waterfall edge, and clean contemporary lines that feel straight from a high-end design magazine. Spa-inspired bathrooms echo the tranquility of a boutique hotel, offering a refined yet livable sense of luxury. What sets 820 N Formosa apart is how it blends the quality of new construction with the vitality of one of Los Angeles' most celebrated neighborhoods. Melrose, La Brea, and the heart of West Hollywood are right outside your door, placing world-class dining, stylish cafes, cocktail bars, and iconic shopping within effortless reach. From classic Hollywood restaurants to design-forward boutiques, the location offers a lifestyle that is unmistakably LA. With its street-level presence, private outdoor spaces, sophisticated interiors, and inspiring views, 820 N Formosa captures the very best of modern West Hollywood living, sophisticated, welcoming, and entirely unique.

remarks: Located behind the gates of Red Oak Retreat in The Canyons’ Elite Point Collection, this exceptional residence offers unobstructed 180-degree views of rolling valleys and surrounding mountains—an awe-inspiring backdrop for everyday living. Step inside a dramatic two-story foyer that opens seamlessly to the expansive great room and dining area, thoughtfully designed for both effortless entertaining and comfortable daily life. The gourmet kitchen is a chef’s dream, featuring a grand center island with breakfast bar seating, abundant counter space, and a spacious walk-in pantry—all positioned to take full advantage of the breathtaking views while cooking, dining, or gathering with guests. Upstairs, a versatile loft/bonus room provides the perfect space for a home office, entertainment lounge, or peaceful retreat. The private primary suite is a true sanctuary, complete with a generous walk-in closet and a spa-inspired en-suite bathroom boasting dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a separate shower. Two additional bedrooms complete the upper level. Beautiful hardwood flooring flows throughout the home, adding warmth and sophistication. On the main level, a thoughtfully designed bedroom with an adjacent full bath offers ideal accommodations for guests or family. This modern home is enhanced with premium upgrades, including owned solar panels, an EV charging station, and high-end interior finishes that elevate every detail. Enjoy resort-style living with exclusive access to a stunning community center featuring a sparkling pool, rejuvenating spa, BBQ areas, cabanas with TVs, a meeting room, and inviting indoor-outdoor seating. Ideally located near a 54-acre community park, The Vineyards at Porter Ranch, top-tier schools, and premier dining and shopping, this home perfectly blends luxury, functionality, and convenience in one of Porter Ranch’s most coveted gated communities.

Matthew “Matt” Guzman, a real estate agent in Houston and the surrounding areas, is owner of RE/MAX Universal. A native Texan, he spent 11 years in the financial services industry in both Houston and Laredo.

Quality focused, Matt understands both the bottom-line and the long-term impact of service. Searching for a place to practice his true passion in real estate, Matt joined RE/MAX after noticing the top quality training, company reputation and high energy of the agents and staff. As a top producer, Matt consistently exceeds goals and is willing and ready to share best practices with other agents. After joining Matt’s team, agents have gone from no production to multiple units within weeks of joining his team. Matt enjoys giving back and helping agents and clients achieve their goals.

He is bilingual in Spanish and English and is often asked to serve as a translator. An entrepreneur at heart, Matt is very dedicated to serving his customers and building long-term relationships. He is self-motivated, goal-oriented and focused on quality. His friends and family often say, “If you want something done right, ask Matt for help.”

The house-buying and house-selling experiences should be exciting and memorable. Matt strives to provide the best service and loyalty to his clients. Whatever your needs, whether you are looking to buy, sell or join the Matthew Guzman Team, Matt would be honored to serve you.

remarks: Welcome to 5327 CJ Walker in Sandrock Station. High, soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and luxury plank vinyl flooring create a bright, open feel throughout the main living areas. The open-concept layout flows seamlessly into a modern kitchen featuring quartz countertops, 42-inch cabinetry, classic subway tile backsplash, large island, and inviting breakfast bar ideal for entertaining and everyday living. The spacious primary suite and three additional bedrooms provide flexibility for guests, office space, or growing needs. Bathrooms feature tile extended to the ceiling for a clean, elevated finish. Outstanding curb appeal with a striking stone and brick exterior. The garage includes a mini-split A/C, insulated door, epoxy flooring, LED lighting, and a 14-foot workbench. Home also includes a dedicated 220V exterior generator connection installed at the main electrical panel. Convenient access to Beltway 8, Hwy 288, and 610. Come see for yourself what this gem has for you!

Houston Realtor, Caroline Schlemmer, knows that integrity, commitment to each client's best interests, and absolute professionalism are the keys to real estate success. In fact, it's been the winning formula that's earned her numerous industry accolades and a loyal following of repeat and referral clients throughout her over twenty years in the business.

Caroline specializes in new construction, residential resale, condominiums, and townhomes throughout Houston’s close-in neighborhoods including The Heights, West University, Memorial, Oak Forest, Spring Branch, and Montrose. She has been acknowledged for her extraordinary sales and marketing techniques by multiple high-end builders and renovators working on large-scale projects, and individual buyers, sellers, and investors rave about her savvy negotiation skills and customer service.

She is an active member of the community, devoted to a number of organizations, including Adoptive Families of Houston, The Junior League of Houston, Kappa Kappa Gamma Alumnae, and various neighborhood schools in The Heights. During the pandemic, Caroline created Positivity Pop Ups, a community program whose mission is to spread kindness and connections for neighbors. She is focused on expanding this program to foster more positivity all around.

agents.bio:
Becky is an expert on trendy, upscale living in the Bayou City—living close to and enjoying the sights and sounds of Houston. She appreciates the cultural life of Houston and its communities and is thus known for her advice on where to live and why. So, it should be no surprise that she found her niche at Compass.

A Houston resident for over three decades, Becky knows her way around town. Her familiarity with close-in neighborhoods and real estate trends within the city makes her the ideal adviser to discuss the options available to you and your family based on your personal, professional, and family goals. In particular, Becky’s comprehensive knowledge of the Heights’ housing market truly sets her apart.

Few are plugged into and well-versed in Heights real estate these days than Becky. Her “Becky’s Best Bungalow Bets” (BBBB), a weekly digest of Heights properties that you can have delivered straight to your email, ensures no new listing in the Heights gets by Becky. She scours the “hot sheets”, taking a look at all the properties coming onto the market in the Heights each week, then cuts through the nonsense to share a few insights about the properties she finds most interesting, or her “best bets.” These weekly breakdowns also include status updates, price reductions, and a list of previous “best bets” that haven’t sold yet. In addition, Becky keeps her own stats on Heights home sales, so don’t hesitate to ask her if you’re looking for a localized market update.

With a professional career, a BBA (Accounting, Stetson University), an MHA (Masters in Health Administration, University of Houston), and experience in marketing, sales, finance, and publishing (including being former editor-in-chief of Bayou City Magazine), Becky pays great attention to details. She continually demonstrates integrity, honesty, and excellent customer service. She also has a welcoming, down-to-earth personality that her clients appreciate.

Becky’s firm understanding of Houston’s close-in neighborhoods and the city’s market, in general, has allowed her to establish herself as an expert on the listing side of transactions. Even with hard-to-market properties, Becky combines her own marketing experience with Compass’ full-service marketing team to consistently produce results. Multiple times, she has even successfully marketed and sold homes that flooded during Hurricane Harvey.

In her leisure time, Becky advocates for training in Houston of a non-invasive technique to improve, restore, or optimize function in special needs children and people suffering from trauma (PTSD, stroke, injury).

Growing up in River Oaks, Ginny attended St. Michael’s and St. Agnes Academy, then headed to Los Angeles, where she received her undergraduate degree from Loyola Marymount University. With her energetic grasp of the Houston market, Ginny has been taking the Houston real estate market by force since 2005 with her thorough market knowledge and excellence in client satisfaction.

As a Real Estate investor, Ginny appreciates the house hunt process and strives to find suitable investments for all her clients. She loves Houston’s rich history and culture and specializes in the “inside-the-loop” market. Ginny has assisted many clients in finding their dream homes and income property. She enjoys consulting on renovation projects and prides herself on that element of her service. As a Texas Monthly Five Star Realtor and boasting a HAR seller/buyer rating of 5.0/5.0, Ginny is consistently a Top Producing agent.

She has an extensive understanding of architecture, construction, and renovation and has acted as a general contractor for multiple projects. She is well-informed on construction, local suppliers and resources, estimated costs, landscaping, and interior design.

Ginny previously lived in Montrose and resided in West University with her husband and two sons; she actively supports many charities and organizations, such as Preservation Houston, Leukemia and Lymphoma Society, Star of Hope, and Houston Aphasia Recovery Center (HARC). When she’s not working, she enjoys spending time with family and friends, attending auctions and antique shopping, or traveling.

Ginny is active in many charities and organizations, such as The University of Houston, the American Heart Association, Star of Hope, and HARC—Houston Aphasia Recovery Center. When she’s not working, she enjoys spending time with her husband and two young sons, attending auctions and antique shopping, or traveling.

agents.bio:
As a 5th generation Houstonian, I have a deep appreciation for this city and its people. This is an exciting time to live in the Greater Houston Area, and I'm proud to be a part of it all! I've been licensed for 10 plus years and have successfully closed over 500 transactions since 2010. Although I live and work in Bellaire, I proudly serve the entire Houston market and will continue to provide exceptional service for each of my clients and my community as a whole. As your Real Estate Specialist, I promise to be your trusted resource for answers about the process of buying or selling. I will provide expertise about neighborhood features and schools and will target your home search based on your individual needs and wants. My custom innovative marketing strategies along with my strong negotiation skills are the keys to your successful transaction.

As an agent who's an expert in this local area, I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise about buying and selling real estate here. It's not the same everywhere, so you need someone you can trust for up-to-date information. I am eager to serve you. Here are some of the things I can do for you. Do you need someone who knows this area inside and out? I can work with you to find the right home at the right price for you, including all the neighborhood amenities that matter - not to mention the essential criteria you have for your ideal home. When it's time to move, you need someone who will advertise your home, show it to prospective buyers, negotiate the purchase contract, arrange to finance, oversee the inspections, handle all necessary paperwork and supervise the closing. I can take care of everything you need, from start to close. Oftentimes buyers don't visualize living in your home the way you do. I can make your home attractive to its ideal audience which can help you get top dollar. Things like staging the home, making repairs or minor improvements, or even simply painting the walls can be the difference between a home resting on the market and one that's sold fast.

He is enthusiastic about leading-edge technology and marketing and prides himself on maximizing the effectiveness of new resources in a way to best serve his clients. A true Los Angeles native, David earned his Bachelor of Science degree in Economics and Finance from Cal State Northridge. He has since been actively involved with several charitable foundations, including The American Cancer Society, the Theodore Payne Foundation, Project Angel Food, the Brady Campaign and the Remote Area Medical Foundation. Volunteering as a Big Brother, David was proud to support the most effective youth mentoring organization in the country.

Tirelessly dedicated to his clients and his community, David currently represents Cedar Sinai, law firms, Trusts, corporate and other institutions in the selling of residential and residential income assets. Garnering a steady stream of referrals from law firms who place their trust in David and have for many years, he has a keen awareness of legal boundaries to help protect clients from unnecessary legal issues. David was one of the top agents representing California Federal bank (now Citibank) in REO sales and was instrumental in updating the company’s sales.

After years of making his mark in real estate, David established his very own team and sought out hard-working, honest agents that would only further his covering of greater Los Angeles and cultivate a culture of encouragement, friendship and above all, efficiency. While David predominately specializes in the Platinum triangle, his team pursues areas well beyond that including, but not limited to: Brentwood, Santa Monica, Venice, Malibu, West LA, Hollywood Hills, Sunset Strip and SFV. Under his counsel and support, David Kramer Group supplements the already dynamic business and propels it to new heights.

Andrew is a dynamic agent with ample experience and a unique skill set. He has accomplished the rare Hollywood trifecta, successfully representing Oscar, Emmy, and Grammy winners. He represented the buyer of the highest priced transaction in Brentwood in 2020 ($25,800,000), sold significantly more real estate in the ultra-prime west of seventh section of Santa Monica than any other Los Angeles agent in 2021, and holds the record for the highest west of seventh transaction selling the historically significant 405 Palisades Ave for $12,150,000. Numerous other notable sales bolster his resume including 73+74 Beverly Park handled along with David Kramer, and the iconic Brentwood mid-century "boomerang" house tied to the world’s richest man.

Andrew understands that buying or selling a home requires the utmost level of diligence and care from an agent. agents.bio:
Born and raised in Los Angeles County, Joanne Brown brings a lifetime of local insight and over two decades of real estate expertise to her clients. Before launching her real estate career in 2002, Joanne was a successful business owner—an experience that sharpened her skills, discipline, and business acumen, which now provide peace of mind to the buyers and sellers she serves.

Specializing in complex and emotional transactions—such as probate sales, trust sales, and assisting seniors with downsizing or relocating—Joanne is known for her unwavering commitment to guiding clients through each step with clarity, compassion, and confidence. Her clients often praise her listening skills, negotiation expertise, and ability to mediate challenges while marketing properties with precision.

Her approach is simple yet powerful:

Listen closely to each client’s needs

Know the Los Angeles market inside and out

Guide every client toward the best possible outcome with the least stress

Joanne holds an impressive portfolio of professional designations, including GRI (Graduate REALTOR® Institute), SRES® (Seniors Real Estate Specialist), SFR® (Short Sale & Foreclosure Resource), SRS® (Seller Representative Specialist), ABR® (Accredited Buyer’s Representative), and certification as a mediation expert from Pepperdine University’s renowned Straus Institute for Dispute Resolution.

Her clients remain loyal because they trust her to go the extra mile—no matter how complicated the circumstances. Friendly and approachable yet fiercely protective of her clients’ interests, Joanne doesn’t stop until every option has been explored and the best solution found.

Grounded in her faith and inspired by the values her late parents instilled—a servant’s heart, confidence, and independence—Joanne remains deeply committed to giving back. She volunteers her time in real estate leadership at both the local and state levels, serves her community, supports children’s and animal nonprofit organizations, and is active in her church. She also keeps her promises—like caring for her mother’s beloved dog, Hershey, who continues to bring her joy.

For Joanne, the greatest reward is seeing her clients’ smiles at the close of a successful transaction. That joy is genuine—because she truly loves what she does: helping people successfully sell their home, whether it’s a standard sale, probate, trust, or distressed property, and experience the pride and happiness of homeownership.

Glenda Mejia – Broker Associate | CB&A, Realtors

Glenda Mejia is a dedicated real estate professional serving the Houston area, bringing over a decade of experience in residential sales and leasing. Originally from San Salvador, El Salvador, Glenda is a graduate architect with a strong background in construction documentation, technical project planning, and construction contracts.

Her early career includes more than 10 years of impactful community and volunteer work with the NGO Fe y Alegría, where she contributed to the design and development of school classrooms for rural communities. This experience shaped her core values of empathy, integrity, and a deep commitment to helping others.

Glenda relocated to Houston in 2015, where she further expanded her expertise by studying Drafting at Lone Star College and gaining experience in architectural and landscape design. Her strong foundation in design, architecture, and construction gives her clients a unique advantage when evaluating properties and making informed decisions.

With over 112 closed home sales totaling more than $15 million in volume, and 76 successful lease transactions, Glenda has built a solid reputation for results-driven service. In December 2025, she achieved a significant milestone by obtaining her Broker license and currently serves as a Broker Associate with CB&A, Realtors.

Known for her strong negotiation skills and client-first approach, Glenda is committed to protecting her clients’ best interests in every transaction. She provides personalized guidance, market insight, and full-service support from start to finish.

Beyond real estate, Glenda is deeply committed to her family and community. She has volunteered as a mentor for at-risk youth with Klein ISD from 2018 to 2021, reflecting her passion for making a positive impact both professionally and personally.

agents.bio:
Martina's enthusiasm, dedication, and desire to succeed has led her to a rewarding career in real estate. A French native, Martina and her family have called Houston home for more than 20 years after a few moves around the world.Having herself lived the expat life, Martina loves helping local and international families call Houston their “Home Sweet Home” and has deep knowledge and understanding of many neighborhoods and school systems within Houston.
Martina is known to work tirelessly to find the best possible solution for her clients’ real estate needs. As a testament to her dedication, most of her business comes from past clients and their referrals.
A true believer in supporting her community, Martina is a proud founding member of the first French immersion public school in Texas (Mark White ES) and a co-founder (and current President) of Education Francaise Greater Houston, a French after school program for over 10 years.

agents.bio:
As one satisfied client summed up in one of Mel’s recent seller surveys, “Mel Reyna is amazing.” And we agree. Elaborating on Mel’s extraordinary service, another client remarked, “he worked very hard to sell my home quickly and keep me fully informed throughout the process – I would recommend Mel to anyone.” Mel’s professionalism, efficiency, market knowledge, listening skills, reliance and dedication are qualities that only scratch the surface of what he does for his clients and customers on a daily basis.

Mel was the first agent to join Greenwood King’s brand new Heights Boulevard office in 1999. Every year since, he has been the Heights office top producer. Three years later, Mel was ranked as one of the “Top 25 Residential Real Estate Individuals” by the Houston Business Journal. His success as a leading real estate agent may be attributed to a maxim he strictly adheres to – “always treat clients as you would expect to be treated yourself.” Without a doubt, his philosophy works, as this dynamic agent has significantly impacted residential real estate in the Heights for more than 17 years.

Honesty distinguishes this experienced pro, who’s number one priority is to ensure his clients not get too wrapped up in the emotions involved. “Always buy and sell smart,” Mel stresses, comforting clients with the fact that he will do whatever it takes – working as long as needed – to negotiate the best deal. He also takes pride in working with first-time buyers and is delighted to guide them through every step of this complicated process.

Mel specializes in the Heights (where he grew up and currently resides), as well as various surrounding neighborhoods such as Oak Forest, Shady Acres, Timbergrove Manor, Montrose, Memorial, Spring Branch, the Museum District and Galveston. As if his service to the industry wasn’t enough, Mel’s sense of neighborhood extends well beyond his professional endeavors. He has been involved in numerous charitable organizations such as the Heights Association, Heights Boulevard Beautification, St. Andrew’s Church and Harvard Elementary.

Kyla Linn spent several years bringing the best of fashion to Houstonians as one of the lead buyers for Houston's own legacy luxury retailer, Tootsies. After a decade in the retail industry, she developed a keen eye and sharp negotiation skills. These skills, along with an aptitude for customer service, marketing, competitive analysis, pricing, and data analytics, allow Kyla to bring value to her clients when selling or buying their next home. With over $200 million in residential real estate sales in the Greater Houston and surrounding areas, Kyla offers unmatched expertise to buyers, sellers, and investors. Rapidly rising to one of the top agents in Houston, Kyla has been featured in HAR's Rising Stars of Real Estate Top 20 Under 40 and Houston Business Journal's Top 10 Groups in Houston two years in a row.

Kyla's success has always been attributed to her customer centric approach, and she has long held the principle that a customer's experience is far more important than the transaction itself. Organized, detail oriented, and quick to respond, Kyla has had success streamlining processes for many organizations throughout her career, so her clients can be sure that they will have a seamless and stress free experience.

When asked why she decided to make the move to real estate, Kyla explained "My entire career, I have had success understanding and meeting the needs of consumers all across the United States. Retail was a perfect match for me, as it coupled my creative nature with my strong business acumen. As I got older, I became passionate about personal finance and helping others understand how to build a better future for themselves. I am eager to be in a position where I can utilize my skills and take my passion for understanding the needs of others to give my clients a competitive edge when it comes to undertaking what will likely be one of the biggest investments of their lifetime, their home."

Kyla is a native Houstonian and a graduate of Houston Christian High School. She received a degree in Business Marketing from Texas A&M University, where she graduated Summa Cum Laude. She has been voted by her peers in several positions of leadership throughout her career, as her reputation for being smart, levelheaded, and empathetic makes her an excellent advocate for others. She enjoys a love of food and travel, having visited over 30 countries in her lifetime, and is always eager to give restaurant and travel recommendations. She currently lives with her husband, daughter, and two goldendoodles in the Heights.

remarks: Experience the pinnacle of coastal living in this newly constructed, custom California Coastal estate an exceptional collaboration between Live Inspired Homes, JRD Construction, and renowned coastal designer Molly Waggoner. Thoughtfully conceived as a private compound, this residence evokes the elegance of Montecito with a distinctly modern sensibility. A herringbone brick walkway leads through manicured grounds to the 3,400 sq ft main residence, where high ceilings, abundant natural light, and refined architectural elements establish a sense of both scale and serenity. Each space has been curated by Waggoner, whose two decades of design expertise are reflected in every hand-selected finish - from the artisanal tilework and wide-plank hardwood floors to the tongue-and-groove ceilings and custom wall treatments. The dramatic stone facade wrapping the entry hall introduces a warm, textural sophistication that continues throughout this exceptional home. The central kitchen offers the perfect balance of form and function. Anchored by a substantial center island, this space features Thermador appliances, a custom designed hood with brass details and an expansive walk-in pantry outfitted with custom built-in cabinetry. Designed with both entertaining and everyday living in mind, it opens seamlessly to the home's main living areas, creating a fluid, sunlit space where gatherings unfold with ease. The main residence offers four ensuite bedrooms and five baths, including a versatile first-floor suite that opens to a serene patio - ideal for guests or a tranquil home office. Upstairs, a central family lounge connects three additional bedrooms, each with its own exquisitely tiled ensuite bath and custom closets. The primary suite overlooks the lush backyard retreat and features a private balcony, oversized walk-in closet, and spa-like bath with soaking tub and multi-head shower. Also on this level, a lavish utility room combines elegance with practicality, featuring custom cabinetry, abundant built-in storage, and a dedicated sink, elevating daily routines with refined ease. Beyond the interiors, an extraordinary outdoor sanctuary awaits. A sunlit pool with baja shelf, infinity-edge spa, and a fully outfitted outdoor BBQ kitchen are framed by an expansive patio and elevated deck - merging the best of resort and residential living. The pool gracefully links the main residence to a fully equipped 650 sq ft ADU, complete with a great room area, private bedroom and bath, full kitchen, laundry, office nook, and an outdoor pool bathroom, offering exceptional versatility and opportunity. A bespoke mudroom and direct-access two-car garage complete the home's thoughtful layout. Set within a close-knit, highly desirable neighborhood with premier access to top-tier schools, the beach, golf, tennis, shopping, dining, and LAX, this estate is a rare opportunity to live beautifully, live effortlessly, and live inspired.

In 2017, he closed approximately $60 million, which garnered praise and recognition as one of the Houston Business Journal’s Top Agents by Sales Volume for the sixth consecutive year.

David lives in Montrose with his wife, Heather, and their two young children, Hart and Holden. remarks: Welcome to a rare opportunity in Westchester's Westport Heights: a meticulously renovated 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom single-story home, available for the first time in 50 years. This 1,752 sq ft residence masterfully blends vintage beach cottage charm with modern luxury, showcasing original ornate architectural details by Silas Nowell.The thoughtfully designed floor plan offers privacy with bedrooms on one side and expansive living areas on the other. Dual living spaces, each featuring a wood-burning fireplace with gas starter, provide versatile comfort. The formal living room boasts a coved ceiling and bay window, while the great room integrates family living and dining, highlighted by a limewashed brick fireplace and a stylish dry bar with quartz countertop. Dark wood ceiling beams and white wall paneling create a striking beachy aesthetic. Culinary enthusiasts will appreciate the renovated galley kitchen, equipped with premium Bosch appliances, vertical shiplap walls, and champagne bronze hardware. Abundant natural light fills the space, which includes an eat-in seating area and Spanish-crafted hex tile flooring that extends into the spacious laundry room with new GE Profile appliances. The luxurious private quarters include a primary bedroom positioned at the rear for tranquility, featuring a full-light patio door leading to a secluded outdoor sanctuary. Two generously sized secondary bedrooms offer comfort and privacy.Outdoor living is perfected in the professionally landscaped backyard, featuring tropical foliage and nightscaping. Two distinct patios offer diverse entertainment options: one with a charming shed, pergola, and spill fountain, and the other, accessible from the kitchen, equipped with utilities for a potential outdoor kitchen. Adding significant value is the beautifully finished 323 sq ft garage, offering exceptional versatility as an office, home gym, or with strong potential for ADU conversion ideal for rental income or multi-generational living. Recent upgrades include a new shingle roof, Bryant furnace and ductwork, 200-amp electrical panel, updated appliances, and many newly installed Milgard windows, ensuring modern comfort without sacrificing character. Enjoy an enviable location in one of Los Angeles' most convenient neighborhoods. Just 10 minutes from pristine beaches and 3 miles from LAX, this home is ideally situated near Silicon Beach, Playa Vista, and LMU. This prime location offers a vibrant tapestry of dining, shopping, and entertainment, balancing residential serenity with urban convenience. This isn't just a home; it's a lifestyle opportunity and a smart investment in a highly desirable area.
