agents.bio:
My name is Lynn Blair. I am the mother of 2 beautiful children! I was an elementary school teacher for over a decade in Cy-Fair and continue to substitute if I have a free moment. I also coach Special Olympics Track and Swimming for the Cy-Fair school district and foster for the local Cypress dog rescue, Cypress Lucky Mutts. Aside from my love of children and animals, I have always had a passion for real estate. I have been an investor along with my husband (whom is a realtor as well) since 2009.

12 years ago I made my dream a reality and took up real estate alongside my husband, Cody. Three years ago, I became a broker and we opened up Blair Realty Group here in Fairfield! I have lived in Fairfield in the Cypress area for over 18 years and have watched it grow from FARfield, to one of the most beautiful, outstanding neighborhoods in the Houston area. I love this area and know how amazing it has been to live, work, play, and start a family here. I pride myself in customer service and making sure we find you EXACTLY what you are looking for! We service anywhere from Katy, Cypress, Tomball, Spring and MORE! I CANNOT WAIT TO MAKE YOUR DREAM A REALITY AND FIND YOU THE PERFECT HOME! Thank You!

Hi, my name is An, though family and friends back home lovingly call me Anneke. I’m originally from Brussels, Belgium, and I’m fluent in Dutch, French, and English. Life has taken me on an incredible journey, with over 27 years in the oil and gas industry, where I’ve had the privilege of traveling the world, working with diverse teams, and leading multicultural groups. Along the way, I’ve called the Netherlands and Singapore home before settling in Houston 12 years ago.
My background in Communication means I understand the importance of clear and open communication throughout the entire process, whether it’s navigating challenges or celebrating milestones. Combined with my global supply chain experience, I bring a problem-solving attitude and a “let’s get it done” mindset to every situation. Having lived and worked across so many cultures, I deeply understand how important it is to find a home that feels just right—especially when you’re starting fresh in a new place with your family.
With a wide international network and a genuine passion for connecting with people, I’m dedicated to helping families find more than just a house—I help them find their safe haven. I bring empathy, professionalism, and a heartfelt commitment to making every relocation or transition as smooth and meaningful as possible

remarks: Lock the door, catch a flight, come home to nothing that needs mowing. This EaDo townhome sits inside a gated enclave minutes from downtown, with a private garage and a layout built for people who are out more than they are in. The main level opens up - high ceilings, real wood floors, granite counters, and a kitchen that keeps the cook in the conversation, plus a powder bath for guests. Upstairs, each bedroom has a bath of its own, and the primary adds dual vanities, a private water closet, and a soaking tub with shower. Laundry sits on the top floor where the clothes already are, washer and dryer included. Outside the gate the neighborhood does the rest: Daikin Park within walking distance, Toyota Center a few minutes away, and Ninfa’s, El Tiempo, The Rustic, and EaDo’s breweries, markets, and taquerias scattered up and down the surrounding blocks. The HOA covers roof, foundation, exterior, gates, trash, water, and sewer, so your weekends go to the city instead of to a punch list.

agents.bio:
Over 18 years and hundreds of millions of dollars in Houston closings taught me one thing that never changes: the deal is won before anyone signs — in the prep, the pricing, and the negotiation. That's where I go to work for you.

I'm Le Nguyen, Broker and Owner of Go-M Realty, and I took the road less traveled to get here. I hold an accounting degree from UH-Downtown, so I read a contract the way few agents do — every number, every clause, every dollar that should stay in your pocket. Before real estate, I worked as a contractor for the U.S. Army in Kirkuk, Iraq, during the war as a purchaser, handling logistics, supplies and contracts. I also spent 16 years coaching competitive women's gymnastics — a sport where everything comes down to preparation, nerve, and executing when it counts. Those chapters shaped how I run a deal today. The numbers stay tight, and I don't flinch when the stakes climb.

When it's time to sell, I don't sit on a listing and hope. I market it hard — sharp pricing, strong presentation, and a strategy built to put your property in front of the right buyers fast. I'm a Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist and a Certified Negotiation Expert, but the part of my business I'm proudest of is the referrals. Most of my clients come from people I've worked with before — folks who trusted me enough to send me their family and friends. I don't take that lightly, and I've built my whole career on earning it.

When I'm not at the closing table, you'll find me in the gym, hunting down a new restaurant across town, planning my next trip, or getting talked back to by Lola, my parrot. When you're ready to make a move in Houston, I'd be proud to be your partner.

Mike’s enthusiasm, dedication, and consummate market knowledge make him the Realtor® of choice for his many clients who do not hesitate to recommend his services to family and friends.

Mike was born and grew up in Creswell, North Carolina. He graduated from East Carolina University with a degree in Industrial Technology and Business. His Houston sales career began in the 1980s when Mike was transferred to Bayou City while working in retail management. He changed his career path in 1987 to residential real estate sales and has never looked back.

Mike’s father owned a small development and construction company, and that exposure gave Mike a particular interest in and knowledge of new home construction. He understands the builders’ language, and that expertise has made a successful difference for his clients in numerous transactions.

Leadership, experience, market expertise, above all, an understanding of people, and the importance of building relationships make Mike a top-producing, in-demand Realtor®.

As a Los Angeles native and long-time Westchester resident, Stephanie offers hyper-local knowledge that few agents can match. She specializes in: Westchester, Playa del Rey, Playa Vista, Marina del Rey, Culver City, Venice, and El Segundo

What Makes Stephanie Different?

- Stephanie's unique background in sales, event planning, hospitality, and the arts makes her an expert in both marketing and negotiation.
- She believes: “Real estate, like life, is all about getting the details right.”

Her Process Includes:

- Helping clients define and align their vision, goals, and budget

- Leading a high-performing team to deliver seamless service

Local, Loyal, and Living Here...

Stephanie lives in Westchester with her husband—a playwright and LMU professor—and their two children. She’s proud to serve the neighborhoods she calls home, and her passion for community is reflected in her generous support of local charitable organizations including the YMCA, Westchester Arts and Music Block Party, and more.

As a Mortgage Loan Originator and Real Estate Broker with over 28 years of experience in the real estate industry, I have developed a strong expertise in sales, real estate marketing, and loan originating. I am the broker owner at Sherie Howard & Associates, where our team services single family home owners, buyers, commercial property investors, and property management. I am also certified as a Mortgage Broker and signed with top lenders such as UWM, Rocket Mortgage, The Lender, Velocity, and many more.

He is bilingual in Spanish and English and is often asked to serve as a translator. An entrepreneur at heart, Matt is very dedicated to serving his customers and building long-term relationships. agents.bio:
James is an associate with RE/MAX Northwest, Realtors. Whether buying or selling, his market insight and no nonsense approach ensures that his clients are informed and confident during every step of the transaction. James' focus, tenacity, and above all else, his honesty are second to none.

Perhaps surprisingly, much of James' 24 year career was not spent in real estate, but in the offshore oil and gas industry. He is an engineering consultant who managed subsea control systems for projects in the Gulf of Mexico that ranged up to $6+ billion. His attention to detail, ability to see the big picture, and manage multiple vendors gives him an experience that you won't find in many agents. The offshore industry offered a fast paced and challenging career (not that real estate doesn't as well), but working in real estate allows James to take his children to school in the morning, and see his family every night. It's the "little" things in life that are actually the "big" things that we sometimes miss.

James is a graduate of Texas A&M University. The father of three children and married for 15 years, James and is wife, Becky, have lived in the NW Houston area for over 14 years.

Houston Broker & Owner of The Zilveti Group, Andrés Zilveti creates exceptional experiences and optimal outcomes for buyers and sellers throughout the Greater Houston area backed by more than a decade of hands-on marketing experience. As a third-generation real estate professional, the business is practically in his DNA. Clients rave about his patient, understanding and professional approach, calling his ability to zero in on his customers' unique needs "brilliant."

Before getting his real estate license, Andrés ran a digital agency, where he honed the razor-sharp marketing and social media talents that are indispensable to his clients today. As the owner/broker of The Zilveti Group, he thrives on helping people move forward and upward in their lives, whether that means guiding a first-time home purchase, serving relocators and young professionals, or helping investors expand their portfolios. With Andres at the helm, clients at every price point enjoy attentive expert service backed by powerful industry know-how.

Andrés was raised in Austin and moved to Houston to attend the University of Houston, where he earned a bachelor's degree in public relations with a minor in art history. After a three-year stint as an expat in Perth, Australia, he returned to Houston. Andrés now resides in Spring Branch, where he appreciates the relaxing lifestyle and central location. When he's not hard at work for his clients, he enjoys spending time with his family and dogs and pursuing his passion for pickleball.

agents.bio:
The Bruner Team is currently a one-woman show—me, Elisa (Bruner) McNinch—and I’m honored to carry on the real estate legacy my parents began more than 40 years ago. Real estate has always been personal in our family, and that’s exactly how I still do business today: with genuine care, calm guidance, and a big dose of Southern hospitality.

I’m proud to have been recognized with the Five Star Professional Award for real estate customer service 13 years in a row (2012–2025)—an honor earned by fewer than 1% of Houston-area Realtors. I’m also a consistent multi-million dollar producer, but what matters most to me is that my clients feel heard, protected, and confident from start to finish.

If you ask where I work in Houston, you’ll probably hear me say: “If you divide Houston in half, I work the left-hand side.” I primarily serve Northwest Houston, and I’m very familiar throughout West Houston as well, including Spring, Tomball, Spring Branch, Cypress, Katy, and Richmond/Rosenberg.

Even though I’m tech-savvy (and yes—your home will be marketed online the right way), I still believe the best service happens voice-to-voice and face-to-face whenever possible. I’m hands-on with every client: meeting with sellers to stage and prepare a home, taking listings, coordinating photography, marketing, showing properties, hosting open houses, attending inspections—you name it. I’m the face and heart of The Bruner Team.

Behind the scenes, I’m supported by a trusted transaction coordinator who helps prepare listing documents and offers, tracks deadlines, and keeps everything moving smoothly—so you get both personal attention and professional precision.

If you’re looking for a knowledgeable agent who feels more like a steady partner than a sales pitch, I’d love to help you make your next move.

Native Houstonian and fourth-generation Texan, Adria Czerewaty considers it her honor helping buyers and sellers onto the next stage of their life's journey.  Backed by a decade of real estate experience and multiple specialist designations, she offers an astute understanding of the market, unwavering integrity and an amiable personality that makes the entire experience enjoyable.

Before real estate, Adria honed her exceptional interpersonal and communications skills as a professional recruiter.  It's a profession she credits formed her elite problem-solving skills, negotiations prowess, discretion and flair for helping those relocating both stateside and Internationally.

Inspired by her grandmother, a successful realtor in her own right, Adria entered the profession yearning to wield her considerable talents for buyers and sellers, from first-timers to those in Houston's luxury sector.  Clients remark on her ability to deliver a caring, patient approach coupled with a whole lot of determination and hustle.

Adria is a consistent top producer, and her roster of additional coursework in the field is a testament to her devotion to the craft.  She's a Certified Negotiation Expert (CNE), Accredited Luxury Home Specialist (ALHS), Pricing Strategy Advisor (PSA), Senior Real Estate Specialist (SRES) and Institute for Luxury Home Marketing certified.

Adria resides in the Memorial Park area, where she loves the natural beauty and serenity of the park, surrounded by the convenience of big city living.  She's deeply involved in the Houston community through her work with numerous nonprofits and local organizations, including Bo's Place, Nora's Home, the Wildlife Center, the Landing, and the Crestwood Garden Club.  In her free time, Adria can be found gardening, helping neighbors, and spending time with friends, family and her two beloved rescue dogs.  As a lover of nature and adventure, she adores travel, has lived Internationally and looks forward to growing her already over-one-million-miles airline status continuing to explore more amazing destinations.

remarks: Welcome to this well-maintained home in the desirable Osage neighborhood of Westchester, offering comfort, space, and easy California living. A double-door entry opens to a light-filled interior where abundant natural light and a skylight in the front living room create a warm, inviting atmosphere from the moment you arrive. The home features four spacious bedrooms and three bathrooms, providing flexibility for family living, guests, or a home office. The open kitchen is designed for both everyday living and inspired cooking. Rich wood cabinetry, tile countertops, a gas range, and a powerful range hood make it an ideal space for preparing delicious meals. Just beyond, the dining area flows seamlessly to the backyard, creating a natural setting for indoor-outdoor gatherings and relaxed entertaining. A step-down second living area adds character and versatility, perfect as a family room or media space. The thoughtfully designed bedroom layout includes two bedrooms connected by a convenient Jack-and-Jill bathroom, while the fourth bedroom enjoys easy access to a well appointed hall bath. The generous primary suite offers a private sanctuary, complete with a walk-in closet and en-suite bath featuring dual vanities, a shower/jetted tub combination, and a separate water closet. Outside, the backyard invites you to unwind beneath the pergola-covered patio, while a prolific orange tree adds charm and a taste of California living. Drought-tolerant landscaping enhances the home's appeal while promoting easy maintenance. Additional highlights include excellent interior storage, central HVAC, and a two-car attached garage with direct access for everyday convenience. Lovingly cared for and ideally located near restaurants, LAX, and all the amenities of the Westside, this exceptional Westchester home offers a rare opportunity to enjoy space, comfort, and a vibrant coastal lifestyle in one of the area's most desirable neighborhoods.

Watching people fall in love with their new home, or selling their current one is fun and exciting, and I have had the honor of being in the top 1% of sales in my office, earning the respect of my fellow REALTORS, and helping many clients. My wife, Becky (who is also a Realtor), and I also own a small farm, where we hatch, raise, and sell heritage and specialty breeds of chickens, turkeys, and guineas, as well as farm fresh eggs. remarks: Reimagined Eagle Rock Gem with Versatile Living Spaces. Tucked away on a quiet corner lot in one of Eagle Rock's most welcoming cul-de-sacs, this beautifully remodeled 1926 home blends timeless character with thoughtful modern updates. From the moment you arrive, you'll feel the warmth of a property designed for both daily comfort and effortless entertaining. On the main level, three bedrooms and two updated bathrooms provide ample room for family or guests. The bright, modern kitchen is the true heart of the home, with stylish finishes and a layout that makes morning coffee or evening meals a delight. An open-concept living and dining area creates an inviting space where natural light pours in perfect for everything from cozy nights at home to lively dinner parties. The lower level is where this home really stands apart (400 sq ft). With its own private entrance, this fully finished space features a living room, kitchen, bedroom, and bath. Whether you need a guest suite, an in-law setup, a private retreat for older kids, or even rental/income potential, the possibilities are endless. Outdoor living is equally impressive. A covered deck offers a perfect spot for grilling, gathering with friends, or enjoying your morning coffee, while the yard provides room for gardening, play, or simply soaking in the California sunshine. This rare combination of usable outdoor space and functional indoor design makes the home feel like a private retreat right in the city. Beyond the property itself, Eagle Rock is one of Los Angeles' most sought-after neighborhoods, known for its vibrant community and highly regarded schools. Families will appreciate the acclaimed Eagle Rock High School, the only LAUSD school offering an integrated International Baccalaureate program for grades 7-12, along with gifted and talented magnet options. Add in the welcoming cul-de-sac environment where neighbors know each other and kids still ride bikes and set up lemonade stands and you have a home that offers more than just four walls, but a lifestyle. This is a rare opportunity to own a home that seamlessly combines modern convenience, flexible living spaces, and a true sense of community in the heart of Eagle Rock. Don't miss your chance to make this one yours!

agents.bio: Drew Smyth was born in Issaquah, Washington, where he grew up racing motocross, playing rugby and drag racing his 64 Chevelle, which he still has! His first job out of school was selling cars, and he did it successfully for 3 years. Needing a change, Drew decided to move to California in 2010. He got his first taste of the hot real estate market when he worked doing short sales with investors and real estate agents. In 2018 he decided to take the leap into being a real estate agent himself. The first year was a lot of learning, but by his second year as an agent, Drew was already in the top 50% of his KW office. By his third year Drew was in the top 20% of his office and was asked to join the ALC board of directors for the KW Los Feliz office. After closing over 5 million in sales in 2020 alone, Drew has become one of the top agents to call when looking to buy or sell in the LA area. In a market that is hot, and people are offering over asking, Drew has become creative in finding ways to get discounts or instant equity on 90% of his sales for clients. The need to win for his clients is always his biggest drive for Drew. His chill demeanor, cheerful outlook, and unique laugh will keep you calm as you navigate one of the biggest purchases of your life. Do yourself a favor and call Drew when you are ready to buy, sell or lease real estate.

remarks: Perched on a premier corner lot in North Kentwood, this extensively rebuilt 2025 residence captures sweeping city, mountain, and peek-a-boo ocean views while offering the effortless indoor-outdoor lifestyle Southern California buyers seek. Originally built in 1953, the home underwent a comprehensive down-to-the-studs reconstruction and expansion. The property was rebuilt with entirely new electrical, plumbing, framing, insulation, ductwork, gas lines, drywall, windows, and structural systems throughout both levels. The result is a home that lives and feels like new construction. Step inside to discover a high-end gourmet kitchen, beautifully appointed with quartz countertops and backsplash, an oversized island, Bertazzoni range and hood, KitchenAid refrigerator, and a wine refrigerator perfectly designed for effortless entertaining. The adjacent great room, bathed in natural light, features a custom Milgard four-panel stacking slider that opens seamlessly to an expansive outdoor deck. Just beyond, the formal dining area and inviting family spaces create the ideal setting for intimate dinners or lively gatherings. On the first level, the luxurious primary suite awaits, complete with a custom walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bathroom showcasing marble finishes, quartz countertops, and a custom vanity. An additional bedroom or office on this level adds versatility and convenience. Ascend the custom stairway to the upper level, where two spacious secondary bedrooms are thoughtfully positioned on opposite sides of a generous family room. A convenient upstairs laundry room and a balcony with cozy seating provide the perfect place to unwind while taking in the home's panoramic vistas. Outside, the entertainer's backyard invites you to relax and enjoy the Southern California lifestyle with a built-in fire pit, outdoor TV, and two grassy play areas. The fully permitted ADU offers remarkable flexibility ideal for guests, extended family, or generating additional rental income. During the expansion, the home was thoughtfully enhanced with a new powder bath and stairway, while the front fade was completely reimagined with hand-cut Sierra White Limestone, creating a striking architectural presence and elevated curb appeal. As the Tricia Turner Group, we work with a team of qualified specialists to help with the sale of your home, from beginning to end.  We have put together a full marketing team, our own staging company, as well as a Preferred Partner Program, which involves a list of vendors that we know, like, and trust.

No truly successful company on the planet has one person doing everything, including the real estate company you hire. We would love to be your expert home selling advisors.

With over 25 years in the real estate industry, and having SOLD thousands of homes, TTG has put together some amazing plans and programs that are unique to our organization, and have the best results in achieving our goals.  We keep our eyes laser focused on the market and what’s ahead, while maintaining a unique culture within our organization.

Our belief in providing the best customer experience keeps us steadfast as innovators, as we continue to differentiate ourselves from our competition.  No other real estate company has employed such strategies and opportunities to help the consumer experience as TTG.

What separates us…

~ The Coming Soon Listing Program - we have a private FB group that we moderate which allows us to market our listings, before they are active, to the top producers in our industry~ 
~ Our own “Make it Pretty” Program allows you, the homeowner, to have repairs done on your home prior to listing, with no upfront cost to you
~ Professional STAGING INCLUDED with our own staging company Honeybee Homestaging & More
~ Our own 60 Step Listing Program - for optimal marketing on all listings which includes a partnership with Homes.com to maximize our exposure
~ Protect and Serve Program - we give discounts and rebates to all military, police officers, firefighters, first responders, and teachers
~ Easy Exit Listing Plan - you can fire us for any reason if you are not 100% satisfied 
~ Flexible Commission Plan - Pay as little as zero% commission
~ Immediate Buyout Program with our own CASH OFFER DIVISION
~ Love It or Leave It Program - if you’re not happy in your home during the first 12 months of owning it, we’ll sell it for you for FREE (waive the listing broker fee of 3%)
~ Immediate Response System - All buyer inquiries will be handled in 5 minutes or less and most often within the first 60 seconds
~ Reverse Offer Strategy - this lets us go to buyers that may be on the fence about your home and make an offer to them, with terms, conditions, and prices that are acceptable to all parties
~ Preferred Partner Program - a list of vendors that we work exclusively with - you can locate them at:   www.residentialservicedirectory.com
~ Move for Free - use of our company moving truck at no charge...forever

With the real estate industry always changing, it is imperative that we stay ahead of the curve and always have the best techniques to help you, the consumer, with one of the largest investments in your life

remarks: Experience this beautiful and bright three-bedroom plus den home with a detached guest suite featuring a kitchenette, located in the heart of Kentwood and overflowing with curb appeal. Framed by two mature trees including a stately blooming blue jacaranda and adorned with drought-tolerant landscaping, this gorgeous traditional residence offers an impressive and functional floor plan. A welcoming front porch opens into the light-filled, open-concept living room, dining area, and newly updated kitchen, all seamlessly connected to the backyard through glass doors that invite effortless indoor-outdoor living. The newly remodeled kitchen features Quartz countertops, a stunning marble center island with breakfast counter, custom cabinetry, pot filler, and a 5-burner range designed for both everyday living and elevated entertaining. A dedicated pantry and laundry room are conveniently located just off the kitchen, adding everyday functionality and additional storage. The kitchen flows beautifully into the dining area with built-in display cabinetry, creating a warm and inviting gathering space.A formal living room off the main entry showcases picture windows overlooking the front yard, while a spacious family room/den provides separation and privacy for the primary suite. The serene primary suite offers dual closets including a walk-in closet with custom built-ins and an ensuite bath with dual sinks, walk-in shower, soaking tub, and French doors that open directly to the backyard patio. Two additional bedrooms and a full bathroom in the main house offer flexibility for secondary bedrooms, guests, or a home office. Outside, the detached garage has been thoughtfully converted into a private guest suite complete with kitchenette and breakfast counter, full bathroom, air conditioning, and closet space ideal for visitors or creative workspace. Additional upgrades include an electric gated driveway, paver patio areas, central heating and air conditioning, plantation shutters, hardwood floors, and dual-pane windows throughout. Conveniently located near Trader Joe's, Westchester Golf Course, LMU, and LAX, with easy access to Marina del Rey, Culver City, and Playa Vista, this charming and versatile home presents an exceptional opportunity not to be missed. The main house spans approximately 1,883 square feet, complemented by a detached 350-square-foot guest house, providing flexibility for extended family, guests, or a private office retreat.

remarks: Welcome to 7737 Denrock Avenue, a beautifully appointed residence in the heart of North Kentwood, where Craftsman-style accents, mature landscaping, and thoughtful design create a home that feels both grounded and refined. Set beneath the shade of a stately magnolia tree, this timeless property offers an exceptional blend of character, comfort, and functionality. Step through the front door into a welcoming entry hall that opens directly into the formal living room - an inviting space anchored by a classic fireplace and custom built-in bookshelf. The adjacent formal dining area offers an elegant setting for gatherings, seamlessly connected to the updated kitchen, where a peninsula island with bar seating, modern appliances, and ample storage create a space that is both practical and polished. Beyond the kitchen, the family room provides a cozy, functional retreat with built-in office cabinetry and sliding glass doors that lead out to a serene backyard oasis. Designed with intention, the outdoor patio is perfect for alfresco dining and quiet evenings under the stars, with steps down into the yard filled with drought-tolerant garden beds and a mature tree that provides shade and serenity. Back inside, the first floor includes two well-sized bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a thoughtfully placed powder room for guests, creating a layout that balances comfort and convenience. Just off the living room, a built-in dry bar lounge area and soaring two-story ceilings create a striking space for casual entertaining or quiet moments of pause. Upstairs, a spacious laundry and utility room adds everyday ease to the home’s thoughtful design, while an additional bedroom and the expansive primary suite complete the upper level. The primary retreat features vaulted, beamed ceilings, a fireplace, a generous walk-in closet, and a beautifully updated ensuite bathroom with custom mosaic tile, a soaking tub, and a separate glass-enclosed shower. Ideally situated on a quiet, coveted street, 7737 Denrock Avenue is a home where architectural charm meets everyday ease - offering layered living spaces, timeless design, and an unmistakable sense of place in one of Westchester’s most beloved neighborhoods.

A licensed agent since 2012 and a real estate investor since 2002, Evan has sold more than $250 million in real estate and brings a builder's and investor's eye to every home, from foundation and roof to resale value.

Areas: Houston Heights, Woodland Heights, Garden Oaks/Oak Forest, Montrose, Midtown, West University, Bellaire, Spring Branch, Pearland, Katy, Cypress and The Woodlands.

agents.bio:
Lizz & Chris Sansone established The Sansone Group in 2000 and began their Real Estate business in Sugar Land and the Houston Metro Area. Last year, The Sansone Group earned the Diamond Club Award from RE/MAX International for the fifth time in six years. The Diamond Club Award is RE/MAX's highest level of production, less than 1% of agents out of more than 84,000 in the U.S. achieve Diamond Club status.

The Sansone Group is a team of 7 dedicated licensed Realtors® who specialize in Residential Real Estate, New Construction Homes, Luxury Homes, Commercial Property for Sale, Commercial Property for Lease, Farm & Ranch and Investment Property & Land.

In 2018, The Sansone Group had 156 transactions for more than $44 million in sales volume and is in the Top 25 RE/MAX teams in the state of Texas. In 2017, The Sansone Group was named #15 in Luxury Sales, #15 in Transaction Count and #20 in Sales Volume among Real Estate Teams in the Houston Metro Area by the Houston Business Journal.

Transactions in 2017 were 175, 2016 transactions numbered 154, transactions totaled 147 in 2015 and 129 in 2014, for a total transaction count of 761 sold properties alone since 2014! The Sansone Group has achieved career awards with RE/MAX as a member of the RE/MAX Hall of Fame and they have been awarded the RE/MAX Lifetime Achievement Award.

The Sansone Group is a member of RE/MAX Fine Properties in Sugar Land, Texas, the #1 RE/MAX Office in Texas for the last three years.

Lizz was named a Five Star Real Estate Agent in the Houston Region for the 8th year in a row (2010-2018). Lizz has been featured in the June edition of Texas Monthly Magazine each year! A Five Star agent is one who scored highest in overall satisfaction.

Chris has his Broker's license and is a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Texas Association of Realtors and the National Association of Realtors. Chris has spoken at several real estate conferences on the subject of building successful real estate teams on the state level for RE/MAX of Texas and the national level at RE/MAX International events.

The Sansone Group covers Sugar Land to all over the Houston Metro Area including Katy, Missouri City, Richmond, Rosenberg, Pearland, Spring and The Woodlands.

Raised in Southeast Texas, but a long-time resident of Houston since the early 1990’s. Spent the first 20+ years of my professional life as a management consultant and in Information Technology across many industries, including 10 years in the oil&gas sector. In 2017, I decided to make the leap to Real Estate, a long-time interest and passion of mine! Also am an owner of a construction / remodeling company where we have the opportunity to transform houses to dream homes. Whether you are an investor or end-buyer/seller, I am a full-service resource that can help you every step of the way of your home buying/selling experience.

agents.bio: After twenty-three years as a Special Agent with the U.S. Secret Service and the U.S. Department of Commerce, Matt Clark decided he wanted to get into Real Estate and help people reach their dreams of buying their first home or their forever home. Matt is excited to assist anyone in any community from Huntsville to Galveston, especially in his home area of League City, Friendswood, & Clear Lake area. Matt and his wife are avid boaters and beachgoers, he is extremely familiar with Clear Creek and Clear Lake, Galveston Beach, and most of the water-accessible areas of Galveston Bay. Matt specializes in waterfront and beachfront property and is one of the few agents in the area that will take you to view waterfront communities by boat if possible. With this specialization, he has become most familiar with the communities of Bayou Vista, Tiki Island, Omega Bay, and Dickinson Bayou, as well as Lake Conroe, Lake Livingston & Houston. Matt is also an avid car enthusiast so needless to say, he enjoys talking cars, boats, fishing, and property! Whatever your hopes and dreams are, Matt is looking forward to meeting you and assisting you soon.

remarks: This light-filled residence is ideally situated in the highly sought-after Kentwood neighborhood of Westchester, offering an exceptional blend of refined design and comfortable family living. A beautifully landscaped, terraced front entry sets the tone, welcoming you into a thoughtfully curated interior featuring white oak hardwood floors, fresh designer paint, plantation shutters throughout, and an effortless, open flow. The spacious living areas are both inviting and sophisticated, while the remodeled bathrooms showcase high-end finishes, including updated flooring, elegant fixtures, and a beautifully reimagined tub and shower. The kitchen is conveniently located just off the living room and features a door leading directly to the backyard, creating an easy flow for indoor-outdoor living and everyday functionality. Two generously sized secondary bedrooms are filled with natural light and provide ideal space for family, guests, or a home office. A wide, extended hallway leads to the private primary suite, thoughtfully positioned for maximum tranquility. This serene retreat features dual closets, including a walk-in, and a spa-inspired bathroom with floating vanities, a glass-enclosed shower, and a solar tube that fills the space with soft, natural light. A sliding glass door offers seamless indoor-outdoor living with direct access to the backyard. Designed for both entertaining and everyday enjoyment, the backyard features a spacious deck perfect for al fresco dining, a lush grassy yard ideal for play, and a tranquil waterfall that creates a peaceful, retreat-like setting. Completing the property is a detached two-car garage with abundant storage and exciting potential for a future guesthouse, ADU, or flexible living space. This is a rare opportunity to own a home that effortlessly combines style, function, and warmth in one of Westchester's most desirable neighborhoods.

remarks: Set within the highly sought-after Kentwood Elementary school district, this thoughtfully updated four-bedroom, two-bathroom home offers a flexible layout, inviting living spaces, and a backyard designed to be enjoyed. With two bedrooms and two bathrooms on the main level, including a well-appointed primary suite, the home is well suited for a variety of living arrangements. The main floor is filled with warm west-facing light, creating an inviting atmosphere in the living room, where built-in bookshelves and a wood-burning fireplace serve as a natural focal point. A formal dining area connects to the remodeled kitchen, finished with custom gray cabinetry, ample counter space, and a subway tile backsplash. Double ovens, a smart refrigerator, and an eat-at peninsula with pendant lighting and a wine refrigerator make the space as functional as it is welcoming. Just beyond, the family room offers additional flexibility with built-in storage and French doors that open directly to the backyard. Positioned for privacy, the primary suite on the main level opens to the outdoor space and includes a walk-in closet and a remodeled bathroom with dual vanities, gold hardware and fixtures, black and gold hexagonal tile floors, custom wallpaper, and a marble-tiled shower with a rainfall showerhead and built-in niches. A secondary bathroom on this level features a soaking tub and a calming, spa-like feel. Upstairs, two additional bedrooms are filled with natural light and character, enhanced by dormer windows, skylights, and built-in study nooks that create comfortable spaces for work, reading, or play. The backyard is designed for both relaxation and gathering, anchored by a heated pool with a cascading waterfall and surrounded by lush landscaping. The gated driveway and hardscaped areas provide additional room for play, while still offering privacy and separation from the street. A standout feature of the property is the oversized garage, currently set up as a poolside retreat with eight-foot folding doors that open to the yard. Complete with a built-in bar, keg refrigerator with taps, and a projector with screen, it functions as an extension of the outdoor living space. This structure also presents an opportunity for future use as a guest house or potential ADU, or it can be returned to a traditional garage. Moments from the neighborhood's best schools and around the corner from local grocery stores and shops, this traditional beauty makes everyday living easy.

agents.bio:
Haleh brings 18+ years of residential and commercial real estate experience on L.A.’s Westside—serving Culver City, Brentwood, Santa Monica, Pacific Palisades, Malibu, Westwood, Bel Air, and Beverly Hills. She’s known for clear communication, calm guidance, and genuine empathy—whether helping a growing family sell or a young professional buy their first home. From writing the offer to the final walk-through, Haleh explains every step so you feel confident and informed.
Ready to move forward? Contact Haleh and put her expertise to work for you.

Since moving to Southern California in 2006, Alejandra has developed a deep love for the region's environment and communities, particularly the Westside of Los Angeles. She began her career in commercial real estate and property management before transitioning to residential real estate in 2012, when she joined a boutique firm in Pacific Palisades. There, she helped elevate the brand, marketing, and client service to exceptional standards, resulting in a 254% increase in sales volume in 2015 alone.

In 2016, Alejandra joined one of the world's most exclusive real estate luxury brokerages, where she honed her negotiation, contract review, and finalization skills. In the spring of 2023, Alejandra joined the Don Heller Group at Christie’s International Real Estate, an authentic and highly regarded boutique firm renowned for its remarkable success in representing and selling luxury residences and new developments in the Greater Los Angeles Area, and around the globe.

Alejandra’s experience negotiating, finalizing, and reviewing contracts is well known to colleagues and an invaluable asset to her clients. With her international management background in the luxury hospitality industry, Alejandra is uniquely skilled in anticipating the wants and needs of her clients, both local and international. She understands the emotional and logistical challenges of buying, selling, or choosing a home or investment property, making her an invaluable asset to her clients.

As a long-time resident of Santa Monica and Pacific Palisades, Alejandra has an unparalleled breadth and depth of real estate skills and local knowledge, which she leverages to offer her clients the highest level of professional service and advocacy. Her tireless work ethic, coupled with her ethics and constant focus on client needs, ensures that her clients' satisfaction is always her top priority.

In her free time, Alejandra enjoys spending time outdoors with her husband Jon and their children, exploring the diverse culture and architecture of Los Angeles, whether at the beach, the Santa Monica Mountains, or in the city's neighborhoods.

agents.bio:
As a proud Houstonian and seasoned real estate professional, Dena brings a deep understanding of the local market and a passion for her city to every transaction. Whether you’re buying, selling, or investing, Dena offers a comprehensive, concierge-level service that ensures each client’s needs are met with precision and care. “I do more than simply help clients buy or sell homes,” Dena says. “I’m committed to promoting Houston, a city I know and love.”

With certifications as a Certified International Property Specialist (CIPS) and a Master Certified Negotiator (MCN), Dena’s expertise extends far beyond the basics of real estate. She’s equipped to handle complex, high-value transactions, whether locally, nationally, or internationally. Dena’s sharp negotiation skills and ability to connect buyers with the perfect home or community set her apart from others in the industry.

In addition to her real estate expertise, Dena is an active leader in the industry and community. In 2022, she served as the Membership Chair for the Women’s Council of Realtors® (WCR) Houston, and in 2023, she became President-Elect, set to assume the role of President in 2024. In 2025, Dena will serve as the Strategic Partnership Chair for WCR Texas. She’s also on the Houston Association of Realtors® (HAR) Global Advisory Committee (2023-2025), and actively involved in the TREPAC Committee (2024-2025) and the HAR Political Affairs Advisory Group (2025).

Dena is a dedicated volunteer and serves on several key committees for the Houston Livestock and Rodeo, including the Steer Auction Committee, International Committee, Wine Events Committee, and Houston General Go Texan Committee. She is also the past President of the Shady Acres Civic Association, working to enhance the quality of life in the neighborhood, and holds leadership roles with Business Network International (BNI) as both the Realtor® Chair and a member of the Women’s Council of Realtors®.

When she’s not guiding clients through successful real estate transactions or volunteering, Dena enjoys spending time with her husband and their young daughter, who attends Travis Elementary. The family enjoys biking through Houston’s parks, trying new restaurants, and staying active with Pilates.

Dena’s combination of market expertise, leadership, and community involvement, along with her advanced certifications, makes her a standout choice for anyone looking to navigate the Houston real estate market with confidence.

agents.bio:
Named a top 25 Houston real estate agent for multiple years, Steven Kinne is a powerhouse top-producing agent and head of The Kinne Group. 

As a Houston native and agent with almost 20 years of experience, having sold his first homes in The Heights in 2004, Steven has done it all, seen it all, and heard it all when it comes to buying, selling, and investing in homes in and around Houston. 

Steven is a real estate veteran and competitor at heart specializing in relocations, investment properties, new builds, and purchasing and selling homes of all price ranges in Houston and surrounding suburbs. 

As a native Houstonian, Steven grew up in the Spring area with his sister and parents. In high school, he played the Trombone and received a full ride for his first two years before transferring to Texas A&M University. That's where he received a degree in business management and marketing. After college, he returned home and started his career at the Foley's department store corporate office in Downtown Houston as a visual merchandiser and buyer. 

This job was indeed his springboard into real estate. Having run the 13-million-dollar personal care department and managed areas in multiple stores, Steven learned a few valuable skills that have elevated his real estate business to where it is today. 

Much like real estate, the retail industry is non-stop!  The relentless hours taught him the grind never ends, and he takes that learned work ethic into each and every transaction to date. He also learned the importance of proper staging. While a home is much smaller than a department store, he acquired the skill of a well-trained eye for what looks authentically pleasing and what makes people feel comfortable and, for lack of a better term, feel at home. These two invaluable lessons are what set Steven apart from the rest of the agents in Houston.

You might as well call him the master of staging; that is his niche! Having been involved in more than 2000 transactions over the years, one of the small but genuinely impactful differences that make or break a sale or purchase is the home's presentation, and he is one of the few that have mastered this skill. 

Whether it's the presentation of the home or the presentation of the offer, Steven has the knowledge and professional experience to ensure his client's home or offer stands out from the rest of the competition.  

With nearly 1500 5-star Houston real estate reviews, Steven has garnered the reputation of being a great communicator and making his clients feel like they are the only ones he is working with. He truly cares about each client and their needs, wants, and desires. In addition, his vast knowledge of trends in each pocket of this city helps his clients make decisions based on facts rather than emotions.  

When Steven (a self-proclaimed burger connoisseur) isn't selling homes to locals and those relocating to Houston, you will more than likely catch him trying out a new and trendy restaurant, or cool bar, or hanging with his 3 kids and wife in his Fulshear neighborhood. 

As a real estate investor with over 20 properties of his own and in the process of building more, Steven lives and breathes real estate. He and his team's track record is only possible because of their passion for what they do and their ability to deliver results and an enjoyable experience. 

Whether you are looking to buy or sell a home, give him a call if for nothing else than his 5-star burger recommendations!

agents.bio:
Todd Russo knows the Houston real estate market like the back of his hand. Since moving to Houston in 2007, Todd has relentlessly pursued an in-depth knowledge of the local market and a wide network of industry professionals. 

For any buyer, seller, or investor, Todd will be their right-hand man as he seamlessly guides each and every client through the real estate process. For Todd, though, real estate is not about the bottom line – it is about the people 

After a lengthy career in insurance services, Todd is uniquely equipped with a well-trained, detail-oriented eye to guarantee clients feel secure through every step of a transaction. He even manages his own portfolio of fourteen homes that he leases in the Greater Houston market – which makes him notably qualified to work with investors on all levels. When it comes to selling, Todd is the go-to guy.

Todd’s marketing savvy, presence on social media, and knowledge of what moves property sets him apart from others. Sellers can be sure Todd will get the job done. He even has a flair for interior design and staging, so clients can rely on him to make their home showroom ready. In his spare time, Todd enjoys spending time with his teenage son and three dogs, volunteering for animal rescue groups, and developing his own investment portfolio. 

Real estate truly is his passion, and he prides himself on being “hyper-responsive to client needs.” Todd Russo is eager to work with buyers, sellers, and investors in the Greater Houston area.

agents.bio:
Houston Realtor, Caroline Schlemmer, knows that integrity, commitment to each client's best interests, and absolute professionalism are the keys to real estate success. In fact, it's been the winning formula that's earned her numerous industry accolades and a loyal following of repeat and referral clients throughout her over twenty years in the business.

Caroline specializes in new construction, residential resale, condominiums, and townhomes throughout Houston’s close-in neighborhoods including The Heights, West University, Memorial, Oak Forest, Spring Branch, and Montrose. She has been acknowledged for her extraordinary sales and marketing techniques by multiple high-end builders and renovators working on large-scale projects, and individual buyers, sellers, and investors rave about her savvy negotiation skills and customer service.

She is an active member of the community, devoted to a number of organizations, including Adoptive Families of Houston, The Junior League of Houston, Kappa Kappa Gamma Alumnae, and various neighborhood schools in The Heights. During the pandemic, Caroline created Positivity Pop Ups, a community program whose mission is to spread kindness and connections for neighbors. She is focused on expanding this program to foster more positivity all around.

Meet Morgan Broussard, a fifth-generation Houstonian and five star real estate force in the heart of Texas. With a track record of hundreds of closed deals, Morgan's expertise extends beyond the standard agent. As a local real estate investor, he personally knows the intricacies of buying or selling a home and how to maximize his clients’ returns. Whether it is their first primary residence or twentieth investment property, look no further than working with Morgan.

agents.bio:
The Bruner Team is currently a one-woman show—me, Elisa (Bruner) McNinch—and I’m honored to carry on the real estate legacy my parents began more than 40 years ago. Real estate has always been personal in our family, and that’s exactly how I still do business today: with genuine care, calm guidance, and a big dose of Southern hospitality.

I’m proud to have been recognized with the Five Star Professional Award for real estate customer service 13 years in a row (2012–2025)—an honor earned by fewer than 1% of Houston-area Realtors. I’m also a consistent multi-million dollar producer, but what matters most to me is that my clients feel heard, protected, and confident from start to finish.

If you ask where I work in Houston, you’ll probably hear me say: “If you divide Houston in half, I work the left-hand side.” I primarily serve Northwest Houston, and I’m very familiar throughout West Houston as well, including Spring, Tomball, Spring Branch, Cypress, Katy, and Richmond/Rosenberg.

Even though I’m tech-savvy (and yes—your home will be marketed online the right way), I still believe the best service happens voice-to-voice and face-to-face whenever possible. I’m hands-on with every client: meeting with sellers to stage and prepare a home, taking listings, coordinating photography, marketing, showing properties, hosting open houses, attending inspections—you name it. I’m the face and heart of The Bruner Team.

Behind the scenes, I’m supported by a trusted transaction coordinator who helps prepare listing documents and offers, tracks deadlines, and keeps everything moving smoothly—so you get both personal attention and professional precision.

If you’re looking for a knowledgeable agent who feels more like a steady partner than a sales pitch, I’d love to help you make your next move.

remarks: Ideally located in the heart of Silver Lake, this striking 3 bedroom, 2 bathroom 1927 Spanish residence sits on a rare street-to-street corner lot, just moments from the Silver Lake Reservoir and premier commercial offerings, including L&E Oyster Bar and LaMill Coffee. Wrapped in towering hedges and entirely gated and fenced, the home offers nearly 2,000 square feet of character-rich living space on an expansive 5,478 sq ft lot with a perfectly landscaped backyard set under towering trees - delivering a compelling blend of privacy, outdoor space, and classic architectural charm. Beyond the privacy gates, a Saltillo-tiled stairwell ascends to a rotunda foyer, opening into a living room with striking beamed ceilings and a dramatic picture window framing the surrounding hills. A traditional Spanish-style fireplace anchors the space, complemented by alabaster wall sconces and built-in niches that enhance the home's architectural character. Refinished original hardwood floors run throughout, with newly installed hardwood in the primary bedroom and lower-level den, adding continuity and warmth. A sunlit dining area sits adjacent to the open kitchen, featuring a generous center island with built-in bar seating, ample storage, Whirlpool stainless steel appliances, and a layout designed for effortless flow. The kitchen opens onto an outdoor deck, perfect for dining and relaxation. The main level features 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, including a primary suite just off the kitchen. A wooden-beamed ceiling and paper lantern define the space, while direct access to a private backyard deck surrounded by greenery enhances the sense of retreat. Two additional bedrooms line the main hallway, offering comfortable proportions, ornate wrought iron window guards, and textured, rustic wall and ceiling finishes that reflect the home's Spanish character. A bright hallway bathroom with dual sinks and a tub/shower combo has also been updated with new mirrors, light fixtures, and fresh paint. The lower level offers a versatile den with its own exterior entrance, ideal for a media room, office, or guest space. Wall sconces and newly installed hardwood flooring add warmth and function. A dedicated laundry room with storage and a utility sink sits nearby, along with an adjacent bonus storage area for added convenience. Outdoor spaces are thoughtfully terraced and designed for both relaxation and entertaining. A dining area with built-in bench seating and a built-in BBQ sits beneath a graceful weeping tree, creating a romantic and laid-back setting. A grassy lawn and vegetable garden are surrounded by updated landscaping, including newly planted cypress and olive trees, semi-mature ficus, rosemary, and bougainvillea along the fence and entry. Mature hedging enhances privacy throughout. Additional features include a Nest doorbell and thermostat, as well as an ADT security system with panel and sensors, and gated parking. Ideally located near the Silver Lake Reservoir, walking path, and dog park, with easy access to neighborhood favorites including LaMill, Botanica, and L&E Oyster Bar, and located in the sought-after Micheltorena Elementary School (per LAUSD), this home places the best of Silver Lake right at the doorstep.

agents.bio:
Sam Pompeo is an energetic sales professional who thrives on results, and he has an impressive track record — as well as a steady stream of repeat and referral clients — to prove it.

Sam’s desire to make people’s real estate dreams a reality drew him into the industry in 1988. Since then, Sam has guided clients through over 1,000 real estate transactions, totaling more than $350 million. Whether he’s assisting first-time buyers as they purchase their starter home or negotiating a multimillion-dollar offer with a seasoned seller, Sam is proficient at mediating smart deals that satisfy all parties. He boasts extensive experience in both appreciating and depreciating markets and has even had success selling real estate owned (REO) properties. 

Though he was born in Youngstown, Ohio, Sam has lived in the Greater San Fernando Valley for six decades. His extensive market knowledge offers firsthand wisdom and pricing expertise across a broad spectrum of Southern California communities and neighborhoods.

Sam specializes in representing buyers and sellers of residential real estate properties, and he is skilled in negotiating investment property deals. He has sold many multi-unit buildings and can comfortably navigate net operating income, capitalization rates, and other complex concepts for his clients. Sam has even penned a book, titled “Go Ask Sam,” enumerating the insights he’s gained throughout his decades of industry experience.

Before venturing into the world of real estate, Sam earned a bachelor’s degree in electronic engineering and spent time in the corporate world. With this experience, he developed skills in problem-solving, critical thinking, and compliance adherence, all of which translate into his real estate role. In addition to his career, Sam is an avid golfer and enjoys home renovation projects.

Mimi and Jon Torp’s story began with a blind date more than 30 years ago, and their marriage—built on humor, respect, and compromise—has shaped both their lives and their business. Specializing in Santa Monica and Westside neighborhoods, the Torps are known for raising the bar when it comes to achieving top dollar for their sellers. Their proven buying and selling strategies, combined with sharp negotiation skills, consistently deliver outstanding results.

What truly sets them apart is their people-first approach. They listen with empathy, communicate with honesty, and act with integrity—earning the trust and respect of clients, colleagues, and the community. Having recently sold their longtime Santa Monica townhouse and purchased a home in Mar Vista, they bring firsthand insight into today’s buying and selling experience.

Giving back is at the heart of what they do. Their award-winning community care programs have supported environmental initiatives at Westside schools and promoted neighborhood earthquake preparedness. The family business has also grown with the addition of their daughter, Emily, who brings fresh market insights and expertise in print and social media marketing.

Together, Mimi, Jon, and Emily craft custom marketing plans for every listing, leveraging print, social, and digital platforms to generate thousands of qualified views. They are hands-on in every transaction and go above and beyond to ensure their clients don’t just meet their real estate goals—they exceed them. For the Torp Team, the lasting relationships and friendships they build are the most rewarding part of their work.

agents.bio:
As a top producing broker in the greater Houston area, service is my number one priority. When you are my client, my goal is to make you a client for life and make the process of buying or selling simpler and more enjoyable. I work tirelessly for my clients to reach THEIR goals whether that is garnering the highest dollar possible or a quick sale, finding their first home or their last … or finding that brick and mortar to start building their future business … or selling one they have outgrown- the client's needs always come first. When you choose me I work overtime to be sure that the myriad of issues that can arise during a transaction stay out of your purview and work behind the scenes to keep the road to closing as smooth as possible. 

The process begins before you ever put a home on market or start viewing new ones. It is a collegial process which involves setting the stage for both expectations and next steps. On the listing side, I develop a distinct and unique marketing strategy that includes a thorough competitive market analysis, assistance with staging, preparing the property for the market, top notch photographers, videographers, technological devices and outlets, and plans for presenting the property timely to the marketplace. In addition, I am adept at directed social media postings to ensure that your home is viewed by the most likely buyer for YOUR home. 

Buyers also require their own due diligence such as exploring commute times, neighborhood desires and needs, price limits, setting expectations for new construction as well as older existing homes. I develop an action plan for buyers so when they find that perfect home, they are armed with the necessary information and are prepared to act on it.

At the Craft Team, we work tirelessly to provide gold star service and meet clients’ needs before they are even aware that they have a need. As in any service industry the quality of the experience varies wildly by the provider and here at the Craft Team, we have a proven record to help you craft YOUR new beginning!

In December 2024, Bea and her team joined Compass Real Estate, a decision driven by the extensive marketing opportunities and advanced technology Compass offers. This move allows Luxe Living Group to enhance the already top-notch real estate experience they provide, giving clients access to cutting-edge tools and strategies that elevate every transaction.

Bea specializes in working with traditional buyers and sellers in Houston while carving out a niche in representing out-of-state institutional buyers across Texas cities like Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio. Her commitment to client education and transparent communication has earned her a loyal client base, with an impressive 85-90% of her business coming from repeat clients and referrals.

At Luxe Living Group, Bea ensures every client receives a luxurious and seamless experience, prioritizing meticulous attention to detail and comprehensive support to ensure success in every transaction.

Beyond her success as an agent, Bea is also a dedicated educator. For over nine years, she has been teaching real estate licensing courses, mentoring both agents and clients, and empowering them to navigate their real estate journeys with confidence.

Bea's outstanding achievements have earned her numerous accolades, including recognition among the Top 25 agents in Houston, a recent ranking among the Top 5 agents by production in the Houston Business Journal, and being featured in national publications such as Top Agent Magazine. She also served as President of the Women's Council of Realtors - Bay Area, Houston Chapter in 2013, further demonstrating her commitment to leadership and the advancement of the real estate profession.

With a foundation built on integrity, expertise, and an unwavering commitment to client satisfaction, Bea Flores and her team at Luxe Living Group, now proudly partnered with Compass, are dedicated to providing personalized, seamless real estate experiences that exceed expectations.

Dennis Maynard CCIM CAPM brings over two decades of real estate expertise to his role as Director of Multifamily and Leasing at Aria Properties, a premier luxury real estate firm based in Los Angeles. With a proven track record of brokering, partnering, and consulting on over $130 million in commercial real estate transactions and developing projects with a cumulative net value of $400 million, Dennis is a seasoned leader in the industry. His extensive experience spans multifamily, hospitality, retail, and mixed-use projects, with notable contributions to landmark developments such as Ace Hotel Downtown Los Angeles, NoMad Hotel Los Angeles, and Soho Warehouse Los Angeles.
At Aria Properties, Dennis spearheads multifamily and leasing strategies, leveraging his deep market knowledge and strategic insight to deliver exceptional value to clients. His areas of expertise include stakeholder management, site selection and feasibility, contract sales and negotiation, market research and analysis, development design and planning, budget development and execution, and financial forecasting. Dennis excels at building strong professional relationships, ensuring seamless transactions and client satisfaction, aligning perfectly with Aria Properties’ commitment to a team-driven, client-focused approach.
A California Real Estate Broker since 2013, Dennis holds a Bachelor’s Degree in Interdisciplinary Studies with concentrations in Business and Project Management from Arizona State University, graduating Summa Cum Laude. He is a Certified Commercial Investment Member (CCIM) Designee, with additional certifications in Advanced Study in Commercial Real Estate Development (NAIOP), Certified Associate in Project Management (PMI), and Certified Scrum Master (Scrum Alliance). His technical proficiency includes advanced skills in MS Office and Adobe Presentations, enabling precise financial forecasting and compelling project presentations.
In addition to his role at Aria Properties, Dennis leads Maynard Capital Group, a separate venture focused on acquiring and managing cash-flowing multifamily properties nationwide, emphasizing capital protection and consistent returns for investors. His strategic vision and disciplined approach to real estate investment enhance his ability to guide Aria Properties’ clients through complex multifamily investment opportunities and leasing processes in high-demand markets like Beverly Hills, Studio City, Santa Monica, Los Angeles, Malibu, and Marina Del Rey.
Born in Texas and raised in the South, Dennis is passionate about swimming, outdoor activities, photography, travel, and cheering for the Los Angeles Dodgers. His dedication to excellence and client success makes him an invaluable asset to Aria Properties, where he continues to drive innovative real estate solutions with a personal touch.

agents.bio:
From an early age, Rhonda had a passion for helping others. Growing up in a Real Estate family, this business became the perfect platform for her to pursue her passion today. Rhonda's commitment to assisting others became the driving force and backbone of her day-to-day interactions. Real Estate provided her with an ideal platform to showcase her niche for staging homes and assisting others with interior design. Despite her serious level of professionalism, Rhonda was known to be a bit quirky and always open to the funny side of life.
Over almost 30 years of living in the Energy Corridor, the area had been Rhonda's home for her and her family. She raised two girls, worked, volunteered, and built an amazing network of lifelong friends there. From coaching softball at Memorial Ashford Little League to exploring numerous restaurants in the area, Rhonda could certainly give pointers about the locality. She possessed intimate knowledge of the Energy Corridor's evolution and resilience, always amazed by its ability to maintain a small-town feel in a big city. While Rhonda specialized in her beloved area, she also saw success in many other neighborhoods throughout the Houston area.
Rhonda's passion was not just helping people lease, buy, or sell a home, but also making the process as seamless and stress-free as possible for them. She accomplished this by adopting a proactive approach, staying one step ahead, and anticipating potential roadblocks. Rhonda viewed her client relationships as partnerships, recognizing the need for collective effort toward a common goal. With an elevated level of integrity and a commitment to communication, she walked her clients through the process, ensuring they had some fun along the way.
She took pride in her successful, full-time Real Estate career, attributing it to a durable base of loyal and repeat clients who had now become her friends. Rhonda, known as "Rhonda the Realtor," truly embodied the essence of "Keeping the Real In Real Estate."

remarks: Located in the historic Woodland Heights district, this classic Craftsman home blends timeless charm with modern comfort. The meticulously designed kitchen features a large island, abundant storage, beautiful countertops, and stainless-steel appliances. A first-floor primary suite offers convenience and privacy, with an additional nearby bedroom ideal for a home office or nursery. Upstairs, you’ll find two additional bedrooms and a full bath. Enjoy beautifully landscaped front and back yards, plus an oversized two-car garage. Above the garage is a 584 sq ft one-bedroom, one-bath apartment with vaulted ceiling and a private deck—perfect for guests or rental income. A truly special home in one of the Heights’ most beloved neighborhoods. Zoned to Travis Elementary.

agents.bio:
Rae Lynn White is a Houston native and seasoned REALTOR® with 25 years of experience, consistently recognized as a top-producing agent. Part Realtor, Part Matchmaker, she’s known for connecting people with homes that truly fit their lifestyle. Now with Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Premier Properties, Rae Lynn combines deep local knowledge with a modern, client-focused approach to help buyers and sellers navigate Houston real estate with confidence.

Living inside the Loop since 1992, Rae Lynn has an insider’s understanding of Houston’s historic neighborhoods and diverse housing stock. A true old-home enthusiast, she brings both market savvy and a genuine appreciation for architecture, character, and craftsmanship. Her clients value her integrity, work ethic, and hands-on service—and often become friends and neighbors along the way.

With multiple home renovations behind her, Rae Lynn offers more than guidance—she offers perspective, helping clients buy and sell homes with a sharp eye for potential and real-world experience.

When she’s not working, Rae Lynn enjoys unplugging with her spouse and young daughter, creating memories and recharging at their German farmhouse in La Grange.

For me, real estate has always been about people first.

I'm a Houston native, Broker Associate, and founder of Finch Properties Group. For nearly two decades, I've had the privilege of helping more than 800 of families buy, sell, and invest in homes across Houston. Along the way, I've learned that every move represents something much bigger than a transaction—it's the start of a new chapter.

Finding the right place to call home is personal to me because it's where my own story is unfolding. My husband and I are raising our family in Wilchester, one of Houston's beloved Memorial neighborhoods, with firsthand knowledge of what makes this community such a special place to live. From neighborhood traditions and local schools to market trends that vary street by street, I bring both professional expertise and the perspective of someone who proudly calls this area home.

While my team serves clients throughout the Houston area, my deepest local expertise is in Memorial and the surrounding communities. Whether you're relocating to Houston, moving within the neighborhood, or preparing to sell a home you've loved for years, my goal is to help you make confident decisions with thoughtful guidance every step of the way.

Clients often tell me they appreciate my honest communication, strategic advice, and calm approach during what can sometimes be an emotional process. I believe great real estate is equal parts market knowledge, negotiation, marketing, and genuinely caring about the people on the other side of the transaction.

Today, Finch Properties Group continues to be recognized among Houston's top-performing real estate teams. I'm a Certified Negotiation Expert (CNE), an active real estate investor and landlord, and a graduate of The University of Texas at Austin with a degree in Communication and extensive coursework in advertising. Our team has been recognized among Houston's top real estate professionals, including honors from the Houston Business Journal Top 25, RealTrends Top 100, and REALTOR® Magazine 30 under 30.

More than anything, I hope my clients remember how they felt working with us—heard, cared for, and confident that someone was advocating for their best interests.

Whether you're buying your very first home, moving up for your growing family, downsizing, or investing for the future, I'd be honored to help you navigate what's next.

agents.bio:
Trey Poteet is a Houston-based real estate agent who specializes in helping individuals and families relocate to the Houston area. As a native Houstonian, Trey provides relocating buyers with local insight, clear guidance, and a streamlined approach to navigating one of the largest and most diverse real estate markets in the country.

Houston’s size and variety can be challenging for those moving from out of state or transferring within Texas. Trey helps relocation buyers understand neighborhood differences, commute patterns, school districts, housing styles, and pricing trends across Houston and its surrounding communities. His goal is to help clients quickly narrow their options and make confident, well-informed decisions.

Trey works with corporate relocations, remote professionals, and families moving to Houston for career opportunities, lifestyle changes, or long-term investment. He takes a consultative approach, focusing on education, realistic expectations, and strong negotiation to protect his clients’ interests throughout the buying process.

In addition to relocation buyers, Trey assists sellers and local buyers across the Houston metro area. Sellers benefit from strategic pricing, professional marketing, and data-driven exposure designed to maximize value and reduce time on market.

Known for his responsiveness and clear communication, Trey partners with a trusted network of lenders, inspectors, and service providers to help ensure smooth, efficient transactions—especially important for clients coordinating moves from outside the area.

Whether you are relocating to Houston, purchasing a primary residence, or investing in real estate, Trey Poteet offers professional representation and local expertise you can rely on.

Whether working with first-time buyers, luxury homeowners, or investors, Michelle’s dedication to loyalty, trust, and informed decision-making has helped close dozens of transactions while exceeding client expectations.

agents.bio:
In January 2024, Angelina celebrated her 20th year in real estate!  Her journey began unexpectedly in 2004 when she inherited several rental properties after her mother's passing, becoming what she humorously calls an "unintentional landlord." Dissatisfied with the service provided by leasing agents, Angelina decided to take matters into her own hands and started taking real estate classes. By January 2006, she was a licensed Realtor with plans to only manage her rental properties but her warm demeanor and charisma propelled her to leave her full-time sales job and focus on real estate full time.  “I can’t believe it's been 20 years”, she admits, “and I have seen it all but it is still something new every day!”

Angelina reminds us it's still a “seller's market” in our area even with elevated mortgage rates.  She explains “With higher costs to rent, many renters have decided to buy instead of rent and build equity and in doing so they protect themselves from being priced out of the market in the future.  Other buyers have decided it is better to buy now with a higher interest rate but with today’s sales price instead of overpaying for a home later due to increased buyer competition in the summer months or when rates drop.” Angelina adds,  “There are even lenders that are offering no-cost refinances later when you use them as your lender now”. 

Angelina recommends that sellers consider listing their homes sooner rather than later if it makes sense. She explains that each situation is different but sellers may have fewer competing listings right now if they list before the summer.  Angelina declares “Early spring buyers are motivated buyers!” Sellers and buyers both need a Realtor with decades of wisdom and insight to formulate the best game plan. 

Along with her Broker’s license, attained in 2016, Angelina offers her clients ingenuity, diligence, and the wisdom that comes with almost 400 successful transactions. She skillfully navigates the most complex transactions such as relocation, divorce, and probate.  Drawing from her bachelor’s degree in psychology and background in sales, she caters to her client's unique needs.  Remaining abreast of evolving trends and technology, Angelina is a member of HAR.com’s  MLS Advisory Committee which underscores her dedication to enhancing industry standards for the benefit of agents and consumers alike. 

Beyond real estate, Angelina loves volunteering, supporting her children's activities, and planning fun activities for her friends and clients. Recognized for her numerous community contributions, she received the SBISD 2023 Good Neighbor Award.

Featuring a beautifully updated multi-family layout with a 2-bedroom, 2-bath front home(3343 Roseveiw Ave, 1,339 sq ft) and a 2-bedroom, 1-bath rear unit (3345 Roseview Ave 725 sq ft)—perfect for comfortable living and versatile income potential.
