agents.bio:
William and Thuy Shipman moved to the Houston area in 1982 and have watched the area grow and emerge as one of the most thriving regions in the country! In fact, the Shipmans live in the same Cypress neighborhood that they grew up in! Their appreciation for Cypress and the Houston area stems from its diverse housing options that accommodate a wide range of families, an abundance of recreation opportunities, the people, and unmatched entertainment options. 

Over the last 30 years, they have enjoyed witnessing the continual developments that have made Cypress what it is today! As a real estate team, their goal is to introduce their buyers to an area where they feel this same connection with, and facilitate the selling process for sellers so that they can begin the next chapter of their lives in the home that best suits their needs. 

Prior to real estate, Thuy earned her Bachelor’s degree in Finance and worked as an accountant in the oil and gas field for years, as well as a loan originator and cash accountant for a mortgage company, and later, a cash accountant for a property management company. Her experience gives her a unique insight into the closing process that is unmatched by many. William’s wide scope of experience further enhances each transaction, as well. From helping home builders in his Cypress neighborhood and working in Data, to his experience in automobile sales and owning his own home theatre and automation company, William’s extensive expertise has proven beneficial to the team’s buyers and sellers. Their knowledge, skills, passion for real estate, and experience leasing out their own investment properties led William and Thuy to pursue a career in real estate! 

Determined, driven, self-starters, knowledgeable, personable, and helpful are just a few examples that define the Shipman team. After all, Thuy’s father brought her to America so that she could have a better life, and as a result, she capitalizes on every opportunity that presents itself not only to provide a better life for her family, but also for her clients. They place a great emphasis on communication, whether helping the client price their home, briefing them on the current market or trends, disclosing every detail about a property or neighborhood, or listening to their client’s needs and wants, William and Thuy’s commitment to communication never falters. 

In addition, their diligent work ethic and impressive negotiating skills produce optimal results that are in their client’s best interest. Plus, as residents of the community since 1982, they possess in-depth knowledge about the region and its accommodations.

Aside from their personality characteristics that attribute to their success, Thuy and William’s affiliation with Connect Realty further enhances each transaction. With the most innovative technology and tools in the industry, they have access to unparalleled resources that maximize their effectiveness and efficiency. Plus, Connect Realty’s premier training and support have equipped them with the essential knowledge, skills, and tools to overcome any obstacle that may arise throughout the transaction and deliver the most favorable results. 

When not diligently helping their clients, Thuy enjoys running, skating, attending her children’s events and activities, and spending time with her family. In addition, she owns a jewelry business and sells her jewelry online and at tradeshows. A sports enthusiast, William can be found golfing, shooting, fishing, or playing pool, when he is not spending time with his children.

He even manages his own portfolio of fourteen homes that he leases in the Greater Houston market – which makes him notably qualified to work with investors on all levels. When it comes to selling, Todd is the go-to guy.

Todd’s marketing savvy, presence on social media, and knowledge of what moves property sets him apart from others. Sellers can be sure Todd will get the job done. He even has a flair for interior design and staging, so clients can rely on him to make their home showroom ready. In his spare time, Todd enjoys spending time with his teenage son and three dogs, volunteering for animal rescue groups, and developing his own investment portfolio. 

Real estate truly is his passion, and he prides himself on being “hyper-responsive to client needs.” Todd Russo is eager to work with buyers, sellers, and investors in the Greater Houston area.

Licensed by the Texas Real Estate Commission, Fal Gandhi is a member of the National Association of Realtors, Texas Association of Realtors, and Houston Association of Realtors.

Brooks Ballard is a seasoned real estate visionary and the driving force behind Brooks Ballard International Real Estate. With over 25 years of experience in the luxury real estate market, Brooks is recognized for delivering world-class service, market expertise, and results-driven strategies to discerning clients across Houston, Texas, and globally.

As a trusted name in luxury real estate, Brooks has built his reputation on integrity, innovation, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. He has successfully represented high-profile buyers, sellers, investors, and developers in some of the most prestigious neighborhoods, including River Oaks, Memorial, The Heights, West University, and Tanglewood.

Brooks’ firm is more than a brokerage—it’s a concierge-style real estate experience. His team specializes in luxury listings, international marketing, relocation services, new construction, and high-end property management. With a global network and a deep understanding of both local and international markets, Brooks delivers personalized strategies that help clients maximize their investments and lifestyle goals.

As a former affiliate of Engel & Völkers, Brooks brings European sophistication and global marketing reach combined with Texas-sized hospitality. Whether you're buying your dream home, selling a signature estate, or exploring investment opportunities, Brooks Ballard International Real Estate offers a seamless and strategic approach backed by unparalleled service and discretion.

My name is Jeffery Huynh and I'm a Real Estate Advisor with Brooks Ballard International Real Estate. I'm from Fort Worth and have lived in Houston for 18 years. My husband and I have always lived in the Southwest side and are very familiar with the area. I was in leasing and property management for four years before making the leap into Real Estate. My entire adult life has been focused around helping people in some form or fashion. My focus for my real estate clients is educating them on the home buying process. When Paul and I bought our home, our agent didn't really help us after we had a signed contract. We went to all the inspections on our new build by ourselves, did our own negotiating and even attended our closing by ourselves. We could only hope we were doing everything correctly. As a real estate advisor my job is to provide a smooth and sorrow-free home buying or selling experience without the fear, stress and concerns I had to go through. This is the core reason I'm in this business. Please consider me if you are looking to buy, sell, lease, or invest in Houston!

Evan Compean is the founder of The Compean Group, a boutique Houston real estate team known for data-driven pricing, high-end marketing and skilled negotiation. A licensed agent since 2012 and a real estate investor since 2002, Evan has sold more than $250 million in real estate and brings a builder's and investor's eye to every home, from foundation and roof to resale value.

Areas: Houston Heights, Woodland Heights, Garden Oaks/Oak Forest, Montrose, Midtown, West University, Bellaire, Spring Branch, Pearland, Katy, Cypress and The Woodlands.

Specialties: Luxury and new construction, investment and multifamily properties, land, first-time buyers, and relocation.

Evan is also a licensed loan officer and a partner at Smart Title, so clients get guidance on financing and closing from someone who knows every step. Se habla español. With 400+ five-star reviews across Zillow, Google, Yelp and Realtor.com, The Compean Group focuses on clear communication and a smooth process from first call to closing.

remarks: Experience unparalleled luxury in this one-of-a-kind Summer Lake Ranch estate. Spanning over 0.6 acres, this 5,426 sq ft executive residence is a masterclass in scale and sophisticated technology. The grand two-story entry leads to a floor plan designed for both privacy and grand-scale entertaining, featuring 5 bedrooms, 3.5+ baths, a private study, and an expansive game room. agents.bio: Shane O’Neill is the Principal Broker/Owner of SOS Realty in Houston, TX. With 12+ years of real estate sales experience, Shane has proven the “Service Over Sales” approach is one of the fundamental keys to his success. His experience in the real estate business has also afforded him the opportunity to acquire various off-market multi-family rental properties within the greater Houston metroplex over the past few years. Additionally, Shane and his wife Elizabeth are the proud owners of one of Houston’s top hair salons, Kaleido Hair, which currently employs over 15 hair artists across two locations.

Enthusiastic about the client experience, Michael Ou also regards each relationship with utmost seriousness and attentiveness, pioneering a new genre of the industry defined by service, not sales. After earning his bachelors degree from The University Of Texas, Michael returned to his Houston roots and grew his real estate career.

Armed with data, instinct, and experience, he artfully provides buyers and sellers confidence in their investments, not just in the here and now, but throughout all of their moments to come. He speaks with a knowledgeable, approachable candor to engineer a better home ownership experience, mitigating the potential for mental exhaustion and misconceptions that often come with it. Meticulousness is in his DNA.

Collectively, Michael's authentic approach to advising and building relationships with others regularly results in them sending their friends and family his way, crafting a dynamic client demographic from all walks of life.

On his free time you can find Michael biking along Buffalo Bayou, at the park with his schnauzer, or checking out one of Houston's many fabulous restaurants.

agents.bio:
Over 18 years and hundreds of millions of dollars in Houston closings taught me one thing that never changes: the deal is won before anyone signs — in the prep, the pricing, and the negotiation. That's where I go to work for you.

I'm Le Nguyen, Broker and Owner of Go-M Realty, and I took the road less traveled to get here. I hold an accounting degree from UH-Downtown, so I read a contract the way few agents do — every number, every clause, every dollar that should stay in your pocket. Before real estate, I worked as a contractor for the U.S. Army in Kirkuk, Iraq, during the war as a purchaser, handling logistics, supplies and contracts. I also spent 16 years coaching competitive women's gymnastics — a sport where everything comes down to preparation, nerve, and executing when it counts. Those chapters shaped how I run a deal today. The numbers stay tight, and I don't flinch when the stakes climb.

When it's time to sell, I don't sit on a listing and hope. I market it hard — sharp pricing, strong presentation, and a strategy built to put your property in front of the right buyers fast. I'm a Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist and a Certified Negotiation Expert, but the part of my business I'm proudest of is the referrals. Most of my clients come from people I've worked with before — folks who trusted me enough to send me their family and friends. I don't take that lightly, and I've built my whole career on earning it.

When I'm not at the closing table, you'll find me in the gym, hunting down a new restaurant across town, planning my next trip, or getting talked back to by Lola, my parrot. When you're ready to make a move in Houston, I'd be proud to be your partner.

Raising a family of four in Houston, Joan learned early that the right home can be the heart and hub of a family. Joan’s entrepreneurial spirit continued and she started a boutique brokerage company. Her fresh set of eyes on Houston neighborhoods gives her the ability to recognize the possibilities in all corners of our city. Her success is driven by her philosophy of focusing on the quality of relationships over quantity. Her reputation of honest, active, informed and accountable representation has been the core of her relationship with clients. She continues to follow these core values and is honored to have loyal, repeat clients and referrals.

You will find her involved in the improvement of our parks and the expansion of recreational paths in the City. She has spent hours winding through the trails and parks of Houston and the surrounding areas which affords her a unique perspective on neighborhoods and maximizes her knowledge and expertise of the Bayou City. agents.bio:
Hello, my name is Elias Camhi, I am the President/Broker of ELDA Management Services.  I want to tell you a little bit about myself and how ELDA grew to become such an amazing company.

When I first moved to Houston from El Paso in 1992, I thought I hit the jackpot.  I saw a city that was full of excitement and more importantly, there were trees.  It was a city with potential to do anything and everything I wanted. 

I didn’t start in Property Management, but, in the IT world.  Worked for various companies from small to large, including Compaq and later HP.  I have done everything from testing equipment to writing programs that were utilized worldwide within HP. 

During that time, my wonderful wife and I decided to start investing in real estate, thanks to the outstanding books written by Robert Kiyosaki.  Soon we had a few properties, while our family and friends started doing the same and asking us to take care of theirs as well.  

After the HP merger with Compaq, job loss and migration of jobs to China & India  from one of the most beautiful campuses in Houston was beginning to take shape.  I managed to continue working because of the programs I had written required constant maintenance.  Needless to say, it would be a matter of time before I would be susceptible to losing my job.  So, I completed my Masters degree in business, while working and supporting my family. 

Shortly thereafter, I wrote the business plan to form a high tech property management company.  In January 2004, I launched ELDA Management Services.  I took a leap of faith and left HP to spend my full time growing ELDA.  We were the first company to have developed an interactive website where our owners would have access to their information right from the web.  We quickly grew from 1 property to 400+ properties.

We have always prided ourselves with providing phenomenal customer service to all of our clients and our tenants.  Today, we continue to implement technology into everything we do.  This helps us internally to be more efficient in managing your property, communicating with you and all of our tenants as well as efficiencies in expediting work orders and repairs.   We provide our tenants with their own portal, where they can login and see their balances, late fees and make payments against that.  They also have the capabilities of opening work orders right from their desktop.

As members of the National Association of Residential Property Managers with an RMP designation, I place myself in the top 10% of all property managers in the Nation.  And by partaking in the Texas Association of Realtors Property Management Committee, we not only learn from other property managers, but more importantly, we help shape the direction of property management through legislation and education to future property managers and leasing agents.

With over 8 years of experience in real estate and more than 15 years of sales and relocation experience, Myka is a true expert in the industry.

Myka is committed to ensuring that her clients' goals and satisfaction are always the top priority, and she firmly believes that profit should never come before client satisfaction. She works tirelessly to help buyers, sellers, investors, developers, and renters achieve their real estate goals, and her track record of success speaks for itself.

She is a skilled negotiator, and her attention to detail and commitment to quality service make her stand out in the industry.

Myka's dedication to her clients goes beyond just the transactional aspect of real estate. She believes in building strong relationships with her clients and serving as a trusted advisor throughout the buying, selling, or leasing process. Her clients appreciate her open and honest communication style and her willingness to go above and beyond to ensure their satisfaction.

Whether you're looking to buy or sell a home, invest in real estate, or find the perfect rental property, Myka has the knowledge and experience to help you achieve your goals. When she's not working, Myka enjoys spending time with her son and family and exploring all that the Sugar Land and Richmond areas have to offer. If you're looking for a Realtor who is dedicated to your success, look no further than Myka Sanders and Upscale Real Estate Services.

agents.bio:
Amandeep Singh is the visionary founder of Haus Houston, bringing over a decade of expertise in the real estate industry. He began his career by working closely with clients and investors, honing his skills in property transactions and strategic land acquisitions. His journey led him to the corporate world of commercial real estate brokerage, where he specialized in investment sales and earned recognition as one of the top 10 brokers by the Houston Business Journal.

However, Amandeep became increasingly disillusioned with the corporate approach to real estate, finding it impersonal and overly transactional. Driven by a desire to create a more client-focused and innovative experience, he made the bold decision to leave the corporate world and establish Haus Houston. Today, Haus Houston combines Amandeep’s entrepreneurial spirit and industry expertise with a passion for building exceptional properties. As both a builder and a full-service real estate and development company, Haus Houston delivers unparalleled value to clients, whether they are pursuing strategic investment opportunities or custom residential projects.

agents.bio: Alex decided to pursue a career in real estate in 2012 where he joined forces with his wife, Lisa to create a powerhouse team.  Alex came into the real estate industry after experiencing a successful career as a paralegal; helping homeowners with all aspects of real estate law from drafting deeds to loan modifications.  He immediately earned recognition from various asset management companies as a top tier market analyst.  With a firm understanding of big business and Houston’s ever changing market dynamics, Alex brings a refined and strategic approach when consulting with his clients. When Alex is not selling real estate, he is enjoying family time with his daughter Alessandra and his boxer Titan.  Alex is an avid tennis player and loves playing golf.  He has received the Houston Association of Realtors Top Producing Realtor reward multiple times and has earned several designations such as Certified Negotiation Expert, Certified Neighborhood Specialist and Seller Representative Specialist to name a few.

Michael got his initial taste of real estate in law school when he started a rental home company with one of his professors. The company provided housing to recovering addicts in collaboration with the organization Oxford House, Inc.

Michael began his career as a mergers and acquisition attorney, helping oil and gas clients through a wide range of transactions, and made the move to a real estate development company where he served as Associate General Counsel and Broker. There he had the privilege to work for a great mentor at a diverse company, where he honed his skills in completing both residential and commercial transactions and developments.

In 2017, Michael established FIG Real Estate, headquartered in the Houston Heights, in order to channel his zeal for his profession and community. He has assembled a unique team of Houston realtors focused on helping clients navigate the real estate process.

agents.bio:
I may not be related to former President Bush, but I can help you whether you want to buy a white house, a blue house, or a yellow house! I have lived in Atascocita for over 25 years and has two grown children and four beautiful granddaughters. I am very family oriented and believe that your home is one of the biggest investments you and your family will make. I would like to be there to help you find the perfect home and get the most money for your current home! My areas of expertise are Atascocita, Humble, Kingwood, Huffman, and Crosby, but I am willing and able to help you buy or sell your home anywhere in Houston and the surrounding areas. 

My husband (of 32 years) and I are experienced investors and currently own 39 rentals, both Airbnb, plus short- and long-term rentals. We began investing in 2007 and shortly after opened a Property Management company that my husband runs, Vestpro Residential Services. He manages both Residential and Commercial properties plus Specializes in Commercial Real Estate on top of being a Property Manager.   

I have been in Real Estate since 2004 and in my first full year as a Realtor, I was awarded Texas/Louisiana Rookie of the Year. Since then, I have received Multi-Million Dollar Top Producer awards for 20 years from 2005-2025. In 2011, I was selected by Houston Association of Realtors as one of the Top 20 under 40 agents in Houston. In 2012 I was one of the Top Listing Agents in HAR in 2011, 2012 & 2016. In 2014 I was #17 in Buyers Agents out of 25K Realtors in HAR for the entire year. 2019 I was a Dave Ramsey Endorsed Local Provider and 2021 Featured in Top 100 People in Real Estate. I am proud to say I have been a 12-year 5 Star Award winner in Texas Monthly Magazine. More recently, I was announced as Forbes Magazine Top Agents in Houston 2019-2025 and Fortune Magazine Top 500 From 2021-2025. I currently serve on the HAR Board for the Lake Houston Area. I contribute all my success to my great clients!

remarks: Set on one of Windsor Square's most iconic tree-lined streets, 257 S Van Ness is a classic California two-story home that offers elegance, scale, and endless potential. With over 3,600 square feet of living space, 5 bedrooms, and 3 bathrooms, the home delivers a perfect layout layout that feels both generous and effortless. Updated over the years and well maintained, the interiors are welcoming and thoughtfully configured. With a formal entry leading into a traditional living room and dining room, the home creates a natural flow for gatherings and quiet moments alike. There is also a bedroom, office, flex room and a full bath on the first floor. Upstairs, there is a primary suite as well as two additional large bedrooms that share a bath. A surprising 800+ square foot flat roof deck is over the family room, ideal for expansion or a rooftop retreat. Set on an over 10,000 square foot lot, the property offers a large, private yard and a detached garage ready for transformation into a guesthouse. Located in the Third Street School district, this is a home that blends comfort, location, and square footage just blocks from the best of Larchmont Village. Live beautifully as is, or bring your vision to life - this is the kind of home that rarely comes to market.

remarks: Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom residence in the heart of Westchester, where comfort and style come together in a beautifully curated living experience. Rich hardwood flooring flows seamlessly throughout, creating a sense of cohesion and timeless elegance, while a warm and inviting living room is anchored by a classic wood-burning fireplace, an ideal setting for both relaxation and gathering. The dining area integrates effortlessly into the home's layout and is enhanced by elegant French doors that invite natural light while offering a graceful transition to the outdoors. Just beyond, the kitchen is thoughtfully positioned to provide both functionality and ease, supporting everyday living as well as effortless entertaining. Step outside to a serene backyard retreat, where thoughtfully designed, drought-tolerant landscaping creates an environment that is both eco-conscious and tranquil. This private outdoor space is perfectly suited for al fresco dining, entertaining, or simply unwinding in a peaceful setting. The home's well-appointed bedrooms provide comfort and flexibility, including a spacious primary suite complete with its own ensuite bathroom, offering a true sense of privacy and retreat. Additional highlights include a detached garage that provides secure parking and presents a valuable opportunity for conversion into an accessory dwelling unit, ideal for extended living, guest accommodations, or potential rental income. With its functional layout, refined finishes, and prime Westchester location, this residence represents a rare opportunity to enjoy immediate comfort along with exceptional long-term potential in one of Los Angeles' most desirable neighborhoods.

remarks: Nestled in the highly sought-after North Kentwood neighborhood, this beautifully updated pool home blends timeless character with thoughtful modern upgrades. Offering 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms with single-level living, the home welcomes you with warmth, natural light, and refined finishes throughout. Step inside to discover newly refinished hardwood floors that flow seamlessly throughout the home, enhancing the bright, airy interiors. Classic architectural details such as coved archways and built-in shelving add charm and sophistication, while the open layout creates an effortless connection between living, dining, and entertaining spaces. Built-in speakers throughout the home create the perfect atmosphere for everyday living and entertaining. Ideally located near neighborhood favorites, including little Vons, shops, a yoga studio, and everyday conveniences, this N Kentwood gem offers comfort, style, and an exceptional Westchester lifestyle. The main house is 1,483 sq ft, and the converted garage is approximately 350 sq ft.

remarks: Nestled on a large, flat corner lot in the highly desirable Westport Heights, this 3-bedroom, 3-bath home offers exceptional privacy and thoughtful design. remarks: Presenting a beautifully designed home in the highly sought-after Kentwood neighborhood, where thoughtful architecture and comfortable California living come together. This five-bedroom, six-bath residence offers a clean traditional style with an easy indoor-outdoor flow and a layout designed for both everyday living and entertaining. A welcoming formal entry opens to soaring ceilings and a light-filled interior that carries throughout the home. The spacious great room connects seamlessly to the backyard as Fleetwood doors slide away, creating a natural extension of the living space onto a Trex deck with a pool, spa, and sunken fire pit, an ideal setting for relaxing or hosting gatherings. The backyard is private and well landscaped, featuring a built-in outdoor kitchen that makes outdoor dining and entertaining simple and enjoyable. Inside, the kitchen is both functional and stylish with shaker-style cabinetry, a large center island, and Thermador appliances, including a six-burner stove with griddle, double ovens, wine fridge, and beverage refrigerators, along with ample storage. The main level includes a generous office with a large closet and an additional bedroom with an en-suite bath, offering flexibility for guests or work-from-home needs. Upstairs, four en-suite bedrooms are complemented by a comfortable den and a conveniently located laundry room. The primary suite serves as a peaceful retreat with dual walk-in closets and a spacious bath featuring a soaking tub, large shower, dual vanities, and a private water closet. A two-car attached garage with EV charger and direct access adds everyday convenience, while the overall layout balances openness with privacy. A well-executed home in one of Kentwood's most desirable neighborhoods, offering space, comfort, and a setting that works just as well for quiet living as it does for entertaining.

remarks: Set at the coveted north end of Kentwood Bluffs Drive, 6592 Kentwood Bluffs Dr. rises above the rest with uninterrupted, panoramic vistas stretching from the Pacific Ocean to the Santa Monica Mountains and the city skyline beyond. This custom-remodeled, four-bedroom, three-bathroom Upper North Kentwood residence in Westchester offers an elevated living experience defined by sophistication, comfort, and striking natural beauty. Step through the two-story foyer into a formal living space bathed in natural light and seamlessly connected to the dining room, where sliding glass doors open to the backyard oasis. The adjacent renovated kitchen features white shaker cabinetry, a Thermador stainless-steel appliance suite including a wine refrigerator and effortless flow into the family room. Anchored by a gas fireplace, soaring two-story ceilings, and expansive panoramic glass doors, this central gathering area invites both inspiring indoor-outdoor entertaining and relaxed daily living. Outside, a custom outdoor kitchen equipped with a Twin Eagles BBQ sets the stage for unforgettable gatherings. The expansive backyard unfolds around a heated saltwater pool positioned at the edge of the property for maximum serenity and visual impact. A one-of-a-kind pool deck cover transforms the area into additional usable yard space when the pool is not in use. Glass railings frame the sweeping 180-degree views, while stamped concrete patios, lush turf, a built-in firepit lounge, and a cascading fountain create a resort-like setting. An outdoor speaker system, Solara louvered patio cover, and built-in heaters further elevate year-round enjoyment. Inside, the main-level bedroom offers versatility as an ideal home office or welcoming guest suite. Upstairs, the primary bedroom captures the same breathtaking views and features a gas fireplace and a spa-inspired ensuite bathroom with radiant heated floors and Caesarstone finishes. Two additional bedrooms and a well-appointed bathroom complete this comfortable and inviting upper level. Thoughtful custom upgrades including updated electrical, new flooring, a whole-home water softener and filtration system, Pella windows, and more underscore the property's exceptional quality. Elegant, rare, and meticulously enhanced, this extraordinary home stands as one of North Kentwood's finest opportunities.

Her Process Includes:

- Helping clients define and align their vision, goals, and budget

- Leading a high-performing team to deliver seamless service

Local, Loyal, and Living Here...

Stephanie lives in Westchester with her husband—a playwright and LMU professor—and their two children. A Southern California native, Ron Melendez has lived all over the Los Angeles area. Growing up in the San Gabriel Valley, he would head over to the beaches of Orange County to surf. After moving to Westwood to attend U.C.L.A., Ron has lived in Santa Monica, the Valley, and West Hollywood, before finally settling with his family in the South Bay. They now live in Manhattan Beach’s Tree Section where his daughters attend American Martyrs School.

Ron believes in real estate done right. And he believes that the most important way to do that is to listen to really hear what the client wants and needs, and to put all other concerns aside in pursuit of that. Ron knows how important your decision to buy or sell a property is. After 30 years working as an actor working in both TV and Film, Ron has brought that passion to real estate. He loves helping people find the perfect place to call home or helping someone get the best price for their property so that they can achieve their dreams. He believes that this job is all about service. At the end of the day, he wants to look back and know that he always did right by his clients.

Amy Wallner is committed to making the real estate process a five-star experience for her clients. This self-described people person provides concierge service that begins with her ability to quickly and thoroughly understand the wants and needs of her home buyers, sellers, and leasers. She is adept at guiding her clients to properties that fit well with their objectives, negotiating the best prices and repairs, and relieving their stress through the completion of their transactions. 

For Amy, Real Estate is a family affair. Her mother is a manager with Gary Greene and has been in the industry for close to 30 years. Her sister is also a licensed realtor. Amy's passion for people and desire to help individuals and families make important home decisions, as well as her family's track record, made real estate an easy choice. Before becoming a realtor, Amy was a television reporter for CBS and ABC affiliates where she interviewed people from all walks of life, including local, state, national, and political leaders. She excelled in marketing and sales in the medical and steel industries and managed countless volunteers and helped raise thousands of dollars in the nonprofit arena. Amy's experience increased her knowledge of Houston and taught her the value of staying educated about the market. 

Amy is a native Houstonian and graduated with a Bachelor of Arts degree in Communications and a minor in Classics from Texas A&M University. She and her husband Jeremy have two dogs. When she is not eagerly serving her real estate clients, Amy is enthusiastically volunteering in the community. A past chairperson for the Susan G. Komen Run for a Reason program and media relations specialist for the Chevron Houston Marathon, she is currently a member of VICTORY, a volunteer organization for the American Cancer Society, and serves on a committee for the Leukemia & Lymphoma Society. Amy was a 2019 candidate for Woman of the Year for the Leukemia & Lymphoma Society, where she raised $50,000 in 10 weeks.

agents.bio:
Kasteena Parikh is a results-driven, success-oriented, top 1% producing Houston residential broker who helps clients strategically buy and sell residential real estate throughout West University Place and surrounding areas. She has been a top-producing agent since 2007 and is currently ranked the #15 luxury agent in Houston by the Houston Business Journal - 2022. She is ranked #2 for West University Place based on 2021 sales volume. A lifelong resident of Houston, Kasteena's acute understanding of the local West University Place market, coupled with her exceptional knowledge of the surrounding areas - River Oaks, Southampton, Braes Heights, and Bellaire has made her the broker of choice for home buyers and sellers.

The combination of Kasteena's pre-listing services, strategic pricing, exceptional marketing program, and elevated photography and video content are essential parts of her consistently successful sales. Her comprehensive pre-listing plans for design, renovation and staging are implemented in every home that she lists. Kasteena's extensive experience in design and renovation makes her uniquely qualified to advise her clients on the best investment decisions regarding which home to purchase, when to sell, and what improvements to make before selling to dramatically maximize a property’s resale value.

Raised in Houston, Kasteena graduated with a double major in Human Resources Management and Marketing. She was a Human Resources executive for Citigroup and American International Group prior to real estate. She also worked at the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission in the Mickey Leland Federal Building. She brings a proven, unique skill set to the market including advanced negotiation expertise, unmatched attention to detail, and a steadfast commitment to her clients. Kasteena and her family have resided in West University Place since 1999. She has a son at Strake Jesuit and a daughter at St. Agnes. She is also involved with The Children's Assessment Center, Giveback Homes, the University of Houston's Housing Board, and the Houston Area Women's Center.

Find Your Next Home

Sell a Home

agents.bio: I am a native Houstonian and familiar with its ever-changing market conditions. I began my career out of college as an engineer in the oil and gas industry. I later discovered my real passion is real estate. Real estate has allowed me to use my natural talents (listening, empathizing, communicating, and applying competence) to the favorable benefit of many others. My engineering background enables me to provide the attention to detail and scrutiny real estate transactions require.  The Romar Team later evolved to provide improved efficiency and service to our clients. Together we provide over 30 years of experience in real estate. Our specialized marketing plan and work systems allow us to provide premium services to our clients during and long past the transaction's completion. We never go away. My team and I remain students in the industry and continue to seek ways to improve and grow.  Most of our business is by referral from clients who have enjoyed a trustworthy, competent, and professional service, who, in turn, want the same for their friends, family, and co-workers. Earning and maintaining their trust is paramount. We earnestly seek to provide our clients with a "great experience," not just great customer service. After all, we are "Your Castle Keys Connector."

Binky Watkins is more than just a name in Houston’s luxury residential real estate scene. Originally from Minnesota, she’s embraced the essence of the Greater Houston Area since her teenage years. Binky’s diverse journey, from insurance agent to senior sales director, with a 12-year Middle East stint, uniquely informs her relocation expertise. She has called various places across the greater Houston area her home, all the way to College Station. Venturing into real estate inspired by a close friend and seasoned real estate agent, she brings her zeal for challenges, an undying passion to help others find their dream homes, and an acute sense for the art of the deal.

Binky fluently communicates in English and is on a quest to master Spanish, further broadening her reach. What truly sets her apart, however, is her extensive international exposure. Having relocated almost a dozen times in her life, she’s not just familiar with the nuances of real estate but is a seasoned guide in navigating the emotional and logistical intricacies of moving. To Binky, Houston is a vibrant tapestry of diverse cultures that captivates her with its wide array of attractions, encompassing everything from sports and culinary offerings to its culturally rich festival scene.

Away from the hustle of property deals and viewings, Binky spends her time with her daughters and her grandchildren. Her unwavering philosophy, whether as a mother, grandmother, or a committed real estate agent, is to treat everyone as family.

remarks: 1038 Timbergrove Yards is a rare gem in gated community just minutes from The Heights. A standout feature is the first-floor suite with private entrance, kitchenette, and washer/dryer—ideal for a roommate, in-law suite, or potential Xtra Airbnb income. This 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath home features high ceilings, wood floors throughout, and an open-concept living space filled with natural light. The kitchen offers quartz countertops, SS appliances, a large eat-in island, and abundant storage. The primary suite includes two walk-in closets and a spa-like bath with double vanities, soaking tub, and walk-in shower. Secondary bedrooms each have ensuite baths. Located along a lush courtyard with two dog parks and ample guest parking. Walkable to future mixed-use development The Grove At West Heights! Nearby restaurants, fitness studios, bike trails, and pickleball courts with quick access to 610, I-10, Downtown, the Galleria, and Memorial Park. agents.bio:
A third-generation Houstonian and University of Houston alum, Vincent Biondillo combines deep local knowledge with almost 20 years of real estate experience to help clients buy and sell homes with confidence. As co-founder of Norhill Realty—ranked #12 on the Cougar 100 in 2019—Vincent specializes in Houston’s Inner Loop neighborhoods and is passionate about connecting people to the city’s diverse culture and lifestyle.

With a background in marketing and mortgage lending, Vincent brings a well-rounded, client-first approach to every transaction. He’s a Certified Negotiation Expert (CNE) known for responsive service, honest advice, and smooth, stress-free closings.

Outside of real estate, Vincent stays active in the community through the SPJST Lodge and UH Bauer Alumni Association. He enjoys time with his wife and son, cheering on UH athletics, and competing in local BBQ cookoffs.

If you’re thinking about making a move—or just want to know if that Zestimate is lying to you—let’s talk. Happy to help, no pressure.

Enthusiastic about the client experience, Michael Ou also regards each relationship with utmost seriousness and attentiveness, pioneering a new genre of the industry defined by service, not sales. After earning his bachelors degree from The University Of Texas, Michael returned to his Houston roots and grew his real estate career.

Armed with data, instinct, and experience, he artfully provides buyers and sellers confidence in their investments, not just in the here and now, but throughout all of their moments to come. He speaks with a knowledgeable, approachable candor to engineer a better home ownership experience, mitigating the potential for mental exhaustion and misconceptions that often come with it. Meticulousness is in his DNA.

Collectively, Michael's authentic approach to advising and building relationships with others regularly results in them sending their friends and family his way, crafting a dynamic client demographic from all walks of life.

On his free time you can find Michael biking along Buffalo Bayou, at the park with his schnauzer, or checking out one of Houston's many fabulous restaurants.

remarks: Experience modern farmhouse living in this newly built 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home tucked into the growing Houston Gardens neighborhood. Designed with comfort and simplicity in mind, this home blends clean, timeless style with the benefits of new construction—just minutes from the $1.6B LBJ Hospital expansion, offering strong long-term potential. Inside, vinyl flooring flows throughout a bright, open-concept layout filled with natural light. The kitchen opens seamlessly into the living area, creating an inviting space for everyday living and effortless entertaining. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite serves as a private retreat with a walk-in closet and a sleek ensuite bath. Outside, a large backyard offers room to gather, garden, or relax in your own outdoor space. With no HOA, easy freeway access, and close proximity to Downtown, this home delivers modern farmhouse charm, flexibility, and value—without the new-construction premium.

A native Houstonian and resident for over 30 years, David absolutely loves his hometown. He enjoys working with buyers, sellers, and those looking to lease or invest in the local market. Having lived in Montrose, Houston Heights, Downtown, and EaDo throughout various stages of his life has afforded him an intimate knowledge of Houston's inner-loop neighborhoods.
Currently, David calls the Near Northside, adjacent to the Houston Heights, home. He enjoys helping clients throughout all areas of Houston. A successful healthcare administrator and small business manager for over ten years in his previous career, David finds it most rewarding to work with clients relocating to Houston as well as first time homebuyers. He holds an MBA from Texas Woman's University and an undergraduate degree in Healthcare Administration from the University of Houston Clear Lake.

remarks: Renovated by acclaimed local builder Cason Graye, this exceptional single-story ranch sits on a sprawling corner lot in the heart of Meyerland. The showcase home offers more than 30 original builder’s piers & features both a front circle drive & double-wide driveway along Moonlight Drive for abundant parking. The interior is light & inviting, showcasing an open-concept chef’s kitchen, breakfast area, den with cozy fireplace & separate formal living & dining spaces. The primary suite includes a sitting area with private access to the back patio. Secondary bedrooms are generously sized & share a large hall bath with dual sinks. Convenient guest full bath is located at the rear of the home alongside an oversized, highly functional utility room. A whole-home generator is discreetly positioned behind the oversized two-car garage. Expansive & private backyard is lush with mature landscaping. Zoned to award-winning Bellaire High, Meyerland Middle & Lovett Elementary. Call for a private tour.

agents.bio:
As a 5th generation Houstonian, I have a deep appreciation for this city and its people. This is an exciting time to live in the Greater Houston Area, and I'm proud to be a part of it all! I've been licensed for 10 plus years and have successfully closed over 500 transactions since 2010. Although I live and work in Bellaire, I proudly serve the entire Houston market and will continue to provide exceptional service for each of my clients and my community as a whole. As your Real Estate Specialist, I promise to be your trusted resource for answers about the process of buying or selling. I will provide expertise about neighborhood features and schools and will target your home search based on your individual needs and wants. My custom innovative marketing strategies along with my strong negotiation skills are the keys to your successful transaction.

As an agent who's an expert in this local area, I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise about buying and selling real estate here. It's not the same everywhere, so you need someone you can trust for up-to-date information. I am eager to serve you. Here are some of the things I can do for you. Do you need someone who knows this area inside and out? I can work with you to find the right home at the right price for you, including all the neighborhood amenities that matter - not to mention the essential criteria you have for your ideal home. When it's time to move, you need someone who will advertise your home, show it to prospective buyers, negotiate the purchase contract, arrange to finance, oversee the inspections, handle all necessary paperwork and supervise the closing. I can take care of everything you need, from start to close. Oftentimes buyers don't visualize living in your home the way you do. I can make your home attractive to its ideal audience which can help you get top dollar. Things like staging the home, making repairs or minor improvements, or even simply painting the walls can be the difference between a home resting on the market and one that's sold fast.

remarks:
THIS HOUSE WAS MADE FOR LIVING. From Thanksgiving dinner in the spacious dining room to the movie nights by the fireplace and friendly competitions in the huge game room, there is room for everyone to gather..or spread out. With 3 living areas, everyone can have their own space without feeling far apart.The downstairs primary suite features a beautifully remodeled bath, while the upstairs offers spacious secondary bedrooms, including one with its own private bath. Enjoy morning coffee or weekend cookouts on the covered patio, then take advantage of the neighborhood walking trails, parks, and nearby schools. Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in established Barker's Ridge, this home offers more than 3,000 square feet at a price that is hard to beat.The hardest decision may be where to put the Christmas tree..because this homes gives you great choices.
Roof was replaced in 2021 and many other updgrades that you will love. Home has never flooded. Low HOA and low taxes.

agents.bio: As a seasoned real estate broker in the greater Houston area since 2003, Thomas L. Saunders offers unparalleled expertise and deep local connections. "Today's real estate transactions are anything but average, and people demand a level of service that matches their complexity," says Saunders, a lifelong Houstonian. He emphasizes the importance of a REALTOR® who is well-prepared to handle issues like seller liability and evolving laws. Early in his career, Saunders gained significant experience with acquisitions and liquidations at HomeVestors of America, and he has worked on REO liquidations with Trillionaire Assets and asset management with Jet Lending, LLC. Beyond his professional commitments, Saunders is dedicated to giving back, supporting Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals® and volunteering at local schools and the Fellowship of the Woodlands East Campus. His extensive background in commercial architecture, BPO evaluations, real estate investment, and REO sales ensures that clients receive top-notch service and expert advice in every transaction.

remarks: MIDTOWN - HEART OF HOUSTON LOCATION! Welcome to this beautifully maintained home located in the sought-after Empire Addition. agents.bio:
In January 2024, Angelina celebrated her 20th year in real estate!  Her journey began unexpectedly in 2004 when she inherited several rental properties after her mother's passing, becoming what she humorously calls an "unintentional landlord." Dissatisfied with the service provided by leasing agents, Angelina decided to take matters into her own hands and started taking real estate classes. By January 2006, she was a licensed Realtor with plans to only manage her rental properties but her warm demeanor and charisma propelled her to leave her full-time sales job and focus on real estate full time.  “I can’t believe it's been 20 years”, she admits, “and I have seen it all but it is still something new every day!”

Angelina reminds us it's still a “seller's market” in our area even with elevated mortgage rates.  She explains “With higher costs to rent, many renters have decided to buy instead of rent and build equity and in doing so they protect themselves from being priced out of the market in the future.  Other buyers have decided it is better to buy now with a higher interest rate but with today’s sales price instead of overpaying for a home later due to increased buyer competition in the summer months or when rates drop.” Angelina adds,  “There are even lenders that are offering no-cost refinances later when you use them as your lender now”. 

Angelina recommends that sellers consider listing their homes sooner rather than later if it makes sense. She explains that each situation is different but sellers may have fewer competing listings right now if they list before the summer.  Angelina declares “Early spring buyers are motivated buyers!” Sellers and buyers both need a Realtor with decades of wisdom and insight to formulate the best game plan. 

Along with her Broker’s license, attained in 2016, Angelina offers her clients ingenuity, diligence, and the wisdom that comes with almost 400 successful transactions. She skillfully navigates the most complex transactions such as relocation, divorce, and probate.  Drawing from her bachelor’s degree in psychology and background in sales, she caters to her client's unique needs.  Remaining abreast of evolving trends and technology, Angelina is a member of HAR.com’s  MLS Advisory Committee which underscores her dedication to enhancing industry standards for the benefit of agents and consumers alike. 

Beyond real estate, Angelina loves volunteering, supporting her children's activities, and planning fun activities for her friends and clients. Recognized for her numerous community contributions, she received the SBISD 2023 Good Neighbor Award.

remarks: Silver Lake VIEW Home -A Piece of Disney History! Since 1957 this residence served as the private sanctuary of Marc Davis, legendary Disney animator, and Alice Davis, renowned Disney costume designer--visionaries whose creative influence helped define the magic of The Walt Disney Company. Alongside Walt Disney, Marc brought to life some of the most enduring characters in Disney history--Tinker Bell, Cinderella, Maleficent, Cruella de Vil--Pirates of the Caribbean and countless beloved characters. Alice's artistry shaped the visual narrative of the 'It's a Small World,' and numerous characters, leaving an indelible mark on Disney history.The Davises acquired their Silver Lake home, at a time when the original Disney Studios were located just blocks away. In this setting inspiration, much of their celebrated work was imagined & brought to life within his home.Nestled in the coveted hills of Silver Lake, the unique residence is a true one-of-a-kind offering. The home's exterior is reminiscent of New Orleans' French Quarter. Inside, Marc designed custome bespoke interior details, including hand-crafted ornate metalwork & original artwork featured within the ceilings. Spanning approximately 2,136 square feet, the residence offers 2 beds & 2 baths, complemented by an expansive living room with built-in features, a formal dining room, inviting family room, large kitchen, sun-filled solarium. An upper-level dining deck extends the living space, capturing exceptional views by day and a sparkling hillside light display by night--a beautiful setting. A private elevator provides effortless flow between both levels, enhancing the home's livability. The lower bedroom level also reveals a generous entertainment room, where Marc's artistry is showcased in striking coffered wood ceilings--an exceptional focal point & true conversation piece. French doors open to a terraced outdoor oasis that transports you to the charm of the New Orleans French Quarter. Anchored by a grand fountain and surrounded by rich brickwork and multiple entertaining areas, this enchanting setting is ideal for al fresco dining or quiet relaxation. The home offers a rare flexibility--perfectly suited for a peaceful, private lifestyle or vibrant entertaining. This residence presents something undeniably rare. This is a place where history was made and the next chapter is ready to be written. Moments from Silver Lake's vibrant cafes, restaurants, boutiques, and dynamic cultural fabric of Los Angeles.

agents.bio:
Marcille Dilsaver Hughes is Principal Realtor® and Real Estate Strategist with The Dilsaver Group, a Pasadena-based real estate team serving buyers and sellers throughout Pasadena, Altadena, San Marino, South Pasadena, Sierra Madre, La Cañada Flintridge, Arcadia, Monrovia, the San Gabriel Valley, Greater Los Angeles, and Southern California.

Since 1975, The Dilsaver Group has built its business on relationships, reputation, market knowledge, and exceptional representation. Marcille brings a strategic, highly personal approach to real estate, understanding that every home, every client, and every decision comes with a different story, set of circumstances, and goal.

For sellers, Marcille believes successful representation begins well before a property reaches the market. Her approach includes thoughtful property preparation, strategic pricing and positioning, distinctive marketing, professional presentation, targeted digital exposure, direct agent-to-agent outreach, and skilled negotiation. Her goal is not simply to list a property, but to position it to achieve the strongest possible outcome while guiding her clients through every decision along the way.

For buyers, Marcille combines local market knowledge, careful property and value analysis, strategic offer preparation, negotiation, and hands-on guidance throughout the purchase process. Whether purchasing a first home, moving to a larger property, downsizing, relocating
or making a significant lifestyle change, clients receive a strategy designed around their individual needs and long-term goals.
Marcille's professional background also includes 30 years in leadership with Nordstrom, where an uncompromising commitment to service, relationships, communication, and attention to detail became foundational to the way she conducts business today.

Real estate is rarely just about a property. It can involve family, finances, timing, transition, opportunity, and important decisions about what comes next. Marcille approaches those decisions with care while bringing the strategy, market perspective, negotiation skills, and experience necessary to protect her clients' interests.

The Dilsaver Group also welcomes referrals from real estate professionals throughout the country. When another agent entrusts a client to Marcille, she understands the responsibility that comes with representing both that client and the relationship the referring agent has worked to build.

Depth | Relationships | Reputation.

Focused on People. Backed by Strategy. Powered by Purpose.

agents.bio:
Deborah’s impact extends far beyond the realm of real estate. With over 30 years of dedicated service as a full-time active Realtor running a team of successful agents, her influence is unmistakably felt. But what truly sets her apart is her deep-rooted commitment to her community.

Beyond the confines of real estate transactions, Deborah served 29 years as a volunteer firefighter in her city. 

Deborah's spirit of service is further illustrated by her involvement in a myriad of community outreach programs. Whether it's partnering with local organizations to uplift underserved neighborhoods or supporting initiatives that enhance the lives of those in the community she serves. Deborah consistently channels her energy towards making a positive impact where it's needed the most.

In times of crisis, Deborah's compassion and determination shine. Her volunteer work with Habitat for Humanity is a testament to her hands-on approach to rebuilding lives. Following the devastation of Hurricane Harvey, Deborah rolled up her sleeves to help rebuild homes, bringing hope and solace to those affected by the catastrophic flood. Her commitment to not just rebuilding structures, but restoring lives, echoes her profound understanding of the human element within every real estate transaction.

As a leader in the real estate industry, Deborah‘s involvement in community outreach programs, and dedication to post-disaster rebuilding are not just separate chapters in her life—they are threads interwoven with her core values. Deborah's legacy is one that transcends transactional success, leaving an indelible mark on the lives of individuals and the fabric of her community. Her community passion is evident not only in her professional life but also in her service to her community.

Chris Charboneau brings more than 28 years of real estate experience, more than $550 million in career sales volume, and over 850 completed transactions. A recipient of numerous Top Producer awards, Chris has built his career helping buyers and sellers throughout the Houston area with a combination of market knowledge, strategic marketing, and experienced guidance.

He earned both his Marketing degree and MBA from Texas Tech University and has extensive experience in both Houston’s Inner Loop and suburban markets. Having lived in both areas, with an office in the Rice Village area, Chris offers a valuable perspective to clients moving across Houston. He has helped many families transition both into the city and out to the suburbs, advising them on neighborhoods, schools, commutes, housing styles, and lifestyle considerations.

Chris also has firsthand experience with waterfront and second-home ownership on Lake Livingston, giving him practical insight into vacation homes, secondary residences, waterfront properties, and short-term rental opportunities.

Outside of real estate, Chris has coached travel baseball for 12 years and has coached 35 players who have gone on to play college baseball. His son currently plays at Baylor University. For families relocating to Houston with children involved in baseball, Chris can also provide valuable insight into local travel organizations, facilities, and programs.

Chris enjoys spending time with his wife, Amber, their three children, and their two golden retrievers.

remarks: Perched gracefully at the crest of a gentle hill in the coveted West Westchester neighborhood, this exceptional residence at 7350 W 91st St offers a rare combination of privacy, charm, and modern refinement. With nearly 1,500 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space, this three-bedroom, two-bathroom home captures the essence of Southern California living. Sunlight pours through expansive south-facing windows that span the living and dining areas, illuminating the interior and highlighting the warmth of the original oak floors. A welcoming fireplace anchors the main living space, creating an inviting atmosphere ideal for both relaxed evenings and refined entertaining. Recent enhancements including fresh paint, new fixtures, and updated hardware introduce a crisp, contemporary feel while preserving the home's timeless character. The layout flows effortlessly, complemented by a dedicated laundry room and an attached two-car garage for added convenience. Step onto the charming front porch and take in the elevated surroundings, or retreat to the peaceful backyard, where the property backs directly to a parkway offering a level of privacy rarely found, with no neighbors behind. Ideally positioned near the vibrant energy of Silicon Beach, this home offers easy access to renowned tech hubs such as Google, YouTube, and SpaceX, while remaining just moments from the coast and an array of shops and restaurants. This is more than a home, it is a distinctive opportunity to own a private hillside retreat in one of Los Angeles' most desirable enclaves.

In 2024 and 2025, Stephanie Younger was the #1 agent in the City of Los Angeles and the Westchester Neighborhood, selling more Single-Family homes than any other real estate agent or team. With unmatched expertise in Westside and South Bay neighborhoods, Stephanie and her team have built their brand on a reputation for service that exceeds all expectations.

Why Buyers and Sellers Choose Stephanie Younger:

- Ranked #11 Sales Team in LA County by the LA Business Journal (2024)
- Over $3 billion in lifetime sales.
- Consistently ranked a top producer in West LA real estate
- Featured in The LA Times, The Argonaut, Dwell, SpectrumNews, The RealDeal and more
- Neighborhood Expert: West LA & the Silicon Beach Corridor

As a Los Angeles native and long-time Westchester resident, Stephanie offers hyper-local knowledge that few agents can match. She specializes in: Westchester, Playa del Rey, Playa Vista, Marina del Rey, Culver City, Venice, and El Segundo

What Makes Stephanie Different?

- Stephanie's unique background in sales, event planning, hospitality, and the arts makes her an expert in both marketing and negotiation.
- She believes: “Real estate, like life, is all about getting the details right.”

Her Process Includes:

- Helping clients define and align their vision, goals, and budget
- Managing complex transactions with clear communication
- Navigating escrow, lending, and inspections with zero surprises
- Leading a high-performing team to deliver seamless service

Local, Loyal, and Living Here...

Stephanie lives in Westchester with her husband—a playwright and LMU professor—and their two children. She’s proud to serve the neighborhoods she calls home, and her passion for community is reflected in her generous support of local charitable organizations including the YMCA, Westchester Arts and Music Block Party, and more.

A Southern California native, Ron Melendez has lived all over the Los Angeles area. Growing up in the San Gabriel Valley, he would head over to the beaches of Orange County to surf. After moving to Westwood to attend U.C.L.A., Ron has lived in Santa Monica, the Valley, and West Hollywood, before finally settling with his family in the South Bay. They now live in Manhattan Beach’s Tree Section where his daughters attend American Martyrs School.

Ron believes in real estate done right. And he believes that the most important way to do that is to listen to really hear what the client wants and needs, and to put all other concerns aside in pursuit of that. Ron knows how important your decision to buy or sell a property is. After 30 years working as an actor working in both TV and Film, Ron has brought that passion to real estate. He loves helping people find the perfect place to call home or helping someone get the best price for their property so that they can achieve their dreams. He believes that this job is all about service. At the end of the day, he wants to look back and know that he always did right by his clients.

agents.bio:
Janel Yglesias has proudly called Houston her home for over two decades. In this diverse and culturally-rich city, she has immersed herself in the community, forging strong bonds with its people. With over a decade of experience in real estate through her family's home remodeling business, Janel has developed a deep understanding of the local market.

Before her real estate journey, Janel Yglesias was a dynamic journalist, having served as a news reporter for Univision Houston. Throughout her successful career, she earned a reputation as an influential and credible journalist at both the local and national levels. Covering significant events like the passing of Cuba's dictator Fidel Castro, Super Bowl LI, Hurricane Harvey, and the Houston Astros' World Series win, she proved her dedication to informing and serving the community.

Janel's exceptional work led to four nominations for the Lone Star Emmy Awards. In 2018, she clinched the prestigious Sylvan Rodriguez 'Best Houston Reporter Award.'

Janel's passion for her community now extends to real estate, where she blends her two passions seamlessly. As a specialist in her field, she takes pride in keeping her clients well-informed, offering programs and incentives for first-time homebuyers, seasoned buyers, and investors alike.

What sets Janel apart from others in the field is her unwavering commitment to her clients' success. She believes that every real estate transaction is a journey, and she is devoted to making it a smooth and enjoyable one.

Janel understands that buying or selling a property is not just a financial decision but an emotional one as well, and she goes above and beyond to ease her clients through the process. With her unique combination of real estate expertise and journalistic background, she is committed to serving the Houston community with dedication and integrity.

Beyond her professional endeavors, Janel Yglesias is a wife and a mother. Her favorite pastime is watching her son play baseball and spending time with her family at the beach. Her faith is very important to her and she thanks God for all of her blessings.

remarks: Welcome to Chapter at Bastrop, a gated collection of modern new construction homes in Houston’s University Area. Interior highlights include quartz countertops, soft close cabinetry, spacious island kitchen with pot filler, vinyl plank flooring, high ceilings, and designer finishes throughout. Enjoy a private balcony, fenced yard, and attached two car garage. Flexible floorplan includes a first floor bedroom ideal for guests, multigenerational living, or a home office. Conveniently located near Downtown, Midtown, the Texas Medical Center, University of Houston, and Texas Southern University. Rare opportunity to own a corner home in this private gated enclave.

Specializing in residential sales and rentals, Julie combines in-depth market knowledge, strong negotiation skills, and a client-first mindset to deliver seamless and successful transactions.

Julie’s background as a small business owner and real estate investor gives her a unique edge in the industry, equipping her with strong problem-solving abilities and a keen eye for market trends. Her extensive list of professional designations—including ABR, MRPSA, SRS, CNE, RSPS, CLHS, AWREP, MRP, and PSA—demonstrates her commitment to ongoing education and excellence in real estate. Whether assisting first-time homebuyers, seasoned investors, or those seeking luxury properties, Julie provides tailored strategies and expert guidance to ensure her clients make well-informed decisions.

Beyond real estate, Julie is deeply involved in her community, volunteering with Houston Food Bank, Habitat for Humanity, and the Breast Cancer Walk. A proud Houston native, she appreciates the city’s diverse culture, vibrant dining scene, and world-class shopping. When she’s not helping clients find their dream homes, you’ll likely find her soaking up the sun at the beach—her favorite place to unwind.

Whether buying, selling, or investing, Julie Wells is committed to delivering an exceptional real estate experience built on trust, expertise, and personalized service.

She specializes in Seabrook, Clear Lake, Kemah, and Galveston, helping buyers find homes that match their vision—whether it’s a waterfront retreat, a luxury second home, or a lucrative investment property.


Nichelle’s approach is built on listening, educating, and empowering her clients. As a Seller Representation Specialist, Certified Negotiation Expert, and Resort & Second Home Property Specialist, she provides data-driven market insights, strategic advice, and a seamless transaction experience. Drawing from her own experiences as both a buyer and seller, she offers firsthand knowledge that makes her guidance relatable, transparent, and effective.


Clients describe Nichelle as detail-oriented, communicative, and deeply invested in their success. She takes pride in building long-term relationships, ensuring every client feels supported, informed, and confident throughout the process. Her mission? To turn real estate dreams into reality while delivering a smooth, stress-free experience.


Living in the coastal suburb of Seabrook, Nichelle enjoys the very lifestyle she helps her clients achieve. When she’s not working, you’ll find her exploring the waterfront, discovering new restaurants, or capturing photos of her toy poodle, Louie Loo (@life.of.louie.loo). agents.bio:
I walk alongside my clients across the Houston metropolitan area, offering guidance, protection, and secure negotiations so they can make confident decisions when buying or selling a home. Because these choices truly matter for their future.

Buying or selling a home in Houston can feel overwhelming. Prices shift, advice conflicts, and one wrong move can cost time, money, or peace of mind. Most people are not looking for a flashy agent. They are looking for clarity and a plan they can trust.

That is where my wife Suzanna and I come in.

We help people navigate the Houston market with clear strategy and steady guidance, whether that means preparing a home for a top dollar sale or finding the right home without overpaying. After more than 19 years in real estate and over 450 clients served, I have learned that the best outcomes come from simplicity, preparation, and strong negotiation.

Before real estate, I was a mechanical engineer. I earned a B.S. and Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering and worked in systems driven environments at GE Automation Systems and Petron Systems. That background trained me to analyze risk, anticipate failure points, and protect outcomes, skills I now use daily to safeguard my clients’ decisions.

I am also a real estate investor and have taught portfolio building at Houston’s largest real estate investment club. My professional designations reflect one thing: deep preparation so you do not have to guess.

Here is how we work.

First, we listen carefully and define the real goal
Second, we build a clear strategy using market data and timing
Third, we negotiate firmly and execute with precision through closing

If you work with us, you will understand your options, feel confident in your decisions, and move forward without second guessing.

If you are trying to buy, sell, or invest in Houston, having clarity is the right decision. We are here to guide you through it.

agents.bio:
Licensed since 2012, Julie Wells is a dedicated real estate professional serving the Greater Houston and Galveston markets. She is known for her expertise, strategic approach, and passion for helping clients navigate their real estate journeys. Specializing in residential sales and rentals, Julie combines in-depth market knowledge, strong negotiation skills, and a client-first mindset to deliver seamless and successful transactions.

Julie’s background as a small business owner and real estate investor gives her a unique edge in the industry, equipping her with strong problem-solving abilities and a keen eye for market trends. Her extensive list of professional designations—including ABR, MRPSA, SRS, CNE, RSPS, CLHS, AWREP, MRP, and PSA—demonstrates her commitment to ongoing education and excellence in real estate. Whether assisting first-time homebuyers, seasoned investors, or those seeking luxury properties, Julie provides tailored strategies and expert guidance to ensure her clients make well-informed decisions.

Beyond real estate, Julie is deeply involved in her community, volunteering with Houston Food Bank, Habitat for Humanity, and the Breast Cancer Walk. A proud Houston native, she appreciates the city’s diverse culture, vibrant dining scene, and world-class shopping. When she’s not helping clients find their dream homes, you’ll likely find her soaking up the sun at the beach—her favorite place to unwind.

Whether buying, selling, or investing, Julie Wells is committed to delivering an exceptional real estate experience built on trust, expertise, and personalized service.

With a deep knowledge of Houston’s most desirable waterfront communities, Nichelle Richards is a trusted guide for clients looking to relocate, invest, or upgrade their lifestyle along the Gulf Coast. She specializes in Seabrook, Clear Lake, Kemah, and Galveston, helping buyers find homes that match their vision—whether it’s a waterfront retreat, a luxury second home, or a lucrative investment property.


Nichelle’s approach is built on listening, educating, and empowering her clients. As a Seller Representation Specialist, Certified Negotiation Expert, and Resort & Second Home Property Specialist, she provides data-driven market insights, strategic advice, and a seamless transaction experience. Drawing from her own experiences as both a buyer and seller, she offers firsthand knowledge that makes her guidance relatable, transparent, and effective.


Clients describe Nichelle as detail-oriented, communicative, and deeply invested in their success. She takes pride in building long-term relationships, ensuring every client feels supported, informed, and confident throughout the process. Her mission? To turn real estate dreams into reality while delivering a smooth, stress-free experience.


Living in the coastal suburb of Seabrook, Nichelle enjoys the very lifestyle she helps her clients achieve. When she’s not working, you’ll find her exploring the waterfront, discovering new restaurants, or capturing photos of her toy poodle, Louie Loo (@life.of.louie.loo). Having purchased her first home at just 19, she understands the transformative power of homeownership and loves sharing this passion with her clients.


Whether you’re looking to invest, relocate, or find your dream home by the water, Nichelle Richards is ready to guide you with expertise, enthusiasm, and a personal touch.

remarks: Morning at Memorial Park, dinner around the kitchen island. This is inner-loop living with room to unwind. Three bedrooms, a full bath for each, and a new heating and cooling system installed in November 2026. This three-story townhome in gated Maxroy Mews puts you in Timbergrove/Lazybrook, minutes from The Heights, Downtown Houston, and Memorial Park. The private first-floor bedroom and full bath give you flexibility for guests or a home office. Upstairs, high ceilings, natural light, and hardwood floors set the stage for open living and dining. The kitchen flows into both spaces and features granite countertops, an island, and stainless steel appliances. On the third floor, the spacious primary suite offers high ceilings, generous closet space, and an en-suite bath with double sinks, a soaking tub, and a separate shower. The third bedroom has its own en-suite bath. Energy-efficient features, a tankless water heater, an attached two-car garage, and landscaped grounds.

That’s why as the Broker/Owner of RE/MAX Northwest professional integrity and personalized service are the key foundation for Stephanie and the Brokerage. The partnership Stephanie and every agent at RE/MAX Northwest form with each and every client assures each client they are confidently and expertly represented with the utmost fiduciary integrity, polished negotiating skills, latest market trend information and personalized communication.

A longtime Houston resident, Stephanie understands the growth of the market and its nuances. This knowledgebase offers a unique specialty that allows Stephanie to customize each buying and selling experience for each client and this experience is not limited to specific neighborhoods, but representing all clients' interests in all areas. Stephanie is a wonderful resource for clients and agents relocating to the Houston area. She is passionate about fulfilling every real estate need. Stephanie and RE/MAX Northwest agents understand that buying or selling a home is more than just a transaction: it’s a life-changing experience. The RE/MAX Northwest Realtors, are seasoned real estate professionals, dedicated to providing exceptional, personalized service for all clients.

agents.bio:
Diana has been a broker/owner of her company since 1994 and loves working with both buyers and sellers. Residential homes, townhomes, patio homes, and condominiums are her main focus. She also works with new custom home builders. 

Most of Diana's business comes from referrals from clients. She has expertise inside the loop, including Medical Center, Rice University, Bellaire, West University, Braes Heights, Southampton, River Oaks, Afton Oaks, Oak Estates, Mid-Town, Museum and Gallery areas. Whether buying their first home or moving up or downsizing Diana can assist her clients in making that possible.

remarks: Located in the sought-after Reserve at New Forest, this elegant residence offers an exceptional blend of space and sophistication with SIX bedrooms, including two on the main level, and four full baths. A grand entry welcomes you with soaring ceilings, a striking chandelier, and timeless plantation shutters. Formal living and dining areas create an inviting setting for entertaining. The beautifully appointed kitchen features transitional cabinetry, a walk-in pantry, and an oversized island that opens seamlessly to the main living space. The spacious primary suite accommodates a sitting area and includes a large walk-in closet. Upstairs offers a generous game room, four bedrooms, and two full baths. Enjoy year-round outdoor living on the covered patio. A three-car garage and storage shed add flexibility. Community amenities include a pool, park, and splash pad, with convenient access to Beltway 8, I-10, US-90, downtown Houston, and IAH.
