remarks: Custom architectural residence in Kentwood, designed and built by C&C Partners in 2008 as the sellers' forever home. This single-level home with soaring ceilings and walls of glass blends organic modern design with warmth and functionality, showcasing a striking mix of stone, wood, metal, copper and glass to create a serene, private retreat designed for both everyday living and exceptional entertaining.The open-concept great room floor plan offers 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms across approximately 2,329 sq ft, plus a detached cabana of approximately 375 sq ft with its own bath, ideal as a home office, guest suite or potential fourth bedroom. Expansive flush-track multi-slide aluminum doors in the great room, primary suite and cabana create seamless indoor-outdoor living. Multiple entertaining spaces include both a formal living room and the expansive great room, while three fireplaces, including a slate wood-burning fireplace in the great room and linear gas fireplaces in the living room and primary suite, add warmth and architectural impact.Honed dolomite limestone flooring and recessed stone baseboards run throughout the main living spaces, complemented by slate ledgestone columns, custom African mahogany and alder cabinetry, 8-foot solid alder doors, skylights and custom lighting. A dramatic 15-foot stainless steel indoor water feature serves as a stunning architectural centerpiece, bringing a tranquil, spa-like ambiance to the home.The chef's kitchen is both functional and beautifully appointed, featuring stone countertops, bronze glass backsplash, heated floors, a large island with prep sink, walk-in pantry and butler's pantry. Premium appliances include Thermador refrigeration, cooktop, double ovens, warming drawer and microwave, Vent-A-Hood ventilation, Bosch and Fisher & Paykel dishwashers, and U-Line wine refrigerator drawers.Privately located at the rear of the home, the luxurious primary suite offers direct backyard access, a custom-built-in king bed with integrated nightstands, walk-in closet, fireplace, heated bathroom floors, honed black granite countertops and pebble stone flooring. Additional bathrooms showcase curated natural stone and custom tile work, and the laundry room includes stone counters, custom cabinetry, deep utility sink and Speed Queen washer and dryer.The backyard feels like a private resort, highlighted by a spacious private patio, a custom outdoor water feature finished in dolomite split-face stone and glass tile, a full-height slate ledgestone accent wall, a linear gas fire pit and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen with built-in BBQ, sink, disposal and storage. The exterior features smooth concrete stucco with copper-clad fascia, custom glass and aluminum side gates, extensive natural stone and dramatic hardscape throughout the driveway and patios. Professionally designed landscaping includes mature olive, acacia, bamboo, citrus and Japanese maple trees.The detached cabana features dolomite flooring, a stone accent wall, built-in workspace and a bathroom finished in tumbled marble.Additional highlights include direct entry to a finished garage with extensive built-in storage, utility sink, workspace and room for a second refrigerator. The home also features a central vacuum system, whole-home Savant smart system with built-in speakers throughout the home, cabana and patio, custom iPad wall charging stations, Lutron lighting controls, solar panels, two tankless water heaters, updated HVAC systems, custom closet build-outs, a Clopay glass garage door, monitored alarm system and enclosed dog run.

agents.bio:
Licensed since 2012, Julie Wells is a dedicated real estate professional serving the Greater Houston and Galveston markets. She is known for her expertise, strategic approach, and passion for helping clients navigate their real estate journeys. Specializing in residential sales and rentals, Julie combines in-depth market knowledge, strong negotiation skills, and a client-first mindset to deliver seamless and successful transactions.

Julie’s background as a small business owner and real estate investor gives her a unique edge in the industry, equipping her with strong problem-solving abilities and a keen eye for market trends. Her extensive list of professional designations—including ABR, MRPSA, SRS, CNE, RSPS, CLHS, AWREP, MRP, and PSA—demonstrates her commitment to ongoing education and excellence in real estate. Whether assisting first-time homebuyers, seasoned investors, or those seeking luxury properties, Julie provides tailored strategies and expert guidance to ensure her clients make well-informed decisions.

Beyond real estate, Julie is deeply involved in her community, volunteering with Houston Food Bank, Habitat for Humanity, and the Breast Cancer Walk. A proud Houston native, she appreciates the city’s diverse culture, vibrant dining scene, and world-class shopping. When she’s not helping clients find their dream homes, you’ll likely find her soaking up the sun at the beach—her favorite place to unwind.

Whether buying, selling, or investing, Julie Wells is committed to delivering an exceptional real estate experience built on trust, expertise, and personalized service.

With a deep knowledge of Houston’s most desirable waterfront communities, Nichelle Richards is a trusted guide for clients looking to relocate, invest, or upgrade their lifestyle along the Gulf Coast. She specializes in Seabrook, Clear Lake, Kemah, and Galveston, helping buyers find homes that match their vision—whether it’s a waterfront retreat, a luxury second home, or a lucrative investment property.


Nichelle’s approach is built on listening, educating, and empowering her clients. As a Seller Representation Specialist, Certified Negotiation Expert, and Resort & Second Home Property Specialist, she provides data-driven market insights, strategic advice, and a seamless transaction experience. Drawing from her own experiences as both a buyer and seller, she offers firsthand knowledge that makes her guidance relatable, transparent, and effective.


Clients describe Nichelle as detail-oriented, communicative, and deeply invested in their success. She takes pride in building long-term relationships, ensuring every client feels supported, informed, and confident throughout the process. Her mission? To turn real estate dreams into reality while delivering a smooth, stress-free experience.


Living in the coastal suburb of Seabrook, Nichelle enjoys the very lifestyle she helps her clients achieve. When she’s not working, you’ll find her exploring the waterfront, discovering new restaurants, or capturing photos of her toy poodle, Louie Loo (@life.of.louie.loo). Having purchased her first home at just 19, she understands the transformative power of homeownership and loves sharing this passion with her clients.


Whether you’re looking to invest, relocate, or find your dream home by the water, Nichelle Richards is ready to guide you with expertise, enthusiasm, and a personal touch.

remarks: Thoughtfully Remodeled Spanish-Style Home with ADU | Hyde Park | 3813 & 3815 - A rare find in the heart of Hyde Park this fully remodeled Spanish-style property offers flexible living for today's modern family. With 5 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms in the main house plus a fully appointed ADU, the layout was designed with intention, comfort, and longevity in mind.The Main House welcomes you with an open-concept living area bathed in natural light. The main floor features 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, including a private en-suite bedroom ideal for guests or family members who prefer single-level living. Upstairs, you'll find the spacious primary bedroom complete with a balcony overlooking the backyard, a full bathroom, and a versatile secondary bedroom perfect as a home office, nursery, or creative space.Throughout the home, the finishes reflect quality at every turn no corners were cut. Paid-off solar, central heating and air conditioning, and in-unit stackable laundry connections make this home as practical as it is beautiful. The backyard is low maintenance with hardscape and grass, giving you outdoor space without the upkeep.The ADU at 3813 is a seamless extension of the main home same quality fixtures, same design sensibility, zero compromise. Featuring its own address, a split-system for heating and cooling, and stackable laundry connections, it functions as a fully independent living space. Whether for extended family, an au pair, or as a rental, the ADU delivers.This property is a natural fit for multigenerational living, offering privacy and independence for each generation while keeping loved ones close. The separately addressed units also open the door to rental income potential.Located in Hyde Park with easy access to SoFi Stadium, Intuit Dome, Crypto.com Arena, major freeways, and the best of South LA.Special financing may be available for qualified buyers ask for details.Total living space: approximately 2,622 sq ft across both addresses. agents.bio:
Born and bred in Carson, CA, a quaint suburb of Los Angeles, Erica has carved out a multifaceted career path as an attorney, realtor, college professor, and probate specialist. With a knack for navigating complex legal frameworks, she seamlessly transitions between roles, leveraging her expertise to serve her clients comprehensively.
Her journey began with a passion for law, earning your stripes as an attorney, where she honed her skills as an adept negotiator and contracts expert. But her entrepreneurial spirit led her to broaden her horizons, venturing into real estate, where she helps buyers to navigate the sometimes precarious real estate market and sellers realize their real estate goals.
In her professional repertoire, she is not just about closing deals; she believes in fostering meaningful relationships with her clients. Recognizing that buying or selling a property is more than a transaction—it's a significant life event—she approaches each case with empathy and dedication. She guides her clients through the intricate process, offering support and solutions every step of the way.
Her commitment to excellence extends beyond the negotiation table. As a devoted mother and the only child, she understands the importance of family and community. This deep-rooted connection fuels her drive to provide exceptional service, ensuring that every client feels valued and heard.
In a competitive market where challenges abound, she thrives on finding creative solutions. Whether it’s helping families navigate the emotional journey of selling a loved one's estate, assisting buyers in securing their dream home against all odds, or working with sellers to get top dollar, she is there, steadfast and reliable.
With her expertise, compassion, and unwavering dedication, she has earned a reputation as a trusted advisor and ally. Erica not just a legal professional or a real estate agent; she is a problem solver, a confidante, and a beacon of support for those embarking on their real estate journey in the bustling landscape of Los Angeles and the surrounding communities.
Erica is mom to a teenager, she is a novice golfer, the Program Director in her Jack and Jill Chapter, active member of her book club, and world traveler.

agents.bio:
Founding CitiQuest Properties during the 2008 housing market crisis was a bold move for Patrick Burbridge. But his resiliency against the turbulent economy and ability to come out the other side even more strongly positioned than when he started is a testament to his commitment, integrity, teamwork, and inspiration (CITI). Patrick has since added unparalleled value to Houston’s new construction development projects and the broader real estate market while generating over $1 billion in transactions.

Patrick’s mother is Mexican, and his father is from the U.S. He spent his early years in Queretaro, Mexico, moved to Houston as a teenager, and attended the University of Houston. After earning his bachelor’s degree in business administration with a focus on marketing and finance, he launched his career in development, construction, land acquisition, and sales. By the time Patrick founded CitiQuest Properties, he had conceived a unique vision of the industry that enabled him to carve out a worthy niche within a sprawling metropolis.

Patrick’s well-rounded expertise in “ground-up” real estate has played a direct role in revitalizing established neighborhoods and shaping up-and-coming communities. His leadership qualities have further influenced his team of agents, who uphold their collective practices and standards when working alongside clients and partners alike. Patrick’s consultative approach has earned him the business of many of Houston’s top developers; other clients include first-time and seasoned buyers, downsizers, investors, and young professionals who desire to live near the city centers.

Patrick is also active in the communities he serves in his personal time. He volunteers to help provide meals to children in need, and one of his short-term goals is to support charities that provide free surgery to repair cleft lips and palates and other facial differences in children and young adults.

Additionally, negotiation and organizational skills are huge in the legal field - and both of these strengths have served Judy and her clients well while working at Designed Realty Group. Selling new construction is a favorite as our area is thriving with numerous builders and new communities. Veterans hold a special place in my heart as my father proudly served in the USAF. We work together as a team, to get them into the home they deserve. As the Broker/Owner my job is to secure listings for the firm so my extensive marketing background ensures your home is seen by as many eyes as possible throughout all real estate professional websites as well as social media outlets across the nation - not just Texas.

When not working, Judy loves to travel - whether beachfront or mountainside - she is always looking for an adventure. Sundays are generally spent poolside with her grand babies and fur babies with her husband grilling something yummy!

agents.bio: Adrienne got her start in Real Estate as an investor/landlord in 2004. She then became licensed to help herself and others obtain their Real Estate Dreams. She has experience working in Residential Sales & Leasing, Farm & Ranch Sales as well as Commercial Real Estate. Recent transactions include 5 counties with a primary concentration in Harris County TX. Adrienne is a highly involved and trained REALTOR and an Accredited Buyer's Representative (ABR) specializing in New Home Sales and Investment Properties. She also has earned her Pricing Strategy Advisor (PSA) which is essential when listing properties for sale. Alexis Mendoza has been in the real estate industry for almost a decade! She began pursuing real estate in 2014, after returning from a year long sabbatical where she trekked the globe with her then fiancé, now husband. Traveling to over 23 countries, she developed a deep appreciation for what family life is for a wide array of cultures and people. Being able to experience, first hand, such diverse lifestyles and perspectives was truly inspiring. It ignited her desire to become an integral part of helping people through such an intimate experience, such as buying and selling a home.

Growing up a classically trained dancer; attending schools such as The Houston Ballet and The Ailey School in NYC (one of the most prestigious dance academies in the world), Alexis is no stranger to the values of hard work, determination and perseverance. She brings that same energy to her real estate business, stopping at nothing until her clients' needs are fully met. Alexis's long standing love for interior design, coupled with her love of architecture and old homes, made her transition into real estate a natural and quickly successful one. She's a proud member of NAR, TAR, HAR, and RENE (Real Estate Negotiation Expert) Designation.

Its really important to me to build a strong relationship with everyone I work with to gain their trust! I am known for my attention to detail, exceptional communication/transparency, and vigorous hustle to make sure my clients are happy and get everything they deserve! I concentrate intensely on the unique needs of each individual client. My focus is not only on the end result, but more importantly; I aim to minimize the stress, educate throughout the process and keep everyone's energy positive and confident! First and foremost, Alexis LOVES helping people achieve their dreams! She whole-heartedly believes it is a PRIVILEGE to be given the opportunity to work with people through this intense journey in the world of real estate.

A native Houstonian, Alexis loves the diversity and rich culture found within the city. She believes the food and art scene is unrivaled and loves exploring the ever evolving, Houston neighborhoods.

Family is everything to Alexis, as she is a mother of 3 beautiful little girls! When not with her clients, Alexis can be found traveling the world with her family, trying out the newest restaurants in the city, or giving back to the community by volunteering with foundations such as The Beacon of Downtown Houston and East End Foundation. For a Realtor who will work to meet the unique, personalized needs of all her clients, and who aims to minimize stress through positive energy and transparency, Alexis is your girl!

agents.bio:
As a native Houstonian and experienced real estate professional, I believe exceptional real estate service begins with understanding what matters most to my clients. My approach is rooted in relationships, built on trust, and driven by a commitment to providing thoughtful guidance, strategic expertise, and personalized service throughout every step of the real estate journey.

Before beginning my real estate career, I spent more than 15 years in executive sales and contract negotiations within the technology industry. Today, I combine that business experience with my knowledge of the Houston real estate market to provide skilled negotiation, strategic advice, and a concierge-level experience tailored to each client's unique needs and goals.

As a homeowner, landlord, and real estate investor myself, I understand firsthand that real estate is more than a transaction. It's a significant financial investment, a lifestyle decision, and often the beginning of an exciting new chapter. Whether you're buying or selling a luxury home, relocating to Houston, purchasing your first home, or exploring investment opportunities, my priority is to protect your interests, simplify the process, and help you make confident, informed decisions.

I proudly serve Houston and its surrounding communities, and I've built my business on integrity, personal connections, and lasting relationships. Nothing means more to me than earning the trust of my clients and knowing they feel confident referring their friends, family, and colleagues to me for the same exceptional level of service.

For me, success isn't simply measured by homes bought and sold. It's measured by the relationships I build, the trust I earn, and the experience I deliver.

I love Houston, I love real estate, and most importantly, I love helping people achieve their goals. I would welcome the opportunity to do the same for you.

Rooted in Houston. Rooted in Relationships. Rooted in What Matters.

Amanda Anhorn specializes in the Heights and other close-in areas for Greenwood King Properties. With a B.A. in management information systems and experience in technology sales and marketing, Amanda is well qualified to effectively serve her real estate clients. 
 
 
. 
 
As a Top Producer for Greenwood King Properties since 2004 and the #1 Top Producer in the Heights Office, Amanda is always accessible in order to respond quickly to opportunities that may arise for her clients. Amanda provides extraordinary service, always going the extra mile for her clients, a trademark of all successful Greenwood King real estate agents. 
Equally adept at handling new construction and resales, including historic homes situated in the inner loop neighborhoods, Amanda has proven to be a valuable as to Greenwood King and to her clients. One of her strengths is her uncommon ability to genuinely take on the perspectives of her clients, understand their wants and needs, and then adopt those as her top priority. As Amanda always says, “Two minds are better than one.” The working relationship with her husband, Rich Anhorn, only enhances the service that Amanda is able to provide to her clients. Jennifer Wallace Warren, their assistant, rounds out this great team to ensure complete success and a smooth transition for all clientele.

Kyla Linn spent several years bringing the best of fashion to Houstonians as one of the lead buyers for Houston's own legacy luxury retailer, Tootsies. After a decade in the retail industry, she developed a keen eye and sharp negotiation skills. These skills, along with an aptitude for customer service, marketing, competitive analysis, pricing, and data analytics, allow Kyla to bring value to her clients when selling or buying their next home. With over $200 million in residential real estate sales in the Greater Houston and surrounding areas, Kyla offers unmatched expertise to buyers, sellers, and investors. Rapidly rising to one of the top agents in Houston, Kyla has been featured in HAR's Rising Stars of Real Estate Top 20 Under 40 and Houston Business Journal's Top 10 Groups in Houston two years in a row.

Kyla's success has always been attributed to her customer centric approach, and she has long held the principle that a customer's experience is far more important than the transaction itself. Organized, detail oriented, and quick to respond, Kyla has had success streamlining processes for many organizations throughout her career, so her clients can be sure that they will have a seamless and stress free experience.

When asked why she decided to make the move to real estate, Kyla explained "My entire career, I have had success understanding and meeting the needs of consumers all across the United States. Retail was a perfect match for me, as it coupled my creative nature with my strong business acumen. As I got older, I became passionate about personal finance and helping others understand how to build a better future for themselves. I am eager to be in a position where I can utilize my skills and take my passion for understanding the needs of others to give my clients a competitive edge when it comes to undertaking what will likely be one of the biggest investments of their lifetime, their home."

Kyla is a native Houstonian and a graduate of Houston Christian High School. She received a degree in Business Marketing from Texas A&M University, where she graduated Summa Cum Laude. She has been voted by her peers in several positions of leadership throughout her career, as her reputation for being smart, levelheaded, and empathetic makes her an excellent advocate for others. She enjoys a love of food and travel, having visited over 30 countries in her lifetime, and is always eager to give restaurant and travel recommendations. She currently lives with her husband, daughter, and two goldendoodles in the Heights.

agents.bio:
With over a decade in the real estate industry, Jonathan Williamson has been a dynamic force in buying, selling, and managing properties. Since becoming a licensed agent in 2013, he has completed over 300 transactions, showcasing an unparalleled commitment to his clients and excellence in service.

Jonathan began his career in real estate as an investor and has personally acquired and sold tens of millions of dollars worth of real estate; a boast few realtors can make. He has experience flipping, remodeling, and building homes, and has also owned dozens of rental properties. This wealth of experience provides him with a deep understanding of the needs of builders and investors, which he skillfully leverages to the benefit of his clients. With Jonathan, clients are able to focus on their own needs in a home while he looks toward the future for any obstacles that might prevent them from getting top dollar for their investment.

Committed to the community, Jonathan has served on the board of the Women's Council of Realtors and the Art League of Houston. His passion for philanthropy extends to animal rescue and welfare, where he has fostered and found homes for dozens of animals in need.

Living in the charming heavily wooded subdivision of Grogan's Mill with his amazing wife and two beloved rescue dogs, Jonathan embraces a life of service, passion, and excellence. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, a seasoned investor, a home builder or somewhere in between, Jonathan is dedicated to making your real estate journey memorable and successful.

Ali Pourmemar is a highly accomplished real estate professional, mortgage loan officer, and long-time real estate investor with more than 30 years of sales and negotiation experience. Known for his strategic mindset and exceptional deal-making ability, Ali has built a reputation as a master negotiator who consistently delivers outstanding results for his clients.

Throughout his career, Ali has developed an elite track record in sales, beginning with door-to-door residential sales and advancing to high-level B2B and enterprise sales. His performance consistently ranked among the top 1% of producers, earning him multiple President’s Club awards—an honor reserved for the highest-performing professionals in enterprise and business-to-business sales.

Today, Ali brings this elite-level negotiation expertise into every real estate transaction.

Ali serves as a Delegated Supervisor at Next Trend Realty, where he helps oversee and support a growing network of 170+ real estate agents, maintaining high standards of professionalism, compliance, and service across the brokerage.

In addition to his role in real estate brokerage, Ali is also a Mortgage Loan Officer, giving his clients a powerful advantage by understanding both the real estate and financing sides of a transaction. As a long-time real estate investor, he also provides valuable insight into investment strategies, market trends, and wealth-building opportunities through real estate.

Ali specializes in:

• Luxury homes
• Land and lot acquisitions
• Commercial real estate
• Investment properties
• Residential sales and purchases
• High-level negotiation and deal structuring

Whether representing homeowners, investors, or commercial clients, Ali is known for his strong advocacy, strategic negotiation, and commitment to delivering exceptional results in every transaction.

Jenny is a dedicated and experienced real estate professional with a passion for helping clients achieve their property dreams. Known for her exceptional customer service, market knowledge, and negotiation skills, Jenny has built a reputation for delivering results and creating lasting client relationships. Whether you're buying your first home, looking for an investment property, or selling a cherished family residence, Jenny is committed to providing personalized and strategic guidance every step of the way.

remarks: In the gated Upland Grove community minutes from the Energy Corridor, CityCentre, and Memorial City, this 2018 contemporary home opens with a dramatic two-story foyer and oversized corner windows that flood the space with natural light. 12-foot ceilings down, tall ceilings up, and an open-concept main level. In the kitchen you will find a large island, upgraded Bosch stainless steel appliances, granite counters, and ample cabinetry — with a butler's pantry/beverage area connecting to the dining space. Wood floors throughout (no carpet), paired with custom interior shutters. Each bedroom has an en-suite bath and walk-in closet; the primary adds a vaulted ceiling, spa bath with soaking tub, glass shower, marble dual vanities, and a custom closet. Garage built-ins add storage, and the low-maintenance backyard is pre-plumbed for gas, water, and wastewater — ready for a future outdoor kitchen. Quick access to Beltway 8 and I-10, zoned to Spring Branch ISD. Don't miss this one!

Houston Broker & Owner of The Zilveti Group, Andrés Zilveti creates exceptional experiences and optimal outcomes for buyers and sellers throughout the Greater Houston area backed by more than a decade of hands-on marketing experience. As a third-generation real estate professional, the business is practically in his DNA. Clients rave about his patient, understanding and professional approach, calling his ability to zero in on his customers' unique needs "brilliant."

Before getting his real estate license, Andrés ran a digital agency, where he honed the razor-sharp marketing and social media talents that are indispensable to his clients today. As the owner/broker of The Zilveti Group, he thrives on helping people move forward and upward in their lives, whether that means guiding a first-time home purchase, serving relocators and young professionals, or helping investors expand their portfolios. With Andres at the helm, clients at every price point enjoy attentive expert service backed by powerful industry know-how.

Andrés was raised in Austin and moved to Houston to attend the University of Houston, where he earned a bachelor's degree in public relations with a minor in art history. After a three-year stint as an expat in Perth, Australia, he returned to Houston. Andrés now resides in Spring Branch, where he appreciates the relaxing lifestyle and central location. When he's not hard at work for his clients, he enjoys spending time with his family and dogs and pursuing his passion for pickleball.

agents.bio:
As one satisfied client summed up in one of Mel’s recent seller surveys, “Mel Reyna is amazing.” And we agree. Elaborating on Mel’s extraordinary service, another client remarked, “he worked very hard to sell my home quickly and keep me fully informed throughout the process – I would recommend Mel to anyone.” Mel’s professionalism, efficiency, market knowledge, listening skills, reliance and dedication are qualities that only scratch the surface of what he does for his clients and customers on a daily basis.

Mel was the first agent to join Greenwood King’s brand new Heights Boulevard office in 1999. Every year since, he has been the Heights office top producer. Three years later, Mel was ranked as one of the “Top 25 Residential Real Estate Individuals” by the Houston Business Journal. His success as a leading real estate agent may be attributed to a maxim he strictly adheres to – “always treat clients as you would expect to be treated yourself.” Without a doubt, his philosophy works, as this dynamic agent has significantly impacted residential real estate in the Heights for more than 17 years.

Honesty distinguishes this experienced pro, who’s number one priority is to ensure his clients not get too wrapped up in the emotions involved. “Always buy and sell smart,” Mel stresses, comforting clients with the fact that he will do whatever it takes – working as long as needed – to negotiate the best deal. He also takes pride in working with first-time buyers and is delighted to guide them through every step of this complicated process.

Mel specializes in the Heights (where he grew up and currently resides), as well as various surrounding neighborhoods such as Oak Forest, Shady Acres, Timbergrove Manor, Montrose, Memorial, Spring Branch, the Museum District and Galveston. As if his service to the industry wasn’t enough, Mel’s sense of neighborhood extends well beyond his professional endeavors. He has been involved in numerous charitable organizations such as the Heights Association, Heights Boulevard Beautification, St. Andrew’s Church and Harvard Elementary.

The REal Hope Team by eXp Realty provides high-level, comprehensive real estate services with care, integrity, and attention to detail. Our specialized team works collaboratively to ensure every client receives expert guidance, clear communication, and a smooth transaction from start to finish.

Rooted in our community, we believe real estate is about more than buying and selling homes—it’s about people. We proudly give back by supporting organizations that serve children in foster care, using our work to help bring hope and stability to kids in need.

Our mission is simple: to guide our clients home while making a meaningful difference in the community we serve.

agents.bio:
I am an accomplished financial services and sales leader with over 20 years of experience in building and maintaining client relationships. Together with my husband, Reginald, we have bought and sold numerous properties as part time investors. After spending the last 10 years of my career as a corporate executive, I decided to leave the "Corporate Rat Race" and turn my part time passion into my next professional career.

Prior to joining First Class Realtors, I earned a Bachelor of Arts degree in Mass Communications from Xavier University of Louisiana. I began my professional career shortly thereafter doing a short stint at Universal Computer Systems as a Sales and Installation Specialist before joining what was then VALIC (now Corebridge Financial). While at Corebridge Financial, I served as Vice President of Strategic Relationship Management. I then transitioned to Lincoln Financial Group to what would be my last corporate role - Head of Small Market Relationship Management.

agents.bio: Fred A. Paskell has served the Houston community for almost 20 years, providing real estate solutions and learning from some of the very best in the business. A native Texan and Army Combat Veteran, Paskell began his career in the commercial real estate sector and has since evolved into a subject matter expert in many aspects of both commercial and residential real estate, including brokerage, valuation and investment analysis. Throughout his career he has worked for several notable and respected firms including Cushman & Wakefield, CBRE, Mohr Partners and the Newmark Group before starting his own practice in 2018. On the commercial side, Paskell focuses on Office, Industrial and Retail assets while being purely focused on the investment side of residential real estate. While beginning his college studies at Louisiana State University (and still a big LSU football fan), he earned both his M.B.A. in Real Estate Finance and B.B.A. in Marketing from the University of Houston, cum laude, with honors. Paskell is also a CCIM designee, the pinnacle designation for commercial investment real estate. Fred devoted ten years of his life to protecting our country in the U.S. Army, including two combat tours to Iraq with the 7th Squadron, 6th Cavalry Regiment as an AH-64 Apache Helicopter Crew-chief, completing his service at the rank of Staff Sergeant. He is also an avid scuba diver of over 26 years having reached the levels of divemaster, rescue diver and technical diver. With this passion he enjoys scuba diving and spearfishing on the offshore oil platforms in the Gulf of Mexico in his spare time as well as fishing, playing poker, staying healthy and spending time with friends and family . Paskell also volunteers for several groups serving disabled veterans, including being a member of the Armed Forces Appreciation Committee at the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo.

remarks: Welcome to this exceptional two-story traditional home with a stunning water view and tropical oasis backyard, offering a light-filled open-concept living. Impressive entry with a curved staircase is flanked by a formal dining and a private study, featuring rich wood flooring. Spacious island kitchen with updated countertops and finishes, opens seamlessly to the living room and overlooks the covered patio, sparkling pool, and rock waterfall. The first-floor primary suite features a crowned chandelier, a sitting area with a wall of windows capturing serene backyard views, and a beautifully remodeled en-suite bath with dual vanities, dual closets, and a frameless glass shower. Upstairs game room showcases breathtaking lake views, a study niche, and hidden storage. Additional highlights include a generator, a private driveway gate, and close proximity to community amenities. Guard-gated community w/ bus service available to Awty, BISH & Village schools.

agents.bio:
HOUSTON, TX
Mary Wassef is a proud Canadian who has made Houston her beloved home, emerging as a leading expert in luxury real estate within The Heights and its historic markets. With over two decades of experience, Mary blends her deep knowledge of historic architecture with modern construction techniques, offering a unique perspective to her diverse clientele. Her multicultural background and extensive network allow her to connect with clients from all walks of life, providing an empathetic and tailored real estate experience. Mary's unwavering commitment to her clients' dreams and goals truly sets her apart. She makes the real estate journey enjoyable and even fun, understanding the profound life changes it often represents. Her dedication extends to walking alongside her clients through every transaction, ensuring that each step is handled with precision and care. In 2011, Mary founded Circa Real Estate, which flourished under her leadership with a team of nearly 30 agents renowned for their personalized and unique services. Her approach is characterized by generosity, selflessness, and an unmatched work ethic, inspiring her team to consistently go above and beyond. Her 19th Street storefront stands as a testament to her commitment to community development, frequently hosting local art, community events, and support for neighborhood businesses. Recently, Mary has transitioned her team, the Circa Houston Group, to Realty of America, allowing her to expand her reach while maintaining the personalized service her clients have come to expect. For Mary, Houston's Heights is more than just a location; it's a cherished community. Whether you're buying, selling, or investing, Mary Wassef is your trusted partner in navigating this vibrant and historic Houston neighborhood.

remarks:
Prime Silver Lake Architectural Townhouse | Walk to the Reservoir

Located in the most prime pocket of Silver Lake — right off Silver Lake Blvd and minutes on foot to the Reservoir — this 1,816 sqft tri-level corner townhouse delivers privacy, light, and peek-a-boo Downtown LA views inside a gated 12-unit enclave.

A true 3-bedroom, 3-bathroom corner unit with only one shared wall, the home opens to a large living room with soaring ceilings, oversized windows, and a wall of light. The open layout flows up to a generous dining area with custom built-ins and architectural cable railings — an entertainer's floor plan with great flow and great bones. Upgraded plank flooring, crisp white walls, recessed lighting, and brand new dual-paned windows installed throughout give the home a clean, modern, move-in-ready feel.

The remodeled kitchen features stainless KitchenAid appliances, granite counters, gas range, and a sunlit pass-through to the home's standout feature: a private covered pergola patio — perfect for al fresco dinners, morning coffee, or unwinding under the open sky. A versatile lower-level bedroom with its own bath works beautifully as a guest suite, home office, or media room with direct patio access.

Upstairs, the primary suite is its own retreat — vaulted ceilings, walk-in closet, and a spa-inspired en-suite with dual vanity, freestanding soaking tub, and separate glass-enclosed shower. A second en-suite bedroom, powder room, and in-unit laundry complete the upper floor. Central A/C and heat, abundant storage, private 2-car garage, and ample guest parking within the gated complex.

Step outside your door and you're walking distance to Silver Lake Reservoir, the Meadow, Sunset Junction, LAMILL, Alimento, L&E Oyster Bar, Botanica, and Erewhon. Quick access to Echo Park, Los Feliz, DTLA, and the 101.

Architectural design, gated privacy, three full bedroom suites, two outdoor spaces, and a 2-car garage — Silver Lake townhouse living at its finest.

agents.bio:
Justin Chavez is a Houston real estate agent, brokerage owner, and real estate advisor serving Greater Houston, including The Woodlands, Conroe, Magnolia, Katy, Memorial, Tanglewood, Galleria / Uptown Houston, the Texas Medical Center area, and The Heights.

Justin is the Brokerage Owner of NextHome Woodland Springs, based in The Woodlands, Texas. He works with home buyers, home sellers, relocation clients, luxury buyers, move-up buyers, first-time homebuyers, investors, and new construction clients throughout the Houston market.

Justin has more than 8 years of real estate experience, has been licensed for 5 years, has helped clients through 100+ real estate transactions, and has closed more than $14 million in sales volume over the last 12 months. His experience includes resale homes, new construction homes, luxury properties, investment properties, relocation moves, and family home purchases.

Justin is recognized as a Top 1.5% real estate agent nationwide by RealTrends. He is also a NextHome President’s Circle Award recipient and was named a HAR YPN Top 20 Under 40 Realtor.

Clients work with Justin for clear guidance, pricing strategy, listing preparation, contract negotiation, builder relationships, buyer consultation, seller strategy, and transaction management. For sellers, he helps price and position the home correctly before it goes on the market. For buyers, he helps compare neighborhoods, understand market value, evaluate resale and new construction options, and move from the first showing to closing with a clear plan.

Justin also offers support for Chinese-speaking clients through his real estate partner, who speaks Chinese. This helps families, relocation clients, and international buyers receive clear communication throughout the buying or selling process.

His approach is simple: explain the process clearly, give honest advice, negotiate carefully, and help clients make confident real estate decisions in the Greater Houston area.

agents.bio:
HOUSTON, TX
Mary Wassef is a proud Canadian who has made Houston her beloved home, emerging as a leading expert in luxury real estate within The Heights and its historic markets. With over two decades of experience, Mary blends her deep knowledge of historic architecture with modern construction techniques, offering a unique perspective to her diverse clientele. Her multicultural background and extensive network allow her to connect with clients from all walks of life, providing an empathetic and tailored real estate experience. Mary's unwavering commitment to her clients' dreams and goals truly sets her apart. She makes the real estate journey enjoyable and even fun, understanding the profound life changes it often represents. Her dedication extends to walking alongside her clients through every transaction, ensuring that each step is handled with precision and care. In 2011, Mary founded Circa Real Estate, which flourished under her leadership with a team of nearly 30 agents renowned for their personalized and unique services. Her approach is characterized by generosity, selflessness, and an unmatched work ethic, inspiring her team to consistently go above and beyond. Her 19th Street storefront stands as a testament to her commitment to community development, frequently hosting local art, community events, and support for neighborhood businesses. Recently, Mary has transitioned her team, the Circa Houston Group, to Realty of America, allowing her to expand her reach while maintaining the personalized service her clients have come to expect. For Mary, Houston's Heights is more than just a location; it's a cherished community. Whether you're buying, selling, or investing, Mary Wassef is your trusted partner in navigating this vibrant and historic Houston neighborhood.

agents.bio:
As the Tricia Turner Group, we work with a team of qualified specialists to help with the sale of your home, from beginning to end.  We have put together a full marketing team, our own staging company, as well as a Preferred Partner Program, which involves a list of vendors that we know, like, and trust.

No truly successful company on the planet has one person doing everything, including the real estate company you hire. We would love to be your expert home selling advisors.

With over 25 years in the real estate industry, and having SOLD thousands of homes, TTG has put together some amazing plans and programs that are unique to our organization, and have the best results in achieving our goals.  We keep our eyes laser focused on the market and what’s ahead, while maintaining a unique culture within our organization.

Our belief in providing the best customer experience keeps us steadfast as innovators, as we continue to differentiate ourselves from our competition.  No other real estate company has employed such strategies and opportunities to help the consumer experience as TTG.

What separates us…

~ The Coming Soon Listing Program - we have a private FB group that we moderate which allows us to market our listings, before they are active, to the top producers in our industry~ 
~ Our own “Make it Pretty” Program allows you, the homeowner, to have repairs done on your home prior to listing, with no upfront cost to you
~ Professional STAGING INCLUDED with our own staging company Honeybee Homestaging & More
~ Our own 60 Step Listing Program - for optimal marketing on all listings which includes a partnership with Homes.com to maximize our exposure
~ Protect and Serve Program - we give discounts and rebates to all military, police officers, firefighters, first responders, and teachers
~ Easy Exit Listing Plan - you can fire us for any reason if you are not 100% satisfied 
~ Flexible Commission Plan - Pay as little as zero% commission
~ Immediate Buyout Program with our own CASH OFFER DIVISION
~ Love It or Leave It Program - if you’re not happy in your home during the first 12 months of owning it, we’ll sell it for you for FREE (waive the listing broker fee of 3%)
~ Immediate Response System - All buyer inquiries will be handled in 5 minutes or less and most often within the first 60 seconds
~ Reverse Offer Strategy - this lets us go to buyers that may be on the fence about your home and make an offer to them, with terms, conditions, and prices that are acceptable to all parties
~ Preferred Partner Program - a list of vendors that we work exclusively with - you can locate them at:   www.residentialservicedirectory.com
~ Move for Free - use of our company moving truck at no charge...forever

With the real estate industry always changing, it is imperative that we stay ahead of the curve and always have the best techniques to help you, the consumer, with one of the largest investments in your life

A great combination of location, comfort, and flexibility.

agents.bio:
Katherine Boddeker grew up in New York and loves the bustle of the big city, so her move to the more southern climate of Houston was a smooth transition. She studied dance at the High School of Performing and Visual Arts, and later attended University of Houston for business.

After college, Katherine entered the real estate world in 1989 and has never wanted to do anything else. If you're searching for an expert in the Houston housing market, look no further. She can help you buy, sell, lease, invest, or even build. Having spent nearly thirty years in the business, she is well versed in all areas of the city and all aspects of the market.

First and foremost, Katherine is a mom. She has spent years as an active advocate in her children's schools, both public and private. She understands how important finding the right school for families can be.

Katherine knows that home is where the heart is, and many times, that home includes pets. A lover of animals, she has spent much of her spare time with dog rescues. She has opened up her home for training, fostering, and interviewing potential owners to find the perfect home for these animals she has come to love. She volunteers at pet adoptions and fundraising activities.

remarks: Welcome HOME to 16523 Torry View Terrace. This immaculate single-story Perry home offers 4 bedrooms & 3 full baths with a thoughtful layout designed for both everyday living & entertaining. Soaring ceilings and an open flow connect the living, dining, and kitchen areas. The remodeled kitchen shines with custom soft-close cabinetry, granite countertops, SS appliances, dual pantries, and an oversized island at the heart of the home. The private primary suite features a spa-like bath, expansive walk-in shower, and generous walk-in closet. Secondary bedrooms are well-positioned for flexibility and privacy. Step outside to your backyard oasis featuring a covered patio with upgraded lighting and ceiling fans, plus a sparkling pool and spa resurfaced in 2025. A 3-car tandem garage and utility shed provide extra storage. Major system updates and meticulous maintenance mean this home is truly move-in ready. Comfort, quality, and lifestyle all in one place!

agents.bio:
The Bruner Team is currently a one-woman show—me, Elisa (Bruner) McNinch—and I’m honored to carry on the real estate legacy my parents began more than 40 years ago. Real estate has always been personal in our family, and that’s exactly how I still do business today: with genuine care, calm guidance, and a big dose of Southern hospitality.

I’m proud to have been recognized with the Five Star Professional Award for real estate customer service 13 years in a row (2012–2025)—an honor earned by fewer than 1% of Houston-area Realtors. I’m also a consistent multi-million dollar producer, but what matters most to me is that my clients feel heard, protected, and confident from start to finish.

If you ask where I work in Houston, you’ll probably hear me say: “If you divide Houston in half, I work the left-hand side.” I primarily serve Northwest Houston, and I’m very familiar throughout West Houston as well, including Spring, Tomball, Spring Branch, Cypress, Katy, and Richmond/Rosenberg.

Even though I’m tech-savvy (and yes—your home will be marketed online the right way), I still believe the best service happens voice-to-voice and face-to-face whenever possible. I’m hands-on with every client: meeting with sellers to stage and prepare a home, taking listings, coordinating photography, marketing, showing properties, hosting open houses, attending inspections—you name it. I’m the face and heart of The Bruner Team.

Behind the scenes, I’m supported by a trusted transaction coordinator who helps prepare listing documents and offers, tracks deadlines, and keeps everything moving smoothly—so you get both personal attention and professional precision.

If you’re looking for a knowledgeable agent who feels more like a steady partner than a sales pitch, I’d love to help you make your next move.

agents.bio:
Bea Flores, ABR, SRS, is a renowned figure in the Houston real estate market, with over 18 years of industry expertise. Her passion for real estate and dedication to exceptional service inspired her to establish her own brokerage, Luxe Living Group, over three years ago. Under her leadership, Bea has guided her team to remarkable success, earning recognition as one of Houston's top agents.

In December 2024, Bea and her team joined Compass Real Estate, a decision driven by the extensive marketing opportunities and advanced technology Compass offers. This move allows Luxe Living Group to enhance the already top-notch real estate experience they provide, giving clients access to cutting-edge tools and strategies that elevate every transaction.

Bea specializes in working with traditional buyers and sellers in Houston while carving out a niche in representing out-of-state institutional buyers across Texas cities like Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio. Her commitment to client education and transparent communication has earned her a loyal client base, with an impressive 85-90% of her business coming from repeat clients and referrals.

At Luxe Living Group, Bea ensures every client receives a luxurious and seamless experience, prioritizing meticulous attention to detail and comprehensive support to ensure success in every transaction.

Beyond her success as an agent, Bea is also a dedicated educator. For over nine years, she has been teaching real estate licensing courses, mentoring both agents and clients, and empowering them to navigate their real estate journeys with confidence.

Bea's outstanding achievements have earned her numerous accolades, including recognition among the Top 25 agents in Houston, a recent ranking among the Top 5 agents by production in the Houston Business Journal, and being featured in national publications such as Top Agent Magazine. She also served as President of the Women's Council of Realtors - Bay Area, Houston Chapter in 2013, further demonstrating her commitment to leadership and the advancement of the real estate profession.

With a foundation built on integrity, expertise, and an unwavering commitment to client satisfaction, Bea Flores and her team at Luxe Living Group, now proudly partnered with Compass, are dedicated to providing personalized, seamless real estate experiences that exceed expectations.

Whether assisting first-time homebuyers, seasoned investors, or those seeking luxury properties, Julie provides tailored strategies and expert guidance to ensure her clients make well-informed decisions.

Beyond real estate, Julie is deeply involved in her community, volunteering with Houston Food Bank, Habitat for Humanity, and the Breast Cancer Walk. When she’s not helping clients find their dream homes, you’ll likely find her soaking up the sun at the beach—her favorite place to unwind.

Whether buying, selling, or investing, Julie Wells is committed to delivering an exceptional real estate experience built on trust, expertise, and personalized service.

Evan Compean is the founder of The Compean Group, a boutique Houston real estate team known for data-driven pricing, high-end marketing and skilled negotiation. A licensed agent since 2012 and a real estate investor since 2002, Evan has sold more than $250 million in real estate and brings a builder's and investor's eye to every home, from foundation and roof to resale value.

Areas: Houston Heights, Woodland Heights, Garden Oaks/Oak Forest, Montrose, Midtown, West University, Bellaire, Spring Branch, Pearland, Katy, Cypress and The Woodlands.

Specialties: Luxury and new construction, investment and multifamily properties, land, first-time buyers, and relocation.

Evan is also a licensed loan officer and a partner at Smart Title, so clients get guidance on financing and closing from someone who knows every step. Se habla español. With 400+ five-star reviews across Zillow, Google, Yelp and Realtor.com, The Compean Group focuses on clear communication and a smooth process from first call to closing.

Houston Broker & Owner of The Zilveti Group, Andrés Zilveti creates exceptional experiences and optimal outcomes for buyers and sellers throughout the Greater Houston area backed by more than a decade of hands-on marketing experience. As a third-generation real estate professional, the business is practically in his DNA. Clients rave about his patient, understanding and professional approach, calling his ability to zero in on his customers' unique needs "brilliant."

Before getting his real estate license, Andrés ran a digital agency, where he honed the razor-sharp marketing and social media talents that are indispensable to his clients today. As the owner/broker of The Zilveti Group, he thrives on helping people move forward and upward in their lives, whether that means guiding a first-time home purchase, serving relocators and young professionals, or helping investors expand their portfolios. With Andres at the helm, clients at every price point enjoy attentive expert service backed by powerful industry know-how.

Andrés was raised in Austin and moved to Houston to attend the University of Houston, where he earned a bachelor's degree in public relations with a minor in art history. After a three-year stint as an expat in Perth, Australia, he returned to Houston. Andrés now resides in Spring Branch, where he appreciates the relaxing lifestyle and central location. When he's not hard at work for his clients, he enjoys spending time with his family and dogs and pursuing his passion for pickleball.

agents.bio:
It could be said that either, you have a passion for real estate or you simply don’t. Without a shadow of doubt, Richard has that passion. He achieved is first real estate license at the age of 18 years old in Johannesburg South Africa. Ever since getting his license, all he has known is residential real estate. Evidence of this, are the best listing and best selling awards he has received in his early years. His passion and energy has served him well. By the age of 21 years old, he was managing an estate agency consisting of 25 experienced estate agents. But that was not enough, with a bold vision and an idea, he decided to go into partnership and start his own residential brokerage in 2009. During this time, Richard earned the esteemed designation of Master Practitioner in Real Estate. He successfully grew the business into a leading estate agency in Alberton & Johannesburg South area in South Africa.

By 2017 a new challenge was calling. He founded Stratton Real Estate in Johannesburg. The business quickly grew into a successful boutique brokerage, which delivered a more personal “white-glove” experience. In 2019, Richard immigrated to Houston Texas, and instantly fell in love with the city and its people. They say, “you might not have been born in Texas, but you got here as quick as you could.” For Richard, this is true. He is always very excited to show new comers to Houston why this is the best place for them and their family.

Richard’s ability to succeed and become a leading estate agent can be attributed to some key traits which makes him stand out from the crowd, namely his high energy, caring, friendly and compassionate nature. When you couple this with his relentless drive, attention to detail, along with a winning, “can do” attitude, you have a uniquely dynamic and qualified property professional, who will guide you to realize, your real estate goals.

When Richard is not shaking up the Houston residential property market, he is spending his time with is beautiful wife Roxanne. Richard’s guilty pleasure is Tex-Mex, Texas BBQ and desserts. So if you like good food, just ask Richard where the best restaurants are. Richard is a big sport fans. Growing up just outside of Newcastle, England, he is a huge Newcastle United fan, and he is also a big Rugby fan and not to mention an enthusiastic Texans fan. Richard always welcomes a little friendly banter from opposing sports fans.

remarks: Located in the booming Spring Branch area, this beautifully maintained recent construction home offers a fantastic layout with 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, a home office, spacious game room, and a media room that could easily function as a 5th bedroom. Designed with both everyday living and entertaining in mind, the chef’s kitchen features a large quartz island, high-end appliances, Kent-Moore cabinetry, under-cabinet lighting, and a unique built-in water filler on the side of the island for pet bowls. The spacious primary suite includes double vanities with a dedicated makeup space, freestanding soaking tub, oversized walk-in shower, and a large walk-in closet. Additional highlights include wood flooring throughout the downstairs, upgraded designer lighting, stylish gas fireplace, expanded covered back patio, and tons of thoughtful upgrades and storage throughout the home. Great location with easy access to restaurants, shopping, and major freeways in one of Houston’s fastest-growing areas.

remarks: Offering a perfect blend of modern design, high-end comfort, and prime location, this property is located ideally along the Washington Corridor around shopping, dining and other amenities. Lloyd's real estate history for the last 24 years includes a strong background in commercial real estate as well as residential real estate. His knowledge of both fields has enabled him to provide a comprehensive service to many of his clientele.
More importantly, Lloyd has achieved these goals with the highest level of INTEGRITY and ETHICS. He believes that these traits are imperative in maintaining a strong customer base and in providing superior representation to his clients.

agents.bio:
With over a decade in the real estate industry, Jonathan Williamson has been a dynamic force in buying, selling, and managing properties. Since becoming a licensed agent in 2013, he has completed over 300 transactions, showcasing an unparalleled commitment to his clients and excellence in service.

Jonathan began his career in real estate as an investor and has personally acquired and sold tens of millions of dollars worth of real estate; a boast few realtors can make. He has experience flipping, remodeling, and building homes, and has also owned dozens of rental properties. This wealth of experience provides him with a deep understanding of the needs of builders and investors, which he skillfully leverages to the benefit of his clients. With Jonathan, clients are able to focus on their own needs in a home while he looks toward the future for any obstacles that might prevent them from getting top dollar for their investment.

Committed to the community, Jonathan has served on the board of the Women's Council of Realtors and the Art League of Houston. His passion for philanthropy extends to animal rescue and welfare, where he has fostered and found homes for dozens of animals in need.

Living in the charming heavily wooded subdivision of Grogan's Mill with his amazing wife and two beloved rescue dogs, Jonathan embraces a life of service, passion, and excellence. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, a seasoned investor, a home builder or somewhere in between, Jonathan is dedicated to making your real estate journey memorable and successful.

Henrry is a dedicated residential real estate agent specializing in the vibrant markets of Houston and Galveston. Before real estate, he spent 14 years in a career in sales and business development in the Oil & Gas industry which took him all over the world and now allows him to bring a diverse perspective and connect with a broad spectrum of clients. Yet his real estate journey started a decade earlier, after making the purchase of his first home, initially assisting and guiding friends and family with their home-buying processes based on his personal experiences. He quickly realized his natural aptitude for real estate and for the past 6 years, he has transformed his passion for real estate into a successful career, leading clients in the sale or purchase of their homes and investment, from first time home buyers to luxury homes and multi million dollar investments. Henrry has a true heart for people and is devoted to the welfare of his clients.

developerInfo.description:
Monte Vista Homes began with the vision of building world class homes, for homebuyers and for renters, in the Inland Empire.  

When other firms were stagnating through the Great Recession, Monte Vista Homes remained nimble and effective.  Today, with an eye on the art and science of building, the team works together to keep costs affordable, build timely, and design considerately, without sacrificing craftsmanship.  It is this mission that has made Monte Vista Homes a company to watch, in terms of excelling at processes and growth. 

These practices, not typical with public builders, are based in the flexibility and artisanship that could only come from a small private builder. That is why Monte Vista Homes proudly supports and is heavily involved in the building industry’s efforts to expand affordable homes, whether for purchase or rent, for all Californians.

agents.bio:
In January 2024, Angelina celebrated her 20th year in real estate!  Her journey began unexpectedly in 2004 when she inherited several rental properties after her mother's passing, becoming what she humorously calls an "unintentional landlord." Dissatisfied with the service provided by leasing agents, Angelina decided to take matters into her own hands and started taking real estate classes. By January 2006, she was a licensed Realtor with plans to only manage her rental properties but her warm demeanor and charisma propelled her to leave her full-time sales job and focus on real estate full time.  “I can’t believe it's been 20 years”, she admits, “and I have seen it all but it is still something new every day!”

Angelina reminds us it's still a “seller's market” in our area even with elevated mortgage rates.  She explains “With higher costs to rent, many renters have decided to buy instead of rent and build equity and in doing so they protect themselves from being priced out of the market in the future.  Other buyers have decided it is better to buy now with a higher interest rate but with today’s sales price instead of overpaying for a home later due to increased buyer competition in the summer months or when rates drop.” Angelina adds,  “There are even lenders that are offering no-cost refinances later when you use them as your lender now”. 

Angelina recommends that sellers consider listing their homes sooner rather than later if it makes sense. She explains that each situation is different but sellers may have fewer competing listings right now if they list before the summer.  Angelina declares “Early spring buyers are motivated buyers!” Sellers and buyers both need a Realtor with decades of wisdom and insight to formulate the best game plan. 

Along with her Broker’s license, attained in 2016, Angelina offers her clients ingenuity, diligence, and the wisdom that comes with almost 400 successful transactions. She skillfully navigates the most complex transactions such as relocation, divorce, and probate.  Drawing from her bachelor’s degree in psychology and background in sales, she caters to her client's unique needs.  Remaining abreast of evolving trends and technology, Angelina is a member of HAR.com’s  MLS Advisory Committee which underscores her dedication to enhancing industry standards for the benefit of agents and consumers alike. 

Beyond real estate, Angelina loves volunteering, supporting her children's activities, and planning fun activities for her friends and clients. Recognized for her numerous community contributions, she received the SBISD 2023 Good Neighbor Award.

remarks: Welcome to 15803 Echo Hill Drive, a lovely, single-story home that has been incredibly well-kept. Inside, you'll love the bright, open layout featuring modern vinyl plank flooring, tons of natural light, and a remodeled home office with a built-in desk. The kitchen offers a double oven and plenty of counter space, while the primary suite includes a convenient walk-in shower.Step outside to a covered backyard patio and new vinyl gutters. Plus, the refrigerator, washer, and dryer are all included!Enjoy a neighborhood with a community pool, park, and walking trails. You can walk to Armand Bayou Elementary, and HEB is right around the corner. You are also just minutes from NASA, UH Clear Lake, Kemah, and Galveston Bay.Best of all, it has never flooded and features a brand-new tankless water heater (2026), updated electrical panel, new toilets, energy-efficient windows with a transferable warranty, PEX plumbing (2009), a 2019 roof, and a 2018 HVAC. It's completely worry-free!

agents.bio:
Deborah’s impact extends far beyond the realm of real estate. With over 30 years of dedicated service as a full-time active Realtor running a team of successful agents, her influence is unmistakably felt. But what truly sets her apart is her deep-rooted commitment to her community.

Beyond the confines of real estate transactions, Deborah served 29 years as a volunteer firefighter in her city. 

Deborah's spirit of service is further illustrated by her involvement in a myriad of community outreach programs. Whether it's partnering with local organizations to uplift underserved neighborhoods or supporting initiatives that enhance the lives of those in the community she serves. Deborah consistently channels her energy towards making a positive impact where it's needed the most.

In times of crisis, Deborah's compassion and determination shine. Her volunteer work with Habitat for Humanity is a testament to her hands-on approach to rebuilding lives. Following the devastation of Hurricane Harvey, Deborah rolled up her sleeves to help rebuild homes, bringing hope and solace to those affected by the catastrophic flood. Her commitment to not just rebuilding structures, but restoring lives, echoes her profound understanding of the human element within every real estate transaction.

As a leader in the real estate industry, Deborah‘s involvement in community outreach programs, and dedication to post-disaster rebuilding are not just separate chapters in her life—they are threads interwoven with her core values. Deborah's legacy is one that transcends transactional success, leaving an indelible mark on the lives of individuals and the fabric of her community. Her community passion is evident not only in her professional life but also in her service to her community.

Since 2013, I’ve proudly served Seabrook and the surrounding Clear Lake communities as a trusted REALTOR®. With over a decade of experience, I specialize in waterfront and lifestyle properties, helping buyers and sellers achieve their real estate goals with confidence. My approach is rooted in honesty, local expertise, and personalized service — whether you’re purchasing your first home, upgrading to your dream property, or investing in the coastal lifestyle. As a long-time Seabrook resident, I understand the unique charm of our community and the value of living near the water. I’m passionate about giving back, staying engaged in local events, and building lasting relationships with clients. My mission is simple: to deliver results while making the process seamless, enjoyable, and tailored to your needs.

remarks: Welcome to this exceptional 1-story Perry Home on a massive 13,766 sq ft lot in the Lakeshore community! Spanning 3,575 sq ft, this 4-bed, 3.5-bath showplace features a grand entry flanked by an elegant library and formal dining room. The gourmet island kitchen boasts granite counters, 42” raised-panel cabinetry, a Butler’s pantry, and GE Profile stainless appliances. It opens seamlessly to the family room, highlighted by soaring 12’ ceilings, a cast stone fireplace, and abundant natural light. Entertain easily in the adjoining game room! Retreat to the luxurious primary suite featuring a dramatic curved wall of windows and a spa-like bath with a soaking tub and separate glass shower. A private guest suite with a full bath is perfect for visitors. Outside, enjoy a covered patio and a huge, pool-ready backyard. Complete with a 3-car tandem garage and fantastic community amenities near Lake Houston, this home truly has it all!

remarks: Experience refined Brentwood living in this tastefully remodeled front-facing corner residence at the desirable Villa Monet. This spacious 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers a thoughtfully designed floor plan filled with natural light and an effortless flow between living spaces. An elegant foyer opens to the inviting living room with fireplace, seamlessly connecting to the dining area, private balcony, and updated kitchen featuring quartz countertops and custom cabinetry. The expansive primary suite serves as a true retreat with its own fireplace, dual closets including a generous walk-in closet, and a spa-inspired bath complete with dual vanities, oversized shower, and soaking tub. Privately situated on the opposite side of the home, the guest suite features an en-suite bath and private balcony, offering ideal comfort and flexibility for guests or a home office. Additional highlights include wide-plank engineered hardwood flooring, recessed lighting, central HVAC, in-unit washer and dryer, dedicated storage locker, and tandem parking for two cars. Villa Monet residents enjoy access to premium amenities including an indoor pool, sauna, fitness center, and ample guest parking. HOA dues include water, trash, sewer, and earthquake insurance. Ideally located just moments from Brentwood's best shopping, dining, cafes, and entertainment, with convenient access to UCLA, the Westside beaches, major freeways, and public transportation.

agents.bio:
Recognized as a top-producing agent since 2011, David Lukan has commanded industry-wide attention through his discerning eye and strong negotiation skills that have enabled him to establish a flawless track record of success for his clients. As both an East Coast and European transplant living in Southern California for over 20 years, David has an intimate knowledge of Los Angeles and the diverse communities within. As a client-focused, results-driven Realtor and lifelong Houstonian, Tracy Brandon is ready to guide you on your Houston home journey, making sure you feel right at home throughout the process. Tracy has a passion for relationship building and connecting people with other people, places, and things that create a meaningful impact. As a licensed real estate agent, that passion shines through in a variety of ways, including her commitment to finding you a home in a neighborhood that will have a positive, meaningful impact on your life.

Thanks to her previous career in Supply Chain Management (with 20+ years of experience as a Procurement and Contracts Manager), Tracy brings a unique skill set and perspective to her work as a Realtor. That experience helped her become savvy at the art of negotiation and keenly adept at writing contracts that bring value. In addition, her former career contributes to her excellent ability to work with people from different cultures, backgrounds, and professions.

Tracy is a lifelong resident of Houston and a long-term resident of the Heights and inner city. That means she has immense knowledge of inner loop neighborhoods and communities, which she utilizes every day, both as a Realtor and as an active Houston urbanite. She's always in the know when it comes to fun activities, restaurants, and nightlife around the city so don't hesitate to reach out for a recommendation. Tracy is also an ardent music fan and a live music enthusiastshe even used to book live shows! These days, she gives back to the Houston area by volunteering within the music community and working with local artists and venues to promote the Houston music scene and all that it has to offer. Tracy's daughter is her greatest joy in life, and they enjoy experiencing their shared passion for live music together.

agents.bio:
Hello and welcome! I’m Caroline Daniel, founder and Broker of Sterling Realty and Lending here in beautiful Los Angeles. For over 25 years, I’ve had the joy of helping people turn their real estate dreams into reality — whether that’s finding a forever home, building a business space, or creating a path toward financial independence.

My journey in real estate has been about more than just buying and selling property — it’s about building lasting relationships and guiding clients through some of the most meaningful decisions of their lives. I take pride in really getting to know the people I work with, understanding their goals, and helping them make choices that set them up for long-term success.

In addition to real estate, I’m licensed in Insurance and Financial Services, allowing me to take a holistic approach to financial planning and wealth building. My clients appreciate that I can look at the bigger picture — helping them protect what they’ve built and plan for the future with confidence.

One of the most fulfilling parts of my work has been serving and mentoring military veterans. Helping veterans navigate homeownership, financial stability, and entrepreneurship has been a true honor and a way for me to give back to those who have given so much.

At Sterling Realty and Lending, we believe in honesty, integrity, and service from the heart. Every client is family here, and I’m committed to making your experience not only successful but also personal, supportive, and rewarding.

remarks: This magnificent gated residence has recently been adorned with a fresh coat of paint. The entryway, characterized by its high ceilings, leads to the exquisite living area and dining room, both graced with wood flooring. The magnificent wood stairs leads to the second floor with the primary bedroom featuring laminate flooring, LED lighting, and a balcony overlooking the expansive backyard. The primary bathroom features a separate shower and jacuzzi tub, accompanied by a large walk-in closet. The secondary bedroom, featuring a custom paint job and extended seating area, presents a unique charm. The majority of the light switches also provide an automatic sensor function. Large private backyard including a dedicated generator outlet. New complete A/C system. The community offers pool & gazebos.

agents.bio:
Carrie Nelson – Trusted Real Estate Professional

Carrie Nelson, originally from Teague, Texas, grew up in Deer Park and has called the Clear Lake area home for the past 25 years.

Her career began in early childhood education, where she taught at a Christian preschool before transitioning into management with a UK-based oil and gas company. It was during this time that she adopted her guiding philosophy: every problem is simply an opportunity to find a solution. This perspective has become a cornerstone of her success in real estate.

Known for her exceptional attention to detail, Carrie takes pride in guiding clients through every step of the buying and selling process. Her hands-on approach ensures clients feel informed, confident, and comfortable with their decisions. Whether assisting first-time buyers, seasoned investors, or families preparing to sell, Carrie provides personalized service tailored to each client’s needs.

Carrie’s dedication is rooted in her values of honesty, trustworthiness, and loyalty. Her genuine passion for helping people shines through in her commitment to delivering seamless transactions and positive experiences.

Outside of real estate, Carrie has been happily married for 35 years. She and her husband are proud parents of five children and delight in spending time with their six grandchildren.
