Michael is a real estate professional affiliated with Compass Real Estate in Houston, Texas, primarily serving the vibrant Heights area. Since 2009, he has built a reputation for dedication, expertise, and a deep commitment to both his clients and community.

Michael is an active member of the Houston LGBT Chamber of Commerce and The LGBTQ+ Real Estate Alliance, and he is a past president of the Women’s Council of Realtors Houston Network. His credentials include a wide range of professional designations: CRS, RSPS, CHMS, PMN, TAHS, HFR, and CIPS.

In addition to his real estate career, Michael is a passionate community leader. He is a graduate of Avenue CDC’s Advocacy Fellowship and a certified T4T Trainer through LISC’s Training for Trainers program. He is a past president of the Lindale Park Civic Club and is honored to be the FitHouston Ambassador for the Moody Park Saturday morning walking group. Michael takes pride in making a lasting impact in Lindale Park—the neighborhood he proudly calls home.

remarks: Ideally located in Memorial Bend, zoned to Spring Branch ISD and the prestigious Memorial High School, and just steps from Terry Hershey Park's world-class hike and bike trails, 211 Faust Lane checks every box for the discerning Houston buyer. This 5-bedroom, 3.5-bath traditional home offers 3,698 sq ft on a sprawling .365-acre lot with a fenced backyard and patio — plenty of room for a future pool. The primary suite on the second floor features a spacious sitting area ideal for a home office, nursery, or workout space, while two bedrooms downstairs, including one with an en-suite bath, offer flexible living arrangements for guests or multigenerational needs. Inside, enjoy soaring ceilings, hardwood floors, a gaslog fireplace, granite countertops, gas cooktop, and a kitchen that opens to the family room. This is Memorial living at its finest.

With over 40 years of calling Houston home, Jen Tran has developed an intimate understanding of the city's diverse neighborhoods, market trends, and hidden gems.

As a top-producing realtor at KW Memorial Houston, Jen stands out for her unwavering commitment to exceeding client expectations. Whether you're buying, selling, or investing in Houston's dynamic real estate market, Jen Tran is your trusted guide, leveraging her analytical prowess and strategic mindset to secure the best deals for her clients.

What sets Jen apart is her ability to translate complex data into actionable insights, empowering clients to make informed decisions with confidence. From meticulously crafting marketing strategies to skillfully negotiating contracts, Jen Tran ensures a seamless and rewarding real estate experience every step of the way.

remarks: New Price Exceptional Value in the Beverlywood Vicinity! Discover a rare opportunity to own a charming California bungalow in one of the Westside's most sought-after neighborhoods. Whether you're looking for your next home, a Westside investment, or a property with future upside, this newly priced bungalow delivers exceptional value in a premier location. Motivated seller ready to consider reasonable offers.

It’s easy to see why so many have trusted Walter with the most important transactions of their lives. At any moment, you’ll find him going above and beyond the call of duty, fighting to turn every client’s dreams into a reality. Even after more than 20 years as an agent, his dedication is stronger than ever and he’s never stopped improving his services. In doing so, Walter recently made the move to Keller Williams Los Feliz; joining an elite team of real estate professionals who echo his commitment to clients and allow him to build upon his array of stellar services. Simply put, the best is truly yet to come.

agents.bio:
Being awarded the 20 Under 40 Rising Star in Real Estate by the Houston Association of Realtors in 2021, and consistently in the top 1% of all Houston real estate agents in production volume, Jihye has risen to be a young leader in the real estate profession. She has experience across the real estate spectrum, including single-family homes, historical properties, lots, townhomes, and condominiums. Her success continues to grow thanks to hard work, diligence, and referrals from prior clients.

Her career started out in accounting and finance at KPMG and then Phillips66, and the valuable skills she gained has enabled her to serve her clients and provide them with the best combination of business acumen, professionalism, and mindfulness. As an agent with Compass, the nation's #1 real estate brokerage, she is equipped with best-in-industry technology and can provide her clients with support and services that they will not find anywhere else. Due to her highly personable nature and exceptional customer service, people come to Jihye as clients but leave as friends.

For sellers, she provides the best suite of services you can ask for: professional photography, staging consultation with a professional stager and available funds through the Compass Concierge program, to prepare your home for sale by fronting the cost of home improvement services like staging, painting and more. She treats each listing as if it were her own home for sale and negotiates for top dollar!

For buyers, she knows that this is one of the biggest investment decisions they will make, so she strives to be transparent and honest about the market and the process. Jihye knows that for many buyers they aren't simply looking for a house, they are looking for a place to call home. Whether the client is a first-time homebuyer or a couple or family looking to upgrade, she can help you navigate through the different market areas and provide insights into communities and schools. She keeps her pulse on the market daily. Due to her great relationships with many agents, Jihye has knowledge of coming-soon homes and has been able to get her clients previews before homes are even listed. Also, being a foodie and active in the city, she can provide information to buyers new to Houston on the upsides and downsides of different areas in the city.

In addition to being a top-performing Realtor®, Jihye is an Accredited Luxury Home Specialist, Certified Negotiation Expert and Accredited Buyer's Rep as well as being a member of the Houston Association of Realtors®, Texas Association of Realtors® and National Association of Realtors®. Jihye is also an avid marathon runner, having run in Boston, Germany, multiple marathons in Houston and a 50-mile ultra-marathon around Lake Tahoe.

remarks: Nestled in the coveted Upper North Kentwood neighborhood of Westchester, 7412 Stewart Avenue presents a rare opportunity to enjoy timeless coastal-inspired living in one of the community's most sought-after locations. This charming center courtyard Light House-style residence offers 3 bedrooms, 3 bathrooms, and approximately 1,965 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space filled with warmth, character, and exceptional indoor-outdoor flow. A classic brick walkway leads from the grassy front yard to the welcoming front porch, while curated garden beds add color and charm to the home's picturesque curb appeal. Inside, the formal living room overlooks the front grounds and is anchored by a gas fireplace, creating an inviting space to gather and unwind. Toward the rear of the home, a generous family room showcases beamed ceilings and a wall of picture windows that frame tranquil backyard views and flood the space with natural light. Centrally positioned between the living spaces, the kitchen blends functionality and warmth with caesarstone countertops, a gas cooktop, dual ovens, and a charming corner sink with greenhouse window. A convenient passthrough pocket makes entertaining effortless, while direct access to the home's signature center courtyard creates the perfect setting for al fresco dining, morning coffee, or evenings under the stars. The private backyard retreat offers a serene escape with mature citrus trees, a brick paver patio, and an in-ground spa. The primary suite enjoys peaceful courtyard views, complemented by a well-appointed ensuite bathroom with a separate shower. Two additional bedrooms, one with its own ensuite bath, provide comfort and flexibility for family, guests, or work-from-home living. The main bathroom off the hallway enhances everyday convenience and features a spacious soaking tub along with a separate shower, adding a touch of spa-like relaxation to the home. A detached two-car garage with a bonus storage room tucked behind adds valuable flexibility for additional storage, hobbies, or creative space. Adding even more long-term potential, a future second-story addition could capture sweeping vistas of the Marina, Pacific Ocean, and Santa Monica Mountains, an exceptional opportunity to further elevate both lifestyle and value. Perfectly positioned within the Westchester neighborhood, this special home is just moments from the Bluff Creek Trail entrance, offering easy access to scenic walking and biking paths connecting to Playa Vista, Silicon Beach, and the coast. Nearby enjoy the vibrant dining, shopping, and recreation of Playa Vista and Marina del Rey, along with Loyola Marymount University, local parks, highly regarded schools, and convenient access to LAX and the Westside. Combining charm, location, and future potential, this is a truly exceptional offering in one of Westchester's premier enclaves.

remarks:
Tucked behind a private gate in the coveted HPOZ neighborhood of Wilshire Park, this beautifully updated home offers a rare combination of historic charm and updated modern living.

The main residence features 2 bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom, plus a large upstairs den/loft that can easily function as a third bedroom, office, media room, or flex space. With 3.5 bathrooms in the main house, the layout is thoughtfully designed for both comfortable living and entertaining.

The open-concept living and dining area showcases soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, a cozy fireplace, and elegant marble flooring. Recessed lighting throughout the home enhances the bright, polished atmosphere.

The fully upgraded kitchen is a standout feature, offering newer cabinetry, quartz countertops, a stylish backsplash, and a coordinated suite of energy-efficient black stainless-steel appliances.

The oversized primary suite serves as a private retreat, complete with a luxurious en-suite bath featuring a separate soaking tub, walk-in shower, and generous cabinet space.

Adding even more value and flexibility is the detached converted garage approximately 252 sq ft, complete with its own refrigerator, washer/dryer and full bathroom. Perfect as a guest suite, home office, creative studio, or potential income-producing space, this bonus structure expands the home's functionality well beyond the main residence.

Additional highlights include an EV charger, washer /dryer, and refrigerator, not to mention the mature and beautiful lemon tree and persimmon tree that yield abundantly throughout the seasons. The large backyard and driveway are hardscaped to create a perfect canvas for an outdoor entertainment area with enough room to fit at least 4 cars.

Ideally located just minutes from Larchmont Village, Hancock Park, Koreatown, Miracle Mile, and major freeways including the 10 and 110, this gated Wilshire Park gem combines character, convenience, and versatile living in one exceptional property. This home qualifies for a $20K Grant with City National Bank!

agents.bio:
Over 18 years and hundreds of millions of dollars in Houston closings taught me one thing that never changes: the deal is won before anyone signs — in the prep, the pricing, and the negotiation. That's where I go to work for you.

I'm Le Nguyen, Broker and Owner of Go-M Realty, and I took the road less traveled to get here. I hold an accounting degree from UH-Downtown, so I read a contract the way few agents do — every number, every clause, every dollar that should stay in your pocket. Before real estate, I worked as a contractor for the U.S. Army in Kirkuk, Iraq, during the war as a purchaser, handling logistics, supplies and contracts. I also spent 16 years coaching competitive women's gymnastics — a sport where everything comes down to preparation, nerve, and executing when it counts. Those chapters shaped how I run a deal today. The numbers stay tight, and I don't flinch when the stakes climb.

When it's time to sell, I don't sit on a listing and hope. I market it hard — sharp pricing, strong presentation, and a strategy built to put your property in front of the right buyers fast. I'm a Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist and a Certified Negotiation Expert, but the part of my business I'm proudest of is the referrals. remarks: Experience the perfect blend of style, space, and convenience in this beautifully updated Sonoma Ranch home. Offering 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and 3,002 sq ft, this home is designed for both everyday living and effortless entertaining. The open-concept layout is anchored by a stunning custom media wall with fireplace, creating a warm and inviting focal point. The designer kitchen features striking two-tone cabinetry, modern finishes, and generous space to gather. The downstairs primary suite offers a private retreat with a spa-inspired bath and walk-in closet. Upstairs, enjoy a massive game room and exceptionally spacious secondary bedrooms rarely found in newer construction. Step outside to a large backyard with no rear neighbors for added privacy. Ideally located with quick access to Beltway 8, I-10, and Hwy 59, and just 20 minutes to Downtown Houston and IAH...this home delivers both lifestyle and location. Schedule a tour today!

agents.bio:
As a native Houstonian and experienced real estate professional, I believe exceptional real estate service begins with understanding what matters most to my clients. My approach is rooted in relationships, built on trust, and driven by a commitment to providing thoughtful guidance, strategic expertise, and personalized service throughout every step of the real estate journey.

Before beginning my real estate career, I spent more than 15 years in executive sales and contract negotiations within the technology industry. Today, I combine that business experience with my knowledge of the Houston real estate market to provide skilled negotiation, strategic advice, and a concierge-level experience tailored to each client's unique needs and goals.

As a homeowner, landlord, and real estate investor myself, I understand firsthand that real estate is more than a transaction. It's a significant financial investment, a lifestyle decision, and often the beginning of an exciting new chapter. Whether you're buying or selling a luxury home, relocating to Houston, purchasing your first home, or exploring investment opportunities, my priority is to protect your interests, simplify the process, and help you make confident, informed decisions.

I proudly serve Houston and its surrounding communities, and I've built my business on integrity, personal connections, and lasting relationships. Nothing means more to me than earning the trust of my clients and knowing they feel confident referring their friends, family, and colleagues to me for the same exceptional level of service.

For me, success isn't simply measured by homes bought and sold. It's measured by the relationships I build, the trust I earn, and the experience I deliver.

I love Houston, I love real estate, and most importantly, I love helping people achieve their goals. I would welcome the opportunity to do the same for you.

Rooted in Houston. Rooted in Relationships. Rooted in What Matters.

remarks: Welcome to this charming 1-story open floor plan, 4-bedroom, and 2.5 bath home located in a quiet Grand Oaks Subdivision. Zoned to highly rated Cyfair schools. This spacious home offers large tile floors throughout the formal dining room, kitchen, breakfast room, and formal living room, high ceilings, and new carpets in all bedrooms. The kitchen features SS appliances with a new dishwasher, walk-in pantry, granite countertops, and dark, rich cabinetry. The open-concept layout creates a warm, inviting atmosphere perfect for both everyday living and entertaining. Oversized main suite with nice bathroom includes double sinks, a garden tub, a separate shower, and a huge walk-in closet. No back neighbors. Big backyard with a covered patio. Residents enjoy the community pool, parks, and playground. Easy access to Hwy 6, I-10, and the Grand Parkway puts shopping, dining, and the Energy Corridor within easy reach.

agents.bio:
A little about me! I was born in Houston and raised in the Dallas/Fort Worth Metro Area.  I moved back to Houston (Dickinson) in 2007 and was happy to live closer to family again.  I went into Real Estate because I have a passion for helping people, and how better to do that than to be a part of the process of helping people build a future and live out the American dream of homeownership!  Watching people fall in love with their new home, or selling their current one is fun and exciting, and I have had the honor of being in the top 1% of sales in my office, earning the respect of my fellow REALTORS, and helping many clients.  Prior to Real Estate, I earned my Bachelor of Business from Dallas Baptist University and minored in Psychology.  I also had worked in telecommunications for 25 years, most recently as a Project Manager/Contracts Negotiator for custom contracts all over the world. My wife, Becky (who is also a Realtor), and I also own a small farm, where we hatch, raise, and sell heritage and specialty breeds of chickens, turkeys, and guineas, as well as farm fresh eggs. We focus on pasture-raised flocks and feed only high-quality and Non-GMO/Soy-free feed products.  I look forward to working with you to make your Real Estate dreams a reality!

Jim Atkinson is a Broker Associate, REALTOR® and the Team Leader for Hidden Paradise Realty Team at UTR - Texas, Realtors, located in Houston, Texas, near NASA.  Our team is comprised of experienced Agents who have a passion for real estate, and who are ready to assist you with all your buying, selling, or rental needs!  Our team is structured differently than most teams, as we don't have buyer's agents or seller's agents, who simply hand you off to someone else once the contract is signed.  Rather, we believe in the value of relationships, and we know that the relationship you have with your Agent is extremely vital to you during your home buying, selling, or renting experience. We have an amazing Transaction Coordinator to assist you and our Agents throughout the process, but your Agent will remain actively involved - all the way to the closing table and beyond!

remarks: Stunning and chic, this four-bedroom, three-bath Thomas James farmhouse offers the perfect blend of modern elegance, thoughtful design, and exceptional craftsmanship. Newly built in 2018, this beautifully appointed two-story residence showcases outstanding curb appeal with a charming white picket fence, newly landscaped grounds, and an attractive paver-pattern driveway. A welcoming front porch leads into a light-filled interior highlighted by expansive ceilings and an ideal open-concept floorplan designed for today's lifestyle. Wide-plank White Oak flooring flows throughout the main level, where the spacious living room features a classic marble fireplace and sliding glass doors that seamlessly connect to the private backyard, creating effortless indoor-outdoor living. The gourmet kitchen is a true showpiece, appointed with top-of-the-line Bertazzoni appliances, custom cabinetry, sparkling Caesarstone countertops, and a timeless subway tile backsplash. A large statement island with prep sink and breakfast bar, along with a generous walk-in pantry, make this space both beautiful and functional for everyday living and entertaining. The first floor also offers a versatile guest bedroom or home office and a full bathroom, providing flexibility for guests, remote work, or multigenerational living. Direct access from the attached two-car garage adds convenience to daily life. Upstairs, a spacious media loft creates the perfect entertainment or relaxation space, complemented by a well-appointed laundry room, three additional bedrooms, and two bathrooms. The luxurious primary suite serves as a private retreat, featuring a large walk-in closet and a spa-inspired ensuite bath complete with a double vanity, oversized walk-in shower, raised soaking tub, and large picture window that fills the space with natural light. Outside, the expansive grassy backyard provides an inviting setting for entertaining, play, or simply enjoying Southern California's year-round sunshine. Combining timeless farmhouse style, premium finishes, and a highly desirable layout, this exceptional home presents a rare opportunity to enjoy sophisticated living in one of Los Angeles' most sought-after neighborhoods.

agents.bio:
In 2024 and 2025, Stephanie Younger was the #1 agent in the City of Los Angeles and the Westchester Neighborhood, selling more Single-Family homes than any other real estate agent or team. With unmatched expertise in Westside and South Bay neighborhoods, Stephanie and her team have built their brand on a reputation for service that exceeds all expectations.

Why Buyers and Sellers Choose Stephanie Younger:

- Ranked #11 Sales Team in LA County by the LA Business Journal (2024)
- Over $3 billion in lifetime sales.
- Consistently ranked a top producer in West LA real estate
- Featured in The LA Times, The Argonaut, Dwell, SpectrumNews, The RealDeal and more
- Neighborhood Expert: West LA & the Silicon Beach Corridor

As a Los Angeles native and long-time Westchester resident, Stephanie offers hyper-local knowledge that few agents can match. She specializes in: Westchester, Playa del Rey, Playa Vista, Marina del Rey, Culver City, Venice, and El Segundo

What Makes Stephanie Different?

- Stephanie's unique background in sales, event planning, hospitality, and the arts makes her an expert in both marketing and negotiation.
- She believes: “Real estate, like life, is all about getting the details right.”

Her Process Includes:

- Helping clients define and align their vision, goals, and budget
- Managing complex transactions with clear communication
- Navigating escrow, lending, and inspections with zero surprises
- Leading a high-performing team to deliver seamless service

Local, Loyal, and Living Here...

Stephanie lives in Westchester with her husband—a playwright and LMU professor—and their two children. She’s proud to serve the neighborhoods she calls home, and her passion for community is reflected in her generous support of local charitable organizations including the YMCA, Westchester Arts and Music Block Party, and more.

A Southern California native, Ron Melendez has lived all over the Los Angeles area. Growing up in the San Gabriel Valley, he would head over to the beaches of Orange County to surf. After moving to Westwood to attend U.C.L.A., Ron has lived in Santa Monica, the Valley, and West Hollywood, before finally settling with his family in the South Bay. They now live in Manhattan Beach’s Tree Section where his daughters attend American Martyrs School.

Ron believes in real estate done right. And he believes that the most important way to do that is to listen to really hear what the client wants and needs, and to put all other concerns aside in pursuit of that. Ron knows how important your decision to buy or sell a property is. After 30 years working as an actor working in both TV and Film, Ron has brought that passion to real estate. He loves helping people find the perfect place to call home or helping someone get the best price for their property so that they can achieve their dreams. He believes that this job is all about service. At the end of the day, he wants to look back and know that he always did right by his clients.

Neil Chhabria's areas of expertise and service include Palos Verdes Estates, Rancho Palos Verdes, Rolling Hills, Rolling Hills Estates, Redondo Beach, Hermosa Beach, Manhattan Beach, and Torrance. Growing up in a Realtor family in Palos Verdes (his father Raju Chhabria is one of the most productive Realtors in all of the country) Neil was exposed to the selling process and local markets his whole life. After graduating from the University of San Diego in 2009, Neil went straight to assisting his dad as well as helping buy and sell real estate for clients of his own. Neil has held a salesperson license for over 5 years and has been an active Realtor for over 3 years. He truly enjoys helping people find their perfect home and working with people who appreciate his service - he's practically available 24/7 for his clients. Being under the tutelage of his father, Neil has access to a wealth of knowledge, experience, information, and many other resources, all of which he leverages in favor of his clients. He is accustomed to working with busy hardworking people who have a true need for a home and are really depending on him to make sure the buying/selling process goes smoothly and seamlessly. Of course, the buying/selling process could not happen so seamlessly without the help of his great team. Neil has two offices to serve our clients - one in Hermosa Beach and one in Palos Verdes Estates. Additionally, they have a very experienced and dedicated team of licensed transaction coordinators, assistants, and agents.

remarks: Amazing home in Historic Houston Heights. Three story six bedroom four- and one-half bath. Large Gourmet kitchen and dining area with generous living room and bedrooms. Refrigerator and clothes washer and dryer stay with the sale of the property. This property has two entrances, one on White Oak Drive and one on Oxford Street. Ground floor formally used as a commercial office space with residence on second and third floor and converted to a single family. This could easily be converted back, to rent out the first floor or use as an office again or utilize as is. There is not an HOA, no deed restrictions, and not located in a Historical District. Short term rentals are allowed. This home is located on the MKT hiking/biking trail in the heart of The Heights. Many other options with this property, do not miss your opportunity to tour this incredible home. Verify room dimensions for accuracy.

agents.bio:
There is an elegance to the way in which Aaron Sonnier works. He manages every detail, no matter how small. He is committed to excellence in service and luxury in every way. He curates his every choice with refinement and grace.

That would explain why he is an esteemed member of Martha Turner's Circle of Excellence.

Nothing compares when it comes to the unsurpassed attention he pays to every client and every property, right down to the clothes he wears and the image he projects. It is no wonder why he was voted Best Dressed Realtor (2019) by Realtor Magazine.

Originally from Lake Charles, Louisiana, Aaron holds a Bachelor of Fine Arts Degree with a concentration in Photography and Painting from USL in Lafayette, Louisiana.

It is his impeccable work ethic and his degree in fine arts combined with his unparalleled experience in branding, management, and leadership that makes him such a force.

He has thirty years of retail industry experience and owns a concierge and construction management company. His success in the real estate world comes from knowing how to lead, how to negotiate, and how to make things happen brilliantly and without exception.

For Aaron, doing the right thing, means attending to any client need that may arise from driving contracts to and from title companies, meeting mobile notaries on site, reading the meter on a prospective sale, and staging a home.

Aaron is acutely aware that the key to the best transactions is impeccable communication, and there is nothing at which Aaron is more skilled. He answers every call and responds to every text. The time of day is no matter – what matters is always delivering the most refined service each and every time.

Paramount to all of Aaron’s work is building lasting relationships and helping clients to make the most informed decisions. Whether it is a home or a piece of property, whether a client is buying or selling, Aaron instills in clients the kind of confidence that can only come from working with a discerning professional of the highest caliber.

No decision has ever been easier for Aaron than choosing to be a part of the Martha Turner Sotheby’s International Realty team. Having superior tools and the latest in technology at his fingertips, allows Aaron - a 2020 Top Producer at his previous firm - to always be one step ahead of the competition.

In the high stakes world of real estate, you do not just want to get a property on the market, you want to get it the attention it deserves. Aaron Sonnier gets every property and client the attention they deserve.

remarks: Set high atop the coveted Baldwin Vista neighborhood, this beautifully remodeled California Ranch pairs timeless mid-century architecture with a fresh, modern sensibility. A landscaped, drought-tolerant front yard creates a memorable first impression and hints at the thoughtful updates found throughout the home. Inside, expansive south-facing windows fill the home with natural light and highlight rich oak hardwood floors that extend throughout. The formal living room is anchored by a striking wall of custom built-in bookshelves, while the adjacent family room brings warmth and character with exposed beam ceilings and a gas fireplace. The living spaces transition comfortably into the dining area and fully renovated kitchen, creating a layout equally suited for everyday life and entertaining. The kitchen balances function and style with quartz countertops, custom cabinetry, premium stainless steel Fisher & Paykel appliances, a generous eat-at peninsula, pantry, built-in workstation, and abundant storage. Recessed lighting, designer finishes, and beautifully updated bathrooms continue the elevated feel throughout the home. All three bedrooms are well proportioned, including a charming secondary bedroom with a built-in window seat. The peaceful primary suite opens directly to the backyard through sliding glass doors. Thoughtfully reimagined by a landscape architect for seamless indoor-outdoor living and entertaining, the outdoor spaces offer multiple destinations to gather and unwind. A new entertaining deck, additional hillside view deck, mature orange and lemon trees, and an expansive grassy yard create a setting made for summer dinners, weekend gatherings, and everyday enjoyment. Additional highlights include an attached two-car garage with direct access, custom The Shade Store window coverings throughout, and one of Baldwin Vista's most desirable locations. Just around the corner, neighborhood access leads directly into Kenneth Hahn State Recreation Area, where miles of trails, scenic overlooks, open green space, and panoramic city views become part of daily life. Known for its larger lots, architectural character, and central location, Baldwin Vista continues to attract buyers seeking more space without giving up convenience. Moments from Culver City's creative and tech corridor, including Apple's Culver City campus, Amazon Studios, and the Hayden Tract, the home is also close to local favorites including The Platform, Downtown Culver City, Ivy Station, Whole Foods, Target, and the upcoming Costco. With easy access to Playa Vista, the Westside, Downtown Los Angeles, and LAX, this location delivers a rare combination of neighborhood charm and city connectivity.

In 2024 and 2025, Stephanie Younger was the #1 agent in the City of Los Angeles and the Westchester Neighborhood, selling more Single-Family homes than any other real estate agent or team. With unmatched expertise in Westside and South Bay neighborhoods, Stephanie and her team have built their brand on a reputation for service that exceeds all expectations.

Why Buyers and Sellers Choose Stephanie Younger:

- Ranked #11 Sales Team in LA County by the LA Business Journal (2024)
- Over $3 billion in lifetime sales.
- Consistently ranked a top producer in West LA real estate
- Featured in The LA Times, The Argonaut, Dwell, SpectrumNews, The RealDeal and more
- Neighborhood Expert: West LA & the Silicon Beach Corridor

As a Los Angeles native and long-time Westchester resident, Stephanie offers hyper-local knowledge that few agents can match. She specializes in: Westchester, Playa del Rey, Playa Vista, Marina del Rey, Culver City, Venice, and El Segundo

What Makes Stephanie Different?

- Stephanie's unique background in sales, event planning, hospitality, and the arts makes her an expert in both marketing and negotiation.
- She believes: “Real estate, like life, is all about getting the details right.”

Her Process Includes:

- Helping clients define and align their vision, goals, and budget
- Managing complex transactions with clear communication
- Navigating escrow, lending, and inspections with zero surprises
- Leading a high-performing team to deliver seamless service

Local, Loyal, and Living Here...

Stephanie lives in Westchester with her husband—a playwright and LMU professor—and their two children. She’s proud to serve the neighborhoods she calls home, and her passion for community is reflected in her generous support of local charitable organizations including the YMCA, Westchester Arts and Music Block Party, and more.

A Southern California native, Ron Melendez has lived all over the Los Angeles area. Growing up in the San Gabriel Valley, he would head over to the beaches of Orange County to surf. After moving to Westwood to attend U.C.L.A., Ron has lived in Santa Monica, the Valley, and West Hollywood, before finally settling with his family in the South Bay. They now live in Manhattan Beach’s Tree Section where his daughters attend American Martyrs School.

Ron believes in real estate done right. And he believes that the most important way to do that is to listen to really hear what the client wants and needs, and to put all other concerns aside in pursuit of that. Ron knows how important your decision to buy or sell a property is. After 30 years working as an actor working in both TV and Film, Ron has brought that passion to real estate. He loves helping people find the perfect place to call home or helping someone get the best price for their property so that they can achieve their dreams. He believes that this job is all about service. At the end of the day, he wants to look back and know that he always did right by his clients.

Buying a home is a big decision and also a big investment. Trustworthy agent's are what you need. I'm the type of agent who takes pride and specializes in finding buyers the right home, and to  help seller's get top dollars for their property. I understand how exciting it can be to purchase a home, the overwhelming feeling and nervousness of buying a home for the first time. That is why I am here for you. I was born in Indonesia and immigrated to the US in 1996 and haved lived here ever since. I purchased my first house in 2001 and I know how difficult it can be to buy a home for the first time and how a real estate agent's guidance can be really helpful in the purchasing process.  I speak Mandarin, Indonesia, Chau Zhou, and some Cantonese. I believe every transaction or deal is unique and every client has their needs. I will make everyone who works with me will feel special and cared for and as result will refer to friends and family in the future about my profession to help them look for a new place called home.  Let's get a deal.

The fourth floor offers indoor-outdoor entertaining with a projector and screen, an additional bedroom, and a balcony showcasing incredible Houston skyline views.

Zigna Patel is a relationship-driven real estate professional specializing in residential rentals throughout Houston and the Humble area. With more than 20 years of hospitality industry experience, she brings a calm, solutions-oriented approach that helps clients feel supported, informed, and confident at every stage of the leasing process.

After moving to Houston from Fort Worth in 2019, Zigna developed a strong appreciation for the city’s diverse neighborhoods and lifestyle opportunities. Her background in the hospitality industry naturally led her to real estate, where she could apply her passion for guiding people through important life decisions. In her first year alone, she achieved a $1 million closing milestone, demonstrating both her dedication and ability to deliver results. Known for being reliable, honest, and a natural problem-solver, Zigna focuses on building lasting relationships while making the rental experience smooth, efficient, and stress-free.

A member of HAR, NAR, and Texas Realtors, Zigna stays connected to industry best practices while serving a diverse client base. Outside of real estate, she enjoys exploring Houston’s vibrant food scene, traveling, and spending quality time with family and friends.

For Zigna, success is defined by the moment her clients feel confident and excited about their next move. She is committed to providing personalized guidance and dependable service to help every client find the right home in the Houston market.

remarks: Nestled in the coveted Hollywood Grove and Los Feliz Historical Preservation Zone, this enchanting Spanish-style residence blends timeless character with an exceptional location. Rich in original architectural details, the home showcases stunning period light fixtures, graceful archways leading into nearly every room, and the warmth and charm that define classic Los Angeles Spanish architecture. Offering 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, the thoughtfully designed floor plan features a private formal dining room, a dedicated pantry room, a spacious upstairs bonus room, and a separate office, providing flexibility for today’s lifestyle. The primary suite serves as a true retreat, highlighted by an oversized private balcony with breathtaking city views that stretch across the Los Angeles skyline. Perched on a hillside setting, the property offers a unique sense of privacy and tranquility, enhanced by the rare presence of a natural water spring on the grounds. Whether enjoying morning coffee on the balcony, entertaining guests in the formal living spaces, or simply appreciating the home’s original character, this residence offers a truly special living experience. Just minutes from Franklin Village, residents enjoy easy access to beloved neighborhood cafés, restaurants, boutique shopping, and scenic hiking trails. Ideally positioned between Hollywood and Los Feliz, this home presents a rare opportunity to own a distinctive architectural gem in one of Los Angeles’ most desirable neighborhoods, where historic charm, natural beauty, and urban convenience come together seamlessly.

agents.bio:
With more than two decades of experience in real estate and mortgage lending, Jesse Guzman brings a unique, full-service perspective to every transaction. Serving buyers, sellers, investors, and property owners throughout Southern California, Jesse combines extensive real estate experience with in-depth knowledge of financing, negotiation, market analysis, and investment strategy.

What sets Jesse apart is his ability to look beyond simply buying or selling a property. As both a real estate broker and experienced mortgage professional, he understands the complete transaction,from determining the right pricing and negotiating strategy to evaluating financing options and structuring a deal that makes sense for his clients.

Jesse's experience spans residential homes, luxury properties, investment properties, multi-unit buildings, commercial real estate, and a wide range of financing solutions. Whether representing a first-time buyer, marketing a family home, negotiating a complex transaction, or helping an investor evaluate an opportunity, his approach is centered on preparation, communication, and protecting his client's best interests.

Over the years, Jesse has built his business largely through relationships, referrals, and repeat clients. He believes great representation means being accessible, explaining the process clearly, anticipating problems before they become obstacles, and providing clients with the information they need to make confident decisions.

Today, Jesse works alongside his family through The Guzman Group, providing clients with a team-oriented approach backed by decades of industry experience and a strong network of real estate, lending, escrow, title, and industry professionals.

For Jesse, real estate isn't just about completing a transaction, it's about becoming a trusted resource clients can rely on before, during, and long after closing.

Whether you're considering buying, selling, refinancing, or investing, Jesse welcomes the opportunity to help you evaluate your options and develop the right strategy for your goals.

Born and raised in Philadelphia, PA, Justin Freeling has always had a passion for the real estate business. After graduating with top honors from Temple University with a BA in Finance and Real Estate, he immediately began his career in Residential Property Management. Justin eventually went on to continue his education while simultaneously working full-time to obtain his MBA before moving to the Los Angeles area.

Once Justin landed in Los Angeles, he quickly went to work to obtain his California Real Estate license. He continued his work on the West Coast as a property manager in the commercial setting before moving into Residential Sales. Now apart of Sotheby's International Realty and a member of the Take Sunset team, Justin is loving his career and loving making new connections everyday.

Central to Justin's business ethos is placing the client's needs and satisfaction first. Superior customer service and professional representation is key to a successful relationship. "A property represents an important investment, which deserves a superior level of personal service and individualized attention. Building and maintaining relationships and a reputation of integrity and loyalty is what I value most."

Justin has become an integral part of Sotheby's and Take Sunset with the knowledge he brings to today's technological environment. Justin has the ability to market properties through social media, websites, and digital media to bring your listing to the next level. He continues to investigate the latest technologies, take classes to keep up-to-date on the newest real estate tools, and continuously strives to know what is happening in the market around him.

The chef-inspired kitchen is beautifully appointed with stainless steel appliances, offering both style and functionality for everyday living and entertaining. This stunning residence features 3 spacious bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom, plus an additional guest bathroom for added convenience. The private backyard provides the perfect setting for relaxation, gatherings, or outdoor enjoyment.
Additional features include central air and heating, a tankless water heater, washer and dryer hookups, recessed LED lighting, digital entry door lock, automatic gate access, and an automatic garage door. Conveniently located near the Intuit Dome, SoFi Stadium, and Los Angeles International Airport, this home offers easy access to entertainment, dining, shopping, and major transportation hubs.

remarks:
**LIVE, RENT, INVEST — Remodeled Los Angeles Property with Multiple Permitted Living Spaces**

Discover a rare opportunity to own a versatile Los Angeles property designed for flexible living and income potential. Featuring a beautifully remodeled main residence plus additional permitted living spaces, this property is ideal for owner-occupants, multi-generational households, investors, and buyers looking to offset housing expenses through rental income. With multiple usable living areas, modern upgrades, and a fully gated lot with RV access, opportunities like this are increasingly difficult to find in today's market.

The beautifully updated main residence offers approximately 1,056 sq ft with 2 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, highlighted by an open-concept floor plan, quartz countertops, modern cabinetry, oversized breakfast bar, upgraded flooring, fresh interior and exterior paint, newer A/C system, and updated plumbing and electrical.

A detached studio with private entrance and bathroom creates an ideal space for extended family, guests, rental income, or a home office. The studio currently includes a shower installed by the owner; buyer to independently verify permit status with the City of Los Angeles Building and Safety.

Adding even more versatility, the detached 2-car garage is accompanied by a large finished bonus/recreation room, perfect for entertaining, fitness, hobbies, workspace, or additional storage.

The fully gated lot offers privacy, generous parking, and rare RV access. City records indicate the primary structures are permitted. The overall configuration provides approximately 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms across all usable spaces. Buyer to independently verify square footage, permits, bedroom and bathroom count, and permitted uses.

Conveniently located near major freeways, shopping, dining, and public transportation. Whether you're an owner-occupant looking to offset expenses, a multi-generational household seeking flexible living arrangements, or an investor searching for strong rental potential, this property delivers exceptional value and opportunity.

**Short sale subject to lender approval. Offers submitted promptly.**

agents.bio:
For the past 5 years, I've had the privilege of helping individuals and families navigate the dynamic Houston real estate market. My passion lies in connecting people with their ideal properties and negotiating the perfect deal; whether it's the excitement of a first-time home purchase, the strategic sale of a luxury estate, or a savvy investment opportunity.

My areas of expertise include:

First-Time Homebuyers: I love guiding and educating first-time buyers through every step of the process, from understanding financing options to finding the perfect starter home. I believe in empowering my clients with knowledge, making their journey into homeownership exciting and stress-free.

Luxury Home Sellers: Selling a luxury property requires a sophisticated and strategic approach. I leverage comprehensive market analysis, targeted marketing, and a vast network to showcase your home's unique value and attract the right discerning buyers, maximizing your return.

Investors: Houston's robust economy and growth make it an attractive market for real estate investors. I work closely with investors to identify high-potential properties, analyze market data, and develop strategies that align with their financial goals, whether it's for passive income or long-term appreciation.

agents.bio:
Bea Flores, ABR, SRS, is a renowned figure in the Houston real estate market, with over 18 years of industry expertise. Her passion for real estate and dedication to exceptional service inspired her to establish her own brokerage, Luxe Living Group, over three years ago. Under her leadership, Bea has guided her team to remarkable success, earning recognition as one of Houston's top agents.

In December 2024, Bea and her team joined Compass Real Estate, a decision driven by the extensive marketing opportunities and advanced technology Compass offers. This move allows Luxe Living Group to enhance the already top-notch real estate experience they provide, giving clients access to cutting-edge tools and strategies that elevate every transaction.

Bea specializes in working with traditional buyers and sellers in Houston while carving out a niche in representing out-of-state institutional buyers across Texas cities like Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio. Her commitment to client education and transparent communication has earned her a loyal client base, with an impressive 85-90% of her business coming from repeat clients and referrals.

At Luxe Living Group, Bea ensures every client receives a luxurious and seamless experience, prioritizing meticulous attention to detail and comprehensive support to ensure success in every transaction.

Beyond her success as an agent, Bea is also a dedicated educator. For over nine years, she has been teaching real estate licensing courses, mentoring both agents and clients, and empowering them to navigate their real estate journeys with confidence.

Bea's outstanding achievements have earned her numerous accolades, including recognition among the Top 25 agents in Houston, a recent ranking among the Top 5 agents by production in the Houston Business Journal, and being featured in national publications such as Top Agent Magazine. She also served as President of the Women's Council of Realtors - Bay Area, Houston Chapter in 2013, further demonstrating her commitment to leadership and the advancement of the real estate profession.

With a foundation built on integrity, expertise, and an unwavering commitment to client satisfaction, Bea Flores and her team at Luxe Living Group, now proudly partnered with Compass, are dedicated to providing personalized, seamless real estate experiences that exceed expectations.

agents.bio:
A fourth-generation Los Angeleno, Lexi graduated cum laude from Yale University with a degree in English literature. She spent several years touring the world as a professional singer before developing an interest in the overlap between art and business. In 2012, she bought her first property, and fell in love with the real estate process and the freedom that owning property could bring to friends and soon-to-be-friends looking to plant roots in Los Angeles. 

The rest is history: Lexi is proud to have been named the top producing agent at her Compass branch in 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, and 2022 - five years straight. She and her team have sold over $250,000,000 of real estate since she established herself as a full-time agent. She's repeatedly earned the distinction of "Real Estate All Star" by Los Angeles Magazine and one of "America's Best" by RealTrends (given to the top 1.5% of agents nationwide). Her listings have broken sales records and have appeared in publications like the New York Times and Domino Magazine. She's even sold a Los Angeles Cultural Historic Landmark! At the same time, she has maintained a perfect 5-star client review rating - she and her team have a genuine obsession with client satisfaction and believe that the real estate process can be both fun and fulfilling.

As a member of Compass, Lexi combines her skills with those of an entire team of agents who work closely to benefit each other's buyers and sellers. The firm is ideally sized to represent you effectively—small enough to act quickly, but big enough to deliver the powerful resources and global connections needed to get rewarding results.

Ashmat Delawari exemplifies the mantra, “the way you do one thing is the way you do everything.” Known for his dedication to health and athleticism, his seemingly laid-back demeanor belies a fierce negotiator with an iron will. With extensive experience working with high-profile clients from the entertainment industry, Ashmat has built a reputation for excellence in handling the unique needs of CEOs, musicians, writers, and their representatives.

Years of collaboration with developers have honed Ashmat’s expertise in both ground-up constructions and the revival of character homes with a modern twist. His comprehensive understanding of building, design, and buyer preferences positions him uniquely to approach each situation from all vantage points. This multidimensional perspective ensures he knows exactly what premium buyers and sellers are looking for.

Before entering real estate, Ashmat’s career in mortgage lending provided him with a deep, reassuring understanding of the financial aspects of buying and selling homes. Outside of work, his time is devoted to intense workouts, family, and his beloved dogs.

My approach is rooted in relationships, built on trust, and driven by a commitment to providing thoughtful guidance, strategic expertise, and personalized service throughout every step of the real estate journey.

Today, I combine that business experience with my knowledge of the Houston real estate market to provide skilled negotiation, strategic advice, and a concierge-level experience tailored to each client's unique needs and goals.

As a homeowner, landlord, and real estate investor myself, I understand firsthand that real estate is more than a transaction. It's a significant financial investment, a lifestyle decision, and often the beginning of an exciting new chapter. Whether you're buying or selling a luxury home, relocating to Houston, purchasing your first home, or exploring investment opportunities, my priority is to protect your interests, simplify the process, and help you make confident, informed decisions.

I proudly serve Houston and its surrounding communities, and I've built my business on integrity, personal connections, and lasting relationships. Nothing means more to me than earning the trust of my clients and knowing they feel confident referring their friends, family, and colleagues to me for the same exceptional level of service.

For me, success isn't simply measured by homes bought and sold. It's measured by the relationships I build, the trust I earn, and the experience I deliver.

I love Houston, I love real estate, and most importantly, I love helping people achieve their goals. I would welcome the opportunity to do the same for you.

Rooted in Houston. Rooted in Relationships. Rooted in What Matters.

remarks: Nestled in the highly sought-after Kentwood neighborhood of Westchester, within the boundaries of the highly acclaimed Kentwood Ave Elementary School, this charming traditional home offers a wonderful opportunity to own a property full of character in an ideal Westside location. Warm and inviting, the home blends timeless vintage details with a comfortable and functional layout. Recently refinished, original hardwood floors run throughout the home, setting the tone for a space that feels both classic and welcoming. The living room features dentil molding and a cozy wood-burning fireplace, creating a comfortable setting for everyday living and relaxed gatherings. Just beyond, the formal dining room showcases a distinctive mid-century light fixture and original built-ins that add to the home's unique personality. Two well-sized bedrooms provide ample natural light and closet space, while the original bathroom retains its charming period details and vintage tile. The kitchen continues the home's classic appeal with vintage tile accents, a convenient half bath nearby, and a dedicated laundry area that adds everyday practicality. A bright sunroom extends from the dining area and opens through French doors to a private, landscaped backyard, which is an ideal setting for entertaining, gardening, or enjoying quiet outdoor moments. The detached two-car garage offers additional flexibility and potential for future use. With its desirable Kentwood location, classic architectural details, and inviting atmosphere, this home presents a rare opportunity to enjoy vintage charm in one of Los Angeles' most established and welcoming neighborhoods.

agents.bio:
Kate Myhan brings a highly distinctive background to commercial real estate, combining international business experience, advanced academic training, strategic marketing expertise, and hands-on dealmaking across multiple asset types. Based in Houston, Texas, Kate works with commercial property owners, investors, developers, landlords, tenants, and business buyers locally, nationally, and internationally. In addition to representing clients in Texas, she also works with national buyers pursuing opportunities in other states, helping them identify, evaluate, and secure the right assets based on their investment goals.

With a Master’s in Economics and more than two decades of experience in marketing, management, client relations, and real estate investing, Kate offers a sophisticated, results-driven approach to every assignment. Her professional background includes serving as a strategic marketing professor in Santiago, Chile, where she taught MBA students and developed high-level expertise in positioning, negotiation, market strategy, and consumer behavior. That international academic and business experience gives her a rare advantage in commercial real estate, especially when advising clients on marketability, asset positioning, and investment potential.

Kate has built her reputation on strong relationships, creative problem-solving, relentless work ethic, and an ability to connect the right people to the right opportunities. She is known for identifying value where others may not, whether in on-market listings, off-market deals, redevelopment sites, land opportunities, industrial assets, retail properties, mixed-use projects, multifamily investments, or business-related real estate transactions. Her combination of analytical thinking and marketing expertise allows her to not only find opportunities, but also present and promote properties in a way that drives attention and results.

Her experience is especially valuable to clients seeking guidance on acquisitions, dispositions, site selection, development potential, investment strategy, and high-visibility property marketing. Kate understands that commercial real estate success requires more than simply listing a property or submitting an offer—it requires insight, negotiation skill, persistence, financial awareness, and the ability to create momentum around a deal. She approaches each client relationship with professionalism, urgency, and a commitment to maximizing value.

Kate is a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Texas REALTORS®, National Association of Realtors, and the CCIM Institute. She holds respected industry credentials including CCIM (Certified Commercial Investment Member), CIPS (Certified International Property Specialist), TACS (Texas Accredited Commercial Specialist), and CRS (Certified Residential Specialist). Fluent in English, Spanish, French, and Polish, she is able to work effectively with a diverse range of clients, including international investors and cross-border buyers.

Clients appreciate Kate for her extensive market knowledge, global perspective, broad-based network, and unwavering devotion to their success. Her business is built largely through referrals and repeat relationships, reflecting the trust she earns through outstanding service, strategic guidance, and strong results. Whether representing a Houston-based owner, an out-of-state investor, or a national buyer expanding into new markets, Kate brings the experience, intelligence, and dealmaking energy needed to move complex transactions forward.

agents.bio:
I specialize in helping clients identify high-value real estate opportunities with a strong focus on commercial properties, investments, and strategic acquisitions. As an active real estate investor myself, I understand investing from both sides of the table — not only as an advisor, but as someone who personally owns rental houses, apartment properties, and commercial buildings focused on building long-term passive income and wealth creation.

My growing investment portfolio gives me firsthand experience in evaluating opportunities, negotiating strong deals, managing risk, and recognizing value that others may overlook. I believe the best way to guide clients is by applying strategies I personally use and believe in.

Whether you are expanding an investment portfolio, purchasing commercial real estate, or searching for the right opportunity, I bring a hands-on, results-driven approach built on market knowledge, strong negotiation, and real-world investing experience.

Real estate is more than buying and selling properties — it is about building financial freedom and creating long-term value. My goal is simple: help clients make smart decisions, secure exceptional opportunities, and build wealth with confidence.

remarks: Beautiful 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo located in the highly sought-after Egret Bay Condominiums! Perfectly situated between Cow Bayou and the vibrant social scene of NASA/Clear Lake, this home offers the ideal blend of comfort and convenience. Enjoy an open kitchen with a breakfast bar that flows into the cozy living area, complete with a fireplace. Additional ground-level storage provides plenty of space for your belongings, and there are two reserved carport spaces right next to the storage closet. This pet-friendly community features multiple pet stations, exceptional amenities including waterfront pools, a private boat launch, and docks along the bayou. Spend peaceful evenings fishing from the dock or head out for a day of boating and fun on the water. Zoned to the highly acclaimed Clear Creek Independent School District (CCISD), this condo is an excellent choice for families as well. Experience relaxed waterfront living and unbeatable convenience at Egret Bay Condominiums!

remarks: Welcome to Hamlet at Champions — an exclusive gated community of only 20 estates on a sprawling 0.65-acre lot. This 5-bed, 3 full & 2 half-bath home offers 5,766 sq ft of turnkey luxury, transformed by nearly $200,000 in recent upgrades: new pool, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, water pump, kitchen flooring, interior & exterior paint, all-new switches & outlets, pergola with concrete pad, basketball court, and professional landscaping. Inside: grand foyer with crystal chandeliers, spiral staircase, custom woodwork, crown molding, dual wet bars, home office, and formal dining. Primary suite features French doors to a private patio, jetted tub, and walk-in closet. Upstairs: game room, flex room & 3 secondary bedrooms. $50,000 in premium furnishings fully included — move-in ready from day one. Rear yard offers guest home potential. Circle drive & 3-car garage.

agents.bio: Alex decided to pursue a career in real estate in 2012 where he joined forces with his wife, Lisa to create a powerhouse team.  Alex came into the real estate industry after experiencing a successful career as a paralegal; helping homeowners with all aspects of real estate law from drafting deeds to loan modifications.  He immediately earned recognition from various asset management companies as a top tier market analyst.  With a firm understanding of big business and Houston’s ever changing market dynamics, Alex brings a refined and strategic approach when consulting with his clients. When Alex is not selling real estate, he is enjoying family time with his daughter Alessandra and his boxer Titan.  Alex is an avid tennis player and loves playing golf.  He has received the Houston Association of Realtors Top Producing Realtor reward multiple times and has earned several designations such as Certified Negotiation Expert, Certified Neighborhood Specialist and Seller Representative Specialist to name a few.

remarks: Oak Forest, NEVER FLOODED. Updated single-story charmer offering 2 beds, 1 bath, and 1,297 sq ft on a roughly 7,595 sq ft lot. The updated kitchen with stainless steel appliances and a cozy breakfast nook, keeps everyday living easy, and the fully fenced backyard delivers real usable space with a wood deck, built-in seating, and a storage shed. A one-car garage adds covered parking. Lovingly maintained by one owner for 20+ years on a quiet, established street with a park just steps away. City living without the city price tag. H-E-B, Kroger, and Whole Foods are a short drive, with TC Jester Park close by for walking, running, and cycling. Minutes from Oak Forest and Garden Oaks dining and retail, with quick access to 610 and 290. Classic Oak Forest charm in a well-connected pocket of the city.

agents.bio:
Success has never been accidental for Ced. Long before becoming one of Houston's most recognized real estate professionals, he was building businesses and creating opportunities. From selling cool cups as a child, to running successful ventures as a teenager and college student, to owning local businesses, entrepreneurship has always been woven into his DNA. That relentless drive ultimately led him to real estate, an industry where dedication, expertise, and work ethic directly impact results.

Today, Ced has built a reputation as one of the Houston area's premier real estate advisors, closing more than 300 transactions and facilitating over $85 million in real estate sales volume. His success is rooted in a simple philosophy: put people first, deliver exceptional service, and create results that change lives.

Clients quickly recognize that Ced's approach is different. His leadership style is authentic, hands-on, and unwaveringly focused on helping buyers, sellers, and investors achieve their goals. Whether guiding a first-time homebuyer, negotiating a luxury home purchase, or helping investors maximize returns, Ced brings the same level of commitment, transparency, and strategic expertise to every transaction.

Ced Attended Abilene Christian University for 3 years but earned his Bachelor's degree in Communications and MBA from Texas Southern University, Ced combines education, innovation, and market expertise to provide clients with a competitive advantage. As a former collegiate football athlete, he learned early that success is earned through discipline, preparation, and determination—qualities that continue to define his career today.

Throughout his career, Ced has earned numerous industry accolades, including:
• 4xTop Producer (2019-2022)
• 3x Golden Level Producer (2022-25)
• HBREA Top 40 (2021)
• Voted #1 Agent on Social Media in Pearland by Property Spark (2020)
• Jesse H. Jones School of Business 40 Under 40 (2019)
• Ruby Masters Award Recipient (2018)
• Voted #2 Agent on Social Media in Texas by Property Spark (2017)
• Quality Service Pinnacle Producer (2016 & 2017)
• Houston 40 Under 40 (2016)
• Quality Service Award (2015)
• Gold Jacket Recipient (2014)

Ced has also been featured at numerous speaking engagements throughout Houston, sharing his expertise on real estate, entrepreneurship, branding, and business development.

As Founder of the Reserve Realty Group, brokered by Legacy Homes & Properties, Ced leads a team dedicated to delivering a world-class real estate experience. Through personalized service, cutting-edge marketing, advanced technology, and in-depth market knowledge, the team helps clients confidently navigate one of the most important financial decisions of their lives.

For Ced, real estate is about more than buying and selling homes—it's about building relationships, creating wealth, and helping families establish lasting legacies.

Beyond real estate, Ced remains deeply committed to serving the community that helped shape him. A former educator and passionate mentor, he supports youth development through after-school programs, youth athletics, and the Space City Heat 501(c)(3) football program. His dedication to mentorship and community service reflects the same values that have made him successful in business: leadership, integrity, and a genuine desire to help others succeed.

When you work with Ced Thomas, you're not just hiring a real estate agent—you're partnering with a trusted advocate, skilled negotiator, and proven professional dedicated to helping you achieve extraordinary results.

agents.bio:
Bay Oaks, is a premier golf community located in southeast Houston’s Clear Lake/NASA area. Dan McCarver knows the Clear Lake Real Estate Market very well.

Dan is a native Houstonian and a second-generation Realtor. Licensed since 1977, Dan is familiar with Clear Lake’s finest neighborhoods and focuses on the golf community of Bay Oaks.

He has handled over 620+ resale homes in Bay Oaks over the last twenty-two years. Over the years, Dan’s stellar reputation has earned him referrals and repeat business as the “go-to” agent for Bay Oaks properties and other Clear Lake area luxury residences.

Exemplary service is his standard. Dan possesses cool confidence, a professional demeanor, and a gracious personality, which is a winning combination and approach to his craft.

Mentored by his Mother, Barbara McCarver, a leading Real Estate Broker in Houston for 50 years, Barbara served as the first female President of the Houston Association of Realtors. Dan comments, “Real estate is a challenging and rewarding business. Having grown up around home sales, it seems second nature to me.”

Dan McCarver has achieved the #1 position in resale real estate transaction sales volume many times in the Clear Lake area. His success is no surprise. The honors and recognition he has received are indicative of his commitment, professionalism, and level of understanding in this specialized discriminating market.

Carrie Nelson, originally from Teague, Texas, grew up in Deer Park and has called the Clear Lake area home for the past 25 years.

It was during this time that she adopted her guiding philosophy: every problem is simply an opportunity to find a solution. This perspective has become a cornerstone of her success in real estate.

Known for her exceptional attention to detail, Carrie takes pride in guiding clients through every step of the buying and selling process. Her hands-on approach ensures clients feel informed, confident, and comfortable with their decisions. Whether assisting first-time buyers, seasoned investors, or families preparing to sell, Carrie provides personalized service tailored to each client’s needs.

Carrie’s dedication is rooted in her values of honesty, trustworthiness, and loyalty. Her genuine passion for helping people shines through in her commitment to delivering seamless transactions and positive experiences.

Outside of real estate, Carrie has been happily married for 35 years. She and her husband are proud parents of five children and delight in spending time with their six grandchildren.

agents.bio: Jessica Escamilla anticipates her client's needs and takes pride in matching them with the best possible home and the best location for their particular lifestyle. She has worked with Cartus, Graebel, and Crown World Mobility, just to name a few relocation organizations. In addition, she is a USAA and NFCU trained agent, as her father served in the US Air Force. Military families are very special to her, and she understands the challenges that come with that. She prides herself on working with clients from all over the world. The Houston Association of Realtors offers an array of information for international buyers. Serving on the Global Advisory Group for the Houston Association and the Texas Realtor Global Committee has added experience and knowledge that allows her to better assist clients who may come from anywhere in the world. Homeownership is a lifetime dream for all, not just a few!

agents.bio:
Evan Compean is the founder of The Compean Group, a boutique Houston real estate team known for data-driven pricing, high-end marketing and skilled negotiation. A licensed agent since 2012 and a real estate investor since 2002, Evan has sold more than $250 million in real estate and brings a builder's and investor's eye to every home, from foundation and roof to resale value.

Areas: Houston Heights, Woodland Heights, Garden Oaks/Oak Forest, Montrose, Midtown, West University, Bellaire, Spring Branch, Pearland, Katy, Cypress and The Woodlands.

Specialties: Luxury and new construction, investment and multifamily properties, land, first-time buyers, and relocation.

Evan is also a licensed loan officer and a partner at Smart Title, so clients get guidance on financing and closing from someone who knows every step. Se habla español. With 400+ five-star reviews across Zillow, Google, Yelp and Realtor.com, The Compean Group focuses on clear communication and a smooth process from first call to closing.

remarks: A study in modern design, this refined residence in the gated Uptown North community offers 2,086 SF of thoughtfully curated living space. Soaring ceilings, expansive windows, and clean architectural lines create an atmosphere that is both sophisticated and inviting. The designer kitchen serves as the heart of the home, featuring custom wood cabinetry, Silestone countertops, premium Bosch appliances, a gas cooktop, and a striking waterfall island. The serene primary suite is complemented by a spa-inspired bath with dual vanities, a soaking tub, separate shower, and generous walk-in closet. A private balcony extends the living experience outdoors, while a 4-ton HVAC system with three-zone electronic dampers and independent thermostats ensures exceptional comfort on every level. Ideally positioned near Memorial Park, Memorial City, The Galleria, and Downtown Houston, this lock-and-leave residence delivers modern luxury in one of the city's most connected locations.

Mary is an integral part of The LaRose Kaileh Group by first and foremost delivering a high level of client service and professionalism. Before entering real estate, Mary gained experience at a luxury interior design firm and an upstream oil and gas company in their accounting department. This background equips her to expertly prepare properties for sale, highlight their most desirable features, and negotiate the best deals for her clients, whether buying or selling.

Mary has earned her Accredited Buyer's Representation and Pricing Strategy Advisor Designation. Mary is also a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Texas Association of Realtors, and the National Association of Realtors.

Outside of real estate, Mary enjoys spending quality time with her husband, two daughters and furry son Teddy.

With over 12 years of experience as a Communication Specialist, Alex Meza brings a unique blend of expertise and dedication to the real estate market. Known for an exceptional attention to detail and a strong ability to cultivate meaningful relationships, he prioritizes our clients’ needs above all else. Fluent in both Spanish and English, he is adept at serving a diverse clientele and providing tailored solutions that meet their unique requirements. Our business is focused on luxury properties, but he is equally committed to assisting clients at all levels of the market. By leveraging our deep industry knowledge and communication skills, he strives to make every real estate transaction seamless and successful, ensuring the highest level of satisfaction for our clients.

remarks: Spacious 4 bedroom home offering flexible living areas and strong long-term potential in Northwood Manor. The functional layout includes a bonus room ideal for a home office, second living area, or creative space, plus a primary suite with private access to the back deck for easy indoor-outdoor living. Brick accent walls add character, and large windows bring in natural light throughout. Located in a non-flood zone, this property adds an extra layer of confidence for homeowners and investors alike. Priced to reflect cosmetic updates, it presents a great opportunity to personalize finishes and build equity, while the 4 bedroom layout also offers strong rental appeal for those considering a future landlord option. Just minutes from Interstate 59 and Little York, the area continues to see growth with expanding retail, entertainment, and convenient access to major grocery stores.

agents.bio:
Katherine Boddeker grew up in New York and loves the bustle of the big city, so her move to the more southern climate of Houston was a smooth transition. She studied dance at the High School of Performing and Visual Arts, and later attended University of Houston for business.

After college, Katherine entered the real estate world in 1989 and has never wanted to do anything else. If you're searching for an expert in the Houston housing market, look no further. She can help you buy, sell, lease, invest, or even build. Having spent nearly thirty years in the business, she is well versed in all areas of the city and all aspects of the market.

First and foremost, Katherine is a mom. She has spent years as an active advocate in her children's schools, both public and private. She understands how important finding the right school for families can be.

Katherine knows that home is where the heart is, and many times, that home includes pets. A lover of animals, she has spent much of her spare time with dog rescues. She has opened up her home for training, fostering, and interviewing potential owners to find the perfect home for these animals she has come to love. She volunteers at pet adoptions and fundraising activities.

If you're looking for an experienced Real Estate Broker who knows the ropes and understands your needs, call Katherine today at 555.483.6838. Her website is: www.katherinetxrealtor.com
