agents.bio:
As one satisfied client summed up in one of Mel’s recent seller surveys, “Mel Reyna is amazing.” And we agree. Elaborating on Mel’s extraordinary service, another client remarked, “he worked very hard to sell my home quickly and keep me fully informed throughout the process – I would recommend Mel to anyone.” Mel’s professionalism, efficiency, market knowledge, listening skills, reliance and dedication are qualities that only scratch the surface of what he does for his clients and customers on a daily basis.

Mel was the first agent to join Greenwood King’s brand new Heights Boulevard office in 1999. Every year since, he has been the Heights office top producer. Three years later, Mel was ranked as one of the “Top 25 Residential Real Estate Individuals” by the Houston Business Journal. His success as a leading real estate agent may be attributed to a maxim he strictly adheres to – “always treat clients as you would expect to be treated yourself.” Without a doubt, his philosophy works, as this dynamic agent has significantly impacted residential real estate in the Heights for more than 17 years.

Honesty distinguishes this experienced pro, who’s number one priority is to ensure his clients not get too wrapped up in the emotions involved. “Always buy and sell smart,” Mel stresses, comforting clients with the fact that he will do whatever it takes – working as long as needed – to negotiate the best deal. He also takes pride in working with first-time buyers and is delighted to guide them through every step of this complicated process.

Mel specializes in the Heights (where he grew up and currently resides), as well as various surrounding neighborhoods such as Oak Forest, Shady Acres, Timbergrove Manor, Montrose, Memorial, Spring Branch, the Museum District and Galveston. As if his service to the industry wasn’t enough, Mel’s sense of neighborhood extends well beyond his professional endeavors. He has been involved in numerous charitable organizations such as the Heights Association, Heights Boulevard Beautification, St. Andrew’s Church and Harvard Elementary.

remarks: Welcome to 1823 Millwood, a fully renovated 4-bed 2-bath home is located in Houston's desirable Lazybrook inside the 610 Loop. This down-to-the studs comprehensively renovated home offers a light/bright/open floor plan & plenty of space both inside and out. Floor to ceiling custom built-ins anchor the living area. Generous cabinetry, large central island, upgraded appliances & designer c-top/tile selections define the kitchen. Both bathrooms are a must see - both finishes and functionality. Major system updates include electrical, plumbing, HVAC, roof, foundation and windows. Additional upgrades: hot tub w/heating and chilling capabilities for year-round enjoyment, whole-home water filtration system, epoxy-coated garage flooring, custom storage shed, electrical panel with generator tie-in. Parks and green spaces, Heights, Memorial Park, First Ward Arts District, The Galleria, and Uptown are just a sample of what's within minutes of your front door. Welcome home!

Charlie Bingham is a distinguished REALTOR® specializing in the Greater Houston market. Renowned for his exceptional negotiation skills and meticulous attention to detail, Charlie ensures that every client receives unparalleled service tailored to their unique needs. His client-centric approach is rooted in a deep understanding of the real estate process, supported by his extensive background in hospitality management.

Charlie’s expertise encompasses investment properties and renovation projects, making him a valuable advisor for clients at any price point. His commitment to open communication keeps clients well-informed and confident throughout their real estate journey. Fluent in French, Charlie adeptly assists French-speaking clients and other expatriates, simplifying their transition to Houston.

An active community member, Charlie serves as the President of the Crestwood Civic Club, volunteers at the Houston Food Bank, contributes to a Rodeo Committee, and is a member of the Memorial Park Advisory Board.

Outside of real estate, Charlie enjoys cultural events, padel, and pickleball. He is happily married, with two daughters and a Pomeranian dog.

Charlie Bingham’s dedication to excellence and his profound understanding of the Houston real estate market make him an outstanding choice for clients seeking an authentic and trustworthy REALTOR®.

agents.bio:
A Top Producer for the last 10 years, with over 350 transactions under her belt, accumulating a career volume of almost $265+ million, Rachel Conkling is your go-to Houston realtor. A long-time Houstonian with a passion for real estate and an energy level that is unmatched. Buying or selling a home can be complicated and stressful, and Rachel’s goal is to make the process as smooth and enjoyable as possible from start to finish.

It is evident that her approach and knowledge throughout each transaction, have contributed to her remarkable success from day one: At her previous broker, she was inducted into their Hall of Fame in 2019, recognized as the top producing new agent, 2014, received the award for Most Transactions with Buyers, 2016, and was one of the Top 25 Producing Agents 3rd Quarter 2016 and 2nd Quarter 2018. She was selected as one of the Houston Association of Realtors "Top 20 Under 40 Rising Stars," 2015. Recently, Rachel was a Houston Business Journal Residential Award Winner, 2022, ranked #25 in the city based on sales volume. Rachel thrives on guiding her clients during the home sale or purchase process, always an exciting, yet emotional milestone in people's lives. 

Rachel specializes in all areas "inside the Loop" and "just outside the Loop" including The Heights, Oak Forest/Garden Oaks, Montrose, Rice Military, West University, River Oaks, Tanglewood, Briargrove, Spring Branch, Memorial, Memorial West, and Bellaire. Rachel graduated from Second Baptist High School in Houston. She comes from "a long line of Longhorns," graduating from the University of Texas, Austin, where she was a member of Pi Beta Phi. Later she earned an M.B.A. from Houston Baptist University. She is a member of St. Martins Episcopal Church, serves on the board for The Children's Fund, Inc., and is a member of the Salvation Army Women's Auxiliary. Rachel and her husband are the proud parents of two little girls and enjoy living in Memorial.

agents.bio:
Josh Goldstein has enjoyed working in the real estate industry since 2008.

After graduating from the Kelley School of Business at Indiana University and founding a real estate investment company specializing in student income properties, Josh moved to Los Angeles where he earned his MBA in 2011 from Loyola Marymount University.

It was during his graduate program when Josh entered the Los Angeles real estate market by first serving the needs of several local NBA athletes. Through his dedication, attention to detail, creative ability, and reputation for maintaining confidentiality, Josh quickly grew his clientele base, which now includes more than 20 NBA players, as well as some of the most recognized names in other sports and entertainment.

Josh brings knowledge, a wealth of experience, and a complete list of resources to every deal. Whether it’s representing Sellers, Buyers, Tenants or Landlords, his ability to provide exposure for his listings and locate off-market options is truly what sets Josh apart from other agents, as is reflected by his clients’ referrals and repeat business.

agents.bio:
Kate Myhan brings a highly distinctive background to commercial real estate, combining international business experience, advanced academic training, strategic marketing expertise, and hands-on dealmaking across multiple asset types. Based in Houston, Texas, Kate works with commercial property owners, investors, developers, landlords, tenants, and business buyers locally, nationally, and internationally. In addition to representing clients in Texas, she also works with national buyers pursuing opportunities in other states, helping them identify, evaluate, and secure the right assets based on their investment goals.

With a Master’s in Economics and more than two decades of experience in marketing, management, client relations, and real estate investing, Kate offers a sophisticated, results-driven approach to every assignment. Her professional background includes serving as a strategic marketing professor in Santiago, Chile, where she taught MBA students and developed high-level expertise in positioning, negotiation, market strategy, and consumer behavior. That international academic and business experience gives her a rare advantage in commercial real estate, especially when advising clients on marketability, asset positioning, and investment potential.

Kate has built her reputation on strong relationships, creative problem-solving, relentless work ethic, and an ability to connect the right people to the right opportunities. She is known for identifying value where others may not, whether in on-market listings, off-market deals, redevelopment sites, land opportunities, industrial assets, retail properties, mixed-use projects, multifamily investments, or business-related real estate transactions. Her combination of analytical thinking and marketing expertise allows her to not only find opportunities, but also present and promote properties in a way that drives attention and results.

Her experience is especially valuable to clients seeking guidance on acquisitions, dispositions, site selection, development potential, investment strategy, and high-visibility property marketing. Kate understands that commercial real estate success requires more than simply listing a property or submitting an offer—it requires insight, negotiation skill, persistence, financial awareness, and the ability to create momentum around a deal. She approaches each client relationship with professionalism, urgency, and a commitment to maximizing value.

Kate is a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Texas REALTORS®, National Association of Realtors, and the CCIM Institute. She holds respected industry credentials including CCIM (Certified Commercial Investment Member), CIPS (Certified International Property Specialist), TACS (Texas Accredited Commercial Specialist), and CRS (Certified Residential Specialist). Fluent in English, Spanish, French, and Polish, she is able to work effectively with a diverse range of clients, including international investors and cross-border buyers.

Clients appreciate Kate for her extensive market knowledge, global perspective, broad-based network, and unwavering devotion to their success. Her business is built largely through referrals and repeat relationships, reflecting the trust she earns through outstanding service, strategic guidance, and strong results. Whether representing a Houston-based owner, an out-of-state investor, or a national buyer expanding into new markets, Kate brings the experience, intelligence, and dealmaking energy needed to move complex transactions forward.

agents.bio:
Oscar C. Hernandez, founder of The Advisory Real Estate + Development and Team Leader of The Oscar Fine Properties Team, has been a Houston real estate leader since 2002. His local expertise, financial background and client-first approach make him a trusted Advisor to clients. Oscar has closed more than $300 million in transactions and earned numerous industry accolades and designations, but he prefers to measure success through the satisfaction of his clients. Guided by a desire to serve others, he provides exceptional, personalized representation that surpasses the agent role - making him an integral member of each client’s professional services team. 
 
A Houston native, Oscar graduated from prestigious Rice University with a Bachelor’s Degree in Economics before heading to Wall Street, where he had an eight-year career as an oil & gas equity research analyst. He entered the real estate industry after he had moved back to Houston, when a former colleague sought his advice on the purchase of four multi-family properties. Oscar was the point person during the life of these investments; assisting with occupancy, improvements and, eventually, divestment. 
 
In many ways, Oscar's background as a financial analyst defines his approach to real estate. He views every purchase and sale through an investment lens. He specializes in using short and long-term trend analyses to determine a property’s current and potential resale value alongside in-depth market knowledge to guide his clients through the intricacies of real estate transactions. Oscar is also known for his creative marketing strategies and events - from open houses, to soiree's to client appreciation parties - and he has been creating and utilizing personalized, professional HD videos to sell lifestyle since 2008. 
 
Oscar specializes in Houston’s luxury market but believes in providing a luxury experience at every price point. He tailors his communication style to his clients’ preferences and provides information that is as thorough or concise as they wish. Many people in Oscar’s returning client-roster are busy professionals who are experts in their respective fields, and he’s also an expert that top Houston area agents call upon for their personal property needs or when a listing isn't selling in a timely fashion. He embraces the opportunity to collaborate with other agents on any need that may arise. 
 
Personally, Oscar's charitable donations and volunteer efforts include involvement with The Beacon, a local nonprofit that provides counseling, housing, and other civil services to bring Houston’s unhoused back into the community, and Scenic Houston, an organization that beautifies, connects, and improves Houston neighborhoods, drawing out his passion to help shape the future of Houston. Other organizations near and dear to his heart are Rice University, Kids' Meals, Inc., Ryan's Well Foundation, Living Water International, Autism Speaks, Houston Pets Alive, Pup Squad Animal Rescue and MD Anderson. 
 
When not with clients or giving back to the community, you’ll find Oscar keeping up with the latest events and openings around town, and enjoying the many activities that the greater Houston area offers - manifesting his mantra of 'Come Live Where You Play!'  Oscar is a resident of Houston's First Ward (est. 1840) and enjoys tennis, biking, leisurely walks, wine & food tastings and has a deep appreciation for the arts.

Outside, the property provides something increasingly rare: room to breathe. Not only is there a generous greenspace and garden but the large lot allows for a pool as well. The timeless, classic aesthetic and incredible attention to detail make this a true gem!

agents.bio:
Paul P. Marin specializes in helping sellers obtain the highest price for their homes in the shortest amount of time. He does this by taking detailed notes about the home and making suggestions on what repairs to do that will cost a penny and return a dime. He also has a list of preferred contractors that do quality work at very reasonable prices. Thus, helping sellers get the highest return on investment. These services are suggested prior to marketing the home for sale to maximize the equity in each home. Many of these contractors he uses when flipping his own investments. Hence, he takes the guess work out of hiring true professionals with a proven track record. This is part of his service to sellers. He also helps buyers make great investments by buying the right home based on his 20 plus years of real estate knowledge. Paul also managed a mortgage brokerage for 14 years and held a tax license for 5 years and uses this knowledge to assist his clients in making the best financial decisions when buying and selling a home. He is also certified to work with probate, wills, trust and estate sales. He also has a Bachelor of Arts from U.C.L.A.


Paul is a member of the National Association of Realtors, California Association of Realtors, Pasadena Board of Realtors, the U.C.L.A. Alumni Association, and an active volunteer for the Mt. Baldy Ski Patrol at the Mt. Baldy Ski Resort, a National Ski Patrol Member, Outdoor Emergency Care Certified Medical "First Responder" and a member of the Southern California Golf Association. He enjoys giving back to the community by rescuing people in the Angeles National Forest . Paul's nature has always been to look out for the interest of others.

agents.bio:
There is an elegance to the way in which Aaron Sonnier works. He manages every detail, no matter how small. He is committed to excellence in service and luxury in every way. He curates his every choice with refinement and grace.

That would explain why he is an esteemed member of Martha Turner's Circle of Excellence.

Nothing compares when it comes to the unsurpassed attention he pays to every client and every property, right down to the clothes he wears and the image he projects. It is no wonder why he was voted Best Dressed Realtor (2019) by Realtor Magazine.

Originally from Lake Charles, Louisiana, Aaron holds a Bachelor of Fine Arts Degree with a concentration in Photography and Painting from USL in Lafayette, Louisiana.

It is his impeccable work ethic and his degree in fine arts combined with his unparalleled experience in branding, management, and leadership that makes him such a force.

He has thirty years of retail industry experience and owns a concierge and construction management company. His success in the real estate world comes from knowing how to lead, how to negotiate, and how to make things happen brilliantly and without exception.

For Aaron, doing the right thing, means attending to any client need that may arise from driving contracts to and from title companies, meeting mobile notaries on site, reading the meter on a prospective sale, and staging a home.

Aaron is acutely aware that the key to the best transactions is impeccable communication, and there is nothing at which Aaron is more skilled. He answers every call and responds to every text. The time of day is no matter – what matters is always delivering the most refined service each and every time.

Paramount to all of Aaron’s work is building lasting relationships and helping clients to make the most informed decisions. Whether it is a home or a piece of property, whether a client is buying or selling, Aaron instills in clients the kind of confidence that can only come from working with a discerning professional of the highest caliber.

No decision has ever been easier for Aaron than choosing to be a part of the Martha Turner Sotheby’s International Realty team. Having superior tools and the latest in technology at his fingertips, allows Aaron - a 2020 Top Producer at his previous firm - to always be one step ahead of the competition.

In the high stakes world of real estate, you do not just want to get a property on the market, you want to get it the attention it deserves. Aaron Sonnier gets every property and client the attention they deserve.

agents.bio:
Buying or selling a home can feel overwhelming, especially when you are trying to make the right decision for your family, your finances, and your future.

That is where I come in.

With 20 years of real estate experience and a strong background in relocation, negotiations, and the Katy and greater Houston market, I help sellers, buyers, landlords, tenants, and investors move forward with confidence.

My goal is to make the process smoother, more informed, and less stressful by guiding you step by step, helping you avoid costly mistakes, and making sure you feel supported from start to finish.

Whether you are buying your first home, selling to make your next move, relocating, investing, or navigating the rental market, you deserve a REALTOR® who brings knowledge, persistence, problem-solving, and genuine care to the table.

Real estate is more than a transaction to me. It is about relationships, trust, and helping people find not just a house, but a place they can truly call home.

Ready to make your next move?

remarks: Modern duplex sits on an oversized 7,775 SF double lot with a large backyard and potential to build another duplex. agents.bio:
It is Shad’s total dedication to guiding clients safely through the complex real estate process that makes him one of the most trusted and knowledgeable real estate professionals in the Houston area. His enthusiasm for education and his love of imparting it to others through his weekly real estate radio program has brought him recognition as a professional who not only knows his stuff but wants to make sure his clients are also fully informed.  

As a lifelong resident of Houston who also holds an actual degree in real estate, Shad is uniquely qualified in every aspect of this field and will walk clients through every step of the process, from real estate financing to closing, fully explaining clients' options along the way. As the producer of a long-running and successful call-in radio program focusing on real estate, Shad is intimately familiar with the myriad details of the home buying and selling process, giving clients unparalleled access to his breadth of knowledge. He carefully listens to clients' unique goals and needs to formulate an effective plan to meet them. To make sure nothing falls through the cracks, he has assembled a staff of highly qualified professionals to take care of the many details involved in client's real estate transactions. Because of his years of experience helping first-time homebuyers find their dream home, Shad is especially turned to the unique needs and anxieties buyers face.

agents.companyName: Compass RE Texas, LLC - West Houston
agents.bio:
Hanah Choukal is an enthusiastic and dedicated Realtor with a true commitment to helping you with the sale, purchase, or lease of your home. Exceptional customer service is of paramount importance, so Hanah treats every client with the highest level of respect, integrity, and commitment whether she is finding the ideal home for a new buyer or helping a seller achieve their goals in record time. Having recently joined the Champions office of Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate Gary Greene, she offers a patient and knowledgeable buying and selling experience and enjoys giving her clients an insider’s view of local neighborhoods to help them make well-informed decisions. 

Clients receive Hanah’s full dedication to meeting the challenges of her responsibilities, from inception of a first meeting to closing the transaction. The same quality of attention never waivers. It is given to first -time home buyers, moving up buyers, buyers for new and period homes, as well as new and seasoned investors. With her down-to-earth attitude and straight-forward style of doing business, Hanah’s ongoing goals are to connect the right sellers and buyers to maximize the experience for whichever party she is representing. Selling or buying a home can be stressful, but Hanah wants to make your real estate experience an exciting and joyous one with superior customer service.

remarks: Now offered at $299,990 with brand-new carpeting! Welcome to 5931 Foresthaven Dr in the established Greenwood Forest community. This spacious 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers 2,824 sq. ft. of living space on a 9,600 sq. ft. lot. The thoughtfully designed layout features formal living and dining rooms, a comfortable den with a gas log fireplace, a bright breakfast area, and a versatile upstairs game room. The kitchen includes a breakfast bar, double ovens, electric cooktop, and ample cabinet space. Two bedrooms are located downstairs, including the primary suite, offering flexibility for everyday living, guests, or a home office. Recent improvements include newly installed carpeting, adding a fresh touch to the interior. High ceilings, large windows, and tile flooring enhance the living spaces. Step outside to enjoy the covered patio overlooking the spacious, fully fenced backyard. Complete with a detached 2-car garage and convenient access to shopping, dining, parks, and major roadways.

agents.bio:
Prior to joining Keller Williams, Claudia cultivated her skills by graduating from University of Tamaulipas with a degree in architecture. Architecture gave her the sensibility and expertise in construction building and the ability to perceive and appreciate details. She also has 45 years in marketing and retail business, which developed her skill set as a strong negotiator and entrepreneur at youthful age.
 
Adding designations and specializations to her real estate education is evident of her willingness to work hard on her client’s behalf and to inform them of the latest tendencies of the market. Claudia reflects her genuine desire to help others and shares her knowledge with her clients. She is fluent in both English and Spanish. Claudia has lived in Houston for 30 years. Having personally relocated and purchased several homes, she knows how vulnerable the client can be in the transaction process.

I am a trilingual real estate agent fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese. I have lived and studied abroad in Mexico, Chile, Spain and Brazil and I love to travel and learn about other cultures. My experiences abroad help me to relate to people from all walks of life and the diversity of the greater-Houston area is one of the things that I most love about living here. The abundance of fantastic restaurants is another thing I really enjoy about living here. In my free time you might find me sampling new cuisines, listening to podcasts about a number of topics or doing aerial yoga. I moved to Katy in 2007 after obtaining my undergraduate and Master’s degrees from the University of Pittsburgh. Prior to becoming a Realtor, I taught Spanish in Pennsylvania, Cypress-Fairbanks ISD and Katy ISD. Having worked with students for many years increased my patience, dedication & ability to help others throughout a step by step process to reach their goals. My goal is to make the process of buying or selling a home stress-free and enjoyable as possible. I’m here to help you make good decisions with this large investment and provide excellent customer service. I enjoy helping new residents learn about the local area so that they can feel right at home here. I have designations as a Certified Negotiation Expert and Certified Home Marketing Specialist and I’m a recipient of the International Sterling Society Award.

agents.bio:
Over 18 years and hundreds of millions of dollars in Houston closings taught me one thing that never changes: the deal is won before anyone signs — in the prep, the pricing, and the negotiation. That's where I go to work for you.

I'm Le Nguyen, Broker and Owner of Go-M Realty, and I took the road less traveled to get here. I hold an accounting degree from UH-Downtown, so I read a contract the way few agents do — every number, every clause, every dollar that should stay in your pocket. Before real estate, I worked as a contractor for the U.S. Army in Kirkuk, Iraq, during the war as a purchaser, handling logistics, supplies and contracts. I also spent 16 years coaching competitive women's gymnastics — a sport where everything comes down to preparation, nerve, and executing when it counts. Those chapters shaped how I run a deal today. The numbers stay tight, and I don't flinch when the stakes climb.

When it's time to sell, I don't sit on a listing and hope. I market it hard — sharp pricing, strong presentation, and a strategy built to put your property in front of the right buyers fast. I'm a Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist and a Certified Negotiation Expert, but the part of my business I'm proudest of is the referrals. Most of my clients come from people I've worked with before — folks who trusted me enough to send me their family and friends. I don't take that lightly, and I've built my whole career on earning it.

When I'm not at the closing table, you'll find me in the gym, hunting down a new restaurant across town, planning my next trip, or getting talked back to by Lola, my parrot. When you're ready to make a move in Houston, I'd be proud to be your partner.

remarks: Rare new-reconstruction in the Heights, this 4-bed, 4.5-bath main home offers 2,889 sq ft on a 6,600 sq ft lot plus a 509 sq ft garage apartment (2 bed, 1.5 bath) ideal for guests, extended family, office, or income potential. Open-concept living centers on a gas fireplace and chef’s kitchen with ZLINE appliances, 36” range, wine storage, large island, and generous prep space. Outdoor living includes an elevated vaulted deck above the garage apartment and a lower-level outdoor kitchen and dining area for layered entertaining. Turfed, low-maintenance backyard with sprinkler system. Exceptional layout and versatility throughout.

remarks: Welcome to The Tremont, one of Westchester's most desirable resort-style communities. This beautifully maintained 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condominium offers the perfect blend of comfort, style, and convenience in an unbeatable Westside location. The open-concept floor plan features rich hardwood flooring, fresh interior paint, a gorgeous faux wood accent wall in the living room, and seamless indoor-outdoor flow to an oversized private patio. Both bedrooms and the living room offer direct access to the patio, creating an airy and inviting extension of the living space. The gourmet kitchen is thoughtfully appointed with granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, generous cabinetry, and a new refrigerator, creating a space that is both functional and inviting. The spacious primary suite offers dual closets, including a walk-in closet, and a beautifully remodeled en-suite bathroom featuring dual vanities and a stunning oversized walk-in shower. The second bedroom and bathroom provide flexibility for guests, a home office, or additional living space. Additional highlights include a new 2026 HVAC system, in-unit stackable washer and dryer, central heat and air conditioning, and two assigned secured subterranean parking spaces.Residents of The Tremont enjoy an exceptional array of amenities, including a sparkling pool and spa, fully equipped fitness center, clubhouse, recreation room, stylish lounge areas, secured entry, guest parking, and beautifully maintained grounds. Ideally situated near Playa Vista, Marina del Rey, Westfield Culver City, LAX, shopping, dining, major freeways, and the beach, this turnkey home offers convenient access to many of the Westside's leading employers, including Amazon, Google, YouTube, Apple, Sony Pictures, Snap, Hulu, and the thriving Silicon Beach tech corridor.

agents.bio:
#1 Team on the Westside, #2 Mega Team in California, #4 Mega Team in the United States (per RealTrends June 2026)

Founder and CEO of Pardee Properties, Tami Pardee has established dramatic new standards of success in real estate. She created a cutting-edge concierge brokerage model built around specialized teams, strategic leadership, and life-changing client experiences. Since its inception in 2005, Pardee Properties has sold over $8 billion in residential and commercial real estate and expanded to three offices across California — earning its place as one of the top-ranking brokerages in the state.

While many know Tami as one of LA’s top-producing agents, she’s spent the past five years as the full-time CEO of Pardee Properties — shaping the company’s growth strategy, mentoring agents, and ensuring that every sale reflects her unwavering standards. Tami remains actively involved behind the scenes on key listings, offering strategic guidance on pricing, positioning, and negotiations, while her hand-selected listing team leads the day-to-day client experience.

Under her leadership, Pardee is ranked by Real Trends/The Wall Street Journal as the #1 Mega sales team on LA’s Westside, #2 in California, and #4 in the nation. The Los Angeles Business Journal has also recognized the firm as one of the largest woman-owned businesses and fastest-growing companies in Los Angeles.

Tami’s impact extends well beyond real estate. She’s a champion for community empowerment, having directed over $1.65 million in charitable giving to underserved areas of Venice and West LA. She also founded the nonprofit Life Change Warriors, guiding people of all backgrounds to overcome fear, set goals, and chart new paths in life. Her recognitions include The Hollywood Reporter’s Top Real Estate Agents, The Real Deal’s Top 20 Agents in LA, LABJ’s LA 500 Most Influential People (three consecutive years), and Good Housekeeping’s Awesome Women Award, among others.

Despite a diagnosis of multiple sclerosis, Tami continues to lead with vision, heart, and resilience. She is a proud member of YPO and a sought-after speaker in real estate and entrepreneurship. Based in Venice, she lives with her husband and business partner John Moos and their blended family of six — a true modern-day Brady Bunch.

Amber McLain has been an award winning agent and top producer for over twenty years. Her early career as one of the most sought after and knowledgable escrow officers for luxury home transactions in Beverly Hills gave her a major advantage when she moved into sales. A polished professional, with commanding knowledge of the buying and selling process and a diligent commitment to her clients, she regularly completes a prodigious volume of sales and is in demand by buyers and sellers alike for her expert representation. As an owner of multiple properties herself, she is as comfortable dealing with seasoned investors as first time home buyers, and takes pride that the vast majority of her business comes from referrals and repeat clients. "Having been on all sides of the transaction," Amber says, "gives me a unique perspective when helping my clients, and my experience allows me to anticipate and react to every situation which will ultimately give my clients a wonderful experience.

In 2024 and 2025, Stephanie Younger was the #1 agent in the City of Los Angeles and the Westchester Neighborhood, selling more Single-Family homes than any other real estate agent or team. With unmatched expertise in Westside and South Bay neighborhoods, Stephanie and her team have built their brand on a reputation for service that exceeds all expectations.

Why Buyers and Sellers Choose Stephanie Younger:

- Ranked #11 Sales Team in LA County by the LA Business Journal (2024)
- Over $3 billion in lifetime sales.
- Consistently ranked a top producer in West LA real estate
- Featured in The LA Times, The Argonaut, Dwell, SpectrumNews, The RealDeal and more
- Neighborhood Expert: West LA & the Silicon Beach Corridor

As a Los Angeles native and long-time Westchester resident, Stephanie offers hyper-local knowledge that few agents can match. She specializes in: Westchester, Playa del Rey, Playa Vista, Marina del Rey, Culver City, Venice, and El Segundo

What Makes Stephanie Different?

- Stephanie's unique background in sales, event planning, hospitality, and the arts makes her an expert in both marketing and negotiation.
- She believes: “Real estate, like life, is all about getting the details right.”

Her Process Includes:

- Helping clients define and align their vision, goals, and budget
- Managing complex transactions with clear communication
- Navigating escrow, lending, and inspections with zero surprises
- Leading a high-performing team to deliver seamless service

Local, Loyal, and Living Here...

Stephanie lives in Westchester with her husband—a playwright and LMU professor—and their two children. She’s proud to serve the neighborhoods she calls home, and her passion for community is reflected in her generous support of local charitable organizations including the YMCA, Westchester Arts and Music Block Party, and more.

Known as the glue that holds Pardee Properties together, Samantha has been Tami’s “right hand” for over 10 years.  Born and raised in Culver City with a bachelor’s degree in Communications from Cal State University of Northridge, Samantha fell into real estate by chance and has passion in it ever since. “It’s an amazing feeling to be excited to come to work every day – it’s so much more than just a job – the adventure, memories and most of all the relationships with the individuals I get to meet are all priceless.”

Samantha strives to exceed client’s expectations while making them feel secure and at ease in every scenario presented. Enjoying Tami as a mentor, Samantha has attacked the opportunity to learn all aspects of this business. A keen work ethic and the ability to juggle multiple projects with ease have made her a key force to the Pardee team.

remarks: Discover the timeless appeal of Mid-Century Modern design in this Tanglewilde gem. agents.bio:
Rae Lynn White is a Houston native and seasoned REALTOR® with 25 years of experience, consistently recognized as a top-producing agent. Part Realtor, Part Matchmaker, she’s known for connecting people with homes that truly fit their lifestyle. Now with Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Premier Properties, Rae Lynn combines deep local knowledge with a modern, client-focused approach to help buyers and sellers navigate Houston real estate with confidence.

Living inside the Loop since 1992, Rae Lynn has an insider’s understanding of Houston’s historic neighborhoods and diverse housing stock. A true old-home enthusiast, she brings both market savvy and a genuine appreciation for architecture, character, and craftsmanship. Her clients value her integrity, work ethic, and hands-on service—and often become friends and neighbors along the way.

With multiple home renovations behind her, Rae Lynn offers more than guidance—she offers perspective, helping clients buy and sell homes with a sharp eye for potential and real-world experience.

When she’s not working, Rae Lynn enjoys unplugging with her spouse and young daughter, creating memories and recharging at their German farmhouse in La Grange.

remarks: Owned by only two families, and located in El Sereno's desirable University Hills area, this 1937 bungalow has fully paid off SOLAR and an automatic robot lawn mower! Imagine your monthly electricity bill being $0!! There are so many reasons to love this home. Its personality is reflected in coved ceilings, original period tile in the bath, stylish light fixtures, and character throughout. Beautiful newly refinished hardwood floors offer warmth and welcoming vibes. Patio level basement workshop offers 300+ additional square feet! The pergola patio with fire pit is perfect for alfresco dining and entertaining. Programmable lighting offers seasonal styling and excitement for all occasions. Alarm system and keyless entry are installed for your convenience and security. Green thumbs take note of the low water, low maintenance landscaping, and generous space in the vegetable garden and a beautiful grapefruit tree. Need I go on?? Find ample storage space in lockable Tuff shed, garage and basement. The detached one and half car garage offers use-of-space flexibility. Engineering drawings for the garage space will be transferred to the new owner. Plenty of driveway parking, and close proximity to local businesses and transportation make life convenient. This could be your new home!

remarks: Move-in ready! Located on a quiet, tree-lined street between Westwood and Century City, this beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence offers approximately 1,569 sq. ft. of light-filled living in a Mediterranean-style building. A secure entry leads through a charming open-air courtyard with a fountain, setting a welcoming tone before entering the residence. Inside, a thoughtful floor plan unfolds with a foyer, an open kitchen with an adjacent family room, and a spacious living area designed for both relaxed daily living and easy entertaining. The bedrooms are positioned on opposite sides of the residence, providing privacy and separation. The primary suite features a walk-in closet space, a tub, and direct access to a large, covered balcony. Multiple rooms open to the balcony, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow and extending the living space for morning coffee, dining, or evening gatherings. Architectural details include wood floors, crown moldings, graceful arches, tilework, and tall ceilings. Additional amenities include gated underground parking with two tandem spaces and guest parking. Ideally located just moments from Westwood Village, Century City, UCLA, and many of the Westside's most popular dining and shopping destinations.

agents.bio:
Chris Hicks is a Director of the Estates Division at the Agency. Chris recently joined The Agency from Berkshire Hathaway, where he ranked among the top 1% of sales associates nationwide. Specializing in luxury properties across L.A.’s Westside, he believes that knowledge, integrity and local expertise are the keys to success.

Born and raised in Santa Monica, and currently residing in Brentwood, Chris is particularly fluent in coastal properties and brings an insider’s perspective to every transaction. Known for his extensive market knowledge and quick follow-up, Chris is committed to providing impeccable service throughout every step of a transaction. Chris also prides himself on remaining up-to-date on recent transactions and market trends, as well as local schools, parks, restaurants, shopping and service professionals to better serve his clients.

With a background in the construction industry, Chris utilizes his experience to help buyers and sellers navigate the complex list of repairs that may arise during a transaction. His unshakeable work ethic and dedication have allowed him to center his business on repeat clients and referrals, often garnering insider-information on the latest listings before they hit the market.

A graduate of Loyola Marymount University, when Chris isn’t representing clients in real estate, he enjoys spending time with his family, playing sports, and entertaining. He is an active member at the Beach Club, Santa Monica.

Angela von Detten is a Los Angeles–based real estate professional specializing in luxury homes, estates, and new development across Santa Monica, Brentwood, and the Westside. With a background deeply rooted in real estate—having grown up around property development in Taiwan—Angela brings a rare combination of global perspective and local expertise to every transaction. Fluent in Mandarin and a graduate of UCLA with a degree in sociology, she blends cultural fluency, emotional intelligence, and market insight to serve her diverse clientele with precision and care.

Known for her passion, determination, and deep commitment, Angela treats every client’s journey as if it were her own. Whether representing buyers, sellers, or investors, she is a fierce negotiator and trusted advocate who prioritizes long-term relationships over one-time transactions. Her mission is not only to help clients find their perfect home or investment but to empower them with confidence and clarity throughout the process.

Beyond her success in real estate, Angela treasures time with her three children and family, exploring new restaurants and traveling to discover fresh perspectives. For her, real estate is more than a career—it’s a calling to create meaningful connections and lasting impact in the lives of those she serves.

remarks: Completely reimagined and updated down to the studs, this exceptional Briargrove home blends timeless design with modern luxury. Every major system has been replaced, including a new roof, HVAC, electrical, and energy-efficient windows, offering peace of mind for years to come. Thoughtfully designed for both everyday living and entertaining, the home features a stunning controlled wine room with secure access, custom cabinetry throughout, a spacious butler's pantry, and a premium appliance package with Thermador and Bosch appliances. The outdoor living space is equally impressive, complete with an outdoor shower and beautifully curated spaces that extend the home's functionality. This is a rare opportunity to own a turnkey home where every detail has been carefully considered.

remarks: Welcome to easy single-story living in Inwood North! This charming 3 bed, 2 bath home with a 2-car attached garage offers a great opportunity to move in now & add your own personal touches over time. Inside, enjoy an open & airy layout with wood-look laminate flooring in the foyer & family room, tile in the kitchen & dining areas, a vaulted ceiling, wood-burning fireplace, & a flexible formal dining room that could also serve as a study or sitting area. The kitchen features granite counters, tumbled stone backsplash, rich wood cabinetry, an undermount sink with pull-down sprayer, & sleek black appliances. The spacious primary suite offers 2 walk-in closets & a private bath with dual sinks, granite vanity, & updated walk-in shower. Refrigerator, washer & dryer stay. Extras include Nest thermostat w/Wi-Fi, leased security system, full-yard sprinkler system, & fenced backyard. Neighborhood amenities include pool, park, & tennis courts. Zoned to Klein ISD & quick access to 249.

Her multicultural background and extensive network allow her to connect with clients from all walks of life, providing an empathetic and tailored real estate experience. Mary's unwavering commitment to her clients' dreams and goals truly sets her apart. She makes the real estate journey enjoyable and even fun, understanding the profound life changes it often represents. Her dedication extends to walking alongside her clients through every transaction, ensuring that each step is handled with precision and care. In 2011, Mary founded Circa Real Estate, which flourished under her leadership with a team of nearly 30 agents renowned for their personalized and unique services. Her approach is characterized by generosity, selflessness, and an unmatched work ethic, inspiring her team to consistently go above and beyond. Her 19th Street storefront stands as a testament to her commitment to community development, frequently hosting local art, community events, and support for neighborhood businesses. Recently, Mary has transitioned her team, the Circa Houston Group, to Realty of America, allowing her to expand her reach while maintaining the personalized service her clients have come to expect. For Mary, Houston's Heights is more than just a location; it's a cherished community. Whether you're buying, selling, or investing, Mary Wassef is your trusted partner in navigating this vibrant and historic Houston neighborhood.

agents.bio:
Brad Evans is a Broker Associate with the Houston Properties Team and was named Best Realtor in Fort Bend County by Living Magazine (2025). He has served Richmond, Katy, Sugar Land, Fulshear, Cypress, Missouri City, and Fort Bend County, TX since 2012.

A University of Dayton graduate with a finance background, Brad takes a data-driven approach — pricing homes with real local comps, building neighborhood market-trend guides, and pairing sharp negotiation with staging and marketing that helps listings sell quickly and for top dollar. He has sold 190+ homes since 2012, with about 68% of his business coming from repeat clients and referrals.

A born-and-raised Houstonian and Eagle Scout, Brad is recognized as a Team Top Producer and Five Star Service Professional, and is a member of the Houston Association of REALTORS® (TREC #). Clients describe him as responsive, calm under pressure, and genuinely in it for the long haul.

Whether you're a first-time buyer, relocating, buying new construction, or selling in Fort Bend County, Brad delivers local expertise and honest guidance.

Annie Chen, a visionary leader the driving force behind Homegrown Wealth's leadership, Annie deftly navigates and directs elite teams, including The A-Team, and The A-Team Commercial Real Estate (ACRE) Keep Mom Safe (KMS). In 1988 Annie honed her skills in real estate investment, development, financing, sales, and marketing. A dedicated UCLA Bruin and a proud USC and UCLA Mom, Annie earned her degree in Business Economics from UCLA.  Annie is happily married with two children. Currently residing in Beverly Hills. She is fluent in English, Taiwanese, Cantonese, and Mandarin. She enjoys reading, ballroom dancing and golfing. Annie is a determined, client-focused business woman, developer, and author who is always ready to help. She is passionate about building wealth in real estate through strategic investments.

Michelle Hinton has been a consistent top producer throughout her decade-long career in real estate. By navigating each transaction with integrity, finesse and an impeccable diligence, Hinton is adept at ensuring a smooth and seamless transaction. She works alongside her husband, Rick, and employs a small team of industry experts to ensure a top-notch client experience.

In addition to maintaining a 5-star rating on HAR, Hinton is ranked as one of HAR’s top producing listing agents. She has also earned several industry designations and is a member of the Greater Houston Luxury Home Connection and the Houston Relocation Network group. Hinton is consistently among the Top 1 percent for production and maintains a five-star rating in Texas Monthly.

remarks: Welcome to 6423 Coachwood, a stunning, move-in-ready residence that has been thoughtfully renovated from top to bottom. This beautiful 4-bedroom home showcases soaring vaulted ceilings, a cozy fireplace, and a bright, open layout designed for both comfortable living and effortless entertaining. Major updates completed in 2022 include a new roof, energy-efficient Low-E windows, sliding glass door, HVAC system, updated plumbing, repaired foundation, luxury flooring, designer lighting, a fully remodeled kitchen, and spa-inspired bathrooms featuring elegant granite countertops. Step outside to a spacious, fully fenced backyard perfect for relaxing or hosting family and friends. With high-end upgrades throughout and exceptional value, this home is ideal for first-time buyers or anyone seeking a turnkey property with modern style and lasting quality. Schedule your private tour today!

agents.bio: Downtown's number one Realtor, Terry Stanfield, is a Missouri native turned devoted Houstonian since 1987. While Terry is well attuned to the entire city he focuses on marketing the Downtown and Midtown areas. His extraordinary knowledge of this chosen market has become the stuff of legend. He lives and loves the urban lifestyle that he sells so successfully and is one of the defining reasons that Downtown Houston has reemerged as the place to be. Working for 14 years as Director of Operations and Customer Service for a Houston auto group prior to choosing a career in real estate, Terry learned how to provide exceptional assistance and client satisfaction. Terry brings this same love for working with people and customer service experience to Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate Gary Greene. Driven to succeed for all the right reasons, Terry promises he will do whatever it takes to provide great service and get the job completed, and he fulfills that pledge by giving his clients and career his all. That attitude has earned him the undying respect of his peers and clientele and a well-deserved reputation for flawless execution and attention to detail. It is this dedication that first earned him the Star Achiever award in 2003, then moved him to Top Producer status in 2004, where he has remained ever since. In a company with offices throughout Houston and more than 1,100 agent licensees, Terry's being listed as one of the Company-Wide Top 20 Producers year after year is certainly proof of his outstanding achievement. But the true testament to his enduring and exceptional success was his being ranked locally by the Houston Business Journal as one of the area's Top 25 Residential Real Estate Professionals from 2009 through 2017 and now nationally among REAL Trends' Top 100 Agents List, where he was one of only two Realtors in Houston and only seven in the entire state of Texas! Terry's commitment to his clients has also earned him a Five Star Professional Ranking. With integrity, enthusiasm, and sincere attention to the needs of his clients Terry ensures award-winning customer service every time.

agents.bio:
There is an elegance to the way in which Aaron Sonnier works. He manages every detail, no matter how small. He is committed to excellence in service and luxury in every way. He curates his every choice with refinement and grace.

That would explain why he is an esteemed member of Martha Turner's Circle of Excellence.

Nothing compares when it comes to the unsurpassed attention he pays to every client and every property, right down to the clothes he wears and the image he projects. It is no wonder why he was voted Best Dressed Realtor (2019) by Realtor Magazine.

Originally from Lake Charles, Louisiana, Aaron holds a Bachelor of Fine Arts Degree with a concentration in Photography and Painting from USL in Lafayette, Louisiana.

It is his impeccable work ethic and his degree in fine arts combined with his unparalleled experience in branding, management, and leadership that makes him such a force.

He has thirty years of retail industry experience and owns a concierge and construction management company. His success in the real estate world comes from knowing how to lead, how to negotiate, and how to make things happen brilliantly and without exception.

For Aaron, doing the right thing, means attending to any client need that may arise from driving contracts to and from title companies, meeting mobile notaries on site, reading the meter on a prospective sale, and staging a home.

Aaron is acutely aware that the key to the best transactions is impeccable communication, and there is nothing at which Aaron is more skilled. He answers every call and responds to every text. The time of day is no matter – what matters is always delivering the most refined service each and every time.

Paramount to all of Aaron’s work is building lasting relationships and helping clients to make the most informed decisions. Whether it is a home or a piece of property, whether a client is buying or selling, Aaron instills in clients the kind of confidence that can only come from working with a discerning professional of the highest caliber.

No decision has ever been easier for Aaron than choosing to be a part of the Martha Turner Sotheby’s International Realty team. Having superior tools and the latest in technology at his fingertips, allows Aaron - a 2020 Top Producer at his previous firm - to always be one step ahead of the competition.

In the high stakes world of real estate, you do not just want to get a property on the market, you want to get it the attention it deserves. Aaron Sonnier gets every property and client the attention they deserve.

The Boutwell Team
For over 25 years Cindy Boutwell has proudly served the Greater Houston real estate market. With deep roots in the community, they specialize in Cypress and surrounding areas including Tomball, Spring, Magnolia, Waller, Hockley, Northwest Harris County, Waller County, and Montgomery County.
Working from an award-winning office recognized for both production and quality of service, Cindy and her team has earned the trust and respect of their clients. Their reputation is built on professionalism, integrity, and exceptional client care.
Community Commitment
The Boutwell Team believes real estate is about more than buying and selling homes—it’s about building stronger communities. Cindy and Dan are proud to partner with local schools throughout the year, volunteering at events, speaking at 1000 Guys in Ties and 1000 Girls in Tiaras, Volunteering at local schools providing support for teachers.
They also give back by supporting Family Ties, Family Resource Services, where Cindy currently serves as Board President. Through fundraising efforts and hands-on service, they continue to make a positive difference in the lives of local families. In 2025 Boutwell Properties helped raise over $50k for Family Ties, Family Resource Services. The Boutwell Team ONLY partners with local title companies, lenders, cleaning crews, contractors that share the same values of giving back to our local community. 
Professional Expertise
Certified Home Marketing Specialist – Cindy helps sellers “Dress Your House for Success,” ensuring every property is market-ready and appealing to buyers.
Luxury Home Specialist – Offering premium service for high-end properties.
Unmatched Market Knowledge – Dan and Cindy EACH have over 22 years of experience successfully negotiating contracts, listing homes, representing both buyers and sellers and investors.
Full-Time Realtors® – Dedicated to clear communication and seamless guidance throughout the buying and selling process.
Team Culture
For Our Clients
Our culture is built around service, trust, and relationships. When you work with The Boutwell Team, you’re treated like family. We believe in relationships over transactions, guiding you with honesty, transparency, and care every step of the way. From the first meeting to the closing table and beyond, you’ll feel supported, informed, and confident in your decisions.

For Our Team
Behind the scenes, The  Cindy Boutwell Team thrives on collaboration, mentorship, and shared success. Our 12 agents work in a supportive environment where knowledge is freely shared, achievements are celebrated, and personal growth is encouraged. We believe that when our team feels valued and empowered, our clients receive the very best service possible.
The Team
The Cindy Boutwell Team is comprised of local community leaders who share a commitment to exceptional service. Their collective goal is to provide clients with the knowledge, tools, and confidence they need to make the best decisions—whether buying a dream home or selling a current one.

Why Choose The Boutwell Team?
Trusted by clients for over two decades
Award-winning office for service and results
Strong community presence and leadership
A people-first culture of care, collaboration, and trust.

Personalized strategies tailored to every client

Call The Boutwell Team today – They’ll get you moving!

agents.bio: Esther Atere is a full-time real estate agent with Keller Williams Southwest who began her real estate journey with a mission to secure her children's education. Prior to this she was a real estate investor for 20 years plus. Today, she uses the same methodical and strategic approach to help her clients build their own real estate portfolios. Esther is an expert in commercial, residential, land, and luxury properties. She works with a diverse range of clients, from young professionals making their first property purchase to seasoned investors expanding their portfolios. Before transitioning to real estate, Esther had a successful career in business development within the Energy and Consulting sectors. She also was an engineer in the oil and gas industry for over a decade, managing multi-million-dollar projects globally. This diverse background provides her with a unique and insightful perspective on the real estate market and analyzing real estate data and trends. She believes in using her experience in finance, contracts, negotiating, and marketing to your best advantage. Combining our extensive knowledge of Houston and surrounding area with her expertise in real estate will produce results for you.

Thalia has a proven history of increasing the values in neighborhoods. She will advise the owner on what it takes to get top dollar for their home and gets results. She will go the extra mile to make the process less strenuous on the seller. She also works with buyers showing residential properties and demonstrating the features and benefits of available homes. Thalia will evaluate the needs of a buyer whether it is for a resale home or new construction home. She is an experienced negotiator and prepares contracts and documentation. She advises home buyers on general escrow and title procedures, design and update marketing material, and perform competitive home marketing evaluations.

Founder and President of Energy Realty, Sherry Campbell is recognized as the most successful broker in the burgeoning Energy Corridor and West Houston. Energy Realty is a Houston-based, privately owned, top producing boutique brokerage with a global client list. Sherry is known within the industry as a real estate, entrepreneur, and innovator. Leading by example and fostering the success of agents. A true thought leader, Campbell is an admitted perfectionist who believes in giving her clients and team members 110%.

Campbell, a supportive broker, established Energy Realty in 2012. Since that time, she has grown it to include 40+ agents, two offices and posted more than $130M in production in 2022. Known for her inimitable integrity, five-star service, mentoring skills, ability to analyze and respond to market changes and commitment to community. She recognizes what today’s agents need to be successful. Campbell is a working broker – dealing with buyers and sellers on a daily basis.

For Shantanu Patil, it started as a hobby and a desire to assist friends find the home of their dreams. He himself has been a resident of the Southwest Houston area for 20 years. With a Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering and a Master's in IT, Shantanu has a strong background knowledge of structures and design. This made the understanding of Real Estate transactions an easy adaptation. The passion grew and he was very successful in building a good reputation in the arena of selling and buying homes. During the initial meeting itself, Shantanu is quick to understand his client's needs and their taste. Whether it is identifying the right property to buy, marketing the property to sell, or negotiating tough buy/sell situations. Be it a first home or a luxurious multi-million dollar home, he has helped clients in all stages of their home buying experience. Shantanu is very personable and has excellent interpersonal skills and quickly gains his client's trust. He is very transparent and straightforward in his communication with his clients. Over the years, he has served multiple clients in making their real estate transactions a smooth and immensely satisfying experience. Most of his new clients are referred to him by existing or previous clients. If you are in the market for a new home or wish to sell your existing home, Shantanu will take the worry and stress out of this process and will be right there with you and on your side each step of the way!

agents.bio:
My name is Lynn Blair. I am the mother of 2 beautiful children! I was an elementary school teacher for over a decade in Cy-Fair and continue to substitute if I have a free moment. I also coach Special Olympics Track and Swimming for the Cy-Fair school district and foster for the local Cypress dog rescue, Cypress Lucky Mutts. Aside from my love of children and animals, I have always had a passion for real estate. I have been an investor along with my husband (whom is a realtor as well) since 2009.

12 years ago I made my dream a reality and took up real estate alongside my husband, Cody. Three years ago, I became a broker and we opened up Blair Realty Group here in Fairfield! I have lived in Fairfield in the Cypress area for over 18 years and have watched it grow from FARfield, to one of the most beautiful, outstanding neighborhoods in the Houston area. I love this area and know how amazing it has been to live, work, play, and start a family here. I pride myself in customer service and making sure we find you EXACTLY what you are looking for! We service anywhere from Katy, Cypress, Tomball, Spring and MORE! I CANNOT WAIT TO MAKE YOUR DREAM A REALITY AND FIND YOU THE PERFECT HOME! Thank You!

remarks: Beautifully remodeled spacious 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home is designed for comfortable living and effortless entertaining. The dramatic two-story entry opens to a bright, open-concept layout with abundant natural light and no carpet throughout. The main floor features a private primary suite with a large bath remodeled in 2023, while upstairs offers three additional bedrooms, including a guest room remodeled in 2023, and a spacious game room—perfect for family, guests, or a home office. The kitchen offers 42-inch oak cabinetry with abundant storage and opens to the family and breakfast areas. Major updates include HVAC, water heater, range, and dishwasher, all replaced in 2023, plus a roof replaced in 2018. remarks: Set in the heart of Silver Lake's coveted Sunset Junction, this charming 1920s Spanish bungalow blends timeless character with modern comfort just moments from the neighborhood's most beloved cafes, restaurants, and shops. Filled with natural light, the thoughtfully designed 2-bedroom, 1-bath residence showcases classic charm at every turn, from the decorative fireplace and expansive built-in living room bookshelf to the inviting breakfast nook tucked beside the kitchen. Dark wood floors flow throughout the main living areas, complementing the home's character-rich details. The updated kitchen features stainless steel appliances, butcher block countertops, and a warm, welcoming atmosphere ideal for everyday living and entertaining. Beyond the main home, an architect-designed converted garage bonus space with a seamless bi-fold door provides a versatile bonus space perfect for a creative studio, home office, gym, or guest retreat. Central heating and air conditioning in the main residence ensure year-round comfort, while an EV charger hookup adds modern convenience. Outside, lush landscaping creates a private urban oasis complete with a mature lemon tree, grapevine, fragrant rosemary, and vibrant bougainvillea. The spacious backyard is designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living, featuring a dining and lounge deck with a magnolia tree, illuminated by twinkling garden lights- an ideal setting for entertaining or quiet evenings at home. Just two blocks from Sunset Boulevard and a short stroll to Alfred Coffee, Night + Market Song, Millie's Cafe, Bacari, and other neighborhood favorites, this exceptional home places the best of Silver Lake right outside your door. Enjoy easy access to the Silver Lake Reservoir, highly regarded Micheltorena Elementary, and the vibrant lifestyle that makes this one of Los Angeles' most sought-after communities. A rare opportunity to own an authentic Spanish bungalow in one of Silver Lake's most desirable locations.

remarks: Fine finishes energize this coastal residence with thoughtful elegance and functionality. Ascend past an aromatic garden of drought-tolerant planting to a welcoming covered patio. From there, enter the spacious living room anchored by a stately fireplace and newly restored wood flooring that adds warmth and character throughout the home. Freshly painted interiors create a bright and inviting atmosphere, complementing the home's refined design. Entertain in the bright and airy kitchen equipped with newly painted cabinetry, stainless appliances, Caesarstone counters, and a convenient island. Returning inside, two well-appointed bedrooms share a spacious, recently updated bath. The primary suite is a sanctuary featuring a spa-like en suite bath plus attached space that provides options as a den, office, or nursery. The backyard is your own personal oasis with functional artificial turf lawn, shading provided by matured trees and privacy hedging, and LeafGuard gutter protection installed throughout the home for low-maintenance outdoor living with gutters that don't require routine cleaning. An impressive bonus space behind the garage provides options for a home office, gym, or additional living space and both vaulted ceiling and views of lush wisteria vines. Centrally located in the heart of Kentwood, this impressive enclave is not to be missed.

remarks: Nestled in the heart of Mar Vista, just moments from Marina del Rey and Playa Vista, 4241 Beethoven St is a masterfully reimagined 1925 Spanish-style residence that seamlessly blends timeless character with elevated modern living. Meticulously remodeled and rebuilt in 2019, this exceptional property offers refined design, thoughtful functionality, and luxurious indoor-outdoor living in one of the Westside's most desirable neighborhoods. While preserving its classic Spanish charm, the home was taken down to the studs and underwent an extensive transformation with updated electrical, plumbing, HVAC, roof, windows, and major systems throughout offering the benefits and peace of mind of modern construction. Spanish tile-lined walkways welcome you into a sun-drenched great room featuring soaring vaulted ceilings, an inviting fireplace, and an airy open-concept floor plan designed for both everyday comfort and sophisticated entertaining. The designer kitchen serves as the centerpiece of the home, complete with a large center island, Carrera marble countertops, Samsung Smart appliances, custom cabinetry, and a striking custom wine display. The main residence features 3 bedrooms and 2 beautifully appointed bathrooms, including a stunning primary suite with vaulted ceilings, a thoughtfully designed walk-in closet, dual vanities, and French doors that open directly to the serene backyard retreat. Step outside to a beautifully landscaped, ultra-private backyard designed to evoke a spa-like experience, complete with a custom-built Finnleo sauna imported from Finland and multiple spaces to relax or entertain under the California sun. Adding incredible versatility and value, the fully permitted detached 1-bedroom, 1-bath ADU includes its own kitchen, bathroom, and separate address ideal for guests, a home office, creative studio, or income potential. Additional highlights include SMART home capability, Nest thermostat, Google Nest doorbell and security system, CAT 6 wiring throughout, and a surround sound speaker system. Perfectly situated near Short Avenue Elementary School which has a 10/10 GreatSchools rating, shops, restaurants, and lifestyle destinations of Marina del Rey, Playa Vista, and the greater Westside, this rare Spanish sanctuary offers the ideal blend of charm, sophistication, and modern convenience.

agents.bio:
Driven by core values of hard work, integrity, and outstanding client service, Lalit Khanna is a Houston real estate professional with a business tailored to residential sales and leases. Passionate about friendly and informed representation of the purchase or sale of a home, Lalit is committed to offering a seamless and stress-free real estate experience and gives his clients an insider’s view of local neighborhoods to help them make the best decision for them.

Lalit is passionate about his clients and his business. Prior to launching his real estate career, Lalit worked as a corporate customer service manager and consultant for over two decades. Always eager to help people and solve problems, Lalit brings a proven track record of excellent customer service skills and compassionate client care. In today’s highly competitive market, he has taken deliberate steps to stay on top of market conditions by earning professional distinctions such as Real Estate Negotiation Expert, Pricing Strategy Advisory, Graduate of the Realtor Institute, Seniors Real Estate Specialist, and Texas Residential Leasing Specialist.

In his free time, he enjoys spending time traveling, listening to music, and dining out. He is a proud member of NAR, TAR, and HAR as well as the Houston Audiophile Society. Passionate about his community, Lalit is actively involved in neighborhood landscaping as well as holiday party committees.

agents.bio:
I began my career in Residential Real Estate because everyone deserves a place to call home—and I wanted to be the one to help make that happen. Trained and mentored by some of the industry’s best, I bring a strong commitment to professionalism, client care, and continuous improvement. Guided by the principles of Total Quality Management, I’m always learning—through certifications, webinars, and mastermind sessions—to stay ahead of the curve.

Selling or buying a home can feel overwhelming—emotionally, financially, and logistically. Why? Because it’s not just a transaction; it’s a major life transition and I get it. I’ve lived through it myself multiple times.

Then there is the looming ominous worry - “What if something goes wrong?”

I am proud to say, after 10 years in the business, I have guided hundreds of clients through their transitions and transactions - SUCCESSFULLY! My purpose is clear to me: Cut through the real estate brain fog and remove the fear factors. Keep it stress-free and simple and make them smile!

My father would tell me, “You think too much.” He meant it as a criticism—but I consider it my greatest strength. I’m constantly analyzing, learning, and anticipating—so I can make smart recommendations, resolve problems, protect my clients’ blind sides and seize opportunities before others do. I can provide the clear and honest confidence-building advice needed to make the best decisions for you and your family. I provide realistic timelines and present real numbers so there are no surprises at the closing table. I lead with transparency, trust, and implement programs designed to help my clients sleep better at night.

As you may know, real estate is a relationship business—built on trust and word-of-mouth. That’s why I’m dedicated to delivering five-star service every time. My success depends entirely on your success and your confidence in referring me to your family, friends, and neighbors.  Over the years, clients and colleagues have praised my work and dedication. I’m deeply grateful for the endorsements and referrals from those who see me as a trusted adviser, subject-matter expert, and top-rated agent. You can see my reviews on HAR and Zillow.

It’s been an incredible journey, and I’m grateful every day that I chose this path. If you’re looking for a Realtor who understands what you’re going through—who’s experienced, proactive, and fully invested in your next life chapter—look no further.

Let’s talk about your next move.
Call or text: 555-952-4547

agents.bio:
As a 5th generation Houstonian, I have a deep appreciation for this city and its people. This is an exciting time to live in the Greater Houston Area, and I'm proud to be a part of it all! I've been licensed for 10 plus years and have successfully closed over 500 transactions since 2010. Although I live and work in Bellaire, I proudly serve the entire Houston market and will continue to provide exceptional service for each of my clients and my community as a whole. As your Real Estate Specialist, I promise to be your trusted resource for answers about the process of buying or selling. I will provide expertise about neighborhood features and schools and will target your home search based on your individual needs and wants. My custom innovative marketing strategies along with my strong negotiation skills are the keys to your successful transaction.

As an agent who's an expert in this local area, I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise about buying and selling real estate here. It's not the same everywhere, so you need someone you can trust for up-to-date information. I am eager to serve you. Here are some of the things I can do for you. Do you need someone who knows this area inside and out? I can work with you to find the right home at the right price for you, including all the neighborhood amenities that matter - not to mention the essential criteria you have for your ideal home. When it's time to move, you need someone who will advertise your home, show it to prospective buyers, negotiate the purchase contract, arrange to finance, oversee the inspections, handle all necessary paperwork and supervise the closing. I can take care of everything you need, from start to close. Oftentimes buyers don't visualize living in your home the way you do. I can make your home attractive to its ideal audience which can help you get top dollar. Things like staging the home, making repairs or minor improvements, or even simply painting the walls can be the difference between a home resting on the market and one that's sold fast.

remarks: Welcome to Idlewood Condominiums! A gated community surrounded by oak trees and lush, mature landscaping. This first-floor condo is the largest 1-bedroom, 1-bath in Idlewood. agents.bio: I am originally from the Panhandle of Texas where I graduated from Amarillo College as a Dental Hygienist. We moved to North Carolina for 24 years and it’s great to be back in Texas! After retirement from Dental Hygiene, I made a career change to Real Estate and continue to care for people. Now, I’m caring for people in a different way...helping them realize their dream of owning a home!

Meet Chantelle. Chantelle is a seasoned agent, bringing a wealth of experience and expertise to the world of real estate. She earned the distinction of Top Producer, closing over $10 million in sales. Carrying that momentum, she continues to shine as a top-producing agent, a testament to her relentless commitment and exceptional skills. Her venture to Houston sprouted in 2008 when she made a spontaneous move from Arizona to continue the pursuit of her Business Administration studies at the University of Houston-Downtown, graduating with high honors. Before carving her path as a Realtor, she found her footing in the legal industry, collaborating with law firms specializing in real estate transactions. Drawing from a wellspring of 15+ years of industry experience, Chantelle skillfully merges her past and present capabilities to ensure that her clients receive the guidance and support they need to achieve their goals. Beyond her professional pursuits, Chantelle embraces an active lifestyle. She enjoys going to high energy bootcamp classes, finding balance through flowy yoga sessions, savoring leisurely walks, exploring local scenes/activities with friends, and making travel plans with family. Chantelle lives in a neighborhood nestled just North of the Heights where she dedicates time as a monthly volunteer with the Civic Club. Chantelle also frequently participates in outings and volunteer engagements allowing her to foster connections and strengthen her local involvement. Whether selling a cherished home, purchasing a dream property, or navigating leasing intricacies, Chantelle stands as a reliable partner with an unwavering commitment to guide and advocate for her clients.
