remarks:
ADDITONAL 40K PRICE REDUCTION! ABSOLUTELY RARE opportunity to own a truly turnkey, top-to-bottom remodeled 3-bedroom, 1-bath home with exceptional future development potential in one of East Los Angeles' most convenient and centrally located neighborhoods.

Situated within a Special Planning (SP) zoning area, the property may offer the potential to develop up to four additional residential units—two homes and two ADUs—creating the possibility of five total residential units on the property (buyer to independently verify zoning, development potential, and all building requirements with the appropriate governmental agencies).

The beautifully renovated front residence has been thoughtfully rebuilt with quality craftsmanship and modern design throughout. This comprehensive renovation showcases contemporary finishes, recessed lighting, brand-new flooring, a stunning kitchen with brand-new appliances, and fully upgraded mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems—delivering the style, comfort, and peace of mind today's buyers are looking for.

The location is equally impressive. Situated directly across from Eugene A. Obregón Park, you'll enjoy immediate access to green space, recreation, playgrounds, sports facilities, and outdoor activities. Just minutes away are Downtown Los Angeles, the USC Health Sciences Campus, the Keck School of Medicine of USC, Los Angeles General Medical Center (formerly LAC+USC Medical Center), Cal State LA, East Los Angeles College, Monterey Park, Montebello, and the City of Commerce. South Pasadena, Pasadena, and Glendale are also just a short drive away. Convenient access to the I-5, I-10, I-710, and SR-60 freeways provides seamless connectivity throughout Los Angeles, the San Gabriel Valley, Santa Monica, Long Beach, and Orange County.

Whether you're searching for a move-in-ready primary residence, a multi-generational family property, or an exceptional investment opportunity, this home offers a rare combination of modern living, a premier location, and outstanding long-term development potential. Live in the beautifully remodeled front home today while exploring the opportunity to build additional residences tomorrow—creating long-term value, multiple income streams, and a legacy investment for generations to come.

remarks: Tucked inside a small, gated community in the Westchase District, this townhome offers an unbeatable location just outside Beltway 8 and Westheimer—plus no back neighbors for extra privacy. Upstairs, you’ll find a versatile game room, office nook, two additional bedrooms, a nice secondary bathroom, and walk-in laundry room. Neutral finishes throughout make this home truly move-in ready!

I may not be related to former President Bush, but I can help you whether you want to buy a white house, a blue house, or a yellow house! I have lived in Atascocita for over 25 years and has two grown children and four beautiful granddaughters. I am very family oriented and believe that your home is one of the biggest investments you and your family will make. I would like to be there to help you find the perfect home and get the most money for your current home! My areas of expertise are Atascocita, Humble, Kingwood, Huffman, and Crosby, but I am willing and able to help you buy or sell your home anywhere in Houston and the surrounding areas. 

My husband (of 32 years) and I are experienced investors and currently own 39 rentals, both Airbnb, plus short- and long-term rentals. We began investing in 2007 and shortly after opened a Property Management company that my husband runs, Vestpro Residential Services. He manages both Residential and Commercial properties plus Specializes in Commercial Real Estate on top of being a Property Manager.

agents.bio:
For almost 3 decades, Real Estate has been my passion. I love the intricacies, complexities, & fact that every transaction requires not only market knowledge & competency but also the challenge of surpassing client expectations. I take very seriously & w/ great pride the fact that most of my business comes from past clients, their friends, families & associates. Nothing is more satisfying than to hear from clients whose real estate needs I have handled for decades. Nothing makes me happier than the fact that many of these clients have become lifelong friends.

While my job definitely entails helping clients buy & sell real estate, perhaps the most important aspect of my job is giving clients the most accurate & credible information. Buying or selling are not always the best options. My job is to give my clients information w/ which they can make 1 of the most important decisions of their economic lives. While I am always grateful for the opportunity to market a home, my job is to help clients make the best decision for themselves & their families.

I am a lifelong Houstonian & third generation Texan. Although I grew up in River Oaks & Tanglewood, where my parents built in the 50s, I have lived for the past 40 years in a Museum District home that my father built in 1930.

I have a BS in Horticulture from Texas A&M & am a passionate gardener & garden lover. Like absolutely everyone who writes a profile, I love to travel but at the end of the day, there is no place that beckons me year after year like West Texas. The wide-open spaces of Big Bend, Alpine, Marfa and Terlingua require a road trip with the dogs at least once a year.

When not working, I am either gardening, spending time w/ Lola and Milo my rescue pups, or teaching my feral cats tricks w/ flaming hoops & batons. I am a Feral Cat Colony Manager & support a number of international childrens and animal causes including the ASPCA, Child Fund International.

agents.bio:
Success has never been accidental for Ced. Long before becoming one of Houston's most recognized real estate professionals, he was building businesses and creating opportunities. From selling cool cups as a child, to running successful ventures as a teenager and college student, to owning local businesses, entrepreneurship has always been woven into his DNA. That relentless drive ultimately led him to real estate, an industry where dedication, expertise, and work ethic directly impact results.

Today, Ced has built a reputation as one of the Houston area's premier real estate advisors, closing more than 300 transactions and facilitating over $85 million in real estate sales volume. His success is rooted in a simple philosophy: put people first, deliver exceptional service, and create results that change lives.

Clients quickly recognize that Ced's approach is different. His leadership style is authentic, hands-on, and unwaveringly focused on helping buyers, sellers, and investors achieve their goals. Whether guiding a first-time homebuyer, negotiating a luxury home purchase, or helping investors maximize returns, Ced brings the same level of commitment, transparency, and strategic expertise to every transaction.

Ced Attended Abilene Christian University for 3 years but earned his Bachelor's degree in Communications and MBA from Texas Southern University, Ced combines education, innovation, and market expertise to provide clients with a competitive advantage. As a former collegiate football athlete, he learned early that success is earned through discipline, preparation, and determination—qualities that continue to define his career today.

Throughout his career, Ced has earned numerous industry accolades, including:
• 4xTop Producer (2019-2022)
• 3x Golden Level Producer (2022-25)
• HBREA Top 40 (2021)
• Voted #1 Agent on Social Media in Pearland by Property Spark (2020)
• Jesse H. Jones School of Business 40 Under 40 (2019)
• Ruby Masters Award Recipient (2018)
• Voted #2 Agent on Social Media in Texas by Property Spark (2017)
• Quality Service Pinnacle Producer (2016 & 2017)
• Houston 40 Under 40 (2016)
• Quality Service Award (2015)
• Gold Jacket Recipient (2014)

Ced has also been featured at numerous speaking engagements throughout Houston, sharing his expertise on real estate, entrepreneurship, branding, and business development.

As Founder of the Reserve Realty Group, brokered by Legacy Homes & Properties, Ced leads a team dedicated to delivering a world-class real estate experience. Through personalized service, cutting-edge marketing, advanced technology, and in-depth market knowledge, the team helps clients confidently navigate one of the most important financial decisions of their lives.

For Ced, real estate is about more than buying and selling homes—it's about building relationships, creating wealth, and helping families establish lasting legacies.

Beyond real estate, Ced remains deeply committed to serving the community that helped shape him. A former educator and passionate mentor, he supports youth development through after-school programs, youth athletics, and the Space City Heat 501(c)(3) football program. His dedication to mentorship and community service reflects the same values that have made him successful in business: leadership, integrity, and a genuine desire to help others succeed.

When you work with Ced Thomas, you're not just hiring a real estate agent—you're partnering with a trusted advocate, skilled negotiator, and proven professional dedicated to helping you achieve extraordinary results.

agents.bio:
As a proud Southern California resident for over 45 years, I bring deep roots, local insight, and personal pride to every real estate transaction. I’ve had the privilege of growing up, raising my children, and giving back to the very communities I now serve. From coaching Little League to volunteering at neighborhood schools, my ongoing involvement in the community allows me to offer clients a true insider’s perspective on the Southern California lifestyle and market.

As a United States Marine Corps Veteran and current Commandant of the Big Stick Detachment of the Marine Corps League, I’ve built my life and career on the values of integrity, accountability, commitment, and clear communication. I bring those same values into every real estate deal making your satisfaction and needs my top priority.

With experience helping first-time buyers, seasoned investors, and families with diverse needs, I tailor my approach to match your goals. If you’re buying a home, I’ll take the time to understand exactly what you’re looking for then work relentlessly to find the perfect fit. You should never have to settle when it comes to your future.

If you’re selling your home, my knowledge of the local market and my finely tuned marketing strategies will help ensure your property stands out and sells for the highest possible price.

No shortcuts. No guesswork. Just honest service, expert guidance, and results that move you forward.

Kristi had a successful career in sales and marketing for some of the top media companies including CBS, Viacom, Cox Communications and Clear Channel. She quickly became a top producing account representative due to her attentive customer service, strong work ethic and by creating unique, successful solutions for her clients. Her insight into the market, along with her ability to execute propelled her into leadership roles. 

Kristi decided to become a stay-at-home mother after her second child and be as involved as possible in the life surrounding her children. She took the drive and determination to help her clients and applied it to help improve local community organizations as she has always had a heart to help wherever she could. 

Many families choose to live in Manhattan Beach because of the strength of the school system. Kristi’s experience and involvement in the Manhattan Beach School District and the Manhattan Beach community make her uniquely qualified to help her clients understand the nuances of any school in the district. Her goal is to ultimately guide families towards buying a home in the area that is also the best fit for their children. 

Kristi is partnered with Principal Rudy Kusuma who has more than 100 years' experience and is consistently ranked as one of the top brokers in Southern California. She is a Southern California native and a long time Manhattan Beach resident. Kristi is a member of the National Association of Realtors (NAR), the South Bay Association of Realtors (SBAOR) and a certified sellers representative (SRS). 

If you have any questions about searching for or selling a property, or property management, please feel free to contact Kristi.

remarks: Imagine stepping out your front door and into the heart of it all. 3139 Jeanetta St sits on a generous 13,980 SF lot between Richmond Ave and Westheimer Rd, surrounded by shops, restaurants, offices, medical and multifamily uses. Picture living in a custom-built, all-brick single-story home and running your business steps away, with coffee, clients and errands just around the corner. Inside are 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, both formals and a 2-car detached garage with a covered walkway to the kitchen, plus a storage and utility room. Live here, work here, lease it or plan for tomorrow. The Westchase, Richmond, Hillcroft and Fondren corridor keeps growing, minutes from the Galleria, Westchase District, Beltway 8, Westpark Tollway and I-69. A rare blend of home, land and opportunity. Buyers should verify deed restrictions, platting and city permitting for any intended use.

remarks: Nestled in the sought-after Enclave at Shady Acres, this freestanding 3-bedroom, 3.5-bath home offers luxury, comfort, and unbeatable Inner Loop convenience in a gated community. Built in 2008 by award-winning Sandcastle Homes, this residence showcases quality craftsmanship with hardwood and tile flooring, crown molding, and soaring 10-foot ceilings. The open-concept floor plan is ideal for entertaining and everyday living, featuring a granite island kitchen with stainless steel appliances, gas range, abundant cabinetry, and refrigerator included. Spacious living and dining areas offer abundant natural light. The oversized primary suite features a spa-inspired granite bath with separate shower, whirlpool tub, and generous closet space. Secondary bedrooms offer private bath access. The property is also equipped with an electric car charger for added modern convenience. Enjoy low-maintenance living with easy access to The Heights, restaurants, shopping, parks, and major freeways.

remarks: Tucked in the heart of Houston’s Energy Corridor, this beautifully designed 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath custom home blends character, comfort, and everyday functionality. The open kitchen offers granite countertops, stainless appliances, and easy flow to the breakfast room and formal dining area. The primary suite includes a marble-accented bath and generous closet space, while the upstairs layout offers three spacious bedrooms, two baths, and a large bonus room with flexible use potential. Recent enhancements include PEX plumbing, a tankless water heater, pool updates, A/C service, and select home improvements. Outside, enjoy a covered patio, private courtyard, and sparkling pool designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living near I-10, dining, shopping, parks, and Katy ISD.

agents.bio:
Peggie Pentecost has been a Houston realtor for over 25 years, specializing in residential real estate. Her expertise covers a wide range, including resale and new construction properties, multi-family residences, and residential leasing. While she's well-versed in traditional neighborhoods around Loop-610 like West University and River Oaks, her market knowledge extends to areas such as The Woodlands, Cypress, and Sugar Land.

Peggie is deeply committed to community service, holding leadership roles in various organizations, including the Houston Association of Realtors. She currently serves as the National Liaison  of the Women's Council of Realtors, she is currently serves on the Board of Directors for Houston Association of Realtors and for Texas Realtors. Peggie  has been an instructor at the University of Houston Small Business Development Center where she headed up the Women’s Roundtable program and taught Business planning and Marketing to Entrepreneurs. She shares her insights as a real estate panelist and speaker at industry-related events and actively participates in committees for the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo.

As a 5th generation Houstonian, I have a deep appreciation for this city and its people. This is an exciting time to live in the Greater Houston Area, and I'm proud to be a part of it all! I've been licensed for 10 plus years and have successfully closed over 500 transactions since 2010. Although I live and work in Bellaire, I proudly serve the entire Houston market and will continue to provide exceptional service for each of my clients and my community as a whole. As your Real Estate Specialist, I promise to be your trusted resource for answers about the process of buying or selling. I will provide expertise about neighborhood features and schools and will target your home search based on your individual needs and wants. My custom innovative marketing strategies along with my strong negotiation skills are the keys to your successful transaction.

As an agent who's an expert in this local area, I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise about buying and selling real estate here. It's not the same everywhere, so you need someone you can trust for up-to-date information. I am eager to serve you. Here are some of the things I can do for you. Do you need someone who knows this area inside and out? I can work with you to find the right home at the right price for you, including all the neighborhood amenities that matter - not to mention the essential criteria you have for your ideal home. When it's time to move, you need someone who will advertise your home, show it to prospective buyers, negotiate the purchase contract, arrange to finance, oversee the inspections, handle all necessary paperwork and supervise the closing. I can take care of everything you need, from start to close. Oftentimes buyers don't visualize living in your home the way you do. I can make your home attractive to its ideal audience which can help you get top dollar. Things like staging the home, making repairs or minor improvements, or even simply painting the walls can be the difference between a home resting on the market and one that's sold fast.

agents.bio:
Mimi and Jon Torp’s story began with a blind date more than 30 years ago, and their marriage—built on humor, respect, and compromise—has shaped both their lives and their business. Specializing in Santa Monica and Westside neighborhoods, the Torps are known for raising the bar when it comes to achieving top dollar for their sellers. Their proven buying and selling strategies, combined with sharp negotiation skills, consistently deliver outstanding results.

What truly sets them apart is their people-first approach. They listen with empathy, communicate with honesty, and act with integrity—earning the trust and respect of clients, colleagues, and the community. Having recently sold their longtime Santa Monica townhouse and purchased a home in Mar Vista, they bring firsthand insight into today’s buying and selling experience.

Giving back is at the heart of what they do. Their award-winning community care programs have supported environmental initiatives at Westside schools and promoted neighborhood earthquake preparedness. The family business has also grown with the addition of their daughter, Emily, who brings fresh market insights and expertise in print and social media marketing.

Together, Mimi, Jon, and Emily craft custom marketing plans for every listing, leveraging print, social, and digital platforms to generate thousands of qualified views. They are hands-on in every transaction and go above and beyond to ensure their clients don’t just meet their real estate goals—they exceed them. For the Torp Team, the lasting relationships and friendships they build are the most rewarding part of their work.

A longtime industry professional with a distinguished track record of success, Peter Gragnani has built a highly successful business over the past 20+ years. Combining a diverse professional background with in-depth knowledge of the entire Los Angeles area, Peter is adept at quickly connecting with any client and guiding them through the entire transaction process.

Before joining the world of real estate, Peter received a degree in Criminal Justice and also studied at the renowned Culinary Institute of America in Hyde Park, N.Y. He honed his tireless work ethic at the prestigious Patroon and Butterfield 81 restaurants in Manhattan, before heeding the call of the West and moving out to L.A.

A natural salesman with a knack for forming close, authentic relationships with clients, Peter’s diverse range of experiences has left him well-equipped to connect with clients from all walks of life. He has represented many high-profile individuals in real estate sales, as well as international buyers from Taiwan, Mexico, Norway, and elsewhere.

Peter has lived in several different areas throughout Los Angeles, selling proficiently in a broad range of premier neighborhoods including Hollywood Hills, Beverly Hills, West Hollywood, Bel Air, Westwood, Miracle Mile, and Pasadena. He has an in-depth understanding of the market throughout the region, having worked with buyers and sellers all over L.A.

Most importantly, Peter has earned the trust, respect, and loyalty of luxury homebuyers and sellers with his high-touch and individualized personal service. Peter’s intimate knowledge of the area’s higher-end homes, his honest-to-a-fault approach to every detail of the purchase and sales process, and his ability to market luxury properties with the most effective techniques all combine to create a rewarding experience for his clients. He has built a loyal base of clientele over the years, including significant referral business. Whomever the client, Peter is known for going above and beyond to deliver exceptional results.

agents.bio:
The Bruner Team is currently a one-woman show—me, Elisa (Bruner) McNinch—and I’m honored to carry on the real estate legacy my parents began more than 40 years ago. Real estate has always been personal in our family, and that’s exactly how I still do business today: with genuine care, calm guidance, and a big dose of Southern hospitality.

I’m proud to have been recognized with the Five Star Professional Award for real estate customer service 13 years in a row (2012–2025)—an honor earned by fewer than 1% of Houston-area Realtors. I’m also a consistent multi-million dollar producer, but what matters most to me is that my clients feel heard, protected, and confident from start to finish.

If you ask where I work in Houston, you’ll probably hear me say: “If you divide Houston in half, I work the left-hand side.” I primarily serve Northwest Houston, and I’m very familiar throughout West Houston as well, including Spring, Tomball, Spring Branch, Cypress, Katy, and Richmond/Rosenberg.

Even though I’m tech-savvy (and yes—your home will be marketed online the right way), I still believe the best service happens voice-to-voice and face-to-face whenever possible. I’m hands-on with every client: meeting with sellers to stage and prepare a home, taking listings, coordinating photography, marketing, showing properties, hosting open houses, attending inspections—you name it. I’m the face and heart of The Bruner Team.

Behind the scenes, I’m supported by a trusted transaction coordinator who helps prepare listing documents and offers, tracks deadlines, and keeps everything moving smoothly—so you get both personal attention and professional precision.

If you’re looking for a knowledgeable agent who feels more like a steady partner than a sales pitch, I’d love to help you make your next move.

Shana is an investment sales broker for clients looking to build wealth through commercial real estate and multi-family units. Shana has a masters in public administration & a background in law enforcement which has provided a strong frame work for negotiation. She continues to draw on her emergency management experience, and her ability to see through to the core matters in time-pressured situations has proven to be a valuable asset in representing her clients' interests.

remarks: Not your typical home. This architecturally distinctive contemporary residence pairs dramatic scale with light-filled, highly functional living. Soaring vaulted ceilings, expansive Low-E windows, and bold architectural lines set the tone, while a floor-to-ceiling fireplace anchors the living room beneath a striking second-floor gallery. The kitchen centers around an oversized quartz island with shaker cabinetry, stainless appliances, dual pantries, dry bar, and abundant storage. Floor-to-ceiling dining windows frame a private courtyard, while a skylit atrium creates an inspiring office, reading room, or lounge. Hard-surface flooring throughout, pet-friendly turf, a double iron entry gate, plus shared ownership of the community pool and tennis court complete a rare offering for buyers seeking design, privacy, and something truly different.

agents.bio: Starting his second year of his career in real estate on a team, was an excellent choice looking back. He immediately was thrown into the real estate market and forced to learn the right way by putting the clients first. He brings a very particular perspective on real estate, as he also is the Owner and Founder of Legacy Preferred Lending (Hard Money Fix/Flip Loans) as well as Legacy Premier Title company.  His brand was maximized by leveraging his business using the eXp Real Estate Model, being one of only two 10X Icon Award recipients of eXp realty’s most prestigious award. The training and collaboration they offer at eXp launched the second part of his career into new levels by using their technology and CRM systems to put his business on autopilot. Jeff has built a very sophisticated AI platform using Claude, Gpt, and Anthropic, ensuring his team stays ahead of the many AI platforms to be able to serve his clients at a very high level. They are investor heavy on the transaction side and eXp allows them to leverage out the ins and outs of the deals to focus on finding new deals for their investors, selling luxury homes, and navigating the buying process throughout Texas.

Houston, Texas and its surrounding areas are great places to live and work, which is why Kevin chooses to call it home. Born and raised in Houston, Kevin settled in one of its northern suburbs, Klein, TX in 2013. His background, dating back to 2001 as a residential designer and home builder/developer, offers the perfect opportunity to meld his knowledge and passion for real estate with his commitment to Houston area residents and investors.

As a proud member of the international eXp Realty family, Kevin carries the values of hard work, integrity, and outstanding client service into everything he does. He isn't solely focused on helping clients purchase and sell real estate. Kevin also serves on his neighborhood's board and loves being part of its community events. When Kevin isn't in the office or volunteering, he enjoys spending time with his family and friends at restaurants and events around town.

remarks: Tucked away into a quiet cul-de-sac in the highly sought-after Brook Forest neighborhood, this beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 2.5 bath home offers 2,742 sq ft of thoughtfully updated living space. From the moment you arrive, the impeccable landscaping and new siding set the tone. Inside, tile flooring flows throughout, anchored by a beautifully updated kitchen perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Anderson windows flood the home with natural light while boosting energy efficiency. The standout feature is a heated and cooled sunroom with interchangeable screens and glass windows - a true year round retreat. The 2-car garage includes a bonus room for a workshop or storage. Major mechanicals are solid: 5-year roof, heat pump, and updated systems throughout. Enjoy the Brook Forest HOA lifestyle with parks, a pool, and scenic trails -- all within a top rated school district.

agents.bio:
Binky Watkins is more than just a name in Houston’s luxury residential real estate scene. Originally from Minnesota, she’s embraced the essence of the Greater Houston Area since her teenage years. Binky’s diverse journey, from insurance agent to senior sales director, with a 12-year Middle East stint, uniquely informs her relocation expertise. She has called various places across the greater Houston area her home, all the way to College Station. Venturing into real estate inspired by a close friend and seasoned real estate agent, she brings her zeal for challenges, an undying passion to help others find their dream homes, and an acute sense for the art of the deal.

Binky fluently communicates in English and is on a quest to master Spanish, further broadening her reach. What truly sets her apart, however, is her extensive international exposure. Having relocated almost a dozen times in her life, she’s not just familiar with the nuances of real estate but is a seasoned guide in navigating the emotional and logistical intricacies of moving. To Binky, Houston is a vibrant tapestry of diverse cultures that captivates her with its wide array of attractions, encompassing everything from sports and culinary offerings to its culturally rich festival scene.

Away from the hustle of property deals and viewings, Binky spends her time with her daughters and her grandchildren. Her unwavering philosophy, whether as a mother, grandmother, or a committed real estate agent, is to treat everyone as family.

agents.bio:
Val is committed to continuously participating in continuing education to ensure that she and her staff provide their clients with the most accurate, thorough & knowledgeable service possible to protect your interests & make the experience of buying or selling a home as enjoyable as possible.

For their seller clients, they have developed a 33 point comprehensive marketing system that provides clients with some very unique services for listing properties. It is unmatched in the local market! A few of the strategies include advertising your listing on over 100 local & national websites, reverse prospecting & reverse offers, and providing an immediate call tracking system for inquiries, & virtual broker open houses.

They work closely with Buyers to educate & protect them throughout the process. They analyze, not only the most recent sales activity in an area, but also complete trend reports to see the longer term history of the neighborhood's sales prices. Their goal is to negotiate a strong deal & help buyers obtain "instant equity".

Valery grew up around real estate by helping her grandparents fix up homes & re-sell and/or lease them. They also owner financed many properties to increase their returns even more, so she realized early on the power of Real Estate. She followed in her family's footsteps & was an Investor for many years before obtaining her Real Estate License in 2006, after retiring as a Health Care Executive.

She & her husband love to travel, enjoy great wine, & LOVE animals! She "gets in trouble" a lot with her husband for rescuing animals!
The team is also committed to giving back to the community. Val volunteers regularly at an Assisted Living Facility, & they donate a portion of their earned commission from every transaction to the charity of their clients' choice!

remarks: Beautifully maintained and updated home nestled at back of gated Enclave on TC Jester. Kitchen overlooks the expansive living and dining areas, yet is still a separate working space. A bay window in the living room and balcony off primary bedroom overlook Little Thicket Park at back of community. Generously sized primary suite provides a peaceful retreat with a spa bath, complete with two sinks, a soaking tub, separate shower, and a large walk-in closet. Balcony off 2nd bedroom overlooks back yard. Low-maintenance backyard is ideal for pets, relaxing and hosting friends. Located just minutes from The Heights, Downtown Houston, Memorial Park, and miles of interconnected Houston Bayou trails for jogging and cycling, this home combines modern living with an excellent location. agents.bio:
He is very knowledgeable about the nuances in many neighborhoods throughout Houston, which strengthens his ability to help people relocating to Houston from other cities. David's primary concern is satisfying his clients, because satisfied clients generate repeat business and referrals. 

A native Houstonian, David graduated from Memorial High School in 1980 and received a BA in finance from the University of Texas at Austin in 1984. He traveled internationally after college, then moved to California, where he cultivated a diverse management background, including two years in residential mortgage brokerage, nine years in international trade management, and six years in enterprise software sales management. 

David returned to Houston in 2001, obtained his real estate license, and joined his father, David H Young, in residential real estate sales. In January 2005, they started the David Young Team, bringing together top-producing agents and experienced assistants to provide the highest quality service to buyers and sellers of residential real estate. They were recognized for 12 years by the Houston Business Journal as one of the Top 5 Teams in Houston, with sales volume over $100,000,000 per year.

David joined Compass in October 2020, where he has operated as Young Realty Group - a small team of agents and a licensed assistant with them since 2014. ?On a personal level, David's wife Brenda and he are very active in animal rescue. She established Save A Purrfect Cat Rescue many years ago and they, along with an army of volunteers, find homes for 250-300 cats yearly. To keep fit he has practiced Tae Kwon Do since the 1990s and has been a member of the Houstonian Club since 2007. He also relieves stress by banging on his drum set.

A native Houstonian, Lance graduated from Memorial High School in 1980, went on to the University of Texas at Austin where he received his degrees in business administration and marketing, and attended graduate school at McCombs Graduate School of Business in Austin.

Since the 1980s, Lance has successfully acquired an influential background in building sales, office leasing, marketing and divesting. He also possesses wide-ranging understanding of business management through his experiences owning and managing both private and public companies.

The "Lance philosophy" as a real estate agent is that he must earn his clients business by putting their complete satisfaction first and foremost. He believes that satisfied clients generate repeat business and referrals.

Throughout his career, Lance has had the honor of representing many deserving clients in the Houston area. He first entered the world of residential real estate and then became a top producer, focused on the West University, River Oaks, Bellaire and Close-In Memorial neighborhoods. Now Lance continues his work as a luxury-home agent for both buyers and sellers throughout the Houston area.

As a Texas Real Estate Commission licensed real estate broker, a member of the Texas Association of Realtors, and a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Lance values the trust of his clients and the respect of his fellow brokers and agents.  In his free time, Lance enjoys spending time with his wife, Valerie and their dog Maxwell.  He is also a competitive triathlete, so he is always running, biking or swimming. Lance is a fan of live music venues and watching Houston sports.

remarks: This beautiful townhome, located near I-45, NASA, and Clear Lake, offers modern updates and a functional floorplan with fresh paint and new luxury vinyl plank flooring downstairs, making it move-in ready. The main level features stylish fixtures, a spacious dining room, living area, home office, breakfast nook, guest bath, and an updated kitchen with pretty white cabinets, stainless steel appliances, and a walk in closet. Upstairs, there are three generously sized bedrooms, two full bathrooms, and a convenient laundry room. remarks: New construction duplex featuring two modern residential units—ideal for investors or owner-occupants seeking rental income potential. Each unit offers an open-concept floor plan with ceilings over 10 ft high. Interior finishes include commercial-grade LVP flooring on the first floor and carpet on the second floor, along with quartz countertops. The kitchen features a large waterfall quartz island, white soft-closing shaker cabinets with black sleek hardware, a farm-style sink, and modern pendant lighting. Additional features include recessed LED lighting and motion-sensor lights in the main living areas and bedrooms. Property includes an alarm system and is pre-wired for surround sound and surveillance cameras. Each unit has its own privately fenced, generously sized backyard. Each unit can be leased for between $2,100 - $2,200. Conveniently located ~10 miles from Downtown Houston, ~7 miles from the Texas Medical Center, and ~5 miles from the UH. Builder includes a 1/2/6 warranty.

agents.bio:
Matthew “Matt” Guzman, a real estate agent in Houston and the surrounding areas, is owner of RE/MAX Universal. A native Texan, he spent 11 years in the financial services industry in both Houston and Laredo.

Quality focused, Matt understands both the bottom-line and the long-term impact of service. Searching for a place to practice his true passion in real estate, Matt joined RE/MAX after noticing the top quality training, company reputation and high energy of the agents and staff. As a top producer, Matt consistently exceeds goals and is willing and ready to share best practices with other agents. After joining Matt’s team, agents have gone from no production to multiple units within weeks of joining his team. Matt enjoys giving back and helping agents and clients achieve their goals.

He is bilingual in Spanish and English and is often asked to serve as a translator. An entrepreneur at heart, Matt is very dedicated to serving his customers and building long-term relationships. He is self-motivated, goal-oriented and focused on quality. His friends and family often say, “If you want something done right, ask Matt for help.”

The house-buying and house-selling experiences should be exciting and memorable. Matt strives to provide the best service and loyalty to his clients. Whatever your needs, whether you are looking to buy, sell or join the Matthew Guzman Team, Matt would be honored to serve you.

Real estate is my passion and I always put my clients’ needs first. I believe in customer service before, during and after the sale. You are my customer for life. "I believe in happily ever afters!" My ultimate goal is your happiness. Helping you sell your home for the best price and purchasing the home of your dreams is my number one priority!

I worked in the oil and gas industry for over 22 years, this afforded me the knowledge and experience necessary to work hand in hand with many cultures. I love diversity and learning something new every day. Being fully bilingual allows me to assist Spanish speaking buyers and sellers in navigating through real estate transactions.

I understand the various aspects which go into buying and selling real estate, my goal is to use innovative strategies to achieve your goals. I strive to become your family realtor and take pride in helping you and your family and friends. I am now a Top Producer and have an amazing Top Producing Team. My clients are my priority! After all its all about the EXPERIENCE of Home Ownership!


What I promise, I deliver!

agents.bio: I am a trilingual real estate agent fluent in English, Spanish and Portuguese. I have lived and studied abroad in Mexico, Chile, Spain and Brazil and I love to travel and learn about other cultures. My experiences abroad help me to relate to people from all walks of life and the diversity of the greater-Houston area is one of the things that I most love about living here. The abundance of fantastic restaurants is another thing I really enjoy about living here. In my free time you might find me sampling new cuisines, listening to podcasts about a number of topics or doing aerial yoga. I moved to Katy in 2007 after obtaining my undergraduate and Master’s degrees from the University of Pittsburgh. Prior to becoming a Realtor, I taught Spanish in Pennsylvania, Cypress-Fairbanks ISD and Katy ISD. Having worked with students for many years increased my patience, dedication & ability to help others throughout a step by step process to reach their goals. My goal is to make the process of buying or selling a home stress-free and enjoyable as possible. I’m here to help you make good decisions with this large investment and provide excellent customer service. I enjoy helping new residents learn about the local area so that they can feel right at home here. I have designations as a Certified Negotiation Expert and Certified Home Marketing Specialist and I’m a recipient of the International Sterling Society Award.

agents.bio:
With over a decade in the real estate industry, Jonathan Williamson has been a dynamic force in buying, selling, and managing properties. Since becoming a licensed agent in 2013, he has completed over 300 transactions, showcasing an unparalleled commitment to his clients and excellence in service.

Jonathan began his career in real estate as an investor and has personally acquired and sold tens of millions of dollars worth of real estate; a boast few realtors can make. He has experience flipping, remodeling, and building homes, and has also owned dozens of rental properties. This wealth of experience provides him with a deep understanding of the needs of builders and investors, which he skillfully leverages to the benefit of his clients. With Jonathan, clients are able to focus on their own needs in a home while he looks toward the future for any obstacles that might prevent them from getting top dollar for their investment.

Committed to the community, Jonathan has served on the board of the Women's Council of Realtors and the Art League of Houston. His passion for philanthropy extends to animal rescue and welfare, where he has fostered and found homes for dozens of animals in need.

Living in the charming heavily wooded subdivision of Grogan's Mill with his amazing wife and two beloved rescue dogs, Jonathan embraces a life of service, passion, and excellence. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, a seasoned investor, a home builder or somewhere in between, Jonathan is dedicated to making your real estate journey memorable and successful.

remarks: Nestled in one of Silver Lake's most sought-after pockets, this beautifully restored 1920s Mediterranean duplex blends timeless character with thoughtful modern updates. The side-by-side residences each span two levels and offer 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, beautifully updated kitchens and bathrooms, central HVAC, in-unit laundry, hardwood floors, recessed lighting, generous closet space, dedicated office nooks, and charming sunrooms with views of the surrounding hills and the city skyline.What truly sets this property apart are its exceptional outdoor spaces. Each residence enjoys its own private outdoor area, while the fully fenced grounds provide an uncommon sense of privacy and security, complete with exterior lighting and security cameras. Lush landscaping, mature succulents, vibrant plantings, and fruit trees create a tranquil garden retreat equally suited for entertaining or everyday enjoyment.Adding even more versatility is an approximately 350-square-foot detached, partially converted garage offering one-car parking with an EV charger, along with a flexible bonus space ideal for an art studio, music room, home gym, or office. An additional off-street parking space is available in the driveway.Both residences are occupied by excellent month-to-month tenants paying market rents, generating a combined gross monthly income of $10,550 ($5,800 and $4,750 per month). Current annual operating expenses for utilities and maintenance, including water, sewer, trash, and landscaping, are approximately $7,700. With both leases on a month-to-month basis, the property offers exceptional flexibility for investors seeking immediate cash flow or owner-users looking to occupy one residence while offsetting their mortgage with rental income.Ideally located just moments from the reservoir, Sunset Junction, Erewhon, acclaimed restaurants, boutiques, and nightlife. This is a rare opportunity to own a beautifully restored duplex in one of Los Angeles' most vibrant and coveted neighborhoods.

remarks: Welcome to the iconic Broadway Hollywood, an architectural masterpiece and one of Los Angeles' most coveted historic addresses, at the world-famous intersection of Hollywood & Vine! Designed by renowned architect B. Marcus Priteca and meticulously reimagined as luxury residences, this celebrated landmark seamlessly blends timeless architectural character with sophisticated, contemporary luxury living. This exceptional corner unit is bathed in natural light and features soaring ceilings, designer finishes, and a dramatic open-concept floor plan that creates a striking sense of scale while offering the flexibility of a coveted live-work lifestyle. Beyond the residence itself, ownership includes the highly sought-after Mills Act designation, providing significant property tax savings rarely found in luxury real estate. Indulge in an unrivaled collection of resort-caliber amenities, including a spectacular rooftop oasis featuring a pool, spa, private cabanas, and breathtaking views of the iconic Capitol Records Building, the Hollywood Sign, and the Hollywood Hills. Valet parking, attentive service, a fitness room, and an unmatched location complete the experience. Surrounded by premier dining, entertainment, theaters, nightlife, and some of the city's most recognizable landmarks, this is a rare opportunity to own an extraordinary residence in one of Hollywood's most iconic and architecturally significant buildings.

agents.bio:
As a client-focused, results-driven Realtor and lifelong Houstonian, Tracy Brandon is ready to guide you on your Houston home journey, making sure you feel right at home throughout the process. Tracy has a passion for relationship building and connecting people with other people, places, and things that create a meaningful impact. As a licensed real estate agent, that passion shines through in a variety of ways, including her commitment to finding you a home in a neighborhood that will have a positive, meaningful impact on your life.

Thanks to her previous career in Supply Chain Management (with 20+ years of experience as a Procurement and Contracts Manager), Tracy brings a unique skill set and perspective to her work as a Realtor. That experience helped her become savvy at the art of negotiation and keenly adept at writing contracts that bring value. In addition, her former career contributes to her excellent ability to work with people from different cultures, backgrounds, and professions.

Tracy is a lifelong resident of Houston and a long-term resident of the Heights and inner city. That means she has immense knowledge of inner loop neighborhoods and communities, which she utilizes every day, both as a Realtor and as an active Houston urbanite. She's always in the know when it comes to fun activities, restaurants, and nightlife around the city so don't hesitate to reach out for a recommendation. Tracy is also an ardent music fan and a live music enthusiastshe even used to book live shows! These days, she gives back to the Houston area by volunteering within the music community and working with local artists and venues to promote the Houston music scene and all that it has to offer. Tracy's daughter is her greatest joy in life, and they enjoy experiencing their shared passion for live music together.

agents.bio:
He is very knowledgeable about the nuances in many neighborhoods throughout Houston, which strengthens his ability to help people relocating to Houston from other cities. David's primary concern is satisfying his clients, because satisfied clients generate repeat business and referrals. 

A native Houstonian, David graduated from Memorial High School in 1980 and received a BA in finance from the University of Texas at Austin in 1984. He traveled internationally after college, then moved to California, where he cultivated a diverse management background, including two years in residential mortgage brokerage, nine years in international trade management, and six years in enterprise software sales management. 

David returned to Houston in 2001, obtained his real estate license, and joined his father, David H Young, in residential real estate sales. In January 2005, they started the David Young Team, bringing together top-producing agents and experienced assistants to provide the highest quality service to buyers and sellers of residential real estate. They were recognized for 12 years by the Houston Business Journal as one of the Top 5 Teams in Houston, with sales volume over $100,000,000 per year.

David joined Compass in October 2020, where he has operated as Young Realty Group - a small team of agents and a licensed assistant with them since 2014. ?On a personal level, David's wife Brenda and he are very active in animal rescue. She established Save A Purrfect Cat Rescue many years ago and they, along with an army of volunteers, find homes for 250-300 cats yearly. To keep fit he has practiced Tae Kwon Do since the 1990s and has been a member of the Houstonian Club since 2007. He also relieves stress by banging on his drum set.

A native Houstonian, Lance graduated from Memorial High School in 1980, went on to the University of Texas at Austin where he received his degrees in business administration and marketing, and attended graduate school at McCombs Graduate School of Business in Austin.

Since the 1980s, Lance has successfully acquired an influential background in building sales, office leasing, marketing and divesting. He also possesses wide-ranging understanding of business management through his experiences owning and managing both private and public companies.

The "Lance philosophy" as a real estate agent is that he must earn his clients business by putting their complete satisfaction first and foremost. He believes that satisfied clients generate repeat business and referrals.

Throughout his career, Lance has had the honor of representing many deserving clients in the Houston area. He first entered the world of residential real estate and then became a top producer, focused on the West University, River Oaks, Bellaire and Close-In Memorial neighborhoods. Now Lance continues his work as a luxury-home agent for both buyers and sellers throughout the Houston area.

As a Texas Real Estate Commission licensed real estate broker, a member of the Texas Association of Realtors, and a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Lance values the trust of his clients and the respect of his fellow brokers and agents.  In his free time, Lance enjoys spending time with his wife, Valerie and their dog Maxwell.  He is also a competitive triathlete, so he is always running, biking or swimming. Lance is a fan of live music venues and watching Houston sports.

remarks: Beautifully updated 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home located in a cul-de-sac in the desirable Shepherd Trace neighborhood of West Houston. This property has undergone numerous recent updates including a new roof, flooring, carpet, interior and exterior paint, remodeled bathrooms, countertops, appliances, plumbing and electrical fixtures. The primary bedroom is located on the first floor, while three additional bedrooms are upstairs. Additional features include a formal dining area, home office/study, wet bar, wine room, breakfast area, walk-in closet, and spacious family room. Major systems have also been updated with an HVAC approximately 3 years old and a roof approximately 2 years old. The home also offers a 50-amp EV charging outlet for electric vehicle owners. agents.bio:
Award-winning Houston Realtor Christine Routt delivers exceptional outcomes for buyers and sellers backed by her exceptional work ethic, unbridled honesty and powerful negotiation skills. Having relocated with her family countless times over the years, she knows firsthand how stressful and challenging the moving process can be. More importantly, she knows how to remove as much of that stress and anxiety as possible. As the leader of The Routt Team, alongside her husband Jackson, Christine offers the extensive market knowledge and professionalism that make every home search or sale successful and enjoyable.

Christine launched her professional life as a legal assistant to law and engineering firms, an experience she credits with perfecting the contract knowledge, organizational skills and business acumen that are integral to her real estate success. Since pivoting to real estate in 2006, she has enjoyed serving buyers and sellers across Greater Houston, with a specialty in the Memorial area's Tealwood subdivision, where she resides. Christine is proud of the significant repeat and referral client base she's built over the years, considering it the highest compliment and greatest reward she can receive. Her numerous industry designations, meanwhile, underscore her ongoing dedication to her clients and her craft. 

Christine and Jackson — an MBA with experience in construction, chemical engineering, and the oil & gas industry — have called Tealwood home for 15 years. In fact, she had served on the Homeowner's Association Board for nearly their entire time in the neighborhood. Christine has three grown daughters and seven grandchildren and is a proud stepmom to Jackson's two daughters and son. In their free time, the couple enjoys spending time with their extended family, golfing, scuba diving, walking their dog and traveling.

remarks: Experience refined lakefront living in the guard-gated community of Twin Lakes, ideally located in Houston’s Energy Corridor. This stately 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home invites you in with fresh, light-filled interiors and a versatile layout designed for both relaxed living and elegant entertaining. Enjoy morning coffee with tranquil water views, unwind in the spacious primary retreat, or host gatherings across two expansive living areas. A private study offers the perfect work-from-home space, while the gameroom provides a fun escape for family and guests alike. Recently painted throughout, the home offers a crisp, neutral backdrop ready for your personal touch. Step outside to serene lake vistas that create a daily sense of calm. Complete with a 3-car garage and access to scenic walking trails, this is an exceptional opportunity to create your dream lifestyle in one of Houston’s most sought-after communities.

agents.bio:
Founder and President of Energy Realty, Sherry Campbell is recognized as the most successful broker in the burgeoning Energy Corridor and West Houston. Energy Realty is a Houston-based, privately owned, top producing boutique brokerage with a global client list. Sherry is known within the industry as a real estate, entrepreneur, and innovator. Leading by example and fostering the success of agents. A true thought leader, Campbell is an admitted perfectionist who believes in giving her clients and team members 110%.

Campbell, a supportive broker, established Energy Realty in 2012. Since that time, she has grown it to include 40+ agents, two offices and posted more than $130M in production in 2022. Known for her inimitable integrity, five-star service, mentoring skills, ability to analyze and respond to market changes and commitment to community. She recognizes what today’s agents need to be successful. Campbell is a working broker – dealing with buyers and sellers on a daily basis.

remarks: Showcasing meticulous craftsmanship and refined details, this home offers an elevated living experience in Harris County. A lead glass front door welcomes abundant natural light into the entryway, setting a grand tone reflected by soaring high ceilings, exquisite crown molding, and custom-built-ins throughout the living spaces. Rich flooring and plush Berber carpeting underfoot add immediate warmth, leading into a magnificent kitchen highlighted by captivating C-tile flooring and a massive granite-topped center island. Designed for effortless indoor-outdoor living, the home extends into a private, fully enclosed screened-in deck and patio equipped with a surround sound system—an ideal setting for year-round entertaining amidst beautifully landscaped grounds. Blending sophisticated design, premium finishes, and practical functionality, this exceptional Houston residence delivers a seamless balance of style, comfort, and grandeur.

remarks: Situated on a 19,725 SF corner lot in Tanglewood, this 5,318 SF home offers 4-5 bedrooms, spacious living areas, and a large backyard for everyday living and entertaining. A two-story entry opens to the formal living and dining rooms, while a paneled study with custom built-ins provides the perfect home office. The kitchen is equipped with premium appliances, ample cabinetry, a walk-in butler's pantry, and a wine bar, offering functionality for everyday living while providing a seamless setup for entertaining. Upstairs, the primary suite is complemented by three additional bedrooms, a media room, and walk-up attic storage. Outside, the backyard offers mature landscaping and towering trees, a covered summer kitchen, and room for a future pool. A 3-car garage, expansive motor court, and additional guest parking complete this Tanglewood property.

agents.bio:
He is very knowledgeable about the nuances in many neighborhoods throughout Houston, which strengthens his ability to help people relocating to Houston from other cities. David's primary concern is satisfying his clients, because satisfied clients generate repeat business and referrals. 

A native Houstonian, David graduated from Memorial High School in 1980 and received a BA in finance from the University of Texas at Austin in 1984. He traveled internationally after college, then moved to California, where he cultivated a diverse management background, including two years in residential mortgage brokerage, nine years in international trade management, and six years in enterprise software sales management. 

David returned to Houston in 2001, obtained his real estate license, and joined his father, David H Young, in residential real estate sales. In January 2005, they started the David Young Team, bringing together top-producing agents and experienced assistants to provide the highest quality service to buyers and sellers of residential real estate. They were recognized for 12 years by the Houston Business Journal as one of the Top 5 Teams in Houston, with sales volume over $100,000,000 per year.

David joined Compass in October 2020, where he has operated as Young Realty Group - a small team of agents and a licensed assistant with them since 2014. ?On a personal level, David's wife Brenda and he are very active in animal rescue. She established Save A Purrfect Cat Rescue many years ago and they, along with an army of volunteers, find homes for 250-300 cats yearly. To keep fit he has practiced Tae Kwon Do since the 1990s and has been a member of the Houstonian Club since 2007. He also relieves stress by banging on his drum set.

Keri Josephson and his family have been a part of Texas real estate so long they have original land grants from Mexico from when they arrived with Stephen F. Austin in East Texas. Keri has been in Houston for over 17 years, and it has been fun seeing all the changes that have happened during this time. He lived in Argentina for two years after high school where he picked up Spanish and a love for Latin American food and culture. He graduated from Brigham Young University in Provo Utah where he studied biology, international business, and Spanish. Keri has two grown daughters that he loves spending time with when their schedules allow. His long-term goal is to have a garage full of roadsters, he has always enjoyed a convertible roadster. He has had a passion for cars ever since his grandmother took him to auto shows as a child. Keri works hard daily to be the person his dog, Maker, sees him as.

remarks: Discover elevated Houston living in this beautifully renovated, move-in-ready home, ideally located near vibrant Chinatown. Designed for buyers seeking luxury, comfort and exceptional value, this stylish residence features a rare double-wide driveway and an impressive collection of modern upgrades. Enjoy a newer roof, fresh interior and exterior paint, Low-E energy-efficient windows, luxury vinyl flooring, designer lighting, ceiling fans in every bedroom, a new sliding glass door, professionally repaired foundation, and new water heater. The sophisticated kitchen is a centerpiece, showcasing quartz countertops, a dramatic full-height backsplash, waterfall-edge island, and brand-new stainless steel appliances. Both bathrooms have been elegantly remodeled with contemporary finishes. Minutes from Houston shopping, dining, schools, parks and major highways, this turnkey home is an outstanding choice for first-time buyers, downsizers, or anyone seeking a refined Houston home near Chinatown.

I specialize in helping clients identify high-value real estate opportunities with a strong focus on commercial properties, investments, and strategic acquisitions. As an active real estate investor myself, I understand investing from both sides of the table — not only as an advisor, but as someone who personally owns rental houses, apartment properties, and commercial buildings focused on building long-term passive income and wealth creation.

My growing investment portfolio gives me firsthand experience in evaluating opportunities, negotiating strong deals, managing risk, and recognizing value that others may overlook. I believe the best way to guide clients is by applying strategies I personally use and believe in.

Whether you are expanding an investment portfolio, purchasing commercial real estate, or searching for the right opportunity, I bring a hands-on, results-driven approach built on market knowledge, strong negotiation, and real-world investing experience.

Real estate is more than buying and selling properties — it is about building financial freedom and creating long-term value. My goal is simple: help clients make smart decisions, secure exceptional opportunities, and build wealth with confidence.

agents.bio:
Evan Compean is the founder of The Compean Group, a boutique Houston real estate team known for data-driven pricing, high-end marketing and skilled negotiation. A licensed agent since 2012 and a real estate investor since 2002, Evan has sold more than $250 million in real estate and brings a builder's and investor's eye to every home, from foundation and roof to resale value.

Areas: Houston Heights, Woodland Heights, Garden Oaks/Oak Forest, Montrose, Midtown, West University, Bellaire, Spring Branch, Pearland, Katy, Cypress and The Woodlands.

Specialties: Luxury and new construction, investment and multifamily properties, land, first-time buyers, and relocation.

Evan is also a licensed loan officer and a partner at Smart Title, so clients get guidance on financing and closing from someone who knows every step. Se habla español. With 400+ five-star reviews across Zillow, Google, Yelp and Realtor.com, The Compean Group focuses on clear communication and a smooth process from first call to closing.

remarks: Set on a private lot with no rear neighbors in Northgate Forest golf neighborhood, this Mediterranean pool home offers grand scale and exceptional indoor outdoor living. A two story entry with a sweeping staircase opens to soaring ceilings, arched sightlines, formal living and dining rooms, limestone and hardwood flooring, and a private study. The open kitchen features abundant granite counters, custom cabinetry, Jenn Air appliances, pot filler, walk in pantry, and butler’s pantry overlooking the family room and pool. The first floor primary suite includes bay windows, a lighted tray ceiling, sitting area, spa bath, and walk in closet. A second bedroom iand bonus room are downstairs, with three bedrooms and game room are upstairs. Outside, enjoy a heated pool with in floor cleaning and UV system, full pool bath, summer kitchen, two story covered patio, and private green space. Additional features include three HVAC systems, surround sound, interior pest system, and sprinklers.

Charlie Bingham is a distinguished REALTOR® specializing in the Greater Houston market. Renowned for his exceptional negotiation skills and meticulous attention to detail, Charlie ensures that every client receives unparalleled service tailored to their unique needs. His client-centric approach is rooted in a deep understanding of the real estate process, supported by his extensive background in hospitality management.

Charlie’s expertise encompasses investment properties and renovation projects, making him a valuable advisor for clients at any price point. His commitment to open communication keeps clients well-informed and confident throughout their real estate journey. Fluent in French, Charlie adeptly assists French-speaking clients and other expatriates, simplifying their transition to Houston.

An active community member, Charlie serves as the President of the Crestwood Civic Club, volunteers at the Houston Food Bank, contributes to a Rodeo Committee, and is a member of the Memorial Park Advisory Board.

Outside of real estate, Charlie enjoys cultural events, padel, and pickleball. He is happily married, with two daughters and a Pomeranian dog.

Charlie Bingham’s dedication to excellence and his profound understanding of the Houston real estate market make him an outstanding choice for clients seeking an authentic and trustworthy REALTOR®.

agents.bio:
About Jennifer Bartlow

REALTOR

There is a reason why moving is often listed as one of life’s most stressful events. When you are buying or selling what will often be the biggest investment of your life it can feel completely overwhelming. Do you have pets? Are you transitioning from a major life event such as retirement, marriage or divorce?

MY STORY

As your Realtor I get it! My husband and I moved across the country over 10 years ago from Northern Virginia to Houston, Texas. Not only was my husband working in Texas while I tried to sell our home but I had two young boys and three pets to take care of. Plus, we picked the worst time to sell. We put our house on the market during one of the biggest real estate downturns. By the time our real estate agent put up our “For Sale” sign we had eight other houses on our street for sale! But we pulled through with determination, patience and the help of a wonderful agent located here in Houston. Not only that…but we ended up in an amazing neighborhood in Spring, Texas.

LET ME HELP

My goal is to give you the very best service and make your transaction go as smoothly as possible. Whether you are buying or selling your home I will work hard to negotiate the best price. If you are new to the area, my goal is to find out where you will feel most comfortable. Whatever your real estate objectives are I want to help you achieve them.

TELL ME YOUR STORY.

Call me today at 555-084-0718 or email me at contact-16213cc044@example.com. I look forward to giving you the keys to your next home.

agents.bio:
William and Thuy Shipman moved to the Houston area in 1982 and have watched the area grow and emerge as one of the most thriving regions in the country! In fact, the Shipmans live in the same Cypress neighborhood that they grew up in! Their appreciation for Cypress and the Houston area stems from its diverse housing options that accommodate a wide range of families, an abundance of recreation opportunities, the people, and unmatched entertainment options. 

Over the last 30 years, they have enjoyed witnessing the continual developments that have made Cypress what it is today! As a real estate team, their goal is to introduce their buyers to an area where they feel this same connection with, and facilitate the selling process for sellers so that they can begin the next chapter of their lives in the home that best suits their needs. 

Prior to real estate, Thuy earned her Bachelor’s degree in Finance and worked as an accountant in the oil and gas field for years, as well as a loan originator and cash accountant for a mortgage company, and later, a cash accountant for a property management company. Her experience gives her a unique insight into the closing process that is unmatched by many. William’s wide scope of experience further enhances each transaction, as well. From helping home builders in his Cypress neighborhood and working in Data, to his experience in automobile sales and owning his own home theatre and automation company, William’s extensive expertise has proven beneficial to the team’s buyers and sellers. Their knowledge, skills, passion for real estate, and experience leasing out their own investment properties led William and Thuy to pursue a career in real estate! 

Determined, driven, self-starters, knowledgeable, personable, and helpful are just a few examples that define the Shipman team. After all, Thuy’s father brought her to America so that she could have a better life, and as a result, she capitalizes on every opportunity that presents itself not only to provide a better life for her family, but also for her clients. They place a great emphasis on communication, whether helping the client price their home, briefing them on the current market or trends, disclosing every detail about a property or neighborhood, or listening to their client’s needs and wants, William and Thuy’s commitment to communication never falters. 

In addition, their diligent work ethic and impressive negotiating skills produce optimal results that are in their client’s best interest. Plus, as residents of the community since 1982, they possess in-depth knowledge about the region and its accommodations.

Aside from their personality characteristics that attribute to their success, Thuy and William’s affiliation with Connect Realty further enhances each transaction. With the most innovative technology and tools in the industry, they have access to unparalleled resources that maximize their effectiveness and efficiency. Plus, Connect Realty’s premier training and support have equipped them with the essential knowledge, skills, and tools to overcome any obstacle that may arise throughout the transaction and deliver the most favorable results. 

When not diligently helping their clients, Thuy enjoys running, skating, attending her children’s events and activities, and spending time with her family. In addition, she owns a jewelry business and sells her jewelry online and at tradeshows. A sports enthusiast, William can be found golfing, shooting, fishing, or playing pool, when he is not spending time with his children.

agents.bio: Randall Doe has been opening doors in Houston's finest communities for the last 30 years as a real estate broker. He focuses on selling homes inside and near Houston's Loop 610 in upscale neighborhoods where he offices and lives and serves on civic boards. His thorough knowledge of Houston's housing market and genuine people skills have earned him great respect from a long list of satisfied clients. An exceptional eye for design allows Randall to view a home and see details others may not notice. He helps clients uncover the potential in outdated resale homes and works with new- construction clients to design custom homes. A relocation specialist Randall assists medical, oil, and gas professionals, attorneys, and university employees to find homes throughout the Houston area. With an acute business acumen, he can position listings to investors and end-users alike. Developing budgets on potential improvements and help to strategize what improvements return the best value on the resale. “Success by Design” is his mantra that pervades Randall’s business model. He is resilient and resourceful and keeps his finger on Houston's quickly changing marketplace. He has this team approach with a full service corporation providing "hands on" support that has produced proven results. Randall is an experienced professional who prides himself in attention to details. Randall has several certifications including the Relocation Referral Certification,  Graduate Realtor Institute,  Acredited Buyer Rep, certified Negotiation Expert, Certified Residential Specialist, National Association of Home Builders, and National Kitchen and Bath Association.

In 2018, Linda Ragland received her real estate agent license and joined Womack Development & Investment
Realtors, Inc. as a full time residential and commercial real estate sales agent, where she is a top
producer with the firm.

Linda Ragland’s professional career began in the banking industry followed by a 30+ year career in the
media industry. She is currently working in the real estate industry in Houston, TX, where she resides.

Ragland’s first job in the banking industry was in 1979 with Benjamin Franklin Savings and Loan as an
IRA/Keogh Specialist. Her first job in media was in 1984 with E.W. Scripps Company, newspaper.

Linda Ragland had quite a unique and successful career in the media and entertainment industry. Her
media path included media broadcast sales with Summit Communications, iHeartMedia, Inc. and Radio
One Inc.; with a broad client base of Fortune 500 companies, financial institutions, universities, retail,
home builders and others. During her 2000 – 2015 sixteen-year tenure with Radio One, Inc., she served
as a marketing/sales consultant and as a non-traditional revenue (NTR) marketing manager. Her
experience in the entertainment industry included working as General Manager for Music World
Entertainment, former management company for Beyonce’ Knowles and other artists.

Linda Ragland is very engaged in community outreach initiates and has received numerous awards and
recognitions to include recognition from The City of Houston, 2102 and 2020; and U.S. House Of
Representatives Certificate of Congressional Recognition, 2012.

remarks: This is a new construction 4-bedroom home with an extensive list of upgrades in the highly sought-after Ponte Vista community. This all-electric home stands out with a curated upgrade package and upgraded flooring and no carpet! The chef's kitchen is the heart of the home, featuring the full Gourmet Kitchen package complete with a drop-in electric induction cooktop, built-in single wall oven, a range hood, and a microwave drawer integrated into the island. White quartz counters, a white tile backsplash, and crisp white shaker-style cabinetry with soft-close mechanisms complete the space. The living and dining areas are filled with natural light and connected seamlessly to a spacious private deck through an upgraded multi-slide door. Whether entertaining guests or enjoying a quiet evening with coastal breezes, this outdoor connection elevates everyday living. On the first floor, the junior primary suite is enhanced by its own bi-fold door, giving it the versatility to function as a private guest suite, a work from home space, creative studio, or a flexible space. The first-floor Bath 3 has been upgraded, bringing a spa-like quality to what is typically a builder-standard space. The third floor is anchored by a generous Primary Suite with a walk-in closet and private bath, while two additional bedrooms share a well-appointed full bath. A dedicated laundry area on the third floor adds everyday practicality to the thoughtful layout. Solar panels owned. The 2-car garage is pre-plumbed for EV charging. Located in Ponte Vista, a master-planned community nestled near the Palos Verdes Peninsula, enjoy proximity to the revitalized LA Waterfront, the Port of Los Angeles, top-rated coastal dining, parks, and easy freeway access to the greater South Bay and Los Angeles. Whole-house white window blinds round out the thoughtful details. Common area amenities include a pool, spa, fitness center, and rec center within a gated community minutes from the coast. Model photos shown.

remarks: The one with the pool. This renovated Champions-area 4 bed/3.5 bath home in top-rated Klein ISD pairs a private heated pool and spa with over 3,500 square feet on an oversized, gated cul-de-sac lot framed by mature trees—a true entertainer's retreat. Over $200K in updates, including a new 2025 roof, a custom chef's kitchen with granite and stainless appliances, a remodeled first-floor primary suite, updated electrical panel, water heater, gutters, and replaced tile flooring & carpet, fresh paint, plantation shutters, gated driveway, and Medeco high-security locks. Inside: formal living and dining, an upstairs game room w/vaulted ceiling, a dedicated study, two wet bars with wine fridges, a wall-of-windows den with a gas fireplace, and storage galore. Add a 3-car garage with epoxy floors. Space, privacy, and a resort backyard you can't add later.
