agents.bio:
For me, real estate has never been just about buying and selling homes—it's about helping people make one of the biggest financial and personal decisions of their lives with confidence. As a Texas REALTOR, I believe every client deserves honest advice, expert guidance, and an advocate who genuinely puts their goals first.

Born and raised in Cypress and now proud to call Katy home, I have a deep understanding of the Houston and West Houston markets, including Katy, Fulshear, Cypress, Richmond, Rosenberg, Sugar Land, and the surrounding communities. Whether you're purchasing your first home, relocating to Texas, selling a luxury property, or investing in real estate, my commitment is to make the process smooth, strategic, and successful.

In just six years in real estate, I've built a reputation for delivering results through expert negotiation, innovative marketing, and exceptional client service. I received a 4x ICON REALTOR Award during my time with eXp Realty, a recognition reserved for top-performing agents, and I've helped countless buyers and sellers successfully navigate every type of market. My business has been built almost entirely through referrals and repeat clients—a reflection of the trust I've earned by putting relationships before transactions.

Today, I'm proud to be brokered by SERHANT. Texas, a brokerage redefining luxury real estate through the power of media, technology, and personal branding. By combining SERHANT.'s cutting-edge marketing platform with my background in digital marketing and content creation, every listing receives maximum exposure across today's most influential online platforms. My Bachelor of Fine Arts from the University of Houston allows me to approach every property with a creative eye for branding, photography, video, and storytelling that helps homes stand out in a competitive market.

My approach is simple: provide honest advice, communicate consistently, negotiate relentlessly, and treat every client's investment as if it were my own. I believe successful real estate isn't about pressure—it's about education, preparation, and building lifelong relationships based on trust and personalizing every buyer and sellers experience directly to benefit them.

Whether you're searching for your dream home, selling for top dollar, relocating to Texas, or exploring new construction opportunities, I'd be honored to help you achieve your real estate goals.

Let's Get It With Gabe.

agents.bio:
Carrie Nelson – Trusted Real Estate Professional

Carrie Nelson, originally from Teague, Texas, grew up in Deer Park and has called the Clear Lake area home for the past 25 years.

Her career began in early childhood education, where she taught at a Christian preschool before transitioning into management with a UK-based oil and gas company. It was during this time that she adopted her guiding philosophy: every problem is simply an opportunity to find a solution. This perspective has become a cornerstone of her success in real estate.

Known for her exceptional attention to detail, Carrie takes pride in guiding clients through every step of the buying and selling process. Her hands-on approach ensures clients feel informed, confident, and comfortable with their decisions. Whether assisting first-time buyers, seasoned investors, or families preparing to sell, Carrie provides personalized service tailored to each client’s needs.

Carrie’s dedication is rooted in her values of honesty, trustworthiness, and loyalty. Her genuine passion for helping people shines through in her commitment to delivering seamless transactions and positive experiences.

Outside of real estate, Carrie has been happily married for 35 years. She and her husband are proud parents of five children and delight in spending time with their six grandchildren.

Legacy. Integrity. Adventure.

These values shape how I represent my clients, negotiate contracts, and deliver results that matter.

Honest advice and personalized service throughout the process
Strategic pricing, marketing, and open house execution
Clear and consistent communication from consultation to closing
A calm, organized, and professional approach
A well-connected agent who knows Houston and the surrounding areas inside and out

agents.bio:
Mr. Guidry Joined Berkshire Hathaway in August of 2013 as Managing Director for Berkshire Hathaway HS Commercial where his role is to oversee acquisition and disposition of commercial real estate.  In addition to managing commercial transactions his current responsibilities include mentoring and training Berkshire agents and assist the facilitation of commercial opportunities throughout Texas.
Mr. Guidry acts as Director of Development for Houston, Texas based Innata Development, LLC.  Managing the development of residential and commercial projects throughout Texas.  Typical projects requirements include: site selection, feasibility, financial modeling, acquisition, entitlements and disposition.  Guidry works with local governments and communities to encourage regional investment in real estate development projects.  Roles include Identification of builder partners and retail end-users then responsibilities move toward managing and directing day to day operations and best practices.  Guidry works closely with Architects, Engineers, Designers and Land Planners to identify market values, determine highest and best use, recruit end users and manage the implementation of horizontal infrastructure.
Prior to joining Berkshire Hathaway in 2013, Guidry spent eight years with Sperry Van Ness, International, a global real estate firm with more than eight hundred commercial brokers throughout the US, South America and China.  Guidry most recently acted as Managing Director for SVN| Principal Advisor Group, based in Houston, Texas and spent the previous five years, specializing in the sale of net leased investment properties within the office, retail and multifamily market segments.  
A native Texan, Mr. Guidry has a solid understanding of commercial valuation procedures and finance strategies as well as ground up development practices.  He passes that knowledge through to his clients in order to achieve partner level relationships with those clients. He approaches every opportunity with a “win-win or no-deal” mentality.
Prior to joining Sperry Van Ness in 2005, Guidry served as Director of Land Acquisition for Historic Land Development, a regional developer of lifestyle center and other mixed-use developments.
Before then he was Vice President of Development for W.C. Perry Properties, a private real estate brokerage and development firm based in Houston, Texas. 

Specialties:  
Mr. Guidry is a proponent of New Urbanism and an advocate for innovative development and the implementation of “best practices” for environmental preservation and energy conservation. He has an eye for molding new developments into the existing landscape, history, and culture of the community. He works closely with members of the Urban Land Institute and collaborates with city and local government entities to address site specific needs and potential.
Mr. Guidry’s undergraduate studies at the University of Houston led him to a career focused on business and real estate. He is an active member of the International Council of Shopping Centers (ICSC), Texas Real Estate Commission (TREC) and Houston Association of Commercial Realtors.

agents.bio:
As a full-time REALTOR and Real Estate Advisor in Houston, I am passionate about helping families, first-time home buyers, sellers, and investors make confident and informed real estate decisions. My role is not simply to help with a transaction, but to guide, educate, and advocate for my clients throughout every step of their real estate journey.

Before transitioning into real estate, I built a strong background in the beauty and service industry, including experience at The Ritz Carlton Miami Beach, The Post Oak Hotel, a Forbes Five-Star property. That environment shaped my commitment to excellence, attention to detail, professionalism, and personalized client care. Today, I bring that same level of service into every real estate relationship.

With a global background and a heart for service, I bring an international perspective to real estate. Born in the U.S., raised in Colombia, and having built part of my family life in London, I understand relocation, culture, and the importance of finding home. As a Certified International Property Specialist and President of Sister Cities Houston–Huelva, Spain, I proudly serve as a bridge between people, communities, and real estate opportunities.

I believe in educating myself continuously so I can better educate and advise my clients with current market knowledge, strong negotiation skills, and strategic guidance.

As an investor myself and part of a family business in the real estate industry, I understand how real estate can be used not only to find a home, but also to create long-term stability, opportunity, and generational growth. Whether my clients are purchasing their first home, selling, relocating, or exploring investment opportunities, my goal is to help them make decisions with clarity and confidence.

Beyond real estate, I am deeply committed to community service, women’s ministry, youth mentorship, and international connection. My work is rooted in integrity, service, family values, and a genuine passion for helping others.

I am proud to be a member of the National Association of REALTORS, Texas REALTORS, and the Houston Association of REALTORS, and I am honored to serve my clients with honesty, care, and excellence, not just for one transaction, but as a trusted advisor for life.

agents.bio:
A little about me! I was born in Houston and raised in the Dallas/Fort Worth Metro Area.  I moved back to Houston (Dickinson) in 2007 and was happy to live closer to family again.  I went into Real Estate because I have a passion for helping people, and how better to do that than to be a part of the process of helping people build a future and live out the American dream of homeownership!  Watching people fall in love with their new home, or selling their current one is fun and exciting, and I have had the honor of being in the top 1% of sales in my office, earning the respect of my fellow REALTORS, and helping many clients.  Prior to Real Estate, I earned my Bachelor of Business from Dallas Baptist University and minored in Psychology.  I also had worked in telecommunications for 25 years, most recently as a Project Manager/Contracts Negotiator for custom contracts all over the world. My wife, Becky (who is also a Realtor), and I also own a small farm, where we hatch, raise, and sell heritage and specialty breeds of chickens, turkeys, and guineas, as well as farm fresh eggs. We focus on pasture-raised flocks and feed only high-quality and Non-GMO/Soy-free feed products.  I look forward to working with you to make your Real Estate dreams a reality!

Jim Atkinson is a Broker Associate, REALTOR® and the Team Leader for Hidden Paradise Realty Team at UTR - Texas, Realtors, located in Houston, Texas, near NASA.  Our team is comprised of experienced Agents who have a passion for real estate, and who are ready to assist you with all your buying, selling, or rental needs!  Our team is structured differently than most teams, as we don't have buyer's agents or seller's agents, who simply hand you off to someone else once the contract is signed.  Rather, we believe in the value of relationships, and we know that the relationship you have with your Agent is extremely vital to you during your home buying, selling, or renting experience. We have an amazing Transaction Coordinator to assist you and our Agents throughout the process, but your Agent will remain actively involved - all the way to the closing table and beyond!

agents.bio:
As one satisfied client summed up in one of Mel’s recent seller surveys, “Mel Reyna is amazing.” And we agree. Elaborating on Mel’s extraordinary service, another client remarked, “he worked very hard to sell my home quickly and keep me fully informed throughout the process – I would recommend Mel to anyone.” Mel’s professionalism, efficiency, market knowledge, listening skills, reliance and dedication are qualities that only scratch the surface of what he does for his clients and customers on a daily basis.

Mel was the first agent to join Greenwood King’s brand new Heights Boulevard office in 1999. Every year since, he has been the Heights office top producer. Three years later, Mel was ranked as one of the “Top 25 Residential Real Estate Individuals” by the Houston Business Journal. His success as a leading real estate agent may be attributed to a maxim he strictly adheres to – “always treat clients as you would expect to be treated yourself.” Without a doubt, his philosophy works, as this dynamic agent has significantly impacted residential real estate in the Heights for more than 17 years.

Honesty distinguishes this experienced pro, who’s number one priority is to ensure his clients not get too wrapped up in the emotions involved. “Always buy and sell smart,” Mel stresses, comforting clients with the fact that he will do whatever it takes – working as long as needed – to negotiate the best deal. He also takes pride in working with first-time buyers and is delighted to guide them through every step of this complicated process.

Mel specializes in the Heights (where he grew up and currently resides), as well as various surrounding neighborhoods such as Oak Forest, Shady Acres, Timbergrove Manor, Montrose, Memorial, Spring Branch, the Museum District and Galveston. As if his service to the industry wasn’t enough, Mel’s sense of neighborhood extends well beyond his professional endeavors. He has been involved in numerous charitable organizations such as the Heights Association, Heights Boulevard Beautification, St. Andrew’s Church and Harvard Elementary.

agents.bio: Patricia is originally from Salinas, California and moved to Houston over 39 years ago. She has 32 years of experience in the real estate realm, that include purchasing, rehabbing, investing, and selling. She is a landlord with multiple homes in the Houston area. She also has over 28 years of experience in the construction industry having managed estimating teams on multi-million dollar projects. Patricia holds two B.S. degrees from Prairie View A&M University, one in Construction Science and one in Architecture and graduated Summa Cum Laude. In 2016 she received her graduate degree from Prairie View A&M University in Community Development. Patricia is very passionate about helping her clients find their dream home, and making sure they are educated in every aspect of the process.

agents.bio: Marlon David Martinez serves as the Team Lead at Urban Collective Group, bringing a wealth of experience in project management, relationship building, and sales to the dynamic landscape of real estate. With a proven track record, Marlon has contributed to nearly $10 million in sales in his short 3 years of real estate and played a pivotal role in launching several high-profile properties in Houston. His professional journey reflects expertise in managing transactions from inception to completion, ensuring a seamless and gratifying experience for all involved. Marlon's forte lies in high-level communication and establishing genuine connections with clients and peers. His skills have been instrumental in the success of numerous transactions, navigating complexities with precision and delivering exceptional outcomes. Prior to his role at Urban Collective Group, Marlon excelled in project management for a national interior design firm, handling diverse projects on both local and international scales. His leadership style prioritizes the best interests of clients and teams alike, fostering an environment of collaboration and success. Outside the professional realm, Marlon finds joy in exploring Houston's culinary scene, jogging along Buffalo Bayou Park, and embarking on international travels. As a proud Honduran, he carries a profound love for Latin American cuisine and culture in all its diverse forms.

A people pleaser at heart, a role that prominently features customer service was inevitable for Marie. She thrives on that round-the-clock realtor pace of life and derives great satisfaction from translating your real estate goals into actionable, achievable results. Her motivation to get her clients to the closing table is what compels her to start and end each day by asking the question, How can I go beyond? Marie does not shout the loudest, but her perspective is valued all the more because of it. She is refreshingly earnest, gracious, and dedicated. She is a deep thinker and an even deeper listener. agents.bio:
He is very knowledgeable about the nuances in many neighborhoods throughout Houston, which strengthens his ability to help people relocating to Houston from other cities. David's primary concern is satisfying his clients, because satisfied clients generate repeat business and referrals. 

A native Houstonian, David graduated from Memorial High School in 1980 and received a BA in finance from the University of Texas at Austin in 1984. He traveled internationally after college, then moved to California, where he cultivated a diverse management background, including two years in residential mortgage brokerage, nine years in international trade management, and six years in enterprise software sales management. 

David returned to Houston in 2001, obtained his real estate license, and joined his father, David H Young, in residential real estate sales. In January 2005, they started the David Young Team, bringing together top-producing agents and experienced assistants to provide the highest quality service to buyers and sellers of residential real estate. They were recognized for 12 years by the Houston Business Journal as one of the Top 5 Teams in Houston, with sales volume over $100,000,000 per year.

David joined Compass in October 2020, where he has operated as Young Realty Group - a small team of agents and a licensed assistant with them since 2014. ?On a personal level, David's wife Brenda and he are very active in animal rescue. She established Save A Purrfect Cat Rescue many years ago and they, along with an army of volunteers, find homes for 250-300 cats yearly. To keep fit he has practiced Tae Kwon Do since the 1990s and has been a member of the Houstonian Club since 2007. He also relieves stress by banging on his drum set.

A native Houstonian, Lance graduated from Memorial High School in 1980, went on to the University of Texas at Austin where he received his degrees in business administration and marketing, and attended graduate school at McCombs Graduate School of Business in Austin.

Since the 1980s, Lance has successfully acquired an influential background in building sales, office leasing, marketing and divesting. He also possesses wide-ranging understanding of business management through his experiences owning and managing both private and public companies.

The "Lance philosophy" as a real estate agent is that he must earn his clients business by putting their complete satisfaction first and foremost. He believes that satisfied clients generate repeat business and referrals.

Throughout his career, Lance has had the honor of representing many deserving clients in the Houston area. He first entered the world of residential real estate and then became a top producer, focused on the West University, River Oaks, Bellaire and Close-In Memorial neighborhoods. Now Lance continues his work as a luxury-home agent for both buyers and sellers throughout the Houston area.

As a Texas Real Estate Commission licensed real estate broker, a member of the Texas Association of Realtors, and a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Lance values the trust of his clients and the respect of his fellow brokers and agents.  In his free time, Lance enjoys spending time with his wife, Valerie and their dog Maxwell.  He is also a competitive triathlete, so he is always running, biking or swimming. Lance is a fan of live music venues and watching Houston sports.

agents.bio:
For almost 3 decades, Real Estate has been my passion. I love the intricacies, complexities, & fact that every transaction requires not only market knowledge & competency but also the challenge of surpassing client expectations. I take very seriously & w/ great pride the fact that most of my business comes from past clients, their friends, families & associates. Nothing is more satisfying than to hear from clients whose real estate needs I have handled for decades. Nothing makes me happier than the fact that many of these clients have become lifelong friends.

While my job definitely entails helping clients buy & sell real estate, perhaps the most important aspect of my job is giving clients the most accurate & credible information. Buying or selling are not always the best options. My job is to give my clients information w/ which they can make 1 of the most important decisions of their economic lives. While I am always grateful for the opportunity to market a home, my job is to help clients make the best decision for themselves & their families.

I am a lifelong Houstonian & third generation Texan. Although I grew up in River Oaks & Tanglewood, where my parents built in the 50s, I have lived for the past 40 years in a Museum District home that my father built in 1930.

I have a BS in Horticulture from Texas A&M & am a passionate gardener & garden lover. Like absolutely everyone who writes a profile, I love to travel but at the end of the day, there is no place that beckons me year after year like West Texas. The wide-open spaces of Big Bend, Alpine, Marfa and Terlingua require a road trip with the dogs at least once a year.

When not working, I am either gardening, spending time w/ Lola and Milo my rescue pups, or teaching my feral cats tricks w/ flaming hoops & batons. I am a Feral Cat Colony Manager & support a number of international childrens and animal causes including the ASPCA, Child Fund International.

remarks: Discover vintage luxury at 8122 Meadow Crest, a Houston home designed for grand entertaining and effortless indoor-outdoor living. Beneath mature oaks, the stately red-brick exterior opens to a two-story living room with arched windows, French doors, hardwood floors and a sweeping curved staircase. An expansive kitchen anchors the home with an oversized island, stone counters, abundant cabinetry and double ovens. Gather across large living spaces, multiple wet bars, a paneled library and an upstairs game room opening to a covered balcony. The primary suite offers a fireplace, outdoor access, skylit bath, jetted tub, separate shower, fitted walk-in closet and cedar-lined storage. A private sauna creates a resort-inspired retreat. Outside, covered brick patios surround a courtyard-style backyard shaded by mature trees. This Houston luxury property blends timeless architecture, grand scale and memorable amenities in a home made for celebrations, quiet escapes and gracious everyday living.

agents.bio:
Jeremy Wells is a Greater Houston REALTOR®, founder, and Group Leader of Somerwell Realty Group at Keller Williams Preferred. Based in Manvel, Jeremy leads a purpose-driven real estate team committed to delivering the best results and the most value for every client.

Jeremy serves buyers, sellers, relocation clients, and investors throughout Houston, Pearland, Manvel, Alvin, Rosharon, Angleton, Iowa Colony, Friendswood, Missouri City, and surrounding Texas communities. His real estate experience includes residential homes, luxury estates, acreage, farms, ranches, land, and investment properties.

At Somerwell Realty Group, the goal is not simply to complete a transaction. Jeremy creates strategic, well-managed real estate experiences that help clients make informed decisions, protect their interests, and build lasting value. Sellers receive a comprehensive strategy covering pricing, property preparation, creative marketing, digital exposure, and skilled negotiation. Buyers receive straightforward guidance on financing, neighborhoods, inspections, contracts, and offer strategy so they can move forward with clarity and confidence.

Jeremy combines local market knowledge with data-driven strategy, a strong digital presence, responsive communication, and persistent negotiation. He explains the process in plain language, prepares clients for important decisions, and remains focused on their goals from the first conversation through closing. His approach is professional and direct without relying on high-pressure sales tactics.

Jeremy earned a bachelor’s degree from Sam Houston State University and an MBA in Leadership from Liberty University. Before focusing on real estate, he held leadership positions in property management, supply chain, and operations. That experience included negotiating and managing large commercial projects connected to three major industrial facility moves. It strengthened the financial analysis, project coordination, negotiation, and problem-solving skills he now applies to real estate.

Somerwell Realty Group is built on three core values: integrity, tenacity, and service excellence. Jeremy believes clients deserve honest and transparent advice, relentless advocacy, and a level of service focused on producing the strongest possible outcome.

Whether you are buying your first home, moving up, preparing to sell, relocating to Greater Houston, investing, or searching for land or acreage, Jeremy will help you understand your options and build a clear strategy around your goals.

agents.bio:
Success has never been accidental for Ced. Long before becoming one of Houston's most recognized real estate professionals, he was building businesses and creating opportunities. From selling cool cups as a child, to running successful ventures as a teenager and college student, to owning local businesses, entrepreneurship has always been woven into his DNA. That relentless drive ultimately led him to real estate, an industry where dedication, expertise, and work ethic directly impact results.

Today, Ced has built a reputation as one of the Houston area's premier real estate advisors, closing more than 300 transactions and facilitating over $85 million in real estate sales volume. His success is rooted in a simple philosophy: put people first, deliver exceptional service, and create results that change lives.

Clients quickly recognize that Ced's approach is different. His leadership style is authentic, hands-on, and unwaveringly focused on helping buyers, sellers, and investors achieve their goals. Whether guiding a first-time homebuyer, negotiating a luxury home purchase, or helping investors maximize returns, Ced brings the same level of commitment, transparency, and strategic expertise to every transaction.

Ced Attended Abilene Christian University for 3 years but earned his Bachelor's degree in Communications and MBA from Texas Southern University, Ced combines education, innovation, and market expertise to provide clients with a competitive advantage. As a former collegiate football athlete, he learned early that success is earned through discipline, preparation, and determination—qualities that continue to define his career today.

Throughout his career, Ced has earned numerous industry accolades, including:
• 4xTop Producer (2019-2022)
• 3x Golden Level Producer (2022-25)
• HBREA Top 40 (2021)
• Voted #1 Agent on Social Media in Pearland by Property Spark (2020)
• Jesse H. Jones School of Business 40 Under 40 (2019)
• Ruby Masters Award Recipient (2018)
• Voted #2 Agent on Social Media in Texas by Property Spark (2017)
• Quality Service Pinnacle Producer (2016 & 2017)
• Houston 40 Under 40 (2016)
• Quality Service Award (2015)
• Gold Jacket Recipient (2014)

Ced has also been featured at numerous speaking engagements throughout Houston, sharing his expertise on real estate, entrepreneurship, branding, and business development.

As Founder of the Reserve Realty Group, brokered by Legacy Homes & Properties, Ced leads a team dedicated to delivering a world-class real estate experience. Through personalized service, cutting-edge marketing, advanced technology, and in-depth market knowledge, the team helps clients confidently navigate one of the most important financial decisions of their lives.

For Ced, real estate is about more than buying and selling homes—it's about building relationships, creating wealth, and helping families establish lasting legacies.

Beyond real estate, Ced remains deeply committed to serving the community that helped shape him. A former educator and passionate mentor, he supports youth development through after-school programs, youth athletics, and the Space City Heat 501(c)(3) football program. His dedication to mentorship and community service reflects the same values that have made him successful in business: leadership, integrity, and a genuine desire to help others succeed.

When you work with Ced Thomas, you're not just hiring a real estate agent—you're partnering with a trusted advocate, skilled negotiator, and proven professional dedicated to helping you achieve extraordinary results.

In 2017, Michael established FIG Real Estate, headquartered in the Houston Heights, in order to channel his zeal for his profession and community. He has assembled a unique team of Houston realtors focused on helping clients navigate the real estate process.

remarks: Perched high above the city in the iconic Century Park East, this rare penthouse residence presents a truly elevated lifestyle. Fully remodeled in 2025, this 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home spans 1,053 sq. ft. of refined living space, designed with modern elegance and effortless flow. An open-concept kitchen anchors the home, showcasing custom wood cabinetry, sleek quartz countertops, and breathtaking views that extend to the ocean. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame dazzling city lights from every room, while raised ceilings, rich wood floors, and abundant natural light create an atmosphere of sophistication and warmth. The thoughtfully designed layout places one bedroom on either side of the living room, ensuring privacy, while the west-facing private balcony offers the perfect vantage point for golden sunsets. Century Park East is renowned for its full-service lifestyle, offering 24-hour valet, concierge, doorman, and guest parking. Residents enjoy resort-style amenities including an Olympic-size heated pool, tennis court, state-of-the-art fitness center, dog park, children's playground, and beautifully landscaped grounds. Set in the heart of Century City, this home is just moments from world-class shopping, dining, and entertainment at Westfield Century City, with Beverly Hills and Westwood only minutes away. Penthouse opportunities in this building are exceedingly rare making this an exclusive chance to own a piece of Los Angeles luxury living.

A Los Angeles native, Ashley Sackerman was born into a real estate family. Her parents both built their professional lives around the sale, management and corporate aspects of residential real estate and are esteemed members of the Westside real estate community.

Ashley graduated from the Marshal School of Business at USC knowing exactly what she wanted to do next: sell real estate. Since then, she has had the pleasure and privilege of working closely with some of the best and most respected agents in the business and has established her own reputation as an astute, engaging, honest and energetic professional.

Her ability to listen intently to her client's wants, needs and desires enables her to deliver highly personalized real estate experience for each of her clients. Ashley has successfully represented both buyers and sellers in standard, foreclosure and short sale transactions from the San Fernando Valley to the South Bay, West Hollywood to the ocean.

"The diversity of my experience helps me personalize each experience I have with a client," Ashley says. "The skills I have honed allow me to be prepared for any new situation."

With unmatched expertise in Westside and South Bay neighborhoods, Stephanie and her team have built their brand on a reputation for service that exceeds all expectations.

Why Buyers and Sellers Choose Stephanie Younger:

What Makes Stephanie Different?

Her Process Includes:

- Leading a high-performing team to deliver seamless service

Local, Loyal, and Living Here...

agents.bio:
Licensed since 2012, Julie Wells is a dedicated real estate professional serving the Greater Houston and Galveston markets. She is known for her expertise, strategic approach, and passion for helping clients navigate their real estate journeys. Specializing in residential sales and rentals, Julie combines in-depth market knowledge, strong negotiation skills, and a client-first mindset to deliver seamless and successful transactions.

Julie’s background as a small business owner and real estate investor gives her a unique edge in the industry, equipping her with strong problem-solving abilities and a keen eye for market trends. Her extensive list of professional designations—including ABR, MRPSA, SRS, CNE, RSPS, CLHS, AWREP, MRP, and PSA—demonstrates her commitment to ongoing education and excellence in real estate. Whether assisting first-time homebuyers, seasoned investors, or those seeking luxury properties, Julie provides tailored strategies and expert guidance to ensure her clients make well-informed decisions.

Beyond real estate, Julie is deeply involved in her community, volunteering with Houston Food Bank, Habitat for Humanity, and the Breast Cancer Walk. A proud Houston native, she appreciates the city’s diverse culture, vibrant dining scene, and world-class shopping. When she’s not helping clients find their dream homes, you’ll likely find her soaking up the sun at the beach—her favorite place to unwind.

Whether buying, selling, or investing, Julie Wells is committed to delivering an exceptional real estate experience built on trust, expertise, and personalized service.

With a deep knowledge of Houston’s most desirable waterfront communities, Nichelle Richards is a trusted guide for clients looking to relocate, invest, or upgrade their lifestyle along the Gulf Coast. She specializes in Seabrook, Clear Lake, Kemah, and Galveston, helping buyers find homes that match their vision—whether it’s a waterfront retreat, a luxury second home, or a lucrative investment property.


Nichelle’s approach is built on listening, educating, and empowering her clients. As a Seller Representation Specialist, Certified Negotiation Expert, and Resort & Second Home Property Specialist, she provides data-driven market insights, strategic advice, and a seamless transaction experience. Drawing from her own experiences as both a buyer and seller, she offers firsthand knowledge that makes her guidance relatable, transparent, and effective.


Clients describe Nichelle as detail-oriented, communicative, and deeply invested in their success. She takes pride in building long-term relationships, ensuring every client feels supported, informed, and confident throughout the process. Her mission? To turn real estate dreams into reality while delivering a smooth, stress-free experience.


Living in the coastal suburb of Seabrook, Nichelle enjoys the very lifestyle she helps her clients achieve. When she’s not working, you’ll find her exploring the waterfront, discovering new restaurants, or capturing photos of her toy poodle, Louie Loo (@life.of.louie.loo). Having purchased her first home at just 19, she understands the transformative power of homeownership and loves sharing this passion with her clients.


Whether you’re looking to invest, relocate, or find your dream home by the water, Nichelle Richards is ready to guide you with expertise, enthusiasm, and a personal touch.

agents.bio:
Before becoming a licensed Realtor 25 years ago, I too, was a consumer in the housing world. I remember feeling overwhelmed and often frustrated by the lack on information and misinformation I was given throughout the entire process. After surviving listing appointments, selling and buying a home with a few agents - I decided I wanted to know first hand everything I could about real estate to make the buying or selling process less confusing for anyone else.  Having taken my own experiences in real estate as the consumer and client, I pride myself as a Realtor in providing personal connections and integrity to each and every transaction. I still to this day feel sense of pride each time I can hang a sold rider on a client's sign or hand over keys to anxious buyers. Although I do not profess to know everything about real estate with my 25 years of experience- I make sure I know most things in my profession and challenge myself regularly to stay in front of the changes in market conditions and metropolitan inventory and happenings. From working with first time buyers to the most seasoned clients, I honestly can say I love every aspect of real estate. Buying and selling in today's market can often be intimidating and frustrating, especially when trust and communication can hamper positive results. I work with investors, relocation clients, rental properties, unimproved land, buyers, sellers and commercial clients.I am available 7 days a week and make your schedule work for my schedule to create the most positive experience for your personal transaction; ready when you are; let's do this! 
Please contact me at any time, I will respond in a timely manner - if not answer on your first call! I look forward to working with you!

remarks: This light and bright end unit offers additional windows, natural light, and a thoughtfully designed layout. This new construction home features an open-concept floor plan with a spacious feel throughout. The kitchen is appointed with sleek white shaker-style cabinets and all-electric stainless-steel appliances, including refrigerator, washer, and electric dryer. The sun-drenched living area flows effortlessly outdoors through an expansive 3-panel multi-slide door, creating a seamless connection to the spacious deck. The fourth bedroom on the entry level features a 3-panel bi-fold door, offering flexibility for use as a home office, additional living space, or media room. Upstairs, the third floor features a spacious primary bedroom with walk-in closet and en-suite bath, two additional bedrooms, and a dedicated laundry area. Whole-house white blinds, video doorbell, and energy-efficient features are among the additional features included in the home. A 2-car side-by-side garage completes the home. There is still an opportunity to select flooring, counters, and backsplash at the design studio. Conveniently located near the Palos Verdes Peninsula. Common area amenities include a pool, spa, recreation center, fire pit, and fitness center. Interior photos and virtual tour are of the Plan 1 model home and are used for representational purposes only.

Michael got his initial taste of real estate in law school when he started a rental home company with one of his professors. The company provided housing to recovering addicts in collaboration with the organization Oxford House, Inc.

Michael began his career as a mergers and acquisition attorney, helping oil and gas clients through a wide range of transactions, and made the move to a real estate development company where he served as Associate General Counsel and Broker. There he had the privilege to work for a great mentor at a diverse company, where he honed his skills in completing both residential and commercial transactions and developments.

In 2017, Michael established FIG Real Estate, headquartered in the Houston Heights, in order to channel his zeal for his profession and community. He has assembled a unique team of Houston realtors focused on helping clients navigate the real estate process.

agents.bio:
A Top Producer for over a decade in Real Estate, Nicole Brende was born into a real estate family. Raised in Las Vegas, Nicole she got to Texas as fast as she could and earned a bachelor's degree in broadcast journalism at Southern Methodist University in Dallas. Nicole grew up in a real-estate oriented family. Her father develops award winning master-planned communities in Houston and her mother and other family members practice real estate in Nevada, California, and Idaho. I grew up touring properties and job sites, says Nicole. I knew one day I would be helping clients with their real estate needs and I could not wait. In fact, it's in my blood.

Prior to her career in residential real estate, Nicole was a professional on-camera television host and producer for 10 years. Her programs included “Hot On! Homes” for KPRC Local 2, “Designing America” on HDNet, and “Designing Texas,” all of which kept her in contact with various facets of real estate. “I really enjoyed showcasing the beautiful homes and educating buyers about the current inventory as well as the quality of the builders we featured,” says Nicole. She was also a live television news reporter /producer and a former co-founder/publisher of one of Houston’s first online society magazines. As a Realtor, Nicole uses her media and marketing skills to get “top dollar” for her sellers.

Nicole attributes her success to dedication to her clients, a deep love of real estate, and, most importantly, building strong relationships that result in repeat sales and client referrals to family and friends. She believes that one of the best aspects of residential real estate sales is the lifestyle she is able to present to so many individuals and families, and the personal satisfaction she receives from helping them to make a major change in their lives. According to Nicole, “a home is the one place we get to personalize and make our very own and finding the right neighborhood matters.”

An excellent listener and communicator, Nicole is always accessible to her clients. She understands marketing, knows how to deliver and follow through, and stays current with the Houston real estate market. Nicole often finds homes for her buyers that are not yet on the market, and she is an excellent resource for homeowners who are considering a sale. She is also certified to work with relocation buyers, a specialized skill much in demand in a fast-moving city like Houston.

Nicole is proud to support her community. She serves on numerous charitable host committees and stays active with the SMU Houston alumni chapter, Alpha Chi Omega sorority, and DAR Lady Washington Chapter. Nicole is a guest writer for local publications and writes her own blog, the "Trende Brende Report". When not working, she enjoys spending quality time with her husband & family, traveling, and attending the Houston Symphony, Theater Under the Stars, charity events, and completing creative projects around the house.

agents.bio:
As one satisfied client summed up in one of Mel’s recent seller surveys, “Mel Reyna is amazing.” And we agree. Elaborating on Mel’s extraordinary service, another client remarked, “he worked very hard to sell my home quickly and keep me fully informed throughout the process – I would recommend Mel to anyone.” Mel’s professionalism, efficiency, market knowledge, listening skills, reliance and dedication are qualities that only scratch the surface of what he does for his clients and customers on a daily basis.

Mel was the first agent to join Greenwood King’s brand new Heights Boulevard office in 1999. Every year since, he has been the Heights office top producer. Three years later, Mel was ranked as one of the “Top 25 Residential Real Estate Individuals” by the Houston Business Journal. His success as a leading real estate agent may be attributed to a maxim he strictly adheres to – “always treat clients as you would expect to be treated yourself.” Without a doubt, his philosophy works, as this dynamic agent has significantly impacted residential real estate in the Heights for more than 17 years.

Honesty distinguishes this experienced pro, who’s number one priority is to ensure his clients not get too wrapped up in the emotions involved. “Always buy and sell smart,” Mel stresses, comforting clients with the fact that he will do whatever it takes – working as long as needed – to negotiate the best deal. He also takes pride in working with first-time buyers and is delighted to guide them through every step of this complicated process.

Mel specializes in the Heights (where he grew up and currently resides), as well as various surrounding neighborhoods such as Oak Forest, Shady Acres, Timbergrove Manor, Montrose, Memorial, Spring Branch, the Museum District and Galveston. As if his service to the industry wasn’t enough, Mel’s sense of neighborhood extends well beyond his professional endeavors. He has been involved in numerous charitable organizations such as the Heights Association, Heights Boulevard Beautification, St. Andrew’s Church and Harvard Elementary.

He has handled over 620+ resale homes in Bay Oaks over the last twenty-two years. Over the years, Dan’s stellar reputation has earned him referrals and repeat business as the “go-to” agent for Bay Oaks properties and other Clear Lake area luxury residences.

Exemplary service is his standard. Dan possesses cool confidence, a professional demeanor, and a gracious personality, which is a winning combination and approach to his craft.

Mentored by his Mother, Barbara McCarver, a leading Real Estate Broker in Houston for 50 years, Barbara served as the first female President of the Houston Association of Realtors. Dan comments, “Real estate is a challenging and rewarding business. Having grown up around home sales, it seems second nature to me.”

Dan McCarver has achieved the #1 position in resale real estate transaction sales volume many times in the Clear Lake area. His success is no surprise. The honors and recognition he has received are indicative of his commitment, professionalism, and level of understanding in this specialized discriminating market.

agents.bio:
Janel Yglesias has proudly called Houston her home for over two decades. In this diverse and culturally-rich city, she has immersed herself in the community, forging strong bonds with its people. With over a decade of experience in real estate through her family's home remodeling business, Janel has developed a deep understanding of the local market.

Before her real estate journey, Janel Yglesias was a dynamic journalist, having served as a news reporter for Univision Houston. Throughout her successful career, she earned a reputation as an influential and credible journalist at both the local and national levels. Covering significant events like the passing of Cuba's dictator Fidel Castro, Super Bowl LI, Hurricane Harvey, and the Houston Astros' World Series win, she proved her dedication to informing and serving the community.

Janel's exceptional work led to four nominations for the Lone Star Emmy Awards. In 2018, she clinched the prestigious Sylvan Rodriguez 'Best Houston Reporter Award.'

Janel's passion for her community now extends to real estate, where she blends her two passions seamlessly. As a specialist in her field, she takes pride in keeping her clients well-informed, offering programs and incentives for first-time homebuyers, seasoned buyers, and investors alike.

What sets Janel apart from others in the field is her unwavering commitment to her clients' success. She believes that every real estate transaction is a journey, and she is devoted to making it a smooth and enjoyable one.

Janel understands that buying or selling a property is not just a financial decision but an emotional one as well, and she goes above and beyond to ease her clients through the process. With her unique combination of real estate expertise and journalistic background, she is committed to serving the Houston community with dedication and integrity.

Beyond her professional endeavors, Janel Yglesias is a wife and a mother. Her favorite pastime is watching her son play baseball and spending time with her family at the beach. Her faith is very important to her and she thanks God for all of her blessings.

agents.bio:
Bea Flores, ABR, SRS, is a renowned figure in the Houston real estate market, with over 18 years of industry expertise. Her passion for real estate and dedication to exceptional service inspired her to establish her own brokerage, Luxe Living Group, over three years ago. Under her leadership, Bea has guided her team to remarkable success, earning recognition as one of Houston's top agents.

In December 2024, Bea and her team joined Compass Real Estate, a decision driven by the extensive marketing opportunities and advanced technology Compass offers. This move allows Luxe Living Group to enhance the already top-notch real estate experience they provide, giving clients access to cutting-edge tools and strategies that elevate every transaction.

Bea specializes in working with traditional buyers and sellers in Houston while carving out a niche in representing out-of-state institutional buyers across Texas cities like Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio. Her commitment to client education and transparent communication has earned her a loyal client base, with an impressive 85-90% of her business coming from repeat clients and referrals.

At Luxe Living Group, Bea ensures every client receives a luxurious and seamless experience, prioritizing meticulous attention to detail and comprehensive support to ensure success in every transaction.

Beyond her success as an agent, Bea is also a dedicated educator. For over nine years, she has been teaching real estate licensing courses, mentoring both agents and clients, and empowering them to navigate their real estate journeys with confidence.

Bea's outstanding achievements have earned her numerous accolades, including recognition among the Top 25 agents in Houston, a recent ranking among the Top 5 agents by production in the Houston Business Journal, and being featured in national publications such as Top Agent Magazine. She also served as President of the Women's Council of Realtors - Bay Area, Houston Chapter in 2013, further demonstrating her commitment to leadership and the advancement of the real estate profession.

With a foundation built on integrity, expertise, and an unwavering commitment to client satisfaction, Bea Flores and her team at Luxe Living Group, now proudly partnered with Compass, are dedicated to providing personalized, seamless real estate experiences that exceed expectations.

remarks: Welcome to 1802 Foxlake Drive! Situated on a desirable corner lot in the established Westlake Village community, this well-maintained two-story home shows true pride of ownership. Built in 1983, the home has been lovingly cared for by one owner since built. This is a wonderful opportunity for buyers looking for a well-kept home with the ability to add their own personal touches. Major highlights include a roof replaced approximately 2 years ago, electrical breaker box replaced 4 years ago, all duct work replaced in 2025 and a lifetime pest-control warranty. Zoned to Katy ISD and conveniently located near I-10 with easy access to shopping, dining, retail centers, medical facilities, and everyday conveniences. The combination of an established neighborhood, corner-lot location, convenient access, and decades of careful ownership makes this home a must-see. Schedule your private showing today!

remarks: Beautifully maintained one-story home on a desirable corner lot featuring a half-circle driveway and fantastic curb appeal! Anita Salazar is a dedicated Realtor with RE/MAX Integrity in Houston, TX, renowned for her commitment to helping clients navigate the real estate market with confidence. With extensive industry experience, Anita is passionate about guiding both buyers and sellers through each step of the process, providing exceptional service and expert advice along the way.

Anita is known for her integrity, dedication, and strong negotiation skills. She understands that buying or selling a home is not merely a transaction but a meaningful life milestone. Her clients trust her to make the journey as smooth and rewarding as possible.

In addition to her role as a Realtor, Anita serves as the First Vice President of the Women’s Council of Realtors Greater West Houston and is an active member of the MLS Committee and the HAR Young Professionals Network Advisory Board. She contributes her expertise, leadership, and support to empower others within the real estate community.

If you’re seeking a trustworthy, client-focused Realtor who genuinely cares about your goals, Anita Salazar is the perfect choice.

Elizabeth Wallace's extensive experience in sales and management has taught her the importance of providing a high level of service to her clients. Since obtaining her real estate license in 2018, customer service has been her top priority. She is Residential Construction Certified as well as a Certified New Home Specialist. Fluent in both English and Spanish, Elizabeth is able to tailor her breadth of expertise to her clients. Considering her career as one of continual education, Elizabeth stays current with ever-changing real estate trends and techniques. Respect, loyalty, and integrity are cornerstones of her personal philosophy, and motivation and positivity drive her everyday routine. Client-focused through and through, Elizabeth assures her clients that if she doesn't have a ready answer for a question, they will find one together. She loves being their go-to source for real estate.

In her free time, Elizabeth is an active mother of three energetic boys, Mason, Landon, and Jackson. On weekends you'll find her at a soccer field, embarrassing the boys as she shouts and cheers them on, or at home listening to some tunes as she tackles a DIY project (well her husband does all the work, she supervises, wink wink). She and her husband love to entertain a roomful of people but also enjoy a quiet night around the campfire.

remarks: Welcome to this stately traditional that has been updated and ready for immediate move-in. The welcoming entry leads you into the formal living and dining rooms. A half-bath for guests is off the entry hallway. At the end of the hallway you'll see the breakfast room and kitchen. Upgrades include Quartz countertops, recent stainless appliances, pantry and cabinets in the open kitchen. The family room has a wall of windows looking out onto the big backyard and patio. The primary bedroom upstairs is large enough for any bedroom suite and still have room for a sitting or office area. Primary bath has both garden tub and shower. All other secondary bedrooms have ceiling fans and are spacious rooms. The game room at the top of the stairs is a secondary gathering/living space for entertaining friends, game tables or media. Recent interior paint, carpet, light fixtures, 2" blinds, and laminate flooring are just some of the extras. Gas fireplace, built-ins and arched doorways. Convenient area.

agents.bio:
Michelle Hinton has been a consistent top producer throughout her decade-long career in real estate. By navigating each transaction with integrity, finesse and an impeccable diligence, Hinton is adept at ensuring a smooth and seamless transaction. She works alongside her husband, Rick, and employs a small team of industry experts to ensure a top-notch client experience.

In addition to maintaining a 5-star rating on HAR, Hinton is ranked as one of HAR’s top producing listing agents. She has also earned several industry designations and is a member of the Greater Houston Luxury Home Connection and the Houston Relocation Network group. Hinton is consistently among the Top 1 percent for production and maintains a five-star rating in Texas Monthly.

remarks: Welcome to 903 E.Spreading Oaks, a pristine mid-century modern treasure offered for the very first time by its original owner. Preserved in exceptional condition, this iconic residence showcases timeless architectural details, original heritage wood floors, and bright, expansive living spaces that capture the true essence of mid-century design. Sitting on a magnificent lot of over 10,000 square feet, outside, convenience meets versatility with a two-car attached garage and a double-wide driveway. A major highlight of the vast lot is the oversized backyard outbuilding, offering incredible flexibility to serve as an extra garage, workshop, studio, or private guest suite. Offered as an estate sale, this meticulously cared-for property combines unmatched character, massive grounds, and incredible potential into one rare opportunity for discerning buyers, investors, and design lovers alike.Improvements: hvac 2024;roof 2009; water heater 2019; Pipe Coating-2021;Floor refinish 2026

agents.bio:
Janice is a native Texan and real estate agent with LPT Realty, LLC in the Houston Metro Area.Janice is a native Texan who grew up in Houston and graduated from the University of Houston. She started her professional career in the insurance industry. After 15 years of managing and negotiating claim settlements for Major Insurance Companies, she left the business for a new challenge in the communications industry. Janice spent the next 6 years buying, selling and managing AM radio stations throughout Texas. Her specialty was serving Houston’s large, multi-cultural markets. As a result of her real estate dealings when buying, selling and leasing station properties, Janice found her calling as a Realtor. She is an advocate of the gentrification of timeworn homes inside many of Houston’s older neighborhoods. She has been involved in multiple restorations, but still has a passion for the quiet, semi-rural farms and ranches that surround the Houston area. She has received multiple certifications as a Realtor and collected the Certified Expert Negotiator Senior Real Estate Specialist  and Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist designations. Janice works very hard for her clients and always strives for a trouble free closing. Whether your desire is to relocate or find the perfect second home, from a Luxury Hi-Rise to a Waterfront Estate or maybe a beautiful Texas Farm and Ranch, Janice can assist you. She has received specialized training in all aspects of marketing, purchasing or selling representation. Her interests and passion drive her to a relentless approach in assisting a client in looking for the perfect primary or secondary residence. 

Janice lives just outside Houston and is a loving, devoted wife and mom to three Miniature Schnauzers and one Maine Coon. When not selling properties, Janice spends her time volunteering or enjoying the outdoors with friends and family. Janice is a member of several organizations including  a board member with Love Heals Youth and the Lone Star Groundwater Conservation District. She is also active with Make-A-Wish, and  C of C . 
Janice has a great passion for Houston,Texas and is committed to Excellence. She is clearly focused on the special needs of her elite clientele and today's international market. She embraces outside agent referrals and networks, providing excellent communication and service to those who are referred.

agents.bio:
As a 5th generation Houstonian, I have a deep appreciation for this city and its people. This is an exciting time to live in the Greater Houston Area, and I'm proud to be a part of it all! I've been licensed for 10 plus years and have successfully closed over 500 transactions since 2010. Although I live and work in Bellaire, I proudly serve the entire Houston market and will continue to provide exceptional service for each of my clients and my community as a whole. As your Real Estate Specialist, I promise to be your trusted resource for answers about the process of buying or selling. I will provide expertise about neighborhood features and schools and will target your home search based on your individual needs and wants. My custom innovative marketing strategies along with my strong negotiation skills are the keys to your successful transaction.

As an agent who's an expert in this local area, I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise about buying and selling real estate here. It's not the same everywhere, so you need someone you can trust for up-to-date information. I am eager to serve you. Here are some of the things I can do for you. Do you need someone who knows this area inside and out? I can work with you to find the right home at the right price for you, including all the neighborhood amenities that matter - not to mention the essential criteria you have for your ideal home. When it's time to move, you need someone who will advertise your home, show it to prospective buyers, negotiate the purchase contract, arrange to finance, oversee the inspections, handle all necessary paperwork and supervise the closing. I can take care of everything you need, from start to close. Oftentimes buyers don't visualize living in your home the way you do. I can make your home attractive to its ideal audience which can help you get top dollar. Things like staging the home, making repairs or minor improvements, or even simply painting the walls can be the difference between a home resting on the market and one that's sold fast.

remarks: Beautifully updated home tucked away in the desirable Thornwood neighborhood offering a rare 6-bedroom floor plan! The remodeled kitchen features custom cabinetry, granite counters, high-end appliances, a large island, and opens nicely to the living and dining areas. The spacious primary suite is downstairs with a walk-in closet and updated bath, along with a second bedroom down that would also make a great home office or guest room. Upstairs you’ll find four generously sized bedrooms and two updated Jack-and-Jill bathrooms, with one of the bedrooms offering great flexibility as a large game room. Great backyard with plenty of room to relax, play or entertain. With six bedrooms, multiple living spaces and a flexible floor plan, there is plenty of room for everyone. Zoned to wonderful SBISD schools and located in the heart of the Energy Corridor just off Memorial with easy access to I-10, Terry Hershey Park, shopping, dining and more.

Whether it be navigating the way for first timers, trying to score that perfect distressed property, or providing help in the luxury market, he knows and has experienced it all.

Amanda Ruchti, a Houston loving, University of Texas graduate, is a top producing agent and part-founder of The Ruchti Realty Group at Coldwell Banker. Amanda has been recognized by the Houston Association of Realtors as a "Top 20 under 40" rising star in Real Estate and was featured in REALTOR Magazine as one of 2012's "Top 30 Under 30" Realtors in the nation. She is also a member of the prestigious Coldwell Banker’s Global Luxury brand, an elite group of high-performing luxury real estate specialists from across the Coldwell Banker global network. Amanda's commitment to excellence and desire to over-deliver is what drives her to be the best.

Alongside her husband and working partner, Aaron Ruchti, they have consistently been acknowledged as one of the city's premier husband-and-wife teams and has held the title of Coldwell Banker Realty's #1 small team in Houston for the past 5 years. Their passion, experience, and results that they routinely bring to the table for their clients is evident as they are among the top tier in customer satisfaction surveys according to the Houston Association of Realtors. The knowledge and experience they provide is unparalleled and unique to the industry. By utilizing cutting edge technology and providing 24/7 availability to clients, the Ruchti team assures the most efficient and enjoyable real estate experience possible.

remarks: Welcome to this gorgeous, well-cared-for two-story home nestled in a desirable gated community just minutes from I-10, offering an easy commute around town and only an exit from Memorial Mall and all that the sought-after Memorial District has to offer. Rich wood floors create an elegant feel throughout the open-concept kitchen, dining, and living areas, providing a spacious setting for entertaining or relaxing at home. The convenient laundry room and split-bedroom floor plan provide privacy, with secondary bedrooms positioned away from the primary suite. The primary features his-and-her closets, while secondary bedrooms offer spacious walk-in closets. Step outside to a beautifully transformed, low-maintenance backyard with no grass to maintain and no direct backyard neighbors-a rare bonus! MUST SEE!

This one checks all the boxes!

He earned his Bachelor of Science degree in computer science from Northwestern University and has previous experience in complex sales, direct selling, real estate and mortgage. His “5 Step Maximum Price Process” guarantees the best price on your home, and “10-Point Marketing Strategy” delivers the maximum exposure your property deserves. remarks: Welcome home to the "Artemis" by Saratoga Home, a stunning 3-bedroom, 2-bath new construction in the sought-after Eagle Landing community. Inside, a generous family area with backyard access anchors the 1st floor, alongside the spacious primary suite. The primary bedroom features an en-suite bath with a standing shower, and his-and-her walk-in closets, while a convenient utility room completes the level. Upstairs, the 2nd floor opens into an open-concept living and dining area anchored by a kitchen with a beautiful center island with breakfast seating. Two secondary bedrooms offer plenty of space, with one enjoying direct access to the private covered balcony, and share a second full bath featuring a tub/shower combo and dual vanity sinks. Outside, a 2-car garage rounds out the home. Located within close proximity to dog parks, restaurants, retail, and close highway proximity. Schedule your tour today.

His brand was maximized by leveraging his business using the eXp Real Estate Model, being one of only two 10X Icon Award recipients of eXp realty’s most prestigious award. remarks: Welcome home to the "Elias" by Saratoga Home, a stunning 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath new construction in the sought-after Eagle Landing community. A double-wide driveway and covered front balcony set an elevated tone from the curb. Inside, a private secondary suite greets you on the 1st floor, complete with a walk-in shower and walk-in closet, ideal for guests. Upstairs, the 2nd floor opens into a seamless living space where the formal living area flows into a chef-ready kitchen with a large island, anchored by a formal dining space just beyond. The third floor is your private retreat: 2 additional secondary bedrooms, a full bath, and a utility room surround a spacious primary suite featuring a walk-in closet and a spa-inspired bath with dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. Beyond your front door, with Hwy 45 just 2 minutes away, you're perfectly positioned near restaurants, retail, dog parks, and more. Schedule your tour today.

agents.bio:
Nora Garcia is a Houston REALTOR® with Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Premier Properties, licensed since 2022 and serving clients full-time since 2024. She combines decades of financial and business experience with a client-focused approach to residential real estate. Nora earned a Bachelor's degree in Accounting in 2007 and a Master of Business Administration (MBA) in 2008, giving her clients a strong foundation in financial analysis, strategic planning, and real estate investment decisions. She has worked as an accountant and bookkeeper since 1988, helping individuals and businesses make informed financial decisions with accuracy and integrity.
Nora specializes in residential real estate throughout Houston, with particular expertise in The Heights and Katy. She also serves clients in Montrose, Oak Forest, Memorial, Cypress, Sugar Land, Waller, and Cleveland. Her experience includes approximately 30 residential leases, 3 home sales, 5 buyer transactions, an average of 25 transactions per year, and approximately $1 million in annual sales volume. She works with first-time homebuyers, sellers, relocation clients, new construction buyers, condominium purchasers, historic home buyers, investors, and leasing clients.
As an ABR® (Accredited Buyer's Representative) and Texas Residential Leasing Specialist (TRLS), with her Seller Representative designation in progress, Nora is committed to professional education and exceptional client service. She ranks among the Top 5% of agents in her Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Premier Properties office. Fluent in English and Spanish and conversational Italian and Portuguese, she serves a diverse clientele throughout the Greater Houston area.
In addition to real estate, Nora is a yoga and Body Works instructor, reflecting her commitment to discipline, balance, and helping others achieve their goals. Clients value her financial expertise, professionalism, integrity, and personalized service, empowering them to buy, sell, lease, and invest in Houston real estate with confidence.

remarks: Set on a quiet, tree-lined street in Westwood, this spacious 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath residence offers a bright, inviting interior and a well-designed layout. A grand formal entry leads to the main living area, featuring high ceilings, French doors, wood flooring, and a dramatic fireplace. The eat-in kitchen features stainless steel appliances, while new hardwood floors in both bedrooms and fresh interior paint give the home a clean, updated feel. The generous primary suite offers a second fireplace, a large walk-in closet, and an en-suite bathroom with dual sinks and a soaking tub. In-unit laundry, guest parking, and gated entry complete the offering in an intimate seven-unit building near Century City, UCLA, Beverly Hills, and some of the Westside's best dining and shopping.

remarks: First-floor living, beautiful wood floors, and an upgraded backyard patio set the stage for easy living at 4603 Terry Street. Built in 2023, this home features an open living, dining, and kitchen layout with high ceilings and large windows that welcome natural light. The island kitchen offers quartz countertops, soft-close cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and a walk-in pantry. Step outside to a spacious, fenced backyard with room to entertain, dine outdoors, or unwind on the patio. Upstairs, the primary suite features a vaulted ceiling, walk-in closet, and a bath with dual vanities, a soaking tub, and a separate shower. Two additional bedrooms provide space for guests or a home office. A private driveway and attached two-car garage add everyday convenience, while nearby Downtown Houston, restaurants, and shopping keep you connected to the city.

remarks:
Timeless elegance meets modern comfort in this beautifully two-story Colonial home, ideally located in the heart of historic Leimert Park. Offering 4 spacious bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and more than 1,700 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space on a generous 6,390-square-foot lot, this charming residence seamlessly blends classic architectural character with modern updates and everyday comfort. A lush, professionally landscaped front yard welcomes you into a warm and light-filled interior featuring genuine hardwood floors, double-pane windows, elegant white crown molding, and timeless finishes throughout. The inviting living room is anchored by a beautiful fireplace and surrounded by charming windows that fill the space with natural light, creating a comfortable setting for relaxing and entertaining. The functional floor plan features generously sized bedrooms with abundant closet space, a separate laundry room, and central heating and air conditioning for year-round comfort. Recent improvements include copper plumbing, an updated electrical panel, a newer roof, a newer HVAC system, and energy-saving solar panels that can help reduce utility costs.
Step outside to enjoy the expansive backyard, which offers plenty of space for outdoor dining, entertaining, relaxing, or soaking up the California sunshine. A detached two-car garage, large storage shed, and extended driveway provide exceptional storage and ample off-street parking.
Situated on a picturesque, palm-lined street, this desirable Leimert Park location offers convenient access to Culver City, SoFi Stadium, The Forum, Downtown Los Angeles, LAX, and some of Los Angeles' best dining, shopping, entertainment, and cultural destinations.
A rare opportunity to lease a beautifully updated Colonial home in one of Los Angeles' most distinctive and sought-after neighborhoods. Spacious, charming, updated, and ideally located - welcome home!

remarks: GORGEOUS 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath, and 3-car garage home features an attractive brick exterior, complete with a rarely seen front porch, and is located in the desirable gated community of New Forest. The primary bedroom is conveniently situated on the first floor, and the other bedrooms are on the second floor. Other attractions include an extra room configured as a spice kitchen with many built-in storage cabinets, a covered patio, and a custom-built storage shed. It comes with many upgrades, such as new granite countertops in the kitchen and bathrooms, fresh paint throughout the interior, and recently installed LVP flooring, except in the master bedroom. While the sprinkler system maintains a vibrant yard, the water softener ensures clear water for the entire house. The backyard, surrounded by a variety of mature fruit trees, not only provides ample space for outdoor activities but also creates a garden-like atmosphere. NEW ROOF INSTALLED 11/13/2025. Monica Villaseñor is a top-rated Houston REALTOR® and Berkshire Hathaway President’s Circle award recipient, recognized among the Top 25 Agents in Texas. Since becoming licensed in 2020, she has helped buyers and sellers close more than $33 million in real estate across Houston’s most desirable neighborhoods, including The Greater Heights, Montrose, Rice Military, Garden Oaks, Oak Forest, Spring Branch, West University, River Oaks, and Memorial.

Monica specializes in luxury homes, first-time buyers, out-of-state relocations, corporate and medical moves, new construction, move-up buyers, and downsizing. Her industry credentials—including Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist (CLHMS), Certified Home Marketing Specialist (CHMS), Accredited Buyer Representative (ABR), and Certified New Home Specialist—reflect a high level of professional training and a commitment to exceptional client care.

Known for her strong negotiation skills, market knowledge, and personalized service, Monica offers a client-first approach that makes each transaction smooth, informed, and stress-free. Bilingual in English and Spanish and a graduate of The University of Texas at Austin, she combines local expertise with clear communication to help every client achieve their real estate goals with confidence. Whether buying or selling, clients trust Monica for her professionalism, responsiveness, and proven results in the Houston market.

remarks: Welcome home to the "Rev" by Saratoga Home, a stunning 3-bedroom, 3-bath new construction in the sought-after Eagle Landing community. A striking front design, double-wide driveway, and attached 3-car tandem garage set an elevated tone from the curb. Inside, a convenient secondary bedroom welcomes you on the 1st floor with a private en-suite bath — in fact, every bedroom in this thoughtful floor plan enjoys its own private bath. Upstairs, the 2nd floor opens into a seamless living and dining area anchored by a chef-inspired kitchen with a large island, abundant cabinetry, and sleek stainless-steel appliances. The 3rd floor primary suite is your private retreat, featuring a soaking tub, separate shower, and walk-in closet. Beyond your front door, Eagle Landing delivers resort-style living with a clubhouse, playgrounds, a pool, and a dog park. And with Hwy 45 just 2 minutes away, you're perfectly positioned.

remarks: Beautifully updated 2-bedroom downstairs condo near the Galleria in a non-flood zone and widely considered one of the nicest units in the community. Ideal for buyers seeking an updated condo in Houston near the Galleria with style & convenience.
