agents.bio:
Kate Myhan brings a highly distinctive background to commercial real estate, combining international business experience, advanced academic training, strategic marketing expertise, and hands-on dealmaking across multiple asset types. Based in Houston, Texas, Kate works with commercial property owners, investors, developers, landlords, tenants, and business buyers locally, nationally, and internationally. In addition to representing clients in Texas, she also works with national buyers pursuing opportunities in other states, helping them identify, evaluate, and secure the right assets based on their investment goals.

With a Master’s in Economics and more than two decades of experience in marketing, management, client relations, and real estate investing, Kate offers a sophisticated, results-driven approach to every assignment. Her professional background includes serving as a strategic marketing professor in Santiago, Chile, where she taught MBA students and developed high-level expertise in positioning, negotiation, market strategy, and consumer behavior. That international academic and business experience gives her a rare advantage in commercial real estate, especially when advising clients on marketability, asset positioning, and investment potential.

Kate has built her reputation on strong relationships, creative problem-solving, relentless work ethic, and an ability to connect the right people to the right opportunities. She is known for identifying value where others may not, whether in on-market listings, off-market deals, redevelopment sites, land opportunities, industrial assets, retail properties, mixed-use projects, multifamily investments, or business-related real estate transactions. Her combination of analytical thinking and marketing expertise allows her to not only find opportunities, but also present and promote properties in a way that drives attention and results.

Her experience is especially valuable to clients seeking guidance on acquisitions, dispositions, site selection, development potential, investment strategy, and high-visibility property marketing. Kate understands that commercial real estate success requires more than simply listing a property or submitting an offer—it requires insight, negotiation skill, persistence, financial awareness, and the ability to create momentum around a deal. She approaches each client relationship with professionalism, urgency, and a commitment to maximizing value.

Kate is a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Texas REALTORS®, National Association of Realtors, and the CCIM Institute. She holds respected industry credentials including CCIM (Certified Commercial Investment Member), CIPS (Certified International Property Specialist), TACS (Texas Accredited Commercial Specialist), and CRS (Certified Residential Specialist). Fluent in English, Spanish, French, and Polish, she is able to work effectively with a diverse range of clients, including international investors and cross-border buyers.

Clients appreciate Kate for her extensive market knowledge, global perspective, broad-based network, and unwavering devotion to their success. Her business is built largely through referrals and repeat relationships, reflecting the trust she earns through outstanding service, strategic guidance, and strong results. Whether representing a Houston-based owner, an out-of-state investor, or a national buyer expanding into new markets, Kate brings the experience, intelligence, and dealmaking energy needed to move complex transactions forward.

I've been licensed for 10 plus years and have successfully closed over 500 transactions since 2010. Although I live and work in Bellaire, I proudly serve the entire Houston market and will continue to provide exceptional service for each of my clients and my community as a whole. As your Real Estate Specialist, I promise to be your trusted resource for answers about the process of buying or selling. I will provide expertise about neighborhood features and schools and will target your home search based on your individual needs and wants. My custom innovative marketing strategies along with my strong negotiation skills are the keys to your successful transaction.

As an agent who's an expert in this local area, I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise about buying and selling real estate here. It's not the same everywhere, so you need someone you can trust for up-to-date information. I am eager to serve you. Here are some of the things I can do for you. Do you need someone who knows this area inside and out? I can work with you to find the right home at the right price for you, including all the neighborhood amenities that matter - not to mention the essential criteria you have for your ideal home. When it's time to move, you need someone who will advertise your home, show it to prospective buyers, negotiate the purchase contract, arrange to finance, oversee the inspections, handle all necessary paperwork and supervise the closing. I can take care of everything you need, from start to close. Oftentimes buyers don't visualize living in your home the way you do. I can make your home attractive to its ideal audience which can help you get top dollar. Things like staging the home, making repairs or minor improvements, or even simply painting the walls can be the difference between a home resting on the market and one that's sold fast.

agents.bio:
Brad Evans is a Broker Associate with the Houston Properties Team and was named Best Realtor in Fort Bend County by Living Magazine (2025). He has served Richmond, Katy, Sugar Land, Fulshear, Cypress, Missouri City, and Fort Bend County, TX since 2012.

A University of Dayton graduate with a finance background, Brad takes a data-driven approach — pricing homes with real local comps, building neighborhood market-trend guides, and pairing sharp negotiation with staging and marketing that helps listings sell quickly and for top dollar. He has sold 190+ homes since 2012, with about 68% of his business coming from repeat clients and referrals.

A born-and-raised Houstonian and Eagle Scout, Brad is recognized as a Team Top Producer and Five Star Service Professional, and is a member of the Houston Association of REALTORS® (TREC #). Clients describe him as responsive, calm under pressure, and genuinely in it for the long haul.

Whether you're a first-time buyer, relocating, buying new construction, or selling in Fort Bend County, Brad delivers local expertise and honest guidance.

(555) 539-3782 ·  contact-505d715d2c@example.com

Angie Farish is a bilingual real estate agent serving Sugar Land and Richmond, Texas — from Greatwood to Riverstone in Sugar Land, and Canyon Gate to Lakes of Bella Terra in Richmond. She brings ten years of experience helping local homeowners buy and sell throughout both markets.

She works with people making a big move: longtime homeowners ready to sell and right-size into their next chapter, previous homeowners buying again, and longtime renters becoming homeowners for the first time. Angie lives in Greatwood and works out of her Sugar Land office — she's not reading these neighborhoods off a listing sheet, she's driving through them every day.

She also guides buyers through new construction — builder contracts, incentives, and warranty timelines that work differently from resale — bringing that same ten years of experience to Richmond, her current focus.

As a licensed REALTOR®? affiliated with Keller Williams Realty Southwest, Angie combines genuine local expertise with a straightforward, client-first approach — working with clients in both English and Spanish throughout Fort Bend County. 5-star rated by local clients.

agents.bio: I really don't know how to start this and never feel they come out how I want! I never knew what I wanted to be as a kid besides a race car driver or car collector or maybe a hunter! I had a conversation with a stranger turned friend years later that I met in a hotel conference room that I over heard them talking about real estate investing. agents.bio: Having been involved in many facets of real estate, including selling over $250 Million thus far in real estate, Evan brings his knowledge and experience to The Compean Group, a boutique team he founded to expand on his deeply ingrained principles for high level service, marketing, and tactful negotiating with insight, all based on experience and data. Evan is also a licensed loan officer and partner at Smart Title, a 5 star rated Houston title company. Evan began his career in 2002 on the investment side, and then transitioned into working directly with the consumer in 2012, enabling him to utilize his insight to better assist clients directly. Evan's current knowledge and experience first developed from working as an acquisition specialist of distressed properties for a group of investors. He then began managing his personal portfolio of real estate investments, private lending on new construction and rehab projects, and taking on joint ventures with development projects. He has also obtained significant experience personally rehabbing and building, not to mention years as a buyer's agent, before transitioning into a listing agent, and then forming a team. This experience has allowed Evan and his team to bring impactful insight to all of their clients. Over the past few years, The Compean Group has streamlined the selling and buying process for their clients to help them avoid unnecessary headaches and frustration, hence our raving reviews from clients, with over 400+ reviews on multiple platforms like Zillow, Google, and Yelp!

remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated 2-story corner-unit condo in Spenwick Village in the Spring Branch area. This 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath home is zoned to Spring Branch ISD and beloved Lion Lane Pre-School is right next door to the zoned middle school. The kitchen features quartz countertops, a new range, microwave, and dishwasher, while the refrigerator, washer, and dryer are all included! Every bathroom has been tastefully remodeled with modern floating vanities. Energy-efficient upgrades include solar shades on the east-facing windows and a radiant barrier in the upstairs east wall to help reduce heat gain. Relax on the private fenced back patio with a convenient storage room or enjoy neighbors in the common area just outside the front door. Two assigned covered parking spaces are located directly behind the unit. Residents enjoy access to the community pool and a prime location just minutes from The Galleria, Downtown Houston, Memorial Park, shopping, dining, and major freeways.

agents.bio:
As a native Houstonian and experienced real estate professional, I believe exceptional real estate service begins with understanding what matters most to my clients. My approach is rooted in relationships, built on trust, and driven by a commitment to providing thoughtful guidance, strategic expertise, and personalized service throughout every step of the real estate journey.

Before beginning my real estate career, I spent more than 15 years in executive sales and contract negotiations within the technology industry. Today, I combine that business experience with my knowledge of the Houston real estate market to provide skilled negotiation, strategic advice, and a concierge-level experience tailored to each client's unique needs and goals.

As a homeowner, landlord, and real estate investor myself, I understand firsthand that real estate is more than a transaction. It's a significant financial investment, a lifestyle decision, and often the beginning of an exciting new chapter. Whether you're buying or selling a luxury home, relocating to Houston, purchasing your first home, or exploring investment opportunities, my priority is to protect your interests, simplify the process, and help you make confident, informed decisions.

I proudly serve Houston and its surrounding communities, and I've built my business on integrity, personal connections, and lasting relationships. Nothing means more to me than earning the trust of my clients and knowing they feel confident referring their friends, family, and colleagues to me for the same exceptional level of service.

For me, success isn't simply measured by homes bought and sold. It's measured by the relationships I build, the trust I earn, and the experience I deliver.

I love Houston, I love real estate, and most importantly, I love helping people achieve their goals. I would welcome the opportunity to do the same for you.

Rooted in Houston. Rooted in Relationships. Rooted in What Matters.

remarks: Step through the front door and be greeted by a dramatic spiral staircase in this stunning Huntwick Forest home. Enjoy a rare dual-primary layout, with one suite downstairs and a second primary-worthy retreat upstairs among four bedrooms and two full baths. The chef's kitchen features custom cabinetry with corner lazy susans maximizing every inch, plus a large island perfect for gathering. Closet lovers will swoon over the storage throughout, backed by an oversized laundry room with sink. A private office sits tucked at the rear, and energy-efficient windows keep comfort year-round. Outside, an expansive front yard delights plant lovers, while a landscaped backyard with water features creates a zen retreat. The oversized garage includes a full A/C workshop. agents.bio:
I walk alongside my clients across the Houston metropolitan area, offering guidance, protection, and secure negotiations so they can make confident decisions when buying or selling a home. Because these choices truly matter for their future.

Buying or selling a home in Houston can feel overwhelming. Prices shift, advice conflicts, and one wrong move can cost time, money, or peace of mind. Most people are not looking for a flashy agent. They are looking for clarity and a plan they can trust.

That is where my wife Suzanna and I come in.

We help people navigate the Houston market with clear strategy and steady guidance, whether that means preparing a home for a top dollar sale or finding the right home without overpaying. After more than 19 years in real estate and over 450 clients served, I have learned that the best outcomes come from simplicity, preparation, and strong negotiation.

Before real estate, I was a mechanical engineer. I earned a B.S. and Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering and worked in systems driven environments at GE Automation Systems and Petron Systems. That background trained me to analyze risk, anticipate failure points, and protect outcomes, skills I now use daily to safeguard my clients’ decisions.

I am also a real estate investor and have taught portfolio building at Houston’s largest real estate investment club. My professional designations reflect one thing: deep preparation so you do not have to guess.

Here is how we work.

First, we listen carefully and define the real goal
Second, we build a clear strategy using market data and timing
Third, we negotiate firmly and execute with precision through closing

If you work with us, you will understand your options, feel confident in your decisions, and move forward without second guessing.

If you are trying to buy, sell, or invest in Houston, having clarity is the right decision. We are here to guide you through it.

agents.bio:
Erica McLane is a Magnolia, Texas REALTOR® who lives, works and serves in the community she knows best. With deep roots in the Greater Houston area and years spent watching Magnolia and Montgomery County grow, Erica brings true local knowledge and firsthand market insight to every transaction.

Since entering real estate, Erica has quickly built a successful business based largely on relationships, referrals and results. She has been recognized as a Top Producer with the Bridget Moore Group and has helped clients through dozens of successful transactions, including first-time home purchases, VA buyers, listings, new construction, relocation, acreage and land.

Specializing in Magnolia, 77354 and 77355, Erica also serves Montgomery, Pinehurst, Tomball, Cypress, Spring, The Woodlands, Conroe and surrounding communities.

As the wife of a U.S. Army veteran and a Military Relocation Professional (MRP), Erica has a special passion for serving veterans and military families. Having personally navigated the VA home loan process with her family, she understands the unique details of VA financing and works closely with her clients throughout the process.

Before real estate, Erica spent nearly 30 years in the restaurant and management industry, where she learned that taking care of people, communicating well and earning trust are the foundation of a successful business. That same hands-on approach has become a defining part of her real estate career.

Erica is known for going beyond what many clients expect from their agent. From preparing and staging homes for the market to walking inspections, negotiating repairs, assisting with new construction and educating first-time buyers, she stays involved from the first conversation through closing.

agents.bio:
Jeremy Zink joined Cinco Ranch Realty Group after spending over two decades in the hospitality industry. Before settling in Katy, he developed a passion for real estate while relocating around the country as an Executive General Manager with a nationally known restaurant group. Jeremy’s results-driven approach, integrity, and eye for detail make coordinating and negotiating real estate deals a hassle-free experience for his clients. 

Before moving to Katy, Jeremy owned and leased out multiple properties around the country for almost 20 years, making him comfortable dealing with seasoned investors as well as first-time home buyers alike. While Katy is his home, he is intimately familiar with west Houston, including Richmond, Fulshear, Sugar Land and beyond.  His professional style and communication are key to a sometimes complex process, and he has an unwavering commitment and determination to make each and every transaction a success.

Jeremy resides in Katy with his wife – Director of Behavioral Health for HCA Houston Healthcare – and their three children. He is proud to be part of world-class Katy ISD as an executive member of the local PTA, as well as serving as coach and sponsor of sports teams with Katy Youth Soccer Club and Katy American Little League.  Jeremy enjoys spending as much time with family as possible, and looks forward to making you part of the Cinco Ranch Realty Group family as well!

If you have questions about the Katy/Houston market, need real estate advice or suggestions, or need recommendations for agents outside of the Katy/Houston market, please don't hesitate to call Jeremy at (555) 972-4947 or email contact-44f4d785ac@example.com

agents.bio:
In the dynamic world of real estate, success is not merely measured by transactions; it is defined by the ability to transform lives and create lasting legacies. Manuel Martinez is a bilingual real estate professional born in Brownsville, Texas, and raised in the cultural heart of Matamoros, Mexico. He embarked on a transformative journey to Houston, Texas—a city of limitless possibilities—and today stands as a key player in the real estate arena, empowering investors to achieve unprecedented growth and success.
As a devoted husband and proud father of two beautiful daughters, family has always been Manuel's foundation and inspiration. His journey encompasses not just building a successful career but also creating a life of purpose, integrity, and ambition.

Manuel's expertise lies in guiding both first-time investors and seasoned developers through the intricate world of real estate investment, helping them scale their portfolios through strategic financial leverage. With a deep understanding of the market and his clients' aspirations, he has cultivated a reputation for delivering bespoke solutions that turn investment dreams into reality.

Being multicultural and fluent in both English and Spanish enables Manuel to seamlessly connect with an international clientele, providing a tailored experience that resonates across cultures. His connections within Houston’s real estate landscape are extensive, and his commitment to excellence is unwavering.

For Manuel, real estate is more than just property; it is the art of creating opportunities, building wealth, and shaping futures. Whether working with first-time investors or seasoned developers, he prides himself on being the trusted partner who brings vision and success together.

Alberto Escobedo is not just a real estate agent—he’s a dedicated advocate for the Houston Latin community. His deep connections within the area give him a unique perspective, allowing him to serve as a bridge between his clients and their dream homes.
As a staple in the community, Alberto understands the challenges many families face in navigating the complex world of real estate, and he’s committed to making the process smoother, more accessible, and enjoyable for everyone.
Alberto’s passion for helping others goes beyond transactions; he genuinely cares about empowering the families he works with to make confident decisions.
His clients know they can count on him to stand by their side through every twist and turn, from understanding paperwork to negotiating deals that prioritize their best interests.
With his warm, approachable style and strong sense of community, Alberto is not just a realtor—he’s a trusted partner who helps transform dreams into reality while uplifting the neighborhoods that make Houston’s Latin community so special.

remarks: Welcome to 4217 Serman Street at Sherman Landing, a striking new-construction 3-story home in Houston's dynamic EaDo neighborhood. Spanning 2,000 sq ft, this 3-bed/3.5-bath residence blends bold modern design with thoughtful livability. A flexible first-floor bedroom with full bath is perfect as a guest suite or home office. Ascend the dramatic floating staircase to an open second floor where exposed structural trusses soar above a chef's kitchen with dark flat-front cabinetry, granite countertops, gas range, and island seating, flowing into the sunken living room with 42" gas fireplace. The third-floor primary suite delivers vaulted beamed ceilings, a freestanding soaking tub, skylit walk-in shower, and a huge custom built-in closet. An attached 2-car garage completes the package. Steps from the Harrisburg Hike & Bike Trail, 0.4 mi to light rail, and minutes from Minute Maid Park, Buffalo Bayou, and EaDo's acclaimed dining and nightlife scene.

agents.bio:
Mike’s enthusiasm, dedication, and consummate market knowledge make him the Realtor® of choice for his many clients who do not hesitate to recommend his services to family and friends.

Mike was born and grew up in Creswell, North Carolina. He graduated from East Carolina University with a degree in Industrial Technology and Business. His Houston sales career began in the 1980s when Mike was transferred to Bayou City while working in retail management. He changed his career path in 1987 to residential real estate sales and has never looked back.

Mike’s father owned a small development and construction company, and that exposure gave Mike a particular interest in and knowledge of new home construction. He understands the builders’ language, and that expertise has made a successful difference for his clients in numerous transactions.

Leadership, experience, market expertise, above all, an understanding of people, and the importance of building relationships make Mike a top-producing, in-demand Realtor®.

Today, I use that same skill set to guide families, relocators, and investors through seamless real estate moves—whether it’s upsizing, relocating to Texas, selling quickly, or finding a property with long-term value.
Clients work with me because I’m direct, detail-driven, and solutions-focused. I’m committed to understanding the full picture of your needs, educating you at every step, and protecting your best interests from the first consultation to the closing table.
What I Bring to Every Client:
• Strategic pricing & negotiations

• Local expertise in neighborhoods, schools & amenities
• High-level marketing for listings
• A network of top lenders, inspectors, and contractors
• Clear communication—every time
Whether you’re making your first move or your fifth, I’m here to make it your smartest one yet.

remarks: Located on a beautiful tree-lined street in the Houston Heights sits 310 W. 17th St, a stunning 3 bed/2.5 bath home built by Sullivan Bros. 4,624 sf lot (per HCAD). Close to shops/restaurants/entertainment on 19th St + nearby exercise trails/parks.

agents.bio:
Ashley Day, your go-to real estate agent in Houston. Since moving to the area in 2007, Ashley has been deeply connected to the vibrant and dynamic real estate market that the city has to offer. With a passion for people and a background in law, Ashley has found her true calling in the world of Houston real estate.

What Ashley loves most about the real estate industry is the opportunity to work closely with people, utilizing her legal expertise to negotiate and create win-win situations for her clients. She thrives on the collaborative nature of the business, partnering with fellow realtors to ensure every transaction is smooth and successful.

But it's not just the real estate industry that captivates Ashley, it's also the area itself. Houston's walkability, friendly neighbors, incredible restaurants, and beautiful parks make it an ideal place to call home. Ashley's in-depth knowledge of the local market and her ability to understand her clients' needs and preferences make her the perfect guide in finding their dream home in this amazing city. In fact, Ashley has even earned the nickname "Your Walking Agent" due to her commitment to exploring neighborhoods on foot, walking the Houston neighborhoods daily with her rescue dogs, Sunny and Dexter.

Ashley's achievements speak for themselves. With a law degree under her belt, she brings a unique perspective to the table, ensuring her clients receive the most effective negotiation strategies. Additionally, she retains her Broker License and is a Certified Negotiation Expert, an Accredited Buyer Representative, and a Luxury Home Marketing Specialist.

Beyond her professional life, Ashley cherishes her role as a mother and wife. With a daughter attending Texas A&M and a son who excels on the soccer field at St Thomas High School, she understands the importance of finding a home that meets the needs of a growing family. Her children have attended HISD schools as well as private schools in Memorial, Spring Branch, and River Oaks area. Thus, Ashley has a true grasp for area school and athletics options.

With Ashley, you can expect a professional yet friendly approach to real estate. She is dedicated to serving the community, and her primary goal is to help her clients achieve their real estate dreams. Whether you're buying or selling, Ashley Day is the agent you can trust to guide you every step of the way. She is, after all, Your Walking Agent!

remarks: Located in the Old 6th Ward historic district and close to area restaurants, shops and downtown Houston sits 1722 Washington Ave. #D. This perfect lock ‘n leave property is a stunning lifestyle that brings architectural details to the forefront. Industrial high ceilings, concrete flooring and amazing natural light makes for a truly spectacular property. Open floorplan offers multiple living areas, dining, granite kitchen, half bathroom, laundry and storage closet. Cook’s kitchen is well-appointed with granite counters, stainless steel appliances, pantry, undercabinet lighting and counter seating. Add to it a home office/guest bedroom, primary bedroom/bathroom and covered front patio to enjoy outdoor living to complete the single floor plan. Hallway elevator to all floors. Tandem two car garage plus additional off-street parking from the controlled access gate. Minutes from downtown, the arts district, the Heights and Memorial Park along the Washington Avenue corridor.

New construction homes

Relocation to the Houston area
Investment properties
Residential leasing for both landlords and tenants

Bay Oaks, is a premier golf community located in southeast Houston’s Clear Lake/NASA area. Dan McCarver knows the Clear Lake Real Estate Market very well.

Dan is a native Houstonian and a second-generation Realtor. Licensed since 1977, Dan is familiar with Clear Lake’s finest neighborhoods and focuses on the golf community of Bay Oaks.

He has handled over 620+ resale homes in Bay Oaks over the last twenty-two years. Over the years, Dan’s stellar reputation has earned him referrals and repeat business as the “go-to” agent for Bay Oaks properties and other Clear Lake area luxury residences.

Exemplary service is his standard. Dan possesses cool confidence, a professional demeanor, and a gracious personality, which is a winning combination and approach to his craft.

Mentored by his Mother, Barbara McCarver, a leading Real Estate Broker in Houston for 50 years, Barbara served as the first female President of the Houston Association of Realtors. Dan comments, “Real estate is a challenging and rewarding business. Having grown up around home sales, it seems second nature to me.”

Dan McCarver has achieved the #1 position in resale real estate transaction sales volume many times in the Clear Lake area. His success is no surprise. The honors and recognition he has received are indicative of his commitment, professionalism, and level of understanding in this specialized discriminating market.

agents.bio:
Jamie Kastens has excelled and become one of the Top 20 Agents in her Keller Williams Realty Southwest Market Center. Her clients range from repeat customers and referrals to new clients that have heard about her reputation or found her through social media. The one constant all clients hear about Jamie is she is trustworthy, dependable and will go above and beyond to help her clients find what they are looking for.

What does above and beyond mean? She has helped her clients with design, finishes, de´cor, staging, and of course finding the perfect location. What drives Jamie is her passion to help others find the perfect home. There aren’t many life events more important than finding a new house no matter if it’s your first or your dream retirement home. Those of us privileged enough to impact lives in such a meaningful way carry a responsibility.

Jamie’s goal is to help her clients navigate one of the most important and stressful decisions they’ll face with confidence, trust, and desired outcome. One of the best parts of her career is she usually ends up with new friends as well.

She loves to volunteer in her Ft. Bend community, her children’s school, and has a soft spot for animal shelters and pets of all kind. Jamie loves to travel with her children and husband and hopes someday to have a poodle farm in the country, but until that day comes her clients are her passion.

agents.bio:
Houston Broker & Owner of The Zilveti Group, Andrés Zilveti creates exceptional experiences and optimal outcomes for buyers and sellers throughout the Greater Houston area backed by more than a decade of hands-on marketing experience. As a third-generation real estate professional, the business is practically in his DNA. Clients rave about his patient, understanding and professional approach, calling his ability to zero in on his customers' unique needs "brilliant."

Before getting his real estate license, Andrés ran a digital agency, where he honed the razor-sharp marketing and social media talents that are indispensable to his clients today. As the owner/broker of The Zilveti Group, he thrives on helping people move forward and upward in their lives, whether that means guiding a first-time home purchase, serving relocators and young professionals, or helping investors expand their portfolios. With Andres at the helm, clients at every price point enjoy attentive expert service backed by powerful industry know-how.

Andrés was raised in Austin and moved to Houston to attend the University of Houston, where he earned a bachelor's degree in public relations with a minor in art history. After a three-year stint as an expat in Perth, Australia, he returned to Houston. Andrés now resides in Spring Branch, where he appreciates the relaxing lifestyle and central location. When he's not hard at work for his clients, he enjoys spending time with his family and dogs and pursuing his passion for pickleball.

remarks: Welcome to this beautifully remodeled and light-filled condominium located in the heart of Hollywood, ideally situated between Hollywood Boulevard and Sunset Boulevard, just moments from Griffith Park. This spacious 2-bedroom, 2-bath residence features an open-concept floor plan designed for comfortable living and effortless entertaining. The updated kitchen showcases granite countertops, a breakfast bar, stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, and a built-in wine rack. Rich hardwood flooring, recessed lighting, dual-pane windows, and in-unit laundry add both style and convenience throughout the home. The primary suite offers a private retreat complete with an en-suite bathroom. The secondary bedroom is highlighted by a stunning floor-to-ceiling custom library with a classic rolling ladder, creating a warm and inviting space for book lovers, creatives, or those seeking a distinctive home office. A large finished attic loft provides additional flexible living space ideal for a home office, reading nook, art studio, guest retreat, or generous storage. Additional highlights include two gated and secure parking spaces, guest parking, and a secured building featuring intercom entry and camera surveillance systems. Enjoy the benefits of an exceptionally low HOA, which includes water, trash service, and earthquake insurance. Conveniently located within walking distance of the Metro station, shopping, dining, and entertainment, with convenient access to the 101 Freeway, this is a rare opportunity to live in a stylish, character-rich residence in one of Hollywood's most vibrant and desirable neighborhoods.

agents.bio:
Will Beardslee is an Orange County native and U.S. Army veteran who began his real estate career in 2008 after being honorably discharged from service. A Bronze Star recipient, Will brings the same discipline, integrity, and strategic precision from his military background into every real estate transaction.

With a deep understanding of the Southern California market, Will equips his clients with the knowledge and insight needed to make confident, informed decisions. He holds himself to exceptionally high standards—delivering unmatched service, meticulous attention to detail, and a steadfast commitment to exceeding expectations. Guided by strong family values and a client-first mindset, Will believes that trust, communication, and genuine connection are the foundation of a successful partnership.

For Will, the most rewarding part of his profession is the lasting relationships he builds and the satisfaction his clients feel when their goals are realized. He considers it an honor to play an essential role in one of the most meaningful chapters of their lives.

When he’s not showing homes, negotiating contracts, or hosting open houses, Will enjoys spending time with his wife, Allie, and their daughters, Virginia and Ruby. An avid outdoorsman, he also loves hiking, snowboarding, and surfing. No matter the endeavor, Will approaches each day with purpose, passion, and a dedication to helping others turn their real estate visions into reality.

remarks: La Novella- Coming Fall 2026! Imagine being the first to call this brand-new home yours! Whether you are ready to stop renting and start building equity or expand your rental portfolio with a beautiful new property, this opportunity deserves your attention.

remarks: Opportunity in the highly sought after Clear Lake City community! I'm Michael Gee, a Houston Real Estate Advisor with Real Broker, West Point graduate, and Army veteran who has helped more than 250 families buy, sell, lease, and invest in real estate throughout the Greater Houston area.

I specialize in helping Houston first time homebuyers, military and veteran families, relocations, investment properties, new construction, VA home loans, and assumable VA loans. I also work with investors looking to build long term wealth through rental properties, duplexes, and strategic real estate investments.

My military background taught me the importance of integrity, communication, attention to detail, and putting others first. Those same values guide every client relationship. Whether you're purchasing your first home, relocating to Houston, selling your current property, or expanding an investment portfolio, my goal is to provide honest advice, strong negotiation, and a strategy tailored to your goals.

I'm proud to be a RealTrends Verified Agent and a 4 time Real Elite Agent, consistently recognized as one of the top producing agents at Real Broker. While awards are meaningful, what matters most is earning my clients' trust and helping them make confident real estate decisions.

Outside of serving clients, I enjoy educating consumers through social media by sharing insights on the Houston housing market, investment properties, VA home loans, assumable VA loans, and Houston neighborhoods. As both a veteran and REALTOR®, I understand the unique challenges military families face during PCS moves, transitions from active duty, and using VA benefits to build long term wealth through homeownership.

If you're looking for a trusted real estate professional in the Greater Houston area who values education, communication, and long term relationships, I'd love the opportunity to help you achieve your real estate goals.

remarks: Remodeled modern 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath custom home in Fleetwood, Houston's Energy Corridor. 4,139 square feet on a 7,800-square-foot lot with a circle driveway offering ample guest parking, garage access is via the alley. Spacious and full of natural light, this home shines. The open floorplan connects a chef's kitchen with luxury appliances and a huge walk-in pantry to the main living space; separate formal dining room adds distinct entertaining space. Primary suite on the first floor; double stairways lead to a second-floor game room and additional bedrooms. Private pool, spa, and covered patio anchor the backyard, with a pool bathroom inside the house just off the pool area. There's a side yard for pets and you're walking distance to the neighborhood lake and Terry Hershey trails. Zoned to coveted Katy ISD with easy I-10 access to major Energy Corridor employers. Come see why Fleetwood is one of the most coveted neighborhoods in the Energy Corridor.

remarks: Welcome home to 802 W 41st St. Nestled among the trees, on a 9400+ sqft corner lot sits this reimagined 1940’s Garden Oaks ranch. Step inside to a beautiful foyer that opens to your oversized living space, with direct access to the gourmet kitchen, featuring a large island, 7-burner gas range, and custom-built banquet with storage seating. Just off the kitchen is your primary bedroom and ensuite bath, with walk-in shower and separate soaking tub. Off the hall at the front of the home sit 3 more bedrooms and a large secondary bath with oversized shower and soaker tub. Enjoy the outside on your large deck, perfect for entertaining or al fresco dining. Turf covers your backyard, making maintenance easy. Just off the rear of the house sits a casita with a full bath for added enjoyment; whether an office or guest quarters, the options are yours. Zoned to Garden Oaks Elementary and just blocks from D'Alba, Garden Oaks Montessori, Wakefield favorites, and minutes to 610, I-10, 290, and 45.

agents.bio:
Community driven. Client focused. Trusted advisor. Ginny Ledwell and her team offer a wealth of experience in the Houston Residential Real Estate market. Consistently a top producer as a full service broker and owner of Led Well Realty, she offers her clients: an energetic personality, powerful negotiation talents, excellent communication skills, and a solid knowledge of the market. 

On the buying side, she uses her go-getting personality, attention to detail, and extensive research skills to assist buyers in the task of finding their dream home. On the selling side, she uses her extensive writing skills to create verbiage for marketing campaigns that appeal to all types of buyers while using adept skills in technology to market properties via social media and websites. Additionally, she has an uncanny ability to assist any seller in staging their home to sell for the highest price. Her clients become like family throughout the transaction. As expressed by a former client, “Ginny has a genuine vibe about her that really makes you feel that she sincerely cares about your best interests.”

Ginny is a proud graduate of Texas A&M University with a BA in English and Spanish and a MA from Sam Houston State University in Educational Administration.

She stays involved in her community by volunteering at and sponsoring several organizations, including: The Junior League of Houston; Animal Justice League; Child Advocates; First Baptist Church; Garden Oaks Montessori; Durham & Stevens Elementary as well as several other HISD school. She is an active member of the PTA at her son’s school. She also founded The Oaks Women’s Group in the Oak Forest/Gardens Oaks area. She is blessed with two beautiful children, a loving husband, and two exuberant rescue dogs-Dixie and Duke. In her spare time, she enjoys spending time with family and friends, perusing home design & decor magazines, and exercising. She has called the Garden Oaks/Oak Forest community “home” since 2006.

remarks:
Live where your weekends don’t need planning!

Set in the heart of Koreatown, this home places you in one of Los Angeles’ most vibrant and connected neighborhoods. Where grabbing coffee, meeting friends for dinner, or enjoying a night out can all happen just blocks from your front door.

Located in a controlled-access building, the home includes two subterranean tandem parking spaces and offers the ease of city living without sacrificing comfort.

Inside, this home has a unique two story floor plan with no one above. The spacious open-concept layout creates an inviting place to gather, whether entertaining around the kitchen peninsula or relaxing fireside in the living room. Laminate flooring carries throughout the home, creating a cohesive and low-maintenance living space. Both bedrooms are on the second floor and offer generous amount of space, complemented by two full bathrooms. An added plus is the in-unit laundry.

Beyond the home, enjoy easy access to grocery stores, transit options, major commuter routes, and nearby destinations including Downtown LA, Hollywood, and Mid-Wilshire. Urban convenience, neighborhood energy, and a location that keeps your options open; this is Los Angeles living with everything close to home.

agents.bio:
Committed to unparalleled client service, Jeff Fisher believes in the highest level of customer satisfaction. It is this mission statement that embodies his professional real estate practice and how he approaches his business every day.

With over $610,000,000 in sales and 19 years of local real estate experience, Jeff has been consistently recognized among the top listing and selling agents in the San Gabriel Valley. In 2014, he was named as one of the top two hundred Real Estate Agents in the San Gabriel Valley by Pasadena Magazine. In addition, Jeff is the recipient of Berkshire Hathaway Home Service's (BHHS) prestigious Chairman's Circle Platinum Award, which includes the top 1% of all BHHS Real Estate Agents nationwide. In 2015, Jeff was designated to Berkshire Hathaway Homes Services Luxury Collection Division, consistently selling homes more than $2M.

Jeff also represents BHHS's Corporate Relocation Department who is affiliated with numerous local companies bringing in corporate executives to the area. (Union Bank, Disney, JPL, Cal Tech, Dine Equity & Kaiser, just to name a few).

Jeff specializes in the marketing and sales of residential properties in Pasadena, Altadena, San Marino, La Cañada, South Pasadena, Sierra Madre, Monrovia, Arcadia, and the greater San Gabriel Valley. His commitment to his clients and their goals, evidenced by consistent communication and follow-up, in concert with strong negotiation skills, comprehensive upscale local, national, & international marketing, and a proven record, have led to a long list of satisfied clients and a steady source of referrals and repeat business.

As a longtime resident in Pasadena and real estate expert in the San Gabriel Valley, Jeff provides local knowledge and valuable information about the area and goes into detail on why Pasadena area living is truly something to be desired. With a professional yet friendly approach, Jeff helps clients feel completely at ease from the very beginning to the closing of the sale with the goal to exceed his client's high expectations.

With over 10 years of luxury retail experience, Eric Kim has been able to earn the trust of his clients, delivered results, and driven for high standards. In addition to his experience in luxury retail, Eric’s background in logistics management has strengthened his planning, deep diving, and execution skills. His affinity for real estate began early on, motivated by his own pursuit of the American Dream. Licensed in 2021, he now gets to combine his passion for real estate and helping others at a professional level.

My real estate superpower is: I provide a wealth of knowledge to my clients, and I also foster a comfortable and organic buying and selling experience. 

When I’m not selling homes: I love to take on DIY home projects and try new and different restaurants.

remarks:
Spacious Traditional Home in Established Sageglen Community!

This impressive two-story traditional brick home in the established Sageglen community offers 3,245 square feet of living space on an oversized 11,115-square-foot lot. Designed for comfort and entertaining, the main level features two expansive living areas, a dedicated home office, formal dining space, a wet bar, a functional central kitchen, a half bath, and a gas fireplace anchoring the primary living area. Upstairs, you will find four generous bedrooms and two full bathrooms, complete with two spacious walk-in closets. Outside, the property features a covered breezeway patio opening to a huge backyard, along with a rare parking layout that includes a 3-car detached garage, a 3-car covered carport, and an extended driveway.

So many thing that I enjoyed but didn't know how to start making a career of it as I became an adult. I had a conversation with a stranger turned friend years later that I met in a hotel conference room that I over heard them talking about real estate investing. It peaked my interest almost immediately to the point I joined the conversation on my own. After exchanging numbers with one of my future mentors I realized I knew nothing about how to become a home owner although I am one and even less about investing in real estate. With over 10 years of sales experience, she is seasoned and confident to provide every buyer a fantastic home buying experience. She thoroughly enjoys the home hunting process and considers many of her clients, friends. Vianey specializes as a buyers agent working with first time and repeat buyers to find the home that fits their needs and wants. She also helps investors to grow and manage their portfolios. With a passion for home design and interiors, Vianey offers a Free Staging Consultation to all clients. She can help you make your house a home. If you are in need of an experienced Real Estate Professional to guide you through the home buying process please give her a call today!

Luis Nieto is a strategic and solutions-driven real estate professional serving Houston and its thriving southeast communities, including Friendswood, Clear Lake, League City, and Pearland. With a sharp analytical approach and a deep understanding of market trends, Luis specializes in positioning properties for success and helping clients make confident, data-informed decisions.

His expertise lies in running detailed market analyses, optimizing pricing strategies, and identifying opportunities that maximize value for both homeowners and investors. Known for his efficiency and results-oriented mindset, Luis approaches every transaction with precision—ensuring properties are competitively positioned and do not linger on the market. Whether guiding families toward homeownership or helping investors achieve strong returns, he is committed to delivering outcomes that align with his clients’ goals.

What sets Luis apart is his unwavering belief in solutions. He approaches every challenge with a proactive mindset, focusing on strategy, adaptability, and execution. Working closely alongside his wife, also in real estate, he offers a collaborative and elevated client experience that prioritizes communication, responsiveness, and seamless service from start to finish.

Originally from Mexico, Luis brings a strong appreciation for Houston’s diversity and vibrant culture, which fuels his passion for helping clients find their place within it. Outside of real estate, he enjoys exploring the city’s dynamic food scene and local restaurants. Luis is dedicated to going above and beyond for every client, providing expert guidance and ensuring a successful experience in the Houston and Southeast real estate market.

remarks: Welcome home to the "Artemis" by Saratoga Home, a stunning 3-bedroom, 2-bath new construction in the sought-after Eagle Landing community. Inside, a generous family area with backyard access anchors the 1st floor, alongside the spacious primary suite. The primary bedroom features an en-suite bath with a standing shower, and his-and-her walk-in closets, while a convenient utility room completes the level. Upstairs, the 2nd floor opens into an open-concept living and dining area anchored by a kitchen with a beautiful center island with breakfast seating. Two secondary bedrooms offer plenty of space, with one enjoying direct access to the private covered balcony, and share a second full bath featuring a tub/shower combo and dual vanity sinks. Outside, a 2-car garage rounds out the home. Beyond your front door, Eagle Landing delivers resort-style living with a clubhouse, playgrounds, a pool, lake access, and a dog park. And with Hwy 45 just 2 minutes away, you're perfectly positioned.

agents.bio: Starting his second year of his career in real estate on a team, was an excellent choice looking back. He immediately was thrown into the real estate market and forced to learn the right way by putting the clients first. He brings a very particular perspective on real estate, as he also is the Owner and Founder of Legacy Preferred Lending (Hard Money Fix/Flip Loans) as well as Legacy Premier Title company.  His brand was maximized by leveraging his business using the eXp Real Estate Model, being one of only two 10X Icon Award recipients of eXp realty’s most prestigious award. The training and collaboration they offer at eXp launched the second part of his career into new levels by using their technology and CRM systems to put his business on autopilot. Jeff has built a very sophisticated AI platform using Claude, Gpt, and Anthropic, ensuring his team stays ahead of the many AI platforms to be able to serve his clients at a very high level. They are investor heavy on the transaction side and eXp allows them to leverage out the ins and outs of the deals to focus on finding new deals for their investors, selling luxury homes, and navigating the buying process throughout Texas.

remarks: Welcome to this well-maintained home in the heart of Clear Lake City, offering a thoughtful floor plan and numerous updates. The main level features a formal dining room and inviting kitchen with a great corner window and convenient ledge, bringing in natural light. Double-pane windows downstairs add to the home's efficiency and comfort. The spacious primary suite includes an oversized walk-in shower with grab bars for added convenience. Upstairs, you'll find a versatile game room, three secondary bedrooms, and a bath with double sinks. Enjoy the oversized backyard with a Sunsetter awning—perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Additional highlights include a recent roof, tankless water heater, PEX plumbing installed in 2018, whole-house generator, durable Hardiplank siding, wet bar, and a garage with workbench. A wonderful opportunity to enjoy the comfort, space, and convenience of Clear Lake City!

remarks: Charming 1940 Colonial-style home in established Lindale Park featuring 2 bedrooms, 2 full baths, and 1,702 SF on a 6,175 SF lot. Mature shade trees and a covered front porch provide inviting curb appeal. Interior includes a spacious living room, dining room, den, breakfast area, home office/study, sunroom, and kitchen with gas cooktop, electric oven, microwave, and dishwasher. Features include crown molding and wood, laminate, and carpet flooring. Fenced backyard offers mature trees, patio space, and a large, covered carport. Metal roof, pier-and-beam foundation, central HVAC, and public water and sewer. Excellent opportunity for remodeling, renovation, or potential teardown and new construction. Convenient Northside location with easy access to The Heights, Downtown Houston, dining, shopping, and major thoroughfares.

agents.bio: The Wendy Cline Properties Group specializes in luxury, equestrian, farm and ranch, new home sales and residential real estate. Professional resources allow us to offer comprehensive plans for clients looking to invest in both residential and commercial ventures. At WCP, we strive to provide the best service and obtain maximal results for all clients. Relationships, such as the ones we develop with our clients, are strongest when built with integrity, respect and good communication. To showcase our properties, we utilize a multi-tiered communication and marketing approach, publishing only the best photographs and most complete and captivating content possible. We know that selling a property is a combination of emotional and logical factors and that you must speak to both. Wendy, an area resident with an equestrian background, is an expert in horse properties of all kinds. As a Broker and Realtor®, Wendy has the experience and expertise to assist both buyers and sellers in all situations and at any price point. Her award-winning team has been ranked for the past 4 consecutive years by the Houston Business Journal, both in volume and in size of transaction. Wendy has attained the coveted Million Dollar Guild Member status in the Institute for Luxury Home Marketing and she is additionally certified as a Senior Real Estate Specialist, Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist and an Accredited Buyers Representative.

agents.bio:
As a Texas Realtor with eight years of experience, I’ve built my business on faith, family, and taking care of people the way real estate has always been done — with heart. I am the Co-Owner and Team Lead of the Got Keys Realty Team, where I guide a growing team of dedicated agents and proudly serve buyers and sellers across the Houston area and the Rio Grande Valley.

I specialize in new-construction homes, owner-financing programs, and helping first-time buyers feel confident every step of the way. Whether you’re upgrading, relocating, investing, or finally ready to say “yes” to homeownership, my goal is simple: make the process smooth, clear, and exciting for you.

My marketing is modern, my negotiation style is strong, and my outlook is traditional — every client deserves respect, honesty, and results. With hundreds of successful closings, a strong presence in my community, and leadership roles including Past President of NAHREP North Houston, I’m proud to serve at the highest level.

If you’re looking for a Realtor who will show up, communicate, and treat your goals like her own…I’m ready when you are. Let’s get you home.

Carrie Nelson, originally from Teague, Texas, grew up in Deer Park and has called the Clear Lake area home for the past 25 years.

Her career began in early childhood education, where she taught at a Christian preschool before transitioning into management with a UK-based oil and gas company. It was during this time that she adopted her guiding philosophy: every problem is simply an opportunity to find a solution. This perspective has become a cornerstone of her success in real estate.

Known for her exceptional attention to detail, Carrie takes pride in guiding clients through every step of the buying and selling process. Her hands-on approach ensures clients feel informed, confident, and comfortable with their decisions. Whether assisting first-time buyers, seasoned investors, or families preparing to sell, Carrie provides personalized service tailored to each client’s needs.

Carrie’s dedication is rooted in her values of honesty, trustworthiness, and loyalty. Her genuine passion for helping people shines through in her commitment to delivering seamless transactions and positive experiences.

Outside of real estate, Carrie has been happily married for 35 years. She and her husband are proud parents of five children and delight in spending time with their six grandchildren.

A true professional in the world of real estate, Gwen Key Willis works diligently. Dedication to her career is evident in her constant drive to learn and grow in a dynamic field where her journey to becoming a realtor led her to the successful broker she is today.

Encouraged by her husband, Gwen obtained a broker’s license and opened Key Realtors in 2008. It was time to reinvest the money she handed over to the first agency, in herself. As a broker, Gwen thrives on helping her agents to be successful in reaching their own goals and has tripled her number of agents. Her insight and encouragement ensure that the agency helps as many clients as possible. As a team, they’ve made Key Realtors a community resource where everyone is welcome to ask questions and learn about real estate.

When she is not with clients or volunteering, she enjoys being outdoors and spending time with family on her property near Lake Limestone. She loves being surrounded by her husband, children, and grandchildren just relaxing on what will one day be a place to retire.

My background as a registered nurse instilled in me honesty, compassion, and a deep commitment to caring — qualities I now bring into my real estate practice. I’m passionate about helping people achieve their real estate dreams and providing an honest, supportive experience that’s better than the one I personally encountered.

agents.bio:
Mayda Salgado is a Houston-based real estate advisor with nearly two decades of local insight and a background rooted in business strategy, branding, and value creation. Originally from the Rio Grande Valley, Mayda has called Houston home for almost 20 years, primarily in the Rice Village, Museum District, and surrounding neighborhoods she knows intimately.

With a degree in Business Administration, Mayda began her career in corporate communications, marketing, and mergers & acquisitions for a Fortune 500 building materials company. She later co-founded and scaled an international women’s jewelry and fashion accessories brand, successfully exiting the business in 2012. Her professional experience also includes over eight years working with a prominent Houston nonprofit, supporting underprivileged women and children across Harris County, an experience that continues to shape her people-first, service-driven approach.

Guided by a passion for architecture, interiors, and the meaning of “home,” Mayda has personally designed and built several residences in Houston. This hands-on experience allows her to advise clients beyond the transaction—helping buyers, sellers, and investors identify potential, maximize value, and make confident, well-informed decisions. She works with both end users and investors, offering guidance on renovation strategy, short sales, and long-term real estate investments.

As a real estate advisor with New Leaf Real Estate, Mayda is known for her thoughtful, detail-oriented approach and her commitment to building lasting client relationships. She serves a diverse clientele across Houston, South Texas, and international markets, including Mexico. Fully bilingual and of Mexican heritage, she is especially attuned to the needs of Houston’s Hispanic community and cross-border buyers.

agents.bio:
Licensed since 2012, Julie Wells is a dedicated real estate professional serving the Greater Houston and Galveston markets. She is known for her expertise, strategic approach, and passion for helping clients navigate their real estate journeys. Specializing in residential sales and rentals, Julie combines in-depth market knowledge, strong negotiation skills, and a client-first mindset to deliver seamless and successful transactions.

Julie’s background as a small business owner and real estate investor gives her a unique edge in the industry, equipping her with strong problem-solving abilities and a keen eye for market trends. Her extensive list of professional designations—including ABR, MRPSA, SRS, CNE, RSPS, CLHS, AWREP, MRP, and PSA—demonstrates her commitment to ongoing education and excellence in real estate. Whether assisting first-time homebuyers, seasoned investors, or those seeking luxury properties, Julie provides tailored strategies and expert guidance to ensure her clients make well-informed decisions.

Beyond real estate, Julie is deeply involved in her community, volunteering with Houston Food Bank, Habitat for Humanity, and the Breast Cancer Walk. A proud Houston native, she appreciates the city’s diverse culture, vibrant dining scene, and world-class shopping. When she’s not helping clients find their dream homes, you’ll likely find her soaking up the sun at the beach—her favorite place to unwind.

Whether buying, selling, or investing, Julie Wells is committed to delivering an exceptional real estate experience built on trust, expertise, and personalized service.

With a deep knowledge of Houston’s most desirable waterfront communities, Nichelle Richards is a trusted guide for clients looking to relocate, invest, or upgrade their lifestyle along the Gulf Coast. She specializes in Seabrook, Clear Lake, Kemah, and Galveston, helping buyers find homes that match their vision—whether it’s a waterfront retreat, a luxury second home, or a lucrative investment property.


Nichelle’s approach is built on listening, educating, and empowering her clients. As a Seller Representation Specialist, Certified Negotiation Expert, and Resort & Second Home Property Specialist, she provides data-driven market insights, strategic advice, and a seamless transaction experience. Drawing from her own experiences as both a buyer and seller, she offers firsthand knowledge that makes her guidance relatable, transparent, and effective.


Clients describe Nichelle as detail-oriented, communicative, and deeply invested in their success. She takes pride in building long-term relationships, ensuring every client feels supported, informed, and confident throughout the process. Her mission? To turn real estate dreams into reality while delivering a smooth, stress-free experience.


Living in the coastal suburb of Seabrook, Nichelle enjoys the very lifestyle she helps her clients achieve. When she’s not working, you’ll find her exploring the waterfront, discovering new restaurants, or capturing photos of her toy poodle, Louie Loo (@life.of.louie.loo). Having purchased her first home at just 19, she understands the transformative power of homeownership and loves sharing this passion with her clients.


Whether you’re looking to invest, relocate, or find your dream home by the water, Nichelle Richards is ready to guide you with expertise, enthusiasm, and a personal touch.

Her community passion is evident not only in her professional life but also in her service to her community.

That relentless drive ultimately led him to real estate, an industry where dedication, expertise, and work ethic directly impact results.

Today, Ced has built a reputation as one of the Houston area's premier real estate advisors, closing more than 300 transactions and facilitating over $85 million in real estate sales volume. His success is rooted in a simple philosophy: put people first, deliver exceptional service, and create results that change lives.

Clients quickly recognize that Ced's approach is different. His leadership style is authentic, hands-on, and unwaveringly focused on helping buyers, sellers, and investors achieve their goals. Whether guiding a first-time homebuyer, negotiating a luxury home purchase, or helping investors maximize returns, Ced brings the same level of commitment, transparency, and strategic expertise to every transaction.

Ced Attended Abilene Christian University for 3 years but earned his Bachelor's degree in Communications and MBA from Texas Southern University, Ced combines education, innovation, and market expertise to provide clients with a competitive advantage. Ced has also been featured at numerous speaking engagements throughout Houston, sharing his expertise on real estate, entrepreneurship, branding, and business development.

As Founder of the Reserve Realty Group, brokered by Legacy Homes & Properties, Ced leads a team dedicated to delivering a world-class real estate experience. Through personalized service, cutting-edge marketing, advanced technology, and in-depth market knowledge, the team helps clients confidently navigate one of the most important financial decisions of their lives.

For Ced, real estate is about more than buying and selling homes—it's about building relationships, creating wealth, and helping families establish lasting legacies.

remarks:
Welcome to 5419 S. Rimpau Blvd- Zoned R2. in the View Park/Windsor Hills area.

The home features a new roof, new HVAC system, upgraded electrical panel, copper plumbing, tankless water heater, recessed lighting, new flooring, interior doors, fixtures, and hardware, providing modern comfort and peace of mind. The exterior has also been refreshed with a smooth stucco finish and a landscaped front yard with a sprinkler system. A spacious 2-car garage completes the property. Beautifully renovated and thoughtfully designed, this 3-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers 1,572 square feet of modern living space on an approximately 6,903-square-foot lot. From the moment you arrive, the home's fresh exterior, landscaped front yard, and inviting curb appeal set the tone for what awaits inside.- Step into a welcoming interior filled with natural light. The warm living room features new windows, and cozy fireplace which flows seamlessly into the beautifully remodeled kitchen, new appliances, generous cabinetry, modern finishes, and plenty of space for everyday living. All three bedrooms are generously sized, while the remodeled bathrooms feature stylish finishes, including a beautifully designed primary bath with a double-sink vanity.

The generous rear yard and R2 zoning add another exciting dimension to this property. With approximately 6,903 square feet of land, the backyard offers a blank canvas for creating an exceptional outdoor living space while providing potential for future expansion, an ADU, or additional residential development, subject to City verification. Whether you're looking for a beautifully renovated home, additional living space, or an investment opportunity with future possibilities, this property offers flexibility that is increasingly difficult to find.

Ideally located near local parks, schools, shopping, dining, with convenient access to Culver City, Downtown Los Angeles, Inglewood, LAX, and major entertainment and employment centers. Enjoy the convenience of being within the neighborhood, with opportunities to stroll to Fresh Tribe Coffee & Juice on Slauson or the View Park Windsor Hills Library on 54th Street.

Beautifully renovated, thoughtfully upgraded, and filled with possibilities, 5419 S. Rimpau Blvd. offers the opportunity to enjoy a turnkey home today while embracing the potential of tomorrow. A MUST SEE!

Emma Perez is a dedicated and transparent Realtor® known for her exceptional negotiation, communication, resourcefulness, and integrating technology. She understands that no two transactions are the same—because each client is unique. Emma is committed to tailoring her approach to meet each client’s specific needs while making the process as smooth and stress-free as possible.

With over seven years of real estate experience, Emma has become a trusted name in the industry. Since launching her career in 2018, she has helped countless clients navigate the market with confidence. As a proud member of C21 Cornerstone, she brings extensive knowledge and passion to every client interaction. Her specialties include residential sales, fine homes & estates, trust sales, probate, divorce listings, and working with investors.

Beyond real estate, Emma is a proud wife and mom, as well as a dedicated high school boys volleyball and basketball coach. Her strong background in sports has shaped her team-first mindset and unwavering focus on achieving goals—qualities that serve her clients well in the real estate world. Deeply involved in her community, Emma proudly supports organizations such as City of Hope, St. Jude Children’s Research Hospital, local schools, veterans, and Wounded Warriors. When she's not coaching or closing deals, you’ll find her hiking local trails or expressing her creativity through painting.

Whether you're buying, selling, or navigating a complex life transition, Emma is here to guide you with heart, integrity, and results.

Let’s make your real estate goals a reality—contact Emma today!

remarks:
2104 Mozart Street is an eight-unit multifamily property built in 1993 on approximately a 10,000-square-foot lot. The property benefits from separately metered utilities, making it an attractive investment opportunity in Los Angeles's centrally located Lincoln Heights rental market in excellent conditions.
Neighborhood Overview
Located in the historic Lincoln Heights neighborhood, 2104 Mozart Street offers residents the convenience of urban living with easy access to Downtown Los Angeles, major employment centers, public transportation, and some of the city's fastest-growing cultural destinations. As one of Los Angeles' oldest neighborhoods, Lincoln Heights blends historic charm with ongoing revitalization, making it an attractive location for both long-term residents and investors. Transportation
• Minutes to Downtown Los Angeles (approximately 2–3 miles)
• Easy access to Interstate 5, Highway 110, Highway 101, and State Route 60
• Convenient access to Metro bus routes and nearby Metro A (Gold) Line stations
• Excellent commuter location for USC Medical Center, Chinatown, Arts District, and Civic Center
• Walk Score indicates a very walkable neighborhood with many daily errands accomplished on foot.
Nearby Destinations
• Keck Hospital of USC
• Los Angeles General Medical Center
• Dodger Stadium
• Chinatown
• Arts District
• Union Station
• Downtown Los Angeles
• Ernest E. Debs Regional Park
• Los Angeles State Historic Park
Lifestyle
Lincoln Heights has become one of Los Angeles' emerging neighborhoods, offering a growing collection of restaurants, breweries, cafés, neighborhood markets, and local businesses while maintaining its rich cultural heritage. Recent growth has brought new dining destinations and creative businesses, adding to the area's appeal for residents and visitors alike. Nearby public schools include:
• Griffin Avenue Elementary School
• Florence Nightingale Middle School
• Abraham Lincoln High School

As a 5th generation Houstonian, I have a deep appreciation for this city and its people. This is an exciting time to live in the Greater Houston Area, and I'm proud to be a part of it all! I've been licensed for 10 plus years and have successfully closed over 500 transactions since 2010. Although I live and work in Bellaire, I proudly serve the entire Houston market and will continue to provide exceptional service for each of my clients and my community as a whole. As your Real Estate Specialist, I promise to be your trusted resource for answers about the process of buying or selling. I will provide expertise about neighborhood features and schools and will target your home search based on your individual needs and wants. My custom innovative marketing strategies along with my strong negotiation skills are the keys to your successful transaction.

As an agent who's an expert in this local area, I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise about buying and selling real estate here. It's not the same everywhere, so you need someone you can trust for up-to-date information. I am eager to serve you. Here are some of the things I can do for you. Do you need someone who knows this area inside and out? I can work with you to find the right home at the right price for you, including all the neighborhood amenities that matter - not to mention the essential criteria you have for your ideal home. When it's time to move, you need someone who will advertise your home, show it to prospective buyers, negotiate the purchase contract, arrange to finance, oversee the inspections, handle all necessary paperwork and supervise the closing. I can take care of everything you need, from start to close. Oftentimes buyers don't visualize living in your home the way you do. I can make your home attractive to its ideal audience which can help you get top dollar. Things like staging the home, making repairs or minor improvements, or even simply painting the walls can be the difference between a home resting on the market and one that's sold fast.

agents.bio:
Val is committed to continuously participating in continuing education to ensure that she and her staff provide their clients with the most accurate, thorough & knowledgeable service possible to protect your interests & make the experience of buying or selling a home as enjoyable as possible.

For their seller clients, they have developed a 33 point comprehensive marketing system that provides clients with some very unique services for listing properties. It is unmatched in the local market! A few of the strategies include advertising your listing on over 100 local & national websites, reverse prospecting & reverse offers, and providing an immediate call tracking system for inquiries, & virtual broker open houses.

They work closely with Buyers to educate & protect them throughout the process. They analyze, not only the most recent sales activity in an area, but also complete trend reports to see the longer term history of the neighborhood's sales prices. Their goal is to negotiate a strong deal & help buyers obtain "instant equity".

Valery grew up around real estate by helping her grandparents fix up homes & re-sell and/or lease them. They also owner financed many properties to increase their returns even more, so she realized early on the power of Real Estate. She followed in her family's footsteps & was an Investor for many years before obtaining her Real Estate License in 2006, after retiring as a Health Care Executive.

She & her husband love to travel, enjoy great wine, & LOVE animals! She "gets in trouble" a lot with her husband for rescuing animals!
The team is also committed to giving back to the community. Val volunteers regularly at an Assisted Living Facility, & they donate a portion of their earned commission from every transaction to the charity of their clients' choice!

agents.bio:
Cheryl Oldweiler is an experienced and highly respected residential real estate agent based in Houston, Texas. She has been licensed since 2006 and is known for her exceptional knowledge of the local market and her ability to listed to and take care of her clients' needs. Cheryl group up in the Houston suburb of Pasadena, TX and moved to Houston proper in the late 1980s. She has a Bachelor of Business Administration in Organizational Behavior and Management from the University of Houston, which has provided her with a solid foundation for her work in real estate.

Prior to becoming a real estate agent, Cheryl worked in P.R./Corporate Communications for El Paso Corp for four years and also worked as a computer software trainer and sales rep for ExecuTrain. Her experience in these roles taught her the importance of attention to detail and negotiation skills, which have proven invaluable in her work as a real estate agent. 

Cheryl's decision to become a real estate agent was inspired by her own bad experiences when buying her first two homes. She decided to become the hard-working, knowledgeable, and honest advocate for consumers that she was missing when she bought her own homes. Her husband also pointed out that she was already helping people with real estate matters, which led her to take the plunge and become a real estate agent.

Cheryl is known for her tenacity, conscientiousness, and willingness to go above and beyond for her clients. She is hones, patient and always puts her clients' needs first. She is also a skilled marketer and never too busy to communicate.

Outside of work, Cheryl is an avid traveler and sports fan, particularly the Houston Astros and Houston Cougars. She is rarely seen without her camera. She is a member of the Houston Junior Woman's Club, which is dedicated to helping children's charities. She also serves a monthly meal at Ronald McDonald House and is a member of St. Theresa's Catholic Church Choir. She was on the founding committee of "Operation School Supplies" with the University of Houston, which collected supplies for schools in need, and has held several positions on volunteer Board of Directors. She also spent some time on the Oak Forest HOA Board. Cheryl's mother is a great inspiration to her, and she strives to live by her example of being positive, helpful, caring, and hardworking. In all aspects of her life, Cheryl strives to "show up ready to work" and "make it a great day".

Evan Compean is the founder of The Compean Group, a boutique Houston real estate team known for data-driven pricing, high-end marketing and skilled negotiation. A licensed agent since 2012 and a real estate investor since 2002, Evan has sold more than $250 million in real estate and brings a builder's and investor's eye to every home, from foundation and roof to resale value.

Areas: Houston Heights, Woodland Heights, Garden Oaks/Oak Forest, Montrose, Midtown, West University, Bellaire, Spring Branch, Pearland, Katy, Cypress and The Woodlands.

Specialties: Luxury and new construction, investment and multifamily properties, land, first-time buyers, and relocation.

Evan is also a licensed loan officer and a partner at Smart Title, so clients get guidance on financing and closing from someone who knows every step. Se habla español. With 400+ five-star reviews across Zillow, Google, Yelp and Realtor.com, The Compean Group focuses on clear communication and a smooth process from first call to closing.
