Since becoming licensed in 2020, she has helped buyers and sellers close more than $33 million in real estate across Houston’s most desirable neighborhoods, including The Greater Heights, Montrose, Rice Military, Garden Oaks, Oak Forest, Spring Branch, West University, River Oaks, and Memorial.

Monica specializes in luxury homes, first-time buyers, out-of-state relocations, corporate and medical moves, new construction, move-up buyers, and downsizing. Her industry credentials—including Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist (CLHMS), Certified Home Marketing Specialist (CHMS), Accredited Buyer Representative (ABR), and Certified New Home Specialist—reflect a high level of professional training and a commitment to exceptional client care.

Known for her strong negotiation skills, market knowledge, and personalized service, Monica offers a client-first approach that makes each transaction smooth, informed, and stress-free. Bilingual in English and Spanish and a graduate of The University of Texas at Austin, she combines local expertise with clear communication to help every client achieve their real estate goals with confidence. Whether buying or selling, clients trust Monica for her professionalism, responsiveness, and proven results in the Houston market.

Known for his strategic mindset and exceptional deal-making ability, Ali has built a reputation as a master negotiator who consistently delivers outstanding results for his clients.

Throughout his career, Ali has developed an elite track record in sales, beginning with door-to-door residential sales and advancing to high-level B2B and enterprise sales. His performance consistently ranked among the top 1% of producers, earning him multiple President’s Club awards—an honor reserved for the highest-performing professionals in enterprise and business-to-business sales.

Today, Ali brings this elite-level negotiation expertise into every real estate transaction.

Ali serves as a Delegated Supervisor at Next Trend Realty, where he helps oversee and support a growing network of 170+ real estate agents, maintaining high standards of professionalism, compliance, and service across the brokerage.

In addition to his role in real estate brokerage, Ali is also a Mortgage Loan Officer, giving his clients a powerful advantage by understanding both the real estate and financing sides of a transaction. As a long-time real estate investor, he also provides valuable insight into investment strategies, market trends, and wealth-building opportunities through real estate.

Ali specializes in:

• Luxury homes

• Investment properties
• Residential sales and purchases
• High-level negotiation and deal structuring

Whether representing homeowners, investors, or commercial clients, Ali is known for his strong advocacy, strategic negotiation, and commitment to delivering exceptional results in every transaction.

agents.bio: Moises Arteaga is a proud native Houstonian and your trusted real estate advisor, combining local insight, deep community roots, and a genuine passion for helping others. Raised in the Aldine district on Houston's northeast side, Moises grew up immersed in the city's diverse culture and was part of a nationally ranked Cross Country team, an experience that shaped his competitive spirit and commitment to excellence. Having lived and worked in some of Houston's most iconic neighborhoods, including the Heights, Memorial, and Downtown. Moises brings an intimate understanding of the city's unique character and growth. Over the past two decades, he has witnessed Houston evolve into a world-class city, rich in opportunity and innovation. From its booming job market and affordability to its signature blend of cosmopolitan energy and Southern charm, Houston continues to attract residents and investors from around the globe and Moises is proud to help them call it home. Before entering real estate, Moises spent years in Houston's high-end hospitality industry, where he cultivated a passion for service and a talent for anticipating client needs. These skills translate seamlessly into real estate, where clear communication, thoughtful guidance, and a personalized approach define his service philosophy. Whether you're buying, selling, or leasing, Moises is committed to understanding your unique needs and delivering results with professionalism, care, and integrity. His knowledge of the market, love for Houston, and unwavering dedication to client success make him the ideal partner in your real estate journey. If you're ready to explore the vibrant possibilities Houston has to offer, connect with Moises Arteaga today. He looks forward to helping you find the perfect property and community to match your lifestyle and goals.

remarks: Exceptional value in the Tanglewood/Galleria area! This spacious ground-level 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo offers a private fenced backyard—a rare combination at this price point. remarks: Timeless Victorian elegance meets modern convenience in this classic Heights single-family home. Boasting undeniable curb appeal just steps from the Heights Hike & Bike Trail, a welcoming front porch introduces classic architectural details inside—including extensive crown molding, custom window treatments, refined trim work, and rich, highly durable wood-grain tile floors throughout. She specializes in Seabrook, Clear Lake, Kemah, and Galveston, helping buyers find homes that match their vision—whether it’s a waterfront retreat, a luxury second home, or a lucrative investment property.


Nichelle’s approach is built on listening, educating, and empowering her clients. As a Seller Representation Specialist, Certified Negotiation Expert, and Resort & Second Home Property Specialist, she provides data-driven market insights, strategic advice, and a seamless transaction experience. Drawing from her own experiences as both a buyer and seller, she offers firsthand knowledge that makes her guidance relatable, transparent, and effective.


Clients describe Nichelle as detail-oriented, communicative, and deeply invested in their success. She takes pride in building long-term relationships, ensuring every client feels supported, informed, and confident throughout the process. Her mission? To turn real estate dreams into reality while delivering a smooth, stress-free experience.


Living in the coastal suburb of Seabrook, Nichelle enjoys the very lifestyle she helps her clients achieve. Ali Pourmemar is a highly accomplished real estate professional, mortgage loan officer, and long-time real estate investor with more than 30 years of sales and negotiation experience. Known for his strategic mindset and exceptional deal-making ability, Ali has built a reputation as a master negotiator who consistently delivers outstanding results for his clients.

Throughout his career, Ali has developed an elite track record in sales, beginning with door-to-door residential sales and advancing to high-level B2B and enterprise sales. His performance consistently ranked among the top 1% of producers, earning him multiple President’s Club awards—an honor reserved for the highest-performing professionals in enterprise and business-to-business sales.

Today, Ali brings this elite-level negotiation expertise into every real estate transaction.

Ali serves as a Delegated Supervisor at Next Trend Realty, where he helps oversee and support a growing network of 170+ real estate agents, maintaining high standards of professionalism, compliance, and service across the brokerage.

In addition to his role in real estate brokerage, Ali is also a Mortgage Loan Officer, giving his clients a powerful advantage by understanding both the real estate and financing sides of a transaction. As a long-time real estate investor, he also provides valuable insight into investment strategies, market trends, and wealth-building opportunities through real estate.

Ali specializes in:

• Luxury homes

• High-level negotiation and deal structuring

Whether representing homeowners, investors, or commercial clients, Ali is known for his strong advocacy, strategic negotiation, and commitment to delivering exceptional results in every transaction.

remarks: Welcome to the iconic Broadway Hollywood, an architectural masterpiece and one of Los Angeles' most coveted historic addresses, at the world-famous intersection of Hollywood & Vine! Designed by renowned architect B. Marcus Priteca and meticulously reimagined as luxury residences, this celebrated landmark seamlessly blends timeless architectural character with sophisticated, contemporary luxury living. This exceptional corner unit is bathed in natural light and features soaring ceilings, designer finishes, and a dramatic open-concept floor plan that creates a striking sense of scale while offering the flexibility of a coveted live-work lifestyle. Beyond the residence itself, ownership includes the highly sought-after Mills Act designation, providing significant property tax savings rarely found in luxury real estate. Indulge in an unrivaled collection of resort-caliber amenities, including a spectacular rooftop oasis featuring a pool, spa, private cabanas, and breathtaking views of the iconic Capitol Records Building, the Hollywood Sign, and the Hollywood Hills. Valet parking, attentive service, a fitness room, and an unmatched location complete the experience. Surrounded by premier dining, entertainment, theaters, nightlife, and some of the city's most recognizable landmarks, this is a rare opportunity to live in an extraordinary residence in one of Hollywood's most iconic and architecturally significant buildings. Gas, electricity, and water are ALL included! This unit is also available for sale!

remarks: Masterful design and modern luxury are uniquely embodied in this 5 Bed 4 Bath gem in Highland Village. 3 blocks from River Oaks shopping district and 1 block from shopping at Highland Village. 2928 Suffolk features spacious open floor plan. Wood-like tile throughout the 1st floor and engineered bamboo flooring on the 2nd. The 1st floor features 1 secondary bedroom, 1 full bath, open dining/living area with fireplace, and huge gourmet kitchen. The kitchen is outfitted with a Thermador stainless appliance package, Vicostone Quartz counters, water purification system, and walk-in pantry. The 1st floor also contains a mudroom just outside the garage. The second floor takes you to the Primary suite, 3 secondary bedrooms, and family room. The Primary suite and family room have gorgeous cathedral ceilings and large windows for tons of natural light. The Primary closet was designed with extensive wardrobes in mind, and an island! The backyard has tons of green space and full outdoor kitchen.

remarks: Set on a quiet cul-de-sac in Spring Shadows, this beautifully updated single-story offers comfort and privacy. A mature oak shades the front yard and adds to the curb appeal. Inside, the spacious living room features high ceilings and a brick fireplace and flows naturally into the remodeled kitchen with quartz counters, creating an inviting space for everyday living and gatherings. Warm wood-look tile and fresh interior paint carry through the main living areas, while secondary bedrooms feature new carpet. The secondary bath has been fully remodeled, and the primary bath refreshed with a new vanity, mirror, and lighting. Out back, the patio offers a relaxing spot for morning coffee, bird watching, or hosting. Recent improvements include AC & ductwork, double-paned windows, PEX plumbing, tankless water heater, and roof. A Tesla charger and extended attic storage are extra perks. Convenient location by a green space walking trail, with groceries, shopping, and dining just minutes away.

agents.bio: Hello, I'm Carlos, a Houstonian realtor with a passion for helping families find their dream homes. As a bilingual realtor, I'm fluent in English and Spanish, allowing me to effectively communicate with a wider range of clients and better understand their unique needs and preferences. I'm also family-oriented and understand the importance of finding a home that not only meets the practical needs of a family but also feels like a welcoming and comfortable space where memories can be made. With my years of experience in the real estate industry, I've gained a wealth of knowledge and expertise, allowing me to provide my clients with exceptional service and guidance throughout the home buying or selling process. In addition to my experience in real estate, I have a strong background in management, which has helped me develop excellent problem-solving and solution-oriented skills. Whether I'm helping a client navigate a complex real estate transaction or negotiating on their behalf, I always put my clients' needs first. I'm committed to continuing my education and staying up-to-date with the latest trends and developments in the market, ensuring that I provide my clients with the most accurate and valuable information. If you're looking for a realtor who is knowledgeable, experienced, and committed to helping you find the perfect home, look no further than me, Carlos. Contact me today to schedule a consultation and start your journey to finding your dream home.

agents.bio:
Michael is a real estate professional affiliated with Compass Real Estate in Houston, Texas, primarily serving the vibrant Heights area. Since 2009, he has built a reputation for dedication, expertise, and a deep commitment to both his clients and community.

Michael is an active member of the Houston LGBT Chamber of Commerce and The LGBTQ+ Real Estate Alliance, and he is a past president of the Women’s Council of Realtors Houston Network. His credentials include a wide range of professional designations: CRS, RSPS, CHMS, PMN, TAHS, HFR, and CIPS.

In addition to his real estate career, Michael is a passionate community leader. He is a graduate of Avenue CDC’s Advocacy Fellowship and a certified T4T Trainer through LISC’s Training for Trainers program. He is a past president of the Lindale Park Civic Club and is honored to be the FitHouston Ambassador for the Moody Park Saturday morning walking group. Michael takes pride in making a lasting impact in Lindale Park—the neighborhood he proudly calls home.

agents.bio:
He is very knowledgeable about the nuances in many neighborhoods throughout Houston, which strengthens his ability to help people relocating to Houston from other cities. David's primary concern is satisfying his clients, because satisfied clients generate repeat business and referrals. 

A native Houstonian, David graduated from Memorial High School in 1980 and received a BA in finance from the University of Texas at Austin in 1984. He traveled internationally after college, then moved to California, where he cultivated a diverse management background, including two years in residential mortgage brokerage, nine years in international trade management, and six years in enterprise software sales management. 

David returned to Houston in 2001, obtained his real estate license, and joined his father, David H Young, in residential real estate sales. In January 2005, they started the David Young Team, bringing together top-producing agents and experienced assistants to provide the highest quality service to buyers and sellers of residential real estate. They were recognized for 12 years by the Houston Business Journal as one of the Top 5 Teams in Houston, with sales volume over $100,000,000 per year.

David joined Compass in October 2020, where he has operated as Young Realty Group - a small team of agents and a licensed assistant with them since 2014. ?On a personal level, David's wife Brenda and he are very active in animal rescue. She established Save A Purrfect Cat Rescue many years ago and they, along with an army of volunteers, find homes for 250-300 cats yearly. To keep fit he has practiced Tae Kwon Do since the 1990s and has been a member of the Houstonian Club since 2007. He also relieves stress by banging on his drum set.

remarks: A rare opportunity to own & reimagine a historically significant Craftsman cottage in Houston’s coveted Woodland Heights. Situated on an impressive 9,362 SF lot, this 1,586 SF architectural gem is filled with authentic character. An inviting front porch with beautifully detailed columns sets the tone for the home’s authentic period features. Inside, discover original pine flooring, charming wood windows, soaring beamed ceilings in the living/dine rooms & a wood-burning fireplace framed by bookcases. Rich with architectural character & ready for renovation, this special property offers an exceptional opportunity to restore a classic Craftsman while thoughtfully incorporating today’s comforts. The oversized lot provides additional possibilities for expansion or future improvements. For the buyer with vision & an appreciation for historic architecture, this inspiring Woodland Heights cottage presents the chance to preserve a piece of Houston history & create something truly extraordinary.

agents.bio: Jessica Escamilla anticipates her client's needs and takes pride in matching them with the best possible home and the best location for their particular lifestyle. She has worked with Cartus, Graebel, and Crown World Mobility, just to name a few relocation organizations. In addition, she is a USAA and NFCU trained agent, as her father served in the US Air Force. Military families are very special to her, and she understands the challenges that come with that. She prides herself on working with clients from all over the world. The Houston Association of Realtors offers an array of information for international buyers. Serving on the Global Advisory Group for the Houston Association and the Texas Realtor Global Committee has added experience and knowledge that allows her to better assist clients who may come from anywhere in the world. Homeownership is a lifetime dream for all, not just a few!

remarks: Strikingly transformed and fully remodeled, 5946 Valkeith Drive delivers sophisticated, move-in-ready living to Houston’s Maplewood South. Beautiful white oak style luxury vinyl plank flooring and recessed lighting flow seamlessly through the open-concept layout, where a painted brick fireplace warms the living area. The kitchen transitions into the dining area, featuring crisp white shaker cabinetry, matte black hardware, and brand-new stainless steel appliances with a built-in oven. A sliding barn door reveals a dedicated home office, offering the ultimate work-from-home setup. The primary suite pairs an elegant en-suite bath with a deluxe oversized shower and expansive storage, while each secondary bedroom includes its own generous closet space. Showcasing contemporary finishes across both bathrooms, this pristine home balances modern interior flair with a classic neighborhood aesthetic.

agents.bio:
Charlie Bingham is a distinguished REALTOR® specializing in the Greater Houston market. Renowned for his exceptional negotiation skills and meticulous attention to detail, Charlie ensures that every client receives unparalleled service tailored to their unique needs. His client-centric approach is rooted in a deep understanding of the real estate process, supported by his extensive background in hospitality management.

Charlie’s expertise encompasses investment properties and renovation projects, making him a valuable advisor for clients at any price point. His commitment to open communication keeps clients well-informed and confident throughout their real estate journey. Fluent in French, Charlie adeptly assists French-speaking clients and other expatriates, simplifying their transition to Houston.

An active community member, Charlie serves as the President of the Crestwood Civic Club, volunteers at the Houston Food Bank, contributes to a Rodeo Committee, and is a member of the Memorial Park Advisory Board.

Outside of real estate, Charlie enjoys cultural events, padel, and pickleball. He is happily married, with two daughters and a Pomeranian dog.

Charlie Bingham’s dedication to excellence and his profound understanding of the Houston real estate market make him an outstanding choice for clients seeking an authentic and trustworthy REALTOR®.

Nicholas "Nick" Chambers, CRS, RSPS, CIPS

Nicholas "Nick" Chambers is a Broker Associate with Realty of America (ROA) and founder of Chambers Properties Group, serving homeowners, buyers, investors, and relocation clients throughout Houston and the Greater Houston area.

With more than 17 years of experience in Texas real estate, Nick helps clients make informed decisions through strategic planning, market analysis, and data-driven pricing rather than sales pressure. His advisory approach is built around protecting equity, reducing risk, and creating clear decision paths during significant life transitions.

Nick works with clients buying or selling primary residences, luxury homes, new construction, relocation properties, and select investment real estate throughout Houston's diverse neighborhoods. Every recommendation is tailored to current market conditions, local buyer behavior, inventory levels, and each client's goals and timeline.

Rather than treating real estate as a transaction, Nick approaches every property as a financial asset. Sellers receive guidance on pricing strategy, property preparation, market positioning, and negotiation. Buyers benefit from objective market analysis, competitive offer strategy, and clear advice on when to move forward—or when patience creates a stronger opportunity.

Core Services:
• Residential listing representation
• Strategic home selling and pricing analysis
• Buyer representation and negotiation
• Luxury real estate advisory
• Relocation services
• New construction guidance
• Investment property acquisition and disposition
• Comparative Market Analysis (CMA)
• Home value evaluations

- Areas Served - 
Chambers Properties Group serves clients throughout the Greater Houston region, including:

River Oaks • Memorial • West University • Bellaire • The Heights • Rice Military • Timbergrove • Oak Forest • Cypress • Bridgeland • Towne Lake • Katy • Energy Corridor • Sugar Land • Spring • Tomball • The Woodlands and surrounding communities.

- The Advisory Process -

Every client engagement begins with understanding three questions:
• What are you trying to accomplish?
• What constraints or risks should we account for?
• What strategy creates the strongest long-term outcome?

From there, recommendations are based on market data, pricing trends, buyer demand, and proven execution—not assumptions or one-size-fits-all solutions.

Clients appreciate Nick's ability to simplify complex market information into practical guidance, helping them move forward with confidence from the initial consultation through closing.

agents.bio:
Houston has been Joan's home for over 21 years and she is proud to be called a Houstonian. Raising a family of four in Houston, Joan learned early that the right home can be the heart and hub of a family. Personal service, discretion and candor are keys to her success, whether you are selling your home, relocating to Houston or looking for a new place to land. Her drive and interest in real estate grows out of a desire to find the perfect property that is a reflection of the style and individuality of her clients.

She began in real estate renovating houses and building homes in and around Houston. She knew then that she was committed to the business and soon she had her real estate and then brokerage license. Joan’s entrepreneurial spirit continued and she started a boutique brokerage company. Her fresh set of eyes on Houston neighborhoods gives her the ability to recognize the possibilities in all corners of our city. Her success is driven by her philosophy of focusing on the quality of relationships over quantity. Her reputation of honest, active, informed and accountable representation has been the core of her relationship with clients. She continues to follow these core values and is honored to have loyal, repeat clients and referrals.

You will find her involved in the improvement of our parks and the expansion of recreational paths in the City. She has spent hours winding through the trails and parks of Houston and the surrounding areas which affords her a unique perspective on neighborhoods and maximizes her knowledge and expertise of the Bayou City. Chappell Hill serves as a second home base for the Bremner family, along with their 2 dogs, 4 horses, 1 cat and 12 cows.

agents.bio:
Brooks Ballard is a seasoned real estate visionary and the driving force behind Brooks Ballard International Real Estate. With over 25 years of experience in the luxury real estate market, Brooks is recognized for delivering world-class service, market expertise, and results-driven strategies to discerning clients across Houston, Texas, and globally.

As a trusted name in luxury real estate, Brooks has built his reputation on integrity, innovation, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. He has successfully represented high-profile buyers, sellers, investors, and developers in some of the most prestigious neighborhoods, including River Oaks, Memorial, The Heights, West University, and Tanglewood.

Brooks’ firm is more than a brokerage—it’s a concierge-style real estate experience. His team specializes in luxury listings, international marketing, relocation services, new construction, and high-end property management. With a global network and a deep understanding of both local and international markets, Brooks delivers personalized strategies that help clients maximize their investments and lifestyle goals.

As a former affiliate of Engel & Völkers, Brooks brings European sophistication and global marketing reach combined with Texas-sized hospitality. Whether you're buying your dream home, selling a signature estate, or exploring investment opportunities, Brooks Ballard International Real Estate offers a seamless and strategic approach backed by unparalleled service and discretion.

Jane Thomas is a Houston real estate advisor with Brooks Ballard International Real Estate, specializing in luxury homes, residential real estate, and waterfront properties throughout the Greater Houston area. She serves buyers and sellers in the Memorial Villages, River Oaks, the Houston Heights, Spring Branch, Seabrook, Clear Lake, and surrounding communities.

Originally from Lafayette, Louisiana, Jane graduated from Louisiana State University and has called Houston home for many years. Her local knowledge, personal approach, and strong understanding of Houston’s diverse neighborhoods allow her to guide clients through each step of the buying and selling process with confidence.

Jane is known for providing thoughtful advice, responsive communication, strategic marketing, and skilled negotiation. Whether preparing a luxury property for the market, helping a family relocate to Houston, identifying a home’s hidden potential, or navigating a complicated transaction, she remains focused on protecting her clients’ interests and achieving the best possible outcome.

As a Houston resident, mother, and active member of her community, Jane offers clients more than market statistics. She provides firsthand insight into Houston neighborhoods, schools, lifestyle, commute considerations, and the qualities that make each community distinctive.

Contact Jane Thomas for assistance buying or selling a home in Houston, the Memorial Villages, River Oaks, the Heights, Spring Branch, Seabrook, Clear Lake, or the surrounding Houston area.

agents.bio:
Shannon brings a wealth of financial expertise and a deep love for Los Angeles’ Eastside communities to her career in real estate. A longtime resident of Atwater Village, Shannon pairs her professional background in corporate finance with her hands-on experience in residential renovation to offer clients both strategic insight and personal guidance.

A graduate of Westfield State University in Massachusetts, where she earned her B.S. in Business, Shannon went on to spend over 14 years building an impressive career in Corporate America. She held leadership roles as an Accounting Manager at Mellon Financial and Colony Capital—a private real estate investment firm—before moving into senior positions with Pacific Financial Research and ultimately serving as Assistant Vice President at U.S. Bancorp Fund Services.

Her passion for real estate grew organically while managing multiple home renovation projects in Atwater Village, where she combined her financial acumen with a keen eye for design and value. This hands-on experience inspired her to transition into real estate full-time, pursuing her dream of becoming a REALTOR®.

Today, Shannon leverages her rare blend of financial expertise, project management skills, and neighborhood knowledge to guide clients through every stage of the buying and selling process. Her clients value her professionalism, attention to detail, and dedication to helping them make confident, informed decisions in one of life’s most important investments.

Moises Arteaga is a proud native Houstonian and your trusted real estate advisor, combining local insight, deep community roots, and a genuine passion for helping others. Raised in the Aldine district on Houston's northeast side, Moises grew up immersed in the city's diverse culture and was part of a nationally ranked Cross Country team, an experience that shaped his competitive spirit and commitment to excellence. Having lived and worked in some of Houston's most iconic neighborhoods, including the Heights, Memorial, and Downtown. Moises brings an intimate understanding of the city's unique character and growth. Over the past two decades, he has witnessed Houston evolve into a world-class city, rich in opportunity and innovation. From its booming job market and affordability to its signature blend of cosmopolitan energy and Southern charm, Houston continues to attract residents and investors from around the globe and Moises is proud to help them call it home. Before entering real estate, Moises spent years in Houston's high-end hospitality industry, where he cultivated a passion for service and a talent for anticipating client needs. These skills translate seamlessly into real estate, where clear communication, thoughtful guidance, and a personalized approach define his service philosophy. Whether you're buying, selling, or leasing, Moises is committed to understanding your unique needs and delivering results with professionalism, care, and integrity. His knowledge of the market, love for Houston, and unwavering dedication to client success make him the ideal partner in your real estate journey. If you're ready to explore the vibrant possibilities Houston has to offer, connect with Moises Arteaga today. He looks forward to helping you find the perfect property and community to match your lifestyle and goals.

agents.bio:
Westside LA Real Estate Expert.

A Santa Monica native, Jessica Abbott has a deep and comprehensive understanding of the Los Angeles market. Living in many vibrant pockets and neighborhoods throughout the city, she has valuable firsthand insight into the communities and nuances that make each area unique and how that translates to what clients are looking for.
 
With a successful career in fashion, e-commerce, and luxury, Jessica brings a unique perspective to real estate. She has a keen eye for design, curation, merchandising, and branding and has leveraged these skills to excel in interior design and home remodeling.
 
Born and raised in Santa Monica, Jessica “Jess” Abbott, Westside Native, brings a distinctly local perspective to Los Angeles luxury real estate. Partnered with Christie’s International Real Estate SoCal, she combines homegrown Westside intelligence with the global reach of the world’s most respected luxury real estate brand.

For Jess, local knowledge is not a slogan—it is memory, pattern recognition, and context applied block by block to every property conversation. Her approach prioritizes the block before the bedroom count, the light before the finishes, and the long-term value beyond today’s market.

Before entering real estate, Jess built a successful career across luxury, fashion, and e-com, developing a sophisticated understanding of branding, visual storytelling, and consumer psychology. She later expanded that foundation through interior design, modern remodeling, and new construction consulting, giving her a highly refined editorial eye for property, positioning, and value.

Whether helping a buyer recognize the potential of an off-market Mar Vista property or preparing a timeless Venice compound for market, Jess sees opportunity in details others may overlook.

As a lifelong Westsider, she brings an intimate understanding of the communities that shape Los Angeles—from Santa Monica, Brentwood, Mar Vista, Venice, and Beverly Hills to the city’s broader luxury enclaves. Her clients rely on her not simply for market data, but for perspective: what makes a property special, what may be overlooked, and what will continue to matter long after the transaction closes.

For sellers, that perspective translates into thoughtful positioning, compelling storytelling, and a deep understanding of how discerning buyers experience a property. For buyers, it means looking beyond finishes and square footage to understand context, livability, potential, and long-term value.

Jess pairs this creative intuition with disciplined strategy and formidable negotiation, approaching every client’s interests with quiet confidence and an uncompromising commitment to protecting their assets.

From legacy estates to architectural enclaves, Jess brings refined taste, strategic thinking, unmistakable L.A. style, and distinctly Westside intelligence to every transaction.

She doesn’t simply sell Westside homes—she interprets them

Chris Charboneau brings more than 28 years of real estate experience, more than $550 million in career sales volume, and over 850 completed transactions. A recipient of numerous Top Producer awards, Chris has built his career helping buyers and sellers throughout the Houston area with a combination of market knowledge, strategic marketing, and experienced guidance.

He earned both his Marketing degree and MBA from Texas Tech University and has extensive experience in both Houston’s Inner Loop and suburban markets. Having lived in both areas, with an office in the Rice Village area, Chris offers a valuable perspective to clients moving across Houston. He has helped many families transition both into the city and out to the suburbs, advising them on neighborhoods, schools, commutes, housing styles, and lifestyle considerations.

Chris also has firsthand experience with waterfront and second-home ownership on Lake Livingston, giving him practical insight into vacation homes, secondary residences, waterfront properties, and short-term rental opportunities.

Outside of real estate, Chris has coached travel baseball for 12 years and has coached 35 players who have gone on to play college baseball. His son currently plays at Baylor University. For families relocating to Houston with children involved in baseball, Chris can also provide valuable insight into local travel organizations, facilities, and programs.

Chris enjoys spending time with his wife, Amber, their three children, and their two golden retrievers.

agents.companyName: Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate Gary Greene - Memorial
agents.bio: I have successfully represented buyers and sellers throughout the Houston area. Having lived and worked in the energy corridor for 35 years I am especially familiar with those neighborhoods and their amenities. I now reside in Cypress and market in that area also, but I enjoy working with a variety of buyers and sellers. I am passionate about marketing a desirable life style for all those I represent. Having a agent who will be with you throughout the entire buying and selling experience is very important. I will stand by you throughout the process and beyond. You can count on me!

Martina's enthusiasm, dedication, and desire to succeed has led her to a rewarding career in real estate. A French native, Martina and her family have called Houston home for more than 20 years after a few moves around the world.Having herself lived the expat life, Martina loves helping local and international families call Houston their “Home Sweet Home” and has deep knowledge and understanding of many neighborhoods and school systems within Houston.
Martina is known to work tirelessly to find the best possible solution for her clients’ real estate needs. As a testament to her dedication, most of her business comes from past clients and their referrals.
A true believer in supporting her community, Martina is a proud founding member of the first French immersion public school in Texas (Mark White ES) and a co-founder (and current President) of Education Francaise Greater Houston, a French after school program for over 10 years.

remarks: Exceptional opportunity in guard-gated Royal Oaks Country Club! This 4,500+ SF golf course home offers a pool/spa and expansive views at the 12th hole. A grand entry with rotunda, curved staircase and soaring ceilings sets the tone. Spacious first-floor living includes formal dining, study with French doors, and a great room open to the breakfast area & kitchen w/ island—all overlooking the covered patio, pool and golf course. The first-floor primary suite enjoys the same views, with a generous bath and walk-in closet. A guest bedroom and full bath are also downstairs. Upstairs offers 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, game room with covered balcony, plus large media room. Oversized 2-car garage plus a single garage offering a 3rd space for golf cart or extra car. Estate sale—an excellent opportunity to update and personalize a well-designed home, priced with its current condition in mind. ROCC golf course has just undergone a complete redesign & renovation, re-opening this Fall.

agents.bio:
Rae Lynn White is a Houston native and seasoned REALTOR® with 25 years of experience, consistently recognized as a top-producing agent. Part Realtor, Part Matchmaker, she’s known for connecting people with homes that truly fit their lifestyle. Now with Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Premier Properties, Rae Lynn combines deep local knowledge with a modern, client-focused approach to help buyers and sellers navigate Houston real estate with confidence.

Living inside the Loop since 1992, Rae Lynn has an insider’s understanding of Houston’s historic neighborhoods and diverse housing stock. A true old-home enthusiast, she brings both market savvy and a genuine appreciation for architecture, character, and craftsmanship. Her clients value her integrity, work ethic, and hands-on service—and often become friends and neighbors along the way.

With multiple home renovations behind her, Rae Lynn offers more than guidance—she offers perspective, helping clients buy and sell homes with a sharp eye for potential and real-world experience.

When she’s not working, Rae Lynn enjoys unplugging with her spouse and young daughter, creating memories and recharging at their German farmhouse in La Grange.

remarks: MOVE-IN READY! JUST 1.5 MILES TO NRG STADIUM! Rare detached corner home w/ NO SHARED WALLS & 3 sides of windows for abundant natural light. One of the largest homes in this 24-hr guard-gated community, located on a quiet back street w/ pond behind, 4 guest parking spots next to home & just a 500-ft walk to pool & fitness center. Rooftop deck offers amazing NRG & Texas Medical Center views. 3-bed, 3.5-bath home features 1st-floor bedroom w/ private bath. Main level w/ hardwood floors, open living & a chef’s kitchen w/ Bosch appliances & huge balcony w/ pond-views. 3rd floor is 2 bedrooms, 2 baths & laundry. A spacious primary suite w/ soaking tub, separate shower, dual sinks & large walk-in closet, plus secondary bedroom w/ private bath. Newer washer/dryer. 4th-floor walk-out attic storage & a rooftop deck w/ views of NRG. Upgrades include whole-house generator, roof, refrigerator, washer/dryer & water filtration system. Great location, privacy, views & amenities! View virtual tour!

agents.bio:
Crystal became a real estate agent while a college student. She loved helping friends and classmates find places to live, which at that time was mostly rentals, and earned her license in 2003. Her 1st degree was a BA in Advertising from the University of Houston. After graduation she started selling homes and then worked on earning her broker's license. In 2007, she started her own brokerage, Hooper Brown Realty Group, LLC and sponsored many agents till 2020 when she decided to join a bigger brokerage, which offered bigger marketing capabilities for her sellers.

Crystal is
* A licensed realtor since 2003, A real estate broker since 2007,
* Over 20 years of Real Estate, very knowledgeable in many areas,
* is a RamseyTrusted Real Estate Pro.
* Experienced with Houston Housing and has successfully setup/registered multiple units and filled with tenants.
These are some of the perks that benefit her clients. She is a 1 stop shop and can do it all.

She works with:
* First time home buyers,
* Experienced home buyers/sellers,
* Tenants,
* Landlord investors;
* Fix & Flip investors,
* Builder clients

Not only has she assisted many clients, but she also has done all these things in her personal life too.. Buying & Selling, while living in; a condo, Existing home, New construction home w/ a builder and all the steps of picking out details, Buying an older home, completely gutting to the studs and rebuilding it.

Crystal is married to a contractor and together they buy and renovate homes to be sold for a profit.
Crystal has a wide range of experience, At the time of writing this, she is a member of Houston Association of Realtors and Odessa Realtors. She has been a member of San Antonio, Austin and DFW Realtors. She has closed deals in other Texas markets, and partnered with other Realtors to assist her clients to buy and sell in other states. Based on her vast knowledge of real estate and the different markets, contact Crystal Brown to discuss your Real Estate needs and see how you can work together.

Contact Crystal for your real estate needs.

remarks: Unique opportunity to live in Southampton and have an income producing property that can easily lease out to Rice University Students(3 min walk,) medical residents, or anyone looking for an amazing location. HIGH-DEMAND area for tenants and high occupancy rates. Oversized lot on a very low trafficked street. Formerly a four-plex with a 1/1 set up, and then converted into a duplex, each unit being 2 floors. Currently, the right side unit has 4 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, and left side has 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and 2 large living rooms. There's a shared foyer area with 4 entry doors, which means it could easily be converted back into a 4 plex if desired. Has 4 electrical meters and 1 water meter. Three of the 4 HVAC units are very recent. Roof replaced in 2019. Foundation has recently been leveled. Cast iron under home was replaced to PVC. It also has new water heaters and remodeled kitchens. Minutes to Rice Village, Museum District, Hermann Park, Montrose, and more!

agents.bio: My experience in real estate began in 1997 when I joined the RE/MAX Metro team as a managing owner of the company. I came from a Special Events background, where I worked at the Museum of Fine Arts for many years and managed people and events. My skillset in working closely with people, contracts, and managing details allowed me to shift seamlessly into being a realtor. Focusing on the the individual needs of my clients and providing exemplary service is my focus. I am a Native Houstonian, specializing in the inner-city neighborhoods of Houston, now expanded out South and West  from the Beltway. I have also familiarized myself with West Houston, Friendswood, Pearland, Katy, and Sugarland areas. My familiarity with neighborhoods, demographics, and schools gives me an upper-hand in servicing my clients. remarks: Seller will consider Buyer financing concession! Bordering South Pasadena and the Arroyo Seco, this modern, multi-level residence, with dual pane windows throughout, offers a stylish and functional living space with 3 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms, and 1,974 square feet of luxurious design topped off with a massive rooftop deck. Enter at the ground floor which features a coveted first floor bedroom with full bathroom. Continue to the second level with an open concept floor plan, accentuated by floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the space with natural light. A well-appointed kitchen boasts a large island with counter seating, perfect for casual meals or entertaining. Flow seamlessly into the dedicated dining area and the outdoor patio to enjoy our LA weather year-round. The third floor features the primary suite with amazing views, ceiling fan, and huge closet. The en suite bathroom has two separate sinks, a soaking tub and large shower. An additional bedroom and full bath completes the layout. But don't stop there! Make your way up to the rooftop deck, where sweeping panoramic views set the stage for relaxation and entertainment. Whether you're unwinding with a glass of wine or hosting a lively barbecue, this space offers the perfect backdrop for any occasion. This home also features high ceilings and wood flooring throughout, floor to ceiling windows with blinds, user friendly built in technology, ample storage, central air conditioning, washer/dryer conveniently located on the third level, and direct access to the 2-car garage with EV charging outlet. Leave that car at home and make your way to Arroyo Park, San Pascual Stables, or San Pascual STEAM Magnet Elementary School. Nearby York and Figueroa feature LA's hottest restaurants, shops and entertainment such as Checker Hall and the Lodge Room, Highland Park Bowl, Villa's Tacos, Hippo, Sogo to name a few! Note that the staging depicted in the home has been removed, this property is vacant.

agents.bio:
Oscar C. Hernandez, founder of The Advisory Real Estate + Development and Team Leader of The Oscar Fine Properties Team, has been a Houston real estate leader since 2002. His local expertise, financial background and client-first approach make him a trusted Advisor to clients. Oscar has closed more than $300 million in transactions and earned numerous industry accolades and designations, but he prefers to measure success through the satisfaction of his clients. Guided by a desire to serve others, he provides exceptional, personalized representation that surpasses the agent role - making him an integral member of each client’s professional services team. 
 
A Houston native, Oscar graduated from prestigious Rice University with a Bachelor’s Degree in Economics before heading to Wall Street, where he had an eight-year career as an oil & gas equity research analyst. He entered the real estate industry after he had moved back to Houston, when a former colleague sought his advice on the purchase of four multi-family properties. Oscar was the point person during the life of these investments; assisting with occupancy, improvements and, eventually, divestment. 
 
In many ways, Oscar's background as a financial analyst defines his approach to real estate. He views every purchase and sale through an investment lens. He specializes in using short and long-term trend analyses to determine a property’s current and potential resale value alongside in-depth market knowledge to guide his clients through the intricacies of real estate transactions. Oscar is also known for his creative marketing strategies and events - from open houses, to soiree's to client appreciation parties - and he has been creating and utilizing personalized, professional HD videos to sell lifestyle since 2008. 
 
Oscar specializes in Houston’s luxury market but believes in providing a luxury experience at every price point. He tailors his communication style to his clients’ preferences and provides information that is as thorough or concise as they wish. Many people in Oscar’s returning client-roster are busy professionals who are experts in their respective fields, and he’s also an expert that top Houston area agents call upon for their personal property needs or when a listing isn't selling in a timely fashion. He embraces the opportunity to collaborate with other agents on any need that may arise. 
 
Personally, Oscar's charitable donations and volunteer efforts include involvement with The Beacon, a local nonprofit that provides counseling, housing, and other civil services to bring Houston’s unhoused back into the community, and Scenic Houston, an organization that beautifies, connects, and improves Houston neighborhoods, drawing out his passion to help shape the future of Houston. Other organizations near and dear to his heart are Rice University, Kids' Meals, Inc., Ryan's Well Foundation, Living Water International, Autism Speaks, Houston Pets Alive, Pup Squad Animal Rescue and MD Anderson. 
 
When not with clients or giving back to the community, you’ll find Oscar keeping up with the latest events and openings around town, and enjoying the many activities that the greater Houston area offers - manifesting his mantra of 'Come Live Where You Play!'  Oscar is a resident of Houston's First Ward (est. 1840) and enjoys tennis, biking, leisurely walks, wine & food tastings and has a deep appreciation for the arts.

agents.bio: Fred A. Paskell has served the Houston community for almost 20 years, providing real estate solutions and learning from some of the very best in the business. A native Texan and Army Combat Veteran, Paskell began his career in the commercial real estate sector and has since evolved into a subject matter expert in many aspects of both commercial and residential real estate, including brokerage, valuation and investment analysis. Throughout his career he has worked for several notable and respected firms including Cushman & Wakefield, CBRE, Mohr Partners and the Newmark Group before starting his own practice in 2018. On the commercial side, Paskell focuses on Office, Industrial and Retail assets while being purely focused on the investment side of residential real estate. While beginning his college studies at Louisiana State University (and still a big LSU football fan), he earned both his M.B.A. in Real Estate Finance and B.B.A. in Marketing from the University of Houston, cum laude, with honors. Paskell is also a CCIM designee, the pinnacle designation for commercial investment real estate. Fred devoted ten years of his life to protecting our country in the U.S. Army, including two combat tours to Iraq with the 7th Squadron, 6th Cavalry Regiment as an AH-64 Apache Helicopter Crew-chief, completing his service at the rank of Staff Sergeant. He is also an avid scuba diver of over 26 years having reached the levels of divemaster, rescue diver and technical diver. With this passion he enjoys scuba diving and spearfishing on the offshore oil platforms in the Gulf of Mexico in his spare time as well as fishing, playing poker, staying healthy and spending time with friends and family . Paskell also volunteers for several groups serving disabled veterans, including being a member of the Armed Forces Appreciation Committee at the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo.

agents.bio:
Pius Dawson, CIPS, TRLP, AHWD

Global Chair, Texas REALTORS® (2026)
Global Vice Chair, Texas REALTORS® (2025)
CIPS Excellence Award Recipient (2025), National Association of REALTORS®
Former NAR Global Ambassador – Austria & Germany (2020–2024)

Pius Dawson is an internationally recognized REALTOR®, educator, mentor, and global connector dedicated to elevating cross-border real estate practice and leadership worldwide. As the 2026 Global Chair for Texas REALTORS®, Pius leads statewide and international initiatives that strengthen professional standards, expand global business opportunities, and deepen collaboration between U.S. and international real estate markets.

A Certified International Property Specialist (CIPS) Instructor and recipient of the 2025 CIPS Excellence Award from the National Association of REALTORS®, Pius has trained, coached, and mentored hundreds of real estate professionals across the United States, Mexico, Europe, and beyond. His innovative teaching style and global leadership inspire agents to broaden their reach, embrace cultural intelligence, and excel in international transactions.

Pius’s long-standing commitment to civic diplomacy is reflected in his work with Sister Cities Houston, where he serves as Chair of the Compliance & Governance Committee. In this role, he offers quiet structural support and advisory leadership to the city’s network of 17 affiliate associations, helping strengthen organizational alignment, governance practices, and global engagement. Pius also provides administrative continuity as the organization’s Interim Administrator, working collaboratively in the background to help sustain and enhance its international partnerships.

His mentorship and strategic guidance have made him a trusted coach to real estate professionals around the globe, supporting their growth, development, and long-term success.

In 2026, Pius celebrates a personal milestone—his 30-year marriage to his wife, Jackie. He is a proud father of three sons from a previous marriage and a devoted grandfather to two grandchildren, who continue to inspire his passion for legacy, leadership, and service.

A respected voice in global real estate, Pius continues to elevate industry standards—one class, one connection, and one collaboration at a time.

remarks: Set in a coveted Silver Lake location, this 2019 architectural home unfolds across three light-filled levels. The design is modern but never cold with warm oak floors, soaring ceilings and walls of glass that create a calm, inviting home. The main level brings everyone together: living, dining and kitchen spaces flow easily from one to the next. The kitchen features Bosch appliances and a generous peninsula that is easy for entertaining guests while you cook or a quick breakfast. An accordion glass door opens off the kitchen to a private terrace hedged to make it feel secluded and lush. The three bedrooms downstairs, each with its own en-suite bath, offer separation and privacy. The primary suite is especially serene, with floor-to-ceiling windows, a spacious walk-in closet and a spa-like bath. Dual vanities and an oversized shower complete the retreat. Continue upward to the expansive and private roof deck. By day, the views stretch across the hills and surrounding treetops. By evening, the landscape begins to twinkle. It is an ideal setting for dinner, drinks or a quiet night under the stars. Just moments from Gelson's and Trader Joe's with Silver Lake's cafes, restaurants and boutiques close by. This is a modern home with warmth, privacy and a rare connection to the outdoors. Located in Franklin Elementary.

agents.bio: Known to a generation of home buyers and sellers in Los Angeles, Tracy Do credits her success to the trust that she has earned from her clients and her community. Since 2002, Tracy and her team have guided hundreds of LA homeowners with service powered by knowledge, experience, and skilled negotiating. The results speak volumes including over a decade as the top-producing team in their marketplace. A SoCal native and USC graduate, Tracy is an advocate for animals and fierce competitor on the tennis court.

As a licensed Realtor® since 2001, I have been representing clients with the purchase and sales of single family, and income property. With knowledge and practice in all facets of the industry including leasing, short sales and investment property, I am recognized in the field as a consummate professional. This, along with having excellent relationships with my service providers and my local real estate community, allows me to get the best results within a reasonable amount of time.

Alyse's passion for Real Estate was born from a background in both creative and business spheres. With experience in advertising, fine arts, and Interior Design, Alyse uses her diverse skills to bring excellent service and an eye for beauty to her clients. After receiving a BA from Tufts University, Alyse ran high-profile advertising accounts in both NYC and Los Angeles. As a painter and Interior Designer, she always kept her artistic side alive, showing in galleries and designing homes for clients. She focuses on channeling her creativity and business sense into buying and selling her client's properties. Having lived in Los Angeles for over 11 years, Alyse is a lover of the city's lifestyle. She is happily raising her two young children here with her husband, Matthew.

remarks:
Beautifully remodeled 2-story home featuring 4 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, and 2,521 sq. ft. of living space. The desirable floor plan offers a first-floor primary suite with a sitting area, formal dining room, and an open-concept family room, kitchen, and breakfast area perfect for everyday living and entertaining.

Recent updates include foundation repairs, roof, windows, tankless water heater, new driveway, luxury vinyl plank flooring downstairs, new carpet upstairs, fresh interior and exterior paint, and updated light fixtures throughout.

Upstairs features three secondary bedrooms plus a versatile 6' x 15' flex room with French doors, ideal for a home office, study, craft room, or additional storage.

Situated on an oversized 8,400 sq. ft. lot, the gorgeous backyard is shaded by mature trees and offers plenty of space for outdoor enjoyment. Detached 2-car garage. Move-in ready with major updates already completed!

remarks: Rarely available in coveted Memorial Thicket, this beautifully renovated 2-story custom home occupies an exceptional lot backing directly to the private section of Terry Hershey Park, creating a remarkable sense of privacy and connection to nature. Soaring ceilings, custom millwork and refined finishes elevate the interiors, with two generous first-floor living areas designed for effortless entertaining. The luxurious primary retreat features a fireplace, sitting room, spa-inspired ensuite bath and private study. Three additional bedrooms each enjoy an ensuite bath with walk-in shower. Walk-in attics offer exceptional storage. Outdoors, discover a private resort-style setting with pool, covered outdoor kitchen and fireplace—perfect for year-round entertaining. A gated driveway completes this rare Memorial Thicket offering where luxury, privacy and an extraordinary park-side setting converge.

remarks: This well-designed 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home offers comfort, convenience, and energy savings. The main bedroom has its own private bathroom, and the open layout makes the home feel roomy and easy to live in. The home is built to ENERGY STAR® standards and is ready for net-zero energy use. It includes energy-efficient appliances, such as an ENERGY STAR® refrigerator, electric stove, and dishwasher. Accessibility features are built into the home, including a wheelchair-friendly floorplan, wider doorways, and ramps for easy entry and movement. The home also has a low maintenance backyard, which is a great feature that is not often found at this price in Houston. Across the street, Clark Park offers walking trails, sports fields, and other outdoor activities, making it easy to stay active and enjoy nature. With its energy-saving design and smaller impact on the environment, this home is a great choice for buyers who want a comfortable, affordable, and eco-friendly place to live.

Nicholas "Nick" Chambers, CRS, RSPS, CIPS

Nicholas "Nick" Chambers is a Broker Associate with Realty of America (ROA) and founder of Chambers Properties Group, serving homeowners, buyers, investors, and relocation clients throughout Houston and the Greater Houston area.

With more than 17 years of experience in Texas real estate, Nick helps clients make informed decisions through strategic planning, market analysis, and data-driven pricing rather than sales pressure. His advisory approach is built around protecting equity, reducing risk, and creating clear decision paths during significant life transitions.

Nick works with clients buying or selling primary residences, luxury homes, new construction, relocation properties, and select investment real estate throughout Houston's diverse neighborhoods. Every recommendation is tailored to current market conditions, local buyer behavior, inventory levels, and each client's goals and timeline.

Rather than treating real estate as a transaction, Nick approaches every property as a financial asset. Sellers receive guidance on pricing strategy, property preparation, market positioning, and negotiation. Buyers benefit from objective market analysis, competitive offer strategy, and clear advice on when to move forward—or when patience creates a stronger opportunity.

Core Services:
• Residential listing representation
• Strategic home selling and pricing analysis
• Buyer representation and negotiation
• Luxury real estate advisory
• Relocation services
• New construction guidance
• Investment property acquisition and disposition
• Comparative Market Analysis (CMA)
• Home value evaluations

- Areas Served - 
Chambers Properties Group serves clients throughout the Greater Houston region, including:

River Oaks • Memorial • West University • Bellaire • The Heights • Rice Military • Timbergrove • Oak Forest • Cypress • Bridgeland • Towne Lake • Katy • Energy Corridor • Sugar Land • Spring • Tomball • The Woodlands and surrounding communities.

- The Advisory Process -

Every client engagement begins with understanding three questions:
• What are you trying to accomplish?
• What constraints or risks should we account for?
• What strategy creates the strongest long-term outcome?

From there, recommendations are based on market data, pricing trends, buyer demand, and proven execution—not assumptions or one-size-fits-all solutions.

Clients appreciate Nick's ability to simplify complex market information into practical guidance, helping them move forward with confidence from the initial consultation through closing.

remarks: This exceptional Plan 1A end unit at The Heights at Ponte Vista pairs thoughtful architecture with a highly curated collection of designer finishes. The open-conceptmain level is anchored by a gourmet kitchen featuring a drop-in electric induction cooktop, built-in wall oven, vent hood, and microwave drawer integrated into the oversized island, creating a sophisticated setting for both everyday living and entertaining. The classic white shaker-style cabinets feature matte black hardwarethat is also carried through the entire home for a cohesive and personalized look. The living room expands effortlessly outdoors through a dramatic three-panelmulti-slide door, bringing natural light into the space and creating a seamless connection to the spacious deck. Bath 3 on the first floor features a fully tiled shower. The home includes white faux-wood blinds throughout. Additional energy-efficient features include all-electric appliances, a video doorbell, and a 220-voltgarage outlet ready for electric vehicle charging. Located within the gated Ponte Vista master-planned community in San Pedro, this home is near the Palos Verdes communities, the waterfront, the Port of Los Angeles, and major freeways. Common area amenities include a pool, spa, firepit, open space areas, passive trails, a rec center, a fitness center and BBQ area. Photos are of the model home and common area and are used for representational purposes only.

agents.bio:
As a client-focused, results-driven Realtor and lifelong Houstonian, Tracy Brandon is ready to guide you on your Houston home journey, making sure you feel right at home throughout the process. Tracy has a passion for relationship building and connecting people with other people, places, and things that create a meaningful impact. As a licensed real estate agent, that passion shines through in a variety of ways, including her commitment to finding you a home in a neighborhood that will have a positive, meaningful impact on your life.

Thanks to her previous career in Supply Chain Management (with 20+ years of experience as a Procurement and Contracts Manager), Tracy brings a unique skill set and perspective to her work as a Realtor. That experience helped her become savvy at the art of negotiation and keenly adept at writing contracts that bring value. In addition, her former career contributes to her excellent ability to work with people from different cultures, backgrounds, and professions.

Tracy is a lifelong resident of Houston and a long-term resident of the Heights and inner city. That means she has immense knowledge of inner loop neighborhoods and communities, which she utilizes every day, both as a Realtor and as an active Houston urbanite. She's always in the know when it comes to fun activities, restaurants, and nightlife around the city so don't hesitate to reach out for a recommendation. Tracy is also an ardent music fan and a live music enthusiastshe even used to book live shows! These days, she gives back to the Houston area by volunteering within the music community and working with local artists and venues to promote the Houston music scene and all that it has to offer. Tracy's daughter is her greatest joy in life, and they enjoy experiencing their shared passion for live music together.

Area Serving: Houston Heights, Memorial, Spring Branch, Energy Corridor, Montrose, Rice Military, Meyerland, Galleria, Westbury, Southgate, Rice University, Midtown, Montrose, Inner Loop, Kingwood, The Woodlands, Katy, Sugarland, Clear Lake, Galveston.

Let Tracy Brandon assist you with your real estate needs. She is here for you!

agents.bio: Silvana Sarkis is an accomplished Real Estate Broker recognized for her expertise in complex and sensitive transactions. She holds a Juris Doctor (JD) degree and is a Certified Divorce Real Estate Expert (CDRE), Certified Probate Real Estate Specialist (CPRES) and a Senior Real Estate Specialist (SRES), allowing her to provide highly tailored, legally informed real estate services. Licensed as a broker since 2005, Silvana has managed sales teams and loan officers and has trained more than 250 realtors and industry professionals. She has extensive experience in high-conflict matters, including divorce, probate, foreclosure, and short sales, and works closely with petitioners and attorneys to navigate these transactions with neutrality and care. She is also a published author of 33 Things That Can Go Wrong and Do in Real Estate Transactions and is available to provide expert witness testimony.In addition to her practice, Silvana serves on the board director for VLI and the Veterans Association of Real Estate Professionals (VAREP). Through VAREP, she actively supports military families and veterans, serves as a panel speaker, and advocates for access to housing resources. Her dedication to excellence, leadership, and community impact continues to distinguish her in the real estate industry.

agents.bio:
William and Thuy Shipman moved to the Houston area in 1982 and have watched the area grow and emerge as one of the most thriving regions in the country! In fact, the Shipmans live in the same Cypress neighborhood that they grew up in! Their appreciation for Cypress and the Houston area stems from its diverse housing options that accommodate a wide range of families, an abundance of recreation opportunities, the people, and unmatched entertainment options. 

Over the last 30 years, they have enjoyed witnessing the continual developments that have made Cypress what it is today! As a real estate team, their goal is to introduce their buyers to an area where they feel this same connection with, and facilitate the selling process for sellers so that they can begin the next chapter of their lives in the home that best suits their needs. 

Prior to real estate, Thuy earned her Bachelor’s degree in Finance and worked as an accountant in the oil and gas field for years, as well as a loan originator and cash accountant for a mortgage company, and later, a cash accountant for a property management company. Her experience gives her a unique insight into the closing process that is unmatched by many. William’s wide scope of experience further enhances each transaction, as well. From helping home builders in his Cypress neighborhood and working in Data, to his experience in automobile sales and owning his own home theatre and automation company, William’s extensive expertise has proven beneficial to the team’s buyers and sellers. Their knowledge, skills, passion for real estate, and experience leasing out their own investment properties led William and Thuy to pursue a career in real estate! 

Determined, driven, self-starters, knowledgeable, personable, and helpful are just a few examples that define the Shipman team. After all, Thuy’s father brought her to America so that she could have a better life, and as a result, she capitalizes on every opportunity that presents itself not only to provide a better life for her family, but also for her clients. They place a great emphasis on communication, whether helping the client price their home, briefing them on the current market or trends, disclosing every detail about a property or neighborhood, or listening to their client’s needs and wants, William and Thuy’s commitment to communication never falters. 

In addition, their diligent work ethic and impressive negotiating skills produce optimal results that are in their client’s best interest. Plus, as residents of the community since 1982, they possess in-depth knowledge about the region and its accommodations.

Aside from their personality characteristics that attribute to their success, Thuy and William’s affiliation with Connect Realty further enhances each transaction. With the most innovative technology and tools in the industry, they have access to unparalleled resources that maximize their effectiveness and efficiency. Plus, Connect Realty’s premier training and support have equipped them with the essential knowledge, skills, and tools to overcome any obstacle that may arise throughout the transaction and deliver the most favorable results. 

When not diligently helping their clients, Thuy enjoys running, skating, attending her children’s events and activities, and spending time with her family. In addition, she owns a jewelry business and sells her jewelry online and at tradeshows. A sports enthusiast, William can be found golfing, shooting, fishing, or playing pool, when he is not spending time with his children.

agents.bio:
A little about me! I was born in Houston and raised in the Dallas/Fort Worth Metro Area.  I moved back to Houston (Dickinson) in 2007 and was happy to live closer to family again.  I went into Real Estate because I have a passion for helping people, and how better to do that than to be a part of the process of helping people build a future and live out the American dream of homeownership!  Watching people fall in love with their new home, or selling their current one is fun and exciting, and I have had the honor of being in the top 1% of sales in my office, earning the respect of my fellow REALTORS, and helping many clients.  Prior to Real Estate, I earned my Bachelor of Business from Dallas Baptist University and minored in Psychology.  I also had worked in telecommunications for 25 years, most recently as a Project Manager/Contracts Negotiator for custom contracts all over the world. My wife, Becky (who is also a Realtor), and I also own a small farm, where we hatch, raise, and sell heritage and specialty breeds of chickens, turkeys, and guineas, as well as farm fresh eggs. We focus on pasture-raised flocks and feed only high-quality and Non-GMO/Soy-free feed products.  I look forward to working with you to make your Real Estate dreams a reality!

Jim Atkinson is a Broker Associate, REALTOR® and the Team Leader for Hidden Paradise Realty Team at UTR - Texas, Realtors, located in Houston, Texas, near NASA.  Our team is comprised of experienced Agents who have a passion for real estate, and who are ready to assist you with all your buying, selling, or rental needs!  Our team is structured differently than most teams, as we don't have buyer's agents or seller's agents, who simply hand you off to someone else once the contract is signed.  Rather, we believe in the value of relationships, and we know that the relationship you have with your Agent is extremely vital to you during your home buying, selling, or renting experience. We have an amazing Transaction Coordinator to assist you and our Agents throughout the process, but your Agent will remain actively involved - all the way to the closing table and beyond!

agents.bio: Downtown's number one Realtor, Terry Stanfield, is a Missouri native turned devoted Houstonian since 1987. While Terry is well attuned to the entire city he focuses on marketing the Downtown and Midtown areas. His extraordinary knowledge of this chosen market has become the stuff of legend. He lives and loves the urban lifestyle that he sells so successfully and is one of the defining reasons that Downtown Houston has reemerged as the place to be. Working for 14 years as Director of Operations and Customer Service for a Houston auto group prior to choosing a career in real estate, Terry learned how to provide exceptional assistance and client satisfaction. Terry brings this same love for working with people and customer service experience to Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate Gary Greene. Driven to succeed for all the right reasons, Terry promises he will do whatever it takes to provide great service and get the job completed, and he fulfills that pledge by giving his clients and career his all. That attitude has earned him the undying respect of his peers and clientele and a well-deserved reputation for flawless execution and attention to detail. It is this dedication that first earned him the Star Achiever award in 2003, then moved him to Top Producer status in 2004, where he has remained ever since. In a company with offices throughout Houston and more than 1,100 agent licensees, Terry's being listed as one of the Company-Wide Top 20 Producers year after year is certainly proof of his outstanding achievement. But the true testament to his enduring and exceptional success was his being ranked locally by the Houston Business Journal as one of the area's Top 25 Residential Real Estate Professionals from 2009 through 2017 and now nationally among REAL Trends' Top 100 Agents List, where he was one of only two Realtors in Houston and only seven in the entire state of Texas! Terry's commitment to his clients has also earned him a Five Star Professional Ranking. With integrity, enthusiasm, and sincere attention to the needs of his clients Terry ensures award-winning customer service every time.

remarks: Welcome to 1949 Heidleman Road, a beautifully remodeled single-level hillside home offering 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, an attached 2-car garage, and sweeping rear-facing hillside and city-light views. A scenic Los Angeles hillside setting, this inviting home combines comfortable everyday living with nice outdoor space. The remodeled interior provides a fresh, move-in-ready feel, while the practical single-story layout offers seamless flow between the living areas and bedrooms. Step outside to the rear deck and take in the expansive views - an ideal setting for morning coffee, sunset dining, or entertaining. A stairwell leads down to the generous two-tier backyard, creating versatile areas for outdoor gatherings, gardening, play space, pets, or your own hillside oasis. Whether hosting friends on the deck or cultivating a garden below, the property offers rare flexibility and room to enjoy Southern California's indoor-outdoor lifestyle. University Hills offers an ideal location near Cal State Los Angeles, easy freeway access, green spaces, dining, and entertainment. Agents MUST read private notes.

remarks: Welcome to this beautifully updated one-story home in the established Chimney Hill community! Conveniently situated near shopping, dining, and major roadways, this home offers a wonderful combination of comfort, style, and convenience!

agents.bio:
The Bruner Team is currently a one-woman show—me, Elisa (Bruner) McNinch—and I’m honored to carry on the real estate legacy my parents began more than 40 years ago. Real estate has always been personal in our family, and that’s exactly how I still do business today: with genuine care, calm guidance, and a big dose of Southern hospitality.

I’m proud to have been recognized with the Five Star Professional Award for real estate customer service 13 years in a row (2012–2025)—an honor earned by fewer than 1% of Houston-area Realtors. I’m also a consistent multi-million dollar producer, but what matters most to me is that my clients feel heard, protected, and confident from start to finish.

If you ask where I work in Houston, you’ll probably hear me say: “If you divide Houston in half, I work the left-hand side.” I primarily serve Northwest Houston, and I’m very familiar throughout West Houston as well, including Spring, Tomball, Spring Branch, Cypress, Katy, and Richmond/Rosenberg.

Even though I’m tech-savvy (and yes—your home will be marketed online the right way), I still believe the best service happens voice-to-voice and face-to-face whenever possible. I’m hands-on with every client: meeting with sellers to stage and prepare a home, taking listings, coordinating photography, marketing, showing properties, hosting open houses, attending inspections—you name it. I’m the face and heart of The Bruner Team.

Behind the scenes, I’m supported by a trusted transaction coordinator who helps prepare listing documents and offers, tracks deadlines, and keeps everything moving smoothly—so you get both personal attention and professional precision.

If you’re looking for a knowledgeable agent who feels more like a steady partner than a sales pitch, I’d love to help you make your next move.
