agents.bio:
Val is committed to continuously participating in continuing education to ensure that she and her staff provide their clients with the most accurate, thorough & knowledgeable service possible to protect your interests & make the experience of buying or selling a home as enjoyable as possible.

For their seller clients, they have developed a 33 point comprehensive marketing system that provides clients with some very unique services for listing properties. It is unmatched in the local market! A few of the strategies include advertising your listing on over 100 local & national websites, reverse prospecting & reverse offers, and providing an immediate call tracking system for inquiries, & virtual broker open houses.

They work closely with Buyers to educate & protect them throughout the process. They analyze, not only the most recent sales activity in an area, but also complete trend reports to see the longer term history of the neighborhood's sales prices. Their goal is to negotiate a strong deal & help buyers obtain "instant equity".

Valery grew up around real estate by helping her grandparents fix up homes & re-sell and/or lease them. They also owner financed many properties to increase their returns even more, so she realized early on the power of Real Estate. She followed in her family's footsteps & was an Investor for many years before obtaining her Real Estate License in 2006, after retiring as a Health Care Executive.

She & her husband love to travel, enjoy great wine, & LOVE animals! She "gets in trouble" a lot with her husband for rescuing animals!
The team is also committed to giving back to the community. Val volunteers regularly at an Assisted Living Facility, & they donate a portion of their earned commission from every transaction to the charity of their clients' choice!

agents.bio: Silvana Sarkis is an accomplished Real Estate Broker recognized for her expertise in complex and sensitive transactions. She holds a Juris Doctor (JD) degree and is a Certified Divorce Real Estate Expert (CDRE), Certified Probate Real Estate Specialist (CPRES) and a Senior Real Estate Specialist (SRES), allowing her to provide highly tailored, legally informed real estate services. Licensed as a broker since 2005, Silvana has managed sales teams and loan officers and has trained more than 250 realtors and industry professionals. She has extensive experience in high-conflict matters, including divorce, probate, foreclosure, and short sales, and works closely with petitioners and attorneys to navigate these transactions with neutrality and care. She is also a published author of 33 Things That Can Go Wrong and Do in Real Estate Transactions and is available to provide expert witness testimony.In addition to her practice, Silvana serves on the board director for VLI and the Veterans Association of Real Estate Professionals (VAREP). Through VAREP, she actively supports military families and veterans, serves as a panel speaker, and advocates for access to housing resources. Her dedication to excellence, leadership, and community impact continues to distinguish her in the real estate industry.

agents.bio:
Paul's Real Estate practice encompasses the City of West Hollywood, the Hollywood Hills and the communities of Hancock Park, Los Feliz and Silverlake. Specialization includes residential hillside, historic and architecturally significant properties.

Representing approximately half buyers and half sellers, Paul brings a corporate business background to the increasingly complex world of residential Real Estate.

Paul is a resident of the Sunset Strip area and is knowledgeable of the premier neighborhoods of Los Angeles.

Paul is a 1981 graduate of The University of Southern California with a B.S. in Business Administration and an emphasis in Finance. Paul is a certified "Previews" specialist trained in the marketing of luxury properties.

Shannon brings a wealth of financial expertise and a deep love for Los Angeles’ Eastside communities to her career in real estate. A longtime resident of Atwater Village, Shannon pairs her professional background in corporate finance with her hands-on experience in residential renovation to offer clients both strategic insight and personal guidance.

A graduate of Westfield State University in Massachusetts, where she earned her B.S. in Business, Shannon went on to spend over 14 years building an impressive career in Corporate America. She held leadership roles as an Accounting Manager at Mellon Financial and Colony Capital—a private real estate investment firm—before moving into senior positions with Pacific Financial Research and ultimately serving as Assistant Vice President at U.S. Bancorp Fund Services.

Her passion for real estate grew organically while managing multiple home renovation projects in Atwater Village, where she combined her financial acumen with a keen eye for design and value. This hands-on experience inspired her to transition into real estate full-time, pursuing her dream of becoming a REALTOR®.

remarks: Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in the lush hills of Laurel Canyon, this private single-level retreat offers a rare combination of tranquility, comfort, and effortless indoor-outdoor living, just minutes from the Sunset Strip and Studio City. Reimagined with modern convenience while preserving its mid-century character, the four-bedroom, three-bath residence unfolds around an open living, dining, and kitchen area overlooking a green lawn, fire pit, heated swimming pool and spa. Once outside, enjoy the outdoor kitchen with a passthrough window to the indoor kitchen. The chef's kitchen features a six-burner Viking range, a Sub-Zero refrigerator, and a dedicated wine-cooling fridge. Privately positioned apart from and opposite the home's three additional bedrooms, the primary suite opens directly to the pool through double French doors and features a walk-in wardrobe and spa-inspired bath with a tub and steam shower. Wood and slate tile flooring add texture and a luxurious feel throughout. Outside, mature landscaping, a broad grassy yard, and mountain and canyon surroundings create the feeling of a secluded resort-life in the heart of Los Angeles. There is a mix of mature and newer fruit trees, including lemon, avocado, guava, grapefruit, mandarin and lime trees! Spanning almost 2,000 SF of living space on a 7,791 SF lot, the home has been lovingly maintained by the current owner, and is offered with newer appliances including a washer, dryer, jacuzzi spa by the pool, gas fireplace, updated HVAC, Nest security and latest model outdoor kitchen appliances. Come for the tranquility, stay for the serene mountain views. Buyer is advised to independently verify the accuracy of all information, including square footage, lot size, permits, zoning, schools, and property features.

agents.bio:
Oscar C. Hernandez, founder of The Advisory Real Estate + Development and Team Leader of The Oscar Fine Properties Team, has been a Houston real estate leader since 2002. His local expertise, financial background and client-first approach make him a trusted Advisor to clients. Oscar has closed more than $300 million in transactions and earned numerous industry accolades and designations, but he prefers to measure success through the satisfaction of his clients. Guided by a desire to serve others, he provides exceptional, personalized representation that surpasses the agent role - making him an integral member of each client’s professional services team. 
 
A Houston native, Oscar graduated from prestigious Rice University with a Bachelor’s Degree in Economics before heading to Wall Street, where he had an eight-year career as an oil & gas equity research analyst. He entered the real estate industry after he had moved back to Houston, when a former colleague sought his advice on the purchase of four multi-family properties. Oscar was the point person during the life of these investments; assisting with occupancy, improvements and, eventually, divestment. 
 
In many ways, Oscar's background as a financial analyst defines his approach to real estate. He views every purchase and sale through an investment lens. He specializes in using short and long-term trend analyses to determine a property’s current and potential resale value alongside in-depth market knowledge to guide his clients through the intricacies of real estate transactions. Oscar is also known for his creative marketing strategies and events - from open houses, to soiree's to client appreciation parties - and he has been creating and utilizing personalized, professional HD videos to sell lifestyle since 2008. 
 
Oscar specializes in Houston’s luxury market but believes in providing a luxury experience at every price point. He tailors his communication style to his clients’ preferences and provides information that is as thorough or concise as they wish. Many people in Oscar’s returning client-roster are busy professionals who are experts in their respective fields, and he’s also an expert that top Houston area agents call upon for their personal property needs or when a listing isn't selling in a timely fashion. He embraces the opportunity to collaborate with other agents on any need that may arise. 
 
Personally, Oscar's charitable donations and volunteer efforts include involvement with The Beacon, a local nonprofit that provides counseling, housing, and other civil services to bring Houston’s unhoused back into the community, and Scenic Houston, an organization that beautifies, connects, and improves Houston neighborhoods, drawing out his passion to help shape the future of Houston. Other organizations near and dear to his heart are Rice University, Kids' Meals, Inc., Ryan's Well Foundation, Living Water International, Autism Speaks, Houston Pets Alive, Pup Squad Animal Rescue and MD Anderson. 
 
When not with clients or giving back to the community, you’ll find Oscar keeping up with the latest events and openings around town, and enjoying the many activities that the greater Houston area offers - manifesting his mantra of 'Come Live Where You Play!'  Oscar is a resident of Houston's First Ward (est. 1840) and enjoys tennis, biking, leisurely walks, wine & food tastings and has a deep appreciation for the arts.

agents.bio:
Founder and President of Energy Realty, Sherry Campbell is recognized as the most successful broker in the burgeoning Energy Corridor and West Houston. Energy Realty is a Houston-based, privately owned, top producing boutique brokerage with a global client list. Sherry is known within the industry as a real estate, entrepreneur, and innovator. Leading by example and fostering the success of agents. A true thought leader, Campbell is an admitted perfectionist who believes in giving her clients and team members 110%.

Campbell, a supportive broker, established Energy Realty in 2012. Since that time, she has grown it to include 40+ agents, two offices and posted more than $130M in production in 2022. Known for her inimitable integrity, five-star service, mentoring skills, ability to analyze and respond to market changes and commitment to community. She recognizes what today’s agents need to be successful. Campbell is a working broker – dealing with buyers and sellers on a daily basis.

remarks: Experience elevated Downtown living in this stunning two-level industrial penthouse loft on the 9th floor of Bayou Lofts, Houston’s historic Southern Pacific Railroad Building. This open-concept residence features 2 bedrooms, 2.5 baths, a private balcony off the main living area, and two assigned parking spaces. Interior highlights include Poggenpohl kitchen cabinetry, hardwood floors, and a carpeted mezzanine level. Ideally situated in the heart of Downtown Houston, just minutes from the Theater District, major sports venues, parks, dining, and nightlife. Walk to Market Square Park, POST Houston, and the Main Street Promenade just half a block away. With METRORail nearby and convenient freeway access, this distinctive loft offers the perfect blend of historic character and modern urban living.

agents.bio: Downtown's number one Realtor, Terry Stanfield, is a Missouri native turned devoted Houstonian since 1987. While Terry is well attuned to the entire city he focuses on marketing the Downtown and Midtown areas. His extraordinary knowledge of this chosen market has become the stuff of legend. He lives and loves the urban lifestyle that he sells so successfully and is one of the defining reasons that Downtown Houston has reemerged as the place to be. Working for 14 years as Director of Operations and Customer Service for a Houston auto group prior to choosing a career in real estate, Terry learned how to provide exceptional assistance and client satisfaction. Terry brings this same love for working with people and customer service experience to Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate Gary Greene. Driven to succeed for all the right reasons, Terry promises he will do whatever it takes to provide great service and get the job completed, and he fulfills that pledge by giving his clients and career his all. That attitude has earned him the undying respect of his peers and clientele and a well-deserved reputation for flawless execution and attention to detail. It is this dedication that first earned him the Star Achiever award in 2003, then moved him to Top Producer status in 2004, where he has remained ever since. In a company with offices throughout Houston and more than 1,100 agent licensees, Terry's being listed as one of the Company-Wide Top 20 Producers year after year is certainly proof of his outstanding achievement. But the true testament to his enduring and exceptional success was his being ranked locally by the Houston Business Journal as one of the area's Top 25 Residential Real Estate Professionals from 2009 through 2017 and now nationally among REAL Trends' Top 100 Agents List, where he was one of only two Realtors in Houston and only seven in the entire state of Texas! Terry's commitment to his clients has also earned him a Five Star Professional Ranking. With integrity, enthusiasm, and sincere attention to the needs of his clients Terry ensures award-winning customer service every time.

remarks: Enjoy penthouse-level living at Teramachi, a sought-after 55+ community in the heart of Little Tokyo. This bright one-bedroom, one-bath residence features an open, comfortable floor plan filled with natural light. Floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors extend the living space onto a generous south-facing private patio, an ideal spot for morning coffee, outdoor dining, or simply taking in the city views. The residence also offers the convenience of central Air/Heat, ample closet space, in-unit laundry and one assigned space in the secured parking garage. Designed around an engaging and comfortable lifestyle, Teramachi offers an impressive collection of amenities. Residents enjoy a beautifully landscaped central courtyard with koi pond, fitness center, sauna, guest lounges, community barbecues, and a two-story multipurpose room complete with its own kitchen for gatherings and events. A 24-hour front desk and security station provides additional peace of mind, while guest parking makes entertaining easy. Beyond the community, some of Downtown Los Angeles' best dining, shopping, cultural attractions, museums, and public transportation are just moments away. With Little Tokyo right outside your door and the Arts District nearby, this residence offers an exceptional opportunity to enjoy one of DTLA's most distinctive neighborhoods while coming home to the comfort and tranquility of Teramachi.

Since 2002, Bill has been instrumental in the establishment of various brokerages in Downtown LA, earning him accolades, including Best Residential REALTOR® four times. Bill's expertise extends to a range of diverse neighborhoods, including West Hollywood, Beverly Hills, Hollywood, Los Feliz, Silver Lake, Echo Park, Mount Washington, and Downtown Los Angeles. remarks: Warm Modern Design Meets Effortless Living in Mar Vista. Set on a 7,500+ sq ft lot in the highly coveted Mar Vista Elementary district, this completely reimagined 2026 designer remodel encompasses 4,190 square feet (excluding the garage), featuring an expansive main residence and a detached ADU. Designed with an emphasis on single-story living, the main floor unfolds as a collection of thoughtfully crafted spaces, each offering a distinct experience for daily life, while the second story is reserved entirely for elevated lifestyle and recreation. Inside, sweeping oak and parquet floors meet extensive natural quartzite stone, highlighted by a striking custom quartzite sink in the downstairs powder bath. The formal living area features a wood-burning fireplace and flows naturally into the dining room. A disappearing pocket door in the lounge opens directly to an outdoor kitchen and BBQ area, complete with an icemaker, beverage center and counter seating positioned in front of a vibrant living wall. Abundant glass across the primary suite, great room, kitchen, and lounge creates a truly seamless indoor/outdoor flow. The kitchen features an oversized island, a dedicated pantry, and premium Thermador appliances, all bathed in natural light from overhead skylights. The first-floor primary suite is a private retreat overlooking the pool area, featuring a walk-in closet and an en-suite with dual sinks, dual shower heads, an oversized soaking tub, and a skylight. Three additional en-suite bedrooms, a dedicated laundry room, and a mudroom complete the main level. Upstairs, the dedicated entertainment level expands your living space with a TV room, game area, gym (or 5th bedroom), a playroom/art room, and a full bathroom. Outside, the backyard centers around a pool and a fire pit area, complemented by an outdoor dining space set gracefully in front of the property's second living wall. The detached ADU (3134 Purdue) is a true standalone residence with a private bedroom, living area, and a full kitchen, featuring skylights in both the kitchen and bedroom. Complete with a 2-car attached garage, this property delivers warm modern sophistication tailored for the Southern California family lifestyle.

Westside LA Real Estate Expert.

A Santa Monica native, Jessica Abbott has a deep and comprehensive understanding of the Los Angeles market. Living in many vibrant pockets and neighborhoods throughout the city, she has valuable firsthand insight into the communities and nuances that make each area unique and how that translates to what clients are looking for.
 
With a successful career in fashion, e-commerce, and luxury, Jessica brings a unique perspective to real estate. She has a keen eye for design, curation, merchandising, and branding and has leveraged these skills to excel in interior design and home remodeling.
 
Born and raised in Santa Monica, Jessica “Jess” Abbott, Westside Native, brings a distinctly local perspective to Los Angeles luxury real estate. Partnered with Christie’s International Real Estate SoCal, she combines homegrown Westside intelligence with the global reach of the world’s most respected luxury real estate brand.

For Jess, local knowledge is not a slogan—it is memory, pattern recognition, and context applied block by block to every property conversation. Her approach prioritizes the block before the bedroom count, the light before the finishes, and the long-term value beyond today’s market.

Before entering real estate, Jess built a successful career across luxury, fashion, and e-com, developing a sophisticated understanding of branding, visual storytelling, and consumer psychology. She later expanded that foundation through interior design, modern remodeling, and new construction consulting, giving her a highly refined editorial eye for property, positioning, and value.

Whether helping a buyer recognize the potential of an off-market Mar Vista property or preparing a timeless Venice compound for market, Jess sees opportunity in details others may overlook.

As a lifelong Westsider, she brings an intimate understanding of the communities that shape Los Angeles—from Santa Monica, Brentwood, Mar Vista, Venice, and Beverly Hills to the city’s broader luxury enclaves. Her clients rely on her not simply for market data, but for perspective: what makes a property special, what may be overlooked, and what will continue to matter long after the transaction closes.

For sellers, that perspective translates into thoughtful positioning, compelling storytelling, and a deep understanding of how discerning buyers experience a property. For buyers, it means looking beyond finishes and square footage to understand context, livability, potential, and long-term value.

Jess pairs this creative intuition with disciplined strategy and formidable negotiation, approaching every client’s interests with quiet confidence and an uncompromising commitment to protecting their assets.

From legacy estates to architectural enclaves, Jess brings refined taste, strategic thinking, unmistakable L.A. style, and distinctly Westside intelligence to every transaction.

She doesn’t simply sell Westside homes—she interprets them

agents.bio:
Bea Flores, ABR, SRS, is a renowned figure in the Houston real estate market, with over 18 years of industry expertise. Her passion for real estate and dedication to exceptional service inspired her to establish her own brokerage, Luxe Living Group, over three years ago. Under her leadership, Bea has guided her team to remarkable success, earning recognition as one of Houston's top agents.

In December 2024, Bea and her team joined Compass Real Estate, a decision driven by the extensive marketing opportunities and advanced technology Compass offers. This move allows Luxe Living Group to enhance the already top-notch real estate experience they provide, giving clients access to cutting-edge tools and strategies that elevate every transaction.

Bea specializes in working with traditional buyers and sellers in Houston while carving out a niche in representing out-of-state institutional buyers across Texas cities like Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio. Her commitment to client education and transparent communication has earned her a loyal client base, with an impressive 85-90% of her business coming from repeat clients and referrals.

At Luxe Living Group, Bea ensures every client receives a luxurious and seamless experience, prioritizing meticulous attention to detail and comprehensive support to ensure success in every transaction.

Beyond her success as an agent, Bea is also a dedicated educator. For over nine years, she has been teaching real estate licensing courses, mentoring both agents and clients, and empowering them to navigate their real estate journeys with confidence.

Bea's outstanding achievements have earned her numerous accolades, including recognition among the Top 25 agents in Houston, a recent ranking among the Top 5 agents by production in the Houston Business Journal, and being featured in national publications such as Top Agent Magazine. She also served as President of the Women's Council of Realtors - Bay Area, Houston Chapter in 2013, further demonstrating her commitment to leadership and the advancement of the real estate profession.

With a foundation built on integrity, expertise, and an unwavering commitment to client satisfaction, Bea Flores and her team at Luxe Living Group, now proudly partnered with Compass, are dedicated to providing personalized, seamless real estate experiences that exceed expectations.

agents.bio:
A little about me! I was born in Houston and raised in the Dallas/Fort Worth Metro Area.  I moved back to Houston (Dickinson) in 2007 and was happy to live closer to family again.  I went into Real Estate because I have a passion for helping people, and how better to do that than to be a part of the process of helping people build a future and live out the American dream of homeownership!  Watching people fall in love with their new home, or selling their current one is fun and exciting, and I have had the honor of being in the top 1% of sales in my office, earning the respect of my fellow REALTORS, and helping many clients.  Prior to Real Estate, I earned my Bachelor of Business from Dallas Baptist University and minored in Psychology.  I also had worked in telecommunications for 25 years, most recently as a Project Manager/Contracts Negotiator for custom contracts all over the world. My wife, Becky (who is also a Realtor), and I also own a small farm, where we hatch, raise, and sell heritage and specialty breeds of chickens, turkeys, and guineas, as well as farm fresh eggs. We focus on pasture-raised flocks and feed only high-quality and Non-GMO/Soy-free feed products.  I look forward to working with you to make your Real Estate dreams a reality!

Jim Atkinson is a Broker Associate, REALTOR® and the Team Leader for Hidden Paradise Realty Team at UTR - Texas, Realtors, located in Houston, Texas, near NASA.  Our team is comprised of experienced Agents who have a passion for real estate, and who are ready to assist you with all your buying, selling, or rental needs!  Our team is structured differently than most teams, as we don't have buyer's agents or seller's agents, who simply hand you off to someone else once the contract is signed.  Rather, we believe in the value of relationships, and we know that the relationship you have with your Agent is extremely vital to you during your home buying, selling, or renting experience. We have an amazing Transaction Coordinator to assist you and our Agents throughout the process, but your Agent will remain actively involved - all the way to the closing table and beyond!

remarks: Welcome to 126 Sidney at Sherman Landing, a striking new-construction 3-story home in Houston's dynamic EaDo neighborhood. Spanning 2,248 sq ft, this 3-bed/3.5-bath residence blends bold modern design with thoughtful livability. A flexible first-floor bedroom with full bath is perfect as a guest suite or home office. Ascend the dramatic floating staircase to an open second floor where exposed structural trusses soar above a chef's kitchen with dark flat-front cabinetry, stone countertops, gas range, and island seating, flowing into the living room with 42" gas fireplace. The third-floor primary suite delivers vaulted beamed ceilings, a freestanding soaking tub, skylit walk-in shower, and a custom built-in closet. An attached 2-car garage completes the package. Steps from the Harrisburg Hike & Bike Trail, 0.4 mi to light rail, and minutes from Minute Maid Park, Buffalo Bayou, and EaDo's acclaimed dining and nightlife scene.

agents.bio:
Mike’s enthusiasm, dedication, and consummate market knowledge make him the Realtor® of choice for his many clients who do not hesitate to recommend his services to family and friends.

Mike was born and grew up in Creswell, North Carolina. He graduated from East Carolina University with a degree in Industrial Technology and Business. His Houston sales career began in the 1980s when Mike was transferred to Bayou City while working in retail management. He changed his career path in 1987 to residential real estate sales and has never looked back.

Mike’s father owned a small development and construction company, and that exposure gave Mike a particular interest in and knowledge of new home construction. He understands the builders’ language, and that expertise has made a successful difference for his clients in numerous transactions.

Leadership, experience, market expertise, above all, an understanding of people, and the importance of building relationships make Mike a top-producing, in-demand Realtor®.

agents.bio:
Bea Flores, ABR, SRS, is a renowned figure in the Houston real estate market, with over 18 years of industry expertise. Her passion for real estate and dedication to exceptional service inspired her to establish her own brokerage, Luxe Living Group, over three years ago. Under her leadership, Bea has guided her team to remarkable success, earning recognition as one of Houston's top agents.

In December 2024, Bea and her team joined Compass Real Estate, a decision driven by the extensive marketing opportunities and advanced technology Compass offers. This move allows Luxe Living Group to enhance the already top-notch real estate experience they provide, giving clients access to cutting-edge tools and strategies that elevate every transaction.

Bea specializes in working with traditional buyers and sellers in Houston while carving out a niche in representing out-of-state institutional buyers across Texas cities like Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio. Her commitment to client education and transparent communication has earned her a loyal client base, with an impressive 85-90% of her business coming from repeat clients and referrals.

At Luxe Living Group, Bea ensures every client receives a luxurious and seamless experience, prioritizing meticulous attention to detail and comprehensive support to ensure success in every transaction.

Beyond her success as an agent, Bea is also a dedicated educator. For over nine years, she has been teaching real estate licensing courses, mentoring both agents and clients, and empowering them to navigate their real estate journeys with confidence.

Bea's outstanding achievements have earned her numerous accolades, including recognition among the Top 25 agents in Houston, a recent ranking among the Top 5 agents by production in the Houston Business Journal, and being featured in national publications such as Top Agent Magazine. She also served as President of the Women's Council of Realtors - Bay Area, Houston Chapter in 2013, further demonstrating her commitment to leadership and the advancement of the real estate profession.

With a foundation built on integrity, expertise, and an unwavering commitment to client satisfaction, Bea Flores and her team at Luxe Living Group, now proudly partnered with Compass, are dedicated to providing personalized, seamless real estate experiences that exceed expectations.

agents.bio:
Ann LeTulle has been serving clients throughout the Houston area since 2006 and has consistently been recognized as a top-performing real estate professional. Her experience covers a broad range of real estate needs, including buyers and sellers, investors, landlords and renters, VA clients, and those relocating to the area. She enjoys getting to know each client and finding the right approach for their unique situation.
Ann’s style is straightforward, attentive, and personal. She believes in keeping her clients informed, listening carefully, and being prepared when it matters most, especially at the negotiating table. Her goal is to make the process clear and manageable while helping clients make well-informed decisions.
Before real estate, Ann spent two decades in personal development within the oil and gas industry. That experience strengthened her ability to communicate, understand different perspectives, and build lasting professional relationships.
Ann is known for her down-to-earth personality, determination, and ability to find solutions when challenges arise. Whether helping someone make a move, purchase an investment, or sell a property, clients can count on her to provide thoughtful, professional guidance every step of the way.

agents.bio:
Justin Chavez is a Houston real estate agent, brokerage owner, and real estate advisor serving Greater Houston, including The Woodlands, Conroe, Magnolia, Katy, Memorial, Tanglewood, Galleria / Uptown Houston, the Texas Medical Center area, and The Heights.

Justin is the Brokerage Owner of NextHome Woodland Springs, based in The Woodlands, Texas. He works with home buyers, home sellers, relocation clients, luxury buyers, move-up buyers, first-time homebuyers, investors, and new construction clients throughout the Houston market.

Justin has more than 8 years of real estate experience, has been licensed for 5 years, has helped clients through 100+ real estate transactions, and has closed more than $14 million in sales volume over the last 12 months. His experience includes resale homes, new construction homes, luxury properties, investment properties, relocation moves, and family home purchases.

Justin is recognized as a Top 1.5% real estate agent nationwide by RealTrends. He is also a NextHome President’s Circle Award recipient and was named a HAR YPN Top 20 Under 40 Realtor.

Clients work with Justin for clear guidance, pricing strategy, listing preparation, contract negotiation, builder relationships, buyer consultation, seller strategy, and transaction management. For sellers, he helps price and position the home correctly before it goes on the market. For buyers, he helps compare neighborhoods, understand market value, evaluate resale and new construction options, and move from the first showing to closing with a clear plan.

Justin also offers support for Chinese-speaking clients through his real estate partner, who speaks Chinese. This helps families, relocation clients, and international buyers receive clear communication throughout the buying or selling process.

His approach is simple: explain the process clearly, give honest advice, negotiate carefully, and help clients make confident real estate decisions in the Greater Houston area.

agents.bio:
When searching for a real estate professional, some of the most sought-after qualities are integrity, energy, hard work, dedication, and knowledge. To find all of those qualities and more, one need looks no further than Pamela Brown. Pamela's education and work history primed her well for the real estate industry. Her Bachelor's degree in accounting speaks to her talent for numbers and precision and, together with 12 years’ experience in commercial real estate development, as well as six years working with a general contractor and over a decade of residential real estate, leaves her ready to exceed all her clients' expectations.

Pamela grew up in the Chicagoland area, which provided her with a uniquely Midwestern style and sensibility. Having now lived in southern California for over 30 years, she leverages this diverse perspective and a vast array of market knowledge to the benefit of her clients, ranging from first-time buyers to seasoned investors and cross-country relocation clients. She's lived in Brentwood for 30+ years and serves as a Board Member on the Brentwood Community Council and on the Advisory Board of South Brentwood Resident's Association. Often found hiking in the Santa Monica Mountains or walking dogs around the neighborhood, Pamela recalls her own experience finding a home over 30 years ago. "I believe it's important to love where you live. A home is such a significant investment, with the potential to affect both your finances and your quality of life."

Besides being actively involved in serving the community in which she resides, Pamela's passion for service extends to her charitable contributions as well. In addition to being a Board Member of and contributor to The Charitable Foundation, Pamela has volunteered for the West LA Police Department, Make-A-Wish Foundation as a Wish Provider, and has been involved with fundraising for several other organizations such as Hope for Paws, the Children's Hospital of LA, SPCA-LA, St. Jude, USO, ASPCA, and the Red Cross.

remarks: Welcome to one of Houston’s most preserved neighborhoods, the Old 6th Ward historic district, & to a home that dates back to the turn of the 19th century in 1888 (per seller)...The Eggler House at 1812 Kane St. Over the years this wonderful home has transformed from a single story Victorian to a 4-plex. Today it is a 4,499 sf (HCAD) residence that combines its history along w/modern amenities. Versatile floorplan features 5 bedrooms/4 baths + multiple rooms for office space. This beautifully preserved home is adaptable for various uses to live & work from home as a law office, CPA, pilates, art gallery, etc. Downstairs are numerous living/dining areas + well-appointed full kitchen, wet bar, bedroom, 3 full bathrooms & laundry. Upstairs are 4 bedrooms, 2 living areas, kitchen, sunroom, full bathroom plus plumbed former bathroom. Exposed shiplap walls/ceilings & hardwood floors. Sizable backyard + large workshop. Close to area shops, restaurants, entertainment, parks & minutes to downtown.

agents.bio:
Nora Garcia is a Houston REALTOR® with Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Premier Properties, licensed since 2022 and serving clients full-time since 2024. She combines decades of financial and business experience with a client-focused approach to residential real estate. Nora earned a Bachelor's degree in Accounting in 2007 and a Master of Business Administration (MBA) in 2008, giving her clients a strong foundation in financial analysis, strategic planning, and real estate investment decisions. She has worked as an accountant and bookkeeper since 1988, helping individuals and businesses make informed financial decisions with accuracy and integrity.
Nora specializes in residential real estate throughout Houston, with particular expertise in The Heights and Katy. She also serves clients in Montrose, Oak Forest, Memorial, Cypress, Sugar Land, Waller, and Cleveland. Her experience includes approximately 30 residential leases, 3 home sales, 5 buyer transactions, an average of 25 transactions per year, and approximately $1 million in annual sales volume. She works with first-time homebuyers, sellers, relocation clients, new construction buyers, condominium purchasers, historic home buyers, investors, and leasing clients.
As an ABR® (Accredited Buyer's Representative) and Texas Residential Leasing Specialist (TRLS), with her Seller Representative designation in progress, Nora is committed to professional education and exceptional client service. She ranks among the Top 5% of agents in her Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Premier Properties office. Fluent in English and Spanish and conversational Italian and Portuguese, she serves a diverse clientele throughout the Greater Houston area.
In addition to real estate, Nora is a yoga and Body Works instructor, reflecting her commitment to discipline, balance, and helping others achieve their goals. Clients value her financial expertise, professionalism, integrity, and personalized service, empowering them to buy, sell, lease, and invest in Houston real estate with confidence.

remarks: Situated along the rapidly evolving Long Point corridor, this property offers strong potential for redevelopment, renovation or commercial/residential mixed-use. Centrally located just minutes from Downtown Houston, the Galleria & major freeways, this 1951 home sits on a generously sized lot with extended driveway access. Positioned directly across from the upcoming Long Point Social Club & surrounded by new construction, the location benefits from ongoing area growth. Interior features include original solid oak wood flooring, a functional layout with multiple living areas & flexible-use spaces. The kitchen & two full bathrooms were updated in 2024. All appliances convey. Updates in 2022-23 include custom double-pane Low-E sound- efficient windows, exterior insulated steel doors & a radiant barrier attic system for energy efficiency. The backyard, side access & multiple entry points enhance usability & future potential—offering a versatile opportunity in a transforming corridor.

remarks: Custom-built 4-bedroom, 3-bath home on TWO cul-de-sac lots in Houston, TX 77016. Zone X — never flooded. NO HOA. NO RESTRICTIONS — ideal for business owners or buyers needing flexibility. agents.bio:
Katherine Boddeker grew up in New York and loves the bustle of the big city, so her move to the more southern climate of Houston was a smooth transition. She studied dance at the High School of Performing and Visual Arts, and later attended University of Houston for business.

After college, Katherine entered the real estate world in 1989 and has never wanted to do anything else. If you're searching for an expert in the Houston housing market, look no further. She can help you buy, sell, lease, invest, or even build. Having spent nearly thirty years in the business, she is well versed in all areas of the city and all aspects of the market.

First and foremost, Katherine is a mom. She has spent years as an active advocate in her children's schools, both public and private. She understands how important finding the right school for families can be.

Katherine knows that home is where the heart is, and many times, that home includes pets. A lover of animals, she has spent much of her spare time with dog rescues. She has opened up her home for training, fostering, and interviewing potential owners to find the perfect home for these animals she has come to love. She volunteers at pet adoptions and fundraising activities.

If you're looking for an experienced Real Estate Broker who knows the ropes and understands your needs, call Katherine today at 555.483.6838. Her website is: www.katherinetxrealtor.com

remarks:
Stunning Home located in the Heart of Rice Village!

Live steps from Rice Village in this beautiful 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home offering 4,079 sq ft of open-concept living. Features include soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and modern finishes throughout.

The kitchen showcases premium appliances, sleek European-style cabinetry, and natural stone counters, opening to a spacious living and dining area ideal for entertaining. Upstairs, four bedrooms offer walk-in closets, including a primary suite with high ceilings and a private ~600 sq ft deck. A third-floor game room with a dry bar adds flexible space, and the rooftop deck offers panoramic views of downtown and the Medical Center.

Set on a 6,200 sq ft lot in University Place, this home offers walkability to Rice Village and easy access to the Museum District, Medical Center, and downtown. Zoned to HISD, near Poe Elementary, Lanier Middle, and Lamar High.

We have put together a full marketing team, our own staging company, as well as a Preferred Partner Program, which involves a list of vendors that we know, like, and trust.

No truly successful company on the planet has one person doing everything, including the real estate company you hire. We would love to be your expert home selling advisors.

With over 25 years in the real estate industry, and having SOLD thousands of homes, TTG has put together some amazing plans and programs that are unique to our organization, and have the best results in achieving our goals.  We keep our eyes laser focused on the market and what’s ahead, while maintaining a unique culture within our organization.

Our belief in providing the best customer experience keeps us steadfast as innovators, as we continue to differentiate ourselves from our competition.  No other real estate company has employed such strategies and opportunities to help the consumer experience as TTG.

What separates us…

~ The Coming Soon Listing Program - we have a private FB group that we moderate which allows us to market our listings, before they are active, to the top producers in our industry~ 
~ Our own “Make it Pretty” Program allows you, the homeowner, to have repairs done on your home prior to listing, with no upfront cost to you
~ Professional STAGING INCLUDED with our own staging company Honeybee Homestaging & More

~ Easy Exit Listing Plan - you can fire us for any reason if you are not 100% satisfied 
~ Flexible Commission Plan - Pay as little as zero% commission
~ Immediate Buyout Program with our own CASH OFFER DIVISION
~ Love It or Leave It Program - if you’re not happy in your home during the first 12 months of owning it, we’ll sell it for you for FREE (waive the listing broker fee of 3%)
~ Immediate Response System - All buyer inquiries will be handled in 5 minutes or less and most often within the first 60 seconds
~ Reverse Offer Strategy - this lets us go to buyers that may be on the fence about your home and make an offer to them, with terms, conditions, and prices that are acceptable to all parties
~ Preferred Partner Program - a list of vendors that we work exclusively with - you can locate them at:   www.residentialservicedirectory.com
~ Move for Free - use of our company moving truck at no charge...forever

With the real estate industry always changing, it is imperative that we stay ahead of the curve and always have the best techniques to help you, the consumer, with one of the largest investments in your life

remarks: Situated along the rapidly evolving Long Point corridor, this property offers strong potential for redevelopment, renovation or commercial/residential mixed-use. Positioned directly across from the upcoming Long Point Social Club & surrounded by new construction, the location benefits from ongoing area growth. The backyard, side access & multiple entry points enhance usability & future potential—offering a versatile opportunity in a transforming corridor.

Bay Oaks, is a premier golf community located in southeast Houston’s Clear Lake/NASA area. Dan McCarver knows the Clear Lake Real Estate Market very well.

Dan is a native Houstonian and a second-generation Realtor. Licensed since 1977, Dan is familiar with Clear Lake’s finest neighborhoods and focuses on the golf community of Bay Oaks.

He has handled over 620+ resale homes in Bay Oaks over the last twenty-two years. Over the years, Dan’s stellar reputation has earned him referrals and repeat business as the “go-to” agent for Bay Oaks properties and other Clear Lake area luxury residences.

Exemplary service is his standard. Dan possesses cool confidence, a professional demeanor, and a gracious personality, which is a winning combination and approach to his craft.

Mentored by his Mother, Barbara McCarver, a leading Real Estate Broker in Houston for 50 years, Barbara served as the first female President of the Houston Association of Realtors. Dan comments, “Real estate is a challenging and rewarding business. Having grown up around home sales, it seems second nature to me.”

Dan McCarver has achieved the #1 position in resale real estate transaction sales volume many times in the Clear Lake area. His success is no surprise. The honors and recognition he has received are indicative of his commitment, professionalism, and level of understanding in this specialized discriminating market.

Working from an award-winning office recognized for both production and quality of service, Cindy and her team has earned the trust and respect of their clients. Their reputation is built on professionalism, integrity, and exceptional client care.
Community Commitment
The Boutwell Team believes real estate is about more than buying and selling homes—it’s about building stronger communities. Cindy and Dan are proud to partner with local schools throughout the year, volunteering at events, speaking at 1000 Guys in Ties and 1000 Girls in Tiaras, Volunteering at local schools providing support for teachers.
They also give back by supporting Family Ties, Family Resource Services, where Cindy currently serves as Board President. Through fundraising efforts and hands-on service, they continue to make a positive difference in the lives of local families. The Boutwell Team ONLY partners with local title companies, lenders, cleaning crews, contractors that share the same values of giving back to our local community.

Unmatched Market Knowledge – Dan and Cindy EACH have over 22 years of experience successfully negotiating contracts, listing homes, representing both buyers and sellers and investors.

Our culture is built around service, trust, and relationships. When you work with The Boutwell Team, you’re treated like family. We believe in relationships over transactions, guiding you with honesty, transparency, and care every step of the way. From the first meeting to the closing table and beyond, you’ll feel supported, informed, and confident in your decisions.

Our 12 agents work in a supportive environment where knowledge is freely shared, achievements are celebrated, and personal growth is encouraged. We believe that when our team feels valued and empowered, our clients receive the very best service possible.
The Team
The Cindy Boutwell Team is comprised of local community leaders who share a commitment to exceptional service. Their collective goal is to provide clients with the knowledge, tools, and confidence they need to make the best decisions—whether buying a dream home or selling a current one.

agents.bio:
Kate Myhan brings a highly distinctive background to commercial real estate, combining international business experience, advanced academic training, strategic marketing expertise, and hands-on dealmaking across multiple asset types. Based in Houston, Texas, Kate works with commercial property owners, investors, developers, landlords, tenants, and business buyers locally, nationally, and internationally. In addition to representing clients in Texas, she also works with national buyers pursuing opportunities in other states, helping them identify, evaluate, and secure the right assets based on their investment goals.

With a Master’s in Economics and more than two decades of experience in marketing, management, client relations, and real estate investing, Kate offers a sophisticated, results-driven approach to every assignment. Her professional background includes serving as a strategic marketing professor in Santiago, Chile, where she taught MBA students and developed high-level expertise in positioning, negotiation, market strategy, and consumer behavior. That international academic and business experience gives her a rare advantage in commercial real estate, especially when advising clients on marketability, asset positioning, and investment potential.

Kate has built her reputation on strong relationships, creative problem-solving, relentless work ethic, and an ability to connect the right people to the right opportunities. She is known for identifying value where others may not, whether in on-market listings, off-market deals, redevelopment sites, land opportunities, industrial assets, retail properties, mixed-use projects, multifamily investments, or business-related real estate transactions. Her combination of analytical thinking and marketing expertise allows her to not only find opportunities, but also present and promote properties in a way that drives attention and results.

Her experience is especially valuable to clients seeking guidance on acquisitions, dispositions, site selection, development potential, investment strategy, and high-visibility property marketing. Kate understands that commercial real estate success requires more than simply listing a property or submitting an offer—it requires insight, negotiation skill, persistence, financial awareness, and the ability to create momentum around a deal. She approaches each client relationship with professionalism, urgency, and a commitment to maximizing value.

Kate is a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Texas REALTORS®, National Association of Realtors, and the CCIM Institute. She holds respected industry credentials including CCIM (Certified Commercial Investment Member), CIPS (Certified International Property Specialist), TACS (Texas Accredited Commercial Specialist), and CRS (Certified Residential Specialist). Fluent in English, Spanish, French, and Polish, she is able to work effectively with a diverse range of clients, including international investors and cross-border buyers.

Clients appreciate Kate for her extensive market knowledge, global perspective, broad-based network, and unwavering devotion to their success. Her business is built largely through referrals and repeat relationships, reflecting the trust she earns through outstanding service, strategic guidance, and strong results. Whether representing a Houston-based owner, an out-of-state investor, or a national buyer expanding into new markets, Kate brings the experience, intelligence, and dealmaking energy needed to move complex transactions forward.

agents.bio:
Nora Garcia is a Houston REALTOR® with Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Premier Properties, licensed since 2022 and serving clients full-time since 2024. She combines decades of financial and business experience with a client-focused approach to residential real estate. Nora earned a Bachelor's degree in Accounting in 2007 and a Master of Business Administration (MBA) in 2008, giving her clients a strong foundation in financial analysis, strategic planning, and real estate investment decisions. She has worked as an accountant and bookkeeper since 1988, helping individuals and businesses make informed financial decisions with accuracy and integrity.
Nora specializes in residential real estate throughout Houston, with particular expertise in The Heights and Katy. She also serves clients in Montrose, Oak Forest, Memorial, Cypress, Sugar Land, Waller, and Cleveland. Her experience includes approximately 30 residential leases, 3 home sales, 5 buyer transactions, an average of 25 transactions per year, and approximately $1 million in annual sales volume. She works with first-time homebuyers, sellers, relocation clients, new construction buyers, condominium purchasers, historic home buyers, investors, and leasing clients.
As an ABR® (Accredited Buyer's Representative) and Texas Residential Leasing Specialist (TRLS), with her Seller Representative designation in progress, Nora is committed to professional education and exceptional client service. She ranks among the Top 5% of agents in her Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Premier Properties office. Fluent in English and Spanish and conversational Italian and Portuguese, she serves a diverse clientele throughout the Greater Houston area.
In addition to real estate, Nora is a yoga and Body Works instructor, reflecting her commitment to discipline, balance, and helping others achieve their goals. Clients value her financial expertise, professionalism, integrity, and personalized service, empowering them to buy, sell, lease, and invest in Houston real estate with confidence.

remarks: This is a fabulous home with so much potential. Spacious traditional with 5 bedrooms, 3.5 bathrooms and a 2-car detached garage in Greenwood Forest. Off the entry is a formal dining room to the right and a formal living room to the left which could easily function as a study. The huge den has built-ins, cabinets, block paneling and Saltillo brick tile. The kitchen has granite countertops, stainless sink, solid surface cooktop and stainless vent hood. Open breakfast area and wet bar open onto the den which is great for entertaining. There is a half bath and an indoor utility room conveniently located for access. Upstairs you will find oversized bedrooms with generous closets. The primary bedroom boasts a fireplace for cozy evenings. The primary bath has double sinks, separate vanity area and his and hers walk-in closets. The big backyard has plenty of room for gardening, play equipment and a large patio. The home is being sold "as is with no repairs" and is priced accordingly.

remarks: Stunning contemporary ranch in sought-after Afton Oaks, updated for modern living and entertaining. A redesigned front elevation, circular driveway, and steel-and-glass entry door create impressive curb appeal. Inside, the open-concept layout features LVP flooring, raised ceilings, LED lighting, and abundant natural light. The gourmet island kitchen offers updated cabinetry, countertops, stainless steel appliances, ample prep space and seating, opening to the living area. Renovated bathrooms feature contemporary finishes. The backyard is a private retreat with a sparkling fenced pool, multiple gathering areas, and covered patio with vaulted ceiling and summer kitchen—perfect for entertaining. The air-conditioned garage with epoxy flooring and Murphy bed provides flexible space for an office, gym or guest area. Updates include HVAC, roof, water heater and interior doors. Conveniently located near major freeways, the Galleria, River Oaks District, Downtown and Texas Medical Center.

Jaime is an innovative, trustworthy and committed professional who has a vested interest in making sure his clients are completely satisfied with his guidance and advice at the end of each transaction. Jaime is originally from Colombia, speaks Spanish, English and basic Portuguese and has lived in major metropolitan cities such as Miami, London, Sydney and most recently, New York. The diversity, opportunity and quality of life brought him to Houston and now he prides himself by calling it his home. He has a degree in Finance from the University of Florida and more than 7 years of experience in international banking in Wall Street, NY. He is confident that his experience, integrity, customer service and great attitude will benefit your real estate negotiations and he strongly believes that his success will continue to be determined by impressed clients and constant referrals.

remarks: Step inside and immediately feel the difference—abundant natural light, expansive living spaces and an effortless open layout give this 4-bedroom, 3-bath home an inviting sense of space. At the heart of the home, a generous living room is wrapped in windows and anchored by a striking fireplace, flowing naturally into the kitchen and dining areas. A downstairs secondary bedroom with access to a full bath offers exceptional flexibility, while upstairs reveals a spacious primary retreat with two walk-in closets and a large game room with tall ceilings. Outside, the covered extended patio creates an impressive setting for relaxing and entertaining overlooking the fenced backyard. With 2,256 sq. ft., a 2-car garage and convenient access to West Houston/Katy shopping, dining and entertainment, this home delivers space where it matters most. Schedule your private tour.

agents.bio:
It could be said that either, you have a passion for real estate or you simply don’t. Without a shadow of doubt, Richard has that passion. He achieved is first real estate license at the age of 18 years old in Johannesburg South Africa. Ever since getting his license, all he has known is residential real estate. Evidence of this, are the best listing and best selling awards he has received in his early years. His passion and energy has served him well. By the age of 21 years old, he was managing an estate agency consisting of 25 experienced estate agents. But that was not enough, with a bold vision and an idea, he decided to go into partnership and start his own residential brokerage in 2009. During this time, Richard earned the esteemed designation of Master Practitioner in Real Estate. He successfully grew the business into a leading estate agency in Alberton & Johannesburg South area in South Africa.

By 2017 a new challenge was calling. He founded Stratton Real Estate in Johannesburg. The business quickly grew into a successful boutique brokerage, which delivered a more personal “white-glove” experience. In 2019, Richard immigrated to Houston Texas, and instantly fell in love with the city and its people. They say, “you might not have been born in Texas, but you got here as quick as you could.” For Richard, this is true. He is always very excited to show new comers to Houston why this is the best place for them and their family.

Richard’s ability to succeed and become a leading estate agent can be attributed to some key traits which makes him stand out from the crowd, namely his high energy, caring, friendly and compassionate nature. When you couple this with his relentless drive, attention to detail, along with a winning, “can do” attitude, you have a uniquely dynamic and qualified property professional, who will guide you to realize, your real estate goals.

When Richard is not shaking up the Houston residential property market, he is spending his time with is beautiful wife Roxanne. Richard’s guilty pleasure is Tex-Mex, Texas BBQ and desserts. So if you like good food, just ask Richard where the best restaurants are. Richard is a big sport fans. Growing up just outside of Newcastle, England, he is a huge Newcastle United fan, and he is also a big Rugby fan and not to mention an enthusiastic Texans fan. Richard always welcomes a little friendly banter from opposing sports fans.

agents.bio: Patricia is originally from Salinas, California and moved to Houston over 39 years ago. She has 32 years of experience in the real estate realm, that include purchasing, rehabbing, investing, and selling. She is a landlord with multiple homes in the Houston area. She also has over 28 years of experience in the construction industry having managed estimating teams on multi-million dollar projects. Patricia holds two B.S. degrees from Prairie View A&M University, one in Construction Science and one in Architecture and graduated Summa Cum Laude. In 2016 she received her graduate degree from Prairie View A&M University in Community Development. Patricia is very passionate about helping her clients find their dream home, and making sure they are educated in every aspect of the process.

remarks: Luxury high-rise living in the heart of the Museum District! This 2-bedroom, 2-bath condo on the 14th floor of 5000 Montrose offers stunning panoramic views of the city skyline and Hermann Park. The open layout features floor-to-ceiling windows, hardwood floors, and a spacious living/dining area filled with natural light. Enjoy resort-style amenities including 24-hour concierge, fitness center, rooftop pool, outdoor lounge, and secure parking. The private balcony offers spectacular views of the city skyline! Perfectly situated near the Medical Center, museums including MoFA and HMNS, Hermann Park and the Houston Zoo. The condo fee covers more than standard upkeep—it includes strong reserves for future maintenance and replacement of elevators, HVAC systems, hot water tanks, and common area furnishings and décor. Thanks to this proactive management, special assessments have been rare—just one in the past 20 years.

remarks: Renovated and lifted modern bungalow with NO HOA and NO RESTRICTIONS on a private road with only 8 homeowners on the block! This 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers 2,747 sq. ft. per Seller plus a 22x20 bonus room that could serve as a media room, game room, office, or optional guest suite. Features include an open floor plan, a granite kitchen island, a walk-in pantry, custom wood cabinetry, ceiling beams, stainless steel appliances, a fireplace, recessed lighting, double-pane windows, tile and travertine flooring, and much more. The backyard offers a private retreat with a heated beach-entry pool and patio misting system. The extended driveway accommodates up to 12 vehicles. A lifted foundation provides insulated storage and recreation space beneath the home. Updates include 2020 roof, 2020 HVAC, 2025 water heater, 2025 pool pump motor, smart home system, and a new iron-fenced gate. Conveniently located near Bellaire HS, Galleria, Medical Center, Downtown Houston, and Brays Bayou trails.

agents.bio:
Jeni Raymond is a native Houstonian and experienced REALTOR® specializing in both residential and commercial real estate. Inspired by a family legacy of real estate developers, she has built a successful career helping clients buy, sell, and invest across many of Houston's most desirable neighborhoods. Known as the "Realtor on the Run", Jeni brings energy, integrity, and personal attention to every transaction. She holds certifications including Seller Representative Specialist (SRS), Accredited Buyer's Representative (ABR), Accredited Luxury Home Specialist (ALHS), Certified Home Marketing Specialist (CHMS), and Real Estate Negotiation Expert (RENE).
Jeni is actively involved in the community as an Advisory Board Member of the Houston Health Foundation, a member of the Heart Guild, and a dedicated member of Houston's First Baptist Church. She previously served as Executive Director for CC4C.org and continues to carry that same heart for service into her real estate career. Outside of work, Jeni enjoys early morning races, running Houston's trails, spending time with family and friends, discovering new coffee shops, and exploring Houston's incredible dining scene. 
She is a member of the National Association of REALTORS®, Texas REALTORS®, and the Houston Association of REALTORS® (HAR).

remarks: 9517 Bayou Brook St. is a home located in the subdivision of Woodlake Forest. It backs to a beautiful, natural, landscape and includes a flagstone patio and wooden patio deck, which makes relaxing or entertaining a breeze. A wall of windows overlooking the backyard from both the living room, the first floor primary bedroom and secondary bedroom on the second floor, allows for a pristine view. Tile and wood floors grace the entire first floor and second floor, with the exception of the flex space/game room upstairs, which has carpeting. Upstairs, the two spacious bedrooms can easily accommodate a seating area, or study/desk area. Freshly painted with a neutral color palette, the home is move in ready and provides a beautiful backdrop for any decor style. Centrally located in the memorial area it offers convenience to the Energy Corridor, Galleria, shopping and restaurants. Pickleball courts are currently being renovated and are just steps away from the home, along with the pool.

remarks: Beautifully maintained 4-bedroom, 2.5-bath home in Oak Park Place. The open-concept floor plan features spacious living, dining, and kitchen areas. The kitchen offers granite countertops, gas range, ample cabinetry, and generous workspace. Upstairs, all four bedrooms feature EXTRA generous space and true walk-in closets. The primary suite includes crown molding and a private bath with dual vanities, separate shower, and jetted soaking tub. Enjoy the Texas-size extended covered patio, perfect for dining, entertaining, or relaxing. The backyard offers NO BACK NEIGHBORS. Additional highlights include: an HVAC REPLACED IN 2025, with WASHER, DRYER AND FRIDGE INCLUDED. Enjoy nearby parks, recreation, walking and biking opportunities, plus community splash pads, parks, bayous with fishing, and approximately 10 miles of bike trails. Conveniently located near Highway 6 and Westpark Tollway, with easy access to Westchase, the Energy Corridor, Sugar Land, Katy shopping, dining, and entertainment.

remarks: Welcome to 11020 Little John Way! This meticulously maintained Mediterranean style corner home combines timeless architectural charm with modern comfort. Elegant archways, abundant natural light, and a bright, open-concept layout create an inviting atmosphere throughout. The spacious kitchen features beautiful granite countertops and flows seamlessly into the living areas, ideal for entertaining. The impressive primary suite offers a private covered balcony, custom walk-in closet, and spa-inspired bath with dual vanities, soaking tub, and separate shower. Major upgrades include a new roof (2024), A/C system (2022), reverse osmosis system (2021), and owned water softener. Enjoy a private, fully fenced side yard and the convenience of a gated community. Ideally located with easy access to I-10, Loop 610, and major highways, just minutes from CityCentre, Memorial City Mall, and Downtown Houston. Beautifully maintained, move-in ready, and full of character—schedule your private tour today!

remarks: Cared for by loving homeowners for years, this beautiful 1908 Highland Park Craftsman is now available in the heart of North East Los Angeles. You need to see it in person, and experience this location for yourself. Close to many popular favorite shops, restaurants and cultural attractions, you can walk to any of those OR the park just a half block away! The street front automatic gate entry is the best option on your path to and from many treasures of Highland Park. Once you're inside the artistic and stylish wrought iron gate of this property, there is a feeling of private tranquility and relaxation. Sitting comfortably above the street, you can see the treetop vista and marvel at the peaceful ambiance. Or enter from the back alley, which provides easy garage parking and access to spacious patios, sparkling pool and yard. This home has been lovingly updated with tasteful design choices, as well as structural and system upgrades such as foundation retrofit and paid off solar panels for long term value. The pool was replastered and pool equipment replaced within the last 4 years. Outdoor spaces are abundant and give so many options for relaxation and entertaining. You could just kick back on the secluded front porch to enjoy the views and surroundings. This will be an amazing home for the next owners, just as it is right now. Don't miss this one! It's special... Measured floor plans suggest 1,410 sf. Ask about possible $20k grant for rate buy down or buyer closing cost credit.

remarks: This beatifully maintained home is located just minutes from downtown Houston, great and spacious open concept living on the first floor, with access to a fully fenced-in backyard. The kitchen was built with plenty of storage cabinets and a pantry under the stairs. Upstairs you'll find a primary bedroom with a balcony to relaxe and enjoy your mornings or evenings, a bathroom that feels like a retreat equiped with a glass shower, bathtub, double vanity, and great closet space. Two additional bedrooms share a bathroom, each room with its own sink. 2 car garage and additional space to park in the driveway. Come experience the inner loop life, 8 minutes from downtown, St. Arnold's, Meow Wolf, and 10 minutes from the University of Houston, easy access to Houston's major freeways.

agents.bio: Henrry is a dedicated residential real estate agent specializing in the vibrant markets of Houston and Galveston. Before real estate, he spent 14 years in a career in sales and business development in the Oil & Gas industry which took him all over the world and now allows him to bring a diverse perspective and connect with a broad spectrum of clients. Yet his real estate journey started a decade earlier, after making the purchase of his first home, initially assisting and guiding friends and family with their home-buying processes based on his personal experiences. He quickly realized his natural aptitude for real estate and for the past 6 years, he has transformed his passion for real estate into a successful career, leading clients in the sale or purchase of their homes and investment, from first time home buyers to luxury homes and multi million dollar investments. Henrry has a true heart for people and is devoted to the welfare of his clients.

remarks: Tucked away with no back neighbors, this custom Kickerillo home in Olde Oaks pairs timeless character and craftsmanship with over $170K in documented updates. The 3-bed, 3.5-bath plan with a possible 4th bedroom offers 3,066 SF on nearly 1/4 acre with soaring ceilings, crown molding and rich wood details. The family room features a two-story brick fireplace, wet bar, wine cooler and arched windows overlooking the pool and spa. The island kitchen offers double ovens, two pantries and a bay-window breakfast room. The primary suite has an accessible custom shower and a cedar-lined closet. Upstairs, a game room overlooks the family room. Updates include a 24kW whole-home generator, PEX re-pipe, Trane A/C, 2025 roof and exterior storm repairs and a replastered pool with new heater and pump. Oversized garage with workshop. NEVER FLOODED, including Harvey and Ike! Northgate Country Club membership available. Near Downtown, The Woodlands and IAH.

remarks: Cared for by loving homeowners for years, this beautiful 1908 Highland Park Craftsman is now available in the heart of North East Los Angeles. You need to see it in person, and experience this location for yourself. Close to many popular favorite shops, restaurants and cultural attractions, you can walk to any of those OR the park just a half block away! The street front automatic gate entry is the best option on your path to and from many treasures of Highland Park. Once you're inside the artistic and stylish wrought iron gate of this property, there is a feeling of private tranquility and relaxation. Sitting comfortably above the street, you can see the treetop vista and marvel at the peaceful ambiance. Or enter from the back alley, which provides easy garage parking and access to spacious patios, sparkling pool and yard. This home has been lovingly updated with tasteful design choices, as well as structural and system upgrades such as foundation retrofit and paid off solar panels for long term value. The pool was replastered and pool equipment replaced within the last 4 years. Outdoor spaces are abundant and give so many options for relaxation and entertaining. You could just kick back on the secluded front porch to enjoy the views and surroundings. This will be an amazing home for the next owners, just as it is right now. Don't miss this one! It's special... Measured floor plans suggest 1,410 sf. Ask about possible $20k grant for rate buy down or buyer closing cost credit.

agents.bio:
With over a decade in the real estate industry, Jonathan Williamson has been a dynamic force in buying, selling, and managing properties. Since becoming a licensed agent in 2013, he has completed over 300 transactions, showcasing an unparalleled commitment to his clients and excellence in service.

Jonathan began his career in real estate as an investor and has personally acquired and sold tens of millions of dollars worth of real estate; a boast few realtors can make. He has experience flipping, remodeling, and building homes, and has also owned dozens of rental properties. This wealth of experience provides him with a deep understanding of the needs of builders and investors, which he skillfully leverages to the benefit of his clients. With Jonathan, clients are able to focus on their own needs in a home while he looks toward the future for any obstacles that might prevent them from getting top dollar for their investment.

Committed to the community, Jonathan has served on the board of the Women's Council of Realtors and the Art League of Houston. His passion for philanthropy extends to animal rescue and welfare, where he has fostered and found homes for dozens of animals in need.

Living in the charming heavily wooded subdivision of Grogan's Mill with his amazing wife and two beloved rescue dogs, Jonathan embraces a life of service, passion, and excellence. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, a seasoned investor, a home builder or somewhere in between, Jonathan is dedicated to making your real estate journey memorable and successful.

remarks: Nestled beneath mature trees in Houston's established Olde Oaks community, this beautifully maintained 4 bedroom, 2.5 bath home offers 2,626 square feet of timeless charm and modern comfort. The first floor features stylish wood look tile flooring, a dramatic living room with vaulted ceilings, rustic wood beams, floor to ceiling windows, and a brick gas log fireplace. The updated kitchen boasts granite countertops, soft close cabinetry, a tile backsplash, and a bright bay window breakfast area. The main level primary suite includes dual vanities, granite counters, an oversized shower, and a soaking tub. Upstairs offers a spacious game room and three additional bedrooms with wood flooring. Additional highlights include Low E windows, dual Wi Fi thermostats, and a rare 3 car garage with an air conditioned workshop. The backyard is shaded by mature trees, creating a peaceful outdoor setting. Conveniently located with easy access to FM 1960, I 45, and the Hardy Toll Road.

The spacious primary suite offers a spa-inspired bath with dual vanities and an oversized frameless glass walk-in shower. Both bathrooms have been tastefully remodeled with high-end finishes. A large climate-controlled sunroom provides valuable additional living space that's perfect for entertaining, a game room, home office, fitness area, or year-round relaxation. Conveniently located with quick access to Beltway 8, I-45, and HWY 249, making commuting to Downtown Houston. Move-in ready and designed for today's lifestyle, this is one you won't want to miss.

remarks: Luxury, privacy & effortless living await in Lakes of Parkway! Beautifully maintained by its original owner, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath Mediterranean home offers 2,823 SF in a desirable cul-de-sac setting. Soaring ceilings and continuous tile floors enhance the open, light-filled living spaces, while a cast-stone fireplace with built-ins adds architectural character. The spacious kitchen features granite counters, stainless appliances, gas cooking & built-in Sub-Zero refrigerator. First-floor primary suite provides convenient main-level living, with 2 secondary bedrooms & bath upstairs. Step outside to a generous covered patio, mature landscaping & an exceptionally private backyard with no residential neighbor directly behind. Clay tile roof plus a $10K tankless water heater system. Immaculately cared for and move-in ready, all within the 24-hour guarded & gated Lakes of Parkway community in the Energy Corridor.

remarks: Welcome to a home with the space, character and flexibility to make it your own. Set on a 10,125-square-foot lot in Spring Branch Oaks, this four-bedroom residence offers four full baths, one half bath and 3,173 square feet of living area per a 2009 appraisal. A dramatic two-story great room with a wood-burning fireplace anchors the home, while the centrally located kitchen and dining areas create a natural flow for everyday living and entertaining. A covered rear veranda overlooks the generous backyard, and an elevator-ready shaft provides an option for improved access between levels. Personalize the home over time—from paint, flooring, lighting and fixtures to updated kitchens and baths or more extensive professionally planned improvements—all while preserving the character and function of the existing home.

Nicholas "Nick" Chambers is a Broker Associate with Realty of America (ROA) and founder of Chambers Properties Group, serving homeowners, buyers, investors, and relocation clients throughout Houston and the Greater Houston area.

With more than 17 years of experience in Texas real estate, Nick helps clients make informed decisions through strategic planning, market analysis, and data-driven pricing rather than sales pressure. His advisory approach is built around protecting equity, reducing risk, and creating clear decision paths during significant life transitions.

Nick works with clients buying or selling primary residences, luxury homes, new construction, relocation properties, and select investment real estate throughout Houston's diverse neighborhoods. Every recommendation is tailored to current market conditions, local buyer behavior, inventory levels, and each client's goals and timeline.

Rather than treating real estate as a transaction, Nick approaches every property as a financial asset. Sellers receive guidance on pricing strategy, property preparation, market positioning, and negotiation. Buyers benefit from objective market analysis, competitive offer strategy, and clear advice on when to move forward—or when patience creates a stronger opportunity.

• Residential listing representation
• Strategic home selling and pricing analysis
• Buyer representation and negotiation
• Luxury real estate advisory

River Oaks • Memorial • West University • Bellaire • The Heights • Rice Military • Timbergrove • Oak Forest • Cypress • Bridgeland • Towne Lake • Katy • Energy Corridor • Sugar Land • Spring • Tomball • The Woodlands and surrounding communities.
