Every client engagement begins with understanding three questions:

From there, recommendations are based on market data, pricing trends, buyer demand, and proven execution—not assumptions or one-size-fits-all solutions.

agents.bio: I am a native Houstonian and familiar with its ever-changing market conditions. I began my career out of college as an engineer in the oil and gas industry. I later discovered my real passion is real estate. Real estate has allowed me to use my natural talents (listening, empathizing, communicating, and applying competence) to the favorable benefit of many others. My engineering background enables me to provide the attention to detail and scrutiny real estate transactions require.  The Romar Team later evolved to provide improved efficiency and service to our clients. Together we provide over 30 years of experience in real estate. Our specialized marketing plan and work systems allow us to provide premium services to our clients during and long past the transaction's completion. We never go away. My team and I remain students in the industry and continue to seek ways to improve and grow.  Most of our business is by referral from clients who have enjoyed a trustworthy, competent, and professional service, who, in turn, want the same for their friends, family, and co-workers. Earning and maintaining their trust is paramount. We earnestly seek to provide our clients with a "great experience," not just great customer service. After all, we are "Your Castle Keys Connector."

remarks: This stunning 5-bedroom, 3.5-bath home offers the perfect blend of comfort and functionality for everyday living and entertaining. The open-concept kitchen seamlessly flows into the spacious family room, creating an inviting space to gather, while the bright breakfast area provides the ideal spot for morning coffee. Upstairs, enjoy a large game room complete with an adjacent carved out space for a study nook, perfect for movie nights, homework, or working from home. The primary suite is a private retreat featuring double vanities, a soaking tub, a separate shower, and a generous walk-in closet. Step outside to a spacious backyard ready for entertaining, play, or a future pool. Located on a quiet cul-de-sac, this home offers added privacy with convenient access to major highways, the Texas Medical Center, Downtown, and NRG Park.

agents.bio:
Laree understands that buying or selling a home is one of the most important financial decisions a person can make—and he approaches every transaction with that in mind. A licensed Realtor since 2017, he is known for building strong, lasting relationships with his clients before, during, and after the process.

With a balance of professional expertise and genuine care, Laree brings strong problem-solving skills and expert negotiation to every deal while remaining highly attentive to each client’s unique needs. His philosophy is simple: serve, not sell. Clients can always count on his honesty, transparency, and dedication.

As an Accredited MCNE (Master Certified Negotiation Expert), Laree specializes in the West Houston and Katy areas, while proudly assisting buyers and sellers throughout the greater Houston region.

remarks: Charming single-story home in the established Olympia subdivision featuring 3 bedrooms, 2 baths, and approximately 1,942 sq/ft of comfortable living space. The kitchen includes a breakfast bar, gas range, and ample cabinetry, flowing seamlessly into a bright breakfast area. The primary suite is located on the first floor and features an en-suite bath with double sinks, while secondary bedrooms are well-sized for guests or home office use. Enjoy a fully fenced backyard with a covered patio, perfect for outdoor relaxation or entertaining. Additional highlights include a 2-car attached garage, utility room in-house, ceiling fans, and a convenient location with easy access to major roadways, shopping, and dining.

 Not only are her tactics unique, but they have been shaped by years of experience as a mortgage broker. Whether a buyer or a seller, you will appreciate her competence and patience coupled with her zeal in finding the perfect home or investment for her clients.  When Tilah is not working, she loves spending time with her daughter. She enjoys traveling, watching movies, reading inspirational books, and working out.

remarks: A showstopping transformation. A home designed to bring people together. Set on a cul-de-sac, this renovated 5,800-square-foot residence pairs impressive scale with effortless indoor-outdoor living. Six bedrooms and 5.5 baths offer exceptional flexibility, while two staircases enhance the layout. Two family rooms upstairs provide space to relax and gather. Collapsible doors open the living room to a stunning pool, creating a backdrop for lively gatherings and quiet evenings alike. Two kitchens make entertaining a pleasure, with a pantry and laundry room adding convenience. A dining room with a privacy feature offers an intimate setting for memorable meals. The versatile pool room invites possibilities for a wellness retreat or future cold-plunge space. From poolside afternoons to celebrations that flow indoors and out, 9414 Endicott Ln delivers room to live beautifully, host generously and unwind in style. Zoned to Kolter Elementary and Bellaire High School.

Keri Josephson and his family have been a part of Texas real estate so long they have original land grants from Mexico from when they arrived with Stephen F. Austin in East Texas. Keri has been in Houston for over 17 years, and it has been fun seeing all the changes that have happened during this time. He lived in Argentina for two years after high school where he picked up Spanish and a love for Latin American food and culture. He graduated from Brigham Young University in Provo Utah where he studied biology, international business, and Spanish. Keri has two grown daughters that he loves spending time with when their schedules allow. His long-term goal is to have a garage full of roadsters, he has always enjoyed a convertible roadster. He has had a passion for cars ever since his grandmother took him to auto shows as a child. Keri works hard daily to be the person his dog, Maker, sees him as.

remarks: First-floor living and no carpet throughout in a gated community in Houston's Garden Oaks area! 1006 Shepherd Oaks Dr. offers 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths and a versatile three-story layout. Living, dining and kitchen are on the first floor, with granite countertops, subway tile backsplash, stainless steel KitchenAid appliances and hardwood flooring. The second floor features the primary suite plus another bedroom with an en-suite bath. Two spacious bedrooms and a full bath on the third floor offer flexibility for guests or a home office. Home automation adds convenience. Community amenities include green spaces, a gazebo area and ample guest parking. Enjoy nearby restaurants, breweries, coffee shops, parks and The Stomping Grounds, plus proximity to the Houston Heights. Approximately one mile from Loop 610, with convenient access to US 290 and routes to Downtown Houston, the Galleria and the Energy Corridor.

With 25 years of experience and deep Houston roots, I help buyers, sellers, and relocating professionals move with confidence. I specialize in Houston’s most sought-after areas—from Rice Military, The Heights, Memorial, Bellaire, and West University to Katy, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, and Pearland. My approach blends local expertise, market strategy, and concierge-level service to deliver exceptional results.

As one of the world’s first AI-Certified Agents, I use advanced tools to market smarter, negotiate stronger, and make every step of the process seamless. Whether you’re buying your first home, selling a luxury property, or relocating across the globe, I create a tailored plan that fits your goals and lifestyle.

Clients know me as a calm, strategic advisor who listens, solves problems, and advocates fiercely on their behalf. Many even become lifelong friends.

If you’re looking for a trusted partner who combines experience, innovation, and genuine care—I’d love to help you make your next move.

Brooks Ballard is a seasoned real estate visionary and the driving force behind Brooks Ballard International Real Estate. With over 25 years of experience in the luxury real estate market, Brooks is recognized for delivering world-class service, market expertise, and results-driven strategies to discerning clients across Houston, Texas, and globally.

As a trusted name in luxury real estate, Brooks has built his reputation on integrity, innovation, and an unwavering commitment to excellence. He has successfully represented high-profile buyers, sellers, investors, and developers in some of the most prestigious neighborhoods, including River Oaks, Memorial, The Heights, West University, and Tanglewood.

Brooks’ firm is more than a brokerage—it’s a concierge-style real estate experience. His team specializes in luxury listings, international marketing, relocation services, new construction, and high-end property management. With a global network and a deep understanding of both local and international markets, Brooks delivers personalized strategies that help clients maximize their investments and lifestyle goals.

As a former affiliate of Engel & Völkers, Brooks brings European sophistication and global marketing reach combined with Texas-sized hospitality. Whether you're buying your dream home, selling a signature estate, or exploring investment opportunities, Brooks Ballard International Real Estate offers a seamless and strategic approach backed by unparalleled service and discretion.

remarks: Set along the 1st fairway of Royal Oaks Country Club, this residence is designed for those ready to enjoy the game and the lifestyle around it. Wake to sweeping views of the newly renovated course, step out for a round, meet friends for tennis, or stroll to the clubhouse and restaurant without ever getting in the car. Its prized position captures the beauty of the fairway while remaining remarkably protected from golf-ball traffic. Inside, three bedrooms, a private office overlooking the course, two flexible bonus spaces, a media room and a generous primary suite with three custom closets offer effortless comfort. Outdoors, the pool creates a private retreat overlooking the greens. Three car garages, an air-conditioned two-car garage with motorized storage plus a separate single car or golf carts garage make country-club living seamless. Generac generator, automatic awnings, Marvin windows, Sub-Zero and Thermador appliances complete the home.

agents.bio:
Evan Compean is the founder of The Compean Group, a boutique Houston real estate team known for data-driven pricing, high-end marketing and skilled negotiation. A licensed agent since 2012 and a real estate investor since 2002, Evan has sold more than $250 million in real estate and brings a builder's and investor's eye to every home, from foundation and roof to resale value.

Areas: Houston Heights, Woodland Heights, Garden Oaks/Oak Forest, Montrose, Midtown, West University, Bellaire, Spring Branch, Pearland, Katy, Cypress and The Woodlands.

Specialties: Luxury and new construction, investment and multifamily properties, land, first-time buyers, and relocation.

Evan is also a licensed loan officer and a partner at Smart Title, so clients get guidance on financing and closing from someone who knows every step. Se habla español. With 400+ five-star reviews across Zillow, Google, Yelp and Realtor.com, The Compean Group focuses on clear communication and a smooth process from first call to closing.

remarks: Welcome to Robins Landing! This 2024-built, one-story home at 9607 Bright Song Lane offers modern living, a desirable Houston 77078 location, and exceptional value—now priced below its original new-construction sale price. The spacious 3-bedroom, 2-bath home features a versatile den, dining room, game room, utility room, and 2-car attached garage. Enjoy durable tile flooring throughout the main living areas, with carpet in the bedrooms and game room. The open kitchen is equipped with modern appliances and designed for everyday living and entertaining. Additional highlights include a low tax rate and a newer-home feel without the new-construction price tag. Located in the Robins Landing community with convenient access to Houston-area shopping, dining, and major roadways. A great opportunity for buyers seeking a move-in-ready 2024 home in Houston!

agents.bio:
It could be said that either, you have a passion for real estate or you simply don’t. Without a shadow of doubt, Richard has that passion. He achieved is first real estate license at the age of 18 years old in Johannesburg South Africa. Ever since getting his license, all he has known is residential real estate. Evidence of this, are the best listing and best selling awards he has received in his early years. His passion and energy has served him well. By the age of 21 years old, he was managing an estate agency consisting of 25 experienced estate agents. But that was not enough, with a bold vision and an idea, he decided to go into partnership and start his own residential brokerage in 2009. During this time, Richard earned the esteemed designation of Master Practitioner in Real Estate. He successfully grew the business into a leading estate agency in Alberton & Johannesburg South area in South Africa.

By 2017 a new challenge was calling. He founded Stratton Real Estate in Johannesburg. The business quickly grew into a successful boutique brokerage, which delivered a more personal “white-glove” experience. In 2019, Richard immigrated to Houston Texas, and instantly fell in love with the city and its people. They say, “you might not have been born in Texas, but you got here as quick as you could.” For Richard, this is true. He is always very excited to show new comers to Houston why this is the best place for them and their family.

Richard’s ability to succeed and become a leading estate agent can be attributed to some key traits which makes him stand out from the crowd, namely his high energy, caring, friendly and compassionate nature. When you couple this with his relentless drive, attention to detail, along with a winning, “can do” attitude, you have a uniquely dynamic and qualified property professional, who will guide you to realize, your real estate goals.

When Richard is not shaking up the Houston residential property market, he is spending his time with is beautiful wife Roxanne. Richard’s guilty pleasure is Tex-Mex, Texas BBQ and desserts. So if you like good food, just ask Richard where the best restaurants are. Richard is a big sport fans. Growing up just outside of Newcastle, England, he is a huge Newcastle United fan, and he is also a big Rugby fan and not to mention an enthusiastic Texans fan. Richard always welcomes a little friendly banter from opposing sports fans.

remarks: Discover exceptional value in this beautifully renovated condo in the gated Rivington community, where HOA fees include water, electricity, sewer, trash and more for effortless living. Quietly positioned with pool views, this move-in ready home showcases fresh interior paint, crown molding, durable vinyl flooring, and an open layout filled with natural light. The charming kitchen features granite countertops, a recently replaced stove and microwave, refrigerator, and a convenient dual washer/dryer unit. The spacious bedroom offers two generous closets and connects to an updated bath with stylish finishes. Sparkling clean and thoughtfully refreshed, this home blends comfort with everyday convenience. Ideally located near HEB, Kroger, Trader Joe's, Whole Foods, and an outstanding selection of dining and shopping, this is low-maintenance living in one of Houston's most sought-after locations.

Bay Oaks, is a premier golf community located in southeast Houston’s Clear Lake/NASA area. Dan McCarver knows the Clear Lake Real Estate Market very well.

Dan is a native Houstonian and a second-generation Realtor. Licensed since 1977, Dan is familiar with Clear Lake’s finest neighborhoods and focuses on the golf community of Bay Oaks.

He has handled over 620+ resale homes in Bay Oaks over the last twenty-two years. Over the years, Dan’s stellar reputation has earned him referrals and repeat business as the “go-to” agent for Bay Oaks properties and other Clear Lake area luxury residences.

Exemplary service is his standard. Dan possesses cool confidence, a professional demeanor, and a gracious personality, which is a winning combination and approach to his craft.

Mentored by his Mother, Barbara McCarver, a leading Real Estate Broker in Houston for 50 years, Barbara served as the first female President of the Houston Association of Realtors. Dan comments, “Real estate is a challenging and rewarding business. Having grown up around home sales, it seems second nature to me.”

Dan McCarver has achieved the #1 position in resale real estate transaction sales volume many times in the Clear Lake area. His success is no surprise. The honors and recognition he has received are indicative of his commitment, professionalism, and level of understanding in this specialized discriminating market.

Buying or selling a home is one of the biggest decisions you will make, and it deserves more than a standard sales approach. I provide strategic real estate guidance for homeowners navigating important housing transitions across Kingwood, Northeast Houston, and the greater Houston area. My approach is built on calm leadership, a structured process, and clear communication.

Before we talk about listings or showings, we start with the big picture. I help you think through what your next move actually needs to look like so you can move forward with clarity and confidence. Whether you are planning a downsize or a larger home or a strategic relocation, the goal is the same: making the right decision for your life, not just pushing toward a closing. I stay involved, start to finish, guiding you toward the best outcome with the least amount of stress. If you are considering a change and want to explore your options with a strategic advisor, reach out. Let's start with a conversation about what you need.

agents.bio:
Chris Charboneau brings more than 28 years of real estate experience, more than $550 million in career sales volume, and over 850 completed transactions. A recipient of numerous Top Producer awards, Chris has built his career helping buyers and sellers throughout the Houston area with a combination of market knowledge, strategic marketing, and experienced guidance.

He earned both his Marketing degree and MBA from Texas Tech University and has extensive experience in both Houston’s Inner Loop and suburban markets. Having lived in both areas, with an office in the Rice Village area, Chris offers a valuable perspective to clients moving across Houston. He has helped many families transition both into the city and out to the suburbs, advising them on neighborhoods, schools, commutes, housing styles, and lifestyle considerations.

Chris also has firsthand experience with waterfront and second-home ownership on Lake Livingston, giving him practical insight into vacation homes, secondary residences, waterfront properties, and short-term rental opportunities.

Outside of real estate, Chris has coached travel baseball for 12 years and has coached 35 players who have gone on to play college baseball. His son currently plays at Baylor University. For families relocating to Houston with children involved in baseball, Chris can also provide valuable insight into local travel organizations, facilities, and programs.

Chris enjoys spending time with his wife, Amber, their three children, and their two golden retrievers.

 First-Time Home Buyers: Buying your first home is a monumental milestone, and I'm here to make sure it's a smooth and enjoyable experience. I understand the unique concerns and questions that come with purchasing your first property, and I'll walk you through every step of the process with patience and expertise.

agents.bio:
The Bruner Team is currently a one-woman show—me, Elisa (Bruner) McNinch—and I’m honored to carry on the real estate legacy my parents began more than 40 years ago. Real estate has always been personal in our family, and that’s exactly how I still do business today: with genuine care, calm guidance, and a big dose of Southern hospitality.

I’m proud to have been recognized with the Five Star Professional Award for real estate customer service 13 years in a row (2012–2025)—an honor earned by fewer than 1% of Houston-area Realtors. I’m also a consistent multi-million dollar producer, but what matters most to me is that my clients feel heard, protected, and confident from start to finish.

If you ask where I work in Houston, you’ll probably hear me say: “If you divide Houston in half, I work the left-hand side.” I primarily serve Northwest Houston, and I’m very familiar throughout West Houston as well, including Spring, Tomball, Spring Branch, Cypress, Katy, and Richmond/Rosenberg.

Even though I’m tech-savvy (and yes—your home will be marketed online the right way), I still believe the best service happens voice-to-voice and face-to-face whenever possible. I’m hands-on with every client: meeting with sellers to stage and prepare a home, taking listings, coordinating photography, marketing, showing properties, hosting open houses, attending inspections—you name it. I’m the face and heart of The Bruner Team.

Behind the scenes, I’m supported by a trusted transaction coordinator who helps prepare listing documents and offers, tracks deadlines, and keeps everything moving smoothly—so you get both personal attention and professional precision.

If you’re looking for a knowledgeable agent who feels more like a steady partner than a sales pitch, I’d love to help you make your next move.

agents.bio:
Monica Villaseñor is a top-rated Houston REALTOR® and Berkshire Hathaway President’s Circle award recipient, recognized among the Top 25 Agents in Texas. Since becoming licensed in 2020, she has helped buyers and sellers close more than $33 million in real estate across Houston’s most desirable neighborhoods, including The Greater Heights, Montrose, Rice Military, Garden Oaks, Oak Forest, Spring Branch, West University, River Oaks, and Memorial.

Monica specializes in luxury homes, first-time buyers, out-of-state relocations, corporate and medical moves, new construction, move-up buyers, and downsizing. Her industry credentials—including Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist (CLHMS), Certified Home Marketing Specialist (CHMS), Accredited Buyer Representative (ABR), and Certified New Home Specialist—reflect a high level of professional training and a commitment to exceptional client care.

Known for her strong negotiation skills, market knowledge, and personalized service, Monica offers a client-first approach that makes each transaction smooth, informed, and stress-free. Bilingual in English and Spanish and a graduate of The University of Texas at Austin, she combines local expertise with clear communication to help every client achieve their real estate goals with confidence. Whether buying or selling, clients trust Monica for her professionalism, responsiveness, and proven results in the Houston market.

agents.bio:
Licensed since 2012, Julie Wells is a dedicated real estate professional serving the Greater Houston and Galveston markets. She is known for her expertise, strategic approach, and passion for helping clients navigate their real estate journeys. Specializing in residential sales and rentals, Julie combines in-depth market knowledge, strong negotiation skills, and a client-first mindset to deliver seamless and successful transactions.

Julie’s background as a small business owner and real estate investor gives her a unique edge in the industry, equipping her with strong problem-solving abilities and a keen eye for market trends. Her extensive list of professional designations—including ABR, MRPSA, SRS, CNE, RSPS, CLHS, AWREP, MRP, and PSA—demonstrates her commitment to ongoing education and excellence in real estate. Whether assisting first-time homebuyers, seasoned investors, or those seeking luxury properties, Julie provides tailored strategies and expert guidance to ensure her clients make well-informed decisions.

Beyond real estate, Julie is deeply involved in her community, volunteering with Houston Food Bank, Habitat for Humanity, and the Breast Cancer Walk. A proud Houston native, she appreciates the city’s diverse culture, vibrant dining scene, and world-class shopping. When she’s not helping clients find their dream homes, you’ll likely find her soaking up the sun at the beach—her favorite place to unwind.

Whether buying, selling, or investing, Julie Wells is committed to delivering an exceptional real estate experience built on trust, expertise, and personalized service.

With a deep knowledge of Houston’s most desirable waterfront communities, Nichelle Richards is a trusted guide for clients looking to relocate, invest, or upgrade their lifestyle along the Gulf Coast. She specializes in Seabrook, Clear Lake, Kemah, and Galveston, helping buyers find homes that match their vision—whether it’s a waterfront retreat, a luxury second home, or a lucrative investment property.


Nichelle’s approach is built on listening, educating, and empowering her clients. As a Seller Representation Specialist, Certified Negotiation Expert, and Resort & Second Home Property Specialist, she provides data-driven market insights, strategic advice, and a seamless transaction experience. Drawing from her own experiences as both a buyer and seller, she offers firsthand knowledge that makes her guidance relatable, transparent, and effective.


Clients describe Nichelle as detail-oriented, communicative, and deeply invested in their success. She takes pride in building long-term relationships, ensuring every client feels supported, informed, and confident throughout the process. Her mission? To turn real estate dreams into reality while delivering a smooth, stress-free experience.


Living in the coastal suburb of Seabrook, Nichelle enjoys the very lifestyle she helps her clients achieve. When she’s not working, you’ll find her exploring the waterfront, discovering new restaurants, or capturing photos of her toy poodle, Louie Loo (@life.of.louie.loo). Having purchased her first home at just 19, she understands the transformative power of homeownership and loves sharing this passion with her clients.


Whether you’re looking to invest, relocate, or find your dream home by the water, Nichelle Richards is ready to guide you with expertise, enthusiasm, and a personal touch.

remarks: East End Houston home with detached guest quarters and investment potential, ideally located inside Loop 610 near Downtown, EaDo and the University of Houston. This bungalow offers 3 bedrooms and 2 full baths, including a separate rear 1-bedroom/1-bath space with flexible use as guest quarters, a home office, studio or potential rental. The main residence features original hardwood floors, a granite kitchen and classic bungalow character. Enjoy private alley access, off-street parking, a porch, patio/deck and private yard on a 5,000-sq.-ft. lot with no HOA. The adjacent 5,000-sq.-ft. lot is also available separately, offering the opportunity to assemble approximately 10,000 sq. ft. for additional space or future development, subject to applicable requirements. Convenient access to METRORail, I-45, I-69/US-59 and Loop 610 connects you to Downtown attractions, stadiums, dining and entertainment. Schedule your private showing today!

We all have dreams, but I do this for my family. It's not just about buying or selling a house for me. It's about creating friendships and becoming part of my client's story. Each day is a different day, and I never know who I'm going to meet.
However, you can be sure you'll be working with a passionate person that's honest, trustworthy, and upholds his integrity. I'm willing to work throughout the City of Houston and all surrounding cities.

I have lived in west Houston for over 30 cumulative years. I have a strong appreciation for Houston and all that it has to offer.   My sphere of influence covers a wide range of people including childhood friends, fellow church members, oil field professionals, staffing, and all the support people and friends I have met along the way.

My family is what is most important to me. My daughter, Ashlyn, is in her junior year of college and has great dreams for her future. 

Professionally, I am a results-focused professional with 20+ years in the work force.   I began my career in Human Resource Management and transitioned to Real Estate in 2016. 

I started in Real Estate by working with a close friend as her assistant and began learning the ropes. I quickly discovered my passion for the industry and made the decision to get my license and start down the career path of being a Realtor®.

To sum me up, I am a hungry member of the NextHome Realty Center Team who can’t wait to help you or a friend with their real estate needs. My primary areas of focus are Cypress and Northwest Houston neighborhoods (Cy-Fair ISD), where I have been raised and enjoy raising my daughter. My goal is to provide better customer service than I would expect to receive and that my clients walk away satisfied. The best accolade I could ever receive is for a client or friend to refer me to someone else!

remarks: Located on a quiet cul-de-sac in desirable Huntwick Forest, this spacious two-story home offers 4 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and over 3,000 square feet of living space. With new carpet and fresh paint interior/exterior this traditional floor plan features formal living and dining areas, a private home office, generous family room with brick fireplace and built-ins, and large windows overlooking the backyard. The kitchen offers granite countertops, double ovens, abundant cabinetry, and a breakfast area. The first-floor primary suite provides privacy, while upstairs features three additional bedrooms and a game room. Enjoy a private backyard with pool, spa, and patio, plus a detached two-car garage. Conveniently located in the Champions area near shopping, dining, and major thoroughfares, with access to Cypress-Fairbanks ISD schools. An excellent opportunity for buyers looking to personalize a home with generous living spaces and tremendous potential in an established neighborhood.

agents.bio:
Evan Compean is the founder of The Compean Group, a boutique Houston real estate team known for data-driven pricing, high-end marketing and skilled negotiation. A licensed agent since 2012 and a real estate investor since 2002, Evan has sold more than $250 million in real estate and brings a builder's and investor's eye to every home, from foundation and roof to resale value.

Areas: Houston Heights, Woodland Heights, Garden Oaks/Oak Forest, Montrose, Midtown, West University, Bellaire, Spring Branch, Pearland, Katy, Cypress and The Woodlands.

Specialties: Luxury and new construction, investment and multifamily properties, land, first-time buyers, and relocation.

Evan is also a licensed loan officer and a partner at Smart Title, so clients get guidance on financing and closing from someone who knows every step. Se habla español. With 400+ five-star reviews across Zillow, Google, Yelp and Realtor.com, The Compean Group focuses on clear communication and a smooth process from first call to closing.

remarks: Welcome to 10010 Red Mesa Dr. in the Stone Gate community, home to Houston National Golf Course! This one-story home offers 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, and an attached two-car garage. The inviting floor plan features a formal living room and dining room, along with a dedicated home office. The kitchen boasts an island and stainless steel appliances and opens to the family room and breakfast room. The spacious primary bedroom features a sitting area and a lovely ensuite with dual sinks, a glass-enclosed shower, soaking tub, and walk-in closet. The secondary bedrooms are thoughtfully situated on the opposite side of the home and share a secondary bathroom. Enjoy the amenities of Stone Gate and a convenient location near shopping, dining, entertainment, Hwy 290, and Grand Parkway 99. Zoned to Cypress-Fairbanks ISD. Don't miss the opportunity to make this home your own!

remarks:
Welcome to 709 Fraser Avenue, where classic character meets bright, contemporary style. This gated, single-story Los Angeles property welcomes you with an inviting front lawn and arched entry. Inside, natural light, wood-look flooring, recessed lighting, and crown molding create a warm, cohesive feel throughout the living and dining areas, while air conditioning adds everyday comfort.

The kitchen features white cabinetry, contrasting dark hardware, light countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a skylight that brings in additional sunshine. An indoor laundry room adds everyday convenience. Ceiling fans, mirrored closet doors, and clean-lined finishes add to the home’s appeal, while a dual-sink vanity and glass-enclosed shower offer thoughtful touches.

Outside, the backyard provides space to create your own outdoor retreat, with room for seating and gardening. A long driveway leads to a detached two-car garage, providing parking and storage options within the gated property.

Set in East Los Angeles near the Whittier Boulevard shopping district, the home places local shopping, dining, and everyday conveniences close by. Nearby community destinations include Belvedere Community Regional Park and the East Los Angeles Library, offering opportunities for recreation, reading, and neighborhood activities. With inviting interiors, outdoor possibilities, and an established neighborhood setting, 709 Fraser Avenue offers a welcoming place to call home.

agents.bio:
He is very knowledgeable about the nuances in many neighborhoods throughout Houston, which strengthens his ability to help people relocating to Houston from other cities. David's primary concern is satisfying his clients, because satisfied clients generate repeat business and referrals. 

A native Houstonian, David graduated from Memorial High School in 1980 and received a BA in finance from the University of Texas at Austin in 1984. He traveled internationally after college, then moved to California, where he cultivated a diverse management background, including two years in residential mortgage brokerage, nine years in international trade management, and six years in enterprise software sales management. 

David returned to Houston in 2001, obtained his real estate license, and joined his father, David H Young, in residential real estate sales. In January 2005, they started the David Young Team, bringing together top-producing agents and experienced assistants to provide the highest quality service to buyers and sellers of residential real estate. They were recognized for 12 years by the Houston Business Journal as one of the Top 5 Teams in Houston, with sales volume over $100,000,000 per year.

David joined Compass in October 2020, where he has operated as Young Realty Group - a small team of agents and a licensed assistant with them since 2014. ?On a personal level, David's wife Brenda and he are very active in animal rescue. She established Save A Purrfect Cat Rescue many years ago and they, along with an army of volunteers, find homes for 250-300 cats yearly. To keep fit he has practiced Tae Kwon Do since the 1990s and has been a member of the Houstonian Club since 2007. He also relieves stress by banging on his drum set.

A native Houstonian, Lance graduated from Memorial High School in 1980, went on to the University of Texas at Austin where he received his degrees in business administration and marketing, and attended graduate school at McCombs Graduate School of Business in Austin.

Since the 1980s, Lance has successfully acquired an influential background in building sales, office leasing, marketing and divesting. He also possesses wide-ranging understanding of business management through his experiences owning and managing both private and public companies.

The "Lance philosophy" as a real estate agent is that he must earn his clients business by putting their complete satisfaction first and foremost. He believes that satisfied clients generate repeat business and referrals.

Throughout his career, Lance has had the honor of representing many deserving clients in the Houston area. He first entered the world of residential real estate and then became a top producer, focused on the West University, River Oaks, Bellaire and Close-In Memorial neighborhoods. Now Lance continues his work as a luxury-home agent for both buyers and sellers throughout the Houston area.

As a Texas Real Estate Commission licensed real estate broker, a member of the Texas Association of Realtors, and a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Lance values the trust of his clients and the respect of his fellow brokers and agents.  In his free time, Lance enjoys spending time with his wife, Valerie and their dog Maxwell.  He is also a competitive triathlete, so he is always running, biking or swimming. Lance is a fan of live music venues and watching Houston sports.

Rooted in Houston and shaped by a lifelong exposure to real estate, I bring both heart and strategy to every transaction. Born in California and raised in Houston since the age of nine, my passion for real estate began early on watching my family manage properties and spending weekends touring open houses with my mother, imagining all of the possibilities together!

That foundation led me to earn my real estate license through Champions School of Real Estate and gained hands on experience within a Fortune 500 brokerage. I later worked closely with investors and developers as an Executive Assistant and Project Coordinator, where I developed a strong understanding of real estate development, investment strategy, and the operational side of the business allowing me to advocate for my clients at a higher level than most. Today, I help buyers, sellers, and investors navigate the Houston market with clarity and confidence. My approach is strategic, ROI-minded, and relationship driven.

Outside of real estate, you’ll find me making memories with my children, enjoying long walks, diving into beauty and fashion, or unwinding with a great book, show, or a well-earned margarita with friends. When you work with me, you’re not just hiring an agent, you’re gaining a trusted advisor, fierce advocate, and committed partner. I’m here to protect your interests, elevate your experience, and help you build something lasting through real estate. Give me a call or schedule a consultation on my website and let’s get started!

agents.bio:
Mr. Guidry Joined Berkshire Hathaway in August of 2013 as Managing Director for Berkshire Hathaway HS Commercial where his role is to oversee acquisition and disposition of commercial real estate.  In addition to managing commercial transactions his current responsibilities include mentoring and training Berkshire agents and assist the facilitation of commercial opportunities throughout Texas.
Mr. Guidry acts as Director of Development for Houston, Texas based Innata Development, LLC.  Managing the development of residential and commercial projects throughout Texas.  Typical projects requirements include: site selection, feasibility, financial modeling, acquisition, entitlements and disposition.  Guidry works with local governments and communities to encourage regional investment in real estate development projects.  Roles include Identification of builder partners and retail end-users then responsibilities move toward managing and directing day to day operations and best practices.  Guidry works closely with Architects, Engineers, Designers and Land Planners to identify market values, determine highest and best use, recruit end users and manage the implementation of horizontal infrastructure.
Prior to joining Berkshire Hathaway in 2013, Guidry spent eight years with Sperry Van Ness, International, a global real estate firm with more than eight hundred commercial brokers throughout the US, South America and China.  Guidry most recently acted as Managing Director for SVN| Principal Advisor Group, based in Houston, Texas and spent the previous five years, specializing in the sale of net leased investment properties within the office, retail and multifamily market segments.  
A native Texan, Mr. Guidry has a solid understanding of commercial valuation procedures and finance strategies as well as ground up development practices.  He passes that knowledge through to his clients in order to achieve partner level relationships with those clients. He approaches every opportunity with a “win-win or no-deal” mentality.
Prior to joining Sperry Van Ness in 2005, Guidry served as Director of Land Acquisition for Historic Land Development, a regional developer of lifestyle center and other mixed-use developments.
Before then he was Vice President of Development for W.C. Perry Properties, a private real estate brokerage and development firm based in Houston, Texas. 

Specialties:  
Mr. Guidry is a proponent of New Urbanism and an advocate for innovative development and the implementation of “best practices” for environmental preservation and energy conservation. He has an eye for molding new developments into the existing landscape, history, and culture of the community. He works closely with members of the Urban Land Institute and collaborates with city and local government entities to address site specific needs and potential.
Mr. Guidry’s undergraduate studies at the University of Houston led him to a career focused on business and real estate. He is an active member of the International Council of Shopping Centers (ICSC), Texas Real Estate Commission (TREC) and Houston Association of Commercial Realtors.

Chuck Miller is a highly motivated and results-driven Houston real estate agent with more than a decade of experience serving as a trusted Listing Professional and Buyer’s Agent for clients across Greater Houston. He is dedicated to delivering V.I.P.-level service from the first consultation to the final closing. Known for his “unstoppable” work ethic, Chuck consistently goes above and beyond to exceed client expectations.

A graduate of Southern Illinois University with a Bachelor of Science in Communication, Chuck is a licensed Texas real estate professional with over 15 years of combined experience working alongside physicians, hospitals, business owners, and property investors. His background in administration, consulting, and property management gives clients a strategic advantage when selling, buying, leasing, or investing in Houston real estate.

As an experienced Listing Agent, Chuck provides strategic pricing, high-impact digital marketing, professional staging guidance, MLS exposure, and expert negotiation to help sellers maximize their property’s value. As a dedicated Buyer’s Agent, he offers personalized home searches, competitive negotiation strategies, and hands-on guidance throughout every step of the transaction.

Whether you are a home seller looking for a top-producing listing professional or a buyer seeking a knowledgeable buyer’s agent, the Chuck Miller team offers strategic planning, detailed market analysis, and responsive communication from start to finish.

As proud members of the Houston Association of Realtors (HAR), the team serves clients across Inner Loop Houston, River Oaks, Montrose, The Heights, and surrounding communities. Their in-depth knowledge of neighborhood trends, pricing strategies, and local market conditions helps clients make confident, informed, and profitable decisions.

From luxury homes and new construction to commercial and investment properties, the Chuck Miller Houston Real Estate Group delivers customized solutions tailored to every client’s goals.

As a proud father of four, Chuck understands the importance of finding the right home for every stage of life. He is committed to providing personalized service, honest guidance, and a positive real estate experience built on trust and results.

Don’t settle for average—choose experience, expertise, and results.

Nicholas "Nick" Chambers, CRS, RSPS, CIPS

Nicholas "Nick" Chambers is a Broker Associate with Realty of America (ROA) and founder of Chambers Properties Group, serving homeowners, buyers, investors, and relocation clients throughout Houston and the Greater Houston area.

With more than 17 years of experience in Texas real estate, Nick helps clients make informed decisions through strategic planning, market analysis, and data-driven pricing rather than sales pressure. His advisory approach is built around protecting equity, reducing risk, and creating clear decision paths during significant life transitions.

Nick works with clients buying or selling primary residences, luxury homes, new construction, relocation properties, and select investment real estate throughout Houston's diverse neighborhoods. Every recommendation is tailored to current market conditions, local buyer behavior, inventory levels, and each client's goals and timeline.

Rather than treating real estate as a transaction, Nick approaches every property as a financial asset. Sellers receive guidance on pricing strategy, property preparation, market positioning, and negotiation. Buyers benefit from objective market analysis, competitive offer strategy, and clear advice on when to move forward—or when patience creates a stronger opportunity.

Core Services:
• Residential listing representation
• Strategic home selling and pricing analysis
• Buyer representation and negotiation
• Luxury real estate advisory
• Relocation services
• New construction guidance
• Investment property acquisition and disposition
• Comparative Market Analysis (CMA)
• Home value evaluations

- Areas Served - 
Chambers Properties Group serves clients throughout the Greater Houston region, including:

River Oaks • Memorial • West University • Bellaire • The Heights • Rice Military • Timbergrove • Oak Forest • Cypress • Bridgeland • Towne Lake • Katy • Energy Corridor • Sugar Land • Spring • Tomball • The Woodlands and surrounding communities.

- The Advisory Process -

Every client engagement begins with understanding three questions:
• What are you trying to accomplish?
• What constraints or risks should we account for?
• What strategy creates the strongest long-term outcome?

From there, recommendations are based on market data, pricing trends, buyer demand, and proven execution—not assumptions or one-size-fits-all solutions.

Clients appreciate Nick's ability to simplify complex market information into practical guidance, helping them move forward with confidence from the initial consultation through closing.

agents.bio:
As a native Houstonian and experienced real estate professional, I believe exceptional real estate service begins with understanding what matters most to my clients. My approach is rooted in relationships, built on trust, and driven by a commitment to providing thoughtful guidance, strategic expertise, and personalized service throughout every step of the real estate journey.

Before beginning my real estate career, I spent more than 15 years in executive sales and contract negotiations within the technology industry. Today, I combine that business experience with my knowledge of the Houston real estate market to provide skilled negotiation, strategic advice, and a concierge-level experience tailored to each client's unique needs and goals.

As a homeowner, landlord, and real estate investor myself, I understand firsthand that real estate is more than a transaction. It's a significant financial investment, a lifestyle decision, and often the beginning of an exciting new chapter. Whether you're buying or selling a luxury home, relocating to Houston, purchasing your first home, or exploring investment opportunities, my priority is to protect your interests, simplify the process, and help you make confident, informed decisions.

I proudly serve Houston and its surrounding communities, and I've built my business on integrity, personal connections, and lasting relationships. Nothing means more to me than earning the trust of my clients and knowing they feel confident referring their friends, family, and colleagues to me for the same exceptional level of service.

For me, success isn't simply measured by homes bought and sold. It's measured by the relationships I build, the trust I earn, and the experience I deliver.

I love Houston, I love real estate, and most importantly, I love helping people achieve their goals. I would welcome the opportunity to do the same for you.

Rooted in Houston. Rooted in Relationships. Rooted in What Matters.

agents.bio:
A native Houstonian, Lance graduated from Memorial High School in 1980, went on to the University of Texas at Austin where he received his degrees in business administration and marketing, and attended graduate school at McCombs Graduate School of Business in Austin.

Since the 1980s, Lance has successfully acquired an influential background in building sales, office leasing, marketing and divesting. He also possesses wide-ranging understanding of business management through his experiences owning and managing both private and public companies.

The "Lance philosophy" as a real estate agent is that he must earn his clients business by putting their complete satisfaction first and foremost. He believes that satisfied clients generate repeat business and referrals.

Throughout his career, Lance has had the honor of representing many deserving clients in the Houston area. He first entered the world of residential real estate and then became a top producer, focused on the West University, River Oaks, Bellaire and Close-In Memorial neighborhoods. Now Lance continues his work as a luxury-home agent for both buyers and sellers throughout the Houston area.

As a Texas Real Estate Commission licensed real estate broker, a member of the Texas Association of Realtors, and a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Lance values the trust of his clients and the respect of his fellow brokers and agents.  In his free time, Lance enjoys spending time with his wife, Valerie and their dog Maxwell.  He is also a competitive triathlete, so he is always running, biking or swimming. Lance is a fan of live music venues and watching Houston sports.

remarks: Some homes have a past worth talking about. In the late ’80s, country star Clint Black lived here and wrote his first album by the pool. Couples have said “I do” in the backyard, and families have spent decades of holidays around the wood-burning fireplace. Now it’s ready for its next chapter. Picture Saturday mornings with coffee in the sunroom as the light pours in. Long summer afternoons in the pool while burgers hit the grill. A big table under string lights for a birthday, a graduation, or a wedding of your own. The study works as a home office, a music room, or a quiet place to write your own hit song. Tucked at the end of a quiet cul-de-sac, the home feels private, yet everything is close by. Walk the paved trails Arthur Storey Park. Spend a whole weekend eating your way down Bellaire Blvd through Asiatown and Hong Kong City Mall. Get to Westchase, the Galleria, or the Texas Medical Center from the Beltway. Low community ran HOA. The next great story written here could be yours.

agents.bio:
Over 18 years and hundreds of millions of dollars in Houston closings taught me one thing that never changes: the deal is won before anyone signs — in the prep, the pricing, and the negotiation. That's where I go to work for you.

I'm Le Nguyen, Broker and Owner of Go-M Realty, and I took the road less traveled to get here. I hold an accounting degree from UH-Downtown, so I read a contract the way few agents do — every number, every clause, every dollar that should stay in your pocket. Before real estate, I worked as a contractor for the U.S. Army in Kirkuk, Iraq, during the war as a purchaser, handling logistics, supplies and contracts. I also spent 16 years coaching competitive women's gymnastics — a sport where everything comes down to preparation, nerve, and executing when it counts. Those chapters shaped how I run a deal today. The numbers stay tight, and I don't flinch when the stakes climb.

When it's time to sell, I don't sit on a listing and hope. I market it hard — sharp pricing, strong presentation, and a strategy built to put your property in front of the right buyers fast. I'm a Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist and a Certified Negotiation Expert, but the part of my business I'm proudest of is the referrals. Most of my clients come from people I've worked with before — folks who trusted me enough to send me their family and friends. I don't take that lightly, and I've built my whole career on earning it.

When I'm not at the closing table, you'll find me in the gym, hunting down a new restaurant across town, planning my next trip, or getting talked back to by Lola, my parrot. When you're ready to make a move in Houston, I'd be proud to be your partner.

remarks: Perched in the coveted Franklin Hills neighborhood of Los Feliz, 3902 Sunset Dr. is a sanctuary offering unparalleled views, indoor-outdoor living, and thoughtful modern upgrades. Extensively reimagined by its owners in 2018, the light-filled home features an airy layout, bamboo floors, a spiral staircase, and vaulted wood ceilings w/ exposed beams. The redesigned kitchen offers concrete-finish quartz countertops, a Bosch dishwasher and refrigerator, on-demand filtered and hot water, and custom built-ins. Stunning bi-fold glass doors in the dining room open to an outdoor deck, creating a peaceful setting for gatherings. The indoor-outdoor fireplace adds warmth to the living room, making for a cozy night inside or out. The home features two bedrooms and two and one half baths, plus an upper-level sanctuary that can easily function as a third bedroom, office, den or creative retreat. Spectacular 180-degree city views provide a breathtaking backdrop, with ocean views on clear days and a front-row seat to Fourth of July and New Year's Eve fireworks all over the city.The spacious lower-level primary suite includes a massive walk-in closet and sliding glass doors that open to a beautifully landscaped backyard and patio. The spa-inspired primary bath offers an oversized shower, premium imported Spanish freestanding tub, and Porcelanosa and Cle tile. A generous laundry room with ample storage completes the downstairs retreat. A detached studio with built in storage offers a bonus 137 sq foot setting for working from home, making art, or recording music. An exterior outlet provides power to off-street parking.The 2018 renovation included extensive foundation work, electrical and plumbing upgrades, the installation of central heating and dual A/C systems, comprehensive landscaping with drip irrigation, a retaining wall, drainage improvements, and updates to siding, paint, and lighting.Located between the vibrant neighborhoods of Silverlake and Los Feliz, Franklin Hills is known for its top-rated school system, close-knit community, and hidden network of stairs. Close access to famed restaurants, comedy clubs, and the Greek Theater. A neighborhood coffee shop/wine bar is just down the hill, and Gelsons and Trader Joe's are a short drive away. A rare opportunity to enjoy panoramic views, modern comforts, and a private garden retreat in one of the Eastside's most desirable neighborhoods.

remarks: Designer-inspired living in the heart of Houston's Energy Corridor! agents.bio: Having been involved in many facets of real estate, including selling over $250 Million thus far in real estate, Evan brings his knowledge and experience to The Compean Group, a boutique team he founded to expand on his deeply ingrained principles for high level service, marketing, and tactful negotiating with insight, all based on experience and data. Evan is also a licensed loan officer and partner at Smart Title, a 5 star rated Houston title company. Evan began his career in 2002 on the investment side, and then transitioned into working directly with the consumer in 2012, enabling him to utilize his insight to better assist clients directly. Evan's current knowledge and experience first developed from working as an acquisition specialist of distressed properties for a group of investors. He then began managing his personal portfolio of real estate investments, private lending on new construction and rehab projects, and taking on joint ventures with development projects. He has also obtained significant experience personally rehabbing and building, not to mention years as a buyer's agent, before transitioning into a listing agent, and then forming a team. This experience has allowed Evan and his team to bring impactful insight to all of their clients. Over the past few years, The Compean Group has streamlined the selling and buying process for their clients to help them avoid unnecessary headaches and frustration, hence our raving reviews from clients, with over 400+ reviews on multiple platforms like Zillow, Google, and Yelp!

remarks: Freshly painted inside, this inviting 3-bedroom, 2-bath home in Houston’s Energy Corridor offers comfortable single-story living with versatile spaces throughout. Tile details and accents throughout the house. No carpet at all! The front room is ideal for formal dining, a home office, or a reading nook. High ceilings and a stone-faced fireplace highlight the spacious living area, while the adjoining kitchen features granite countertops, wood cabinetry, a tile backsplash, and a bright breakfast nook. The primary suite includes a bathroom with two separate vanities, a soaking tub, and a walk-in shower. Outside, enjoy a covered tile patio, extended patio area, and a fenced backyard with a mature shade tree and storage shed. An attached two-car garage and dedicated laundry room add everyday convenience. Enjoy access to Terry Hershey Park’s trails, along with shopping and dining at CITYCENTRE and nearby Westheimer destinations.

agents.bio:
Kate Myhan brings a highly distinctive background to commercial real estate, combining international business experience, advanced academic training, strategic marketing expertise, and hands-on dealmaking across multiple asset types. Based in Houston, Texas, Kate works with commercial property owners, investors, developers, landlords, tenants, and business buyers locally, nationally, and internationally. In addition to representing clients in Texas, she also works with national buyers pursuing opportunities in other states, helping them identify, evaluate, and secure the right assets based on their investment goals.

With a Master’s in Economics and more than two decades of experience in marketing, management, client relations, and real estate investing, Kate offers a sophisticated, results-driven approach to every assignment. Her professional background includes serving as a strategic marketing professor in Santiago, Chile, where she taught MBA students and developed high-level expertise in positioning, negotiation, market strategy, and consumer behavior. That international academic and business experience gives her a rare advantage in commercial real estate, especially when advising clients on marketability, asset positioning, and investment potential.

Kate has built her reputation on strong relationships, creative problem-solving, relentless work ethic, and an ability to connect the right people to the right opportunities. She is known for identifying value where others may not, whether in on-market listings, off-market deals, redevelopment sites, land opportunities, industrial assets, retail properties, mixed-use projects, multifamily investments, or business-related real estate transactions. Her combination of analytical thinking and marketing expertise allows her to not only find opportunities, but also present and promote properties in a way that drives attention and results.

Her experience is especially valuable to clients seeking guidance on acquisitions, dispositions, site selection, development potential, investment strategy, and high-visibility property marketing. Kate understands that commercial real estate success requires more than simply listing a property or submitting an offer—it requires insight, negotiation skill, persistence, financial awareness, and the ability to create momentum around a deal. She approaches each client relationship with professionalism, urgency, and a commitment to maximizing value.

Kate is a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Texas REALTORS®, National Association of Realtors, and the CCIM Institute. She holds respected industry credentials including CCIM (Certified Commercial Investment Member), CIPS (Certified International Property Specialist), TACS (Texas Accredited Commercial Specialist), and CRS (Certified Residential Specialist). agents.bio:
I specialize in helping clients identify high-value real estate opportunities with a strong focus on commercial properties, investments, and strategic acquisitions. As an active real estate investor myself, I understand investing from both sides of the table — not only as an advisor, but as someone who personally owns rental houses, apartment properties, and commercial buildings focused on building long-term passive income and wealth creation.

My growing investment portfolio gives me firsthand experience in evaluating opportunities, negotiating strong deals, managing risk, and recognizing value that others may overlook. I believe the best way to guide clients is by applying strategies I personally use and believe in.

Whether you are expanding an investment portfolio, purchasing commercial real estate, or searching for the right opportunity, I bring a hands-on, results-driven approach built on market knowledge, strong negotiation, and real-world investing experience.

Real estate is more than buying and selling properties — it is about building financial freedom and creating long-term value. My goal is simple: help clients make smart decisions, secure exceptional opportunities, and build wealth with confidence.

remarks: Beautifully renovated and expanded one-story home in the heart of Montrose! Situated in a designated Historic District, this exceptional residence has been thoughtfully reimagined while following historic guidelines and original character, with modern comforts. Front porch opens to a grand living area with adjoining sunroom. High ceilings create an airy, spacious ambience throughout. An ample dining room flows into the striking kitchen appointed with custom cabinetry, quartz countertops, and a complete suite of ZLINE appliances. A central hallway leads to powder room and four inviting bedrooms, each featuring its own en-suite bath. Renovation completed 2026, including roof, mechanicals, plumbing, electrical, hvac, flooring. Enjoy the timeless appeal of the historic neighborhood. Prime location near Museum District, Texas Medical Center & Montrose’s restaurants, shopping & nightlife. A wonderful opportunity to experience one-story living in one of Houston’s most cherished neighborhoods!

Rae Lynn White is a Houston native and seasoned REALTOR® with 25 years of experience, consistently recognized as a top-producing agent. Part Realtor, Part Matchmaker, she’s known for connecting people with homes that truly fit their lifestyle. Now with Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Premier Properties, Rae Lynn combines deep local knowledge with a modern, client-focused approach to help buyers and sellers navigate Houston real estate with confidence.

Living inside the Loop since 1992, Rae Lynn has an insider’s understanding of Houston’s historic neighborhoods and diverse housing stock. A true old-home enthusiast, she brings both market savvy and a genuine appreciation for architecture, character, and craftsmanship. Her clients value her integrity, work ethic, and hands-on service—and often become friends and neighbors along the way.

With multiple home renovations behind her, Rae Lynn offers more than guidance—she offers perspective, helping clients buy and sell homes with a sharp eye for potential and real-world experience.

When she’s not working, Rae Lynn enjoys unplugging with her spouse and young daughter, creating memories and recharging at their German farmhouse in La Grange.

agents.bio:
Chuck Miller is a highly motivated and results-driven Houston real estate agent with more than a decade of experience serving as a trusted Listing Professional and Buyer’s Agent for clients across Greater Houston. He is dedicated to delivering V.I.P.-level service from the first consultation to the final closing. Known for his “unstoppable” work ethic, Chuck consistently goes above and beyond to exceed client expectations.

A graduate of Southern Illinois University with a Bachelor of Science in Communication, Chuck is a licensed Texas real estate professional with over 15 years of combined experience working alongside physicians, hospitals, business owners, and property investors. His background in administration, consulting, and property management gives clients a strategic advantage when selling, buying, leasing, or investing in Houston real estate.

As an experienced Listing Agent, Chuck provides strategic pricing, high-impact digital marketing, professional staging guidance, MLS exposure, and expert negotiation to help sellers maximize their property’s value. As a dedicated Buyer’s Agent, he offers personalized home searches, competitive negotiation strategies, and hands-on guidance throughout every step of the transaction.

Whether you are a home seller looking for a top-producing listing professional or a buyer seeking a knowledgeable buyer’s agent, the Chuck Miller team offers strategic planning, detailed market analysis, and responsive communication from start to finish.

As proud members of the Houston Association of Realtors (HAR), the team serves clients across Inner Loop Houston, River Oaks, Montrose, The Heights, and surrounding communities. Their in-depth knowledge of neighborhood trends, pricing strategies, and local market conditions helps clients make confident, informed, and profitable decisions.

From luxury homes and new construction to commercial and investment properties, the Chuck Miller Houston Real Estate Group delivers customized solutions tailored to every client’s goals.

As a proud father of four, Chuck understands the importance of finding the right home for every stage of life. He is committed to providing personalized service, honest guidance, and a positive real estate experience built on trust and results.

Don’t settle for average—choose experience, expertise, and results.

Choose Chuck Miller: Your trusted Houston Listing Professional and Buyer’s Agent, delivering Southern comfort with professional excellence.

agents.bio:
A little about me! I was born in Houston and raised in the Dallas/Fort Worth Metro Area.  I moved back to Houston (Dickinson) in 2007 and was happy to live closer to family again.  I went into Real Estate because I have a passion for helping people, and how better to do that than to be a part of the process of helping people build a future and live out the American dream of homeownership!  Watching people fall in love with their new home, or selling their current one is fun and exciting, and I have had the honor of being in the top 1% of sales in my office, earning the respect of my fellow REALTORS, and helping many clients.  Prior to Real Estate, I earned my Bachelor of Business from Dallas Baptist University and minored in Psychology.  I also had worked in telecommunications for 25 years, most recently as a Project Manager/Contracts Negotiator for custom contracts all over the world. My wife, Becky (who is also a Realtor), and I also own a small farm, where we hatch, raise, and sell heritage and specialty breeds of chickens, turkeys, and guineas, as well as farm fresh eggs. We focus on pasture-raised flocks and feed only high-quality and Non-GMO/Soy-free feed products.  I look forward to working with you to make your Real Estate dreams a reality!

Jim Atkinson is a Broker Associate, REALTOR® and the Team Leader for Hidden Paradise Realty Team at UTR - Texas, Realtors, located in Houston, Texas, near NASA.  Our team is comprised of experienced Agents who have a passion for real estate, and who are ready to assist you with all your buying, selling, or rental needs!  Our team is structured differently than most teams, as we don't have buyer's agents or seller's agents, who simply hand you off to someone else once the contract is signed.  Rather, we believe in the value of relationships, and we know that the relationship you have with your Agent is extremely vital to you during your home buying, selling, or renting experience. We have an amazing Transaction Coordinator to assist you and our Agents throughout the process, but your Agent will remain actively involved - all the way to the closing table and beyond!

remarks: Welcome to this classic one-story brick home in established Braeburn Valley! Set on a 9,600 SF lot with mature trees, this 3-bed, 2-bath home offers 2,104 SF (per HCAD) and a flexible layout with formal living and dining rooms plus a spacious 20x14 den with a wood-burning fireplace. The updated kitchen features granite counters, rich dark cabinetry, stainless appliances, a gas range, breakfast bar, pantry, and an open view to the family room. The primary suite offers a walk-in closet and a bath with a glass-enclosed shower. Laminate and tile floors throughout, no carpet. Energy-efficient features include Energy Star appliances, LED lighting, ceiling fans, and an attic fan. Step outside to a covered patio and an expansive wood deck overlooking a large fenced backyard, ideal for entertaining. Detached 2-car garage with auto opener and gated driveway. FEMA Zone X, outside the 100- and 500-year floodplains. Convenient access to 610, Beltway 8, and the Galleria. Schedule your showing today!

agents.bio:
Kate Myhan brings a highly distinctive background to commercial real estate, combining international business experience, advanced academic training, strategic marketing expertise, and hands-on dealmaking across multiple asset types. Based in Houston, Texas, Kate works with commercial property owners, investors, developers, landlords, tenants, and business buyers locally, nationally, and internationally. In addition to representing clients in Texas, she also works with national buyers pursuing opportunities in other states, helping them identify, evaluate, and secure the right assets based on their investment goals.

With a Master’s in Economics and more than two decades of experience in marketing, management, client relations, and real estate investing, Kate offers a sophisticated, results-driven approach to every assignment. Her professional background includes serving as a strategic marketing professor in Santiago, Chile, where she taught MBA students and developed high-level expertise in positioning, negotiation, market strategy, and consumer behavior. That international academic and business experience gives her a rare advantage in commercial real estate, especially when advising clients on marketability, asset positioning, and investment potential.

Kate has built her reputation on strong relationships, creative problem-solving, relentless work ethic, and an ability to connect the right people to the right opportunities. She is known for identifying value where others may not, whether in on-market listings, off-market deals, redevelopment sites, land opportunities, industrial assets, retail properties, mixed-use projects, multifamily investments, or business-related real estate transactions. Her combination of analytical thinking and marketing expertise allows her to not only find opportunities, but also present and promote properties in a way that drives attention and results.

Her experience is especially valuable to clients seeking guidance on acquisitions, dispositions, site selection, development potential, investment strategy, and high-visibility property marketing. Kate understands that commercial real estate success requires more than simply listing a property or submitting an offer—it requires insight, negotiation skill, persistence, financial awareness, and the ability to create momentum around a deal. She approaches each client relationship with professionalism, urgency, and a commitment to maximizing value.

Kate is a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Texas REALTORS®, National Association of Realtors, and the CCIM Institute. She holds respected industry credentials including CCIM (Certified Commercial Investment Member), CIPS (Certified International Property Specialist), TACS (Texas Accredited Commercial Specialist), and CRS (Certified Residential Specialist). Fluent in English, Spanish, French, and Polish, she is able to work effectively with a diverse range of clients, including international investors and cross-border buyers.

Clients appreciate Kate for her extensive market knowledge, global perspective, broad-based network, and unwavering devotion to their success. Her business is built largely through referrals and repeat relationships, reflecting the trust she earns through outstanding service, strategic guidance, and strong results. Whether representing a Houston-based owner, an out-of-state investor, or a national buyer expanding into new markets, Kate brings the experience, intelligence, and dealmaking energy needed to move complex transactions forward.

Roddy de la Garza grew up inside real estate. Raised in a family brokerage spanning more than 50 years, he was measuring houses and hanging for-sale signs by the age of eight, learning early how homes, people, and decisions intersect. Since 2014, he has closed over 780 transactions totaling more than $400M in volume.

His career spans real estate, media, publishing, technology, and entertainment, shaping an approach that treats home staging like set design and each sale like a film shoot, planned and executed with intention. Influenced by improv training and a background in film directing, Roddy believes clarity beats theater, and momentum beats perfection.

He is known for naming and solving problems early and speaking up when something does not add up, not to create friction, but to save clients time, money, and unnecessary stress. Buying or selling a home can be intense, so his team brings structure, honesty, and a sense of fun to the process.

Roddy leads a team of over 20 agents who cover all of Southern California. He is also the author of Above Asking, the host of the Somebody Had to Say It podcast, and has consulted on and trained AI models on real estate brokerage operations and compliance.

Roddy is co-owner of Immaculate Concepts & Intelligent Design, a Southern California home staging company that has prepared hundreds of occupied and vacant homes for maximum market response. Ask about "List & Stage for 2.5%" services!

Roddy is always welcoming new clients and experienced agents to his team. Roddy's Book, "Above Asking: Daily Mindwork for Real Estate Professionals," is available on Amazon.

remarks: Imagine slow mornings on your charming arched front porch, weekend gatherings in the spacious front yard, and the freedom of having two homes on one lot! Welcome to 2531 Pomeroy Avenue, a unique single-story Los Angeles property offering a total of 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms with incredible flexibility for multigenerational living or potential rental income! The front residence features 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, while the remodeled rear residence offers 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom, complete with a comfortable living area, kitchenette, and generously sized closet, creating an inviting separate space for extended family, guests, or tenants. Picture keeping loved ones close while still enjoying your own privacy, living in one home while renting out the other, or exploring the investment possibilities of owning two homes on one property! Situated on a generous 5,760-square-foot lot, larger than many you'll find in Los Angeles, there's room to gather, entertain, and enjoy the outdoors. And let's talk about LOCATION! Conveniently located near the USC Keck Medical Campus, LA General Medical Center, Downtown Los Angeles, the vibrant Arts District, Mariachi Plaza, and the Metro E Line, this property puts major employment centers, entertainment, shopping, and transportation within easy reach! Enjoy nearby parks, local dining, and convenient freeway access, making commuting and exploring everything Los Angeles has to offer that much easier. Whether you're looking for a place to call home, an opportunity to generate rental income, or a property that accommodates multiple generations under one lot while maintaining separate living spaces, the possibilities here are exciting! With classic Los Angeles character, flexible living arrangements,NO HOA, NO SOLAR, and a desirable central location, this is an opportunity you won't want to miss. Two homes, one lot, and so many possibilities. Welcome home!

remarks:
Newly priced, this spacious home has a flexible layout and lets you settle in now and update at your own pace, one room at a time. This two-story Los Angeles property features four bedrooms and two bathrooms downstairs and three bedrooms and two bathrooms upstairs. An exterior staircase provides additional access to the upper level, offering potential to create separate living areas within the home. Any conversion is subject to buyer verification and applicable City approvals.

The home’s established character provides a starting point for your personal touches, with opportunities to refresh finishes and make improvements over time as your priorities and style evolve.

Mature fruit trees include persimmon, calamansi, orange, avocado, guava, and lemon. A gated front entry and a clipped hedge frame a covered porch accented by stucco arches and decorative wrought iron. Inside, bedrooms are distributed across both levels, with recessed lighting and ceiling fans in select rooms. A front entry ramp and an interior wheelchair lift provide additional access options; per seller, the lift is operational.

The upstairs kitchen features dark cabinetry, a generous peninsula, and a gas range with a hood. An upstairs laundry area adds cabinet storage.

Out back, a large paved parking area holds a detached two-car garage, a carport, and open space for additional cars, plus a covered outdoor cooking area with a sink. A roof replaced in 2023 adds to the home’s practical appeal.

Explore the possibilities of a home with room to grow, spaces to make your own, and a price that leaves room for your plans. Check the virtual tour link below.
