remarks: Contemporary multi-level residence offers a unique living experience. Four meticulously designed floors, efficiently distributed, featuring 3 bedrooms & 3 luxury ensuite baths & guest bath located on the 2nd floor. Primary bedroom located on the 3rd floor, providing ample space for comfort & relaxation along with a laundry room off the stairway for convenience. The heart of the home is a sleek, modern kitchen w/ a striking contrast of white cabinetry & dark tiled backsplash. A large central island w/ waterfall countertop serves as both a workspace & a gathering point. Recessed lighting & pendant fixtures create a bright & inviting atmosphere. Light wood flooring adds warmth to the crisp white walls, large windows flood the rooms with natural light & modern stair railings complement the overall aesthetic. Back outdoor space offers a covered patio with landscaped green space. Urban sophistication with practical living make it an ideal living experience. Inquire about lease to own option!

agents.bio:
Located in Houston, Texas, I'm a dedicated real estate professional with a passion for helping clients navigate the complex world of property transactions.  I specialize in a diverse range of neighborhoods across Texas Gulf Coast region. Whether you're interested in the vibrant communities in the city of Houston, the serene landscapes of the metro Houston area suburbs or the rural areas with land to roam, I am committed to providing personalized and expert real estate services tailored to your unique needs.

With an extensive track record in selling properties, I bring a wealth of experience and insight to every transaction. My certifications as an Accredited Buyer Representative, Certified Home Marketing Specialist, HAR Contracts Pro, and Pricing Strategy Advisor equip me with the skills necessary to guide you through every step of the buying or selling process. I understand that each neighborhood has its own unique charm and characteristics, and I am dedicated to matching my clients with the perfect home that suits their lifestyle and preferences.

I am always up-to-date with the latest market trends and property availability. Whether you're looking to buy, sell, or simply explore your options, I am here to assist you with a comprehensive understanding of the local real estate market. My goal is to make your real estate journey as smooth and successful as possible, leveraging my expertise and the resources of our brokerage.

I look forward to the opportunity to assist you in achieving your real estate goals.

remarks: Located in the heart of Greater Heights, this beautifully maintained 3-story townhome by Perry Homes offers modern design and convenience near local restaurants, breweries, boutique shopping, parks, and the White Oak Bayou Trail. The first floor features a private guest suite with a full bath, while the second floor offers an open-concept living and dining area with soaring ceilings and abundant natural light. The kitchen features granite countertops, a gas cooktop, bar seating, and an oversized pantry. The third-floor primary suite includes dual vanities, a soaking tub with a seamless glass shower combo, and a spacious walk-in closet. Recent updates include a roof (2025), condenser coil (2026), garage door motor (2024), fresh interior paint (2026), and updated flooring. A 2-car attached garage and guest street parking add convenience. HOA covers water, sewer, trash, recycling, and lawn maintenance. Move right in and enjoy all that Greater Heights has to offer.

remarks: Luxury canal-front living in Bal Harbour. This stunning three-level townhome features 3 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and modern finishes throughout. Ideal for boating enthusiasts, your canal access includes a private boat slip and dedicated lift. The open-concept second level serves as the main living hub, seamless blending an elegant kitchen with stainless steel appliances, a spacious dining space, a cozy fireplace, and an entertainer's wet bar. Relax across three private balconies offering peaceful afternoon shade and picturesque water views. The primary suite serves as a spa-like retreat, complete with a soaking tub and a large walk-in glass shower. Fully completed lower level provides versatile additional living space. Neighborhood pool and tennis courts walking distance. Owners can rent Windermere mansion at Bal Harbor Marina for a nominal fee. Close to upcoming Compass Hotel/Margaritaville Nassau Bay. Enjoy a wonderful water lifestyle with close proximity to the big city of Houston!

Joe Diosana is a licensed associate broker through Keller Williams. He earned his Bachelor of Science degree in computer science from Northwestern University and has previous experience in complex sales, direct selling, real estate and mortgage. His “5 Step Maximum Price Process” guarantees the best price on your home, and “10-Point Marketing Strategy” delivers the maximum exposure your property deserves. In his spare time, Joe enjoys pursuing health and wellness through athletics and education to improve his personal development and growth. He also enjoys competitive ballroom, salsa and country-western dancing, and backpacking in England, Europe, Africa and Israel.

Keri Josephson and his family have been a part of Texas real estate so long they have original land grants from Mexico from when they arrived with Stephen F. Austin in East Texas. Keri has been in Houston for over 17 years, and it has been fun seeing all the changes that have happened during this time. He lived in Argentina for two years after high school where he picked up Spanish and a love for Latin American food and culture. He graduated from Brigham Young University in Provo Utah where he studied biology, international business, and Spanish. Keri has two grown daughters that he loves spending time with when their schedules allow. His long-term goal is to have a garage full of roadsters, he has always enjoyed a convertible roadster. He has had a passion for cars ever since his grandmother took him to auto shows as a child. Keri works hard daily to be the person his dog, Maker, sees him as.

remarks:
Welcome to Water's Edge! This beautifully maintained single-story home offers 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and a dedicated flex room that can be used as study/office/ gaming or play room; providing the perfect blend of comfort and functionality. Tucked away in the highly desirable Water's Edge community near Lake Houston, this home features a private fenced backyard and covered patio, creating the perfect space to relax and unwind.

Enjoy neighborhood amenities including scenic walking trails, a community pond for catch-and-release fishing, clubhouse, fitness center, sparkling pool, and children's playground. Conveniently located near IAH Airport, shopping, dining, and top area schools, this home offers the lifestyle you've been looking for. Don't miss your opportunity to live in one of the area's most sought-after waterfront communities!

agents.bio:
A true professional in the world of real estate, Gwen Key Willis works diligently. Dedication to her career is evident in her constant drive to learn and grow in a dynamic field where her journey to becoming a realtor led her to the successful broker she is today.

Encouraged by her husband, Gwen obtained a broker’s license and opened Key Realtors in 2008. It was time to reinvest the money she handed over to the first agency, in herself. As a broker, Gwen thrives on helping her agents to be successful in reaching their own goals and has tripled her number of agents. Her insight and encouragement ensure that the agency helps as many clients as possible. As a team, they’ve made Key Realtors a community resource where everyone is welcome to ask questions and learn about real estate.

When she is not with clients or volunteering, she enjoys being outdoors and spending time with family on her property near Lake Limestone. She loves being surrounded by her husband, children, and grandchildren just relaxing on what will one day be a place to retire.

My background as a registered nurse instilled in me honesty, compassion, and a deep commitment to caring — qualities I now bring into my real estate practice. I’m passionate about helping people achieve their real estate dreams and providing an honest, supportive experience that’s better than the one I personally encountered.

remarks: Beautiful modern, chic patio home located in a small, gated enclave of 19 homes. The spacious 8x18 Entry Hall has high ceilings and beautiful wood floors. Just beyond & under the stairs is a cute, smart Mudroom and storage area. There is a back door that leads to small, low maintenance outdoor area with a covered patio. The first floor 13x11 bedroom has it's own private ensuite bathroom and walkin closet. The 2nd Level is the main living area with a smart, modern, open open floor plan. There is even a 7x8 outdoor terrace. Check out the kitchen with large Island, stainless Bosche appliances, lots of custom cabinets, gas cooktop with hood/fan above. The Powder Room is privately tucked away just off the landing. The large 17x13 Primary Bedroom is on the 3rd floor. You will love the Primary Bath with double vanities, frameless glass enclosed shower, modern soaking tub & a 6x17 closet! Also on the 3rd level is a third bedroom & utility closet. Ten foot ceilings on Levels 1&3. Eleven on 2nd.

agents.bio: Having the right real estate agent means having an agent who is committed to helping you buy and/or sell your home, along with demonstrating:   superior client service, expertise in local markets, competence in the analysis of market/housing data,  responsiveness to calls/emails (accessible 24/7). A rare generational treasure, this fully restored historic estate seamlessly marries original architectural elegance with modern luxury. Situated on a 6,500 sq ft lot minutes from Rice University, St. Thomas, top museums, parks, and dining, this turn-key classic offers unmatched versatility.

The 3,163 sq ft main home features preserved period details: restored trim, hardware, windows, doors, moldings, built-ins, and hardwood floors. Main-level living flows to sprawling porches for effortless entertaining. Upstairs holds a primary suite with en-suite bath, a Jack-and-Jill suite, plus an extra bed and bath. A private 528 sq ft 1-bed/1-bath apartment above the garage adds flexible living or income space.

Complete 2026 mechanical upgrades—HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and roof—ensure total longevity. Fully permitted and COH and Historic Society-approved. A 5-bed, 5-bath historic home of this caliber is extremely rare. Schedule your private showing today!

A native Houstonian and resident for over 30 years, David absolutely loves his hometown. He enjoys working with buyers, sellers, and those looking to lease or invest in the local market. Having lived in Montrose, Houston Heights, Downtown, and EaDo throughout various stages of his life has afforded him an intimate knowledge of Houston's inner-loop neighborhoods.
Currently, David calls the Near Northside, adjacent to the Houston Heights, home. He enjoys helping clients throughout all areas of Houston. A successful healthcare administrator and small business manager for over ten years in his previous career, David finds it most rewarding to work with clients relocating to Houston as well as first time homebuyers. He holds an MBA from Texas Woman's University and an undergraduate degree in Healthcare Administration from the University of Houston Clear Lake.

remarks:

agents.bio:
Nicholas "Nick" Chambers, CRS, RSPS, CIPS

Nicholas "Nick" Chambers is a Broker Associate with Realty of America (ROA) and founder of Chambers Properties Group, serving homeowners, buyers, investors, and relocation clients throughout Houston and the Greater Houston area.

With more than 17 years of experience in Texas real estate, Nick helps clients make informed decisions through strategic planning, market analysis, and data-driven pricing rather than sales pressure. His advisory approach is built around protecting equity, reducing risk, and creating clear decision paths during significant life transitions.

Nick works with clients buying or selling primary residences, luxury homes, new construction, relocation properties, and select investment real estate throughout Houston's diverse neighborhoods. Every recommendation is tailored to current market conditions, local buyer behavior, inventory levels, and each client's goals and timeline.

Rather than treating real estate as a transaction, Nick approaches every property as a financial asset. Sellers receive guidance on pricing strategy, property preparation, market positioning, and negotiation. Buyers benefit from objective market analysis, competitive offer strategy, and clear advice on when to move forward—or when patience creates a stronger opportunity.

Core Services:
• Residential listing representation
• Strategic home selling and pricing analysis
• Buyer representation and negotiation
• Luxury real estate advisory
• Relocation services
• New construction guidance
• Investment property acquisition and disposition
• Comparative Market Analysis (CMA)
• Home value evaluations

- Areas Served - 
Chambers Properties Group serves clients throughout the Greater Houston region, including:

River Oaks • Memorial • West University • Bellaire • The Heights • Rice Military • Timbergrove • Oak Forest • Cypress • Bridgeland • Towne Lake • Katy • Energy Corridor • Sugar Land • Spring • Tomball • The Woodlands and surrounding communities.

- The Advisory Process -

Every client engagement begins with understanding three questions:
• What are you trying to accomplish?
• What constraints or risks should we account for?
• What strategy creates the strongest long-term outcome?

From there, recommendations are based on market data, pricing trends, buyer demand, and proven execution—not assumptions or one-size-fits-all solutions.

Clients appreciate Nick's ability to simplify complex market information into practical guidance, helping them move forward with confidence from the initial consultation through closing.

agents.bio:
Licensed since 2006, I serve home buyers and sellers in Houston, TX and surrounding areas with a client-centered approach built on communication, trust, and results. My real estate business is built on referrals, long-term relationships, and a deep understanding of local communities and market trends.

I specialize in residential real estate across all life stages, including helping first-time buyers, growing families, and clients looking to downsize or rightsize. My work is guided by three core values:

Legacy. Integrity. Adventure.

These values shape how I represent my clients, negotiate contracts, and deliver results that matter.

What You Can Expect:

Honest advice and personalized service throughout the process
Strategic pricing, marketing, and open house execution
Clear and consistent communication from consultation to closing
A calm, organized, and professional approach
A well-connected agent who knows Houston and the surrounding areas inside and out

Outside of real estate, I enjoy early morning gym sessions, spending time with family, and playing pickleball and Mah Jong with friends.If you're searching for a reliable, experienced real estate agent in Houston, I would be honored to help you buy or sell with confidence.

remarks: Beautifully remodeled 5-bedroom, 2.5-bath single-story pool home in desirable Maplewood West, Houston. Thoughtfully updated for today’s lifestyle, this inviting residence blends modern luxury, smart functionality, and a warm, cozy feel. The light-filled interior showcases new Low-E windows, luxury vinyl plank flooring, designer light fixtures, new ceiling fans, and fresh interior and exterior paint. The stunning kitchen features quartz countertops, a stylish backsplash, generous workspace, and an inviting layout perfect for everyday living and entertaining. Updated bathrooms offer a fresh, refined look. Major improvements include a new roof, new PEX plumbing, new electrical panel, and foundation repairs with warranty for added peace of mind. Enjoy your private backyard retreat with a sparkling swimming pool, new pump, and new timer. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, schools, and major roadways, this move-in-ready Houston home offers space, style, comfort, and convenience.

agents.bio:
I specialize in helping clients identify high-value real estate opportunities with a strong focus on commercial properties, investments, and strategic acquisitions. As an active real estate investor myself, I understand investing from both sides of the table — not only as an advisor, but as someone who personally owns rental houses, apartment properties, and commercial buildings focused on building long-term passive income and wealth creation.

My growing investment portfolio gives me firsthand experience in evaluating opportunities, negotiating strong deals, managing risk, and recognizing value that others may overlook. I believe the best way to guide clients is by applying strategies I personally use and believe in.

Whether you are expanding an investment portfolio, purchasing commercial real estate, or searching for the right opportunity, I bring a hands-on, results-driven approach built on market knowledge, strong negotiation, and real-world investing experience.

Real estate is more than buying and selling properties — it is about building financial freedom and creating long-term value. My goal is simple: help clients make smart decisions, secure exceptional opportunities, and build wealth with confidence.

remarks: Beautifully renovated and move-in ready, this stunning two-story home offers the perfect blend of modern style, comfort and effortless living! A gorgeous kitchen with quartz countertops, subway tile backsplash and stainless steel appliances makes everyday living and entertaining a delight. The first-floor primary retreat features a spa-inspired bath with freestanding soaking tub, walk-in shower and dual vanities. Upstairs, three spacious bedrooms, two updated baths, a dedicated home office and versatile game room provide room to work, relax and play. Wood and laminate flooring enhance both levels, while the expansive backyard offers endless possibilities for entertaining, outdoor fun or a future pool. Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in the heart of the Energy Corridor, enjoy an exceptional lifestyle just steps from scenic Terry Hershey Park and highly acclaimed Barbara Bush Elementary. A wonderful place to call home!

remarks: This two-story home in Cypress Terrace offers a functional layout with 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, 1 half bath, and approximately 1,695 square feet. The first floor includes a comfortable living area, formal dining room, breakfast room, and kitchen, creating an easy flow for everyday living and entertaining. All three bedrooms are upstairs, providing separation from the main living areas. The fully fenced backyard offers space for outdoor dining, recreation, pets, or future personalization. Additional features include central gas heating, central electric cooling, a radiant attic barrier, and an attached two-car garage. Located near FM 1960, Aldine Westfield Road, and I-45, the home provides convenient access to shopping, restaurants, services, and major routes throughout north Houston.

agents.bio:
Nicholas "Nick" Chambers, CRS, RSPS, CIPS

Nicholas "Nick" Chambers is a Broker Associate with Realty of America (ROA) and founder of Chambers Properties Group, serving homeowners, buyers, investors, and relocation clients throughout Houston and the Greater Houston area.

With more than 17 years of experience in Texas real estate, Nick helps clients make informed decisions through strategic planning, market analysis, and data-driven pricing rather than sales pressure. His advisory approach is built around protecting equity, reducing risk, and creating clear decision paths during significant life transitions.

Nick works with clients buying or selling primary residences, luxury homes, new construction, relocation properties, and select investment real estate throughout Houston's diverse neighborhoods. Every recommendation is tailored to current market conditions, local buyer behavior, inventory levels, and each client's goals and timeline.

Rather than treating real estate as a transaction, Nick approaches every property as a financial asset. Sellers receive guidance on pricing strategy, property preparation, market positioning, and negotiation. Buyers benefit from objective market analysis, competitive offer strategy, and clear advice on when to move forward—or when patience creates a stronger opportunity.

Core Services:
• Residential listing representation
• Strategic home selling and pricing analysis
• Buyer representation and negotiation
• Luxury real estate advisory
• Relocation services
• New construction guidance
• Investment property acquisition and disposition
• Comparative Market Analysis (CMA)
• Home value evaluations

- Areas Served - 
Chambers Properties Group serves clients throughout the Greater Houston region, including:

River Oaks • Memorial • West University • Bellaire • The Heights • Rice Military • Timbergrove • Oak Forest • Cypress • Bridgeland • Towne Lake • Katy • Energy Corridor • Sugar Land • Spring • Tomball • The Woodlands and surrounding communities.

- The Advisory Process -

Every client engagement begins with understanding three questions:
• What are you trying to accomplish?
• What constraints or risks should we account for?
• What strategy creates the strongest long-term outcome?

From there, recommendations are based on market data, pricing trends, buyer demand, and proven execution—not assumptions or one-size-fits-all solutions.

Clients appreciate Nick's ability to simplify complex market information into practical guidance, helping them move forward with confidence from the initial consultation through closing.

agents.bio: As a seasoned real estate broker in the greater Houston area since 2003, Thomas L. Saunders offers unparalleled expertise and deep local connections. "Today's real estate transactions are anything but average, and people demand a level of service that matches their complexity," says Saunders, a lifelong Houstonian. He emphasizes the importance of a REALTOR® who is well-prepared to handle issues like seller liability and evolving laws. Early in his career, Saunders gained significant experience with acquisitions and liquidations at HomeVestors of America, and he has worked on REO liquidations with Trillionaire Assets and asset management with Jet Lending, LLC. Beyond his professional commitments, Saunders is dedicated to giving back, supporting Children’s Miracle Network Hospitals® and volunteering at local schools and the Fellowship of the Woodlands East Campus. His extensive background in commercial architecture, BPO evaluations, real estate investment, and REO sales ensures that clients receive top-notch service and expert advice in every transaction.

remarks: Beneath mature oaks in Spring Branch, 9317 Livernois pairs original character with thoughtful updates. An inviting kitchen pairs functionality with granite countertops, custom pantry with dedicated spice storage, and champagne bronze hardware. Secondary renovated bath offers serene European spa-inspired retreat with custom-milled cedar paneling and Kohler chrome fixtures. Restored oak floors bring warmth to the open layout, while a pocket door separates the front bedrooms for added privacy. Outside, a generous patio welcomes morning light, while private gardens, a deck, and custom storage shed extend daily living outdoors. Updates: driveway, side fence, gate (26'), with roof, plumbing, electrical, HVAC (16'). A distinctive blend of craftsmanship and inviting outdoor space. Rooted in charm. Connected to the city.

remarks: Breathtaking traditional home in one of Mar Vista's most sought-after pockets, within the coveted Mar Vista Elementary School district. A classic white picket fence and a beautifully landscaped, low-maintenance front yard lead you to a charming red front door. Inside, open living spaces are bathed in natural light and strike the perfect balance between period character and thoughtful upgrades. Warm hardwood floors run through the living areas and bedrooms, starting in a living room anchored by a brick fireplace and continuing into a formal dining room with French doors. The kitchen pairs rich wood cabinetry and bold cobalt tile with modern stainless steel appliances, including double wall ovens. It opens to a sunny breakfast nook with French doors to the yard. A bright sunroom adds a few hundred square feet of flexible space for a family room, home office or creative studio (not included in the square footage). All three bedrooms sit in their own wing, keeping living and sleeping spaces nicely separated. They include a spacious primary bedroom with dual closets, and the home also has two luxuriously updated bathrooms with sleek finishes and glass-enclosed showers. The home offers an impressive amount of storage, plus peace-of-mind upgrades including a newer HVAC system and copper plumbing. Out back, the large, maintenance-free yard is framed by lush hedges for privacy. Brick patios create multiple areas for lounging, relaxing or dining al fresco, and a two-car garage completes the package. All of this sits in one of the Westside's most desirable communities. Walk, bike or drive to the best of Mar Vista, Playa Vista and Venice Beach. You'll have everything your heart could desire nearby, from workouts at Equinox and stand-up paddle boarding on the water to Trader Joe's, Whole Foods and the buzzworthy restaurants along Abbot Kinney and Washington Boulevard. It's an easy, low-maintenance lifestyle to live, work and play in the heart of LA's thriving tech and creative scene.

agents.bio:
Growing up in Venezuela, my family valued entrepreneurship and believed in success being achieved through honesty, dedication, commitment, and hard work. I have carried this with me throughout life, in everything I have done. I have a passion for real estate and know these values, combined with sales, negotiation, contract management, and communication skills developed over 15 years in the oil and gas industry will allow me to successfully cater to your real estate needs.
Before moving to Houston, I attained a bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from one of the most prestigious universities in Venezuela. After graduating, I was eager to move to the United States and I chose Houston as my home, where I obtained a Master of Science in Structural Engineering from the University of Houston. I then pursued a successful career in the oil and gas industry for 15 years, working for Fortune 500 companies such as NOV, GE, Cameron and Schlumberger. During this time, I gained experience and acquired skills which prepared me for success in real estate. This includes international experience working in multimillion dollar projects with high profile customers, a successful track record in International sales, customer excellence, technical and commercial negotiations, contract management and project management.

Even before dedicating myself to real estate full time, I was always passionate about it and was actively involved in Houston’s real estate market, developing and managing a substantial portfolio of investment properties in the inner loop. In addition, I have constantly been there to serve friends by providing them with sound advice and direction in areas such as real estate investment, home buying, and home staging and decoration.
I like to stay active and support my community. When not working, I enjoy spending quality time with my family and friends, cooking, trying new restaurants, traveling, exploring Houston’s wonderful parks, practicing yoga, gardening, and attending the Houston Symphony as well as other local theaters.
14 years working, living and playing in the Great Heights and inner loop area.

agents.bio:
Charlie Bingham is a distinguished REALTOR® specializing in the Greater Houston market. Renowned for his exceptional negotiation skills and meticulous attention to detail, Charlie ensures that every client receives unparalleled service tailored to their unique needs. His client-centric approach is rooted in a deep understanding of the real estate process, supported by his extensive background in hospitality management.

Charlie’s expertise encompasses investment properties and renovation projects, making him a valuable advisor for clients at any price point. His commitment to open communication keeps clients well-informed and confident throughout their real estate journey. Fluent in French, Charlie adeptly assists French-speaking clients and other expatriates, simplifying their transition to Houston.

An active community member, Charlie serves as the President of the Crestwood Civic Club, volunteers at the Houston Food Bank, contributes to a Rodeo Committee, and is a member of the Memorial Park Advisory Board.

Outside of real estate, Charlie enjoys cultural events, padel, and pickleball. He is happily married, with two daughters and a Pomeranian dog.

Charlie Bingham’s dedication to excellence and his profound understanding of the Houston real estate market make him an outstanding choice for clients seeking an authentic and trustworthy REALTOR®.

remarks: Tucked inside a gated Montrose community, 811 Lovett Blvd offers an unexpected sense of privacy in one of Houston’s most connected neighborhoods. The living room flows into a dining area anchored by exposed brick and built in cabinetry. The primary suite includes an updated bath, generous closet space, and access to a private balcony overlooking the courtyard. A community pool, mature landscaping, and distinctive architecture complete the setting, just one block south of Westheimer near Montrose dining, entertainment, Downtown, Midtown, and major employment centers.

Charlton “Chuck” Shelby | REALTOR® | Surge Realty
“Just 10 Digits Away.”
Buying or selling a home is one of the biggest moves you’ll ever make—and you deserve a strategist who treats your goals with precision, urgency, and respect. I’m Charlton “Chuck” Shelby, a Houston-area REALTOR® specializing in Fort Bend County, Katy, Richmond, Fulshear, Waller County, and the Greater Houston suburbs.
My background in the automotive industry gives me a competitive edge: negotiations, customer service, and clear communication are second nature. Today, I use that same skill set to guide families, relocators, and investors through seamless real estate moves—whether it’s upsizing, relocating to Texas, selling quickly, or finding a property with long-term value.
Clients work with me because I’m direct, detail-driven, and solutions-focused. I’m committed to understanding the full picture of your needs, educating you at every step, and protecting your best interests from the first consultation to the closing table.
What I Bring to Every Client:
• Strategic pricing & negotiations
• Market-backed guidance (no fluff—only reality)
• Local expertise in neighborhoods, schools & amenities
• High-level marketing for listings
• A network of top lenders, inspectors, and contractors
• Clear communication—every time
Whether you’re making your first move or your fifth, I’m here to make it your smartest one yet.

remarks: Located in the heart of Houston's revitalized East End! This beautifully renovated 2-story, 3BR/2BA home includes a versatile garage apartment offering a 3/2 layout or 2/1 plus efficiency configuration. The efficiency features granite countertops and a sink, ready for kitchenette completion. The apartment has its own laundry and electric meter, while downstairs offers flex/office space and separate storage. The main home showcases refinished hardwood floors, new windows, custom cabinetry, granite countertops, island kitchen, stainless appliances and plantation shutters. Enjoy a soaking tub with separate shower, plus an outdoor spa hot tub beneath a pergola with Edison lights! A Generac generator adds peace of mind. The upstairs third bedroom doubles as a loft, office or game room. Ideal for multigenerational living or potential rental income. Minutes from Downtown and UH, near METRO transit, with easy access to I-45, US-59 and Loop 610. Priced to sell!

remarks: Zoned to award-winning schools, this charming Westbury home is ideally situated in one of the neighborhood’s most desirable pockets. Offering 3 bedrooms, 2 full baths, a spacious flex room & air-conditioned garage workshop, gym or hobby space, the floor plan provides exceptional versatility. As a 5th generation Houstonian, I have a deep appreciation for this city and its people. This is an exciting time to live in the Greater Houston Area, and I'm proud to be a part of it all! I've been licensed for 10 plus years and have successfully closed over 500 transactions since 2010. Although I live and work in Bellaire, I proudly serve the entire Houston market and will continue to provide exceptional service for each of my clients and my community as a whole. As your Real Estate Specialist, I promise to be your trusted resource for answers about the process of buying or selling. I will provide expertise about neighborhood features and schools and will target your home search based on your individual needs and wants. My custom innovative marketing strategies along with my strong negotiation skills are the keys to your successful transaction.

As an agent who's an expert in this local area, I bring a wealth of knowledge and expertise about buying and selling real estate here. It's not the same everywhere, so you need someone you can trust for up-to-date information. I am eager to serve you. Here are some of the things I can do for you. Do you need someone who knows this area inside and out? I can work with you to find the right home at the right price for you, including all the neighborhood amenities that matter - not to mention the essential criteria you have for your ideal home. When it's time to move, you need someone who will advertise your home, show it to prospective buyers, negotiate the purchase contract, arrange to finance, oversee the inspections, handle all necessary paperwork and supervise the closing. I can take care of everything you need, from start to close. Oftentimes buyers don't visualize living in your home the way you do. I can make your home attractive to its ideal audience which can help you get top dollar. Things like staging the home, making repairs or minor improvements, or even simply painting the walls can be the difference between a home resting on the market and one that's sold fast.

As an active real estate investor myself, I understand investing from both sides of the table — not only as an advisor, but as someone who personally owns rental houses, apartment properties, and commercial buildings focused on building long-term passive income and wealth creation.

Whether you are expanding an investment portfolio, purchasing commercial real estate, or searching for the right opportunity, I bring a hands-on, results-driven approach built on market knowledge, strong negotiation, and real-world investing experience.

Real estate is more than buying and selling properties — it is about building financial freedom and creating long-term value. My goal is simple: help clients make smart decisions, secure exceptional opportunities, and build wealth with confidence.

Monica Villaseñor is a top-rated Houston REALTOR® and Berkshire Hathaway President’s Circle award recipient, recognized among the Top 25 Agents in Texas. Since becoming licensed in 2020, she has helped buyers and sellers close more than $33 million in real estate across Houston’s most desirable neighborhoods, including The Greater Heights, Montrose, Rice Military, Garden Oaks, Oak Forest, Spring Branch, West University, River Oaks, and Memorial.

Monica specializes in luxury homes, first-time buyers, out-of-state relocations, corporate and medical moves, new construction, move-up buyers, and downsizing. Her industry credentials—including Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist (CLHMS), Certified Home Marketing Specialist (CHMS), Accredited Buyer Representative (ABR), and Certified New Home Specialist—reflect a high level of professional training and a commitment to exceptional client care.

Known for her strong negotiation skills, market knowledge, and personalized service, Monica offers a client-first approach that makes each transaction smooth, informed, and stress-free. Bilingual in English and Spanish and a graduate of The University of Texas at Austin, she combines local expertise with clear communication to help every client achieve their real estate goals with confidence. Whether buying or selling, clients trust Monica for her professionalism, responsiveness, and proven results in the Houston market.

remarks: Set along a tree-lined street with views of the surrounding hills and beautiful neighboring estates, 5295 College View Avenue presents an exceptional opportunity to reimagine a character-filled home in Eagle Rock. Offered as-is, this three-bedroom, two-bath fixer invites a thoughtful renovation that honors its architectural roots while creating a fresh vision for modern living. Original plans and construction specifications reflect an emphasis on craftsmanship, with details such as oak flooring, custom woodwork, and a brick fireplace, an inspiring reference for its next chapter. The existing layout includes separate living and family rooms, a dining area, and a dedicated laundry room. Front and back yards, a patio, and a veranda offer possibilities for outdoor entertaining and landscaping. A side driveway with a partially covered parking area leads to a two-car garage, with an additional room accessible behind the garage. Interior stairs provide access to a basement beneath the raised foundation. Eagle Rock's distinctive neighborhood character, local cafes, restaurants, and shops along Colorado and Eagle Rock Boulevards, together with Occidental College, add to the appeal of this Northeast Los Angeles setting. Bring your imagination and explore the possibilities to restore, refresh, and make this home your own. Any expansion or change of use is subject to buyer investigation and applicable approvals.

For sellers, Hamid develops tailored pricing, preparation, and marketing plans designed to highlight each property’s strengths and attract qualified buyers. Based in Culver City, Hamid serves communities across Los Angeles and Orange County. Outside real estate, he enjoys skiing, hiking, water sports, and exploring Southern California with family and friends.

agents.bio:
Growing up in Venezuela, my family valued entrepreneurship and believed in success being achieved through honesty, dedication, commitment, and hard work. I have carried this with me throughout life, in everything I have done. I have a passion for real estate and know these values, combined with sales, negotiation, contract management, and communication skills developed over 15 years in the oil and gas industry will allow me to successfully cater to your real estate needs.
Before moving to Houston, I attained a bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from one of the most prestigious universities in Venezuela. After graduating, I was eager to move to the United States and I chose Houston as my home, where I obtained a Master of Science in Structural Engineering from the University of Houston. I then pursued a successful career in the oil and gas industry for 15 years, working for Fortune 500 companies such as NOV, GE, Cameron and Schlumberger. During this time, I gained experience and acquired skills which prepared me for success in real estate. This includes international experience working in multimillion dollar projects with high profile customers, a successful track record in International sales, customer excellence, technical and commercial negotiations, contract management and project management.

Even before dedicating myself to real estate full time, I was always passionate about it and was actively involved in Houston’s real estate market, developing and managing a substantial portfolio of investment properties in the inner loop. In addition, I have constantly been there to serve friends by providing them with sound advice and direction in areas such as real estate investment, home buying, and home staging and decoration.
I like to stay active and support my community. When not working, I enjoy spending quality time with my family and friends, cooking, trying new restaurants, traveling, exploring Houston’s wonderful parks, practicing yoga, gardening, and attending the Houston Symphony as well as other local theaters.
14 years working, living and playing in the Great Heights and inner loop area.

remarks: Welcome to your urban oasis in the heart of Westchase! This stunning second-floor, 1-bedroom condo combines low-maintenance living with unbeatable city convenience. Stepping inside, you are greeted by an open-concept living space that flows seamlessly into a private, tree-lined balcony—perfect for your morning coffee or evening wind-down. The bedroom features a generous walk-in closet, providing plenty of storage space. Located in a secure, gated community, residents enjoy access to beautifully maintained grounds and a sparkling neighborhood pool. HOA fees cover water, sewer, trash, and exterior maintenance, offering a truly lock-and-leave lifestyle. Best of all, you are just seconds from Beltway 8 and the Westpark Tollway, putting Houston’s premier dining, shopping, and entertainment right at your doorstep. Whether you are looking for a savvy investment property or a place to call home, this Westchase gem is a must-see!

agents.bio:
Curtis is an exceptional real estate agent with a wealth of experience as a real estate investor, bachelor of science degree in music production, accomplished musician, and private pilot. With a successful career spanning over 15 years servicing the private office of the Minister of Petroleum of Saudi Arabia, he brings a unique blend of skills and a keen understanding of the industry to every transaction.

Known for his strategic approach and meticulous attention to detail, Curtis has an innate ability to identify lucrative investment opportunities and navigate complex real estate deals with ease. He has a passion for helping clients achieve their financial goals through property investment and homeownership, leveraging his market knowledge and negotiation prowess to deliver exceptional results.

Outside the real estate realm, Curtis is a talented musician with a bachelor's degree in music production, showcasing his creativity and dedication to honing his craft. As a private pilot, he embraces challenges with a composed and focused demeanor, qualities that also translate into his approach as a real estate agent.

With a diverse background and a reputation for professionalism, integrity, and a client-centric approach, Curtis is the ideal choice for all your real estate needs, providing a seamless and rewarding experience in every transaction. Whether you're a first-time buyer, seasoned investor, or looking to sell your property, Curtis is ready to guide you through the process and make your real estate dreams a reality.

agents.bio:
HOUSTON, TX
Mary Wassef is a proud Canadian who has made Houston her beloved home, emerging as a leading expert in luxury real estate within The Heights and its historic markets. With over two decades of experience, Mary blends her deep knowledge of historic architecture with modern construction techniques, offering a unique perspective to her diverse clientele. Her multicultural background and extensive network allow her to connect with clients from all walks of life, providing an empathetic and tailored real estate experience. Mary's unwavering commitment to her clients' dreams and goals truly sets her apart. She makes the real estate journey enjoyable and even fun, understanding the profound life changes it often represents. Her dedication extends to walking alongside her clients through every transaction, ensuring that each step is handled with precision and care. In 2011, Mary founded Circa Real Estate, which flourished under her leadership with a team of nearly 30 agents renowned for their personalized and unique services. Her approach is characterized by generosity, selflessness, and an unmatched work ethic, inspiring her team to consistently go above and beyond. Her 19th Street storefront stands as a testament to her commitment to community development, frequently hosting local art, community events, and support for neighborhood businesses. Recently, Mary has transitioned her team, the Circa Houston Group, to Realty of America, allowing her to expand her reach while maintaining the personalized service her clients have come to expect. For Mary, Houston's Heights is more than just a location; it's a cherished community. Whether you're buying, selling, or investing, Mary Wassef is your trusted partner in navigating this vibrant and historic Houston neighborhood.

remarks: Welcome to 6027 W 76th Street, where timeless character meets modern sophistication in Westchesters desirable North Westport Heights! Beautifully reimagined, this 4-bedroom, 4-bath residence offers 2,617 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space on a generous 7,442-square-foot lot. A charming exterior accented by warm wood detailing and mature landscaping sets the stage for an interior built around indoor/outdoor living and the kind of California entertaining that actually brings people together. Step inside to an expansive, light-filled floor plan featuring wide-plank flooring, recessed lighting, and a striking fireplace wrapped in natural wood slat detailing and marble-inspired stone. The remodeled kitchen is anchored by quartz countertops, white shaker cabinetry, contrasting black hardware, and generous storage, and flows directly into the living and dining spaces so the whole main level opens up for everyday life and gatherings alike. A main-level bedroom with its own full bath makes an ideal guest suite, home office, or multigenerational setup, with a second main-level bedroom offering added flexibility. Upstairs, the primary retreat features its own fireplace and a spa-inspired ensuite with a freestanding soaking tub and glass-enclosed shower. A second upstairs ensuite bedroom offers added privacy for guests or extended stays. The real showstopper is outside. A spectacular multi-level backyard unfolds across three distinct terraces, with a sparkling pool and spa surrounded by lush landscaping, inviting patios for lounging and dining, and an upper terrace lawn

remarks: Embrace the ultimate coastal lifestyle in this exquisite Bal Harbour residence. A masterpiece of maritime-inspired design, this home offers a seamless blend of luxury and direct access to the vibrant Nassau Bay waterfront. Enjoy your hot tub at home, access to tennis courts, Swim Club and Exclusive Access to the Windemere Mansion for events. An expansive, light-filled layout featuring soaring ceilings, designer finishes, and floor-to-ceiling windows that capture serene water views accompanied by new carpets and a fresh coat of paint. Step outside to a private deck overlooking the canal—your gateway to Clear Lake and the Gulf. Enjoy your private boat slip access as well. Minutes from the Johnson Space Center, elite yacht clubs, and the Bay Area’s finest dining and boardwalks. Future nearby Margaritaville development coming 2027.

remarks:
Move-in ready Houston Medical Center condo! Enjoy a quiet setting in Briar Green, a gated community near the Texas Medical Center, NRG Stadium, Rice University and Museum District. Walk to METRORail and a shuttle bus stop for convenient transportation.

This one-bedroom corner unit features a spacious living room with abundant natural light, a wood-burning fireplace and custom mantel. The kitchen offers updated countertops, a microwave, dishwasher and included refrigerator. A generous walk-in closet, hall closet and outdoor storage off the private patio provide ample storage. The bathroom features a double vanity and linen closet. Stacked washer/dryer included; HVAC replaced in 2020.

Monica specializes in luxury homes, first-time buyers, out-of-state relocations, corporate and medical moves, new construction, move-up buyers, and downsizing. Her industry credentials—including Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist (CLHMS), Certified Home Marketing Specialist (CHMS), Accredited Buyer Representative (ABR), and Certified New Home Specialist—reflect a high level of professional training and a commitment to exceptional client care.

Known for her strong negotiation skills, market knowledge, and personalized service, Monica offers a client-first approach that makes each transaction smooth, informed, and stress-free. agents.bio:
Oscar C. Hernandez, founder of The Advisory Real Estate + Development and Team Leader of The Oscar Fine Properties Team, has been a Houston real estate leader since 2002. His local expertise, financial background and client-first approach make him a trusted Advisor to clients. Oscar has closed more than $300 million in transactions and earned numerous industry accolades and designations, but he prefers to measure success through the satisfaction of his clients. Guided by a desire to serve others, he provides exceptional, personalized representation that surpasses the agent role - making him an integral member of each client’s professional services team. 
 
A Houston native, Oscar graduated from prestigious Rice University with a Bachelor’s Degree in Economics before heading to Wall Street, where he had an eight-year career as an oil & gas equity research analyst. He entered the real estate industry after he had moved back to Houston, when a former colleague sought his advice on the purchase of four multi-family properties. Oscar was the point person during the life of these investments; assisting with occupancy, improvements and, eventually, divestment. 
 
In many ways, Oscar's background as a financial analyst defines his approach to real estate. He views every purchase and sale through an investment lens. He specializes in using short and long-term trend analyses to determine a property’s current and potential resale value alongside in-depth market knowledge to guide his clients through the intricacies of real estate transactions. Oscar is also known for his creative marketing strategies and events - from open houses, to soiree's to client appreciation parties - and he has been creating and utilizing personalized, professional HD videos to sell lifestyle since 2008. 
 
Oscar specializes in Houston’s luxury market but believes in providing a luxury experience at every price point. He tailors his communication style to his clients’ preferences and provides information that is as thorough or concise as they wish. Many people in Oscar’s returning client-roster are busy professionals who are experts in their respective fields, and he’s also an expert that top Houston area agents call upon for their personal property needs or when a listing isn't selling in a timely fashion. He embraces the opportunity to collaborate with other agents on any need that may arise. 
 
Personally, Oscar's charitable donations and volunteer efforts include involvement with The Beacon, a local nonprofit that provides counseling, housing, and other civil services to bring Houston’s unhoused back into the community, and Scenic Houston, an organization that beautifies, connects, and improves Houston neighborhoods, drawing out his passion to help shape the future of Houston. Other organizations near and dear to his heart are Rice University, Kids' Meals, Inc., Ryan's Well Foundation, Living Water International, Autism Speaks, Houston Pets Alive, Pup Squad Animal Rescue and MD Anderson. 
 
When not with clients or giving back to the community, you’ll find Oscar keeping up with the latest events and openings around town, and enjoying the many activities that the greater Houston area offers - manifesting his mantra of 'Come Live Where You Play!'  Oscar is a resident of Houston's First Ward (est. 1840) and enjoys tennis, biking, leisurely walks, wine & food tastings and has a deep appreciation for the arts.

As an investor myself, I know that every move should be closely evaluated to bring maximum ROI. My trusted lenders, inspectors, and contractors make your deal smooth.

As a marathon runner, triathlete and Hyrox competitor, I bring focus and grit to keep things on track — and I’ll keep you informed with proactive calls, texts, and updates so you’re never left in the dark.

remarks: Located in gated Alys Park in Houston's Rice Military/Washington Corridor, this contemporary corner residence offers 3,188 square feet across three levels, with additional windows and abundant natural light. The first floor features an en-suite bedroom and access to a fenced outdoor entertaining area with a covered kitchen, patio, pergola and open-air space. Upstairs, the main living level includes wood floors, high ceilings, spacious living and dining areas, a quartz island kitchen, walk-in pantry, pot filler, soft-close cabinetry, under-cabinet lighting and balcony. The third floor offers a spacious primary suite with an oversized bath and walk-in closet, an additional en-suite bedroom and utility room. Additional features include an oversized three-car tandem garage, dedicated elevator shaft for potential future installation, generator-ready infrastructure, exterior gas connection and wired sound.

agents.bio:
Nicholas "Nick" Chambers, CRS, RSPS, CIPS

Nicholas "Nick" Chambers is a Broker Associate with Realty of America (ROA) and founder of Chambers Properties Group, serving homeowners, buyers, investors, and relocation clients throughout Houston and the Greater Houston area.

With more than 17 years of experience in Texas real estate, Nick helps clients make informed decisions through strategic planning, market analysis, and data-driven pricing rather than sales pressure. His advisory approach is built around protecting equity, reducing risk, and creating clear decision paths during significant life transitions.

Nick works with clients buying or selling primary residences, luxury homes, new construction, relocation properties, and select investment real estate throughout Houston's diverse neighborhoods. Every recommendation is tailored to current market conditions, local buyer behavior, inventory levels, and each client's goals and timeline.

Rather than treating real estate as a transaction, Nick approaches every property as a financial asset. Sellers receive guidance on pricing strategy, property preparation, market positioning, and negotiation. Buyers benefit from objective market analysis, competitive offer strategy, and clear advice on when to move forward—or when patience creates a stronger opportunity.

Core Services:
• Residential listing representation
• Strategic home selling and pricing analysis

In 2011, Mary founded Circa Real Estate, which flourished under her leadership with a team of nearly 30 agents renowned for their personalized and unique services. Her approach is characterized by generosity, selflessness, and an unmatched work ethic, inspiring her team to consistently go above and beyond. Her 19th Street storefront stands as a testament to her commitment to community development, frequently hosting local art, community events, and support for neighborhood businesses. Recently, Mary has transitioned her team, the Circa Houston Group, to Realty of America, allowing her to expand her reach while maintaining the personalized service her clients have come to expect. For Mary, Houston's Heights is more than just a location; it's a cherished community. Whether you're buying, selling, or investing, Mary Wassef is your trusted partner in navigating this vibrant and historic Houston neighborhood.

agents.bio:
Bea Flores, ABR, SRS, is a renowned figure in the Houston real estate market, with over 18 years of industry expertise. Her passion for real estate and dedication to exceptional service inspired her to establish her own brokerage, Luxe Living Group, over three years ago. Under her leadership, Bea has guided her team to remarkable success, earning recognition as one of Houston's top agents.

In December 2024, Bea and her team joined Compass Real Estate, a decision driven by the extensive marketing opportunities and advanced technology Compass offers. This move allows Luxe Living Group to enhance the already top-notch real estate experience they provide, giving clients access to cutting-edge tools and strategies that elevate every transaction.

Bea specializes in working with traditional buyers and sellers in Houston while carving out a niche in representing out-of-state institutional buyers across Texas cities like Houston, Dallas, and San Antonio. Her commitment to client education and transparent communication has earned her a loyal client base, with an impressive 85-90% of her business coming from repeat clients and referrals.

At Luxe Living Group, Bea ensures every client receives a luxurious and seamless experience, prioritizing meticulous attention to detail and comprehensive support to ensure success in every transaction.

Beyond her success as an agent, Bea is also a dedicated educator. For over nine years, she has been teaching real estate licensing courses, mentoring both agents and clients, and empowering them to navigate their real estate journeys with confidence.

Bea's outstanding achievements have earned her numerous accolades, including recognition among the Top 25 agents in Houston, a recent ranking among the Top 5 agents by production in the Houston Business Journal, and being featured in national publications such as Top Agent Magazine. She also served as President of the Women's Council of Realtors - Bay Area, Houston Chapter in 2013, further demonstrating her commitment to leadership and the advancement of the real estate profession.

With a foundation built on integrity, expertise, and an unwavering commitment to client satisfaction, Bea Flores and her team at Luxe Living Group, now proudly partnered with Compass, are dedicated to providing personalized, seamless real estate experiences that exceed expectations.

agents.bio:
Your Realtor for bigger wins, smaller stress

Buying or selling a home is one of life’s biggest financial decisions. With so many moving parts and big rewards at stake, you shouldn’t have to navigate it alone. I’m Roberta Meggs, your Texas Realtor and real estate investor, here to help you make smart, valuable, stress-free choices, whether it’s a luxury property or a cozy condo in Sugar Land.

As a Certified Negotiation Expert (CNE) and Pricing Strategy Advisor (PSA), I bring proven strategy to every transaction. You’re making this big move, and I’m your guide with 11 years of real estate experience. My sales and marketing background helps you sell fast or find the right home. As an investor myself, I know that every move should be closely evaluated to bring maximum ROI. My trusted lenders, inspectors, and contractors make your deal smooth.

As a marathon runner, triathlete and Hyrox competitor, I bring focus and grit to keep things on track — and I’ll keep you informed with proactive calls, texts, and updates so you’re never left in the dark.

Your plan to win:

1) Share Your Goals – You tell me what you want, we’ll plan a strategy.

2) Choose Smart – You’ll get clear info to decide confidently.

3) Succeed Together – You’ll close the deal with ease, with me by your side.

Ready? Call for a no-pressure chat or text “HOME” for a home value report! (555) 404-5268. 
No spam. No pressure. Just real help when you’re ready.

agents.bio:
Bay Oaks, is a premier golf community located in southeast Houston’s Clear Lake/NASA area. Dan McCarver knows the Clear Lake Real Estate Market very well.

Dan is a native Houstonian and a second-generation Realtor. Licensed since 1977, Dan is familiar with Clear Lake’s finest neighborhoods and focuses on the golf community of Bay Oaks.

He has handled over 620+ resale homes in Bay Oaks over the last twenty-two years. Over the years, Dan’s stellar reputation has earned him referrals and repeat business as the “go-to” agent for Bay Oaks properties and other Clear Lake area luxury residences.

Exemplary service is his standard. Dan possesses cool confidence, a professional demeanor, and a gracious personality, which is a winning combination and approach to his craft.

Mentored by his Mother, Barbara McCarver, a leading Real Estate Broker in Houston for 50 years, Barbara served as the first female President of the Houston Association of Realtors. Dan comments, “Real estate is a challenging and rewarding business. Having grown up around home sales, it seems second nature to me.”

Dan McCarver has achieved the #1 position in resale real estate transaction sales volume many times in the Clear Lake area. His success is no surprise. The honors and recognition he has received are indicative of his commitment, professionalism, and level of understanding in this specialized discriminating market.

Chris also has firsthand experience with waterfront and second-home ownership on Lake Livingston, giving him practical insight into vacation homes, secondary residences, waterfront properties, and short-term rental opportunities.

agents.bio:
Over 18 years and hundreds of millions of dollars in Houston closings taught me one thing that never changes: the deal is won before anyone signs — in the prep, the pricing, and the negotiation. That's where I go to work for you.

I'm Le Nguyen, Broker and Owner of Go-M Realty, and I took the road less traveled to get here. I hold an accounting degree from UH-Downtown, so I read a contract the way few agents do — every number, every clause, every dollar that should stay in your pocket. Before real estate, I worked as a contractor for the U.S. Army in Kirkuk, Iraq, during the war as a purchaser, handling logistics, supplies and contracts. I also spent 16 years coaching competitive women's gymnastics — a sport where everything comes down to preparation, nerve, and executing when it counts. Those chapters shaped how I run a deal today. The numbers stay tight, and I don't flinch when the stakes climb.

When it's time to sell, I don't sit on a listing and hope. I market it hard — sharp pricing, strong presentation, and a strategy built to put your property in front of the right buyers fast. I'm a Certified Luxury Home Marketing Specialist and a Certified Negotiation Expert, but the part of my business I'm proudest of is the referrals. Most of my clients come from people I've worked with before — folks who trusted me enough to send me their family and friends. I don't take that lightly, and I've built my whole career on earning it.

When I'm not at the closing table, you'll find me in the gym, hunting down a new restaurant across town, planning my next trip, or getting talked back to by Lola, my parrot. When you're ready to make a move in Houston, I'd be proud to be your partner.

Chris Charboneau brings more than 28 years of real estate experience, more than $550 million in career sales volume, and over 850 completed transactions. A recipient of numerous Top Producer awards, Chris has built his career helping buyers and sellers throughout the Houston area with a combination of market knowledge, strategic marketing, and experienced guidance.

He earned both his Marketing degree and MBA from Texas Tech University and has extensive experience in both Houston’s Inner Loop and suburban markets. Having lived in both areas, with an office in the Rice Village area, Chris offers a valuable perspective to clients moving across Houston. He has helped many families transition both into the city and out to the suburbs, advising them on neighborhoods, schools, commutes, housing styles, and lifestyle considerations.

Chris also has firsthand experience with waterfront and second-home ownership on Lake Livingston, giving him practical insight into vacation homes, secondary residences, waterfront properties, and short-term rental opportunities.

Outside of real estate, Chris has coached travel baseball for 12 years and has coached 35 players who have gone on to play college baseball. His son currently plays at Baylor University. For families relocating to Houston with children involved in baseball, Chris can also provide valuable insight into local travel organizations, facilities, and programs.

Chris enjoys spending time with his wife, Amber, their three children, and their two golden retrievers.

For over 25 years Cindy Boutwell has proudly served the Greater Houston real estate market. With deep roots in the community, they specialize in Cypress and surrounding areas including Tomball, Spring, Magnolia, Waller, Hockley, Northwest Harris County, Waller County, and Montgomery County.
Working from an award-winning office recognized for both production and quality of service, Cindy and her team has earned the trust and respect of their clients. Their reputation is built on professionalism, integrity, and exceptional client care.
Community Commitment
The Boutwell Team believes real estate is about more than buying and selling homes—it’s about building stronger communities. Cindy and Dan are proud to partner with local schools throughout the year, volunteering at events, speaking at 1000 Guys in Ties and 1000 Girls in Tiaras, Volunteering at local schools providing support for teachers.
They also give back by supporting Family Ties, Family Resource Services, where Cindy currently serves as Board President. Through fundraising efforts and hands-on service, they continue to make a positive difference in the lives of local families. In 2025 Boutwell Properties helped raise over $50k for Family Ties, Family Resource Services. The Boutwell Team ONLY partners with local title companies, lenders, cleaning crews, contractors that share the same values of giving back to our local community. 
Professional Expertise
Certified Home Marketing Specialist – Cindy helps sellers “Dress Your House for Success,” ensuring every property is market-ready and appealing to buyers.
Luxury Home Specialist – Offering premium service for high-end properties.
Unmatched Market Knowledge – Dan and Cindy EACH have over 22 years of experience successfully negotiating contracts, listing homes, representing both buyers and sellers and investors.
Full-Time Realtors® – Dedicated to clear communication and seamless guidance throughout the buying and selling process.
Team Culture
For Our Clients
Our culture is built around service, trust, and relationships. When you work with The Boutwell Team, you’re treated like family. We believe in relationships over transactions, guiding you with honesty, transparency, and care every step of the way. From the first meeting to the closing table and beyond, you’ll feel supported, informed, and confident in your decisions.

For Our Team
Behind the scenes, The  Cindy Boutwell Team thrives on collaboration, mentorship, and shared success. Our 12 agents work in a supportive environment where knowledge is freely shared, achievements are celebrated, and personal growth is encouraged. We believe that when our team feels valued and empowered, our clients receive the very best service possible.
The Team
The Cindy Boutwell Team is comprised of local community leaders who share a commitment to exceptional service. Their collective goal is to provide clients with the knowledge, tools, and confidence they need to make the best decisions—whether buying a dream home or selling a current one.

agents.bio:
When searching for a real estate professional, some of the most sought-after qualities are integrity, energy, hard work, dedication, and knowledge. To find all of those qualities and more, one need looks no further than Pamela Brown. Pamela's education and work history primed her well for the real estate industry. Her Bachelor's degree in accounting speaks to her talent for numbers and precision and, together with 12 years’ experience in commercial real estate development, as well as six years working with a general contractor and over a decade of residential real estate, leaves her ready to exceed all her clients' expectations.

Pamela grew up in the Chicagoland area, which provided her with a uniquely Midwestern style and sensibility. Having now lived in southern California for over 30 years, she leverages this diverse perspective and a vast array of market knowledge to the benefit of her clients, ranging from first-time buyers to seasoned investors and cross-country relocation clients. She's lived in Brentwood for 30+ years and serves as a Board Member on the Brentwood Community Council and on the Advisory Board of South Brentwood Resident's Association. Often found hiking in the Santa Monica Mountains or walking dogs around the neighborhood, Pamela recalls her own experience finding a home over 30 years ago. "I believe it's important to love where you live. A home is such a significant investment, with the potential to affect both your finances and your quality of life."

Besides being actively involved in serving the community in which she resides, Pamela's passion for service extends to her charitable contributions as well. In addition to being a Board Member of and contributor to The Charitable Foundation, Pamela has volunteered for the West LA Police Department, Make-A-Wish Foundation as a Wish Provider, and has been involved with fundraising for several other organizations such as Hope for Paws, the Children's Hospital of LA, SPCA-LA, St. Jude, USO, ASPCA, and the Red Cross.

remarks: Welcome home to this meticulously maintained townhome in the quiet and desirable Memorial Club community. This charming 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers warm, inviting living spaces filled with natural light, crown molding, plantation shutters, beautiful engineered wood flooring, newly painted, new carpet and updated lighting in the family room and kitchen.The flexible floor plan includes spacious living and dining areas, a bright kitchen with abundant storage, and a cozy breakfast room overlooking the private courtyard. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms, each with its own bathroom, providing comfort and privacy. The tranquil courtyard patio, complete with a pergola and lush landscaping, creates the perfect outdoor retreat. Beyond the patio is a two-car covered carport and private storage closet. Lovingly cared for and move-in ready, this home combines timeless character, comfort, and convenience in one of Memorial's most established communities.

agents.bio:
A Top Producer for over a decade in Real Estate, Nicole Brende was born into a real estate family. Raised in Las Vegas, Nicole she got to Texas as fast as she could and earned a bachelor's degree in broadcast journalism at Southern Methodist University in Dallas. Nicole grew up in a real-estate oriented family. Her father develops award winning master-planned communities in Houston and her mother and other family members practice real estate in Nevada, California, and Idaho. I grew up touring properties and job sites, says Nicole. I knew one day I would be helping clients with their real estate needs and I could not wait. In fact, it's in my blood.

Prior to her career in residential real estate, Nicole was a professional on-camera television host and producer for 10 years. Her programs included “Hot On! Homes” for KPRC Local 2, “Designing America” on HDNet, and “Designing Texas,” all of which kept her in contact with various facets of real estate. “I really enjoyed showcasing the beautiful homes and educating buyers about the current inventory as well as the quality of the builders we featured,” says Nicole. She was also a live television news reporter /producer and a former co-founder/publisher of one of Houston’s first online society magazines. As a Realtor, Nicole uses her media and marketing skills to get “top dollar” for her sellers.

Nicole attributes her success to dedication to her clients, a deep love of real estate, and, most importantly, building strong relationships that result in repeat sales and client referrals to family and friends. She believes that one of the best aspects of residential real estate sales is the lifestyle she is able to present to so many individuals and families, and the personal satisfaction she receives from helping them to make a major change in their lives. According to Nicole, “a home is the one place we get to personalize and make our very own and finding the right neighborhood matters.”

An excellent listener and communicator, Nicole is always accessible to her clients. She understands marketing, knows how to deliver and follow through, and stays current with the Houston real estate market. Nicole often finds homes for her buyers that are not yet on the market, and she is an excellent resource for homeowners who are considering a sale. She is also certified to work with relocation buyers, a specialized skill much in demand in a fast-moving city like Houston.

Nicole is proud to support her community. She serves on numerous charitable host committees and stays active with the SMU Houston alumni chapter, Alpha Chi Omega sorority, and DAR Lady Washington Chapter. Nicole is a guest writer for local publications and writes her own blog, the "Trende Brende Report". When not working, she enjoys spending quality time with her husband & family, traveling, and attending the Houston Symphony, Theater Under the Stars, charity events, and completing creative projects around the house.

remarks: Updated Oak Forest home with a whole-home Generac generator and mechanical upgrades! This well-maintained, single-story 3-bedroom, 2-bath home blends 1955 character with modern comfort. Updates include a 2021 3.5-ton HVAC with APCO UV light, 2017 electrical panel and attic insulation with radiant barrier, Wi-Fi-enabled sprinklers, French drains, and a 2025 garage door and motor. The open floor plan connects the sitting area, formal dining room, kitchen, breakfast area, and family room. Highlights include original hardwood floors, granite countertops, white shaker-style cabinetry, stainless appliances, peninsula seating, and a walk-in pantry. The primary suite offers a walk-in closet and remodeled bath with dual sinks and an oversized shower featuring dual showerheads/rainfall feature, bench, and niche. Enjoy a fully turfed backyard, covered paver patio with ceiling fans, privacy fence, gated front porch, one-car garage, two-car carport, and access to White Oak Bayou Trail.

remarks: Featuring a first-floor junior suite, an expansive second-floor great room, and a spacious private deck, this three-story townhome at The Heights at Ponte Vista offers versatile living spaces and an impressive collection of upgrades. The first-floor junior suite features a separate entrance, direct access to the main residence, and pre-wiring for a future kitchenette. Upstairs, the open-concept great room provides ample space for distinct living and dining areas, seamlessly connecting to the outdoor deck. The generously sized kitchen features an oversized island with abundant seating, classic white shaker-style cabinetry, upgraded countertops, and all-electric, energy-efficient appliances, including an induction cooktop, built-in oven, vent hood, and microwave drawer. Additional features include window blinds throughout, owned solar panels, and an attached two-car garage pre-plumbed for future EV charging. Community amenities include a pool, spa, fire pit, recreation center, fitness center, and outdoor BBQ areas with covered dining. Conveniently located in the South Bay, with access to Redondo Beach, Torrance, Long Beach, Anaheim, and Downtown Los Angeles.

remarks: This beautiful brick bungalow has been restored to it's original glory with permits from the city of Houston. The home features high 9 ft ceilings throughout, intricate custom trimwork to match the original 1930 design, refinished solid wood floors, original restored 1930 gas fireplace, repaired and restored original 1930 doors, coupled with high end large format tile finishes in both bathrooms. The primary bathroom features a huge double shower. The kitchen features shaker cabinetry, quartzite countertops, subway tile backsplash, high end appliances and a utilitarian use of the space. Lots of natural light throughout the home coming in through the many windows that the home has metal fencing with a motorized gate on 2 sides of the property.
