agents.bio:
Kate Myhan brings a highly distinctive background to commercial real estate, combining international business experience, advanced academic training, strategic marketing expertise, and hands-on dealmaking across multiple asset types. Based in Houston, Texas, Kate works with commercial property owners, investors, developers, landlords, tenants, and business buyers locally, nationally, and internationally. In addition to representing clients in Texas, she also works with national buyers pursuing opportunities in other states, helping them identify, evaluate, and secure the right assets based on their investment goals.

With a Master’s in Economics and more than two decades of experience in marketing, management, client relations, and real estate investing, Kate offers a sophisticated, results-driven approach to every assignment. Her professional background includes serving as a strategic marketing professor in Santiago, Chile, where she taught MBA students and developed high-level expertise in positioning, negotiation, market strategy, and consumer behavior. That international academic and business experience gives her a rare advantage in commercial real estate, especially when advising clients on marketability, asset positioning, and investment potential.

Kate has built her reputation on strong relationships, creative problem-solving, relentless work ethic, and an ability to connect the right people to the right opportunities. She is known for identifying value where others may not, whether in on-market listings, off-market deals, redevelopment sites, land opportunities, industrial assets, retail properties, mixed-use projects, multifamily investments, or business-related real estate transactions. Her combination of analytical thinking and marketing expertise allows her to not only find opportunities, but also present and promote properties in a way that drives attention and results.

Her experience is especially valuable to clients seeking guidance on acquisitions, dispositions, site selection, development potential, investment strategy, and high-visibility property marketing. Kate understands that commercial real estate success requires more than simply listing a property or submitting an offer—it requires insight, negotiation skill, persistence, financial awareness, and the ability to create momentum around a deal. She approaches each client relationship with professionalism, urgency, and a commitment to maximizing value.

Kate is a member of the Houston Association of Realtors, Texas REALTORS®, National Association of Realtors, and the CCIM Institute. She holds respected industry credentials including CCIM (Certified Commercial Investment Member), CIPS (Certified International Property Specialist), TACS (Texas Accredited Commercial Specialist), and CRS (Certified Residential Specialist). Fluent in English, Spanish, French, and Polish, she is able to work effectively with a diverse range of clients, including international investors and cross-border buyers.

Clients appreciate Kate for her extensive market knowledge, global perspective, broad-based network, and unwavering devotion to their success. Her business is built largely through referrals and repeat relationships, reflecting the trust she earns through outstanding service, strategic guidance, and strong results. Whether representing a Houston-based owner, an out-of-state investor, or a national buyer expanding into new markets, Kate brings the experience, intelligence, and dealmaking energy needed to move complex transactions forward.

agents.bio:
Evan Compean is the founder of The Compean Group, a boutique Houston real estate team known for data-driven pricing, high-end marketing and skilled negotiation. A licensed agent since 2012 and a real estate investor since 2002, Evan has sold more than $250 million in real estate and brings a builder's and investor's eye to every home, from foundation and roof to resale value.

Areas: Houston Heights, Woodland Heights, Garden Oaks/Oak Forest, Montrose, Midtown, West University, Bellaire, Spring Branch, Pearland, Katy, Cypress and The Woodlands.

Specialties: Luxury and new construction, investment and multifamily properties, land, first-time buyers, and relocation.

Evan is also a licensed loan officer and a partner at Smart Title, so clients get guidance on financing and closing from someone who knows every step. Se habla español. With 400+ five-star reviews across Zillow, Google, Yelp and Realtor.com, The Compean Group focuses on clear communication and a smooth process from first call to closing.

remarks: NO HOA FEES. NO RESTRICTIONS. agents.bio:
Founder and President of Energy Realty, Sherry Campbell is recognized as the most successful broker in the burgeoning Energy Corridor and West Houston. Energy Realty is a Houston-based, privately owned, top producing boutique brokerage with a global client list. Sherry is known within the industry as a real estate, entrepreneur, and innovator. Leading by example and fostering the success of agents. A true thought leader, Campbell is an admitted perfectionist who believes in giving her clients and team members 110%.

Campbell, a supportive broker, established Energy Realty in 2012. Since that time, she has grown it to include 40+ agents, two offices and posted more than $130M in production in 2022. Known for her inimitable integrity, five-star service, mentoring skills, ability to analyze and respond to market changes and commitment to community. She recognizes what today’s agents need to be successful. Campbell is a working broker – dealing with buyers and sellers on a daily basis.

Andrea believes that a Realtor® is someone who should not only represent your best interests but also make the experience of real estate a pleasant and fun experience! Andrea moved to Houston from Caracas Venezuela in 2008 to study at the University of Houston. She chose to make Houston her home when she fell in love with the city of Houston and its people.
She realized that Houston is a city full of culture, diversity and wonderful friendly people! Andrea decided to finish her studies at the University of Houston and met a fellow Houstonian-Venezuelan and now is married with twins!! After purchasing her own home, Andrea was drawn to the real estate process and decided to become a Realtor®. She believes that it is not just a transaction but a key moment in someone’s life and having a professional by their side is very important.

Andrea has lived in several areas of the city and has knowledge of the Inner Loop as well as the Energy Corridor and Katy! Buying a home is one of the biggest investments someone makes in their lifetime, and Andrea knows this well. She decided to join Energy Realty’s professional team of Realtors® so that she could be professionally trained in all the intricate steps of the home buying or selling process. She is committed to offering professional guidance in the home buying and selling process while always looking after the best interests of her clients. As a foreign national herself who is now an American citizen, Andrea knows what is like to relocate to a new city or country! She loves helping her clients find the right community and the perfect home.

remarks: Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac street in established Champion Forest North, this impressive home features many updates completed in 2024. Generous living and dining spaces flow into a bright kitchen with quartz countertops, extensive cabinetry, center island and adjoining breakfast area. A first-floor bedroom and full bath offer added flexibility. Upstairs, the spacious primary suite features a beautifully updated bath with dual vanities, freestanding soaking tub and oversized frameless glass shower. Secondary bedrooms include a Jack-and-Jill bath with private vanity areas, plus another bedroom with an en-suite bath. The upper-level bonus room with built-ins can serve as a game room, media room, office or 6th bedroom. Additional 2024 improvements include updated baths, flooring, paint, fixtures, lighting and replacement of both interior and exterior HVAC units. Covered patio, fenced backyard, sprinkler system and extended garage. Neighborhood pool, tennis courts and playground.

He even manages his own portfolio of fourteen homes that he leases in the Greater Houston market – which makes him notably qualified to work with investors on all levels. When it comes to selling, Todd is the go-to guy.

Todd’s marketing savvy, presence on social media, and knowledge of what moves property sets him apart from others. Sellers can be sure Todd will get the job done. In his spare time, Todd enjoys spending time with his teenage son and three dogs, volunteering for animal rescue groups, and developing his own investment portfolio. 

Real estate truly is his passion, and he prides himself on being “hyper-responsive to client needs.” Todd Russo is eager to work with buyers, sellers, and investors in the Greater Houston area.

remarks: A fresh chapter begins in Windsong with a home that has seen an impressive series of updates inside and out. The fully bricked exterior received new paint in 2025, along with newly-installed front-yard grass and a flower bed, while all three exterior doors were replaced in 2026. Inside, most walls have been freshly painted, select flooring was updated, and the guest bathroom received a 2026 refresh. The kitchen is equipped with a new dishwasher, microwave, and gas oven purchased in 2025, adding modern convenience to the space. A new 3.5-ton HVAC system was installed in August 2026, while new lighting and ceiling fans throughout add a polished finishing touch. The roof was replaced in 2018, rounding out the extensive list of improvements. Mere steps away from Wilson Elementary and located near Barker Cypress Road and West Little York Road, the property also offers convenient access to Bear Creek Pioneers Park, shopping, dining, and everyday amenities.

HOUSTON, TX
Mary Wassef is a proud Canadian who has made Houston her beloved home, emerging as a leading expert in luxury real estate within The Heights and its historic markets. With over two decades of experience, Mary blends her deep knowledge of historic architecture with modern construction techniques, offering a unique perspective to her diverse clientele. Her multicultural background and extensive network allow her to connect with clients from all walks of life, providing an empathetic and tailored real estate experience. Mary's unwavering commitment to her clients' dreams and goals truly sets her apart. She makes the real estate journey enjoyable and even fun, understanding the profound life changes it often represents. Her dedication extends to walking alongside her clients through every transaction, ensuring that each step is handled with precision and care. In 2011, Mary founded Circa Real Estate, which flourished under her leadership with a team of nearly 30 agents renowned for their personalized and unique services. Her approach is characterized by generosity, selflessness, and an unmatched work ethic, inspiring her team to consistently go above and beyond. Her 19th Street storefront stands as a testament to her commitment to community development, frequently hosting local art, community events, and support for neighborhood businesses. Recently, Mary has transitioned her team, the Circa Houston Group, to Realty of America, allowing her to expand her reach while maintaining the personalized service her clients have come to expect. For Mary, Houston's Heights is more than just a location; it's a cherished community. Whether you're buying, selling, or investing, Mary Wassef is your trusted partner in navigating this vibrant and historic Houston neighborhood.

remarks: Welcome to this charming home in the highly sought-after Timbergrove Manor neighborhood, just minutes from The Heights! Large glass doors connect the interior to a beautiful backyard retreat featuring a private swimming pool and relaxing outdoor spaces, perfect for entertaining or enjoying Houston's warm weather. Refrigerator, washer, and dryer are included. Ideally located near parks, walking and biking trails, popular restaurants, and shopping, with convenient access to Loop 610, Highway 290, I-10, Downtown Houston, The Galleria, and the Texas Medical Center. An exceptional opportunity for homeowners or investors seeking location, lifestyle desirable established neighborhoods.

agents.bio:
Tyrone Deckard, MRP, ABR®

Realtor | Brown & Deckard Realty Team
VA Loan & Community Heroes Real Estate Specialist
Serving Willis, Conroe, and Spring, Texas

With over 20 years of honorable service in the United States Air Force as a Security Forces member, Tyrone Deckard brings elite discipline, integrity, and mission-driven execution to his real estate career. A proud veteran, he specializes in serving veterans, active-duty military, first responders, nurses, and teachers—the Community Heroes who serve and protect our communities.

As a Military Relocation Professional (MRP) and Accredited Buyer’s Representative (ABR®), Tyrone has extensive experience helping clients navigate VA Loans, military relocations (PCS moves), and complex real estate transactions. He is well-versed in VA eligibility, zero-down financing, VA assumable loans, and the timelines unique to military and public-service careers.

Tyrone’s firsthand military experience allows him to confidently guide service members and their families through buying or selling a home. His focus is delivering a seamless, stress-free VA Loan process, from offer to closing, while protecting his clients’ interests every step of the way.

For first responders, nurses, and educators, Tyrone provides a highly personalized, advocacy-driven approach. He understands demanding schedules, budget considerations, and the importance of finding a home that supports long-term stability, safety, and quality of life.

A defining highlight of Tyrone’s military career was the honor of protecting Air Force One—an experience that shaped his standard of precision, accountability, and professionalism, a philosophy he brings to every real estate transaction.

Whether you are buying with a VA Loan, relocating, selling, or investing in Willis, Conroe, or Spring, Tyrone Deckard is committed to serving Community Heroes with integrity, care, and results-driven expertise.

Contact Tyrone today and work with a Realtor who understands service, sacrifice, and success.

Her single-minded devotion to excellence and unparalleled commitment to customer service have resulted in a continuously expanding network of loyal clients and referrals.
